title: Combining Retrieval-Augmented Text Generation with LLMs for Reading Content Recommendations
summary: This work presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a system for generating personalized reading content using Large Language Models (LLMs) combined with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The proposed architecture consists of four modules: Input, RAG, Generation, and Judging and enables users to specify both a question and a target reading content complexity. RAG is employed to retrieve relevant information from the Internet, enriching and grounding the content produced by three modern LLMs: Meta LLaMA 4 Scout, LLaMA 3.1 8B Instant, and Google Gemma2 9B. Reading materials are generated using three prompting strategies (Chain-of-Thought, zero-shot, and few-shot), and the LLM-as-a-Judge module automatically evaluates answer quality and alignment with the desired readability level. Experimental results show that RAG consistently improves system performance across all models and prompting techniques, increasing relevance and particularly groundedness by up to 26-35 percentage points. Overall, the findings demonstrate that the RAG-augmented architecture effectively produces reading content tailored to user queries and desired textual complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合RAG架构与LLM的系统，根据用户需求生成定制化难度的阅读材料，并通过实验证实RAG能显著增强生成内容的 groundedness 和相关性。
AI.motivation: 为了解决如何利用大语言模型（LLMs）结合检索增强生成（RAG）技术，生成满足用户特定主题且具备特定阅读难度级别（复杂度）的个性化阅读内容的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一套包含输入、RAG（检索增强生成）、生成、评估（LLM-as-a-Judge）四个模块的系统架构；使用了Meta LLaMA 4 Scout、LLaMA 3.1 8B Instant和Google Gemma2 9B三款模型；采用了思维链（CoT）、零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shot）三种提示策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，RAG技术一致性地提升了所有模型和提示策略的性能，其中关联性和接地气程度（groundedness）分别提升了26-35个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RAG与LLM的结合显著提升了生成内容的准确性和接地气程度（groundedness），证实了该架构在实现个性化、符合特定复杂度要求的阅读材料生成方面的有效性。

title: Co-Scraper: query-aware DOM Pruning and Reusable Scraper Synthesis for Lightweight Web Data Extraction
summary: The abundant and heterogeneous nature of web content necessitates automated information extraction, and generating scrapers that can be reused across similar web pages offers an effective solution for scalable data extraction. In this work, we propose Co-Scraper, a two-stage framework capable of handling the hierarchical complexity of long HTML documents. By integrating a query-aware DOM pruning mechanism with stable extraction strategy induction, Co-Scraper can effectively transforms web content into executable programmatic wrappers using a fine-tuned Qwen3-8B model. On the test set of SWDE, Co-Scraper achieves state-of-the-art performance with an F1 score of 94.78% and a reuse success rate of 90.39%. This framework significantly enhances the accuracy and resilience of data extraction, providing a highly efficient approach for web data acquisition tasks.

AI.tldr: Co-Scraper 是一个基于 Qwen3-8B 的两阶段网页抓取框架，通过查询感知修剪和策略归纳，实现了高效、高精度且具备跨页面复用能力的自动化数据提取。
AI.motivation: 网页内容海量且异构，为了实现可扩展的数据抓取，需要能够跨相似网页重用的自动化信息提取解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段框架 Co-Scraper：第一阶段采用查询感知的 DOM 修剪（Query-aware DOM pruning）处理长文档的层级复杂度；第二阶段利用微调后的 Qwen3-8B 模型进行稳定的提取策略归纳，并将网页内容转化为可执行的程序封装（Wrappers）。
AI.result: 在 SWDE 测试集上取得了 94.78% 的 F1 分数，且复用成功率达到 90.39%，达到了业内领先（SOTA）水平。
AI.conclusion: Co-Scraper 通过结合查询感知 DOM 修剪和策略归纳，有效解决了大规模网页数据抓取的复杂性和可重用性问题，显著提升了提取精度与稳健性。

title: Retrieval-as-a-Service:A System-Oriented Analysis of Industrial Retrieval Pipelines in Web Systems
summary: Retrieval systems have become a foundational infrastructure component in modern Web services, supporting applications such as content recommendation, advertising targeting, and API discovery. In large-scale industrial environments, retrieval is increasingly deployed as an independent service layer, commonly referred to as Retrieval-as-a-Service (RaaS). This paper presents a system-oriented survey of industrial retrieval pipelines, focusing on architectural design and deployment trade-offs under real-world constraints. Unlike prior surveys that emphasize algorithmic developments, we analyze retrieval systems from an infrastructure perspective, highlighting how latency requirements, scalability constraints, and resource limitations shape system design in production environments. We introduce a unified RaaS pipeline abstraction that models retrieval as a multi-stage service, including high-efficiency candidate generation, embedding-based semantic matching, and resource-aware re-ranking. We further examine the integration of Large Language Model (LLM)-based retrieval mechanisms and analyze their impact on semantic performance, latency, and computational overhead. The results provide a system-level understanding of retrieval as a service-oriented infrastructure and offer practical guidelines for designing scalable, efficient, and QoS-aware retrieval architectures in large-scale Web systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了工业级检索系统的架构设计，提出了“检索即服务”（RaaS）的统一抽象，重点分析了在生产约束（延迟、规模、资源）下，如何通过多阶段流水线及LLM集成构建高效的检索基础设施。
AI.motivation: 现有调查多关注算法层面，缺乏从工业生产环境的系统架构、延迟约束、可扩展性及资源限制角度对“检索即服务”（RaaS）的研究。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的RaaS流水线抽象模型，涵盖了高效候选生成、基于嵌入（embedding）的语义匹配以及资源感知的重排序阶段；并通过系统级分析，探讨了LLM在检索系统中的集成及其对性能、延迟和资源开销的影响。
AI.result: 揭示了生产环境中架构设计与部署权衡的规律，分析了LLM集成在语义性能与计算开销之间的平衡点，定义了RaaS在现代Web服务中的基础设施角色。
AI.conclusion: 该论文通过系统架构的视角，为大型Web系统设计可扩展、高效且具有服务质量（QoS）保障的检索架构提供了实践指南，确立了检索即服务（RaaS）在工业界的核心基础设施地位。

title: Beyond Positive Signals: Unlocking Implicit Negative Behaviors for Enhanced Sequential User Modeling
summary: User behavior sequence modeling has become a central component in modern click-through rate (CTR) prediction. Over the past years, the community has invested substantial effort into improving how sequences are encoded, from target-aware attention and interest evolution networks to unified architectures that jointly process sequential and non-sequential features. However, a more fundamental question remains under-explored: what should constitute the behavior sequence? Current practice constructs sequences exclusively from positive interactions (clicks, purchases, completions), while the far more abundant implicit negative behaviors (skips, low engagement, scroll-past) are largely underutilized. As gains from longer positive sequences approach diminishing returns, we revisit this underutilized data source within the sequential modeling framework. In this paper, we demonstrate that mixed-polarity behavior sequences, which chronologically interleave positive and negative tokens within a fixed length budget, consistently outperform positive-only sequences across diverse model architectures with negligible additional computational overhead. We further identify a semantic indistinguishability problem inherent to naive polarity embeddings and propose Target-Aware Polarity Fusion (TAPF), a lightweight target-conditioned gating mechanism that provides additional gains by differentiating behavioral evidence. Notably, even the simpler polarity bias baseline captures the majority of improvement, underscoring that the primary contribution is the mixed-polarity data paradigm itself. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements of +1.9% to +9.6% relative AUC across five architectures, which validate the practical value of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本研究打破了CTR预测中仅利用正向行为序列的惯例，提出引入隐式负面行为构造“混合极性序列”，并配合TAPF机制显著提升了点击预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: CTR预测中现有的行为建模仅关注正向交互行为（点击、购买），忽略了海量的隐式负面行为（跳过、低停留时长等）。随着正向序列长度提升带来的边际效应递减，利用负面行为提供更全面的用户兴趣表征成为研究重点。
AI.method: 1. 提出混合极性序列构建方法，即在固定长度内按时间顺序交错正负反馈行为；2. 针对极性嵌入引入的语义模糊问题，提出Target-Aware Polarity Fusion (TAPF)机制，通过目标条件门控机制增强行为证据的区分度。
AI.result: 在三个公共基准测试和五种主流模型架构上进行了验证，相对AUC提升幅度达1.9%至9.6%；证明了混合极性数据范式本身就是性能提升的主要贡献源。
AI.conclusion: 将隐式负面行为引入用户行为序列构建是提升CTR预测性能的有效手段。研究证实了混合极性序列（positive-only到mixed-polarity）的范式转移能够带来显著的性能提升，且具备极高的计算效率和通用性。

title: uringscope: Portable, Low-Overhead Observability for io_uring
summary: io_uring moves I/O submission and completion into shared-memory rings. This makes it fast, and it also makes it invisible. strace sees only the ring setup, and the kernel tracepoints that expose the request flow are not stable ABI, so the few tools built on them work only on narrow kernel ranges. We present uringscope, a single-binary, language-agnostic observability tool for io_uring built on CO-RE (Compile Once, Run Everywhere) eBPF. uringscope makes four contributions. The first is a precise model of the request lifecycle and a method to reconstruct per-request flows from kernel events. The second is a technique for attaching portably to an unstable tracepoint surface, using BTF-probed program variants, CO-RE field flavors, and position-independent reads. The third is an evaluation of the tradeoff between overhead and fidelity: on device-bound NVMe workloads uringscope's aggregate mode costs 0.7 to 9.9% of throughput, which is cheaper than every full-fidelity alternative we measured. The fourth is a lightweight correctness mode that reuses the same reconstruction to detect submission-boundary hazards, together with a built-in doctor that turns the measurements into named pathologies with evidence, for operators who are debugging a tail-latency incident rather than browsing histograms.

AI.tldr: 针对 io_uring 高性能、不可见的特性，本文开发了 uringscope，利用 CO-RE eBPF 技术克服了不稳定 tracepoint 的限制，实现了低开销的请求追踪与自动化性能诊断。
AI.motivation: io_uring 由于采用了共享内存环形缓冲区机制，导致传统的系统调用追踪工具（如 strace）失效，且内核 tracepoint 的 ABI 不稳定，缺乏成熟的内核态观测工具来诊断性能问题。
AI.method: 1. 利用 CO-RE eBPF 实现跨内核版本的可移植性；2. 构建精确的 io_uring 请求生命周期模型以及请求流重构方法；3. 采用 BTF 探测程序变体、CO-RE 字段变体和位置无关读取技术解决不稳定 tracepoint 的接管难题；4. 提供聚合模式（高性能）与正确性模式（调试辅助）。
AI.result: 在磁盘 I/O 负载测试中，uringscope 的聚合模式性能开销在 0.7% 到 9.9% 之间，优于当前所有全保真度的对比工具；同时能够准确识别提交边界的配置错误并提供自动化的病理诊断。
AI.conclusion: uringscope 通过 CO-RE eBPF 技术解决了 io_uring 的观测难题，在保持低开销的同时，提供了从单次请求追踪到系统级诊断的全面观测能力。

title: Green AI Carbon Optimizer: Carbon-Efficient Training Location Recommendation and Global AI Energy Demand Forecasting
summary: AI training and deployment consume substantial electricity, but carbon outcomes remain weakly integrated into routine model development decisions. This paper presents Green AI Carbon Optimizer with two primary contributions: (i) a carbon aware cloud region recommendation method for training workloads, and (ii) a power law forecasting pipeline for global AI energy demand. For location recommendation, we combine regional grid carbon intensity, renewable share, and data center Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) into a unified scoring model across 100+ regions from major cloud providers. For a reference workload (8*A100, 100h), estimated emissions in our sampled regions range from 7.74kg to 272.00kg CO2. Selecting the best region instead of the worst corresponds to a 97.2% reduction relative to the worst case. Ablation shows that ranking by renewable share alone can select regions with higher CO2 emissions than rankings that include grid carbon intensity. For forecasting, we fit a power law relation between parameter count and training energy using 26 anchor models. We combine this fit with scenario assumptions on model growth, hardware efficiency, and training frequency, and evaluate sensitivity to inference ratio and ecosystem scaling. Across scenarios, projected 2030 demand ranges from 7TWh to 1,436TWh under the stated assumptions, highlighting the importance of deployment choices, model scaling discipline, and transparent energy reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“绿色人工智能碳优化器（Green AI Carbon Optimizer）”，通过云区域智能推荐显著降低训练排放，并利用幂律模型预测AI行业未来的能源需求，呼吁将碳指标纳入AI模型研发的常规决策。
AI.motivation: AI训练与部署带来的能源消耗巨大，但当前的研发决策流程中尚未充分整合碳排放考量，缺乏针对性的决策辅助工具和行业长期能耗评估。
AI.method: 1. 区域推荐：综合区域电网碳强度、可再生能源占比及数据中心PUE（能源使用效率），建立统一打分模型以优化云端算力调度。2. 需求预测：利用26个基准模型建立模型参数量与训练能耗之间的幂律关系（Power Law），并结合不同场景假设预测未来AI能源需求。
AI.result: 1. 在云区域推荐方面，性能差异巨大，最优与最差区域的排放差距可达97.2%。研究指出，仅凭可再生能源占比排名并不准确，需综合考虑电网碳强度。2. 预测显示，到2030年AI能源需求波动范围极大（7TWh至1,436TWh），强调了模型规模化 discipline 及透明报告的重要性。
AI.conclusion: AI训练和部署的碳排放高度依赖位置选择和模型扩展策略。通过实施区域智能调度和建立模型能源需求预测框架，可以在不降低性能的情况下显著减少碳足迹。未来的AI研发决策需将碳排放指标纳入常规流程。

title: Recurring Public Transit Schedules: Stable Identification from GTFS and Similarity Analysis
summary: Public transit schedules contain recurring service structures: many dates share the same passenger-facing timetable, while others differ because of weekends, holidays, seasons, or special events. GTFS does not encode these recurring schedules directly, so downstream scheduling, assignment, and mismatch models lack an explicit recurrent supply object. This paper formalizes recurring schedules as DayTypes, defined by the complete set of Route Pattern trips operating on a date, and develops a stable GTFS-based extraction method using H3 route-pattern keys. We then define a schedule-comparison framework with exact, time-tolerant, and structural-comparability metrics that distinguish strict timetable differences from small timing shifts and larger service changes. Validation on Japanese and Canadian GTFS feeds shows substantial schedule compression, a median of four nonempty DayTypes per agency in the pairwise-analysis sample, hierarchical nesting between service classes, and country-level differences in the persistence of exact disjointness. The resulting DayTypes provide compact Route-Pattern-time schedule sets for timetable synchronization, vehicle scheduling, demand assignment, and schedule-consolidation analysis.

AI.tldr: 针对 GTFS 缺乏周期性调度编码的问题，本文提出了基于 DayTypes 的提取方法及比较框架，实现了时刻表的高效压缩与结构化分析，适用于交通运筹与规划。
AI.motivation: 目前的 GTFS 标准无法直接编码公共交通中广泛存在的周期性服务结构，导致下游模型难以直观理解时刻表的重复性与差异性。
AI.method: 1. 将时刻表定义为 DayTypes（由特定日期运行的所有路径模式行程集合构成）；2. 使用 H3 路径模式键（Route-Pattern keys）从 GTFS 数据中提取 DayTypes；3. 建立包含精确匹配、时间容忍和结构可比性的综合度量框架。
AI.result: 对日本和加拿大 GTFS 数据验证显示：时刻表压缩效果显著（每家机构中位数仅 4 种非空 DayTypes）；揭示了服务类别的层级嵌套关系，并识别出不同国家在时间表重合度上的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 通过将公共交通时刻表形式化为 DayTypes，并结合 H3 空间索引和多维度比较框架，该研究有效地压缩了复杂的时刻表数据，为交通规划、车辆调度及需求分配等下游应用提供了更简洁、高效的数据基础。

title: Unified KV Pooling to Accelerate Long-Context LLM Serving
summary: Long-context LLM serving requires offloading KV caches to host-memory and SSDs, but existing mechanisms are not designed for such long contexts. We observe significant inefficiencies in current KV caching in long contexts: high serving latency ~30.7 s, exceeding the typical TTFT requirement of 10 s by more than 3x. Our in-depth analysis explains two major reasons: (1) retrieval is serialized through host-memory and SSD, leaving other host-memory modules and SSDs underutilized, and (2) SSD-based KV retrieval spends 84% of its time in the kernel filesystem rather than actual device access. To address the problems, we propose unified KV pooling, which aggregates multiple host-memory modules and SSDs into a single logical pool and distributes KV caches across devices based on their bandwidth. To eliminate the filesystem overhead, we design KV-passthrough, which bypasses the kernel filesystem and directly accesses SSD-resident KV caches from user space via SPDK. Across evaluations on LLaMA 3.1-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B, unified KV pooling reduces TTFT in long-contexts ~4.1x over state-of-the-art techniques, all making under 10 s. It also reduces blocked I/O time by up to 23.2x by eliminating filesystem overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对长上下文LLM服务卸载KV缓存引起的高延迟问题，本文提出了统一KV池化和用户态直接访问（KV-passthrough）机制，有效消除文件系统瓶颈并优化资源调度，显著提升了模型首字响应速度。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM服务中，KV缓存卸载到主机内存和SSD时存在严重效率低下问题（TTFT接近30.7秒，远超10秒限制），主要诱因是串行检索导致资源利用率低，以及内核文件系统开销巨大（占SSD retrieval时间84%）。
AI.method: 1. 统一KV池化（Unified KV Pooling）：将多个主机内存模块和SSD聚合成单一逻辑池，根据带宽动态分配KV缓存；2. KV直接透传（KV-passthrough）：利用SPDK绕过内核文件系统，直接从用户空间访问SSD中的KV缓存。
AI.result: 在LLaMA 3.1-8B、GPT-OSS-20B和Qwen3-30B-A3B模型测试中，TTFT较现有技术降低约4.1倍（均低于10秒），并将阻塞I/O时间大幅缩减了高达23.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入统一KV池化和KV直接透传技术，该系统有效解决了长上下文大模型服务中KV缓存卸载带来的高延迟问题，显著降低了首字延迟（TTFT），使其满足实际应用需求。

title: Differentially Private Submodular Maximization with a Knapsack Constraint
summary: Submodular maximization subject to a knapsack constraint (SMK) is a fundamental problem in discrete optimization, with wide-ranging applications in machine learning and related fields. As these applications increasingly involve sensitive individual data, there is a growing need for high-utility algorithms that provide formal privacy guarantees. In this work, we study the SMK problem under differential privacy, considering both monotone and non-monotone objective functions. For monotone objectives, we propose a differentially private algorithm that achieves the optimal $(1-1/e)$-approximation ratio while significantly improving both additive error and query complexity over prior work. We also present a more efficient algorithm for the same setting, achieving a $1/2$-approximation. For non-monotone objectives, we introduce, to our knowledge, the first differentially private algorithm with provable guarantees, achieving a $1/4$-approximation in expectation and an additive error comparable to the best known for monotone objective functions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了差分隐私下的子模最大化（SMK）问题，为单调和非单调目标函数提供了高精度、低复杂度的近似算法，填补了非单调场景下的理论空白。
AI.motivation: 在机器学习及相关领域中，SMK问题涉及敏感个体数据，亟需在满足差分隐私的前提下，设计兼具高实用性（高精度）和理论保障的优化算法。
AI.method: 设计针对差分隐私的子模最大化算法：对于单调函数，提出分别实现 $(1-1/e)$ 和 $1/2$ 近似比的算法；对于非单调函数，提出实现 $1/4$ 近似比的算法。
AI.result: 1. 单调目标函数：实现了最优的 $(1-1/e)$ 近似，并显著降低了加性误差与查询复杂度；同时提供了 $1/2$ 近似的高效算法。2. 非单调目标函数：提出了首个具有可证明保障的算法，实现了 $1/4$ 期望近似比。
AI.conclusion: 研究为带背包约束的子模最大化问题（SMK）在差分隐私约束下提供了首个或最优的保障，涵盖了单调和非单调目标函数，并优化了算法的近似比与查询复杂度。

title: Poster: EdgeCitadel -- Hybrid NATS-MQTT Orchestration for Edge Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Edge-resident AI agents increasingly span home servers, IoT hubs, laptops, and phones, yet their coordination stacks still assume cloud-style transports or a central relay. We present EdgeCitadel, an edge multi-agent orchestration platform built around a single NATS 2.10 server with the built-in MQTT adapter. The design combines MQTT connectivity for heterogeneous agents, JetStream-backed persistence and replay for backend services, direct peer delegation over a shared subject namespace, and a passive aggregator that visualizes and stores traffic without sitting on the delivery path. Our poster highlights the migration from MQTT relay prototypes (common in IoT communication) to the current hybrid architecture and demonstrates a working cross-device testbed spanning ARM64, x64, and Android clients.

AI.tldr: EdgeCitadel 是一款创新的边缘多智能体编排平台，它放弃了传统的云端中心化通信，转而利用 NATS 及其内置 MQTT 支持，实现了跨异构边缘设备的高效、持久且灵活的对等协调。
AI.motivation: 现有的边缘 AI 智能体协调协议通常依赖于云端传输或中央中继，难以适应边缘环境下设备多样性和去中心化的通信需求，因此需要一种更高效、灵活的架构。
AI.method: 基于 NATS 2.10 服务器及内置 MQTT 适配器构建；采用 JetStream 实现持久化与消息重放；利用共享主题命名空间（shared subject namespace）实现直接的对等委派（peer delegation）；使用被动聚合器（passive aggregator）进行流量监控。
AI.result: 项目完成了从传统 MQTT 中继原型向混合架构的迁移，并成功搭建了跨越多种硬件平台（ARM64、x64 和 Android）的测试床，验证了系统的可行性。
AI.conclusion: EdgeCitadel 通过整合 NATS 及其内置 MQTT 适配器，成功构建了一个能够跨异构硬件（ARM64, x64, Android）高效运行的边缘多智能体编排平台，证明了该架构在边缘计算环境下的有效性。

title: Audited Conformal Prediction for Classification under Unknown Distribution Shift
summary: We consider the problem of uncertainty quantification for a pretrained classification model deployed under unknown distribution shift. We propose Audited Conformal Prediction (ACP), a method that leverages a small labeled dataset from the target population to train an auxiliary audit model identifying inputs where the legacy model is likely to fail. By integrating the audit model's outputs into the conformal prediction framework, ACP produces prediction sets that guarantee marginal coverage while achieving substantially higher conditional coverage in practice than existing approaches. We develop and analyze two complementary integration strategies -- one targeting marginal coverage with improved conditional performance, the other providing explicit group-conditional coverage guarantees -- and establish theoretical guarantees for both. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the method and illustrate trade-offs between prediction set size and conditional coverage.

AI.tldr: 针对部署中遇到的未知分布偏移问题，ACP 通过引入审计模型来预判原模型的失效风险，从而在共形预测中实现更精准的条件覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 在现实应用中，预训练分类模型常面临未知的分布偏移（Distribution Shift），现有的不确定性量化方法难以在保证理论覆盖率的同时，在失效区域提供有效的预测集。
AI.method: 提出“审计共形预测”（Audited Conformal Prediction, ACP）方法：利用目标域的小规模标注数据训练一个辅助审计模型，识别原模型易失效的输入，并将审计结果集成到共形预测框架中；开发并分析了两种集成策略，分别针对整体覆盖优化和明确的组条件覆盖保证。
AI.result: 实验表明，ACP 在合成数据集和真实数据集上均优于现有方法，能够在控制预测集大小的同时，实现更高的条件覆盖率，并具备明确的理论保障。
AI.conclusion: ACP 方法通过结合审计模型与共形预测框架，成功在存在未知分布偏移的情况下，实现了既能保证边际覆盖率，又显著提升了条件覆盖率的目标，为部署预训练分类模型提供了更稳健的不确定性量化手段。

title: Bayesian Optimization for Learning Nonlinear MPC in Autonomous Agent Navigation
comment: Published at the IEEE ICRA 2026 Xplore Workshop (Oral), Cross-Disciplinary aspects of Exploration in Robotics, Reinforcement Learning, and Search
summary:
Real-time autonomous navigation in dynamic, unknown environments remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robotics. We propose a map-free framework that tightly integrates reactive rolling-horizon planning with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC). At each control cycle, a LiDAR-based Gaussian occupancy representation is constructed and used to generate collision-free trajectories via A* search, which are then tracked by a CasADi/IPOPT MPC formulation incorporating a smooth sigmoid obstacle barrier. To improve robustness to parameter sensitivity, we adopt an offline Bayesian optimization scheme based on Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE), which identifies near-optimal controller parameters with respect to a composite navigation objective. In addition, a Gaussian Process surrogate is used to analyze parameter sensitivity and provide insight into the optimization landscape.
  The proposed framework is robot-agnostic and is evaluated on the Unitree Go2 quadruped in simulation using Gazebo, followed by deployment on the physical robot. Experimental results show that parameters tuned in simulation transfer effectively to hardware, maintaining comparable performance without additional tuning. The full system achieves up to a 90.0\% navigation success rate when deployed, along with a 38.9\% average improvement in the evaluation metrics across simulated environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合滚动时域规划与非线性MPC的无图自主导航框架，利用贝叶斯优化提升参数鲁棒性，在四足机器人上实现了高成功率的实时动态避障与导航。
AI.motivation: 解决移动机器人在动态、未知环境中实时自主导航的挑战，特别是提高对参数敏感性的鲁棒性及导航性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种无图（map-free）框架，结合了滚动时域规划与非线性模型预测控制（MPC）；利用基于LiDAR的高斯占用描述进行A*路径规划，并通过带有平滑Sigmoid障碍物惩罚的MPC跟踪；使用基于树结构Parzen估计（TPE）的离线贝叶斯优化进行参数调优，并利用高斯过程代理模型分析参数敏感性。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2四足机器人上验证，实现了高达90.0%的导航成功率，在模拟环境下的综合评测指标提升了38.9%，且成功实现了从仿真到实物的参数迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是机器人通用的，其参数具有良好的仿真向实物迁移能力，无需额外调整即可保持高性能，有效解决了动态未知环境下的实时自主导航难题。

title: PhoneHarness: Harnessing Phone-Use Agents through Mixed GUI, CLI, and Tool Actions
summary: Phone agents are increasingly expected to complete real mobile workflows rather than merely predict the next screen action. However, much of the current mobile-agent literature still evaluates agents primarily as GUI controllers that observe a screen, emit taps and swipes, and are scored by target app state. Real phone-use tasks are broader: they require deciding when to use app GUIs, device-side commands, or structured tools, while leaving evidence that the intended side effect actually occurred. We introduce PhoneHarness, a mixed-action benchmark and execution harness for studying phone-use agents on verifiable mobile workflows. PhoneHarness runs a device-side agent loop over GUI, CLI, and host-side tool actions, combining deterministic action routing with bounded GUI delegation and auditable execution traces. Its benchmark, PhoneHarness Bench, evaluates whether agents complete tasks with observable side effects, not only whether they produce plausible final answers. On the annotated evaluation split, PhoneHarness reaches a 75.0% pass rate, outperforming the strongest non-PhoneHarness settings by 12.9 percentage points. PhoneHarness and PhoneHarness Bench therefore play distinct but mutually dependent roles: the harness makes mixed phone workflows executable, while the benchmark measures whether agents can use that harness reliably and safely. Our findings suggest that reliable phone automation depends on action-surface routing and verifiable execution, not only visual GUI control.

AI.tldr: PhoneHarness是一个旨在处理混合操作（GUI/CLI/工具）的移动智能体基准与执行框架，强调通过验证任务的实际执行结果来评估智能体，而非仅仅评估GUI动作序列。
AI.motivation: 现有的移动智能体研究多局限于GUI控制器（仅观测屏幕、点击/滑动），难以处理实际应用中需要结合GUI、命令行及结构化工具的复杂、可验证的工作流。
AI.method: 提出PhoneHarness，一个支持混合动作（GUI、CLI、主机端工具）的基准测试与执行框架。该框架采用了确定性动作路由、有限GUI委托以及可审计的执行追踪技术。与其对应的PhoneHarness Bench通过观察任务产生的实际副作用（Side Effects）而非仅关注GUI操作序列来评估智能体。
AI.result: 在标注评估集上，PhoneHarness达到了75.0%的通过率，比非PhoneHarness环境高出12.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的手机自动化不仅依赖于视觉GUI控制，更取决于动作表面的路径规划（Action-surface routing）和可验证的执行机制。

title: QPILOTS: Efficient Test-Time Q-Steering for Flow Policies
summary: Flow-matching and diffusion policies are expressive action generators, but optimizing them with temporal-difference reinforcement learning (RL) remains difficult. Effective policy extraction requires exploiting the critic's action gradient, yet directly backpropagating this signal through a multi-step denoising process can be numerically unstable. Existing methods work around this either by discarding gradient information, distilling the policy into a simpler one-step actor, or repeatedly fine-tuning the denoising policy as the critic improves. We propose QPILOTS, a method that leaves the original policy unmodified and steers the denoising process at inference time. At each denoising step, instead of evaluating the critic on the noisy intermediate action where critic predictions are unreliable, we first project that intermediate state to an estimate of the final clean action and compute the critic gradient there. We introduce two variants: QPILOTS-U uses a fast single-point approximation, while QPILOTS-M draws differentiable posterior samples via a learned auxiliary network. On a standard offline-to-online RL benchmark, QPILOTS achieves the best aggregate performance, reaching an average success rate of 90% across 50 tasks. We also apply QPILOTS to steer a large, frozen, pretrained Vision-Language Action (VLA) foundation model, outperforming or matching prior inference-time approaches across six manipulation tasks in simulation.

AI.tldr: QPILOTS 提出了一种推理时引导扩散/流匹配策略的新方法，通过将去噪过程中的中间状态投影至最终动作空间计算评论家梯度，解决了反向传播梯度时的数值不稳定问题，实现了高性能的在线策略适应。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散/流匹配的策略在利用时序差分（TD）RL 进行优化时，直接通过多步去噪过程反向传播评论家梯度会导致数值不稳定，且现有替代方法（蒸馏或反复微调）存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出 QPILOTS 方法：在多步去噪的每一步中，不直接对中间噪声状态进行梯度计算，而是先将中间状态投影到最终去噪动作的估计值，再在此处计算评论家（critic）梯度进行导向。提供两个变体：QPILOTS-U（单点估计）和 QPILOTS-M（基于学习的辅助网络进行可微后验采样）。
AI.result: 在离线到在线 RL 基准测试中取得最优聚合性能（50个任务平均成功率达 90%）；在 steer 大规模预训练 VLA 模型应用中，表现优于或匹敌现有推理时引导方法。
AI.conclusion: QPILOTS 通过在推理阶段引导去噪过程，无需修改预训练模型即可提升策略性能，证明了在扩散/流匹配策略中利用评论家梯度进行推理时控制的有效性。

title: Guiding Federated Graph Recommendation with LLM-encoded knowledge
summary: Graph-based recommender systems are highly effective at extracting collaborative signals from user--item interactions, and federated learning (FL) allows these models to be trained while preserving user privacy. However, aggregating graph representations across distributed, non-IID clients remains a challenge; structural embeddings learned locally often misalign, and naive averaging fails to capture meaningful cross-client relationships. Most existing federated graph methods rely exclusively on structural aggregation, neglecting the rich, global semantic context available in large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we propose a novel framework that uses LLM-encoded knowledge to guide federated graph recommendation. Specifically, clients learn structural representations from local graphs while simultaneously summarizing their typical interaction patterns into compact semantic vectors via a frozen LLM. The central server then uses these LLM-encoded semantic signals to discover related preference patterns across clients, guiding the selective aggregation of their structural representations. This enables semantically informed cross-client collaboration without exposing raw data. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that guiding structural alignment with LLM-encoded knowledge consistently improves recommendation accuracy over existing federated graph baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合LLM语义信息与联邦图学习的推荐框架，通过全局语义向量引导局部结构表示的聚合，解决了联邦图推荐中跨客户端协同对齐的难题。
AI.motivation: 联邦图推荐系统中，由于Non-IID数据导致的局部结构嵌入对齐困难以及简单平均聚合无法捕获跨客户端全局协同信号的问题亟待解决，且现有方法往往忽视了LLM所蕴含的丰富语义背景知识。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于LLM指导的联邦图推荐框架。客户端学习本地结构化表示，并通过冻结的LLM将交互模式转化为紧凑的语义向量；服务器利用这些语义向量发现跨客户端的偏好关联，从而指导结构化表示的选择性聚合。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上的实验表明，该框架能显著提高推荐准确率，证明了将LLM编码的知识引入结构化对齐策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用预训练LLM提供的全局语义信息能有效对齐异构联邦客户端的结构化嵌入，从而解决非独立同分布（Non-IID）数据带来的性能下降问题，显著优于现有仅依赖结构聚合的联邦图推荐方法。

title: StorRep: Storage Research Experiment Patterns on Chameleon Cloud and Trovi
comment: The first two authors contribute equal amount of work and are sorted alphabetically based on their first names
summary: Storage experiments are vital to advancing storage research, but creating extensible and reproducible storage artifacts can be a challenging task. Our research has shown that only 1% of SSD simulator-based experiences are packaged and 0.5% of them can be easily reproduced. The lack of such artifacts without proper reproducibility can significantly impede the advancement of storage research. The biggest challenges in these types of experiments are ensuring that we have the correct environment to conduct them and creating extensible experiments that can be built upon in future research. To address this issue, we introduce StorRep, a thorough study that provides six extensible and reproducible storage experiment artifacts that serve as the foundation for further storage research, utilizing the Chameleon infrastructure. Our study offers experiment patterns and guidelines that can help researchers create transparent and dependable storage experiments. We have successfully integrated our methods in several experiments in multiple community and educational events over several years and produced publicly accessible artifacts that can be extended and fully reproduced without any restrictions.

AI.tldr: 针对存储研究中实验难以复现和扩展的问题，该研究引入了StorRep框架，通过提供可扩展的实验制品及标准化流程，显著提升了存储实验的透明度与可重复性。
AI.motivation: 存储研究领域中，SSD模拟器实验的封装率（1%）和易复现率（0.5%）极低，由于环境配置困难及缺乏可扩展性带来的实验复现难题，严重阻碍了存储学术研究的进展。
AI.method: 利用Chameleon基础设施，构建了六个可扩展且可复现的存储实验制品（Artifacts），并总结出一套标准化的实验范式与设计准则。
AI.result: 成功实现了多项存储实验的标准化集成，并在多个社区及教育活动中得到应用。所有产出的实验制品均已公开，实现了无限制的完全复现与扩展。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过开发StorRep并提供相关实验范式与指南，有效解决了存储研究中实验不可复用和难以复现的问题，为学界提供了可参考的基准，有助于提升学术成果的透明度和可靠性。

title: LLMs have Visualization Literacy: Now What? Experiments Exploring LLM Visualization Evaluation Capabilities
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become more popular within the visualization community, researchers increasingly leverage them for diverse visualization tasks such as design guideline suggestions and visualization evaluation. However, in order for LLMs to act as trustworthy and fair evaluators, we argue that LLMs would need to possess visualization literacy, be capable of following user instructions and uphold graphical integrity. We test the latest versions of the most prominent LLMs, specifically Anthropic's Claude (Opus 4.5), OpenAI's Generative Pretrained Transformers (GPT 5.2 Pro), and Google's Gemini (Gemini 3 Flash) on these features and find that while these models now possess visualization literacy, they still struggle with other features necessary for instruction following and graphical integrity. Using a modified Visualization Literacy Assessment Test (VLAT), our findings show that these recent LLMs have achieved greater than human-levels of visualization literacy in contrast to prior research. In order to test the models' abilities to follow instructions, we used few-shot and chain-of-thought prompting as proxies for instruction following tasks on evaluating visualization literacy and find that these specialized prompting techniques are becoming obsolete with respect to improving visualization literacy. Additionally, we experiment with the inherent ability of LLMs to evaluate misleading visualizations to test the models' abilities for upholding graphical integrity and find that without specialized or leading prompting techniques, the models struggle with being able to accurately identify whether a visualization is misleading or not. Our results further break down the performance of each model on these tasks, but the culmination of our findings force us to reconsider the current effectiveness of LLMs as visualization evaluators.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了顶尖LLM在可视化任务中的表现，发现它们虽具备高水平的可视化素养，但在指令遵循和识别误导性可视化（图形完整性）方面表现不足，目前尚不足以成为可靠的可视化评估工具。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在可视化任务中应用日益广泛，研究者需要验证这些模型是否具备作为“可信且公平的评估者”所需的关键素质，即可视化素养、指令遵循能力和图形完整性。
AI.method: 使用修正版可视化素养评估测试（VLAT）评估模型素养；通过少样本（few-shot）和思维链（CoT）提示测试指令遵循能力；评估模型识别误导性可视化的能力以测试图形完整性。模型对象包括 Claude Opus 4.5、GPT 5.2 Pro 和 Gemini 3 Flash。
AI.result: 1. LLMs在可视化素养方面表现极佳（超过人类水平）；2. 传统的few-shot和CoT提示技术对提升可视化素养任务的效果已趋于过时；3. 模型在缺乏针对性提示的情况下，难以准确识别误导性可视化，缺乏图形完整性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管前沿大语言模型（LLMs）在可视化素养上已达到或超越人类水平，但在指令遵循和图形完整性（如识别误导性可视化）方面仍存在显著局限，这使得目前的LLM作为可视化评估者的有效性值得商榷。

title: Schema-Agnostic Process Trace Construction: From Raw Tables to Execution Behavior
summary: Traditional information systems (IS) engineering assumes stable schemas, explicit keys, and curated event logs. In modern OLTP environments, schemas drift, keys are sparse, and execution traces are dispersed across loosely connected tables, making manual process trace construction costly and error prone. We propose a schema-agnostic pipe-line that automatically reconstructs process execution traces directly from raw relational data. The pipeline (i) identifies columns that function like keys or timestamps, (ii) discovers table-to-table connections using statistical signals rather than predefined schemas, (iii) assembles and orders events for each case while accommodating multiple date fields, and (iv) learns likely ordering and flow relations across systems using a Temporal Convolutional Network which models long-range dependencies and patterns. Evaluations on TPC-H/E benchmarks, synthetic corpora, and a real industry dataset show that our pipeline reconstructs high-fidelity event traces and accurate trace orderings, correctly predicting the next event with 85% accuracy and recovering about 82% of ground-truth precedence relations. By eliminating dependence on predefined schemas, ER diagrams and domain templates, our work offers a generalizable and scalable pathway for automated reconstruction of execution behaviour in dynamic and continuously evolving IS environments.

AI.tldr: 针对现代OLTP系统中数据结构动态变化导致的流程挖掘难题，本文提出了一种无需预设Schema的自动执行流程重构框架，通过深度学习建模逻辑顺序，实现了高精度的流程自动捕获。
AI.motivation: 传统的流程挖掘依赖稳定的Schema和显式的键值，但现代OLTP系统存在模式漂移（schema drift）、键值稀疏以及数据分散等问题，导致人工重建流程痕迹的成本极高且易出错。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化管线，包含四个关键步骤：(i)自动识别潜在的键和时间戳字段；(ii)基于统计信号而非预定义模式发现表连接关系；(iii)组装并排序各案例的事件流；(iv)利用时间卷积网络（TCN）学习系统间的长距离依赖和执行逻辑。
AI.result: 在TPC-H/E基准测试、合成数据及真实行业数据集上的验证结果显示，该方案在预测下一个事件方面的准确率达到85%，并能恢复约82%的真实顺序关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种无需预定义模式（Schema-agnostic）的流程跟踪自动重建管线，证明了在现代动态OLTP环境中，利用统计信号和深度学习技术能够有效替代传统的基于ER图和人工构建的流程挖掘方法，具备高可扩展性和通用性。

title: Running hardware-aware neural architecture search on embedded devices under 512MB of RAM
summary: This document proposes a novel approach to hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW NAS) that considers the resources available on the computing platform running it, enabling its execution on various embedded devices. The presented HW NAS produces tiny convolutional neural networks (CNNs) targeting low-end microcontroller units (MCUs), typically involved in the Internet of Things (IoT) or wearable robotics, opening new use cases. A gateway could run it to tailor CNNs' architecture on the acquired data without using external servers, ensuring privacy. The proposed technique achieves state-of-the-art results in the human-recognition tasks on the Visual Wake Word dataset, a standard TinyML benchmark, on several embedded devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种能够在低端微控制器（MCU）本地直接运行的硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW NAS）技术，实现了在无需云端的条件下自适应生成高性能CNN模型，兼顾了任务表现与隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 为了弥补现有神经架构搜索在低端嵌入式设备（如IoT、可穿戴机器人）上应用时的资源限制问题，同时解决云端计算在隐私保护和部署效率方面的不足。
AI.method: 提出一种具备硬件感知能力的神经架构搜索（HW NAS）算法，该算法能够根据目标嵌入式设备的资源限制动态定制模型架构，无需依赖外部云服务器。
AI.result: 在Visual Wake Words（VWW）数据集及多种嵌入式设备上达到了最先进（State-of-the-Art）的性能水准。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种能够在边缘设备（如低端MCU）上直接执行的硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW NAS）方法，实现了本地化、隐私保护的轻量级CNN模型生成，并显著提升了TinyML任务的性能。

title: Optimality of Random Regular Graphs in Sparse Network Designs
summary:
The problems of designing sparse networks arise frequently in resource allocation and operations research. In production systems, for example, sparse process flexibility designs are used to handle uncertain demand effectively: the goal is to construct the sparsest bipartite graph between supply and demand that still achieves an expected fulfilled demand comparable to that of a fully flexible system. In middle-mile transportation, sparse delivery-route subgraphs that sustain large matchings after random node deletions help reduce delivery costs; here, the goal is to design the sparsest graph whose maximum matching size remains comparable to that of the fully connected graph under node deletions.
  The design of sparse networks has been studied extensively, with state-of-the-art results providing order-wise optimal designs for both bipartite and unipartite networks (Chen et al., 2015; Feng et al., 2024). However, identifying designs that achieve the sharp theoretical limit -- where the average degree asymptotically matches the lower bound of any graph to achieve a given loss level, has remained open. In this paper, we prove that the random regular graph achieves this sharp optimal condition in both bipartite and unipartite settings. Numerical experiments further validate this optimality. Our results highlight a practical guideline for sparse flexibility networks: designs that combine degree regularity with low edge correlations can achieve optimal performance under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了随机正则图是解决稀疏灵活性网络设计问题的最优方案，能够以最低的平均度达到理想的系统性能，填补了该领域寻找“尖锐理论极限”设计的空白。
AI.motivation: 尽管现有研究已在稀疏网络设计中取得了阶数最优（order-wise optimal）的成果，但如何达到“尖锐理论极限”（sharp theoretical limit，即平均度与理论下界渐近匹配）仍未解决。研究旨在寻找一种既能满足稀疏性又能达到理论最优性能的网络结构。
AI.method: 通过数学论证证明了随机正则图在二分图（处理需求不确定性）和无向图（处理节点删除下的最大匹配）下的最优性；并通过数值实验对理论结果进行了验证。
AI.result: 证明了随机正则图在二分和非二分场景下均达到最优；实验结果显示其在处理需求波动和节点删除时表现出色，与理论下界高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 随机正则图（Random Regular Graph）在二分图和一般图中均能达到稀疏网络设计的理论最优界，即其平均度能够渐近匹配实现特定性能损耗水平的理论下界。该研究确立了“度正则性+低边相关性”作为实现最优稀疏灵活性的设计准则。

title: SWARM-LLM: Collaborative Inference for Edge-based Small Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide strong performance across a wide range of tasks but are typically hosted on centralised cloud infrastructure, incurring significant bandwidth, latency, and privacy costs. In contrast, small language models (SLMs) can run on edge devices but have limited capability and robustness. This paper introduces SWARM-LLM, a routing and collaboration layer that coordinates a small swarm of edge-hosted SLMs with an optional cloud foundation model (FM). SWARM-LLM decides, for each query, whether to answer locally, collaborate with peer SLMs, or "summon" a cloud FM, using lightweight uncertainty estimates and safety signals. We implement a working prototype on commodity hardware with three heterogeneous SLMs and a 70B-parameter cloud FM accessed via API, and evaluate it on a controlled study workload of easy, hard, and safety-oriented queries. Our results show that SWARM-LLM substantially improves performance on hard questions compared to an edge-only deployment, while limiting cloud usage to roughly one quarter of queries, illustrating a practical trade-off between accuracy, latency, and cost for privacy-conscious edge deployments. The implementation code is available at the GitHub repository https://github.com/mdahshan/swarm_llm.

AI.tldr: SWARM-LLM 是一种协调边缘多个小型模型与云端大模型的路由框架，通过智能决策机制优化了边缘计算的性能、成本与隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）在中心化云端运行所带来的带宽、延迟和隐私问题，同时克服单一小型语言模型（SLM）在处理复杂任务时能力不足和鲁棒性差的限制。
AI.method: 引入了一个名为SWARM-LLM的路由与协作层。该方法使用轻量级的不确定性估计和安全信号来实时决策：选择本地直接回答、与边缘端的多个小型模型（SLM）协作，还是调用云端基础模型（FM）。
AI.result: 在由异构SLM和云端70B大模型组成的实验系统中，SWARM-LLM在处理复杂查询时表现远优于纯边缘部署方案，同时将云端调用频率降低至查询总量的约四分之一，有效权衡了准确性、延迟与成本。
AI.conclusion: SWARM-LLM通过引入多层级路由与协作机制，在保持隐私保护和降低成本的同时，有效平衡了边缘计算的高效性与云端大模型的强大能力，为边缘设备部署LLM提供了一种切实可行的方案。

title: Conformal Candidate Certification for Offline Model-Based Optimization
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline model-based optimization (MBO) proposes candidates by optimizing a surrogate trained on a fixed historical dataset. Because candidates are deliberately out-of-distribution, surrogate rankings are least reliable exactly where the optimizer is most aggressive, yet existing methods provide no per-candidate statistical certificate that a design meets a target threshold. We propose \emph{Conformal Candidate Certification} (CCC), a post-hoc wrapper that attaches a calibrated one-sided lower bound to each candidate and advances only those whose bound exceeds the target. We show that entropy-regularized surrogate maximization induces a Gibbs-tilted proposal, so the same surrogate supplies importance weights for weighted conformal prediction without a separate density-ratio estimation step. In a controlled synthetic study, CCC certifies $16.7\%$ of an aggressive proposal pool with empirical coverage 0.990 at nominal 0.90, while standard conformal prediction ignoring the covariate shift collapses to 0.416 coverage.

AI.tldr: 针对离线模型优化（MBO）中因 OOD 数据导致评估失效的问题，本文提出 CCC 框架，通过加权共形预测为候选设计提供统计置信下界，显著提升了候选点的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 离线模型优化（MBO）在基于固定数据集训练的替代模型上进行优化，产生离分布（OOD）候选点时，替代模型的排名准确度下降且缺乏统计置信度。
AI.method: 提出“共形候选认证”（Conformal Candidate Certification, CCC）：一种事后封装方法，通过熵正则化替代目标最大化产生重要性权重，并结合加权共形预测（Weighted Conformal Prediction）为每个候选点提供校准的单侧下界。
AI.result: 在合成研究中，CCC 在 0.90 置信水平下实现了 0.990 的经验覆盖率，成功认证了 16.7% 的候选点；相比之下，不考虑协变量偏移的标准共形预测覆盖率仅为 0.416。
AI.conclusion: CCC 成功解决了离线 MBO 中因分布外（OOD）候选点导致的模型评估不可靠问题，通过引入共形预测框架，提供了一种无需额外密度比估计的有效候选认证方案。

title: Synthetic-to-Real Pipeline for Safe Landing Zone Detection
comment: Proceedings of Conference on Robots and Vision (CRV) 2026, Vancouver, British Columbia , Canada
summary: As Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) transition toward higher levels of autonomy, the ability to perform unassisted recovery in non-cooperative, unstructured environments becomes critical. Achieving safe autonomous landing requires high-fidelity semantic resolution to distinguish navigable terrain from hazardous obstacles, yet development is often hindered by the scarcity of annotated aerial datasets. This work proposes a comprehensive perception and data generation pipeline designed to bridge the sim-to-real gap for autonomous landing tasks. We introduce a procedural synthetic data engine that generates photorealistic urban environments with automated semantic annotations through domain randomization. A Transformer-based OneFormer architecture is fine-tuned exclusively on this synthetic data, leveraging multi-head self-attention mechanisms for global context resolution. To ensure operational safety, a deterministic landing module utilizes a Euclidean Distance Transform (EDT) and dynamic inference logic to identify the largest inscribed safe landing zones while maintaining strict clearance buffers around obstacles. Quantitative benchmarking against the UAVid dataset demonstrates robust semantic segmentation performance, while qualitative validation on real-world UAV footage confirms the system's ability to identify collision-free landing sites in unseen environments. Our results highlight the potential of high-fidelity procedural simulation to eliminate the need for manual annotation while providing robust, edge-deployable situational awareness for autonomous UAV recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于无人机自主着陆的仿真实时感知与数据生成管线，通过程序化合成数据训练Transformer模型，并结合EDT算法实现鲁棒的安全着陆区识别，成功克服了标注数据集稀缺的难题。
AI.motivation: 无人机在非协作、非结构化环境中实现自主回收时，缺乏高质量的标注空中数据集，导致难以进行精确的地形语义识别与安全着陆规划。
AI.method: 1. 构建程序化合成数据生成引擎：利用域随机化（Domain Randomization）自动生成高逼真度、带语义标注的城市环境数据集。2. 模型微调：使用OneFormer架构（基于Transformer的多头自注意力机制）仅在合成数据上进行微调。3. 安全着陆规划：开发基于欧几里得距离变换（EDT）和动态推理逻辑的确定性模块，识别最大安全着陆区并保持避障缓冲。
AI.result: 1. 在UAVid数据集上的定量基准测试显示出强大的语义分割性能。2. 在真实世界无人机视频中的定性验证表明，系统能有效识别未见环境中的无遮挡安全着陆点。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了高保真程序化仿真能够有效消除对人工标注的需求，为无人机在复杂、非协作环境下的自主回收提供了鲁棒且可边缘部署的态势感知方案。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Proof Autoformalization in Lean 4
summary: Proof autoformalization aims to translate a mathematical informal proof written in natural language into a formal proof in a formal language such as Lean~4. Several works have developed LLM-based models for proof autoformalization. However, existing evaluations have typically focused on translating well-formed informal proofs from curated datasets. We argue that a robust proof autoformalizer must remain faithful even for informal proofs that diverge from these idealized ones, and we present the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models. We formulate two categories of perturbations and evaluate robustness under each: a global perturbation paraphrases the informal proof in a different style, under which the formalization should remain consistent; a local perturbation alters a value, symbol, or proof step, possibly in a counterfactual way, and a robust formalization should faithfully reflect the perturbation rather than reverting to the original one or inferring a different one on its own. We build a benchmark with both perturbations on miniF2F and MATH-500, and automatically measure how stable a proof autoformalization's correctness is under global perturbations and how faithfully its output reflects local perturbations. We evaluate seven recent models, all of which are sensitive to global perturbations and mostly fail to remain faithful under local perturbations. Code and data are available via https://github.com/ucr-rai/robust-proof-autoformalization.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了证明自动形式化模型在面对各种非正式证明输入时的鲁棒性，发现当前模型在处理样式改变或细微逻辑偏差时表现不可靠。
AI.motivation: 当前的证明自动形式化研究仅关注策划过的理想数据集，缺乏对模型在处理非理想（如表达方式改变或细微偏差）的非正式证明时的稳健性与忠实度评价。
AI.method: 定义了两种扰动类型用于衡量鲁棒性：1. 全局扰动（Global perturbation）：改变证明陈述的风格而不改变含义，评估模型输出的一致性；2. 局部扰动（Local perturbation）：修改关键值、符号或步骤，评估模型输出是否忠实于篡改后的信息。基于 miniF2F 和 MATH-500 数据集构建自动化测试基准。
AI.result: 对7种主流形式化模型进行了评估，结果显示这些模型对全局扰动非常敏感，且在面对局部扰动时，往往无法忠实地遵循修改后的指令，表现出较差的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 现有的大模型（LLM）驱动的证明自动形式化模型在面对非理想化的输入时表现脆弱。研究表明，现有的7种模型在全局扰动（同义改写）下表现不稳定，在局部扰动（语义改变）下缺乏忠实度，无法准确反映输入的变化。

title: GRAPE: Guided Parameter-Space Evolution for Compact Adversarial Robustness
summary:
Adversarial Training (AT) improves neural network robustness, but most methods train a fixed parameter space from the start. This paper asks whether the order in which parameters become optimizable can affect the final robust solution, even when the final architecture or computation budget is controlled.
  We propose GRAPE, Guided Parameter-Space Evolution, a training framework for compact adversarial robustness. GRAPE combines parameter-space stabilization with progressive hidden expansion: it stabilizes robust optimization in the currently exposed space, gradually releases new optimizable dimensions, and uses an adversarial spectral utilization score to guide newly released capacity toward high-pressure modules. In contrast to fixed-structure AT, GRAPE treats robust model learning as a process of progressive parameter-space exposure and evolution.
  Under the standard $\ell_\infty$ threat model on CIFAR-10, with fixed-structure ResNet-18 AT as a controlled reference, GRAPE improves PGD-20 robust accuracy from 51.70% to 56.94% at a nearly matched computation budget with a FLOPs ratio of 1.009x, while reducing parameter count by about 21.4%. A sequential grow variant with the same final ResNet-18 architecture reaches 56.52% PGD-20 robust accuracy, indicating that the gain is not only due to final architecture differences but also to the parameter-space exposure path. These results suggest that guided parameter-space evolution can yield compact and robust parameter configurations under matched computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAPE框架，通过渐进式演化参数空间而非固定结构进行对抗训练，成功在降低参数量的同时提升了神经网络的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗训练（AT）方法大多在训练开始即锁定参数空间，忽略了参数成为可优化状态的顺序对最终鲁棒解的影响。本文旨在探索通过控制参数空间的演化路径是否能获得更优的鲁棒性配置。
AI.method: 提出了GRAPE（Guided Parameter-Space Evolution）框架，核心包含两个机制：1. 参数空间稳定化（Parameter-space stabilization），在当前暴露的维度中稳定鲁棒优化；2. 渐进式隐藏层扩展（Progressive hidden expansion），结合对抗谱利用分数（Adversarial spectral utilization score）引导新增产能向高压模块分配。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集（$\ell_\infty$攻击模型）下，GRAPE使ResNet-18的PGD-20鲁棒准确率从51.70%提升至56.94%，同时参数量减少约21.4%，且计算开销（FLOPs）基本保持一致。对比实验表明，性能提升源于参数空间暴露的演化路径，而非单纯的结构差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了参数空间的演化路径（而非仅模型结构）对对抗鲁棒性至关重要；“引导式参数空间演化”能够以较低的参数量实现更高的鲁棒性，为获得紧凑且强鲁棒的模型提供了新的优化范式。

title: OneBar: An End-to-End Content-Grounded Generative Query Recommendation Framework for E-Commerce Video Feeds
comment: Any questions feel free to contact: benchen4395@gmail.com
summary: Short-video platforms now expose clickable search entries beneath the video player, enabling users to easily express content-induced search intent. However, conventional query recommendation systems on short-video platforms suffer from latency constraints and objective misalignment, while recent generative approaches struggle with noisy content-side metadata and preference drift. To address these issues, we propose OneBar, an end-to-end generative framework for real-time query recommendation for E-Commerce video feeds. OneBar features three key innovations: (1) a collaborative-multimodal intent grounding module that fuses multimodal video understanding and behavior-derived collaborative anchors; (2) a Unified End-to-End architecture equipped with a prompt-compression mechanism for efficient online serving; and (3) a progressive preference learning strategy for efficient preference-internalization, which internalizes hierarchical behavior preferences into the generative policy, eliminating the need for a separately trained reward model. Compared with online base, OneBar increases Query Exposure by 16.91\% and Query Click by 18.68\%, while maintaining a slight Query CTR gain of 0.19\%. The additional search traffic further contributes to 20.36\% more guided orders and 21.67\% higher GMV.

AI.tldr: 针对短视频电商的实时搜索推荐，OneBar 提出了一种集成协同多模态引导、轻量化端到端生成及偏好内化策略的生成式框架，在提升用户查询粘性的同时显著促进了商业转化。
AI.motivation: 传统短视频平台的搜索查询推荐系统存在延迟限制和目标不一致问题，且现有的生成式方法难以处理噪声多模态元数据及用户偏好漂移。
AI.method: 提出 OneBar 框架，包含三个核心创新：1. 协同多模态意图引导模块（融合视频多模态内容与行为锚点）；2. 带有提示词压缩机制的统一端到端生成架构（优化在线服务性能）；3. 渐进式偏好学习策略（将分层用户偏好直接内化进生成策略，无需额外奖励模型）。
AI.result: 相比线上基准，OneBar 在查询曝光（+16.91%）、查询点击（+18.68%）、引导订单（+20.36%）及 GMV（+21.67%）上均实现显著增长，并保持查询点击率（CTR）的轻微提升（+0.19%）。
AI.conclusion: OneBar 框架通过协同多模态意图引导、端到端架构优化和渐进式偏好学习，有效解决了短视频电商场景中实时查询推荐的延迟与对齐问题，显著提升了搜索曝光、点击率及商业转化效果。

title: CacheWise: Understanding Workloads and Optimizing KVCache Management for Efficiently Serving LLM Coding Agents
summary:
Coding agents are a fast-growing LLM application, executing as long-running closed-loop sessions in which LLM generations alternate with external tool calls. Yet, unlike chat workloads, their serving behavior has not been studied extensively. We address this gap by collecting a dataset of real-world coding assistant traces. Our analysis shows that coding agent sessions repeatedly reuse large prefixes and create sustained KVCache pressure that conventional LLM serving policies handle poorly.
  Based on our analysis, we present CacheWise, a KVCache management layer that improves KVCache reuse for coding agent workloads. CacheWise combines prefix-aware scheduling with reuse-aware eviction guided by lightweight predictions from tool call metadata. Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on the collected traces, CacheWise reduces KVCache evictions by up to 2-2.6x and improves total agent session completion time by up to 3.5x.

AI.tldr: CacheWise 是一种专为编码代理负载设计的新型 KVCache 管理层，通过优化前缀重用和改进驱逐策略，大幅提升了代理任务的执行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 服务策略无法有效处理编码代理负载中频繁重用长前缀和持续 KVCache 压力的特性，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了 CacheWise 管理层，结合了前缀感知调度（prefix-aware scheduling）和基于工具调用元数据轻量级预测的重用感知驱逐机制（reuse-aware eviction），并在 vLLM 框架上进行了实现与评估。
AI.result: 使用真实世界代理负载进行评估，CacheWise 将 KVCache 驱逐次数减少了 2-2.6 倍，代理会话总完成时间缩短了最高 3.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: CacheWise 通过感知前缀调度和基于工具调用元数据的重用感知驱逐策略，有效缓解了编码代理负载中 KVCache 的压力，显著提升了系统性能。

title: MADAR: An Address-Free Processor
summary: In a modern processor, computing is the cheap part. Most of its area and energy go to \emph{addressing} -- moving operands to and from a register file and cache, and running the tags, ports, miss queues, and bypass networks that find a value where it was left. MADAR deletes that machinery by abolishing the address. All state circulates in rings of slots that advance one position per clock; instructions and data ride in the same slots; a value is named by its place in an orbit -- a \rp{} coordinate -- not by an address; a fixed station computes when a circulating instruction sweeps past its operands, on a schedule set at compile time; and a hierarchy of rings of increasing period replaces the cache hierarchy, movement between them scheduled rather than triggered by a miss. No prior circulating-store, dataflow, or statically scheduled machine combines all four of these. We define the execution model, validate it in a cycle-accurate register-transfer-level implementation, show it \emph{compilable} -- a constructive scheduler emits programs cross-checked against the implementation -- and price it with a first-order energy model. The payoff is clearest for AI acceleration: the multiply-accumulate at the heart of every matmul and convolution compiles to a streaming form whose energy per operation stays flat as the reduction grows, and the operand reuse that makes matrix multiplication efficient is carried by the ring-period hierarchy -- the memory hierarchy doing by rotation what a cache does by tags. MADAR is a new design point for any computation whose data movement is known before the program runs.

AI.tldr: MADAR 架构通过废除地址概念，利用循环传输数据和编译时调度替代传统的缓存和访存逻辑，从而显著降低处理器的寻址开销，在 AI 加速任务中表现出极高的能效。
AI.motivation: 现代处理器的主要功耗和面积开销来源于“寻址”（如寄存器文件、缓存、标签查找、旁路网络等），而非实际的计算操作。为了解决这一设计瓶颈，研究者旨在通过废除地址的概念来消减这些开销。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 MADAR 的架构。该架构废除了显式地址，采用环形槽位循环传输数据和指令，通过“轨道坐标”标识数据。计算单元在指令随槽位经过时根据预先安排的编译器调度执行计算。利用不同周期的环层级结构替代传统的缓存层级，通过循环调度而非访存触发数据移动。
AI.result: 通过周期精确的 RTL 实现验证了该模型；开发了编译器能够生成符合硬件约束的可执行代码；采用一级能源模型验证了能效。实验表明该架构在人工智能矩阵乘法和卷积任务中表现出色，能量效率随规模增长保持平稳。
AI.conclusion: MADAR 提供了一种全新的处理器设计范式，特别适用于数据移动模式在程序运行前已知的情况（如AI计算）。它通过消除复杂的寻址逻辑、标签和缓存层级，利用环形数据流和编译时调度，实现了极高的能效。

title: CoeusBI: A Comprehensive Interactive Business Intelligence System Powered by LLMs at Baidu [Extended Version]
summary: The advent of Large Language Models has catalyzed the emergence of interactive Business Intelligence (BI) systems. Although commercial BI products increasingly adopt semantic layers paired with natural language interfaces, they predominantly rely on manual configurations to define metrics and dimensions. Real-world deployments face critical challenges: (a) frequent JOIN operations degrade the accuracy of SQL generation; (b) wide schemas exacerbate the challenge of schema linking; and (c) the generation of dialect-specific queries and the accurate support for multi-round dialogues incur high computational costs and yield limited accuracy. We introduce CoeusBI, an industrial-scale interactive BI system that addresses these barriers through a novel Dual-Agent Architecture paired with a Hierarchical Schema Linking module: (1) an offline View Generation Agent that utilizes error-feedback to autonomously convert complex JOIN queries into simple single-view queries, which eliminates the need for manual semantic modeling; (2) a Hierarchical Schema Linking module that leverages vector retrieval over views to handle exceptionally wide schemas efficiently; and (3) a dynamic Routing Agent that evaluates dialogue contexts to route queries, dynamically invoking either the synthesis of new intermediate representations or targeted modifications of existing ones, before compiling the unified representation via a deterministic SQL compiler that is agnostic to dialects. Extensive experiments on both public datasets and production datasets demonstrate that CoeusBI achieves significant improvements in query accuracy, token efficiency, and user satisfaction relative to existing methods. CoeusBI is deployed as a standalone service on the data platform of Baidu and is widely used across multiple business lines supporting thousands of users daily, thereby evidencing strong practicality and scalability.

AI.tldr: CoeusBI 是一款工业级交互式 BI 系统，通过双智能体架构和分层 schema 链接技术，替代了繁琐的手动语义建模，显著增强了应对复杂 Join、宽表场景及多轮对话的能力，并在百度实现了规模化落地。
AI.motivation: 现有商业 BI 系统严重依赖手动配置，且在大规模工业应用中面临 SQL 生成准确率低、复杂表关联性能差、宽表场景下模式链接困难以及多轮对话成本高等挑战。
AI.method: 提出了 CoeusBI 系统，核心包含：(1) 离线视图生成智能体：利用错误反馈机制将复杂 Join 查询自动简化为单视图查询；(2) 分层模式链接模块：通过基于视图的向量检索处理超宽表模式；(3) 动态路由智能体：根据对话上下文决定是合成新表示还是修改现有表示，并配合方言无关的确定性 SQL 编译器。
AI.result: 在公共数据集和百度实际生产数据集的实验中，CoeusBI 显著提升了查询准确率、Token 使用效率和用户满意度，并支持了百度内部大规模的业务场景。
AI.conclusion: CoeusBI 通过创新的双智能体架构和分层模式链接模块，有效解决了工业级 BI 系统在语义层配置、复杂 Join 处理、宽表模式链接及多轮对话中的痛点，不仅提升了 SQL 生成的准确性和效率，且已在百度大规模生产环境中得到验证。

title: KATANA: A Fast, Low-Power Mapping of Kalman Filters onto Edge NPUs for Real-Time Tracking
summary: State estimation is the closed-loop core of every real-time tracking system, from radar surveillance and counter-UAV defense to autonomous driving and robotics. These deployments run on edge platforms, where defense systems mount on vehicles and drones, and civilian pipelines live on cars and handheld devices. Here, every additional watt of compute erodes mission duration or operational range. Two hard constraints follow: each new measurement must be fused before the next control cycle, and the total compute must fit within a strict battery and thermal power envelope. The Linear and Extended Kalman Filters (LKF, EKF) are dominant estimators on these systems, but today they execute almost exclusively on CPUs, which serialize multi-object tracking (MOT) updates, or on custom FPGA/ASIC accelerators that lengthen design cycles. Contemporary AI-PC SoCs, like the Intel Core Ultra Series 1 and 2, integrate a low-power, data-parallel Neural Processing Unit (NPU). We therefore ask whether the Kalman filter can be mapped onto this existing matrix engine to meet real-time and low-power budgets simultaneously, avoiding a dedicated accelerator and keeping the CPU and GPU free for primary workloads. We present KATANA, an NPU-aware optimization framework delivering the first end-to-end mapping of the LKF and EKF onto a commercial NPU, alongside a cross-platform characterization on shipping AI-PC silicon. KATANA applies three algebraic graph rewrites: subtract-to-add reformulation via a precomputed negative-projection matrix H_neg, static-shape tensor fusion, and block-diagonal batched parallelization, ensuring 100% of operations execute on the DPU matrix engine. On the Series 2, the optimized batched EKF reaches 223.35 FPS at 13.43 W active power, and the LKF reaches 408.73 FPS at 14.05 W, delivering up to a 97.9% reduction in dynamic energy versus the CPU implementation.

AI.tldr: KATANA 是首个将 Kalman 滤波完整映射至商用 NPU 的优化框架，通过高效的矩阵运算重构，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了边缘计算场景下的功耗。
AI.motivation: 在边缘计算平台（无人机、自动驾驶等）上，传统 CPU 处理 Kalman 滤波存在序列化延迟和功耗高的问题，而定制化 FPGA/ASIC 设计周期过长，论文旨在探索利用现有的商用 AI PC NPU 实现低功耗、高实时的状态估计。
AI.method: 提出 KATANA 优化框架，通过三种代数图重写技术（相减转相加重构、静态形状张量融合、分块对角矩阵批处理并行化），将 100% 的矩阵运算映射至 NPU 的矩阵引擎上。
AI.result: 在 Intel Core Ultra Series 2 平台上，KATANA 实现的 EKF 达到 223.35 FPS（13.43W），LKF 达到 408.73 FPS（14.05W），相较于 CPU 实现方案，动态能耗最高可降低 97.9%。
AI.conclusion: KATANA 证明了通过代数图重写技术，可以将传统的卡尔曼滤波（LKF/EKF）高效映射至商用AI PC的NPU上，在满足实时性要求的同时，实现比CPU方案显著的能效提升，为边缘侧实时系统提供了一种无需定制专用加速器的高效解决方案。

title: Comparison Patrols on Drifting Orders: Certified Rank Maintenance, Evolving Planar Maxima, and Selection under Drifting Fitness
comment: 41 pages, 8 figure, 16 tables, ancillary files provided
summary: Rank-based selection in dynamic environments acts on order information that becomes stale while it is being used. Tournaments, elitism, truncation, and Pareto selection may therefore consume rankings that no longer match the current fitness order, while full re-evaluation competes with search for the same budget. This paper formulates the missing information layer as a data-structure problem. A hidden total order on $n$ items drifts by adjacent transpositions, while a maintainer receives one truthful pairwise comparison per step and must answer rank queries continuously. We introduce the comparison patrol, a constant-time maintained-order structure using $3n+O(1)$ words, one comparison per update, deterministic verification-age bounds, and per-item displacement certificates. We prove lower bounds showing that oblivious and location-oblivious maintainers incur expected Kendall error $Ω(\min(α,1)n)$, and show that the patrol operates at the same order. A bump invariant yields exact self-stabilization after drift-free corruption: if the maximum rank overstatement is $L$, recovery takes at most $L$ aligned cycles and cannot finish before $L-1$. This gives a deterministic shock-recovery calculus and a crossover with full rebuild near $L\approx \log_2 n$. The maintained order is then transferred to evolving planar maxima and to evolutionary selection rules, giving deterministic bounds for truncation, tournament, elitist, and two-objective Pareto decisions under drifting fitness. Experiments up to $n=65{,}536$ audit the certificates, recovery laws, equilibrium behavior, and equal-budget dynamic evolutionary loops, identifying when certified local rank maintenance outperforms global re-evaluation and when it should hand over.

AI.tldr: 针对动态环境下秩信息滞后的难题，本文提出了“比较巡逻”算法，实现了高效、自我稳定的秩维护结构，在保证秩质量的同时显著降低了计算预算。
AI.motivation: 在动态演化算法中，基于秩的选择（如锦标赛、精英策略）面临信息滞后（stale information）的问题。传统方法要么使用过时的秩，要么耗费大量预算进行全局重评估，迫切需要一种在动态环境下高效维护秩信息的方法。
AI.method: 将动态环境下的秩维护建模为数据结构问题；提出了“比较巡逻”算法，利用位移证书（displacement certificates）和凸起不变式（bump invariant）实现自我稳定，并进行理论证明和大规模实验验证。
AI.result: 1. 实现了常量时间维护的秩结构，空间消耗仅为 3n+O(1)；2. 证明了秩维护的理论误差界限；3. 建立了确定性的冲击恢复演算；4. 成功将该方法应用于平面极大值问题和演化选择规则，并在 $n=65,536$ 的规模下验证了其优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种名为“比较巡逻（comparison patrol）”的结构，证明了在动态环境下进行秩维护的理论界限。实验表明，当预算受限时，该方法在处理演化选择规则时优于全局重评估。

title: Secure and Low-Latency IoT Analytics Using an Edge-Based Streaming Architecture
summary: The rapid growth of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has led to large-scale continuous data streams that require realtime processing. Traditional cloud-centric architectures fail to meet low-latency and bandwidth efficiency requirements due to network delays and high data transmission overhead. This paper proposes EdgeStream, a lightweight edge-based framework for real-time streaming analytics in IoT environments. The system integrates edge nodes for local processing with a cloud backend for coordination and storage, using MQTT-based communication and distributed processing with anomaly detection. Analytical models for latency, throughput, and bandwidth are developed to evaluate performance. Experimental results, compared to cloudbased systems, show up to 92.8

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EdgeStream边缘计算框架，旨在解决物联网数据流实时处理中云端架构的延迟和带宽瓶颈问题，经实验验证其性能优于传统云端方案。
AI.motivation: 物联网设备激增产生了海量实时数据流，传统云端处理模式因网络长延迟和高带宽占用，无法满足实时分析的需求。
AI.method: 提出名为EdgeStream的轻量级边缘计算框架，结合边缘节点本地处理与云端协调存储，采用MQTT协议通信，并实现分布式异常检测；通过建立时延、吞吐量和带宽的理论分析模型进行性能评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，与传统云端系统相比，EdgeStream在性能指标（如延迟、带宽利用率）上有显著提升，其中在特定指标上改进幅度高达92.8%。
AI.conclusion: EdgeStream架构通过边缘计算有效克服了传统云中心架构在处理大规模物联网流数据时的低延迟和高带宽效率挑战。

title: Finite Resources False Discovery Rate Control in Structured Hypothesis Spaces
summary: Scientific discovery relies on large-scale hypothesis testing. However, the capacity to identify true discoveries while controlling false discovery faces major challenges: obtaining relevant reference data (the null distribution) is resource-intensive, leaving finite-data uncertainty, and the procedure should account for the inherent structure in the hypothesis space, when such structure exists. Here, we present a framework for controlling the false discovery rate both when each hypothesis is evidenced only by a finite count of null draws, leaving its p-value uncertain, and when the hypothesis space carries arbitrary structure, requiring only that the structure be represented through a suitable reproducing kernel. We present two decision rules that are both robust to structural mis-specification, yet offer a distinct trade-off between exact FDR control and statistical power. The first rule guarantees exact FDR control; the second maximizes power by adapting mirror-statistic control into count space, utilizing an analytical framework to assess FDR control when exact mirror symmetry is relaxed. Furthermore, the tractability gained by the RKHS framework allows us to directly investigate finite-data uncertainties, which we leverage to suggest a policy for the efficient allocation of null distribution samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于RKHS的统计框架，通过两种决策规则解决了科学发现中有限采样下的FDR控制与统计功效平衡问题，并优化了零分布采样的资源分配。
AI.motivation: 在大规模假设检验中，如何同时解决“获取零分布数据资源成本高（导致有限样本不确定性）”以及“如何有效利用假设空间中潜在的结构信息”这两个挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一套依托再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的统计框架：1. 针对P值不确定性，开发了两种决策规则，一种保证严格的FDR控制，另一种通过将镜像统计（mirror-statistic）推广至计数空间以最大化统计功效；2. 利用RKHS的易处理性，推导了有限样本下零分布采样的最优分配策略。
AI.result: 该框架在存在结构误设的情况下仍表现出极强的稳健性；成功平衡了严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制与统计功效（power）；并提供了能直接优化零分布样本采样分配的实施策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究构建的基于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的框架，有效解决了假设检验中有限样本不确定性和假设空间结构化的问题，为高效的科学发现提供了统计保障。

title: Deep Learning-Based Lunar Crater Terrain Relative Navigation
summary: Accurate position estimation is crucial for the successful implementation of future lunar landings using autonomous vehicles, especially in dangerous environments with sparse terrain features. In this paper, we propose a terrain relative navigation (TRN) algorithm combining our deep-learning crater detector, which was designed specifically for the NASA Crater Detection Challenge problem, and an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). Our detector analyzes crater features from the monocular images acquired from orbit, and their matches with craters from a global database are identified via a Hungarian assignment approach followed by the consensus-based outliers removal method. The estimated measurements are then used to refine an EKF, where spacecraft pose estimation in the Lunar-Centered Lunar-Fixed (LCLF) frame of reference, augmented with altitude aiding information, constrains radial drift. The simulation results indicate that even if the spacecraft is off from its actual location up to 5 km, TRN could recover from this situation, achieving navigation error reduction to a few hundred meters. It should be noted that in order to maintain crater feature correspondences, it is important to match the image resolution and the scales within the scene to the detector training set distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合深度学习陨石坑检测与扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的地形相对导航（TRN）算法，实现了在月球复杂环境下航天器高精度的自主定位。
AI.motivation: 在地形特征稀疏的危险环境下，为未来的月面着陆任务提供准确、自主的导航与定位。
AI.method: 1. 训练专门针对NASA陨石坑检测挑战的深度学习检测器以提取陨石坑特征； 2. 通过匈牙利分配算法与基于共识的离群值剔除方法实现当前图像与陨石坑全局数据库的匹配； 3. 将匹配的测量数据输入扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行状态更新； 4. 在月心月固（LCLF）坐标系中结合高度辅助信息，约束径向漂移。
AI.result: 即使航天器初始定位偏差高达5公里，该算法也能通过轨道单目图像成功恢复并导航，将定位误差降低至几百米范围内。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结合深度学习陨石坑检测与扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），为缺乏地貌特征的月球环境提供了一种鲁棒的自主导航方案。研究强调了保持图像分辨率与训练集分布匹配对维持特征对应关系的必要性。

title: Context Compression Is Not One Thing: Readable Symbolic Re-expression vs. Coherent Summary at Matched Budget
summary: We study context compression for multi-hop question answering with small language models. We propose Telegraph English, a readable symbolic format that rewrites retrieved passages into structured entity-relation statements, preserving reasoning evidence at lower token cost. In controlled experiments on MuSiQue, TwoWiki, and HotpotQA, Telegraph English outperforms three matched-budget compression baselines (character-level deletion, truncation, and random sub-sampling) on every dataset, with gains of 13 to 20 F1 percentage point. It also outperforms a coherent prose summary produced by the same encoder on the hardest dataset. A pre-registered depth-interaction hypothesis is null: the advantage does not grow with reasoning depth within datasets. We interpret these results as evidence that readable symbolic re-expression preserves entity content more densely than either natural language or coherent summarization at matched token budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为 Telegraph English 的符号化上下文压缩格式，通过将检索到的文本转化为实体-关系陈述，在显著降低代币成本的同时，大幅提升了小模型在多跳问答任务中的性能。
AI.motivation: 在大规模语言模型时代，如何在保持推理性能的同时，通过压缩输入上下文（context compression）来降低小语言模型处理多跳问答任务时的计算成本和代币开销。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 Telegraph English 的可读符号格式，将检索到的段落重写为结构化的实体-关系语句，旨在降低多跳问答任务中的代币消耗并保持推理证据。通过在 MuSiQue、TwoWiki 和 HotpotQA 数据集上，将其与字符级删除、截断和随机子采样等基准方法进行对比实验。
AI.result: Telegraph English 在所有测试数据集上均优于其他基准方法，F1 分数提升了 13 到 20 个百分点；在最难的数据集上，其表现也优于基于连贯散文的摘要方法。此外，实验反驳了“优势随推理深度增加”的假设。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过将检索到的段落重写为结构化的实体-关系陈述（Telegraph English）并配合小语言模型，可以在相同的代币预算下比自然语言或传统的摘要方法更紧凑、更有效地保留推理证据。此外，该方法的效果并不随推理深度的增加而线性增长，证明了其在信息密度上的优势。

title: α-Fair Insurance Pricing: A Fairness Continuum
summary: Fairness in insurance pricing remains a long-standing and deeply debated puzzle. On one hand, insurers, driven by profitability considerations, set premiums that differentiate across individual risks to achieve actuarial fairness. On the other hand, insurance serves a critical societal function by pooling risks across a population, motivating cross-subsidization among groups to promote solidarity fairness. The tension between these two competing notions of fairness makes insurance pricing inherently complex, particularly in modern settings where granular data allow for increasingly fine risk differentiation and regulators face growing pressure to protect vulnerable groups. To address this challenge, we propose an $α$-\textbf{F}air \textbf{I}ndividual \textbf{S}olvent \textbf{P}remium ($α$-FISP) framework for insurance pricing that explicitly captures the trade-off between actuarial and solidarity fairness while guaranteeing solvency, a fundamental requirement in insurance operations. We formulate the pricing problem as a constrained optimization task, where actuarially fair premiums are adjusted subject to budget constraints on cross-subsidization within each risk class. This formulation naturally yields a family of solutions parameterized by $α$, tracing a continuum between purely actuarial and purely solidarity-based pricing and enabling decision-makers to select an operating point along this fairness spectrum. We derive theoretical guarantees for the proposed framework. Numerical experiments show that $α$-FISP is computationally tractable and aligns well with the U.S. regulatory regimes featuring heterogeneous state-level fairness requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 α-FISP 的保险定价框架，通过带约束的优化模型在个体精算公平与社会团结公平之间寻找最佳平衡点，同时确保保险公司偿付能力。
AI.motivation: 保险定价中长期存在“精算公平”（基于盈利和个体风险差异）与“团结公平”（通过风险池进行群体交叉补贴）之间的矛盾。随着数据细分能力的提高及监管机构对弱势群体保护压力的增加，如何平衡这两者并确保保险公司偿付能力成为一个亟待解决的复杂问题。
AI.method: 提出 α-FISP（α-Fair Individual Solvent Premium）框架，将保险定价问题形式化为一个带约束的优化任务。通过引入参数 α，在精算公平与团结公平之间建立权衡，同时将保险公司的偿付能力限制和各风险类别内的交叉补贴预算作为约束条件进行求解。
AI.result: 证明了该框架的理论可行性。数值实验表明，α-FISP 框架计算效率高，能够灵活调整定价以符合不同的监管偏好，并与美国复杂的州级监管环境高度适配。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的 α-FISP 框架通过设置可调节参数，有效地在精算公平（基于个体风险）与团结公平（基于群体补贴）之间取得了平衡，并保证了保险公司的偿付能力。该方法具有计算可行性，且能很好地适配美国不同州的多样化监管要求。

title: HoloRec: Holistic Encoding and Interleaved Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation models that formulate the task as sequence generation overcome the objective fragmentation problem of traditional cascade architectures, yet existing approaches still suffer from flat semantic representations lacking hierarchical structure for multi-step reasoning and an externally constructed chain-of-thought (CoT) that requires expensive annotations and remains disconnected from the generation objective. We propose HoloRec, an endogenous chain-of-thought recommendation mechanism that unifies representation, reasoning, and generation by constructing a hierarchical semantic encoding matrix via multi-granularity nested residual quantization optimized by a holistic reconstruction loss. HoloRec supports two inference modes: a non-thinking mode that uses lightweight multi-granularity supervised alignment for fast prediction, and a thinking mode that employs an interleaved reasoning scheme to generate CoT steps on the fly, directly embedding reasoning into the generation process without external data. Experiments on multiple public recommendation datasets demonstrate that HoloRec consistently outperforms baselines, with especially significant gains in sparse scenarios, and the thinking mode achieves better accuracy than the non-thinking mode with only modest inference overhead.

AI.tldr: HoloRec是一种端到端的生成式推荐模型，通过内生的层次化语义编码与即时思维链生成技术，实现了高效且具备深度推理能力的推荐，无需额外人工标注数据。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐模型存在语义表示扁平化、缺乏多步推理能力，以及依赖昂贵的外部标注思维链（CoT）且CoT与生成目标脱节的问题。
AI.method: 提出HoloRec模型，包括：1. 采用多粒度嵌套残差量化构建分层语义编码矩阵；2. 设计整体重构损失进行优化；3. 实现非思维模式（轻量级对齐）与思维模式（交叉推理即时生成CoT）两种推理机制。
AI.result: 在多个公开推荐数据集上的实验证明，HoloRec优于现有基准模型；在稀疏场景下优势显著；思维模式表现优于非思维模式，且仅带来适度推理开销。
AI.conclusion: HoloRec通过内生思维链机制成功将表示、推理与生成统一，有效解决了生成式推荐系统中的语义扁平化与外部CoT依赖问题，并在推理效率与准确性之间取得了良好的平衡。

title: Beyond CPU-GPU Frequency: Memory-Clock and Tail Effects in Edge Inference Latency Estimation
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/dankang21/jetson-latency-lab ; traces: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20694688
summary: Frequency-aware latency estimators enable deadline-aware DVFS for edge ML inference by modeling latency over CPU and GPU frequencies. We present a measurement study on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano showing three phenomena outside this modeling scope. (1) The memory clock is a missing axis: across the realistic upper EMC range (2133->3199 MHz) it shifts median latency by +11% to +48% depending on workload, and for a synthetic L2-resident kernel at the top GPU clock we observe a reproducible non-monotonic case (-9%). A GPU-frequency estimator profiled under one power profile and deployed under another consequently underestimates latency by up to 32%; tabulating the four lockable EMC points repairs most workloads, while a parametric 1/f_emc term does not. (2) Aggregate miss rates hide bursts: at fixed clocks, 100k-cycle runs show knife-edge distributions whose deadline-miss cliffs span ~1 ms, yet misses cluster far beyond independence - at a 0.1% aggregate miss rate, the next cycle also misses with probability up to 74% (740x the independent baseline). Gaussian mu+3sigma margins overshoot a 0.1% miss target by 13x-29x, while out-of-sample generalized Pareto margins stay within ~2x of it across all eight configurations. (3) Frequency actuation is not free: per-domain transition stalls stay below 100 us, but the new operating point takes 1/5/8 ms (CPU/GPU/EMC) to take effect - a substantial fraction of typical inference periods for per-inference governors. We release the full measurement harness and discuss implications for the next generation of frequency-aware estimators and governors.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了边缘ML推理中现有频率感知模型的三个关键局限：忽略了内存时钟（EMC）的关键影响、未能捕捉延迟违例的突发特性、以及低估了DVFS频率切换的显著时延开销，并提出了相应的改进方向。
AI.motivation: 现有的频率感知潜伏期估计器通常仅关注CPU和GPU频率，但在边缘计算场景中存在模型缺失或偏差，且缺乏对延迟突发行为和动态频率调整（DVFS）开销的精确建模，导致任务难以满足实时性需求。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上进行了广泛的实证测量研究；分析了EMC频率对延迟的影响；通过广义帕累托分布（GPD）替代高斯分布来建模延迟突发现象；定量测定了频率切换带来的 actuation stall（制动延迟）开销。
AI.result: 1. EMC频率对延迟有显著影响（+48% ~ -9%），现有单一建模忽略EMC导致延迟估计偏差高达32%；2. 延迟违例具有突发性，高斯模型无法捕捉，而广义帕累托分布能大幅提高边缘延迟预测的准确性；3. 频率切换开销不可忽视（高达8ms的同步延迟），这对于短周期推理任务的频率调节器设计至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 传统的频率感知潜伏期估计器在边缘侧推理中存在局限性，不能简单依赖CPU/GPU频率。为了实现高精度的延迟预测和实时调度，必须将内存时钟（EMC）纳入建模，使用极值理论（EVT）改进延迟违例预测，并充分考虑电压频率调节（DVFS）本身带来的显著时延开销。

title: When Does q-error Predict Plan Regret? Three Regimes of Cardinality-Estimation Error
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Code, benchmarks, and full pre-registration: https://github.com/samyama-ai/ce-metric-eval
summary: Cardinality-estimation (CE) research ranks estimators by q-error, yet it is well known that q-error is an imperfect proxy for query-plan quality. We give a measurement-driven account of when it is a good proxy and when it is not, and why. Modeling plan selection as an argmin over a piecewise-linear cost landscape, we find that plan regret (the cost of the chosen plan relative to the optimal, under true cardinalities) is governed by plan-cost geometry in a regime-dependent way. (i) For small errors, a true-point condition number kappa predicts regret and out-predicts q-error; its predictive power decays to zero as error grows, as a local linearization must. (ii) For large errors -- where deployed learned estimators operate -- an estimator-independent average-case sub-optimality measure ACS-infinity predicts which queries are regret-prone (Spearman rho ~ 0.54 on STATS-CEB), while q-error is nearly uninformative at the query level (rho ~ 0.05). (iii) The worst case is Haritsa's maximum sub-optimality (MSO). The three are one cost-ratio spectrum under three weightings. We prove a limit law ACS-infinity = sum_k r_k pi_k with cardinality-independent combinatorial weights, and validate every claim on STATS-CEB and JOB-light with four released estimators under pre-registered decision rules, and confirm on real PostgreSQL runtime that ACS-infinity predicts regret where q-error does not. The contribution is conceptual and empirical -- an average-case companion to worst-case robust query optimization, and a characterization of when an accuracy metric tracks plan quality -- rather than a new estimator. Code and the full pre-registration are public.

AI.tldr: 本文研究指出 q-error 作为基数估计的性能指标存在严重局限性，并提出了 ACS-infinity 作为一种能更好预测查询计划代价风险（regret）的评估指标，通过理论与实证分析证明了其在实际数据库查询优化中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 基数估计（CE）领域通常采用 q-error 作为估计器的排名指标，但该指标在真实查询计划的选择质量上表现不佳，难以准确反映代价（cost）差异。本文旨在通过测量分析，探讨 q-error 何时有效，并找出能够更准确预测查询计划风险（regret）的替代度量。
AI.method: 1. 将计划选择建模为分段线性代价（cost）景观上的 argmin 问题；2. 定义并分析了三种度量指标：局部线性化的条件数（kappa）、平均情况下的次优性度量（ACS-infinity）以及最坏情况度量（MSO）；3. 通过数学证明建立 ACS-infinity 的极限规律；4. 使用 STATS-CEB 和 JOB-light 数据集及四种公开估计器进行实证评估（含 PostgreSQL 真实运行时验证）。
AI.result: 1. q-error 在大规模误差情况下对查询计划质量几乎无预测能力（相关系数约 0.05）；2. 在小误差下，kappa 指标的效果优于 q-error；3. 在大误差下（即实际应用场景），提出的 ACS-infinity 指标能显著预测查询风险（相关系数约 0.54），优于现有标准；4. 实验验证了 ACS-infinity 是 q-error 的重要补充，能准确反映真实系统中的查询代价。
AI.conclusion: q-error 常被误用为衡量基数估计性能的指标。通过理论建模与实证分析，本文揭示了查询计划风险（regret）与估计误差之间的深层几何关系，并提出了一套基于 ACS-infinity 的更有效的评估框架，推动了查询优化器评估标准的科学化。

title: PANDA: An LLM-Enhanced Performance-Driven Analog Design Framework Bridging Design Intent and Layout Generation
summary: Traditional design of analog circuits heavily relies on manual interventions across topology, sizing, and layout, with prior automation addressing stages in isolation. In this work, we propose PANDA, an LLM-enhanced framework that bridges high-level design intent to final layout by actively managing cross-stage dependencies through guided topology synthesis, substructure-aware sizing, and constraint-driven layout generation. This shifts automation from algorithm-centric execution to intent-centric co-design, reducing turnaround time from days or weeks to hours while improving design performance.

AI.tldr: PANDA是一个基于LLM的模拟电路设计框架，通过整合拓扑、尺寸和布局各阶段的依赖关系，实现了从设计意图到布局的自动化协同设计，极大地提升了设计效率与质量。
AI.motivation: 解决传统模拟电路设计严重依赖人工干预、各设计阶段（拓扑、尺寸、布局）相互割裂、无法高效协同的问题。
AI.method: 提出PANDA框架：一个大语言模型（LLM）增强的系统，通过引导式拓扑合成（guided topology synthesis）、子结构感知尺寸调整（substructure-aware sizing）以及约束驱动的布局生成（constraint-driven layout generation），实现跨阶段依赖项的管理与集成。
AI.result: 实现了从高层设计意图到最终布局的端到端自动化，显著提升了设计的生产效率并优化了电路性能。
AI.conclusion: PANDA框架成功将模拟电路设计从算法导向转变为意图导向的协同设计模式，在显著缩短设计周期（由数周缩短至数小时）的同时，提升了设计的性能指标。

title: Threshold Minimum Cut with Terminal Quotas: Logarithmic and Planar Approximation Algorithms
summary: We study threshold minimum cut problems with a distinguished root vertex, a set of terminals, and a quota. In the threshold minimum edge cut problem (\TMEC), the goal is to find a minimum-cost edge cut that disconnects at least $k$ terminals from the root.
