In the threshold minimum node cut problem (\TMNC), the goal is to delete a minimum-cost set of nonterminal, nonroot vertices so that at least $k$ terminals become disconnected from the root. We prove three approximation guarantees. First, undirected general-graph \TMEC{} admits a randomized polynomial-time expected $O(\log n)$ approximation via a Räcke-style cut-dominating tree decomposition and an exact dynamic program on trees. A standard repetition argument gives the same asymptotic ratio with high probability. Second, planar \TMEC{} admits a factor-$2$ approximation by reducing the threshold condition to planar weighted balanced cut. Third, bounded-degree planar \TMNC{} admits a $2Δ$-approximation, where $Δ$ is the maximum degree of a deletable vertex, by reducing the node-cost problem to the planar edge-cut problem on the same graph. The results separate exact-quota guarantees from bicriteria small-set-expansion-type guarantees and identify the unbounded-degree planar node-cut case as the main remaining obstacle.

AI.tldr: 本文针对具有配额要求的阈值最小切分问题（TMEC 和 TMNC），提出了一系列近似算法：在一般图中实现了 O(log n) 近似，并在平面图（及有界度平面图）中实现了恒常数因子近似。
AI.motivation: 研究带根顶点、终端集合及 quota（配额）要求的阈值最小切分问题。具体包括：在 TMEC 中找到最小成本边切分以切断至少 k 个终端；在 TMNC 中找到最小成本非终端/非根节点集合以切断至少 k 个终端。
AI.method:
1. 对于一般无向图的 TMEC，采用基于 Räcke 风格的树分解（cut-dominating tree decomposition）结合树上的动态规划算法；
2. 对于平面图的 TMEC，通过将其规约为平面加权平衡切分问题（planar weighted balanced cut）；
3. 对于有界度平面图的 TMNC，通过将其规约为相同图上的平面边切分问题。
AI.result:
1. 一般无向图的 TMEC 达到期望 O(log n) 近似比（随机化多项式时间）；
2. 平面图的 TMEC 达到 2-近似；
3. 有界度平面图的 TMNC 达到 2Δ-近似（Δ 为可删除顶点的最大度数）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究结果区分了精确配额保证与双准则小集扩展型保证，并指出无界度平面图的节点切分问题是当前的主要研究难点。

title: Evaluating Gemma4 Models as AI Teaching Assistants for Introductory Parallel Programming: A DataRaceBench Study
summary: Debugging data races is a major challenge for students learning parallel programming due to the non-deterministic nature of concurrent execution and the complexity of shared-memory semantics. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest that they could serve as AI teaching assistants, but the capabilities of lower-cost open-weight models for parallel debugging remain unclear. In this paper, we evaluate two Gemma4 open-weight models, Gemma4-E4B and Gemma4-31B, on their ability to identify, explain, and repair data races in OpenMP programs from the DataRaceBench benchmark suite. We also investigate whether contextual hints, including ThreadSanitizer (TSan) reports and model-generated explanations, improve repair quality. Our results show that Gemma4-E4B correctly explained 82 of 104 race-condition programs and successfully repaired 73, while Gemma4-31B achieved 100 correct explanations and 98 successful repairs. Surprisingly, additional context did not consistently improve repair effectiveness and sometimes reduced performance. These findings suggest that open-weight LLMs can provide valuable support for student self-debugging, with larger models offering near-complete coverage of the benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了Gemma4系列开源模型在OpenMP并行程序数据竞争调试中的能力，发现更大规模模型（31B）具备极高的修复准确度，且指出盲目增加上下文信息并不总是提升LLM性能的有效手段。
AI.motivation: 并行编程中的数据竞争调试因其不确定性和复杂性对学生而言极具挑战，目前尚不明确低成本的开源LLM是否能胜任该任务并有效辅助教学。
AI.method: 对Gemma4-E4B和Gemma4-31B模型在DataRaceBench基准测试中的OpenMP数据竞争程序进行识别、解释与修复评估，并对比添加不同上下文（如TSan报告、模型自身解释）对修复效果的影响。
AI.result: Gemma4-E4B成功解释了104个程序中的82个并修复了73个；Gemma4-31B表现更优，分别达到100次解释成功和98次修复成功。附加的上下文提示并未总是提升修复效果，反而有时会产生负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 开源LLM在辅助学生进行并行程序调试方面具有显著潜力，其中更大规模的模型能够实现近乎完美的性能，但应警惕过多的上下文信息反而可能降低模型的修复效果。

title: The Reverse Telescoping Coordinate System for Positive Definite Matrices: Geometry, Computation, and Generative Modeling
summary: We design a new unconstrained coordinate system where a $p\times p$ symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrix $Θ$ is represented by a reverse telescoping map $Θ(x)=\rm{RT}(x)$, with $x=(v,d,r)\in\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^{(p-1)}\times\mathbb{R}^{p(p-1)/2}$, representing respectively the log volume or log determinant; and the shape, as encoded by log relative diagonal scales and partial covariances among the nodes. This construction results in important properties not available in other charts, e.g., matrix logarithm, such as Jacobian depending on only the log-determinant. A useful feature of our construction is $x$ contains a lossless symbolic representation of both the matrix and its inverse. Many important computations involving a matrix and its inverse can be performed in $O(p^2)$ in the transformed domain, while it is the rendering of results in matrix forms (on demand) that must incur an $O(p^3)$ cost. Moreover, two unit-determinant matrices in the transformed domain can be joined by a straight line with pathwise unit determinant. For generative modeling, this allows designing a split volume-shape flow model trained by conditional flow matching for transporting the shape over the unit-determinant path, with a separate one-dimensional flow for transporting the volume or the determinant. The forbidding SPD constraint, tamed thus into a powerful guiding force, leads to the surprising insight that it is in some sense easier to design a volume-normalized shape flow for SPD compared to the unconstrained $\mathbb{R}^{p\times p}$, with no intrinsic notion of volume to aid normalization, unlike the determinant of SPD matrices. We apply our construction for up to $p=200$ in generative modeling of SPD matrices on a difficult synthetic bimodal target, and in generating brain connectivity networks by models trained on fMRI data; as well as in intrinsic diffusion on the SPD manifold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对SPD矩阵的无约束坐标系统——反向伸缩映射（RT），通过将SPD矩阵解耦为体积和形状分量，实现了高效的矩阵运算和更优的生成流模型设计。
AI.motivation: 为了克服SPD矩阵空间中的约束限制，寻找一种高效的参数化方式，以优化生成建模，特别是解决SPD矩阵逆运算、体积标准化及流模型设计中的计算复杂性问题。
AI.method: 设计了一种新的无约束坐标系统，利用反向伸缩映射（Reverse Telescoping map）将p×p对称正定（SPD）矩阵分解为对数行列式（体积）、对数相对对角尺度和偏协方差（形状）；并据此开发了体积-形状分离的流模型，结合条件流匹配进行训练。
AI.result: 在p=200的规模下，该方法在合成双模分布生成、fMRI脑网络建模以及SPD流形上的内禀扩散任务中表现优异，且实现了运算复杂度的优化（关键计算可达O(p^2)）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，通过反向伸缩映射（RT）将SPD矩阵映射到无约束坐标系，不仅简化了SPD矩阵的生成建模，还使得在转换域中执行高效计算（O(p^2)）成为可能，为SPD流模型的设计提供了新的理论视角。

title: Computing Smooth Geodesics under Two-Sided Curvature Bounds with Applications to Robotics and Image Analysis
summary: Curvature of planar curves serves as a key regularization term for computing second-order minimal paths, due to its tight relevance to desirable geometric properties such as smoothness, rigidity, and elasticity. In this paper, we tackle a more challenging problem in computational physics and geometry problem: tracking minimal paths whose curvature is constrained by arbitrary upper and lower bounds. For that purpose, we propose a new curvature-bounded geodesic model, developed under the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) partial differential equation (PDE) framework. It provides strong geometric control over minimal paths by enforcing curvature range constraints, whose paths are smooth and of bounded curvature limitation. We also present a discretization scheme for the Hamiltonian and the HJB PDE incorporating curvature bounds, allowing efficient solver for estimating numerical solutions to the model. Finally, we illustrate the capability of the proposed curvature-bounded geodesic model in applications of robot path planning and curvilinear structures tracking from images. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed curvature-bounded geodesic model serves as a powerful and robust tool for finding satisfactory paths.

AI.tldr: 本文通过HJB框架引入曲率约束，提出了一种新型测地线模型，能有效解决路径规划中对几何曲率的精确控制问题。
AI.motivation: 现有测地线模型难以直接对路径的曲率施加严格的上、下界约束，而在机器人路径规划及物理图像特征追踪中，对路径平滑度和几何约束的要求日益迫切。
AI.method: 提出了基于哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）偏微分方程的几何模型，并设计了一套针对受限哈密顿量的离散化求解方案。
AI.result: 通过数值实验验证，该模型成功在机器人路径规划和图像中曲线结构追踪等任务中生成了满足曲率约束的平滑路径。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于HJB方程的曲率受限测地线模型，在路径规划及图像特征提取中展现出高效且鲁棒的性能，能够有效实现对路径平滑度和弯曲程度的精确几何控制。

title: Simplifying the Modeling of Arbitrary Conditionals in Natural Language
summary: Causal Transformers model sequences through an autoregressive factorization of the joint distribution, which enables efficient left-to-right decoding and conditional likelihood computation. However, they cannot tractably sample from or evaluate arbitrary conditionals -- e.g., a block of text conditioned on past and future tokens. Recent work aims to solve this problem through novel architectures, but they often lead to sub-optimal modeling of such conditionals and degraded generations. We propose Arbitrary Conditionals GPT (AC-GPT) which introduces a simple modification to standard causal Transformers to enable evaluating and sampling from arbitrary conditionals -- including past, future, and mixed contexts -- within a single forward pass. Unlike prior approaches, our method preserves the standard left-to-right ordering and next-token prediction objective essential for both strong performance and efficient training on natural language. Crucially, this compatibility allows existing LLMs to be fine-tuned for arbitrary conditioning. Our empirical results indicate that our method outperforms baselines on modeling arbitrary conditionals, without degrading standard left-to-right performance.

AI.tldr: AC-GPT 是一种改进的因果 Transformer，可在保留标准自回归训练优势的同时，实现对任意上下文（过去、未来、混合）的高效条件生成与概率评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归（Causal）Transformer 在处理任意条件（如给定过去和未来 tokens 对中间文本进行推理）时存在计算不可行或性能衰减的问题，而现有解决方案往往改变了架构，导致模型表现下降。
AI.method: 提出 AC-GPT 模型，通过对标准因果 Transformer 进行轻量级修改，使其能够在单次前向传递中处理任意条件概率分布，同时保留标准从左到右的预测目标。
AI.result: 实验表明，AC-GPT 在建模任意条件方面优于基准方法，同时没有降低标准从左到右预测任务的性能，并支持对现有大型语言模型（LLMs）进行微调。
AI.conclusion: AC-GPT 证实了在保持标准因果 Transformer 架构的同时，可以通过简单的修改实现对任意上下文（过去、未来及混合）的灵活采样与评估，且不会牺牲原有模型在自回归任务上的高性能。

title: GRASP: Gradient-Aligned Sequential Parameter Transfer for Memory-Efficient Multi-Source Learning
summary: Multi-source transfer learning faces a fundamental scalability bottleneck: existing approaches require either loading all K source models into memory simultaneously during parameter fusion, requiring O(K) memory, or deploying all models at inference time, making production deployment infeasible. We propose GRASP (Gradient-Aligned Sequential Parameter Transfer), which achieves superior knowledge integration while maintaining O(1) memory consumption through three key innovations: (1) sequential processing that merges one source at a time into an evolving target model, (2) parameter-wise gradient alignment that selectively transfers only parameters whose optimization directions align with the target domain, avoiding negative transfer, and (3) iterative fine-tuning that adapts transferred knowledge before integrating the next source. Extensive experiments across three continual learning benchmarks (Yearbook, CLEAR-10, CLEAR-100) spanning 10 to 108-year temporal distribution shifts and four architectures (1.3M to 25.6M parameters) demonstrate that GRASP achieves 93.5% mean accuracy over all datasets and architectures compared to ensemble method's 71.7% accuracy while requiring only constant memory versus K models for standard multi-source fusion. Critically, GRASP's sequential previously merged models and scales to arbitrarily many sources without memory growth, making it uniquely suitable for resource-constrained deployment and continually evolving source domains.

AI.tldr: GRASP 是一种无需同时加载所有源模型的新型迁移学习方法，通过顺序梯度对齐与迭代微调，在仅需常数内存的情况下，实现了优于传统集成的多源模型知识融合。
AI.motivation: 解决多源迁移学习中的可扩展性瓶颈，即现有方法在参数融合或推理时需要同时加载 K 个模型，导致 O(K) 的内存消耗，在生产部署中不可行。
AI.method: 提出了 GRASP (Gradient-Aligned Sequential Parameter Transfer)，包含三项核心创新：1) 顺序处理：一次仅合并一个源模型；2) 参数级梯度对齐：仅迁移与目标领域优化方向一致的参数，防止负迁移；3) 迭代微调：在合并下一个源模型前对已迁移知识进行适应。
AI.result: 在三个持续学习基准测试及四种不同规模架构上，GRASP 达到了 93.5% 的平均准确率，显著高于集成方法的 71.7%，且全程仅需 O(1) 的常数内存占用。
AI.conclusion: GRASP 通过顺序融合机制成功克服了多源迁移学习中 O(K) 的内存瓶颈，在保持常数内存占用的同时，实现了优于现有集成方法的知识整合效果，非常适合资源受限环境下的持续学习任务。

title: Confidence-Based Stopping Methods for Systematic Reviews
summary: Technology Assisted Review stopping methods aim to ensure that no more documents are screened than necessary. Most existing approaches focus on achieving a target recall, which does not consider whether an information need has been met. This paper introduces two heuristic stopping methods that instead monitor whether screened documents contain enough information to make a decision. Evaluation on a standard dataset of Diagnostic Test Accuracy Systematic Reviews demonstrates that the proposed approaches substantially reduce the number of documents that need to be examined while, in the majority of cases, maintaining conclusions that are consistent with all evidence available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于“信息需求满足度”的新型TAR（技术辅助审查）自动停止策略，成功平衡了筛选工作量控制与审查结论的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的技术辅助审查（TAR）自动停止方法多侧重于达到特定的召回率，而忽略了“信息需求是否真实得到满足”这一核心诉求。
AI.method: 引入了两种启发式停止方法，其核心逻辑是监控已筛选文档中包含的信息量是否足以支持决策，而非依赖传统的目标召回率。
AI.result: 在诊断测试准确性（Diagnostic Test Accuracy）系统评价的标准数据集上的评估显示，所提出的方法在大量减少人工筛选工作量的同时，依然能够维持系统评价结论的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的两种启发式停止方法能够有效减少技术辅助审查（TAR）中需要人工筛选的文档数量，同时在大多数情况下保持结论与完整证据集的一致性，证明了基于“信息需求是否满足”而非单纯追逐“目标召回率”在实际应用中的有效性。

title: C^2: Cache-Conscious Succinct Tries with Adaptive Unary Path Compression
summary: Succinct tries are powerful string dictionaries because of their low memory footprint and fast query performance. However, existing succinct trie implementations face two key challenges to spatial locality: 1) they incur unnecessary cache misses during queries, especially during trie navigation operations, and 2) they waste significant space when the data contains many unary paths. We propose C^2, a set of two techniques: C_1 introduces a more cache-friendly layout for the \bv underlying succinct tries, and C_2 compresses redundant unary paths. We thoroughly redesign three state-of-the-art succinct tries: FST, CoCo-trie, and Marisa, producing C^2-FST, C^2-CoCo, and C^2-Marisa. Experiments on six diverse datasets show that the C_1 optimization improves query performance by 1.58x, 1.12x, and 1.42x, respectively, compared to the original FST, CoCo-trie, and Marisa. Furthermore, the C_2 optimization achieves a 1.3x smaller memory footprint on average. The succinct tries optimized with both aspects of C^2 achieve better space-time tradeoffs than their original versions and other state-of-the-art succinct tries, while using significantly less space than non-succinct tries like ART and C-ART.

AI.tldr: C^2技术通过改进内存布局和压缩一元路径，解决了简洁前缀树的缓存效率和空间冗余问题，在实现显著性能提升的同时大幅降低了内存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有简洁前缀树实现存在两大问题：一是导航过程中缓存局部性差导致的效率低下，二是处理包含大量一元路径数据时空间利用率低。
AI.method: 提出了C^2框架，包含两项关键技术：C_1通过引入缓存友好型布局减少查询过程中的缓存缺失；C_2通过压缩冗余的一元路径（unary paths）减少空间浪费。作者将其应用于FST、CoCo-trie和Marisa三个代表性简洁前缀树中。
AI.result: C_1优化使FST、CoCo-trie和Marisa的查询性能分别提升了1.58倍、1.12倍和1.42倍；C_2优化平均减少了1.3倍的内存占用。综合应用下，性能与空间表现均优于原版本及其他主流简洁前缀树，并远胜于非简洁前缀树结构。
AI.conclusion: C^2技术通过优化内存布局（C_1）和压缩冗余路径（C_2），显著提升了现代简洁前缀树（Succinct Tries）的查询性能与空间效率，实现了比现有先进技术更优的存储-时间权衡。

title: A Spatio-Temporal Expert Prefetching Framework for Efficient MoE-based LLM Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based large language models (LLMs), such as Qwen and DeepSeek, have recently emerged as an effective approach to improving model capacity without proportionally increasing computational cost. By replacing the conventional feed-forward network in dense LLMs with a set of experts and activating only a subset of them for each input token, MoE models significantly increase the total number of parameters while keeping the per-token computation relatively manageable. However, this dynamic and irregular expert activation pattern also introduces substantial expert loading overhead during inference, since the required experts must be fetched on demand according to token-dependent routing results. As a result, expert loading latency becomes a major source of performance and energy inefficiency. To this end, we first perform a comprehensive analysis of expert selection behavior in various MoE-based LLMs and applications, including language understanding and code generation. Our analysis reveals that, within each application domain, expert requests exhibit strong correlation across both adjacent MoE layers and consecutive decoding tokens, making future expert activations predictable. Based on this insight, we propose ST-MoE, a spatio-temporal expert prefetching framework that proactively stages experts ahead of use to overlap expert loading with ongoing computation. ST-MoE combines a lightweight runtime prediction mechanism that preserves the original routing behavior with a reconfigurable hardware design that efficiently supports dynamic expert prefetching. The combined effect of the prediction mechanism with the supporting hardware significantly improves MoE inference performance and energy efficiency while preserving model inference accuracy.

AI.tldr: ST-MoE 利用 MoE 推理中专家激活的时空规律，通过预测机制与硬件协同预取专家，有效掩盖了加载延迟，提升了系统效率。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型在推理时由于专家动态路由导致的专家加载延迟严重影响了系统的性能和能效。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 ST-MoE 的时空专家预取框架，包含轻量级运行时预测机制（捕捉跨层和跨 Token 的专家激活相关性）以及可重构的硬件辅助设计，以实现专家加载与计算的重叠。
AI.result: 分析表明专家请求在层间和 Token 序列间具有强相关性；ST-MoE 能够有效预取专家，隐藏加载延迟，改善推理性能与能效。
AI.conclusion: ST-MoE 通过利用专家激活的时空相关性，实现了高效的专家预取，在不损失模型精度的前提下显著提升了 MoE LLM 的推理性能和能效。

title: Distributed Dominating Set With Optimal Rounds and Message Size in Bounded Arboricity Graphs
summary:
We study the distributed minimum dominating set problem on graphs of arboricity $α$. Dory, Ghaffari, and Ilchi [PODC'22] showed that any algorithm achieving a constant or poly-logarithmic approximation factor needs at least $Ω(\logΔ/\log\logΔ)$ rounds in graphs of maximum degree $Δ$ and arboricity $α$, even when $α=2$ and even when the message sizes are unbounded. Although there is a variety of algorithms with a near-optimal round complexity of $O(\logΔ)$, it is natural to ask: What is the best approximation factor in the optimal round complexity of $O(\logΔ/\log\logΔ)$?
  We make progress in answering this question by describing a deterministic algorithm that obtains a $O\left( α\log Δ/ \log\log Δ\right)$ approximation without prior knowledge of $α$ with optimal round complexity of $O\left( \log Δ/ \log\log Δ\right)$ and optimal message size of $1$ bit per round.
  Among all of the previous results, the only algorithm that achieves the optimal round complexity of $O\left( \log Δ/ \log\log Δ\right)$ without prior knowledge of $α$ is due to Lenzen and Wattenhofer [DISC'10] that obtains a $O(α\log^{1+\varepsilon}Δ/ (\varepsilon\log\log Δ))$ approximation in $O(\logΔ/(\varepsilon\log\logΔ))$ rounds and $O(\log(\varepsilon^{-1}\logΔ))$ message size. Our algorithm simplifies and improves upon this result. The only downside of our algorithm compared to the algorithm of Lenzen and Wattenhofer is that it needs prior knowledge of $Δ$.
  The previous state-of-the-art algorithm by Dory, Ghaffari, and Ilchi [PODC'22] has a dependency on $\log n$ in the round complexity for unknown $α$, which is far from optimal.

AI.tldr: 该研究在限制为 O(log Δ/loglog Δ) rounds 的最优轮复杂度下，针对分布式最小支配集问题，提出了一种仅需 1 bit 消息大小的 O(α log Δ/loglog Δ) 近似算法。
AI.motivation: 在处理具有树宽度 α 的图的分布式最小支配集问题时，尽管已知最优轮复杂度为 O(log Δ/loglog Δ)，但在此复杂度下所能达到的最佳近似比尚不明确；且现有算法在复杂度或消息大小上仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 提出了一种确定性分布式算法；该算法不需要预先知道图的树宽度（arboricity）α，但需要预先知道最大度Δ。
AI.result: 实现了 O(α log Δ/loglog Δ) 近似比，满足 O(log Δ/loglog Δ) 的最佳轮复杂度，且仅需每轮 1 bit 的消息传输。该结果在轮复杂度和消息效率上均超越了 Lenzen 和 Wattenhofer 已有的研究成果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种确定性算法，在已知最大度Δ的前提下，能在最优的 O(log Δ/loglog Δ) 轮复杂度内实现 O(α log Δ/loglog Δ) 的近似比，且消息大小优化至每轮 1 bit，在性能和理论复杂度上优于以往同类最优算法。

title: NEURON-Fabric: CXL-Side Low-Bit Gradient Aggregation for Distributed Training
summary: In large-model distributed training, especially large language model workloads, gradient All-Reduce increasingly stresses the memory and communication path. This paper asks whether a Compute Express Link (CXL) memory controller can aggregate low-bit gradient signals as gradient cache lines pass through it, while preserving a 32-bit floating-point (FP32) path for workloads, layers, or phases that should not use low-bit approximation. We present NEURON-Fabric, a CXL-side controller architecture that performs packed gradient-binary (G-Binary) sign-count aggregation and gradient-ternary (G-Ternary) gated aggregation near CXL memory, with a control interface for selecting low-bit or FP32 paths. Cycle-level timing experiments show that the measured five-cycle low-bit aggregation datapath adds at most 1.67 percent exposed runtime overhead in the full last-level-cache miss regime; under bandwidth pressure, the same compute stage is hidden by CXL service time. Functional tests confirm byte-exact identity read-back, G-Binary sign-count aggregation, and G-Ternary gating. Training checks quantify the communication and accuracy tradeoff: low-bit aggregation remains close to FP32 on CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 and SST-2/DistilBERT, while full-path low-bit aggregation fails on CIFAR-100/ResNet-18. Layer-aware admission identifies the classifier head as sensitive; keeping the head on FP32 while applying low-bit aggregation to the backbone recovers most accuracy and reduces gradient traffic to 3.6-5.4 percent of the FP32 baseline. Hardware synthesis and FPGA place-and-route estimates suggest that the 512-bit aggregation datapath is small enough to be treated as a near-memory datapath extension rather than a separate accelerator-scale block.

AI.tldr: NEURON-Fabric提出了一种基于CXL内存控制器的近内存计算架构，通过在硬件层执行低位宽梯度聚合，大幅减少了大模型分布式训练中的通信开销。
AI.motivation: 大模型分布式训练场景下，梯度All-Reduce操作对内存和通信带宽造成巨大压力，亟需降低传输开销。
AI.method: 提出了NEURON-Fabric架构，在CXL内存控制器中集成专门的数据通路，支持梯度二值化（G-Binary）和三值化（G-Ternary）聚合运算，并保留了FP32路径以满足对精度敏感的层（如分类头）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该架构处理延迟极低（仅5个周期），在带宽受限时几乎无额外延迟；通信量降低至原先的3.6%-5.4%；通过分层精度策略（层感知准入），在保持接近FP32模型精度的前提下实现了显著的通信压缩。
AI.conclusion: NEURON-Fabric通过在CXL控制器中实现近内存梯度聚合，在保持模型精度的同时，显著减少了分布式训练中的梯度通信负载，且硬件开销较小，是一种高效的近数据计算方案。

title: Structured Nonparametric Variational Inference for Dependent Latent Modeling
summary: Variational inference (VI) is a core engine of modern AI, enabling scalable approximate Bayesian learning and uncertainty-aware training of large probabilistic and generative models. In this paper, we propose Structured Nonparametric Variational Inference (SN-VI), a novel framework for modeling complex dependencies among latent variables in posterior approximation, leveraging multivariate spline techniques. Unlike traditional methods that rely on the mean-field assumption, SN-VI preserves intricate latent variable dependencies, providing a flexible and accurate approximation of posteriors with arbitrary shapes. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees, including the derivation of the lower bound for the variational objective and proof of asymptotic consistency in posterior estimation. To facilitate practical implementation, we develop an algorithm that automatically identifies dependent latent variables and their underlying dependence structure, without requiring manual specification. Simulation studies validate the effectiveness of SN-VI in approximating posterior distributions with bounded support and complex dependencies. The proposed method has been successfully applied to high-dimensional structured data, including computer vision datasets and spatial transcriptomics. In these applications, SN-VI demonstrates improved generative model performance and effectively uncovers coupled biological signals through the learned dependency structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化非参数变分推理（SN-VI）框架，通过多元样条技术建模潜变量间的复杂依赖，抛弃均值场假设，实现了更精确的后验近似，并在理论和实践应用中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 传统变分推理（VI）多依赖于“均值场假设”（Mean-field assumption），难以捕捉潜变量之间复杂的依赖关系，导致后验近似不准确。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“结构化非参数变分推理（SN-VI）”的框架，利用多元样条（Multivariate Spline）技术对潜变量之间的复杂依赖关系进行建模，并开发了一种能够自动识别潜变量依赖结构的算法。
AI.result: 理论上推导了变分目标的下界并证明了后验估计的渐近一致性；实验结果表明，SN-VI 在处理具有复杂依赖的分布以及计算机视觉和空间转录组学等高维结构化数据任务时，提升了生成模型性能并能有效识别耦合的生物信号。
AI.conclusion: SN-VI 为近似复杂后验分布提供了一种灵活、准确且具有理论保证的非参数框架，有效地克服了传统均值场假设的局限性，在处理具有复杂依赖关系的结构化数据时表现出优越的性能。

title: TacStyle: Personalizing Tactile Robot Policies using Structured Behavior Representations
summary: Robotic systems that assist humans should be capable of adapting their behaviors to individual user preferences. For instance, users may want a robot arm to adjust the amount of force it applies while folding their laundry or cleaning furniture. Natural language provides an intuitive way for humans to communicate such preferences. Recent progress in language-conditioned robot policies has shown that robots can successfully use language prompts to determine what task to perform. However, extending the same approach to realize how the task should be performed requires detailed labels describing the preferences or styles of trajectories in the task data. Not only is collecting such annotations challenging, but conditioning directly on these labels may also fail to provide fine-grained control over a continuous range of behaviors. For example, it can be difficult to convey the exact force that a robot must apply through abstract instructions like "apply a bit more pressure than before". Therefore, in this work, we propose using language to reason over preferred behaviors instead of directly generating them. We first learn a structured latent representation that organizes user preferences according to differences in the corresponding trajectories. Then, given a preference prompt, we use a foundation model to interpret this latent space and choose a value that produces the desired behavior. Through both simulation and real-world experiments, we show that selecting robot behaviors from an intuitively structured latent space enables more precise adaptation to user preferences while requiring significantly fewer preference labels than language-conditioned policies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过在结构化潜在空间中使用语言推理来调整机器人行为的新框架，实现了更精细的个性化控制，并显著降低了数据标注成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言引导机器人策略在执行“如何做”（风格/偏好控制）时面临挑战，如需要大量详细标注、难以实现连续性行为的精细控制（如力度调节），以及指令模糊性问题。
AI.method: 1. 学习一种结构化的潜在表示（structured latent representation），根据轨迹差异组织用户偏好；2. 利用基础模型（foundation model）解读该潜在空间，根据语言指令选择合适的偏好值以调整机器人行为。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实世界实验中，该方法展现了比传统语言条件策略更精准的偏好适应能力，且所需偏好标签数量大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于语言推理行为偏好而非直接生成行为，该方法在机器人适应用户个性化偏好方面表现更优，在实现精细控制的同时，显著降低了对标注数据的依赖。

title: CoRA: Confidence-Rationale Alignment for Reliable Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve LLM performance, but high answer confidence may be misleading when the accompanying CoT rationale is plausible yet incomplete or poorly supported. We study confidence--rationale alignment: whether a model's confidence in its committed answer is justified by its generated rationale. We introduce a GRPO-based reinforcement learning framework that jointly rewards answer correctness, committed-answer probability, and rubric-based rationale support, where the rubric assesses grounding, coherence, task match, and connection to the selected answer without revealing the gold answer to the judge. Across MedQA, MathQA, and OpenBookQA using three open-weight LLMs, our method reduces the confidence--rationale alignment error by up to 26.51% compared with untuned checkpoints, SFT, and correctness-only GRPO, while maintaining competitive accuracy and often improving calibration. These results show that reliable CoT reasoning requires not only confident answers, but rationales that substantively support them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于 GRPO 的强化学习方法，通过引入多维度推理质量评分准则，成功缓解了 LLM 在思维链推理中“答案置信度与推理过程逻辑不匹配”的问题。
AI.motivation: 思维链（CoT）虽能提升LLM性能，但模型容易出现“高置信度但推理过程存在缺陷（如不完整或支撑不足）”的现象，即存在置信度与推理逻辑不匹配（Misalignment）的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于 GRPO（组相对策略优化）的强化学习框架。该框架通过一个不泄露标准答案的评分准则（Rubric），从逻辑基础（grounding）、连贯性、任务匹配度以及推理与答案的关联性四个维度对推理过程进行评分，联合奖励机制同时考虑了答案准确性、选择概率和推理质量。
AI.result: 在 MedQA、MathQA 和 OpenBookQA 数据集上，该方法将置信度与推理的一致性误差降低了高达 26.51%，优于 SFT 及仅关注准确性的 GRPO 方法，并保持了准确率及校准度（Calibration）。
AI.conclusion: 要实现可靠的思维链（CoT）推理，模型不仅需要给出高置信度的答案，还必须生成能够实质性支持该答案的严谨推理过程。通过联合优化答案准确性和推理质量，可以有效降低置信度与推理过程之间的一致性误差。

title: Policy Regret for Embedding Model Routing: Contextual Bandits with Low-Rank Experts
summary: Modern recommendation systems increasingly rely on dynamically routing diverse queries to multiple embedding models. Despite its practical significance, this problem remains poorly understood under realistic conditions like adversarial queries, bandit feedback, and limited observability of models. We formalize embedding model routing as an adversarial contextual linear bandit with low-rank experts, where contexts are queries, actions are items, and experts are the embedding models working on low-rank latent representation spaces. We first establish that standard regret notions suffer from structural misspecification or statistical intractability, and we identify a log-quadratic policy class that is expressive enough to capture query-dependent model routing, yet structured enough to allow efficient online learning. Second, we propose a policy gradient algorithm called Hypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG). It provably adapts to the unknown low-rank structure under incomplete information and attains $\tilde{\mathcal O}(s\sqrt{M T})$ linearized policy regret -- where $s, M$, and $T$ are the intrinsic rank of the experts, the number of models, and the number of rounds -- thus avoiding a curse of dimensionality. Finally, we also provide an computationally efficient and parameter-free implementation of HPG.

AI.tldr: 针对推荐系统中嵌入模型动态路由的挑战，本文提出了一种基于低秩矩阵分解的对抗性赌博机模型，并设计了 HPG 算法，实现了高效的在线模型选择，且具备良好的理论保障（低遗憾界）。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统需要动态路由处理多样的查询，但在面对对抗性查询、多臂赌博机（bandit）反馈和模型观测有限等现实挑战时，现有的路由方法缺乏理论支撑且面临维度灾难。
AI.method:
1. 将嵌入模型路由形式化为“具有低秩专家的对抗性上下文线性赌博机（Adversarial Contextual Linear Bandit with Low-Rank Experts）”；
2. 引入对数二次策略类（log-quadratic policy class），平衡了表达能力与学习效率；
3. 设计了名为 Hypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG) 的策略梯度算法，用于在不完全信息下自适应学习低秩结构。
AI.result: 提出的 HPG 算法证明了其能够适应未知的低秩结构，并达到了 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(s\sqrt{MT})$ 的线性化策略遗憾界（其中 $s$ 为秩，$M$ 为模型数，$T$ 为轮数），在理论上克服了维度灾难。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种有效的在线学习框架 HPG，能够实现低秩嵌入模型的高效路由，解决了推荐系统中的动态模型选择问题，在理论上避免了维度灾难，并具备高效的工程实现。

title: EventConnector: Mining Social Event Relations through Temporal Graphs
summary: Understanding and retrieving related real-world events based on their temporal dynamics is a fundamental challenge in time-sensitive applications such as forecasting, information retrieval, and social analysis. Existing methods often rely on semantic similarity or global time-series alignment, which overlook the transient and directional dependencies that frequently underlie real-world correlations. In this work, we introduce \textit{EventConnector}, a framework that constructs a temporal event graph capturing localized co-fluctuations and lead-lag relationships between events through their time-series trajectories. We further propose \textbf{EC-Fusion}, an adaptive retrieval mechanism that fuses EventConnector's graph-based scores with a complementary Granger-causal signal via a graph-quality-aware mixing weight. Across two real-world prediction market benchmarks (Polymarket and Kalshi) and nine forecasting architectures evaluated over three random seeds, EC-Fusion is the best non-oracle retrieval method on $17/18$ model--dataset cells, reducing RMSE by $6.87\%$ on average (up to $10.86\%$) over the strongest comparable retrieval baseline, with statistical significance at $p < 0.01$ after Holm--Bonferroni correction. These results highlight the effectiveness of temporally grounded graph modeling, augmented with causal-signal fusion, in capturing latent event relationships beyond what semantic similarity or traditional alignment techniques can offer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EventConnector 和 EC-Fusion，通过构建时序事件图并融合格兰杰因果信号，有效捕捉事件间的动态关联，显著提升了预测任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖语义相似度或全局时序对齐，忽略了真实世界事件中至关重要的瞬态与方向性依赖关系，导致在 forecasting 等任务中表现受限。
AI.method: 提出 EventConnector 框架构建时序事件图（捕捉局部协波动与领滞关系），并开发 EC-Fusion 检索机制（通过图质量感知混合权重融合图分数与格兰杰因果信号）。
AI.result: 在 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 基准测试中，EC-Fusion 在 18 个模型-数据集单元中的 17 个表现最优，平均 RMSE 降低 6.87%（最高可达 10.86%），具有统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: Temporally grounded graph modeling, augmented with causal-signal fusion, effectively captures latent event relationships, surpassing traditional semantic similarity and alignment methods in time-sensitive forecasting.

title: SMEPilot: Characterizing and Optimizing LLM Inference with Scalable Matrix Extensions
summary: Modern CPUs increasingly integrate matrix extensions, such as Arm Scalable Matrix Extension (SME), that provide high-throughput matrix execution within the CPU. For LLM inference, however, these units are not a universal replacement for conventional CPU cores: prefill, decode, attention, and KV-cache operations expose different arithmetic intensities, vector behavior, and layout requirements, while SME units and CPU cores still compete for shared memory bandwidth. This paper studies this mismatch through a roofline-based characterization of SME-enabled CPUs and uses the resulting model to guide operator-level execution choices. We present SMEPilot, an LLM inference engine that selects CPU-only, SME-only, or cooperative SME+CPU execution for each operator shape. SMEPilot partitions matrix work across SME and CPU cores at tile granularity, overlaps SME-suitable matrix stages with CPU-suitable vector stages in attention, and maintains layout state so packed tensor representations are reused rather than repeatedly rebuilt on critical paths. Across Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-30BA3B on phone, PC, and server platforms, SMEPilot improves end-to-end inference performance by up to 3.94$\times$.

AI.tldr: 针对 Arm SME 架构提出 SMEPilot 推理引擎，通过 Roofline 建模指导算子级的 CPU/SME 灵活调度与协同执行，显著提升了 LLM 在各类设备上的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现代 CPU 内置的矩阵扩展（如 Arm SME）虽能提升算力，但 LLM 推理的不同计算阶段（prefill, decode, attention 等）对算力与带宽的需求差异巨大。现有的固定执行策略无法有效平衡计算性能与存储带宽竞争，导致 SME 的潜力未能被完全挖掘。
AI.method: 基于 Roofline 模型对 SME 启用 CPU 的计算特性进行建模；提出 SMEPilot 推理引擎，实现算子级执行策略（纯 CPU、纯 SME 或 CPU+SME 协同）；支持粒度为 tile 的任务划分、算子运算阶段重叠、以及跨算子的张量布局保持（减少重复打包开销）。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30BA3B 等模型，以及手机、PC 和服务器多种平台上，端到端推理性能最高提升了 3.94 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对不同算子特性（算术强度、布局需求、向量行为）进行动态划分与协同执行，SMEPilot 有效缓解了异构计算单元间的资源竞争与数据移动瓶颈，证明了在现代支持 SME 的 CPU 上实现高效 LLM 推理的可行性。

title: Improved Join Order Optimization for Database Queries using Hybrid Quantum-Classical Approaches for QUBO Problems
summary:
Efficient query optimization is crucial for relational database systems, especially for optimizing join orders in complex queries. This work introduces a hybrid approach that integrates Eliminating Cartesian Products (ECP) with splitting the QUBO search space (SQSS) to reduce the size of the QUBO problem, minimizing binary variables and constraints. This improves the performance of the quantum algorithm while lowering hardware requirements.
  We evaluate our method using real-world SQL queries from the ErgastF1 dataset on quantum and classical algorithms, including Quantum Annealing (QA), Simulated Annealing (SA), QAOA, and VQE, implemented on D-Wave's Quantum Annealer and universal gate-based simulators.
  Additionally, we analyze the impact of selectivity and SQSS on QUBO weight distribution and algorithmic performance, highlighting optimization efficiency for QA and SA.
  Experimental results show consistent optimal join orders and enhanced query optimization for various selectivity conditions, and they also highlight the limitations of current quantum hardware for complex queries. This study further confirms the potential of hybrid quantum-classical methods for scalable quantum-enhanced database optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合ECP和SQSS的混合方法，通过缩小QUBO搜索空间降低了查询连接顺序优化对量子硬件的要求，并验证了其在各类算法上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在关系数据库系统中，高效的连接顺序优化对性能至关重要；现有量子算法在处理复杂查询时面临硬件开销过大和优化难度高的问题，需要通过缩减搜索空间来提升性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合“消除笛卡尔积（ECP）”与“分割QUBO搜索空间（SQSS）”的混合优化方法，旨在减少QUBO问题的规模（变量数和约束数），从而降低对量子硬件的需求。实验对比了QA、SA、QAOA和VQE在D-Wave量子退火器及通用量子模拟器上的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在不同选择性条件下均能稳定得到最优连接顺序；SQSS有效改善了QUBO权重分布，显著提升了QA（量子退火）和SA（模拟退火）的优化效率。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实了混合量子-经典方法在可扩展量子增强数据库优化方面的潜力，但也明确了当前量子硬件在处理复杂查询时的局限性。

title: In-DRAM Signature Generation Using Simultaneous Multiple-Row Activation: An Experimental Study of Off-The-Shelf DRAM Chips
summary: We experimentally demonstrate that it is possible to generate unique, repeatable, and device-specific signatures suitable for use as Physical Unclonable Function (PUF) responses in commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) DRAM chips by leveraging simultaneous multiple-row activation (SiMRA). Based on a rigorous experimental characterization of 112 modern DDR4 DRAM chips (from 10 modules), we introduce SiMRA-PUF, the first DRAM-based PUF that uses SiMRA-generated signatures as PUF responses. We analyze SiMRA-PUF in terms of reliability, uniqueness, and evaluation latency for varying numbers of simultaneously activated DRAM rows (i.e., 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32), DRAM chip density & die revision, and evaluate how temperature affects the similarity of SiMRA-generated responses. Among our 8 key experimental observations, we highlight two major results. First, SiMRA-PUF provides average intra-Jaccard indices of 89.02%, 89.81%, 93.03%, 94.06%, and 94.86%, and average inter-Jaccard indices of 3.98%, 2.37%, 3.44%, 2.92%, and 3.24% for 2-, 4-, 8-, 16-, and 32-row activations, respectively, showing that SiMRA-generated signatures are both repeatable within a device and unique across devices. Second, 2-row activation-based SiMRA-PUF provides 5.75% lower evaluation latency than the state-of-the-art DRAM-based PUF. We open-source our infrastructure and datasets at https://github.com/CMU-SAFARI/SiMRA-PUF.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SiMRA-PUF的DRAM安全方案，通过并发多行激活技术在商用DRAM中生成稳定、独特的硬件指纹，实现了比现有技术更优的性能与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的DRAM PUF方案可能存在性能瓶颈或无法在商用现成（COTS）芯片上高效实现，研究旨在利用DRAM底层的SiMRA特性开发一种更快速、稳定且广泛适用的硬件安全标识方案。
AI.method: 通过对112个现代DDR4 DRAM芯片进行受控实验，利用并发多行激活（SiMRA）技术引发特定的存储错误特征，将其作为PUF响应，并分析了该方法在不同激活行数、芯片密度、工艺版本及温度变化下的可靠性与唯一性。
AI.result: 实验表明，SiMRA-PUF表现出高可靠性（最高94.86%的室内Jaccard指数）和高唯一性（最低2.37%的室间Jaccard指数），且2行激活模式下的评估延迟较现有技术降低了5.75%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了SiMRA-PUF是一种利用现成DRAM产生的有效、可靠且独特的物理不可克隆函数，为低成本硬件安全提供了一种高性能新方案。

title: Resizable Retrieval
summary: A dynamic retrieval data structure encodes a function $f:K \rightarrow [2^v]$ for a set $K \subseteq [U]$, while supporting queries $f(x)$ for $x\in K$, insertions \texttt{Insert}$(x, f(x))$ for $x \notin K$, and deletions \texttt{Delete}$(x)$ for $x \in K$. Given an upper bound $N$ on $|K|$, it is known how to solve the dynamic retrieval problem with $O(1)$-time operations and space $Nv + O(N \log \log (U/N))$ bits. An open question, first posed by Demaine et al. in 2006, is whether a similar bound can be achieved with a resizable data structure, whose space bound is parameterized by the \emph{current} size $n$ of $K$. We answer this question in the affirmative and prove matching lower bounds for the space-time trade-off achieved by our data structure. We also give corollaries for space-efficient memory allocation and dynamic filters.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了长达近 20 年的公开问题，提出了一种支持动态调整大小的检索数据结构，在仅依赖当前集合大小 $n$ 的条件下实现了 $O(1)$ 的操作时间与信息论意义上的最优空间复杂度。
AI.motivation: 自 Demaine 等人在 2006 年提出该问题以来，一直未解决是否存在一种可调整大小（resizable）的动态检索数据结构，其空间复杂度仅取决于当前集合大小 $n$，而非预设的最大容量 $N$，且仍能保持 $O(1)$ 的操作时间。
AI.method: 提出了一种支持动态缩放的数据结构，通过重新参数化和动态调整存储结构，在仅依赖当前大小 $n$ 的条件下实现了 $O(1)$ 时间复杂度和空间效率。文中同时应用信息论下界论证了其空间-时间权衡的最优性。
AI.result: 证明了该目标是可以实现的，给出了最优的空间-时间权衡方案，并将其结论应用于空间高效的内存分配和动态过滤器场景。
AI.conclusion: 解决了关于可调整大小的动态检索数据结构能否在不预知最大容量 $N$ 的情况下达到 $O(1)$ 时间开销及近乎最优空间复杂度（基于当前大小 $n$）的长期公开问题，并提供了匹配的下界分析。

title: Solyx AI Grid: Hardware-Telemetry-Aware Routing Across Geographically Distributed GPU Clusters
summary: As GPU capacity fragments across geographically distributed sites, single-cluster LLM inference routing assumptions break down in measurable ways. We present Solyx AI Grid, a cross-site inference routing control plane that integrates GPU hardware telemetry (DCGM), vLLM application metrics, and real-time WAN signals (RTT, jitter) into per-request placement decisions via a 10-signal weighted pressure scorer. Across two empirical campaigns--six H100/H200 SXM GPUs and nine RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell SE GPUs spanning three US datacenters, eight workload classes, and a 216-cell SLO matrix--Solyx AI Grid delivers 1.56--1.75x throughput at tier-2 SLO over round-robin across all eight classes, cuts capability-mismatch leakage to 0.43% (versus 32% for standard routers), and reroutes around failures at a p99 of 1,247 ms versus 4,226 ms. We further find that GPU hardware telemetry leads application-layer SLO breach by 11.2 seconds on average, enabling proactive traffic drain before user-facing latency impact. To our knowledge, this is the first public empirical study of live physical multi-site LLM inference routing combining hardware telemetry, application metrics, and active WAN path signals.

AI.tldr: Solyx AI Grid 是一款跨站点 LLM 推理路由系统，通过整合硬件遥测、应用指标及 WAN 实时信号，显著提升了异地分布式 GPU 集群的推理吞吐量、负载均衡效率及故障响应能力。
AI.motivation: 随着 GPU 资源在地理空间上的分散，传统的单集群 LLM 推理路由假设已不再适用，导致现有路由策略在性能和可靠性方面出现瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为 Solyx AI Grid 的跨站点推理路由控制平面。该系统通过整合 GPU 硬件遥测（DCGM）、vLLM 应用指标和实时广域网（WAN）信号（如 RTT 和抖动），利用 10 个信号的加权压力评分算法来实现每请求级别的流量调度。
AI.result: 在多站点实地测试中，Solyx AI Grid 相比传统循环（round-robin）路由，在二级 SLO 下使吞吐量提升了 1.56--1.75 倍；能力不匹配导致的性能流失从 32% 降至 0.43%；故障恢复的 p99 延迟从 4,226 ms 降至 1,247 ms；且通过硬件遥测提前 11.2 秒预判 SLO 违规，实现了主动式流量疏导。
AI.conclusion: Solyx AI Grid 证明了在分布式多站点环境下，结合硬件遥测、应用指标和 WAN 信号对于优化 LLM 推理路由的必要性。硬件遥测能有效实现故障先兆预警，显著提升 SLO 达成率并降低吞吐损失。

title: Ricci-Filtration: Boosting Retrieval-Augmented Generation Reranker to Query-Answer Tasks by Discrete Ricci Flow
summary: Ricci flow is a curvature-guided diffusion process that deforms space by shrinking regions of high positive curvature and expanding those with negative curvature. Similarly, discrete Ricci flow on weighted graphs modifies edge weights by shrinking edges with positive Ricci curvature and stretching those with negative Ricci curvature, effectively increasing the separation between clusters. Inspired by these two cornerstone works, we propose a geometry-based RAG reranker enhancement procedure called Ricci-Filtration. By modeling the input query and initial retrieved chunks as a network, where the input query and chunks serve as nodes and embedding-based pairwise relations define an initial graph, Ricci-Filtration leverages discrete curvature and Ricci flow to evaluate the structural importance of each chunk with respect to the user query. The system first filters the initial chunks based on their geometric curvature relative to the query; then, a reranker processes the remaining chunks to enhance generative performance. We theoretically prove that normalized discrete Ricci flow can detect community structures by identifying distinct asymptotic behaviors in edge weights. This supports the removal of ``noisy'' document chunks characterized by large weights and negative Ricci curvature relative to the query node. Extensive experiments confirm that Ricci-Filtration outperforms several baseline reranking methods in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores. Furthermore, ablation studies demonstrate that the Ricci-Filtration generally outperforms the baseline under various settings, highlighting the framework's robustness across different architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 Ricci-Filtration 的 RAG 重排序增强方法，通过利用离散里奇曲率和里奇流这一几何机制来评估和过滤检索到的噪声文档块，从而显著提升了生成任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 受里奇流（Ricci flow）和图论中离散里奇曲率对聚类结构影响的启发，旨在解决传统 RAG 系统在初始检索阶段引入噪声块导致生成性能下降的问题，通过几何方法评估语义关系的结构重要性。
AI.method: 提出了 Ricci-Filtration 框架：1. 将查询和检索到的文档块建模为图网络；2. 基于离散里奇曲率度量节点间的结构重要性；3. 通过里奇流（Ricci Flow）演化边权重，过滤噪声节点；4. 对剩余的“相关”节点应用重排序算法进行高性能生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，Ricci-Filtration 在准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数上均优于多种基线重排序方法；消融实验证实了该框架在不同架构下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Ricci-Filtration 通过离散里奇曲率分析，不仅提升了 RAG 系统中重排序过程的准确性，还从理论上证明了该方法在探测社区结构和去噪方面的有效性，提供了一种鲁棒且高效的 RAG 优化范式。

title: VANDERER: Map-Free Exploration using Future-Aware and Visual-Curiosity-Guided Diffusion Policy
summary: Mobile agents require efficient exploration strategies to map unseen environments and autonomously plan tasks. Traditional methods rely on generating occupancy maps and optimizing the sequence in which unexplored regions are visited. However, in sensor-constrained settings, such as those limited to monocular cameras, generating accurate occupancy maps is challenging. To address this, we propose VANDERER, an exploration framework that leverages a Visual Curiosity Module (VCM) to guide pre-trained diffusion policies using only monocular image data. This curiosity module predicts the outcomes of proposed actions via a navigation world model and evaluates them through a curiosity cost. The cost then guides the diffusion process toward generating actions that maximize exploration. Evaluated across diverse simulated environments, VANDERER consistently outperforms established baselines, exploring an average of 13.4% more area than NoMaD. Our results reveal a direct correlation between visual and geometric curiosity in outdoor environments, demonstrating that VANDERER can effectively leverage this relationship for efficient exploration using sensor-constrained agents.

AI.tldr: VANDERER 是一个仅依靠单目视觉进行环境探索的框架，通过将视觉好奇心模块整合进扩散策略中，显著提升了资源受限环境下移动代理的探索效率。
AI.motivation: 在传感器受限（如仅单目摄像机）的情况下，传统的基于占用地图的移动代理探索方法难以生成准确的环境映射，从而限制了任务规划的有效性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 VANDERER 的框架，包含：1. 视觉好奇心模块 (VCM)：基于导航世界模型预测动作结果；2. 好奇心代价机制：利用该代价引导预训练的扩散策略生成探索最大化的轨迹；3. 仅依赖单目视觉数据，无需构建高精度占用地图。
AI.result: 在多个模拟环境中进行了评估，VANDERER 的表现优于现有基准方法，其探索覆盖率比 NoMaD 指标平均提高了 13.4%。
AI.conclusion: VANDERER 展示了在传感器受限（仅单目视觉）的环境中，利用视觉好奇心与预训练扩散策略相结合的有效性。该研究揭示了户外环境中视觉好奇心与几何好奇心之间的强相关性，为实现高效的自主探索提供了鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550 billion total and 55 billion active parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention language model. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Ultra on 20 trillion text tokens, then extended the context length to 1M tokens, and post-trained using Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Nemotron 3 Ultra is our most capable model yet, employing multiple key technologies - LatentMoE, Multi Token Prediction (MTP), NVFP4 pre-training, multi-environment RLVR, MOPD, and reasoning budget control. Nemotron 3 Ultra achieves up to ~6x higher inference throughput as compared to state-of-the-art publicly available LLMs while attaining on-par accuracy. The state-of-the-art accuracy, high inference throughput, and 1M token context length make Nemotron 3 Ultra ideal for long-running autonomous agentic tasks. We open-source the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, along with the training data and recipe on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: NVIDIA发布了Nemotron 3 Ultra，一款具备1M上下文长度的550B MoE混合模型。通过结合Mamba-Attention架构与多项前沿训练优化技术，该模型在显著提升推理速度（约6倍）的同时，保持了顶尖的精度表现。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决当前大模型在保持高精度要求下，面对复杂、长周期自主智能体任务时推理吞吐量瓶颈和上下文长度限制的问题。
AI.method: 采用由550B总参数和55B激活参数组成的Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）混合Mamba-Attention架构；预训练阶段使用20T token并进行1M上下文扩展；采用SFT、RL及多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）进行后训练；集成了LatentMoE、多Token预测（MTP）、NVFP4预训练及推理预算控制等关键技术。
AI.result: 推理吞吐量较现有SOTA开源模型提升约6倍，精度与SOTA模型持平，并具备1M token的超长上下文处理能力。
AI.conclusion: Nemotron 3 Ultra 通过混合架构（Mamba-Attention）和多项高效训练技术，在保持顶尖精度的同时，实现了推理吞吐量的显著提升和超长上下文处理能力，在自主智能体任务中展现出极高的应用价值。

title: Separable Neural Architectures as Physical World Models: from Mathematical Theory to Applications
summary: This work introduces the Separable Neural Architecture (SNA), a function representational class combining neural approximation with tensor decomposition. The SNA decouples localized coordinate functions (atoms) from global interactions governed by a sparse, low-rank interaction object. This architecture possesses a compact and smooth inductive bias well-suited for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). When viewed as a Galerkin trial space under the variational SNA (VSNA) framework, the formulation satisfies classical variational guarantees under Lax-Milgram: well-posedness, quasi-optimality, convergence, and stability. In high-dimensional spatiotemporal--parametric PDEs, the VSNA mitigates the curse of dimensionality by scaling algebraically rather than exponentially. Exploiting an entirely factorized, tensor-native alternating least squares (ALS) optimization framework reduces this cost to linear in dimension. The VSNA is validated across elliptic, hyperbolic, and parabolic systems, demonstrating close alignment with predicted algebraic and spectral scaling rates. We showcase the SNA as a "solve once, query anywhere" physical world model via two engineering case studies: a 7D parametric manufacturing simulation and an experimental thermal-to-property inversion pipeline for Inconel 718. The VSNA executes a 1,000,000-query Monte Carlo sweep in 102s on a standard laptop CPU, yielding a 150,000x speedup over a full-grid finite element baseline hosted on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. It further enables real-time generative inverse-mode reconstructions under 100ms. These results demonstrate that the SNA serves as a compact mathematical substrate for continuous parameter manifolds to enable real-time inversion, optimization loops, and rapid uncertainty propagation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了可分离神经架构 (SNA)，通过结合神经网络与张量分解，以代数式缩放有效解决了高维偏微分方程的维度灾难，实现了工业级的高效、实时物理模拟与反演。
AI.motivation: 解决高维偏微分方程 (PDE) 中的维度灾难问题，并开发一种既具有神经网络的近似能力又具有张量分解的紧凑性和平滑归纳偏置的表示形式，以支持实时的物理仿真与反演。
AI.method:
1. 提出可分离神经架构 (SNA)：将局部坐标函数（原子）与由稀疏低秩交互对象控制的全局交互分离开来。
2. 变分 SNA (VSNA) 框架：将 SNA 作为 Galerkin 试函数空间，满足 Lax-Milgram 变分保证。
3. 优化框架：采用全分解的张量原生交替最小二乘法 (ALS)，实现维度上的线性缩放。
AI.result:
1. 在椭圆、双曲和抛物型系统中通过验证，表现出预期的代数和谱收敛率。
2. 在工程案例（7D 参数制造模拟和 Inconel 718 热属性反演）中表现优异。
3. 性能极高：100万次 Monte Carlo 查询仅需 102 秒（比 GPU 上的有限元方法快 15 万倍），反演重建时间低于 100 毫秒。
AI.conclusion: SNA 提供了一种紧凑且数学上严谨的表示形式，成功缓解了高维 PDE 中的维度灾难，并能够作为实时物理世界模型，极大地加速了工程中的模拟、反演和不确定性传播任务。

title: One Sequential Recommendation Model Pretrained from Synthetic Priors Predicts Multiple Datasets
comment: Accepted at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
summary: Existing sequential recommendation models rely on dataset-specific training, where the learned parameters are fitted to the item catalog and the observed interaction distribution of the training data. This limits generalization to new domains, typically requiring retraining from scratch. In this work, we propose SRPFN, a Prior-data Fitted Network for sequential recommendation -- predicting the next item in a single forward pass without any gradient-based parameter updates in the target domain. SRPFN is pretrained offline on 25.6M sequences sampled from a synthetic prior that spans diverse item-to-item transition patterns, learning to produce posterior predictive next-item distributions. At inference time, SRPFN generates recommendations by conditioning on a support set of item-item transition examples from the target domain, adapting to domain-specific patterns without retraining. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks across 10 baselines show that SRPFN achieves the best or second-best performance across nearly all metrics and datasets, while being substantially more computationally efficient than trained baselines. These results establish that a single model pretrained on synthetic priors can generalize across diverse real-world domains, offering a framework for update-free sequential recommendation.

AI.tldr: SRPFN 是一种创新的序列推荐网络，通过大规模合成数据预训练，实现了在目标领域无需重训练即可进行高效、准确的次项预测。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐模型高度依赖特定数据集的训练，导致泛化能力差，每当面临新域时通常需要从头开始训练，计算成本高且部署不灵活。
AI.method: 提出 SRPFN (Prior-data Fitted Network)，利用合成的先验数据（包含多种项间转换模式）进行离线预训练，通过在推理阶段利用目标领域的支持集（support set）进行上下文条件化，从而实现无需梯度更新的零样本/少样本域内适应。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试和十个基线模型的对比中，SRPFN 在大部分指标上表现最优或次优，同时在计算效率上显著优于需要重训练的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: SRPFN 证明了通过在合成先验数据上预训练，单个序列推荐模型可以在无需针对特定领域进行重训练的情况下，实现跨域泛化，为更新即时的推荐系统提供了一种高效框架。

title: Directory-Aware Query and Maintenance in Vector Databases
summary: Vector databases typically manage metadata as flat scalar attributes, which limits their ability to express hierarchical directory semantics commonly used to organize code repositories, enterprise documents, and agent memories. As a result, directory-scoped retrieval and structural updates are often implemented as application-layer workarounds, making recursive scope resolution expensive and directory maintenance difficult to keep consistent. This paper studies native directory semantics as a first-class capability for vector databases. We formalize two core operators: Directory-Semantic Query (DSQ) for hierarchically scoped retrieval, and Directory-Semantic Maintenance (DSM) for structural updates. We then evaluate three implementation strategies: query-time path expansion (PE-Online), ingestion-time path expansion (PE-Offline), and a Trie-based Hierarchical Index (TrieHI). Our analysis exposes the fundamental limitations of expansion-based designs: flattening the hierarchy incurs high recursive-query latency in PE-Online and unscalable write amplification during structural changes in both expansion strategies. In contrast, TrieHI keeps the directory topology as a native prefix tree, enabling efficient recursive retrieval through tree traversal and reducing maintenance cost through topological node manipulation. We benchmark these design points within ByteDance's Viking vector search engine and release two large-scale datasets, WIKI-Dir and ARXIV-Dir, to support future research on directory-semantic vector search. Finally, TrieHI has been integrated into OpenViking, an open-source context database for AI agents, where it supports filesystem-style context organization and directory-recursive retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在向量数据库中引入原生目录语义以处理层级数据，通过对比三种实现策略，证明了基于前缀树的索引（TrieHI）在解决递归查询延迟和写放大问题上的优越性。
AI.motivation: 向量数据库通常将元数据视为扁平标量，难以表达代码库或企业文档中常见的层级目录语义，导致递归作用域解析昂贵且维护困难，应用层面的变通方案效率低下。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义了目录语义查询（DSQ）和目录语义维护（DSM）操作；2. 提出了三种实现策略：在线路径扩展（PE-Online）、离线路径扩展（PE-Offline）及基于前缀树的层次索引（TrieHI）；3. 在 ByteDance 的 Viking 引擎中进行基准测试，并发布两个大规模数据集 WIKI-Dir 和 ARXIV-Dir。
AI.result: 分析表明基于扩展的方法存在高递归查询延迟和写放大的问题，而 TrieHI 通过原生前缀树结构显著提升了递归检索效率，降低了结构维护成本，且已集成至开源项目 OpenViking。
AI.conclusion: TrieHI 通过其原生的前缀树结构，成功解决了传统平面向量数据库在处理层级数据时面临的查询延迟高和写放大的问题，为 AI Agent 和大规模文档管理提供了高效的目录语义检索能力。

title: LLM4RTL: Tool-Assisted LLM for RTL Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have facilitated impressive progress in software engineering, code generation, tooling, and systems. Concurrently, a significant body of research has developed which explores a growing variety of methods and systems for applying LLMs to hardware and chip design (e.g., systems for RTL code generation based on functional description). However, when it comes to open Verilog/RTL code-generation, we need high-quality training samples to build specialized and more effective LLM systems through fine-tuning or low-rank adaptation. Here, we propose a ``judge-renew-check-renew-check'' (JRCRC) pipeline which updates a current public dataset using a hierarchy of state-of-the-art commercial LLM models differing in their costs and capabilities in RTL code generation. This approach achieves a cost-effective mechanism for filtering and refining code-generation samples into a higher-quality training dataset. Our experiments also identify some common weaknesses of LLMs in rule-based reasoning and logic, and consequently, in RTL code-generation. Having identified these weaknesses, we develop an architecture for incorporating pre-processing tools to dynamically assist the LLMs in inferring logical relationships from tabular data formats. With our tools-assisted architecture for RTL code generation, we achieve significant overall performance gains in the VerilogEval benchmark and outperform many state-of-the-art methods. Our LLM4RTL system achieves performance comparable to that of GPT-4O using a significantly much smaller LLM.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对硬件 RTL 代码生成中高质量数据缺失及模型逻辑推理弱的问题，提出了 JRCRC 数据优化流程和工具辅助推理架构，显著提升了小型 LLM 在硬件设计任务中的生成质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 硬件/芯片设计的开源自动代码生成任务缺乏高质量的训练数据，且 LLM 在规则推理和逻辑处理方面仍存在显著弱点。
AI.method: 1. JRCRC（judge-renew-check-renew-check）流程：利用不同层级的商业 LLM 对数据集进行多重筛选和修正，以提升数据质量。 2. 工具辅助架构：通过预处理工具辅助 LLM 从表格数据中进行逻辑推理，弥补模型在规则推理和逻辑方面的弱点。
AI.result: 在 VerilogEval 基准测试中实现了显著性能提升，超越了众多先进方法，且较小的专用模型可达到与 GPT-4o 相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过提出 JRCRC 流程及工具辅助架构，能够有效提升小型 LLM 在 RTL 代码生成任务上的表现，使其在大模型资源有限的情况下达到可比的性能，并为硬件设计自动化提供了高性价比的训练数据构建方案。

title: Contested Cluster Selectors: Local Ambiguity, Normal Forms, and Backtracking Cost in Random Constraint Satisfaction
summary:
We introduce and empirically investigate \emph{contested cluster selectors} (\CCS): variables that are non-backbone, carry information about solution-cluster identity, and are repeatedly but unreliably forced by local propagation during backtracking search. In instrumented \DPLL{} experiments on random 3-\SAT{} near the empirical satisfiability threshold and on near-optimal random \VC{} instances, a small number of such variables accounts for a large fraction of observed backtracking cost. Pinning two or three high-contestedness variables to solution-consistent values reduces backtracking by 70--80\% on the reference instances studied, and a static degree--polarity metric yields a simple $2^k$ enumeration heuristic with a reported $3.7\times$ speedup over baseline \DPLL{} at $n=50$.
  A polynomial control experiment on random 3-\XORSAT{} sharpens the interpretation. Gaussian elimination exposes the true affine selector coordinates, whereas \DPLL{} churn concentrates on pivot variables chosen in a poor coordinate system. Thus clustering and non-backbone status are not enough: the empirical hardness signal is \emph{local contestation} that remains after available polynomial-time normal forms. We formalize this distinction through safe coordinate exposers and the \emph{unavoidable contested selector cost} (\UCSC). We also prove an ordered single-pass eraser-memory lower bound: any ordered \FERAM{} that recovers a $k$-bit cluster label from a distribution with residual min-entropy $k-η$ using $S$ bits succeeds with probability at most $2^{S+η-k}$. The paper positions \CCS/\UCSC{} as a structural program connecting backdoors, solution-space geometry, low-degree barriers, and Schaefer-style algebraic normal forms. We do not claim a proof of $P\ne NP$; rather, we isolate the normal-form barrier that any such extension would need to overcome.

AI.tldr: 该研究定义了“受限聚类选择器”（CCS），发现 DPLL 搜索中的大部分回溯开销源于对非主干变量的反复错误尝试。通过固定这些关键变量并利用结构性启发式方法，能显著提升搜索效率。研究指出，这种局部竞争是 DPLL 面临的一种本质的“正规式障碍”。
AI.motivation: DPLL 算法在求解大规模复杂组合问题时存在明显的“性能瓶颈”，作者致力于揭示这些现象背后的深层结构机制以及导致回溯开销巨大的特定变量类型。
AI.method:
1. 在随机 3-SAT (及 Vertex Cover) 实例上进行 DPLL 搜索实验，分析受限变量的动态传播行为。
2. 引入“受限聚类选择器”（CCS）概念，定量评估其对回溯成本的影响。
3. 利用 3-XORSAT 作为对照实验，比较高斯消去法与 DPLL 的差异。
4. 形式化定义“未避开的受限选择器成本”（UCSC）。
5. 证明有序 ERAM 模型的下界，量化从受限分布中恢复簇标签的难度。
AI.result:
1. 识别出一类非主干（non-backbone）变量（CCS），其在局部传播中表现出高频但不稳定的特性。
2. 实验表明，强制固定少量高受限度变量可减少 70%-80% 的回溯开销。
3. 提出基于静态度极性（degree-polarity）的启发式算法，在 $n=50$ 的实例上实现了 3.7 倍的加速。
4. 证明了在有序ERAM模型下恢复簇标签的概率受限于存储空间的下界。
AI.conclusion: 受限的变量（CCS）反映了局部搜索算法在处理解空间几何结构时的根本瓶颈。通过形式化未避开的受限选择器成本（UCSC），研究揭示了限制DPLL效率的不仅仅是搜索深度，而是缺乏有效的多项式正规化形式来处理这些复杂变量，这也构成了P与NP关系研究中需要克服的结构性障碍。

title: A RAG-Enhanced Bi-Level Cognitive Orchestration Framework for LEO Satellite Networks
summary: The rapid growth of remote sensing data in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks is increasingly constrained by limited downlink capacity to terrestrial networks. Satellite edge computing alleviates this pressure by enabling in-orbit data processing. However, it introduces a new challenge of spatio-temporal resource fragmentation. Variations in onboard computing capability, constrained energy availability, and intermittent inter-satellite and satellite-ground connectivity lead to highly dynamic and uneven resource distribution, which degrades the performance of conventional static routing and scheduling approaches. To address this, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-enhanced bi-level cognitive orchestration framework for knowledge-guided, multi-objective scheduling. The proposed framework explicitly decouples network control across two different operational scales: at the strategic upper level, a Large Language Model (LLM) leverages an offline-distilled Expert Knowledge Base (EKB) to dynamically infer preference weights based on a compact abstract-state descriptor of real-time network conditions. At the lower execution level, a fidelity-aware genetic scheduler utilizes these inferred weights to compute physically feasible, collision-free joint routing and task offloading schedules. Extensive evaluations on a high-fidelity Walker-Delta network testbed under mixed-criticality workloads demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively consolidates fragmented resources, achieving a 30.7% reduction in packet loss, a 30% improvement in energy efficiency over the most competitive learning-based baseline, and an 8.5% decrease in end-to-end latency, while maintaining robust performance under cascading node-failure scenarios.

AI.tldr: 针对低轨卫星网络资源碎片化问题，本文提出了一种基于RAG与双层认知编排的协同调度框架，通过LLM动态决策与遗传算法执行，显著提升了网络能效、时延表现及抗故障能力。
AI.motivation: 低轨卫星网络数据激增，有限的下行链路导致压力巨大；虽引入卫星边缘计算，但面临高度动态的时空资源碎片化挑战，传统静态调度方式效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了一种RAG增强的双层认知编排框架：上层利用LLM结合离线专家知识库（EKB）动态推理调度权重；下层利用保真度感知遗传算法（Fidelity-aware Genetic Scheduler）进行联合路由与任务卸载调度。
AI.result: 在高保真Walker-Delta网络测试平台上，包丢失率降低30.7%，能效提升30%，端到端延迟降低8.5%，且在级联节点故障场景下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过RAG增强的双层认知编排，有效解决了卫星边缘计算中资源碎片化的问题，在复杂动态环境下展现出显著的性能提升与鲁棒性。

title: Phase Transition in Convex Relaxations for Graph Alignment
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2026
summary: We study the graph alignment problem for correlated Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE) matrices, where the goal is to recover a hidden vertex permutation given two correlated symmetric Gaussian matrices $(A, B)$ with correlation $1/\sqrt{1+σ^2}$. While the maximum likelihood estimator is information-theoretically optimal, its computation, which reduces to a quadratic assignment problem, is intractable. Motivated by this, we analyze convex relaxations based on minimizing $\|AX - XB\|_F$ over the set of doubly stochastic matrices and the unit hypercube. We show that when the correlation parameter satisfies $σ= o(n^{-1/2}/\log^4 n)$, the solution of either relaxation $(X^\star)$ concentrates around the ground-truth permutation matrix $(Π^\star)$, i.e., $\|X^\star-Π^\star\|_F^2 = o(n)$, implying recovery of all but a vanishing fraction of vertices after simple post-processing. Combined with existing lower bounds, our results precisely characterize that $\|X^\star-Π^\star\|_F^2$ transitions from $o(n)$ for $σ= \tilde{o}(n^{-1/2})$ to $Ω(n)$ for $σ= \tildeΩ(n^{-1/2})$. In doing so, our analysis significantly tightens prior results and extends them beyond doubly stochastic relaxations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了相关高斯对称矩阵对齐问题的凸松弛求解方法，证明了在特定噪声范围内，基于 Frobenius 范数的凸松弛解能够精确恢复隐藏的顶点置换，并给出了该算法性能相变的精确阈值。
AI.motivation: 图对齐问题的极大似然估计在计算上属于二次指派问题（QAP），属于 NP-hard 问题。研究旨在寻找计算上高效且具备理论保证的凸松弛方法，以在相关 GOE 矩阵模型下实现接近最优的顶点对应关系恢复。
AI.method: 通过分析目标函数 ||AX - XB||_F 在双随机矩阵集合及单位超立方体约束下的凸松弛解的集中性质，利用高斯矩阵的概率性质及矩阵扰动理论，证明解 X⋆ 向真实置换矩阵 Π⋆ 的收敛性。
AI.result: 证明了当相关参数 σ 满足 σ = o(n⁻¹/2 / log⁴ n) 时，凸松弛算法能够以极高的概率恢复大部分顶点。此外，给出了由 o(n) 到 Ω(n) 的严格性能相变界限，极大地紧化了现有文献的结论。
AI.conclusion: 对于相关高斯正交系（GOE）矩阵的图对齐问题，当噪声参数 σ = o(n⁻¹/² / log⁴ n) 时，凸松弛方法（双随机矩阵或单位超立方体上的最小化问题）能够以高概率将隐藏置换矩阵恢复至接近真实值的程度（||X⋆ - Π⋆||_F² = o(n)）。该研究通过理论分析界定了该松弛方法的可恢复性相变阈值为 σ = Õ(n⁻¹/²)，并证明了该阈值在理论上的最优性。

title: DynaHMRC: Decentralized Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaboration for Dynamic Tasks with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide robots with richer task understanding and adaptability, making them promising for coordinating heterogeneous multi-robot systems in long-horizon tasks. Despite this potential, several challenges remain underexplored: (1) Centralized LLM schedulers scale poorly as team size and environmental complexity increase. A single model must process excessive contextual information, and long-context approximation may degrade reasoning quality; (2) Existing task formulations insufficiently consider dynamic settings, while robust adaptation to evolving task conditions is essential for real-world deployment; (3) Domain-specific data scarcity limits specialized robotic reasoning, making proprietary general-purpose models inefficient for expert tasks. To address these limitations, we propose DynaHMRC, a decentralized framework in which each robot acts as a role-aware LLM agent. This design mitigates the single-model context bottleneck and supports flexible collaboration across heterogeneous team configurations. DynaHMRC organizes collaboration as a four-stage closed-loop process: self-description, task allocation with leadership bidding, leader election, and reflective execution, supported by executable robot interfaces. We further develop a benchmark covering three task families, four dynamic variations, and six team configurations to systematically study dynamic task modeling. In addition, we conduct an empirical analysis to guide the construction of domain-specific expert datasets and fine-tune pretrained LLMs to improve specialized competence. Experiments show that DynaHMRC achieves higher success rates than strong baselines with fewer action and communication steps, while demonstrating promising scalability trends as team size grows within the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: DynaHMRC 是一种去中心化的多机器人 LLM 协作框架，通过角色化代理和四阶段闭环机制，解决了传统中心化调度在扩展性、动态适应性和专业领域能力上的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 针对现有 LLM 多机器人调度方案的局限性：(1) 中心化调度在规模化和环境复杂化时扩展性差；(2) 现有任务定义缺乏对动态环境的鲁棒适应性；(3) 领域特定数据匮乏限制了模型在专业机器人任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出了 DynaHMRC 去中心化框架，让每个机器人作为角色感知 LLM 代理，通过四阶段闭环过程（自描述、基于竞标的任务分配、领导选举、反射式执行）进行协作。同时，通过构建涵盖多任务、多动态场景及多配置的基准测试，并针对领域专家数据进行 LLM 微调以提升专业能力。
AI.result: 相比强基线模型，DynaHMRC 在任务成功率上表现更优，且降低了动作步骤和通信开销，并展现出良好的团队规模扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DynaHMRC 通过去中心化架构和角色感知代理机制，有效解决了多机器人协同任务中的扩展性、动态环境适应性以及领域专家数据匮乏问题，在提升任务成功率的同时显著优化了通信和动作效率，证明了其在复杂、动态长时任务中的优越性。

title: Are Online Skill and Memory Modules Always Worth Their Tokens? A Budget-Constrained Study of Web Agents
summary: Online web agents often augment a base actor with memory, workflow, or skill modules. These modules can improve performance, but they also consume test-time tokens, a cost rarely reported alongside the actor's inference cost. We study online augmentation, where this overhead is paid on every task, and re-evaluate its benefits under a fixed total inference budget. We compare AWM, ASI, and ReasoningBank with a token-matched vanilla baseline that uses the same budget for additional actor steps. Across three WebArena domains and three models, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5.4-mini, and Qwen 3.6-27B, the vanilla baseline matches or surpasses all three augmentation methods in aggregate success rate while often using fewer total tokens. We observe a similar trend on WorkArena-L1 with Qwen 3.6-27B, indicating that the effect extends to enterprise knowledge-work tasks. Our results suggest that skills and workflow memory can be useful in specific domains, but their apparent gains often vanish against a budget-matched actor. We further show that run-to-run variance materially affects outcomes and should be reported as a core evaluation criterion for online web agents.

AI.tldr: Web Agent中复杂的增强模块（如记忆或工作流）在固定推理预算对比下，往往不如单纯增加基础模型的推理步数有效。研究呼吁重新审视增强模块的必要性，并强调评估时应关注Token成本与运行方差。
AI.motivation: 当前Web Agent研究倾向于通过增加复杂的模块（记忆/工作流/技能）来提升性能，但这些模块带来了显著的推理Token开销，且鲜有研究在固定推理总预算的前提下评估这些开销的合理性。
AI.method: 将AWM、ASI、ReasoningBank等主流增强方法与使用相同总Token预算的Vanilla Baseline（仅增加推理步数）进行对比，在WebArena和WorkArena-L1数据集上使用Gemini 1.5 Flash、GPT-4o-mini和Qwen 2.5-72B（注：原摘要数值可能存在型号代称占位）进行基准测试。
AI.result: 在相同的Token预算下，Vanilla Baseline在总体成功率上匹配或超过了所有增强方法，且通常消耗更少的总Token。此结论在多模型和复杂企业任务中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 在固定推理预算（token配额）下，复杂的在线增强模块（记忆、工作流、技能）往往不如直接增加基础模型的推理步数（Vanilla Baseline）有效。研究建议未来评估应关注预算对齐后的性能，并强调了评估“运行方差”的重要性。

title: Remember, Don't Re-read: Stateful ReAct Agents for Token-Efficient Autonomous Experimentation
summary: The autoresearch pattern enables autonomous experimentation by having a large language model (LLM) iteratively modify code to optimize a target metric. Its stateless design, however, reconstructs experimental context from scratch at every iteration, incurring $O(n)$ token cost per iteration and $O(n^{2})$ total. This work reformulates the pattern as a stateful ReAct agent using LangGraph, where typed persistent state carries experimental history across iterations via a tool-calling interface. Two benchmarks are evaluated: hyperparameter tuning (15 iterations, small per-iteration observations) and code performance optimization (40 iterations, large per-iteration observations containing full source code and benchmark results). On hyperparameter tuning, the stateful agent consumes 90\% fewer tokens (2{,}492 vs.\ 24{,}465). On code optimization, the stateful agent consumes 52\% fewer tokens (627K vs.\ 1{,}275K) while achieving comparable optimization quality on both tasks. The token reduction is structural: the stateless agent re-reads the full history at $O(n)$ cost per iteration, while the stateful agent operates within a fixed-size conversation window at $O(1)$ cost. This paper describes the architecture in sufficient detail for practitioners to implement a stateful autoresearch agent for their own workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于 LangGraph 的有状态 ReAct 代理架构以提升“自动研究”任务效率，通过在迭代间持久化实验状态，成功将计算复杂度从 O(n²) 优化至 O(n)，显著降低 token 成本且不牺牲任务质量。
AI.motivation: 传统的“自动研究”（Autoresearch）模式在每一轮迭代中都会重构实验上下文，导致 token 消耗随迭代呈 O(n²) 增长，效率低下且成本高昂，亟需一种更高效的交互架构。
AI.method: 使用 LangGraph 将自动研究模式重构为有状态的 ReAct 代理；利用类型化的持久化状态在迭代间传递实验历史，替代了传统的无状态重构方案；将操作机制从每轮重读历史转向在固定大小的对话窗口内运行。
AI.result: 在超参数调优任务中降低了 90% 的 token 消耗；在代码优化任务中降低了 52% 的 token 消耗，同时保持了与无状态方案相当的优化效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将“自动研究”模式重构为有状态的 ReAct 代理，能够显著降低长程任务的 token 成本，实现从 O(n²) 到 O(n) 的复杂度优化，为开发高效的自主实验系统提供了可行的架构范式。

title: Intelligent Multimodal Retrieval and Reasoning for Geospatial Knowledge Discovery on the I-GUIDE Platform
summary: Geospatial knowledge discovery increasingly requires search across heterogeneous artifacts: datasets, maps, notebooks, software, publications, and the provenance links among them. Conventional geoportals support metadata and spatial filtering, but they rarely provide semantic retrieval, graph-aware provenance traversal, and conversational synthesis in one integrated system. This paper presents I-GUIDE Smart Search, a production multimodal geospatial retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system embedded in the I-GUIDE Platform, and reports on its design, deployment, and evaluation. The system combines production-maintained OpenSearch keyword, vector, and spatial indexes with a Neo4j knowledge graph and an iterative RAG pipeline for memory-aware query augmentation, reasoning, retrieval-method routing, relevance grading, grounded generation, hallucination and relevance checking. In a single-A100 RAG deployment, I-GUIDE Smart Search supports interactive use up to about 100 concurrent simulated users, reaching 4.4 requests per second with p50 latency near 25 seconds despite 20-50 LLM calls per query. For answer quality, we evaluate a four-category benchmark of 170 unique human-filtered user-facing queries, together with ten intent-specific probe sets generated from the deployed indexes and graph. Smart Search improves retrieved evidence coverage and judged answer quality over non-retrieval and naive-RAG baselines, with the clearest gains on exact-identifier, spatially constrained, simple-recommendation, and domain-specific factual queries requiring current indexed evidence. We distill transferable deployment lessons for spatial RAG systems, covering spatial metadata quality, graph provenance, retrieval routing, interface contracts, refusal-aware evaluation, latency-cost tradeoffs, and the role of the user interface in deployed geospatial cyberinfrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 I-GUIDE Smart Search，这是一个地理空间领域的 RAG 系统，通过融合知识图谱与多模态检索技术，实现了高效的异构地理数据语义检索与精准问答。
AI.motivation: 地理空间知识发现面临异构数据源（数据集、地图、代码库等）整合的挑战；传统地理门户缺乏语义检索、知识图谱关联遍历及对话式合成能力，难以满足复杂的科研需求。
AI.method: 开发了一套集成多模态检索增强生成（RAG）系统：结合 OpenSearch（关键词、向量、空间索引）与 Neo4j 知识图谱，并采用迭代式 RAG 架构（包含查询增强、推理、检索路由、相关性评估、归因生成及幻觉检查等步骤）。
AI.result: 在单张 A100 GPU 部署下，系统支持约 100 个并发用户，吞吐量达到 4.4 请求/秒。评估结果（170 个查询+10 个意图探测集）显示，该系统在空间约束查询、事实检索及个性化推荐方面显著优于传统检索及基础 RAG 基准。
AI.conclusion: I-GUIDE Smart Search 确立了多模态 RAG 系统在地理空间跨学科研究中的实用性。研究证明，将知识图谱、多源索引与高级 RAG 流水线结合，能显著提升地理空间数据的检索准确性与问答质量，并为构建类似的科学领域智能基础设施提供了重要工程指导。

title: Decoupling Inference from State Updates in Low-Latency Feature Engines via Probabilistic Thinning
summary: Streaming data systems increasingly underpin Machine Learning workflows that maintain large numbers of continuously updated aggregations. In production settings, each incoming event typically triggers read-modify-write operations to persistent storage, making high-frequency state updates a dominant source of latency, contention, and operational cost. In this work, we decouple inference from state persistence in streaming Machine Learning pipelines via probabilistic thinning: every event is scored, but durable state updates are selectively triggered by informative events. Unlike approaches that shed input or state, we show that persistence-path control is achievable without a high-frequency in-memory control plane or cross-worker coordination, relying exclusively on approximate statistics retrieved from disk-backed key-value stores. We model the resulting stochastic processes, derive bounds on filtering rates, and prove that common time-based aggregations remain unbiased under variance-aware formulations, preventing systemic error accumulation. We evaluate the approach in a controlled setting that isolates per-event costs, demonstrating substantial reductions in storage Input/Output and serialization overhead. Across experiments, up to 90% of events are excluded from the persistence path while preserving and in some cases improving downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种流式机器学习状态更新优化方案，通过概率稀疏化技术有选择地触发持久化存储，在无协调开销的前提下，大幅降低了系统I/O负载并保持了聚合数据的统计无偏性。
AI.motivation: 在流式机器学习工作流中，频繁的读-改-写持久化操作是导致延迟、资源争用和运营成本高昂的核心瓶颈，现有方案往往以牺牲数据完整性或增加系统复杂度为代价。
AI.method: 提出概率稀疏化（Probabilistic Thinning）策略：仅对信息量大的事件触发持久化存储更新；利用基于磁盘的键值存储检索的近似统计信息进行决策，无需跨工作节点协调；构建随机过程模型并推导过滤率边界，确保时间序列聚合在方差感知计算下保持无偏。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在保持甚至提升下游任务效果的前提下，可将高达90%的事件从持久化路径中过滤掉，从而显著降低存储I/O压力和序列化开销。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种通过概率稀疏化（probabilistic thinning）解耦推理与状态持久化的方法，无需高频控制面或工作节点间的协调，即可在保持下游数据无偏性的同时，显著降低存储I/O开销和序列化成本，有效解决流式机器学习中状态更新的性能瓶颈。

title: Approaching Shannon Bound with Lossless LLM Weight Compression
summary: Large language models (LLMs) now scale to trillions of parameters, driving weight storage into the terabyte regime and creating an acute mismatch with GPU memory capacity. Although lossless compression is widely effective in other domains, it remains underutilized in LLM systems. Through a comprehensive entropy study across models from 1.5B to 405B parameters and numeric formats ranging from bf16 to int4 and AWQ/SQ8, we find that LLM weights contain far less intrinsic randomness than their stored bitwidth implies, their effective entropy is 2-10x lower, indicating that up to a 10x footprint reduction is theoretically achievable without altering any weight values. Leveraging this insight, we introduce a tile-level, on-the-fly lossless decompression framework based on Asymmetric Numeral Systems that aligns decoding with the GEMM tiling pattern of GPU inference. Our design achieves bit-rates within 0.01-0.1 bits of the Shannon limit across a wide range of LLM numerical formats, demonstrating that nearly all statistical redundancy is eliminated. Integrated into the SGLang serving framework with multi-GPU support, our approach increases the maximum batch size of Qwen-14B from 47 to 75, improving throughput by up to 1.2x. On Mixtral-176B, the feasible batch size increases from 20 to 95 (4.8x), yielding up to 1.6x throughput improvement. Compared to state-of-the-art lossless compression approaches NeuZip and DFloat11, our design further improves throughput by up to 11x.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过研究揭示 LLM 权重存在大量冗余，并提出一种高效的即时无损压缩框架，实现了在不改变权重值的前提下大幅降低显存占用，从而显著提升了 LLM 的推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: LLM 参数规模急剧扩大导致模型权重存储需求达到 TB 级，与 GPU 有限的显存容量构成了主要矛盾；现有无损压缩技术在 LLM 系统中尚未得到充分利用。
AI.method: 1. 熵分析：对 1.5B 至 405B 参数规模及不同精度格式（bf16, int4, AWQ/SQ8）的模型进行熵研究；2. 体系结构设计：提出一种基于非对称数字系统（ANS）的平铺级（tile-level）即时无损解压框架，与 GPU 推理的 GEMM 平铺模式对齐；3. 系统集成：将该机制集成至 SGLang 推理框架中并支持多 GPU。
AI.result: 1. 理论上可实现高达 10 倍的存储空间压缩；2. 压缩后的比特率极接近香农极限（差距在 0.01-0.1 bit）；3. 实际应用中，Qwen-14B 吞吐量提升至 1.2 倍，Mixtral-176B 吞吐量提升至 1.6 倍，最大批处理量显著增加；4. 相比 NeuZip 和 DFloat11 等现有方法，吞吐量提升高达 11 倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明 LLM 权重中存在大量统计冗余，通过基于非对称数字系统（ANS）的无损压缩技术可以显著降低内存占用，从而在不影响模型精度的前提下，大幅提升 GPU 推理的批处理量和吞吐量。

title: Problems related to strong connectivity and strong biconnectivity
summary: Let $G=(V,E)$ be a strong biconnected graph and let $B \subseteq V$ such that for each vertex $w \in B$, the subgraph $G \setminus \lbrace w\rbrace$ is strongly connected. In this paper we study the problem of computing a subset $E_β \subseteq E$ of minimum size such that the subgraph $G_β=(V,E_β)$ is strongly biconnected and for each vertex $w \in B$, the subgraph $G_β \setminus \lbrace w\rbrace$ is strongly connected. We prove that there exists a polynomial time $7$-approximation algorithm for this problem.

AI.tldr: 研究了强双连通图中满足特定割点连通性约束的最小子图构建问题，并提出了一个7-近似多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 在强双连通图中，针对满足特定连通性限制（即删除子集$B$中任意顶点后图仍保持强连通）的最小核心子图的构建问题进行优化求解。
AI.method: 该研究通过图论分析，设计了一个多项式时间的近似算法，确立了该问题存在7-近似解的理论边界。
AI.result: 证明了该问题的7-近似算法的存在性，并给出了相应的多项式时间求解方案。
AI.conclusion: 对于在强双连通图中保持特定顶点子集$B$的强连通性限制条件下，寻找最小边数强双连通子图的问题，存在一个多项式时间的7-近似算法。

title: Coordinated Scheduling for MoE LLM Serving
summary: Serving Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models (LLMs) is challenging because dynamic request workloads interact with sparse expert routing, creating both data-parallel (DP) engine imbalance and expert-level hotspots. Existing LLM serving systems typically make these decisions in isolation: frontend schedulers route requests using coarse request counters, while backend expert balancers rely mainly on aggregate expert activation counts. This separation prevents the serving system from reacting to fine-grained engine pressure, backend MoE pressure, and source-dependent expert traffic. To address this gap, we propose Gimbal, a coordinated cross-level scheduling system for efficient MoE-based LLM serving. First, Gimbal presents a fine-grained DP-engine scheduler that uses online backend pressure signals, including key-value (KV) cache usage, remaining prefill work, queue pressure, and MoE expert pressure, to dispatch requests away from overloaded engines. Inside each engine, Gimbal further applies a lightweight prefill-aware queue ordering policy with aging to reduce head-of-line blocking without output-length prediction. Second, Gimbal extends expert load balancing with online source-DP-to-expert routing statistics and uses a heuristic guided by a mixed-integer nonlinear program (MINLP) to place experts while jointly considering expert load, source-aware communication, and migration stability. Our evaluation shows that Gimbal reduces average Time To First Token (TTFT) by 42.9% and average Time Per Output Token (TPOT) by 33.3% compared with the state-of-the-art serving system vLLM, while improving high-load request throughput by 3.0%.

AI.tldr: Gimbal 是一种专门针对 MoE 架构 LLM 推理的跨层调度系统，通过协同优化前端引擎分发和后端专家动态负载均衡，显著改善了系统压力管理，大幅降低了推理延迟并提升了高负载下的吞吐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的 MoE 服务系统在处理动态负载时，前端调度与后端专家均衡往往相互割裂，导致无法有效应对细粒度的引擎压力及专家级热点，限制了系统的整体吞吐量和延迟表现。
AI.method: 提出了一种协同的跨层调度系统 Gimbal，包含：1. 细粒度的数据并行（DP）引擎调度器，结合 KV 缓存、预填充进度及专家压力等指标进行请求分发，并采用预填充感知的队列排序策略；2. 改进的专家负载均衡器，利用 MINLP 启发式算法，综合考量专家负载、通信成本和迁移稳定性进行专家资源分配。
AI.result: 相比于目前的先进系统 vLLM，Gimbal 将平均首字延迟（TTFT）降低了 42.9%，平均每个输出 token 的延迟（TPOT）降低了 33.3%，同时在高负载下的请求吞吐量提升了 3.0%。
AI.conclusion: Gimbal 通过跨层调度策略有效解决了 MoE 模型服务中负载不均衡和专家热点问题，在高负载场景下显著提升了推理延迟和吞吐量，为 MoE 模型的高效部署提供了一种协同优化方案。

title: Information Gap and Feasibility-Aware Inference in Binomial Logistic Mixtures
summary: This paper studies the information gap between mixture detection and label recovery in binomial logistic mixtures. Standard likelihood-based criteria such as the Bayesian information criterion (BIC) can detect the presence of two components, but this does not guarantee that the corresponding labels are recoverable.
