We show that this gap is intrinsic to binomial logistic mixtures with a fixed number of trials: observed-data evidence for mixture structure and per-observation information for label recovery have different local orders in the component separation, and only the former accumulates with the sample size. As a result, there exists a detectable-but-unrecoverable regime in which BIC selects two components while the posterior labels remain essentially uninformative. To address this issue, we propose two feasibility-aware inference procedures: a recoverability-aware BIC with a posterior-entropy penalty and an entropy-regularized estimator that mitigates the tendency of the maximum likelihood estimator to produce overly separated components and overly concentrated posterior responsibilities. Numerical experiments confirm the predicted gap and demonstrate that the proposed methods avoid misleading component selections and improve the calibration of posterior label probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文指出二项Logistic混合模型中存在“混合结构可探测但标签不可恢复”的固有信息鸿沟，并提出了两种改进的推断程序以解决常规准则（如BIC）在此区域的误判问题。
AI.motivation: 二项Logistic混合模型中存在一个“可探测但不可恢复”的区域：尽管BIC等标准准则能成功识别存在两个混合组件，但由于信息量不足，无法准确恢复每个观测值的标签。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：证明了观测数据证据（混合结构探测）与单观测信息（标签恢复）在组件分离度下具有不同的局部阶数；2. 改进方法：提出了“可恢复性感知BIC（带后验熵惩罚）”和“熵正则化估计器”，以修正极大似然估计导致的过度分离倾向。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了上述理论预测，证明了传统方法在该区域会产生误导性的组件选择，而提出的新方法能有效规避该问题，并显著提升后验概率的校准质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了二项Logistic混合模型中混合结构探测与标签恢复之间存在本质的信息鸿沟。通过引入可恢复性感知（feasibility-aware）的推断程序，可以有效解决BIC等标准准则在“可探测但不可恢复”区域内的失效问题，从而获得更稳健的组件选择和更准确的后验概率校准。

title: Multimodal Physiological Assessment of Contact-Rich Physical Human-Robot Interaction Under Varying Environmental Conditions
summary: Physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) in real-world settings exposes operators to fluctuating environmental conditions during contact-rich tasks. Traditional task-centric evaluations overlook the physiological burdens imposed by these stressors. Therefore, we conducted a multimodal empirical study involving contact-rich tracing tasks under 18 distinct combinations of temperature, acoustic noise, and illuminance. Synchronously, we recorded electrodermal activity (EDA), surface electromyography (sEMG), eye-tracking data, and subjective environmental comfort ratings. Evaluating these physiological signals alongside execution data revealed hidden physiological costs not captured by objective performance. The results revealed that task performance remained stable across all environmental conditions. Autonomic workload, indexed by tonic skin conductance level (SCL), increased with temperature, while physical and cognitive workload were unaffected. Perceived environmental comfort showed no significant association with tracing error or completion time. These findings reveal a compensatory mechanism where operators maintain consistent performance by increasing their physiological effort to suppress thermal discomfort. Such insight motivates the development of physiology-aware control architectures that leverage real-time physiological metrics to reduce operator workload in unstructured environments.

AI.tldr: 即便在恶劣环境下任务表现稳定，操作员仍会付出巨大的生理代价（如因热压力产生的自主神经负荷），这证明了需要开发能够实时感知并降低操作员生理负担的“生理感知”人机交互系统。
AI.motivation: 传统的物理人机交互（pHRI）评估侧重于任务表现，忽略了真实环境中环境压力源引起的生理负担。
AI.method: 进行了一项多模态实证研究，受试者在18种不同的温度、环境噪音和光照组合下执行接触式跟踪任务；同步采集了皮肤电活动（EDA）、表面肌电图（sEMG）、眼动数据和主观舒适度评分。
AI.result: 尽管环境条件各异，但任务性能保持稳定。然而，温度升高导致自主神经工作负荷（以皮肤电平SCL为指标）增加，而物理和认知负荷未受明显影响；主观舒适度与任务误差或完成时间无显著相关性。
AI.conclusion: 操作员通过增加生理努力（如通过植物神经负荷应对热应激）来补偿环境压力，从而在不同环境下保持稳定的任务性能。这项研究支持开发能够根据实时生理指标自适应调整、以减轻操作员负担的“生理感知”控制架构。

title: Deep Temporal Modeling and Ensemble Fusion for Multimodal Emotion Recognition from Physiological Signals
comment: Accepted for publication in the 17th ACM International Conference on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology and Health Informatics (ACM BCB 2026). DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3807503.3819363
summary: Physiological stress and emotion recognition are important for health monitoring and affective computing. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of deep learning models such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN), and Transformer on the WESAD dataset for multimodal affect recognition using wrist and chest sensor signals. We perform ablation studies to assess the individual contributions of each modality by training models on wrist-only and chest-only inputs. In addition, we implement a late-fusion ensemble strategy that combines predictions from all three architectures trained on multimodal input. We also employ early fusion at the sensor level by concatenating wrist and chest signals before feeding them into each model. Our results show that Transformer models consistently achieve the highest accuracy in multimodal settings, while TCN models perform best in the wrist-only configuration. The ensemble method yields the highest overall accuracy (98.91 +/- 0.13%) and macro-F1 score (98.56 +/- 0.17%). These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of sensor fusion and ensemble-based fusion in developing robust systems for physiological emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文在WESAD数据集上评估了LSTM、TCN和Transformer在多模态生理情感识别中的表现，发现集成学习与传感器融合策略能构建高精度的情感监测系统。
AI.motivation: 生理压力与情感识别在健康监测和情感计算领域具有重要意义，作者旨在评估不同深度学习模型在多模态生理传感器数据上的表现，并探索最优的融合策略以提高识别准确率。
AI.method: 1. 模型架构：对比了LSTM、TCN和Transformer；2. 融合策略：对比了传感器级早期融合（数据拼接）和决策级后期融合（集成学习）；3. 消融实验：对比了腕戴式、胸戴式及多模态输入下的模型表现。
AI.result: 集成学习策略取得了最高性能（准确率98.91%，宏F1分数98.56%）；在多模态任务中Transformer表现最佳，而在单一腕戴式设备场景下TCN表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 通过传感器融合及集成学习策略，能显著提升生理信号情感识别的鲁棒性和准确性，其中Transformer架构在多模态场景下表现最优。

title: A Comparative Study of Graph Neural Network Layer Selection for Interaction Modelling in Driving Trajectory Prediction
summary: Autonomous driving systems rely on precise trajectory prediction to plan safe and efficient movement. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become a promising approach for modelling spatiotemporal interactions among road agents. However, designing GNN architectures for trajectory prediction remains non-standardized, with little guidance on which graph layers effectively capture spatial interactions and temporal dynamics. This paper offers a detailed comparative study of 19 graph layer types, focusing on their spatial and temporal processing capabilities to discover the most effective architectures for trajectory prediction. Within the explored hyperparameter setting, we highlight five standout layer combinations, with ARMA, Chebyshev, and topology-aware layers consistently performing better than others. Beyond performance metrics, our findings yield practical design principles: sum-based aggregation is more effective than mean-based methods, multi-head attention mechanisms enable richer interactions, and assigning different weights to different hop distances significantly improves prediction accuracy. These findings offer useful guidance for designing more interpretable and effective trajectory prediction models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对19种图层类型的对比实验，确立了自动驾驶轨迹预测中GNN架构设计的最佳实践指南，并总结出提升模型精度的高效设计原则。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统对轨迹预测准确性要求极高。尽管图神经网络（GNN）在处理道路参与者时空交互方面显示出潜力，但目前缺乏标准化设计指南，研发人员难以确定哪种架构最能有效捕获复杂的交互动态。
AI.method: 对19种不同的图神经网络（GNN）层类型进行了详细的对比研究，重点评估了它们在空间和时间处理能力上的表现，并在相同的超参数设置下进行了性能基准测试。
AI.result: 识别出了五种表现突出的图层组合。研究证实，特定的层类型（如ARMA、Chebyshev）在性能上具有明显优势，并量化了不同设计选择（聚合方式、机制、权重分配）对预测精度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究提取了实用的设计原则：求和聚合优于均值聚合；多头注意力机制能捕捉更丰富的交互；对不同跳数（hop distances）分配不同权重可显著提高预测精度。ARMA、Chebyshev和拓扑感知层在预测任务中表现最优，为后续模型设计提供了明确的参考依据。

title: MAGE-RAG: Multigranular Adaptive Graph Evidence for Agentic Multimodal RAG in Long-Document QA
summary: Long-document multimodal question answering requires a system to locate sparse evidence in long PDFs and integrate clues from text, tables, images, charts, and complex layouts. Existing RAG methods mostly rely on fixed Top-k retrieval over text chunks or pages. Text retrieval can compress the context but often loses visual and layout information; page-level visual retrieval preserves the original page, yet it also sends large irrelevant regions to the reader, leading to a static trade-off among evidence coverage, noise, and inference cost. This paper proposes MAGE-RAG, a multigranular adaptive graph evidence framework for long-document multimodal QA. MAGE-RAG uses page retrieval as the entry point for query-time evidence construction. Offline, it builds an evidence graph with page nodes and element nodes, encoding containment, reading order, layout adjacency, section hierarchy, and semantic-neighbor relations. At query time, an online evidence controller iteratively activates, opens, searches, and prunes evidence under explicit budgets. The resulting evidence subgraph is then rendered into structured multimodal reader input, allowing the LVLM to consume compact and relevant evidence within a limited context. On LongDocURL and MMLongBench-Doc, we establish a unified comparison and analysis protocol covering Direct MLLM, Text RAG, Page-level Visual RAG, and Graph/Agentic RAG. Experiments show that MAGE-RAG achieves 52.75 overall accuracy on LongDocURL, and 53.26 accuracy with 51.19 F1 on MMLongBench-Doc. Fine-grained breakdowns, budget-performance curves, ablations, and trace-based analysis further show that query-time evidence subgraph construction can balance dispersed evidence coverage with context-noise control. Our code is available at https://github.com/laonuo2004/MAGE-RAG.git.

AI.tldr: 针对长文档多模态问答，MAGE-RAG 通过构建多粒度证据图与在线动态子图剪枝，实现了精准的跨模态证据检索，显著提升了在有限上下文窗口下的问答性能与成本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成（RAG）方法在处理长文档时存在局限：纯文本检索丢失了多模态（图表/布局）信息；页级视觉检索引入过多无关噪声，且在大模型上下文窗口受限的情况下，难以在证据覆盖与噪声/成本之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出 MAGE-RAG 框架：(1) 离线构建多粒度证据图（包含页面、元素及其层级、布局和语义关系）；(2) 在线控制器根据预算需求，通过迭代式的激发、搜索与修剪机制动态构建证据子图；(3) 将该子图渲染为结构化输入，供大视觉语言模型（LVLM）处理。
AI.result: MAGE-RAG 在 LongDocURL 达到 52.75 准确率，在 MMLongBench-Doc 上达到 53.26 准确率和 51.19 F1 分数，优于现有的多种长文档多模态问答基线方案。
AI.conclusion: MAGE-RAG 提出的动态、以图为中心的证据检索与构建方法，有效平衡了长文档多模态问答中“证据覆盖率”、“噪声控制”与“推理成本”之间的矛盾，优于传统的固定切片或页级检索方案。

title: Benchmarking Instance-Dependent Label Noise with Controlled Corruptions
summary: Synthetic instance-dependent label noise (IDN) benchmarks are widely used to evaluate noisy-label learning methods, yet existing approaches typically generate noise through imperfect annotators or classifier raters, leaving the source of ambiguity implicit. We introduce CILN, a benchmark generation framework that creates IDN through controlled input corruptions. A diverse voter pool labels corrupted instances, producing benchmark datasets in which both the source and severity of ambiguity are explicit and controllable. Using CIFAR10, MNIST, and Adult, we construct 90 benchmark settings spanning multiple corruption families and severity levels. Our experiments show that the resulting benchmarks exhibit genuine instance-dependent noise, provide diverse confusion structures, and, on CIFAR-10, can produce label distributions that are closer to human uncertainty than an existing synthetic IDN benchmark. We further demonstrate that corruption-mediated IDN can expose failure modes of popular noisy-label learning methods, including Co-Teaching and DivideMix, that are not observed under comparable levels of rater-fallibility noise. These findings suggest that noise structure, not only noise rate, plays an important role in benchmark difficulty and algorithm behavior. By making ambiguity generation explicit and controllable, CILN provides a complementary benchmarking framework for studying noisy-label learning under diverse sources of instance difficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CILN，一种通过受控输入模糊化生成实例相关标签噪声（IDN）的新框架，能构建来源明确、可控的基准，有效揭示了现有噪声学习算法在不同噪声结构下的真实弱点。
AI.motivation: 现有的合成实例相关噪声（IDN）基准通常通过不完善的标注者或分类器模拟噪声，导致噪声产生的模糊性来源隐晦且不可控，限制了对噪声标签学习方法失败模式的深入分析。
AI.method: 提出CILN框架：通过受控的输入损坏（Input Corruption）模拟产生实例相关噪声（IDN）。将损坏后的样本投喂给多元化的投票池（Voter Pool）进行标注，从而生成来源明确、严重程度可控的噪声标签数据集。测试涵盖CIFAR-10、MNIST和Adult数据集，共构建90种基准配置。
AI.result: 基于CILN构建的基准展示了真实的实例相关噪声特征和多样的混淆结构；在CIFAR-10上，其生成的标签分布比现有基准更接近人类的不确定性；实验证明该框架能揭示Co-Teaching和DivideMix等主流算法在传统噪声模型中未被发现的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 噪声的结构（即噪声的来源和分布模式）与噪声率同样重要，直接影响算法的评估难度和行为。通过显式且可控的模糊性生成，CILN为研究复杂噪声环境下的机器学习算法提供了更严谨、更具区分度的评估基准。

title: EPIC: A System Framework for Efficient Egocentric Perception on Embodied AR Glasses
summary: Modern smart AR glasses are evolving into intelligent systems that support foundation model-based assistance through continuous perception of the user and surrounding environment. However, this perception-first design creates major bottlenecks. Continuously capturing, processing, and storing rich perceptual streams, especially high-resolution egocentric video, imposes substantial power and memory overhead, which is difficult to sustain on resource-constrained AR glasses. In this work, we propose EPIC, an efficient egocentric perception system for embodied intelligence on smart AR glasses. EPIC is an algorithm-hardware co-optimization framework that leverages gaze, pose, and inertial signals to infer user intent and retain only the most informative parts of high-resolution perceptual input, greatly reducing perception overhead. Our results show that EPIC reduces memory footprint by $27.5\times$ and energy consumption by $24.3\times$ on average compared with full video baseline solution, while preserving intelligent assistance accuracy on egocentric video understanding tasks, a key application scenario for embodied intelligence on smart glasses.

AI.tldr: EPIC是一种针对智能AR眼镜的协同优化框架，通过结合用户行为信号（注视、姿态等）过滤冗余视觉数据，在显著降低内存和功耗的同时，保障了具身智能任务的解析精度。
AI.motivation: 现代智能AR眼镜在运行基于基础模型的感知任务时，面临持续处理高分辨率第一视角（egocentric）视频带来的巨大功耗和内存性能瓶颈，难以在资源受限的硬件上持续运行。
AI.method: 提出了一种算法-硬件协同优化框架（EPIC）。利用用户的注视点（gaze）、姿态（pose）和惯性传感器数据（inertial signals）来推断用户意图，并基于此实现从高分辨率视觉流中智能筛选有效信息，而非全量处理。
AI.result: 相比传统的全视频基准方案，EPIC平均减少了27.5倍的内存占用和24.3倍的能耗，同时在第一视角视频理解任务中保持了极高的智能辅助准确度。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法与硬件的协同优化（EPIC），证明了在AR眼镜上实现高效具身智能是可行的。通过仅保留关键感知信息，系统在保持高任务准确度的前提下，极大地缓解了资源限制问题。

title: Single-item lot sizing problem under budgeted lead-time uncertainty
summary: In this paper, a single-item lot sizing problem with backordering is discussed. The time horizon is divided into planning periods, characterized by fixed and variable production costs, and future delivery periods with specified demands, where inventory holding and backordering costs may occur. For each planning period, a common nominal lead time is given. The true lead times can deviate to some extent from the nominal one, and their exact values are unknown at the planning step. We assume that lead times take only integer values and splitting production orders is not allowed. Furthermore, order crossovers are prohibited; thus, an order placed earlier cannot arrive after one placed later. A budgeted uncertainty set of possible lead-time scenarios is defined, where a budget allows us to control the amount of uncertainty of lead times. It is shown how to construct a family of production plans varying from the most optimistic (a best lead-time scenario occurs) to the most pessimistic (a worst lead-time scenario occurs). In order to compute these plans the R* criterion is applied which generalizes the conservative robust min-max criterion, commonly used in robust optimization. The computational complexity of the problem is investigated. Polynomial, pseudopolynomial time algorithms, and mixed integer programming formulations are proposed to solve the general problem and its special cases. The results of computational tests are provided that demonstrate that using the R* criterion can significantly enlarge the set of candidate production plans.

AI.tldr: 针对交货期不确定环境下的单产品批量计划问题，本文引入R*准则构建了一套从乐观到悲观的鲁棒生产策略，通过多项式算法和MIP模型解决了传统鲁棒优化过于保守的局限，提升了生产计划的灵活性与决策空间。
AI.motivation: 在存在交货期不确定性（且交货期仅为整数、不允许拆单及订单交叉）的单产品批量计划问题中，传统的鲁棒优化（min-max）往往过于保守，未能充分考量实际生产中对不同风险偏好的选择需求。
AI.method: 1. 建立基于预算约束的交货期不确定性集合；2. 应用R*准则（R* criterion），通过调节预算参数，在最乐观与最悲观情景间构建一系列生产计划；3. 设计多项式与伪多项式算法，并提出混合整数规划（MIP）模型进行求解。
AI.result: 研究证明了该问题的计算复杂性，并开发了高效的算法与MIP模型。计算实验表明，采用R*准则能显著增加候选生产计划的多样性，使决策者能在成本与风险之间根据预算实现更精细的权衡。
AI.conclusion: R*标准能够有效扩展鲁棒优化中的候选生产计划集合，在应对交货期不确定性方面提供了比传统最差情况（min-max）更具灵活性和实用性的决策方案。

title: Generation Quality-Latency Tradeoff-Aware Inference Offloading for Multimodal LLMs in Cloud-Edge Continuum
comment: This manuscript was submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing on June 3, 2026
summary: Beyond pure cloud, some efforts are being made to deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) in edge to accelerate inference response. So the deployment of LLMs in cloud-edge continuum becomes a promising paradigm, where the tasks involving multimodal data occupy a large part of requests. Under this continuum, users usually concern about multiple Quality-of-Service (QoS) attributes, but it is always intractable to jointly optimize them. In this paper, we propose to study the joint optimization of those attributes and focus on two key representatives, i.e., content generation quality and response latency. We propose to study the offloading technology to achieve a tradeoff between the two objectives in the cloud-edge collaborative Multimodal LLM (MLLM) system. However, it is highly difficult to predict generation quality and inference latency for MLLM inference tasks while optimizing this offloading process. To address these unprecedented difficulties, we propose a Quality-Latency Tradeoff-Aware MLLM Inference Offloading (QLMIO) framework to make decisions that optimally balance generation quality and response latency. Meanwhile, recognizing the absence of publicly available datasets tailored to the MLLM inference offloading problem, we constructed a real-world cloud-edge collaborative MLLM system and subsequently collected an MLLM Inference Offloading Benchmark (MIOBench) to comprehensively evaluate our framework and facilitate the study of this problem. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the QLMIO framework reduces latency by up to 58.14\% compared to baselines, while simultaneously matching the task completion rate achieved under the case that executes all requests exclusively on a cloud server. The dataset and codes are available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大模型在云边协同环境下的部署难题，提出了QLMIO决策框架及MIOBench基准数据集，有效平衡了生成质量与推理延迟，在显著降低延迟的同时保证了任务完成质量。
AI.motivation: 在云边协同环境下部署多模态大模型（MLLM）时，存在生成质量与推理延迟难以平衡的挑战，且目前缺乏专门针对此类推理卸载问题的公开基准数据集。
AI.method: 提出了QLMIO（Quality-Latency Tradeoff-Aware MLLM Inference Offloading）框架，用于协同多目标决策；构建了包含真实云边环境的MIOBench数据集，以支持对推理卸载策略的评估与建模。
AI.result: 实验表明，QLMIO框架相较于基准模型提升了最高58.14%的推理效率，并能够在保证与全云端执行相当的任务完成率的情况下，实现性能的最优权衡。
AI.conclusion: QLMIO框架成功在云边协作架构下实现了生成质量与推理延迟的最佳平衡，为解决多模态大模型在边缘侧部署的难点提供了有效的解决方案，并通过MIOBench推动了该领域的进一步研究。

title: Stochastic trace estimation with tensor train random vectors
summary: Stochastic trace estimation is a standard tool for approximating the trace of a large-scale matrix available only through matrix-vector products. However, in tensor-structured settings, unstructured Gaussian or Rademacher test vectors may be prohibitively expensive to store and compute with, while cheaper rank-one tensor-product vectors can require sample complexities that grow exponentially with the tensor order. This work studies Gaussian random tensor train vectors as a structured alternative for stochastic trace estimation. We show that, with a suitable choice of the tensor train rank, random tensor train vectors recover dimension-independent guarantees for the Girard--Hutchinson estimator. In particular, a median-of-means variant with tensor train rank $r \geq d-1$ achieves the same dependence on the accuracy $\varepsilon$ and failure probability $δ$ as the classical estimator based on unstructured Gaussian vectors. We further prove an oblivious subspace injection result for sketches formed from independent Gaussian random tensor train vectors: tensor train rank $r\geq d-1$ and $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}(k+\log(1/δ)))$ samples suffice for a $k$-dimensional target subspace. Finally, we investigate the use of such sketches within the Nyström++ framework. We show that the resulting estimator can achieve the desired $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-1})$ sample complexity under an additional spectral-tail condition. These results provide clarififcation on both the potential and the limitations of random tensor train vectors in stochastic trace estimation.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入高斯随机张量列车（TT）向量替代非结构化随机向量进行迹估计，通过设置适当的TT秩，在显著降低计算存储成本的同时，保持了与传统方法相当的收敛性能和样本准确度保证。
AI.motivation: 在大规模矩阵迹估计中，传统的非结构化向量（高斯/Rademacher）存储与计算开销极大，而简单的秩一张量积向量又会导致样本复杂度随张量阶数呈指数增长。旨在寻找一种既具备结构化优势又具有低样本复杂度保证的高效替代方案。
AI.method: 提出使用高斯随机张量列车（Tensor Train, TT）向量作为结构化随机向量方案；采用中位数均值法（median-of-means）进行估计；利用忽略子空间注入（oblivious subspace injection）理论对草图（sketch）进行分析；并将该方法应用于Nyström++框架中。
AI.result: 1. 证明了当TT秩 $r \ge d-1$ 时，基于TT的Girard-Hutchinson估计器可恢复维度无关的精度与失败概率保证。2. 证明了对于 $k$ 维子空间，使用该方法只需 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}(k+\log(1/\delta)))$ 个样本。3. 在Nyström++框架下，满足谱尾条件时可实现 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-1})$ 的样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 高斯随机张量列车（TT）向量在随机迹估计和子空间投影中是一种有效的结构化替代方案。当TT秩 $r \ge d-1$ 时，能够实现与非结构化高斯向量类似的性能，且能保持维度无关的收敛保证，同时在存储和计算效率上具有优势。该研究明确了TT格式在迹估计中的应用潜力和局限性。

title: Inference-time Policy Steering via Vision and Touch
summary: Inference-time steering adapts pre-trained generative robot policies during deployment by verifying candidate actions before execution. While prior methods typically perform this verification only with visual observations, vision alone is often insufficient for contact-rich manipulation, where success depends on both global task progress and subtle local interactions such as contact force. We introduce ViTaL, a visuo-tactile inference-time steering framework that formulates multimodal guidance as a bi-level optimization problem. At the high level, visual sampling-and-verification performs long-horizon mode selection, deciding what behavior the robot should execute. At the low level, tactile-guided diffusion editing refines the selected action sequence over a shorter horizon to satisfy local contact requirements. To support outcome-based steering, ViTaL learns a visuo-tactile latent world model and employs semantically aligned visual and tactile verifiers, including a novel text-conditioned tactile reward that scores predicted tactile futures directly in latent space. Across three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ViTaL improves overall success by 51% over the base policy, outperforms unimodal steering by at least 33%, and exceeds naive multimodal fusion by at least 20%. Website: https://yilin-wu98.github.io/vital_website.

AI.tldr: ViTaL是一个视触觉推理时引导框架，通过高层视觉规划与低层触觉细化相结合的双层优化策略，显著提升了机器人处理接触密集型任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理时引导方法主要依赖视觉，但在接触密集型操作任务中，视觉信息不足以捕捉细微的接触力交互，导致任务执行失败。因此需要引入触觉信息来增强环境理解与操作精度。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ViTaL的视触觉推理时引导框架，将其建模为一个双层优化问题：高层利用视觉采样验证进行长时程行为模式选择；低层利用触觉引导的扩散模型编辑对短时程动作进行细化。同时，构建了视触觉潜空间世界模型，并引入文本条件的触觉奖励器。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界的接触密集型操作任务中，ViTaL相比基准策略成功率提升了51%，比单一模态引导方法高出至少33%，比简单的多模态融合方法高出至少20%。
AI.conclusion: ViTaL通过结合视觉和触觉信息，在推理时进行双层策略优化，有效解决了接触密集型机器人操作任务，并在真实世界实验中显著优于单一模态或简单的多模态融合方法，证明了多模态引导在精细操作中的必要性。

title: ReportQA: QA-Based Radiology Report Evaluation
summary: Radiology report evaluation is essential for advancing automated report generation. Natural language generation metrics have limited clinical relevance. Clinical efficacy (CE) metrics evaluate important medical findings, but focus mainly on presence and cover only a limited set of entities. Due to heavy reliance on manual annotations, it is difficult for CE metrics to extend clinical entities or attributes. In clinical practice, radiology reports serve as a medium for information transfer. Clinicians use them to perform downstream diagnostic tasks without directly inspecting images. Based on this insight, we propose ReportQA, a clinical-related and flexible radiology report evaluation framework, supporting detailed quantitative analysis of radiology report generation systems. We first collect datasets covering multiple imaging modalities and anatomical regions. We then construct knowledge trees of clinical entities and attributes with radiologist guidance, and use large language models (LLMs) to extract structured information from raw reports. Next, we generate QA pairs from predefined templates and apply quality control through self-filtering and report-based filtering. During evaluation, the report is treated as context, and an LLM acts as a judge model to answer the QA pairs. Based on the resulting QA accuracy, we introduce QAScore metric. Compared with existing metrics, QAScore shows better alignment with radiologist judgments. Experiments on multiple state-of-the-art vision-language models reveal that current report-based inference paradigms struggle to learn fine-grained clinical representations and exhibit strong negative prior biases. In contrast, question-driven inference provides a more effective alternative. For reproducibility and extensibility, we release the knowledge trees, structured reports, and QA pairs, along with the pipeline code for QA construction and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 针对现有放射学报告评估指标临床相关性不足的问题，提出了基于LLM和QA机制的ReportQA评估框架及QAScore指标，实现了更灵活、细粒度且符合临床判断的报告质量衡量。
AI.motivation: 现有的自然语言生成指标临床相关性低，临床效能（CE）指标难以扩展实体且依赖人工标注，无法满足临床诊断任务的细粒度评估需求。
AI.method: 提出了ReportQA评估框架：1. 构建临床实体与属性的知识树；2. 利用LLM从原始报告中提取结构化信息；3. 基于模板自动生成并筛选高质量QA对；4. 将报告作为上下文，利用LLM进行问答，并计算QAScore作为评估指标。
AI.result: 构建了跨多种成像模态和解剖区域的评估数据集和知识树；研究发现当前主流放射学报告生成模型在细粒度临床表征上存在不足。
AI.conclusion: 通过QAScore评估放射学报告生成系统比现有度量标准更符合放射科医生的临床判断；当前范式在细粒度临床表征学习上存在困难及严重的负面偏见，而基于问题的推理（question-driven inference）是更有效的替代方案。

title: Leveraging Physiological Signals to Predict Exam Outcomes with Machine Learning
summary: This study investigates the application of machine learning models to predict exam outcomes using physiological data collected during examination sessions. Physiological stress indicators, including electrodermal activity, heart rate, and skin temperature, were analyzed to uncover their association with academic performance. A variety of machine learning approaches were employed, ranging from standard models like logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machines to more advanced architectures, including transformers, long short-term memory (LSTM), and gated recurrent unit (GRU) models. This diversity aimed to capture the complex interactions within the data effectively. A key focus was assessing the adaptability of transformers in processing numerical data and evaluating their performance in this novel context. Standard performance metrics, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, were used to compare model efficacy. The experimental results demonstrate that while deep learning models generally excel at capturing complex relationships in physiological data, simpler models like random forests can sometimes achieve superior performance while offering computational efficiency and interpretability. Furthermore, transformers demonstrated notable versatility, showcasing performances comparable to those of the LSTM and GRU models. This research underscores the importance of experimenting with a broad class of models that align with the objectives of the problem at hand, balancing precision, efficiency, and interpretability. By elucidating the relationships between physiological signals and academic performance, this study contributes to understanding stressors affecting students' mental health. It further promotes leveraging physiological data to enhance student well-being and academic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比多种机器学习与深度学习模型，验证了利用生理信号预测考试成绩的可行性，并指出平衡模型准确性、计算效率与可解释性的重要性。
AI.motivation: 探究生理应激指标与学术表现之间的关联，旨在利用生理数据识别考试影响因素，以改善学生的心理健康与学习成果。
AI.method: 通过采集学生考试期间的生理指标（皮肤电、心率、皮肤温度），对比了逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机等传统机器学习模型，以及Transformer、LSTM、GRU等深度学习架构，并使用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1-score进行评估。
AI.result: 深度学习模型能有效捕捉复杂的生理数据关系；随机森林在保证可解释性和计算效率的同时表现优异；Transformer在处理此类数字序列任务中表现出与LSTM和GRU相当的竞争能力。
AI.conclusion: 在预测考试成绩时，需平衡模型性能、计算效率与可解释性；在复杂关系捕捉上深度学习表现出色，但随机森林等模型在特定场景下既高效又具优势；Transformer架构在生理数据分析任务中表现出良好的适用性。

title: Entity Labels Are Not Entity Signals: A Framework for Observable Relevance in Document Re-Ranking
summary: Entity-aware document retrieval uses query-associated entities as ranking signals, assuming that semantically relevant entities are also useful retrieval signals. We show this assumption is insufficient- and explain why. Unlike terms, which are ground-truth observations, entity links are hypotheses produced by an imperfect linker: an entity can be topically central yet provide no discriminative signal if the linker fires indiscriminately across relevant and non-relevant documents. We formalize this as a distinction between Conceptual Entity Relevance (CER)- whether an entity is topically related to a query- and Observable Entity Relevance (OER)- whether its observed presence in a collection discriminates relevant from non-relevant documents. Across four collections and annotation sources including human entity judgments, CER and OER exhibit near-chance agreement ($κ\approx 0$), while OER operationalizations agree substantially ($κ\approx 0.5$), confirming CER as the systematic outlier. CER-based supervision selects topically plausible but weakly discriminative entities, pruning fewer than 4% of non-relevant documents on some collections. Aligning supervision with OER improves non-relevant pruning by up to 10x and open-world MAP by 0.051 over BM25. Our findings motivate a shift from conceptual to observable notions of entity relevance in entity-aware retrieval.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，传统的基于“概念匹配”的实体检索因忽视了实体链接工具的误差，导致检索信号无效。通过引入“可观测相关性（OER）”作为新的监督指标，可显著提高实体感知检索的判别力和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有实体感知文档检索假设“概念相关实体即好的检索信号”，但由于实体链接工具的缺陷，大量概念相关但缺乏判别能力的实体会引入噪声，导致检索性能受限。
AI.method: 提出区分“概念实体相关性（CER，专题相关）”与“可观测实体相关性（OER，判别能力）”；通过实验对比两者的关联度及其实际检索效能，并提出将监督信号向OER对齐的方法。
AI.result: CER与OER几乎无相关性（κ≈0）；基于CER的监督会选出大量无判别能力的实体；将监督信号改为OER后，非相关文档的过滤效率提升高达10倍，检索平均精度（MAP）较BM25提升0.051。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，实体感知的文档检索应从“概念相关性（CER）”转向“可观测相关性（OER）”。基于OER进行监督学习能显著提升检索系统的区分能力和性能。

title: Google's Training Supercomputers from TPU v2 to Ironwood: Architectural Stability, Scale, Resilience, Power Efficiency, and Sustainability Across Five Generations
summary: This paper (to appear in the July/August 2026 issue of IEEE Micro magazine) summarizes five generations of Google s TPUs, from TPU v2 to Ironwood, highlighting their evolution as scalable, resilient, power-efficient, sustainable supercomputers for AI training. It details the TPU s stable architecture, which has surprisingly easily accommodated the rapidly changing deep neural network workloads, such as the rise of Transformers. Key advancements over eight years include 10x increase in HBM capacity and bandwidth per node, a 100x increase in peak node performance, and a 3600x increase in supercomputer performance. The paper also discusses the role of optical circuit switches, built-in self test, and hardware replay in enhancing resilience and how TPU's environmental impact is reduced with substantial improvements in performance per Watt and in carbon emissions per floating point operation. It concludes by identifying six features that may well characterize successful training accelerators of this decade.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了Google五代TPU（v2至Ironwood）的架构进化史，展示了其在算力扩展、能效提升及可靠性优化方面的成就，并归纳了面向未来十年AI训练加速器的核心设计原则。
AI.motivation: 探讨TPU架构如何适应深度学习领域（尤其是Transformer模型）的快速演进，并展示其作为大规模、高能效、可持续AI超级计算机的演变历程。
AI.method: 通过回顾和总结Google五代TPU（从TPU v2到Ironwood）的架构演进，对比关键指标（HBM容量/带宽、峰值性能）的变化，并分析关键技术（光学电路交换、BIST、硬件重放）在性能、能效及可靠性提升中的作用。
AI.result: 过去八年间，TPU实现了单节点HBM容量与带宽的10倍提升、单节点峰值性能的100倍提升，以及超算整体性能的3600倍增长；同时在能效（每瓦性能）和碳排放优化方面取得了显著进展。
AI.conclusion: 总结了过去八年TPU的发展经验，并提出了未来十年成功训练加速器应具备的六个核心特征。

title: Online Matching with KIID Edge Arrivals
summary:
In the classic online stochastic matching proposed by Feldman et al. (FOCS 2009), there is a known bipartite type-graph, where one side of the graph is given offline. Upon the arrival of each online vertex, its type is sampled independently and identically from the other side of the type-graph. This model has been extensively studied over the past decade, yielding a rich body of theoretical results. In this paper, we initiate the study of an edge arrival model for online stochastic matching. In our model, the online edges are sampled independently and identically (KIID) from a known type-graph, which need not be bipartite.
  We first show that the Greedy algorithm cannot achieve a competitive ratio strictly better than $0.5$ while the Suggested Matching algorithm has a competitive ratio of $1-1/e$ under the assumption of integral arrival rates, matching its performance in the one-sided vertex arrival model. We then propose a two-stage algorithm that combines Greedy and Suggested Matching, and show that its competitive ratio is strictly higher than $1-1/e$ for integral arrival rates. While our algorithm is simple, its analysis is intricate and builds upon the Natural LP, which has been proven very powerful in vertex arrival models. Our result reveals that even in the more challenging edge arrival setting for general graphs, competitive ratios better than $1-1/e$ are still possible, given the known distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在线随机匹配的边到达模型，提出了一个两阶段算法，成功在一般图结构中超越了 $1-1/e$ 的竞争比界限。
AI.motivation: 旨在将经典的在线随机匹配问题（通常为顶点到达模型）扩展到更具挑战性的“边到达模型”（Edge Arrival Model），其中在线边从已知的类型图中独立同分布（KIID）采样。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段算法，结合了贪心算法（Greedy）和建议匹配算法（Suggested Matching）。分析过程基于 Natural LP（自然线性规划）方法。
AI.result: 证明了 Greedy 算法的竞争比无法超过 0.5；证明了 Suggested Matching 算法在整数到达率下可达到 $1-1/e$ 的竞争比；所提出的两阶段组合算法在整数到达率下实现了严格大于 $1-1/e$ 的竞争比。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究表明，在边到达模型（Edge Arrival Model）且已知分布的情况下，算法可以突破 $1-1/e$ 的竞争比界限，证明了该模型下存在超越传统算法性能的潜力。

title: Adaptive Resource Management and Quality Control for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive diffusion transformers (AR-DiTs) recast video generation from an offline paradigm to a real-time streaming one: the model generates video one chunk at a time, making each chunk available for playout once produced. The service-level objective (SLO) for this paradigm is no longer fixed latency or throughput but the preservation of playout continuity: generation must stay ahead of the playout timeline. Once generation falls behind, the remaining playable buffer (playout slack) is exhausted, and users experience visible stalls. This objective reveals two serving design insights. First, real-time video generation has a dynamic SLO that evolves with playout progress, so resources should move toward streams with lower playout slack. Second, an acceptable chunk delivered on time is preferable to a late high-fidelity chunk, so per-chunk fidelity configurations should adapt to available playout slack. Guided by these insights, we present SlackServe, a playout-slack-driven serving system that preserves playout continuity in real-time streaming video generation. SlackServe uses playout slack as a unified signal, reallocating resources across streams through three-tier priority queues, re-homing, and elastic sequence parallelism, while selecting per-chunk fidelity configurations within each stream through Bi-Modal Pareto Routing under a quality floor. On a 16-H100 GPU cluster, SlackServe improves Quality of Experience (QoE), measured by Continuous Play Ratio (CPR), by 1.64x-3.29x and reduces Time to First Chunk (TTFC) by 1.61x-9.65x over baselines, while preserving comparable generation quality.

AI.tldr: SlackServe 是一款针对流式视频生成（AR-DiTs）的 Serving 系统，旨在通过实时监控“播放余量”来灵活调节算力分配与生成保真度，在极端压力下最大限度维持视频播放的连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型（AR-DiTs）将生成转变为流式任务后，核心挑战从简单的延迟或吞吐量控制转变为确保播放的连续性（即生成速度必须始终快于播放进度）。当生成滞后于播放时会出现严重的卡顿，现有 serving 系统缺乏对这种“播放进度动态演变”的针对性优化。
AI.method: SlackServe 采用以“播放余量（playout-slack）”为核心的协同调度机制：1. 全局资源调度：通过三级优先级队列、流重新分配（re-homing）和弹性序列并行化，动态将算力分配给播放余量更少的流；2. 局部配置调整：引入双模帕累托路由（Bi-Modal Pareto Routing），根据播放余量动态决策单块视频的保真度配置，在保证质量底线的前提下实现性能最优化。
AI.result: 在 16-H100 GPU 集群上的实验显示，与基线方案相比，SlackServe 将连续播放率（CPR）提升了 1.64-3.29 倍，同时将首帧延迟（TTFC）降低了 1.61-9.65 倍，并保持了相当的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SlackServe 通过利用“播放余量”这一关键指标，有效地解决了自动回归扩散 Transformer (AR-DiTs) 在实时视频流生成中的连续性问题。该系统在无需牺牲视觉质量的前提下，显著提升了生成任务的连续播放率（CPR）并降低了首帧延迟（TTFC），证明了资源调度与视频流播放进度深度耦合的必要性。

title: Spectral Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Structured Non-Exchangeable Data
summary: Conformal prediction gives prediction intervals with finite-sample coverage when the data are exchangeable. Many time-indexed datasets are not exchangeable. They have seasons, recurring regimes, changing frequencies, or other forms of structured dependence. This paper studies a simple way to use that structure. We propose spectral adaptive conformal prediction, a method that forms weighted conformal quantiles using local spectral similarity and then updates the target miscoverage level online. The spectral weights choose calibration residuals that look relevant to the current test point. The adaptive update corrects the long-run miss rate when uncertainty changes over time. We give an approximate coverage result for the fixed spectral weighted quantile and a deterministic long-run calibration result for the adaptive update. Simulations with recurring regimes and slowly changing frequencies, together with three U.S. real-data examples, show that the hybrid method can improve on fixed spectral weighting, while also showing that spectral weighting must be monitored through effective sample size diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 针对非交换性时间序列数据，提出了一种结合局部光谱相似性加权与在线误差校准的共形预测方法，在保持覆盖率的同时提高了预测区间的自适应性。
AI.motivation: 传统的共形预测依赖于数据的可交换性假设，而包含季节性、变频或制度切换等结构依赖的时间序列数据违背了该假设，导致预测区间表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出“光谱自适应共形预测”方法，通过局部光谱相似性计算加权共形分位数，并引入在线机制动态更新目标覆盖误差水平。
AI.result: 理论上证明了固定光谱加权分位数的近似覆盖性质及自适应更新的确定性长期校准结果；实验表明该方法在处理循环制度和变频数据时表现优于固定加权法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过光谱加权和在线适应性调整，有效解决了非交换性时间序列数据下的共形预测不确定性量化问题，并建议结合有效样本量诊断以确保可靠性。

title: LV-Calib: LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration with Boundary-Response Modeling
summary: We present LV-Calib, a calibration framework for LiDAR-camera extrinsic estimation and LiDAR boundary-response calibration using a printable planar target. The target serves as a shared observation carrier: visual fiducials provide indexed image measurements, while circular reflectivity boundaries provide LiDAR-observable structural feature points. Instead of directly fitting boundary points as ideal geometric contours, LV-Calib automatically crops background points, estimates the target plane, and iteratively refines accurate LiDAR-side 3-D feature points from intensity and geometric constraints. The refinement explicitly handles the broadened and distorted transition band induced by finite beam footprint and mixed-intensity returns around black-white reflectivity discontinuities. Given these refined LiDAR features, we formulate a weighted reprojection-consistent extrinsic optimization with LiDAR feature alignment, where image observations are kept in the reprojection domain and LiDAR feature residuals are weighted by refinement confidence. Finally, using the estimated extrinsic and the extracted transition band, LV-Calib calibrates the LiDAR boundary response by estimating pitch-yaw-range residual statistics of boundary-overlap samples. Experiments on printed-board calibration data demonstrate sub-pixel reprojection accuracy, millimeter-level LiDAR feature consistency, and improved odometry performance. Code and calibration data will be released for reproducible evaluation.

AI.tldr: LV-Calib 是一种利用可打印平面目标进行激光雷达与相机外参及边界响应的精确校准框架，能有效处理边界处的波束畸变，提升多传感器融合系统的精度。
AI.motivation: 传统激光雷达-相机外参标定方法通常依赖复杂的环境特征或特定硬件，且激光雷达在处理反射率边界（如黑白交界处）时存在的波束足迹效应和混叠反射会导致测量精度下降。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于可打印平面目标（包含视觉基准标记和反射率边界）的标定框架；通过自动裁剪背景、估计目标平面，并利用强度和几何约束迭代细化激光雷达3D特征点；针对激光束足迹引起的边界畸变进行建模与优化；构建加权重投影一致性优化问题求解外参，并进一步对边界响应进行统计校准。
AI.result: 实现了亚像素级的重投影精度和毫米级的激光雷达特征一致性，并验证了其在改善激光雷达里程计性能方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LV-Calib 通过一种简单的可打印平面校准板，实现了高精度的激光雷达与相机外参标定及激光雷达边界响应校准，优于现有方法，并提升了下游里程计性能。

title: Equity with Efficiency: An Empirical Study of Tokenizers for Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) depend on subword tokenization to bridge discrete text and continuous neural representation. State-of-the-art multilingual LLMs often use Byte-level Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers that structurally favor high-resource languages and Latin scripts. For speakers of underrepresented languages, particularly those across Southeast Asia, this bias inflates inference costs and widens cross-lingual capability gaps. We present the first systematic comparison of equitable tokenizers on a unified benchmark spanning 11 Southeast Asian languages. Beyond tokenizer-level analysis of compression efficiency and cross-lingual equity, we assess downstream task performance through controlled 1.5B-parameter language model training using the same training data. Our results show that Parity-aware BPE lies on the Pareto frontier of the efficiency-equity trade-off, achieving strong compression parity at competitive cost. Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding delivers the best semantic reasoning performance through morphologically richer representations, albeit at a higher computational expense. Byte Latent Transformer underperforms on downstream tasks, possibly because its architectural assumptions misalign with the constraints of limited low-resource training data. Together, our findings demonstrate that cross-lingual fairness and tokenization efficiency are not fundamentally at odds, and offer practical guidance for designing equitable multilingual models.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多语言LLM分词器对低资源语言（东南亚语言）的偏见问题，对比了多种公平分词策略，指出优化分词方式可在提升公平性的同时保持效率，并为开发更公平的多语言模型提供了具体参考。
AI.motivation: 现有的多语言LLM普遍采用Byte-level BPE分词器，这结构性地偏向高资源语言和拉丁脚本，导致代表性不足的语言（特别是东南亚语言）推理成本增加，且加剧了跨语言能力的差距。
AI.method: 在包含11种东南亚语言的统一基准上，进行了系统性比较。通过训练1.5B参数规模的语言模型，在控制变量下评估了不同分词器（Parity-aware BPE, Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding, Byte Latent Transformer）的压缩效率、跨语言公平性及下游任务性能。
AI.result: Parity-aware BPE 在效率-公平的帕累托前沿上，实现了强压缩平价；Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding 提供了最佳的语义推理性能但计算开销较高；Byte Latent Transformer 在低资源数据约束下的下游任务中表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言公平性与分词效率并非必然对立。本文为设计公平的多语言模型提供了实用指导：Parity-aware BPE 是效率与公平的平衡点，而 Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding 在语义推理方面表现更优。

title: Theorem-Grounded Execution Ontologies for Interpretable Machine Reasoning
summary:
Large language models have achieved impressive performance on reasoning tasks spanning mathematics, science, programming, and commonsense inference. Despite these advances, their reasoning processes remain largely latent, making them difficult to interpret, verify, replay, debug, and transfer across domains. Existing approaches such as chain-of-thought, tree-of-thoughts, graph-of-thoughts, and tool-augmented reasoning expose intermediate reasoning artifacts but typically lack explicit execution semantics, formal state representations, and verifiable reasoning structures.
  We introduce Theorem-Grounded Execution Ontologies (TGEO), a framework that models reasoning as an executable state-transition process rather than a sequence of generated tokens. Given an input problem, TGEO identifies relevant theorem families, binds the problem to a domain ontology, discovers semantic objects, instantiates states and operators, constructs predicates and contracts, and synthesizes an executable reasoning graph. The resulting graph provides an interpretable, replayable, and auditable representation of reasoning in which every state transition, operator application, and validation step is explicitly represented.
  TGEO integrates five architectural components: (1) theorem-grounded reasoning priors, (2) executable ontologies, (3) operator-mediated state transitions, (4) predicate and contract-based execution validation, and (5) architectural auditing and failure localization.
  We evaluate TGEO on theorem-intensive reasoning tasks derived from mathematical benchmark domains and a curated Golden Execution Suite. Our findings demonstrate the value of executable reasoning representations for interpretable, verifiable, and reproducible AI reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 TGEO 框架，将大模型的黑盒推理过程重构为显式的、可执行的状态转换图。它通过结合领域本体论与定理验证，确保了推理过程的每个环节都可被追踪、验证和复现。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型（如 CoT, ToT 等）的推理过程隐晦且缺乏形式化语义，导致推理结果难以解释、验证、重现和调试，无法满足严谨科学推理的需求。
AI.method: 提出“定理导向执行本体论 (TGEO)”框架，将推理建模为状态转换过程。核心架构包含五个组件：定理导向的推理先验、可执行本体、操作符介导的状态转换、谓词/契约验证以及架构审计与故障定位，旨在构建可执行的推理图。
AI.result: 在数学基准测试及黄金执行套件上的评估显示，TGEO 能够生成高度可解释、可审计且具备明确执行语义的推理图，显著提升了推理过程的透明度和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: TGEO 提供了一种将逻辑推理转化为可执行、可验证状态转换过程的通用框架，表明显式化的推理表示对构建可解释、可验证及可复现的 AI 推理系统至关重要。

title: AIA: A Customized Multi-core RISC-V SoC for Discrete Sampling Workloads in 16 nm
summary:
Probabilistic models (PMs) are essential in advancing machine learning capabilities, particularly in safety-critical applications involving reasoning and decision-making. Among the methods employed for inference in these models, sampling-based Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques are widely used. However, MCMC methods come with significant computational costs and are inherently challenging to parallelize, resulting in inefficient execution on conventional CPU/GPU platforms.
  To overcome these challenges, this paper presents AIA, a multi-core RISC-V System-on-Chip (SoC) design fabricated using Intel's 16 nm process technology. Our Approximate Inference Accelerator (AIA) is specifically designed to empower edge devices with robust decision-making and reasoning abilities. The AIA architecture incorporates a RISC-V host processor to manage chip-to-chip data communication and a 2D mesh of 16 custom versatile RISC-V cores optimized for high-efficiency approximate inference.
  Each core features (i) custom instructions and datapath blocks for non-normalized Knuth-Yao (KY) sampling, as well as for the interpolation of non-linear functions (e.g., logarithmic, exponential), and (ii) direct data access to the register file of each neighboring core, to reduce the data movement costs of frequent data exchanges between nearby cores. To further capitalize on the parallelism potential in MCMC algorithms, we developed a specialized compile chain that enables efficient spatial mapping and scheduling across the cores.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为 AIA 的定制化 RISC-V 多核 SoC 加速器，专门用于解决 MCMC 算法在边缘设备上的计算瓶颈，通过架构创新 (KY 采样硬件化、邻域直接访问) 和编译器优化，实现了高效的近似推理。
AI.motivation: MCMC 方法在概率模型的推理中计算成本高且难以并行化，无法满足边缘设备在安全关键应用中对实时决策与推理的需求。
AI.method: 研发 AIA (Approximate Inference Accelerator) 多核 SoC；设计包含 16 个定制化 RISC-V 核的 2D 网格架构；支持非标准化 Knuth-Yao (KY) 采样和非线性函数插值；实现邻近核心寄存器文件直接访问以降低数据移动开销；开发专用编译器进行空间映射与调度。
AI.result: 成功流片 (Intel 16nm 工艺)；实现了针对 MCMC 算法的高效并行加速与通信优化，提升了近似推理的执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计定制化的 RISC-V SoC (AIA)，解决了 MCMC 在边缘计算中计算负荷重、并行化难的问题，证明了专用硬件加速对于提升概率模型在安全关键场景下推理效率的有效性。

title: Can Neural Networks Achieve Optimal Computational-statistical Tradeoff? An Analysis on Single-Index Model
summary: In this work, we tackle the following question: Can neural networks trained with gradient-based methods achieve the optimal computational-statistical tradeoff in learning Gaussian single-index models? Prior research has shown that any polynomial-time algorithm under the statistical query (SQ) framework requires $Ω(d^{s^\star/2}\lor d)$ samples, where $s^\star$ is the generative exponent representing the intrinsic difficulty of learning the underlying model. However, it remains unknown whether neural networks can achieve this sample complexity. Inspired by prior techniques such as label transformation and landscape smoothing for learning single-index models, we propose a unified gradient-based algorithm for training a two-layer neural network in polynomial time. Our method is adaptable to a variety of loss and activation functions, covering a broad class of existing approaches. We show that our algorithm learns a feature representation that strongly aligns with the unknown signal $θ^\star$, with sample complexity $\widetilde{O} (d^{s^\star/2} \lor d)$, matching the SQ lower bound up to a polylogarithmic factor for all generative exponents $s^\star\geq 1$. Furthermore, we extend our approach to the setting where $θ^\star$ is $k$-sparse for $k = o(\sqrt{d})$ by introducing a novel weight perturbation technique that leverages the sparsity structure. We derive a corresponding SQ lower bound of order $\widetildeΩ(k^{s^\star})$, matched by our method up to a polylogarithmic factor. Our framework, especially the weight perturbation technique, is of independent interest, and suggests potential gradient-based solutions to other problems such as sparse tensor PCA.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了神经网络通过梯度训练可以在学习单指标模型时实现计算-统计最优权衡，并在稀疏条件下通过权重扰动达到了最优样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 解决神经网络在学习高斯单指标模型（Gaussian single-index models）时，是否能达到由统计查询（SQ）框架所定义的计算-统计最优权衡这一悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种适用于多种损失函数和激活函数的统一梯度训练算法，对于稀疏模型，引入了利用稀疏结构的新型权重扰动技术。
AI.result: 神经网络算法的样本复杂度达到了 $\widetilde{O} (d^{s^\star/2} \lor d)$，与 SQ 的下界匹配；在 $k$-稀疏设置下，样本复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}(k^{s^\star})$，同样与 SQ 下界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种统一的基于梯度的算法，证明了神经网络在训练单指标模型时能够达到与统计查询（SQ）框架下计算-统计权衡匹配的最优样本复杂度，并在稀疏性设置下提出了创新的权重扰动技术。

title: CoAgent: Concurrency Control for Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
Multi-agent LLM systems -- coding agents, devops agents, document agents -- now routinely run several agents in parallel against the same git tree, Kubernetes cluster, or document. As soon as two of them mutate shared state, they enter the regime classical concurrency control has studied for decades, but classical mechanisms fit LLM agents poorly. A single agent transaction spans minutes of inference, read sets are broad and opaque rather than statically inferable, and the live state agents act on admits neither fork nor buffer, so writes take effect the moment they execute. Locks block long inference intervals; OCC abort-and-retry discards minutes of work on every conflict.
  This paper builds concurrency control on a capability classical transactions lack: the LLM inside each agent can judge whether a conflicting write invalidates its plan, and can repair exactly the operations that depended on it. Control therefore turns advisory: the runtime informs, the agent repairs. Our protocol, MTPO (Monotonic Trajectory Pre-Order), fixes a serialization order at launch, serves each read the order-filtered value, and applies writes speculatively in place; a one-way notification asks an affected reader to re-judge and patch its plan, while the framework mechanically undoes and reorders misplaced writes through the saga-style inverse each tool registers in advance. At quiescence the run is serializable in the pre-decided order. We realize MTPO as CoAgent, toolcall middleware whose privileged ToolSmith grows footprint-declared, undoable tools online. On ten contended workloads, CoAgent stays within 5\% of serial correctness at a $1.4\times$ speedup and near-serial token cost, where 2PL and OCC surrender nearly all concurrency gains; on a bash-only target system, it grows a 25-tool library online and lifts the task pass rate from 45/71 to 63/71 at $0.80\times$ the time and $0.86\times$ the cost.

AI.tldr: 针对多智能体系统并发执行面临的效率和一致性平衡问题，论文提出了 MTPO 协议和 CoAgent 中间件，利用 LLM 的判别能力进行冲突修复，取代了昂贵的重试或永久阻塞，显著提升了并发处理效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的并发控制机制（如 2PL、OCC）不适用于多智能体 LLM 系统，因为智能体事务跨度极长、读集模糊且无法预知、状态难以回滚及缓冲。传统的锁会导致长时间阻塞，而传统的 OCC 冲突导致重试会浪费大量推理成本。
AI.method: 提出一种非阻塞的并发控制协议 MTPO (Monotonic Trajectory Pre-Order)。其核心机制包括：启动时固定序列化顺序、读取过滤、原位投机写入、通过通知驱动智能体进行“判断并修复”的异步冲突处理、以及利用预定义的工具逆操作（saga-style）进行机械化回滚与重排。
AI.result: 在十个高冲突负载下，CoAgent 保持了接近串行正确性（准确率误差在 5% 以内），并实现了 1.4 倍的加速及近乎串行的 Token 消耗。在 bash 系统案例中，任务通过率从 45/71 提升至 63/71，且时间和成本分别降低至 0.80 倍和 0.86 倍。
AI.conclusion: MTPO 协议及其实现 CoAgent 有效解决了多智能体系统在共享状态下的并发冲突问题，实现了接近串行的正确性，同时在计算效率和成本上优于传统的锁机制和乐观并发控制（OCC）。

title: PromptShift-CRC: Drift-Aware Conformal Risk Control for Foundation Models Under Prompt and Domain Shift
summary: Foundation models are now used in settings where the prompts they receive can change quickly. Users change, topics change, policies change, and the model may suddenly face a kind of request that was rare in the calibration data. This makes fixed calibration risky. Conformal prediction and conformal risk control give model-agnostic ways to control error, but they work best when the calibration data still look like the future data. This paper develops PromptShift CRC, a drift-aware conformal risk control method for foundation-model outputs under prompt and domain shift. The method embeds prompts and responses, measures how far the current prompt stream has moved from the calibration pool, gives more weight to relevant or recent calibration examples, and updates the risk level online after observed violations. It reports three practical diagnostics: realized risk error, prompt drift, and effective calibration size. We give conditions under which the method controls risk up to terms for distribution mismatch and weighted quantile uncertainty. In a synthetic prompt-shift benchmark, static conformal risk control fails sharply after drift, while PromptShift-CRC gives the best coverage among the adaptive baselines considered. We then evaluate the same calibration layer on public benchmark derived streams for question answering, toxicity, summarization factuality, and long-context hallucination risk

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 PromptShift CRC，这是一种针对基础模型在提示词和领域发生偏移时进行动态风险控制的方法，通过加权校准和在线更新机制，有效解决了静态校准方法在分布偏移场景下失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在部署后常面临提示词、用户意图及内容分布的快速变化，传统的固定校准方法（Conformal Risk Control）在面临数据分布偏移（Distribution Shift）时失效，导致风险控制能力下降。
AI.method: 提出 PromptShift CRC 方法：1. 对提示词和响应进行嵌入表示；2. 计算当前提示流与校准池的偏移量；3. 根据相关性或时效性对校准集样本进行加权；4. 在观测到违规后动态更新风险水平。引入了三个诊断指标：实现风险误差、提示词偏移和有效校准大小。
AI.result: 在合成提示词偏移基准测试中，静态方法在偏移后失效，而 PromptShift CRC 表现最优。在问答、毒性检测、摘要忠实度及长文本幻觉风险等实际基准流测试中均表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: PromptShift CRC 能够有效适应提示词和领域偏移，在保障模型输出风险控制方面优于静态一致性风险控制方法及其他自适应基线。

title: Steering Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Policies via Action Token Intervention
summary: We present Token Steering (TS), a method for dynamically steering trajectories generated by an autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) model through direct intervention in the action-token space. TS injects low-dimensional user inputs into the model's native action-token representation, allowing users to influence trajectory generation without modifying the underlying vision-language model (VLM) architecture. Because TS operates entirely at inference time, it requires no additional training or finetuning. User inputs guide rather than override the pretrained policy, allowing users to influence robot actions while preserving the dexterity, smoothness, and task priors learned by the VLA. We evaluate TS on two household manipulation tasks -- drawer closing after object placement and state-aware object swapping -- and improve success rates from 10.0% to 72.5% and from 16.7% to 93.8%, respectively. By enabling lightweight, intuitive steering over robot foundation models, our interface has the potential to improve human-robot interaction in consumer environments and broaden accessibility for individuals with limited physical control. Project website: https://jasontchan.github.io/token-steering/ .

AI.tldr: 一种无需微调的推理阶段干预方法，通过将用户意图直接注入动作 token，有效引导机器人执行复杂操作任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的 VLA 模型通常难以平衡“遵循用户指令”与“保持模型习得的任务先验（如灵巧性、平滑度）”之间的关系，且修改模型架构或进行微调成本高昂。
AI.method: 在推理阶段，通过将低维用户输入直接注入到自回归视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的原生动作 token 空间中，实现对策略轨迹的动态引导。
AI.result: 在两个家庭操纵任务（放置后关抽屉、状态感知对象交换）中，任务成功率分别从 10.0% 提升至 72.5% 和从 16.7% 提升至 93.8%。
AI.conclusion: Token Steering (TS) 提供了一种无需重新训练即可在推理阶段引导机器人动作的轻量级方案，有效平衡了用户控制意图与模型预训练先验，在提升复杂任务成功率方面表现出色。

title: A Practical Evaluation Method for Long-Form Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Simultaneous speech-to-speech translation (SimulS2ST) enables real-time cross-lingual communication, but existing evaluation has focused largely on short or pre-segmented speech rather than long-form, continuous input. Prior approaches are difficult to reproduce and make assumptions that do not hold for end-to-end systems. We present a practical evaluation method for long-form SimulS2ST. Given source speech, pre-segmented source transcripts, and reference translations, we run automatic speech recognition (ASR) and forced alignment on the generated target speech to recover token-level timestamps, then apply a sentence-embedding-based aligner to match the target text to its corresponding source sentences. This enables sentence-level computation of latency and quality metrics, including YAAL and xCOMET, which are then aggregated into final system-level scores. Experiments on representative SimulS2ST systems show that the method is effective in practice and reveal that current systems suffer from substantial latency accumulation on long speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对长篇语音同传（SimulS2ST）的实用自动评估方法，解决了传统方法在处理长连续数据时的局限性，并揭示了现有系统在长语音任务中普遍存在严重的延迟累积问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 SimulS2ST 评估主要集中在短对话或预分割语音上，无法客观反映长篇连续输入下的系统性能，且现有评估方法难以复现且对端到端系统存在不切实际的假设。
AI.method: 提出了一种评估长篇 SimulS2ST 的实用方法。流程包括：1. 对生成的翻译目标语音运行自动语音识别 (ASR) 和强制对齐，以恢复词级时间戳；2. 使用基于句子嵌入的对齐器将目标文本与源语句对应；3. 在此基础上计算句子级的延迟（如 YAAL）和质量（如 xCOMET）指标，并汇总为系统级分数。
AI.result: 该方法成功实现了长篇 SimulS2ST 的自动、句子级评估。实验表明，当前的主流 SimulS2ST 系统在面对长语音时，会产生严重的延迟累积现象。
AI.conclusion: 现有的长篇同传系统在处理长语音时存在显著的延迟累积问题。提出的评估方法在实际应用中被证明是有效的，填补了长篇连续语音同传评估的空白。

title: Zero-order Parameter-free Optimization for LMO-based Methods: Novel Approach for Efficient Fine-tuning
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) has become a central application of modern optimization, enabling pretrained models to adapt to diverse downstream tasks and domain-specific data. A major obstacle in large-scale fine-tuning is the memory overhead of backpropagation, which requires storing activations, gradients, and optimizer states. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a memory-efficient alternative, but its performance is highly sensitive to the stepsize and smoothing parameter, often requiring costly task-specific tuning. Parameter-free (PF) optimization addresses this issue by adapting algorithmic parameters without prior knowledge of problem-dependent constants. Moreover, large-scale fine-tuning can benefit from geometry-aware updates that account for the heterogeneous structure of parameter blocks, which can be modeled through methods that exploit linear minimization oracle (LMO). In this work, we study PF adaptation for LMO-based ZO optimization and introduce $\texttt{AdaNAGED}$, a method that unifies gradient-free training, adaptive tuning, and non-Euclidean update geometry. We establish convergence guarantees and validate the method on large-scale LLM fine-tuning task with $\texttt{OPT}-1.3\mathrm{B}$ model.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型微调内存开销大及零阶优化超参数调节难的问题，本文提出了 AdaNAGED，一种结合自适应调节与几何感知更新的内存高效无梯度优化算法。
AI.motivation: 传统大模型微调依赖反向传播，内存开销巨大；现有的零阶（ZO）优化虽省内存，但对超参数（步长、平滑参数）极其敏感且难以调节，且缺乏对模型参数块异构结构的几何感知处理。
AI.method: 提出 AdaNAGED 算法，结合了零阶（ZO）优化、参数自由（PF）自适应步长/平滑参数调节策略，以及基于线性最小化预言机（LMO）的几何感知参数更新机制。
AI.result: 在 OPT-1.3B 模型的大规模微调任务中进行了验证，证明该方法能够实现参数自适应，并在内存受限场景下取得了有效的微调效果。
AI.conclusion: 提出 AdaNAGED，一种结合无梯度优化、自适应参数调节与非欧几里得几何更新的算法，在保持内存高效的同时，有效解决了零阶优化对超参数敏感的问题，并在大规模语言模型微调中验证了其有效性。

title: RL-Index: Reinforcement Learning for Retrieval Index Reasoning
summary: Retrieving external knowledge is essential for solving real-world tasks, yet it remains challenging when the relationship between a query and its relevant knowledge involves implicit and complex reasoning beyond surface-level semantic or lexical matching (e.g., mathematical problems relying on the same theorem or coding requiring deep reasoning). Existing approaches primarily rely on query-side reasoning (e.g., query rewriting), which introduces significant online latency and underutilizes the opportunity to perform reasoning over the knowledge corpus itself (i.e., index-side reasoning). In this paper, we propose RL-Index, an agentic indexing framework that formulates retrieval index reasoning as a reinforcement learning problem. Instead of performing reasoning at query time, RL-Index shifts reasoning to the indexing stage by augmenting documents with LLM-generated rationales that explicitly encode the latent query-knowledge relationship. To optimize the quality of these rationales, we employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use retrieval similarity as a verifiable reward signal, enabling direct optimization of indexing decisions for retrieval effectiveness. Extensive experiments on the BRIGHT benchmark demonstrate that RL-Index consistently improves both retrieval and downstream question-answering performance, while significantly reducing online inference latency. Moreover, the learned rationale augmentation generalizes across diverse retrievers and generators, highlighting its robustness as a plug-and-play indexing strategy across different retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: RL-Index 将推理前置到索引阶段，通过强化学习（GRPO）自动为文档生成关键推理信息，从而提升了复杂任务下的检索精度，并有效消除在线计算瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强生成方法多依赖查询侧的复杂推理（如查询重写），导致高在线延迟且未能充分利用索引侧的推理能力。现有方法难以处理需要深层推理（如数学、编程）而非简单语义匹配的任务。
AI.method: 提出 RL-Index 框架，将检索索引推理建模为强化学习问题。在离线索引阶段，利用 LLM 生成解释性文本（rationales）来增强文档，显式编码潜在的查询-知识关系。利用组相对策略优化（GRPO）算法，以检索相似度作为可验证的奖励信号，对索引决策进行端到端优化。
AI.result: 在 BRIGHT 基准测试中，RL-Index 在检索性能和下游问答效果上均有显著提升，同时大幅降低了在线推理延迟。实验证明该方法具有跨不同检索器和生成器的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RL-Index 证明了将推理过程从在线查询阶段迁移到离线索引阶段的可行性与有效性，通过自动化生成高质量的解释性文本增强索引，实现了性能提升与推理耗时的双重优化。该框架具有良好的通用性，可作为一种插拔式策略应用于各种检索系统。

title: Filtered ANN as a Phase Transition: When Selectivity-Estimation Error Causes Plan Regret
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Code, benchmarks, and full pre-registration:https://github.com/samyama-ai/filtered-ann-regret
summary: A filtered approximate-nearest-neighbor (ANN) query returns the k nearest vectors among those satisfying an attribute predicate P of selectivity s. The best execution strategy -- pre-filter, post-filter, or in-filter -- changes with s, so a system must estimate s and choose. We model this as an argmax over a landscape with phases (regions where each strategy wins) separated by boundaries, and show that selectivity-estimation error produces plan regret -- recall lost versus the oracle strategy -- only in the critical regions around those boundaries. The regret is a wedge of log-width equal to the multiplicative estimation error epsilon and height equal to the local cliff |V'(s*)| epsilon; the flip-margin 1/|V'(s*)| is the condition number of a sibling cardinality-estimation study reappearing as the local boundary theory. The two phase boundaries follow from independent mathematics: order statistics place the post-filter cliff at s ~ k/K, and site percolation places the in-filter cliff at s_c ~ 0.83/M for graph degree M (corpus-size independent). Criticality exists only under a constrained budget B < sqrt(k n). Under pre-registered decision rules we confirm, on synthetic sweeps and real SIFT1M, that regret concentrates ~290x at the boundary and that the regret curves obey a finite-size scaling collapse onto one universal wedge across two decades of corpus size. A real approximate index does not mis-locate the boundary, but a biased cost model opens a persistent miscalibration band that estimation-error robustness cannot fix. The contribution is a characterization, not a new index. Code and the full pre-registration are public.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析了过滤ANN查询中不同执行策略的性能权衡，证明了选择性估计误差带来的性能损失主要集中在极少数“临界边界”区域，并利用物理学标度理论证明了这种性能后悔遵循统一的普适规律。
AI.motivation: 过滤近似最近邻（ANN）查询中，最优执行策略（预过滤、后过滤或内过滤）高度依赖于属性谓词的选择性（selectivity）。由于选择性估计存在误差，导致系统难以做出最优决策，进而产生性能损失（后悔）。本文旨在从理论上量化估计误差对计划后悔的影响，理解为何、何时优化估计至关重要。
AI.method: 本文采用了理论建模与实验验证相结合的方法：将执行策略选择建模为策略景观（landscape）上的argmax问题；利用顺序统计量（order statistics）和逾渗理论（site percolation）分析性能边界；通过实验（synthetic sweeps与SIFT1M数据集）验证了后悔曲线的有限尺度标度坍缩及理论预言的准确性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. 后悔集中发生在策略切换的临界区，其幅度与估计误差和性能曲线斜率（cliff）成比例；2. 识别出了两个关键边界：基于顺序统计量的后过滤边界（s ~ k/K）和基于逾渗理论的内过滤边界（s_c ~ 0.83/M）；3. 在临界区呈现出有限尺度标度坍缩现象，且后悔在该区域被大幅放大（约290倍）；4. 成本模型的准确性比估计误差鲁棒性更为关键。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过刻画过滤ANN查询的性能边界，揭示了选择性估计误差导致的执行计划后悔（regret）主要集中在临界区域（critical regions）。研究表明，在该临界区外无需追求极致的估计精度，且通过有限尺度标度（finite-size scaling）实现了跨不同规模数据的一致性验证。该工作重点在于理论机制的刻画，而非提出新索引。

title: When Proofs Meet Hardware: Comparing NTT and SumCheck in Zero-Knowledge Systems
summary:
In the ZKP community, it has long been discussed that the SumCheck protocol is asymptotically more efficient than the Number Theoretic Transform (NTT), requiring only $O(N)$ arithmetic versus $O(N \log N)$. At the same time, hardware accelerator designers propose that NTT is more hardware-friendly, benefiting from locality and data reuse, while SumCheck suffers from sequential, dependent rounds. Despite these competing intuitions, the hardware-system-level trade-offs between NTT- and SumCheck-based proving primitives remain insufficiently understood.
  Beyond individual accelerator design, this work presents, to our knowledge, the first hardware-system-level direct comparison of NTT- and SumCheck-based proving primitives under a unified architectural framework. We study them in the context of the ZeroCheck protocol, a common building block in zkSNARKs. We implement optimized systems for both primitives. Both are evaluated under the same level on-chip SRAM and off-chip bandwidth budgets. Our results show that there is no universal winner. Generally, SumCheck outperforms NTT for high-degree polynomials. For low-degree polynomials, performance depends on memory availability: under given SRAM budgets, NTT might deliver better performance for medium-sized workloads by exploiting data reuse.
  These findings, bridging cryptographic protocol design and hardware architecture, offer practical guidance for understanding the proving cost of NTT- and SumCheck-based zero-knowledge proof systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次在统一硬件框架下对比了 NTT 与 SumCheck 原语，揭示了两者性能优劣取决于多项式次数与硬件内存资源的权衡，打破了简单的“渐进复杂度即性能”认知，为 ZKP 硬件加速设计提供了实践准则。
AI.motivation: ZKP 社区中一直存在关于 SumCheck (O(N)) 和 NTT (O(N log N)) 渐进复杂度及硬件友好性的争议，缺乏针对硬件系统层面该两类证明原语的实证性对比研究，导致底层设计缺乏明确指导。
AI.method: 在统一的架构框架下进行对比，实现了面向 NTT 和 SumCheck 的优化系统，并在相同片上 SRAM 和片外带宽预算限制下，在零知识证明常用原语 ZeroCheck 的上下文中进行了性能评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，性能胜负取决于工作负载和硬件约束：SumCheck 在处理高次多项式时具有优越性，而 NTT 通过利用数据重用，在受限内存的中等规模任务中可能更有优势。
AI.conclusion: NTT 和 SumCheck 之间不存在通用的“胜者”。性能取决于多项式的次数和硬件架构约束（如 SRAM 容量和带宽）：对于高次多项式，SumCheck 通常更优；对于中等规模的低次多项式，NTT 因其数据重用优势可能表现更好。研究强调了在 zkSNARK 系统设计中需综合考虑算法复杂度和硬件资源分配。

title: Raiders of the Lost Log: Synchronous Parallel In-Place Models and Algorithms
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IPDPS-APDCM workshop
summary: Embedded systems and Internet of Things (IoT) applications motivate in-place parallel algorithms, which avoid allocating additional shared memory past the input. Work by Gu, Obeya, and Shun [APOCS '21] defines a family of PIP (parallel in-place) models and parallel algorithms that eschew auxiliary memory at high processor counts while remaining in-situ when run sequentially. However, their models assume asynchronous processing and have no in-place guarantees for intermediate processor counts. We address this gap in the literature by proposing a Synchronous PIP family of models for in-place parallel and distributed computation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our new model by giving efficient and synchronous parallel algorithms in this model that require no auxiliary shared memory and only constant private memory per processor. Importantly, we show how to leverage a new parallel-augmented sweep technique to ensure that Synchronous PIP algorithms remain efficient and strictly in-place at all processor counts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有并行原地（PIP）算法在异步性和处理器规模扩展上的缺陷，提出了同步PIP模型及并行增强扫描技术，实现了在任意处理器数量下严格的原地、高效并行计算。
AI.motivation: 现有的PIP（并行原地）模型假设异步处理，且在中间数量级的处理器（intermediate processor counts）下无法保证原地计算的特性，这限制了其在嵌入式和物联网（IoT）环境中的应用。
AI.method:
1. 提出了同步PIP（Synchronous PIP）计算模型，适用于并行与分布式计算。
2. 设计了基于该模型的原地并行算法，仅需常数级别的私有内存，且无须辅助共享内存。
3. 引入了“并行增强扫描”（parallel-augmented sweep）技术，确保在任意处理器数量下均能保持严格的原地性。
AI.result: 在同步PIP模型下，实现了无需辅助共享内存且每个处理器仅需常数私有内存的高效同步并行算法；证明了所提出的扫描技术能确保算法在任意处理器数量下的严格原地性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了“同步PIP模型”及其配套的并行增强扫描技术，解决了现有PIP模型在中间处理器数量下无法保证原地计算的不足，为嵌入式和物联网系统中的原地高效并行计算提供了理论框架。

title: Is RISC-V Ready for Massively Parallel Astrophysical Codes?
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the ISC High Performance Conference (2026)
summary: We present a performance and portability evaluation of three well-established astrophysical production codes, namely iPIC3D, PLUTO, and OpenGGCM, on a Sophgo SG2044 RISC-V processor (part of the Monte Cimone cluster), with comparisons to AMD EPYC 9554 (x86) and NVIDIA GH200 Grace (ARM) systems. These applications represent memory-bound, compute-bound, and hybrid workloads, respectively. Numerical correctness is verified across all platforms, confirming portability. RISC-V shows consistently lower performance, with slowdowns of about $3-6\times$ relative to x86 and $5-9\times$ relative to ARM. The gap is mainly due to limited memory bandwidth, shared cache constraints, narrower 128-bit vector units, and lower clock frequency, but also less-mature auto-vectorization capability of the GNU compiler suite. Memory-bound kernels are the most affected, where early bandwidth saturation and L2 cache contention reduce scalability at higher thread counts. Hybrid MPI+OpenMP configurations reveal a trade-off between memory contention and communication overhead, with intermediate configurations achieving the best performance. These results suggest that RISC-V is capable of supporting scientific workloads; however, additional improvements in both hardware and compiler technology, particularly in auto-vectorization, are required to achieve competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 评估了RISC-V处理器在天体物理代码上的性能，结果显示其功能可支撑科学计算，但在性能上与主流x86/ARM架构仍有显著差距，主要瓶颈在于硬件带宽限制及编译器向量化优化不足。
AI.motivation: 评估新兴的RISC-V架构在高性能计算（HPC）生产环境中的性能表现、便携性及实际差距。
AI.method: 选取iPIC3D、PLUTO和OpenGGCM三种代表性天体物理代码，在Sophgo SG2044（RISC-V）上进行基准测试，并与AMD EPYC 9554（x86）及NVIDIA GH200（ARM）进行对比评估。
AI.result: RISC-V相比x86和ARM存在3-9倍的性能差距，受限于内存带宽、窄向量寄存器（128-bit）、较低主频及不成熟的自动向量化编译器；内存密集型任务受影响最严重。
AI.conclusion: RISC-V架构虽已具备科学计算负载的部署能力，但在硬件带宽、向量化支持及编译器优化方面仍有显著差距，需进一步迭代以在高性能计算领域达到竞争水平。

title: Closing the Approximation Gap in Simulation-free Latent SDEs
summary: Recovering dynamical systems from noisy observations is a recurring challenge across scientific domains, including neuroscience and physics. Latent stochastic differential equations (SDEs) address this by modeling the system as an unobserved state that evolves according to a learnable SDE and generates the observations. Variational inference (VI) provides a tractable objective for fitting latent SDEs. Traditional VI algorithms evaluate this objective by numerical simulation over a time discretization, trading fidelity for computational cost. A recent class of algorithms, simulation-free VI, sidesteps this tradeoff by parameterizing the posterior through its instantaneous marginals rather than its drift. In this work, we show that the efficiency of existing simulation-free VI algorithms comes at a price: their parameterizations restrict the approximate posterior to a subset of the SDEs available to simulation-based methods, degrading posterior inference and parameter learning. We propose Helmholtz-SDE, a simulation-free VI algorithm that closes this gap by optimizing over path laws compatible with a prescribed collection of marginals. Helmholtz-SDE recovers dynamics more faithfully than prior simulation-free methods, with the largest gains under high posterior uncertainty. It further matches the performance of simulation-based VI at a fraction of the runtime.

AI.tldr: 针对动态系统推断，本文提出 Helmholtz-SDE 算法，解决了现有无模拟变分推断算法表达能力不足的问题，在保持高计算效率的同时，实现了媲美甚至超越基于仿真方法的推断精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于仿真的变分推断（simulation-based VI）计算成本高昂，而现有的无模拟变分推断方法（simulation-free VI）虽然高效，但因其参数化限制导致对后验分布的近似能力较弱，影响了参数学习效果。
AI.method: 提出 Helmholtz-SDE 算法，通过优化路径律（path laws）而非直接参数化漂移项（drift），在无需数值仿真的前提下，实现了与基于仿真的变分推断相当的性能。
AI.result: Helmholtz-SDE 在恢复动态系统时表现出更高的保真度，特别是在后验不确定性较高的情况下效果显著，同时其运行速度远快于基于仿真的 VI 方法。
AI.conclusion: Helmholtz-SDE 通过在兼容给定边缘分布的路径律空间中进行优化，弥补了现有无模拟（simulation-free）变分推断算法的表达能力缺陷，在显著提升推断精度的同时保持了计算效率。

title: An Autonomous Subgram SMA-Based Swimmer
summary: We present the Swima, a bioinspired 900-mg swimmer propelled by two 10-mg high-work-density (HWD) actuators driven by shape-memory alloy (SMA) wires. We integrated onboard power and computation by using a custom-built printed circuit board (PCB) and an 11-mAh 3.7-V 507-mg single-cell lithium-ion (Li-Ion) battery, which in conjunction enable autonomous swimming in excess of 18 min. The Swima can swim at speeds of up to 22.4 mm/s (0.56 Bl/s), achieves turning rates of up to 14°/s, and can follow 0-degree heading reference trajectories with root mean square (RMS) values of tracking errors of about 6.5° across multiple tests. This robot is the first subgram microswimmer with onboard power, actuation, and computation developed to date.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种重900mg的仿生微型游泳机器人Swima，通过整合SMA驱动器、微型电池和板载计算单元，实现了超过18分钟的亚克级机器人自主水下游动。
AI.motivation: 旨在克服微型水下机器人难以同时集成电源、驱动与计算单元的技术挑战，实现亚克级机器人的平稳自主游动。
AI.method: 采用仿生设计，利用形状记忆合金（SMA）驱动的双高功密度（HWD）致动器推进；通过定制PCB与11mAh锂电池实现自主控制与能源供应。
AI.result: 实现了超过18分钟的自主游动；最高游动速度达22.4 mm/s（0.56 Bl/s）；回转速率最高14°/s；轨迹跟踪RMS误差约为6.5°。
AI.conclusion: Swima是目前首个集成板载能源、驱动与计算功能的亚克级（900mg）微型自主游泳机器人，验证了小型化驱动系统在轻量化自主机器人中的应用潜力。

title: CoCoGEC: Counterfactual Generation for Robust Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Grammatical error correction (GEC) systems are usually trained and evaluated on GEC benchmarks, but their performance often drops sharply once the surrounding context is slightly perturbed or extended. This indicates that the existing GEC models usually fail to understand the error patterns in the varying contexts. In this paper, we thoroughly investigate the counterfactuals for GEC tasks, where the subtle changes to the contexts could lead to the label flipping issue. We propose CoCoGEC, a counterfactual generation framework that creates copies of training instances with error-irrelevant contexts altered. Our framework systematically generates counterfactuals by (1) generating intra- and inter-sentence counterfactuals that maintain the error patterns as well as syntax of the original instances by altering the word-level and sentence-level contexts; (2) revising the generated counterfactuals by selecting the instances with flipped labels and high GEC Mutual Information (MI) coefficient. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves the stability of GEC models, outperforming a set of data augmentation baselines. Particularly, it could achieve absolute F0.5 gains of +9.9, +11.3, and +20.8 points on the perturbed BEA-19*,CoNLL-14*, and TEM-8* data set.Our code is released at https://github.com/Quinnok/CoCoGEC

AI.tldr: 针对语法纠错模型在不同上下文下稳定性差的问题，研究提出了 CoCoGEC 框架，通过生成并筛选高质量的“反事实”训练样本，有效提升了模型应对上下文扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有语法纠错（GEC）模型在上下文发生微小扰动或扩展时性能下降严重，表明模型缺乏对上下文语义的深入理解，即存在“标签翻转”问题。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 CoCoGEC 的反事实生成框架：(1) 通过词级和句级修改生成保持错误模式和句法的反事实样本；(2) 利用标签翻转和高 GEC 互信息系数（MI）准则对所生成的样本进行筛选和修订。
AI.result: 在受扰动的 BEA-19*、CoNLL-14* 和 TEM-8* 数据集上，该方法分别取得了 +9.9、+11.3 和 +20.8 的 F0.5 分数增益，表现优于现有的多种数据增强基线。
AI.conclusion: CoCoGEC 通过引入反事实数据增强，显著提升了语法纠错模型在不同上下文下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: FastMix: Fast Data Mixture Optimization via Gradient Descent
summary: While large and diverse datasets have driven recent advances in large models, identifying the optimal data mixture for pre-training and post-training remains a significant open problem. We address this challenge with FASTMIX, a novel framework that automates data mixture discovery while training only a single proxy model. Instead of relying on predefined heuristics or resource-intensive simulations, FASTMIX jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters, substantially improving efficiency and scalability over prior approaches. At the core of FASTMIX is a reformulation of mixture selection as a bilevel optimization problem. Under this reformulation, we show that optimizing mixture ratios is mathematically equivalent to assigning per-source loss weights under uniform source sampling. This embeds the mixture coefficients directly into the differentiable iterative optimization objective, enabling efficient, gradient-based optimization of both mixture and model. To solve the optimization problem, FASTMIX implements an approximate iterative optimization procedure, alternating between (i) updating model parameters on data sampled according to current mixture ratios (inner loop) and (ii) updating mixture ratios based on validation feedback (outer loop). Across pre- and post-training, FASTMIX outperforms baselines while drastically reducing search cost. Code (https://github.com/hrtan/fastmix)

AI.tldr: FASTMIX 是一种自动化的数据混合发现框架，通过将混合比例优化简化为可微的双层优化问题，在训练单个代理模型的同时实现高效的梯度驱动搜索，显著降低了大模型数据组合优化的成本。
AI.motivation: 在大模型训练中，寻找预训练和后训练阶段的最优数据混合方案（Data Mixture Discovery）仍是一个开放性挑战，传统方法依赖启发式规则或资源密集的模拟，效率和可扩展性不足。
AI.method: 提出 FASTMIX 框架，将数据混合选择建模为双层优化问题：使用近似迭代过程，交替进行内层更新（基于当前混合比例更新模型参数）和外层更新（基于验证集反馈更新混合系数），通过基于梯度的优化实现混合系数与模型参数的协同收敛。
AI.result: 在预训练和后训练任务中，FASTMIX 在性能上优于现有基准方法，并极大降低了数据混合搜索的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: FASTMIX 通过将数据混合优化重构为可微的双层优化问题，证明了混合比例优化在数学上等同于均匀采样下的损失权重分配。该方法实现了在训练单个代理模型的同时高效搜索最优数据混合方案，显著降低了计算成本并提升了性能。

title: Leveraging Code-Mixed Product Metadata and User Feedback for Personalized Recommendation on Daraz Bangladesh
summary: Bangladeshi e-commerce platforms host millions of product reviews written in Bengali Unicode, English, and Banglish, where Bengali is phonetically transcribed in Latin script. However, the impact of code-mixed reviews on recommendation performance remains largely unexplored. We present the first such benchmarking on product reviews from Daraz Bangladesh, evaluating six model families under a per-user chronological leave-last-out protocol. To address the severe long-tail sparsity of the dataset, where 59.3% of users have exactly one interaction, we conduct a systematic k-core threshold ablation across five density configurations. The results reveal that Item-based Collaborative Filtering remains stable across settings, Implicit Matrix Factorization degrades sharply with decreasing density, and Explicit Matrix Factorization uniquely improves at higher thresholds. To characterize the impact of code-mixing on recommendation quality, we perform a language-stratified evaluation of content-based filtering using character n-gram TF-IDF profiles. The results provide empirical evidence that fragmentation of the Banglish vocabulary reduces NDCG@10 by 46.8% relative to Bengali-script users, a degradation traceable to transliteration inconsistency across surface forms. This work establishes a reproducible evaluation foundation for recommendation research in code-mixed, low-resource e-commerce settings. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/os-car-war-thy/daraz-recsys.

AI.tldr: 本文首次针对孟加拉国电商平台的代码混合评论进行了推荐系统基准测试，分析了数据稀疏性与音译不一致（Banglish词汇碎片化）对不同推荐模型的影响，并量化了代码混合造成的准确度损失。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国电商平台评论中广泛存在多语言及代码混合（Banglish）现象，但该现象对推荐系统性能的影响此前尚未得到充分探索，且该领域面临严重的数据长尾稀疏问题。
AI.method: 1. 数据集：使用Daraz Bangladesh真实电商数据集；2. 实验设置：采用用户按时间顺序留一法（leave-last-out）；3. 数据处理：针对长尾稀疏问题进行k-core阈值消融实验；4. 模型评估：对比六类模型，并利用基于字符n-gram TF-IDF的内容过滤模型进行语言分层评估。
AI.result: 1. k-core的影响：基于物品的协同过滤模型表现稳定，隐含矩阵分解随密度降低性能显著下降，显式矩阵分解在高阈值下表现提升；2. 代码混合影响：Banglish词汇的碎片化（因音译不一致造成）使得相关用户的NDCG@10指标较孟加拉语用户下降了46.8%。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了孟加拉国代码混合（Code-mixed）电商环境下的基准测试，揭示了数据稀疏性和词汇碎片化对推荐系统性能的具体负面影响。该研究为低资源语言及代码混合环境下的推荐系统研究提供了复现路径。

title: AIA: A 16nm Multicore SoC for Approximate Inference Acceleration Exploiting Non-normalized Knuth-Yao Sampling and Inter-Core Register Sharing
summary:
Probabilistic graphical models (PMs) are popular to empower machine learning with the ability of reasoning and decision-making. To perform approximate inference in PMs, sampling-based Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms are commonly employed. Unfortunately, MCMC is compute-intensive and hard to run in parallel, resulting in inefficient execution on modern CPU/GPU platforms. This paper proposes 
ame{}, an Approximate Inference Accelerator designed to empower decision-making and reasoning at the edge. 
ame{} consists of a RISC-V host, and a 2D mesh of 16 customized RISC-V cores optimized to efficiently support PM inference, each featuring (i) a novel non-normalized Knuth-Yao sampler and interpolation unit; and (ii) core-to-core direct data access via the register file, which provides solutions for compute-intensive operations.
