To fully exploit the parallel potential of Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms, a customized compiler chain has been developed for effective spatial mapping and scheduling on the chip. 
ame{} can generate 1277 MSample/s at 0.9V and 20 GSamples/s/W at 0.7V which is up to 2$	imes$ faster and 1.45x more energy efficient compared to the previous state-of-the-art Markov Random Field (MRF) accelerator. We further map Bayesian Networks benchmark onto 
ame{} to show the flexibility of our design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向边缘计算的概率图模型推理加速器AIA，通过定制RISC-V架构、专用采样单元及编译器优化，显著提升了MCMC算法的推理速度和能效。
AI.motivation: 概率图模型的近似推理算法（MCMC）计算密集且难以并行化，在传统CPU/GPU上运行效率低下，无法满足边缘设备实时推理的需求。
AI.method: 设计了一款名为AIA的专用加速器：1. 硬件架构：采用RISC-V主机配合16个定制RISC-V核心组成的2D网格架构；2. 关键优化：引入非归一化Knuth-Yao采样器、插值单元及寄存器级核心通信机制；3. 软件支撑：开发了定制编译器以实现空间映射和调度优化。
AI.result: AIA在0.9V电压下可达到1277 MSample/s的采样率，能效比高达20 GSamples/s/W（0.7V电压下），相比现有最先进的MRF加速器，性能提升了2倍，能效提升了1.45倍，并成功支持贝叶斯网络推理。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的AIA架构通过定制处理器核心、专用采样单元及高效通信机制，成功解决了MCMC算法在边缘设备上的计算瓶颈，显著提升了概率图模型推理的性能与能效。

title: Active Learning with Low-Rank Structure for Data Selection
summary:
In the data selection problem, the objective is to choose a small, representative subset of data that can be used to efficiently train a machine learning model. Sener and Savarese [ICLR 2018] showed that, given an embedding representation of the data and suitable geometric assumptions, heuristics based on $k$-center clustering can be used to perform data selection. This perspective was further explored by Axiotis et. al. [ICML 2024], who proposed a data selection approach based on $k$-means clustering and sensitivity sampling. However, these methods rely on the assumption that the dataset exhibits intrinsic geometric structure that can be effectively captured by clustering, whereas many modern datasets instead possess global algebraic structure that is better exploited by low-rank approximation or principal component analysis.
  In this paper, we introduce a new data selection framework based on low-rank approximation and residual-based sampling, formulated through the lens of row subset selection and loss-preserving coreset construction. Given an embedding representation of the data satisfying mild regularity conditions, which can be interpreted as algebraic or angular notions of Lipschitz continuity, we show that it is possible to select a weighted subset of $\tilde{O}\left(k + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ data points whose average loss approximates the average loss over the full dataset within a $(1+\varepsilon)$ relative error, up to an additive $\varepsilon Φ_k$ term, where $Φ_k$ denotes the optimal rank-$k$ approximation cost of the embedding matrix. We complement these theoretical guarantees with empirical evaluations, demonstrating that on a range of real-world datasets, our data selection approach achieves improved performance over prior strategies based on uniform sampling or clustering-based sensitivity sampling.

AI.tldr: 针对具有全局代数结构的数据集，提出了一种基于低秩近似和残差采样的数据选择框架，通过构建加权核集实现了高效的训练数据子集选择，并提供了理论性能保证和实证验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据选择方法主要依赖于数据集的几何聚类假设（如k-center或k-means），但在许多现代数据中，全局代数结构（更适合低秩近似处理）更为重要，现有方法难以有效捕捉。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于低秩近似（Low-rank approximation）和基于残差采样（Residual-based sampling）的数据选择框架，利用行子集选择（Row subset selection）和保留损失的核集（Coreset）构建技术。
AI.result: 理论上证明了可以选取 $\tilde{O}\left(k + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ 个加权数据点，使平均损失与全量数据的相对误差在 $(1+\varepsilon)$ 以内（附加一个关于最优秩 $k$ 近似代价的项）。实证表明该方法优于均匀采样和基于聚类的敏感度采样。
AI.conclusion: 针对假设数据集具有代数结构而非聚类结构的情况，基于低秩近似和残差采样的子集选择方法是有效的。该理论框架提供了关于相对误差和加性项的性能保证，并在实验中证明了其比传统均匀采样和聚类采样策略更优。

title: Quantifying the Impact of Lossy Compression on Neural Generative Surrogate Modeling
summary:
Neural networks are used as generative surrogate models for scientific discovery, which are trainable approximations of scientific simulations. These models enable users to replace time-consuming numerical simulations with learned alternatives, providing quick solutions. However, high-fidelity generative surrogate models require massive training datasets, which can create storage and I/O challenges. Lossy compression is a promising way to reduce this burden, but compression errors may affect the model quality in subtle ways, making it challenging to quantify their impact.
  In this work, we examine how lossy compression of training data impacts the quality of generative surrogate models. We begin by characterizing the uncertainty inherent in training neural networks, showing that identical training configurations can produce different models. By exploiting this variability, we propose a method to estimate how much compression-induced error a surrogate model can tolerate without affecting its accuracy. Evaluation of two application simulations demonstrates that our approach significantly reduces memory/storage requirements and speeds up training while producing high-quality surrogate models. These results show that lossy compression saves data storage up to 23.7x and 39x with negligible impact on the quality of the surrogate model. Meanwhile, reducing the size of the training data set also enhances the data loading speed and reduces the training time by up to 3x.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有损压缩对生成式代理模型训练数据的影响，通过利用训练过程的不确定性量化了模型对压缩误差的容忍度，在保持模型高精度的同时显著提升了存储效率和训练速度。
AI.motivation: 生成式代理模型在大规模科学发现计算中能替代耗时的数值模拟，但其高保真要求带来了海量训练数据的存储与I/O瓶颈。尽管有损压缩可缓解该问题，但其产生的量化误差对模型最终质量的具体影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 1. 刻画训练神经网络时固有的随机不确定性（即相同配置下可能产生不同模型）；2. 利用该不确定性，提出一种量化评估方法，以测定代理模型在不损失精度的前提下所能容忍的压缩误差阈值；3. 在两个科学模拟场景中进行实证评估。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法可实现最高23.7倍和39倍的数据压缩比，对模型质量的影响可忽略不计；同时由于数据集规模减小，数据加载速度与训练速度显著提升（最高达3倍）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在训练数据上使用有损压缩可以在不显著影响生成式代理模型质量的前提下，极大地降低存储需求（最高达39倍）并加速训练过程（最高达3倍）。通过量化模型对压缩误差的容忍度，有损压缩是构建高效科学代理模型的可行方案。

title: Generative Modeling on Metric Graphs via Neural Optimal Transport
summary: We introduce, to our knowledge, the first deep generative modeling framework for probability distributions continuously supported on compact metric graphs. Given source and target measures on a metric graph, our method embeds the graph into a smooth ambient space, solves an entropic Kantorovich problem via a neural semidual parameterization, and projects generated samples back onto the original graph. We study two embedded geometries: an extrinsic Euclidean realization and the intrinsic tropical Abel--Jacobi embedding into the Jacobian torus. In both cases, the resulting generator is graph-supported by construction. We prove that, in the joint limit of increasing neural expressivity, the learned generator converges weakly to a valid transport coupling between the original graph measures. Empirically, across a range of geometrically distinct graphs, our method matches or improves upon heuristic transport baselines based on discrete graph OT, while scaling more favorably. Finally, we demonstrate scalability on real-world urban mobility data by training our model on one million Uber pickup locations in Manhattan, New York City.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对度量图的深度生成建模框架，通过空间嵌入与神经半对偶求解最优传输问题，实现了紧致度量图上概率分布的高效生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成建模和最优传输方法通常基于欧几里得空间或离散图结构，无法直接在紧致度量图（compact metric graphs）这一具有连续结构的空间上进行概率分布建模。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于度量图结构的深度生成式建模框架：1. 将图嵌入到平滑空间（欧几里得空间或热带阿贝尔-雅可比环面）；2. 通过神经半对偶参数化求解熵正则化 Kantorovich 问题；3. 将生成的样本投影回原图以保证支撑性。
AI.result: 在多种几何结构的图上，该方法的效果优于现有的离散图最优传输启发式基线，且具备更强的可扩展性，能够处理百万量级的地理位置数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在紧致度量图上实现了有效的概率分布生成与最优传输，在理论上证明了其收敛性，并在实际大规模城市交通数据（如曼哈顿Uber数据）中验证了其可扩展性与优越性能。

title: Exact, Efficient, and Safe Occlusion-Aware Planning Using AH-Polyhedrons
summary: Safely handling occlusions is a fundamental challenge for autonomous mobile robots operating in dynamic environments. This issue is especially prominent in autonomous valet parking (AVP), where traffic rules are lax, occlusions are frequent and cluttered, and overly conservative behavior can leave vehicles stuck. However, existing methods either lack formal safety guarantees, assume agents follow road structures, or introduce conservatism, leaving occlusion-aware planning for AVP an open challenge. In this paper, we propose APRO (AH-Polyhedron Reachability for Occlusions), an exact and efficient occlusion-aware planning framework based on game-theoretic active perception and AH-polyhedron reachability analysis with AVP as our canonical use case. Our key insight is to reformulate set-based safety conditions in prior work as unions of AH-polyhedrons, enabling exact safety verification through linear programming (LP) without any additional conservatism in set computations or assumptions on road topology. We further show how the resulting safety conditions can be integrated into optimization-based planners or a bisection search scheme for real-time applications. We validate our method in simulation and hardware experiments, including data replay on a real-world parking lot dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently achieved a 100% safety rate across all evaluated scenarios while maintaining real-time performance, resulting in safer and more optimal decisions than existing methods with formal safety guarantees.

AI.tldr: 针对自动代客泊车（AVP）中遮挡处理的难题，提出了 APRO 框架。该方法利用 AH-polyhedron 可达性分析实现精确、非保守的安全验证，确保机器人在复杂遮挡环境下既安全又高效。
AI.motivation: 现有 AVP 遮挡处理方法通常缺乏形式化安全保证、依赖道路结构假设或存在过度保守导致车辆无法通行的问题。
AI.method: 提出了 APRO (AH-Polyhedron Reachability for Occlusions) 框架，利用博弈论主动感知和 AH-polyhedron 可达性分析，将基于集合的安全条件重构为 AH-polyhedron 的并集，通过线性规划 (LP) 进行精确的安全验证。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实停车场数据集实验中，APRO 保持了 100% 的安全率，同时满足实时计算需求，性能优于现有的具有形式化安全保证的方法。
AI.conclusion: APRO 框架通过 AH-polyhedron 可达性分析实现了自动代客泊车（AVP）中遮挡场景下的实时、安全且无保守性的决策规划，实验验证了其 100% 的安全性与高效性。

title: Stop When Further Reasoning Won't Help: Attention-State Adaptive Generation in Reasoning Models
summary: By incorporating test-time compute scaling, large reasoning models (LRMs) can solve complex problems through explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning processes. However, they often suffer from overthinking, resulting in redundant token outputs and degraded accuracy. Current methods to mitigate this issue remain limited: training-based approaches require substantial computational resources, while training-free methods rely on well-crafted prompts or unreliable confidence signals. In this work, we investigate early stopping from the perspective of attention distributions and propose a simple method, ASAG, which infers the model's reasoning state and adaptively adjusts the generation strategy. The proposed framework is training-free and plug-and-play, enabling seamless integration into existing LRMs. Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across mainstream LRMs with varying parameter scales, including the DeepSeek-R1-Distill and Qwen3 series. Specifically, ASAG improves average accuracy by 3.2% while reducing the number of generated tokens by nearly 40% across all reasoning tasks on Qwen3-8B.

AI.tldr: 针对大型推理模型（LRM）存在的“过度思考”和资源浪费问题，本文提出了 ASAG 方法。该方法利用注意力分布动态优化生成过程，无需额外训练即可在显著降低算力消耗的同时，提升模型的推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在引入推理时计算扩展后，常出现“过度思考”（overthinking）现象，导致产生冗余标记（tokens）且可能降低准确率。现有的训练方法成本高昂，而现有的免训练方法又缺乏可靠性。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 ASAG（Attention-based State-Aware Generation）的方法，从注意力分布的角度推断推理状态，并在推理过程中自适应地调整生成策略及执行提前停止（early stopping）。
AI.result: 在九个基准测试中验证了 ASAG 的有效性。在该方法应用下，Qwen3-8B 模型在所有推理任务中的平均准确率提升了 3.2%，同时减少了近 40% 的生成标记数量。
AI.conclusion: ASAG 提供了一种高效的训练无关（training-free）且即插即用的推理优化方案，通过感知注意力分布动态调节推理过程，有效缓解了大型推理模型（LRM）的“过度思考”问题，在提升精度的同时显著降低了推理成本。

title: Rational Sparse Autoencoder
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are standard tools for mechanistic interpretability, but current SAE families are constrained by fixed encoder nonlinearities such as ReLU, JumpReLU, and TopK. This hard-codes a particular sparsity mechanism into the model and can distort the reconstruction-versus-sparsity trade-off. We introduce the Rational Sparse Autoencoder (RSAE), which replaces the fixed encoder activation with a trainable rational function. Rational activations are flexible enough to uniformly approximate the activation primitives used by existing SAE families on compact domains (for TopK, the thresholded gate obtained after a separating top-k threshold is supplied), while also providing a richer function class for adapting to the observed pre-activation geometry. We realise this idea through a two-stage pipeline: an initialisation procedure that copies the pre-trained baseline SAE weights, plugs in rational coefficients obtained by the relaxed Remez exchange on synthetic data, and calibrates the scale parameters along with the rational coefficients; followed by a fine-tuning step under the standard sparsity-regularised reconstruction objective. Empirically, on residual-stream activations of three open-weight language models and across all three baseline activation families, the RSAE strictly improves on it after the fine-tuning step, both on reconstruction-side metrics and on downstream-behaviour metrics, without sacrificing feature-level interpretability under sparse probing. These gains are consistent across host language models, across baseline activation families, and across the full range of baseline sparsity we tested, while the upgrade itself adds only a handful of scalar parameters per autoencoder and runs in minutes on a single consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: RSAE 通过引入可学习的有理激活函数取代了传统 SAE 中固定的非线性激活，突破了现有架构对稀疏性机制的硬限制，在保持可解释性的前提下，显著提升了重建质量和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）的编码器激活函数（如 ReLU、TopK 等）通常是固定的，这硬编码了特定的稀疏性机制，限制了模型捕捉预激活几何结构的能力，导致重建与稀疏性之间的权衡不佳。
AI.method: 引入“有理稀疏自编码器”（RSAE），采用两阶段流程：首先通过改进的 Remez 交换算法初始化有理激活函数的系数（迁移现有 SAE 的预训练权重并校准），随后在标准的稀疏正则化重建目标下进行微调。
AI.result: 在三种开源语言模型的残差流激活上验证，RSAE 在所有 baseline 激活函数家族和稀疏度水平下，均在重建指标和下游行为指标上实现了超越。此外，该方法额外参数极少，训练开销仅需数分钟。
AI.conclusion: RSAE 提供了一种通用的、性能更强的稀疏自编码器架构。通过将固定的非线性激活函数（ReLU, JumpReLU, TopK）替换为可学习的有理函数，RSAE 能够更好地适应激活分布，在改善重建质量和下游任务性能的同时，保留了良好的可解释性，并保持了极高的计算效率。

title: PIANO: Personalized Reranking via Information Aggregation Node for Music Search Optimization
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026. 18 pages, 4 figures
summary: Unlike short-video content, music tracks have long lifecycles and lasting value. Effective music search re-ranking must therefore align the user's current query with long-term preferences while jointly optimizing Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate (CVR). However, existing methods suffer from two limitations: (1) sequential methods rely on item-interaction history and therefore cannot use historical search queries to tell which past preferences match the user's current search intent; (2) most listwise models optimize a single objective (e.g., CTR only), and conventional multi-objective methods balance click and conversion at the item level, ignoring how these trade-offs play out across the whole ranked list. To address these limitations, we propose PIANO, a personalized listwise re-ranking framework with two key components: (i) the Query-Driven Interest Refiner (QDIR) uses cross-attention over historical queries to align past intents with the current one; (ii) the Information Aggregation Node (IAN), a learnable [CLS]-style token, aggregates the candidate list and predicts CTR/CVR at the list level. Extensive experiments on public and industrial datasets show consistent gains over strong baselines. In online A/B tests on NetEase Cloud Music, a leading music streaming platform, PIANO achieves statistically significant improvements in CTR (+0.62%) and CVR (+4.45%).

AI.tldr: 针对音乐长生命周期与复杂搜索意图，提出的 PIANO 框架通过“查询驱动的兴趣提取”与“列表级信息聚合节点”，实现了搜索重排序中 CTR 与 CVR 的全局协同优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的音乐搜索重排序方法存在两大痛点：一是仅依赖点击历史而忽视历史搜索意图的引导；二是传统方法多关注单目标或物品级多目标均衡，缺乏对整个列表的全局优化视角。
AI.method: 提出了名为 PIANO 的个性化列表重排序框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Query-Driven Interest Refiner (QDIR)：利用交叉注意力机制挖掘历史查询意图与当前查询的相关性；(2) Information Aggregation Node (IAN)：引入类 [CLS] token，实现候选列表层面的联合 CTR/CVR 预测与全局优化。
AI.result: 在公开及工业数据集上优于强基准模型；在网易云音乐的在线 A/B 测试中，CTR 提升 0.62%，CVR 提升 4.45%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入 PIANO 框架，在个性化重排序中有效融合了历史查询意图与列表级多目标协同优化，在生产环境中显著提升了音乐平台的 CTR 和 CVR。

title: Embedded Arena: Iterative Optimization via Hardware Feedback
summary: Embedded devices from wildlife monitoring stations to clinical wearables require local AI inference due to latency, communication, or privacy constraints. Optimizing models for heterogeneous microcontrollers (MCUs) requires simultaneously satisfying hard physical constraints on memory, power, and temperature while preserving accuracy, a multidimensional optimization that is today performed manually by experts. We ask whether an LLM agent can autonomously navigate this complex, multi-turn pipeline guided by real hardware feedback, and introduce a hardware-in-the-loop agent arena in which the agent iteratively refines both model and firmware -- compiling, flashing, and measuring on real hardware -- to enable closed-loop optimization. Frontier models, including Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, fail entirely without hardware feedback (0% deployment success), whereas our hardware-in-the-loop formulation achieves the first successful deployment within three iterations and can surpass human expert results within seven. This agentic co-optimization achieves 250x compression for vision models with <3.3% accuracy loss and 400x for audio with <6% Feature Error Rate loss, enabling battery-free operation on a commercial MCU via solar harvesting. We demonstrate practical impact in two real-world systems: an elk-detection camera trap (96.7% accuracy) and a phonetic-transcription wearable (8.44% FER) for child development research.

AI.tldr: 针对嵌入式设备受限的资源约束，本文提出一种基于硬件反馈的LLM代理优化框架，通过闭环迭代实现了远超人类专家效率的自动模型压缩与部署方案。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式设备（如野生动物监测、临床可穿戴设备）对边缘AI推理有严格的内存、功率和热限制，目前的人工手动优化过程效率低下且复杂，亟需自动化方案。
AI.method: 提出一个“硬件在环”的代理竞技场（Hardware-in-the-loop agent arena），让大语言模型（LLM）通过闭环反馈机制（编译、刷写、测量）自主迭代优化模型和固件。
AI.result: LLM代理在获得硬件反馈后，首次实现了成功的嵌入式部署；实现了视觉模型250倍压缩（精度损失<3.3%）和音频模型400倍压缩（FER损失<6%）；在 elk-detection 和语音转录系统中表现优异，均满足实际场景需求。
AI.conclusion: 硬件在环（Hardware-in-the-loop）的智能体代理能够自主、高效地完成嵌入式AI模型的优化任务，性能甚至超过人类专家，且能有效满足复杂硬件约束下的部署需求。

title: PreLort: Prefix-Nested LoRA for Federated Fine-Tuning under Rank Heterogeneity
summary: Federated fine-tuning of large language models using parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA enables privacy-preserving adaptation of foundation models. Heterogeneous hardware resources introduce challenges, as clients with different adapter ranks cannot be directly aggregated. While existing methods enable aggregation under heterogeneous ranks, they fail to control how information is distributed across rank dimensions, leading to suboptimal use of shared low-rank representations. Instead, we propose PreLort: a nested low-rank formulation for federated LoRA that organizes adapter dimensions into a prefix hierarchy. Our approach ensures that lower-rank dimensions encode task-relevant information, while higher-rank dimensions capture additional capacity. Building on this, we introduce (i) a segment-wise aggregation rule that averages only over clients contributing to each rank segment, avoiding dilution from zero-padded lower-rank clients, and (ii) a prefix-nested training strategy that optimizes each adapter under multiple rank truncations, encouraging useful signal to concentrate in low-rank prefix dimensions. Together, these components encourage a consistent low-rank prefix capturing the most task-relevant information, while higher-rank dimensions learn additional capacity. This allows low-rank clients to benefit from richer information contributed by higher-rank clients, as prefix dimensions are consistently learned and aggregated. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior heterogeneous federated LoRA methods in accuracy and ROUGE-L, while achieving lower or comparable perplexity across multiple base models.

AI.tldr: PreLort 是一种用于联邦 LoRA 微调的新型嵌套低秩框架，通过构建层级化的维度依赖并改进聚合与训练策略，使异构秩客户端能共享更一致且高效的任务表示。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦 LoRA 异构秩聚合方法无法有效控制信息在秩维度上的分布，导致低秩空间的表达效率低下，难以充分利用不同客户端的共享表示。
AI.method: 提出了 PreLort：1. 嵌套低秩结构：将适配器维度组织成前缀层次结构；2. 分段聚合规则：针对不同秩的贡献进行加权平均，避免低秩客户端受到零填充的干扰；3. 前缀嵌套训练策略：训练过程中对适配器进行多重秩截断，加强低秩前缀的信息集中度。
AI.result: 实验证明，PreLort 在多项任务（准确率、ROUGE-L、困惑度）上均优于现有的异构联邦 LoRA 方法。
AI.conclusion: PreLort 通过嵌套的低秩前缀结构和分段聚合策略，有效解决了联邦学习中 LoRA 异构秩的聚合难题，实现了更优的知识共享与任务适配性能。

title: Diffusion Flow Matching: Dimension-Improved KL Bounds and Wasserstein Guarantees
summary: Diffusion Flow Matching (DFM) has recently emerged as a versatile framework for generative modeling, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain only partially understood. In this work, we provide refined and novel convergence guarantees for Brownian motion based DFMs, focusing on the discretization error. Our analysis is conducted under the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and the 2-Wasserstein distance. Under finite-moment conditions and a mild score integrability assumption, we derive KL convergence bounds with improved dimensional dependence compared to prior work, achieving, up to our knowledge, state-of-the-art scaling under minimal conditions. We further extend the analysis to the 2-Wasserstein distance: under an additional first-order score integrability assumption and a weak log-concavity condition, we obtain convergence guarantees with dimensional dependence consistent with the KL case.

AI.tldr: 本文对布朗运动驱动的扩散流匹配模型（DFM）进行了深入的收敛性分析，在KL散度和2-Wasserstein距离下给出了目前最优的离散化误差维度缩放界。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散流匹配（DFM）在生成式模型中应用广泛，但其收敛特性的理论支持尚不充分，尤其是量化离散化误差及其维度依赖性的研究亟需完善。
AI.method: 采用理论分析方法，在KL散度和2-Wasserstein距离度量标准下，对布朗运动驱动的扩散流匹配（DFM）进行离散化误差分析；利用有限矩条件、得分函数可积性假设，以及在Wasserstein距离分析中引入弱对数凹性假设进行推导。
AI.result: 在KL散度下实现了优于现有研究的最佳维度依赖性边界（SOTA scaling）；在2-Wasserstein距离下，在增加一阶得分可积性和弱对数凹性假设后，获得了与KL情形一致的维度依赖保证。
AI.conclusion: 研究填补了布朗运动扩散流匹配（DFM）在收敛性分析上的空白，证明了在有限矩和轻微约束条件下，KL散度和2-Wasserstein距离下的收敛界具有优越的维度依赖性（Scaling），为DFM算法的理论基础提供了重要的性能保证。

title: Design and Fabrication of a Spin Coater with In-Situ Optical Measurement for Soft Thin Films
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. To be published in the conference proceedings for AIM 2026
summary: Spin coating is widely used for fabrication of thin polymer and elastomer films, yet reliable thickness verification of highly compliant materials remains challenging due to deformation from contact-based measurements and the cost and complexity of conventional optical metrology. Accurate thickness control is especially critical in soft elastomer applications such as dielectric elastomer actuators (DEAs), where mechanical and functional performance scales strongly with film thickness. This work presents a low-cost, primarily 3D-printed benchtop spin coater with an integrated, minimally deforming optical thickness measurement system for soft-film fabrication workflows. The system is designed to manufacture films between 50 and 300 microns thick with repeatability within 10 microns. Thickness is measured in-situ by tracking displacement of a reflected laser beam via quadrant photodetector, avoiding significant deformation. Optical geometry, sensor linearity constraints, and structural validation via finite element analysis are discussed. Experimental validation using calibrated metal shims demonstrated a thickness resolution of 3.6-3.7 microns and best-case measurement repeatability of 13 microns (95 percent confidence interval). The platform repeatably produced silicone films within 9 microns of target thickness, demonstrating that accessible optical metrology can be integrated into a low-cost spin coating system for practical, thickness-controlled fabrication of compliant thin films without specialized industrial instrumentation.

AI.tldr: 针对柔性薄膜厚度测量困难且工业设备昂贵的问题，本文设计了一种低成本、集成光学测量传感器的3D打印旋涂机，实现了软薄膜制造过程中高精度、无变形的在位厚度监控。
AI.motivation: 柔性材料（如介电弹性体驱动器）性能高度依赖薄膜厚度，但现有测量方法在面对极低刚度薄膜时常因接触式测量发生形变，且传统光学测量成本高昂、复杂度高。现有缺乏一种低成本且具备在位精确测量功能的柔性薄膜制造方案。
AI.method: 开发了一种包含自制3D打印旋涂机和基于四象限光电探测器（QPD）的集成反射激光位移测量系统。通过有限元分析（FEA）验证结构，并使用标准金属垫片进行实验标定与分辨率测试。
AI.result: 样机实现了50-300微米范围内的薄膜涂覆，制造重复性在9微米以内；在位测量系统的厚度分辨率达到3.6-3.7微米，重复性（95%置信区间）约为13微米。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功验证了低成本集成光学薄膜厚度测量系统的旋涂机，证明了无需昂贵的工业仪器即可实现对软弹性体薄膜厚度的精确控制和制造，为相关功能材料的研发提供了低成本、高可靠性的解决方案。

title: Ling and Ring 2.6 Technical Report: Efficient and Instant Agentic Intelligence at Trillion-Parameter Scale
summary: Efficient and scalable agentic intelligence requires models that can deliver both low-latency responses and strong reasoning capabilities while remaining practical to train, serve, and deploy. In this report, we present Ling-2.6 and Ring-2.6, a family of models designed to address this challenge at scale. Ling-2.6 is optimized for instant response generation and high capability per output token, whereas Ring-2.6 is tailored for deeper reasoning and more advanced agentic workflows. Instead of training from scratch, we upgrade the Ling-2.0 base model through architectural migration pre-training and large-scale post-training. This upgrade is guided by a unified co-design of model architecture, optimization objectives, serving systems, and agent training environments, enabling improvements in both model capability and deployment efficiency. At the architectural level, we introduce a hybrid linear attention design that integrates Lightning Attention with MLA, improving the efficiency of long-context training and decoding. To further enhance token efficiency, we optimize capability per output token through Evolutionary Chain-of-Thought, Linguistic Unit Policy Optimization, bidirectional preference alignment, and shortest-correct-response distillation. For agentic capabilities, we propose KPop, a reinforcement learning framework designed to support stable training of Ring-2.6-1T on large-scale environment-grounded data. KPop improves training efficiency through asynchronous scheduling across coding, search, tool use, and workflow execution, enabling scalable learning from complex agent-environment interactions. Together, Ling-2.6 and Ring-2.6 provide a practical pathway toward efficient, scalable, and open agentic systems. We open-source all checkpoints in the 2.6 family to support further research and development in practical agentic intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该报告介绍了Ling-2.6和Ring-2.6模型系列，通过混合架构创新、Token高效训练策略以及KPop强化学习框架，在平衡智能体模型推理能力与部署成本方面取得了显著进展。
AI.motivation: 为了在保持低延迟响应的同时，实现强大的推理能力，并解决智能体模型在训练、服务和部署层面的实用性与可扩展性挑战。
AI.method: 1. 架构升级：采用混合线性注意力设计（Lightning Attention + MLA），提升长文本处理效率；2. 效率优化：通过演化思维链（Evolutionary CoT）、语言单元策略优化、双向偏好对齐及最短正确回复蒸馏，提升单位输出Token的效能；3. 智能体训练：提出KPop（一种支持大规模环境交互数据的强化学习框架），集成异步调度机制，优化代码、搜索、工具使用及工作流执行的训练效率。
AI.result: 成功开发了Ling-2.6（瞬时响应与高输出效率）和Ring-2.6（深度推理与高级智能体工作流）模型系列，并通过模型及系统的协同优化，显著提升了模型能力与部署效率。
AI.conclusion: Ling-2.6和Ring-2.6提供了一条实现高效、可扩展且开源的智能体系统的实用路径，通过模型架构与工程系统的协同设计，平衡了推理能力与部署效率。

title: Unlocking Latent Dimensions: Exploring Representations of Large-Scale X-ray Scattering Data using Variational Autoencoders
summary: Scientific user facilities generate X-ray scattering data faster than traditional workflows can process them. We address this challenge across two settings, offline dataset exploration and live on-the-fly analysis. We train a domain-specific attention-based Convolutional Variational Autoencoder (C-VAE) on 1.5 million X-ray scattering images to learn low-dimensional representations capturing structural variation across diverse experimental conditions. The learned latent space reveals well-organized clusters and smooth trajectories reflecting experimental progression. It further supports controlled synthetic scattering image generation across diverse structural states. When deployed without retraining, the model organizes time-resolved film formation experiments at two synchrotron facilities into interpretable latent structures. Benchmarking against DINOv3 (ViT-7B), a general-purpose vision foundation model, demonstrates that domain-specific training yields more interpretable latent organization for scattering data. Both workflows are integrated within Latent Space Explorer, a component of the MLExchange platform, supporting interactive structural exploration across archived datasets and live experiments.

AI.tldr: 针对X射线散射数据处理瓶颈，本文提出了一种基于C-VAE的领域专用深度学习框架，显著提升了针对科研实验数据的表征能力与处理效率，优于通用视觉大模型，并已集成至可交互的分析平台。
AI.motivation: 科学用户设施产生X射线散射数据的速度已超过传统处理工作流的负荷，亟需高效处理离线数据探索和实时分析任务的解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 使用150万张X射线散射图像训练领域专用注意力机制卷积变分自编码器（C-VAE）；2. 构建Latent Space Explorer平台，实现离线数据集探索与实时在线分析；3. 与DINOv3（ViT-7B）通用模型进行零样本（zero-shot）对比评估。
AI.result: 1. 模型成功学习到捕捉结构变化的低维表示，潜在空间具有良好的聚类和轨迹特征；2. 支持高质量的合成数据生成；3. 在未重训练情况下，能直接对同步辐射设施的薄膜形成实验进行解析；4. 实验证明专门针对散射数据训练的模型在解释性上超过通用视觉大模型。
AI.conclusion: 针对X射线散射数据，领域专用的C-VAE模型在可解释性、潜在空间组织能力上优于通用的视觉基础模型（如DINOv3），并可通过Latent Space Explorer有效支撑科研设施的离线分析与实时实验监控需求。

title: SCAR: Semantic Continuity-Aware Retrieval for Efficient Context Expansion in RAG
summary: Fixed-length chunking in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) often leads to boundary fragmentation, where critical evidence is split across segments, degrading retrieval recall. While static windowing and parent retrieval improve recall, they introduce significant token overhead. We propose SCAR (Semantic Continuity-Aware Retrieval), an adaptive retrieval policy that selectively expands neighboring chunks by weighing query-neighbor relevance against a structural continuity penalty. SCAR uses a relative expansion threshold tied to each retrieved chunk's own query-relevance, yielding an approximately scale-invariant decision rule that transfers across embedding models without recalibration. Across four diverse corpora (RFC, GDPR, a 10-K report, and a Merger agreement; N=320 queries; 160 boundary-fragmented), SCAR achieves 92.8% recall on boundary-fragmented queries with only 7.84 chunks, a 22.9% reduction compared to static windowing (10.16 chunks). Paired bootstrap tests (B=10,000) confirm the chunk reduction is highly significant (p<0.0001, Cohen's d=-1.49, large effect), with a small recall difference (Cohen's d=-0.33). The policy transfers across three embedding models (text-embedding-3-large, BGE-large-en-v1.5, zembed-1) using the same single hyperparameter setting, and downstream RAGAS evaluation on the 10-K corpus confirms SCAR preserves generation faithfulness while reducing context tokens by 27.1%.

AI.tldr: SCAR 是一种自适应 RAG 检索策略，通过智能选择邻域分段来缓解边界碎片化问题，在大幅降低 token 成本的同时显著提升了信息召回精度。
AI.motivation: 固定长度分段在 RAG 中会导致边界碎片化（导致关键信息被切割），而现有的静态窗口或父级检索方法又会引入过高的 token 开销。
AI.method: 提出 SCAR（语义连续性感知检索），它根据查询-邻域相关性和结构连续性惩罚，自适应地扩展检索到的分段（chunks），并引入了一个与模型无关的相对扩展阈值作为决策规则。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验结果表明，SCAR 在边界碎片化查询中达到了 92.8% 的召回率，且分段数量较静态窗口减少了 22.9%，同时在下游 RAGAS 评估中证明了在减少 27.1% token 的情况下保持了生成忠实度。
AI.conclusion: SCAR 是一种高效的自适应检索策略，通过平衡检索相关性与结构连续性惩罚，在显著减少 token 消耗的同时保持了高召回率，且具有良好的跨模型泛化能力。

title: NeuronFabric: A Software Reference Architecture for On-Chip Transformer Training with Local Adam
summary: Publicly documented accelerator architectures generally separate training computation from optimizer-state updates or rely on external memory and host orchestration. This paper presents NeuronFabric, a software reference architecture intended for future FPGA and ASIC implementations of transformer training with local Adam updates. A complete C# prototype implements forward pass, backpropagation, and Adam optimization without external machine-learning frameworks. The goal is to validate numerical correctness and memory requirements before hardware implementation. The evaluated model is a 334K-parameter autoregressive transformer (d=88, H=4, f=264, L=4, vocab=256) trained on the Shakespeare corpus. The BF16W configuration achieves evaluation loss 1.5426 after 80K samples, compared with 1.5224 for an FP32 GPU reference, while producing coherent character-level text. The paper introduces BF16W, which stores weights in BF16 while retaining Adam optimizer moments in FP32. This reduces memory requirements for on-chip training. A 334K-parameter FP32 model with Adam moments requires approximately 4.0 MB, matching the BRAM capacity of a Xilinx ZCU102 device. The BF16W variant requires approximately 3.34 MB, leaving memory available for activation storage. We describe the vocabulary-budget constraint observed during earlier experiments, quantify BF16W memory savings, and outline FPGA training as the next stage of development. No FPGA measurements are included in this paper. This publication serves as a public architectural disclosure and software reference implementation for future FPGA and ASIC exploration of the NeuronFabric architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 NeuronFabric 架构，通过 BF16W 量化策略优化内存，实现了在无需外部框架的情况下完成 Transformer 的本地 Adam 训练，为后续 FPGA/ASIC 实现提供了验证和参考。
AI.motivation: 受限于现有加速器架构往往将训练计算与优化器更新分离，或依赖外部主机/内存，本文旨在为未来的 FPGA/ASIC 设计一套能够进行“本地 Adam 更新”的 Transformer 训练架构，以减少外部交互并优化片上内存使用。
AI.method:
1. 开发了名为 NeuronFabric 的软件参考架构，无需外部机器学习框架。
2. 提出 BF16W 数据精度策略：权重使用 BF16，Adam 优化器动量保留为 FP32。
3. 使用 C# 构建原型，在 334K 参数的 Transformer 模型上，基于莎士比亚语料库进行训练验证。
AI.result: 在 80K 样本训练后，BF16W 配置下的模型损失达到 1.5426（FP32 GPU 基准为 1.5224），生成文本具有连贯性；BF16W 内存占用（约 3.34 MB）相较于全 FP32 实现（约 4.0 MB）有效节省了空间，适配了 Xilinx ZCU102 的 BRAM 容量。
AI.conclusion: NeuronFabric 提供了一种针对 Transformer 模型本地 Adam 优化的软件参考架构。通过引入 BF16W（BF16 权重 + FP32 动量）策略，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低了片上内存需求，验证了在资源受限设备（如 FPGA）上实现完整本地训练的可行性。

title: Attention is Just Another Name for Coupling?: A Fast-Slow ODE Perspective on Hierarchical Pretraining
summary:
Causal self-attention is a coupling mechanism: each token's hidden state is updated by a learned mixture of preceding tokens at the same timescale. This paper asks whether a second, temporally slower coupling-a slow sub-system operating on a temporally-downsampled view of the sequence and fed back into the fast path through a zero-initialised gate-complements it. The question is framed in the language of singularly perturbed ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where the fast variable $x$ evolves at the token rate, the slow variable $y$ evolves at one update per $P$ tokens, and the timescale ratio $\varepsilon = 1/P$ is enforced structurally by causal block-mean pooling.
  The paper instantiates the fast-slow ODE formalism as a concrete neural network: a fast path of standard causal attention over $T$ tokens, a slow path of full attention over $T/P$ pooled tokens ($P^2 \times$ cheaper per layer), and a zero-initialised additive gate. In addition, under a linear-generator assumption on the fast dynamics, we prove that the equilibrium manifold $x = φ(y)$ is exactly the master-equation (ME) stationary distribution $p_{\mathrm{st}}(y)$; in that regime a learned MLP $φ_θ(y)$ is a variational approximation of it (the trained block is not a generator, so this identity is the structured limit, not a claim about the network as trained). Empirically, at $500$k tokens the coupling is neutral -- the gate stays closed and the coupled and frozen ablations are within run-to-run noise -- at a wall-clock cost comparable to a dense baseline. The contribution is the precise, gap-marked mapping itself, not a performance gain.

AI.tldr: 论文引入了基于奇异摄动ODE架构的处理序列快慢动态的Transformer扩展，通过降采样慢路径与零初始化门控实现跨尺度信息交互。虽然从数学上成功映射了动力学系统，但实证表明其在当前算力规模下，耦合带来的收益尚不显著。
AI.motivation: 探讨在传统的快路径（token级因果自注意力）之外，增加一个运行在时序降采样视图下的慢路径子系统，是否能从动力学角度改善或补充Transformer模型的序列建模能力。
AI.method: 提出了基于奇异摄动常微分方程（ODE）的快慢子系统形式化框架：快变量 $x$ 以序列token速率演化（标准因果注意力），慢变量 $y$ 以 $1/P$ 的速率通过因果块平均池化进行演化。通过零初始化门控机制将慢路径反馈至快路径。同时，在线性生成器假设下从理论上证明了其平衡流形与主方程（ME）平稳分布的关系。
AI.result: 在 $P^2$ 倍计算效率提升的前提下，提供了快慢路径耦合的精确数学映射。实证结果显示，该结构在当前规模下并未表现出性能优势，验证了该方案在特定尺度下的中性化。
AI.conclusion: 在50万token的实验规模下，该慢速路径耦合机制表现为中性（即门控保持关闭，且模型表现与冻结慢速路径的消融实验无异）。该论文的核心贡献在于提出了基于奇异摄动ODE理论的快慢系统统一建模框架，而非性能层面的提升。

title: DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects
summary: Dexterous interaction with articulated objects is important for household, assistive, and humanoid manipulation, where multi-finger hands can provide compliant contact patterns beyond parallel-jaw grasping. However, articulated-object manipulation differs from static-object manipulation: the target part cannot be directly actuated, and its motion must emerge through sustained physical hand--handle contact. This makes the transition from object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction non-trivial, since geometric trajectory replay or open-loop execution does not model the contact dynamics required to move the articulated part. Moreover, policies trained only for task completion under fixed dynamics can overfit nominal contact loads, especially without tactile or force feedback, and may degrade when the contact load changes. To address these challenges, we present DragMesh-2, a contact-driven framework for dexterous interaction with articulated objects that extends articulated interaction from object-centric generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction, where articulated motion must arise through physical contact. We further propose PICA, a physically informed contact-aware training mechanism that injects physical signals into policy learning without tactile or force feedback, improving robustness and task success under changing contact loads. Finally, we conduct systematic evaluation across multiple damping conditions and articulated-object categories to study robustness under contact-load variation, and provide a pure-geometry dexterous interaction resource to support future loco-manipulation and humanoid hand--object interaction research. Across seven GAPartNet objects, DragMesh-2 achieves stronger robustness under contact-load variation than the compared methods while maintaining high task success across damping conditions.

AI.tldr: 为了解决灵巧手操作铰接物体时接触动力学建模困难及对负载变化鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出了DragMesh-2框架及PICA训练机制，实现了无需触觉反馈的鲁棒性操作。
AI.motivation: 传统铰接物体操作因物体目标部件无法直接驱动且依赖持续的手-物体接触，导致简单的轨迹回放或开环执行效果不佳，且现有策略易过拟合固定接触负载，在负载变化时鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出DragMesh-2框架，将铰接物体交互从物体中心生成扩展为手部驱动的操作；引入PICA（物理启发式接触感知训练机制），在无触觉或力反馈的情况下将物理信号融入策略学习。
AI.result: 在GAPartNet数据集的七种物体上进行了测试，结果表明该方法在多种阻尼条件下保持高任务成功率，且在接触负载变化时的鲁棒性显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: DragMesh-2在处理具有不同阻尼和接触负载的铰接物体时，展现出比对比方法更强的鲁棒性和更高的任务成功率，为灵巧手操作研究提供了新的基准和框架。

title: AdaMame: A Training Recipe for Adaptive Multilingual Reasoning
summary: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) show strong performance in English, they often fail to reason in the language of the query, a phenomenon known as language collapse. Existing RL-based fixes typically add a binary language fidelity reward to the accuracy objective, yet still incur trade-off in accuracy, mid-trace code-switching, and excessive token usage. In this work, we propose AdaMame, a two-stage training recipe for multilingual mathematical reasoning that addresses these limitations by adaptively aligning the reasoning language to the query language without compromising accuracy. The first SFT stage fine-tunes on naturally occurring reasoning traces across five languages to establish multilingual reasoning capability. In the subsequent RL stage, we introduce AdaMame-GRPO, an adaptation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in which a query-conditioned alignment factor grows progressively during training, guiding the model to first explore diverse reasoning languages before exploiting reasoning in the query language. Evaluated across two benchmarks, two LRMs, and 12 languages, AdaMame-GRPO achieves Pareto-optimal performance across reasoning accuracy, language fidelity, and token efficiency over all baselines, with the strongest gains on out-of-domain, lower-resource languages.

AI.tldr: AdaMame是一种针对多语言数学推理的两阶段训练方法，通过动态对齐机制，解决了大型推理模型在多语言任务中的语言坍缩问题，实现了推理准确性与语言保真度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有大型推理模型（LRM）存在“语言坍缩”现象，即在非英语任务中推理能力下降；现有RL方法通过添加二元语言奖励会导致准确率下降、中途代码切换和令牌浪费。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段训练方案：1. SFT阶段：使用多语言推理轨迹数据进行监督微调，建立多语言推理能力；2. RL阶段：引入AdaMame-GRPO，通过随训练过程动态增长的“查询条件对齐因子”，引导模型先进行多语言探索，后针对性地利用查询语言进行推理。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试、两个模型及12种语言上进行了评估。结果显示，该方法在保持高推理精度的同时，在语言保真度和令牌效率方面均优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: AdaMame-GRPO实现了推理准确性、语言保真度和令牌效率之间的帕累托最优，有效地解决了大型推理模型在多语言任务中的“语言坍缩”问题，尤其是在资源匮乏语言上表现优异。

title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
summary:
World models have rapidly become one of the central abstractions in modern AI. Yet the term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. The result is not only metric diversity but also a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers frequently make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can actually establish.
  This paper surveys the recent literature and argues that the central question is use-dependent. When a model is presented as a world model for embodied decision-making, a more decisive issue is not whether it generates visually compelling videos, but whether it supports reliable counterfactual reasoning, policy evaluation, planning, and policy optimization under intervention, policy-induced distribution shift, and long-horizon rollout. We organize the literature using an L0--L7 ladder that ranges from visual plausibility to policy optimization utility. In our interpretation, L0--L3 are most naturally read as diagnostics of generated artifacts, L4 is often the first genuinely interventional test, and L5--L7 provide the most direct evidence of decision usefulness. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a decision-making-centric evaluation framework and a benchmark protocol that foreground counterfactual action fidelity, closed-loop rollout validity, reward/value prediction, policy-ranking agreement, optimization lift, model exploitability, and uncertainty calibration.

AI.tldr: 针对AI世界模型定义与评估标准混乱的问题，本文提出了一套基于L0-L7层级的决策导向评估框架，旨在将评估重点从视觉生成效果转移至具身智能中的反事实推理与策略优化效用。
AI.motivation: 当前AI领域中“世界模型”定义模糊且泛化，导致研究者在评估模型性能时，往往基于视觉效果（如视频真实感）做出超越其实际决策功能的强论断（即“声明与证据不匹配”），缺乏针对具身智能决策能力的系统性评估标准。
AI.method: 1. 文献综述：系统梳理了现有世界模型在定义与评估维度上的碎片化现状；2. 分层架构：提出了L0-L7的层级评估梯队（从视觉合理性到策略优化效用）；3. 评估基准：构建了一套决策导向的评估框架，涵盖反事实动作保真度、闭环轨迹有效性、策略排名一致性及模型可利用性等关键指标。
AI.result: 明确了现有世界模型评估的偏差，建立了一个以决策效用为中心的层级评估方法，有效缓解了评估标准不一致及指标与实际用途脱节的问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有文献在世界模型评估上存在“声明与证据不匹配”的问题。研究提出，评估的核心应从单纯的视觉生成质量转向决策导向的效用评估，并通过提出的L0-L7等级框架和基准协议，确立了衡量世界模型对具身决策支持能力的科学标准。

title: Harmonizing Semantic and Collaborative in LLMs: Reasoning-based Embedding Generator for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Sequential Recommender Systems (SRS) predict the next item of interest based on users' interaction histories and have been widely deployed, but hindered by long-tail problem. Large Language Models (LLMs), with strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising way to enrich item semantics and have recently been used as embedding generators. However, two fundamental gaps remain. First, current LLM-based embedding methods fail to exploit the model's inner reasoning capacity. Second, existing methods often inject collaborative signals implicitly via supervised fine-tuning, lacking explicit guidance for collaborative embedding alignment. In this paper, we introduce ReaEmb, a novel framework that resolves both issues via a Latent Reasoning-enhanced Contrastive Learning (LRCL) stage and a Collaborative Reward Reinforcement Learning (CRRL) stage. LRCL exploits the LLMs' inner reasoning capacity through a two-pass forward process with an additional attention module. CRRL subsequently explicitly injects collaborative signals into the LLM via a tailored reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate superior effectiveness of ReaEmb across multiple SRS models. To ease reproducibility, we release the code online.

AI.tldr: ReaEmb 是一种结合了潜在推理增强对比学习和协作奖励强化学习的框架，旨在通过深度挖掘 LLM 推理能力并显式注入协同信号，解决序列推荐中的长尾问题和语义表征不足。
AI.motivation: 克服现有 LLM-基于序列推荐模型中对 LLM 内在推理能力开发不足，以及协同信号注入缺乏显式指导（长尾问题）的局限。
AI.method: 提出了 ReaEmb 框架，包含两个核心阶段：1. 潜在推理增强对比学习 (LRCL)：通过两阶段前向过程及额外注意力模块挖掘 LLM 的内在推理能力；2. 协作奖励强化学习 (CRRL)：通过定制的强化学习策略显式向 LLM 注入协作信号。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，ReaEmb 在多种 SRS 模型中均表现出优越的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ReaEmb 框架通过融合潜在推理增强对比学习和协作奖励强化学习，有效解决了 LLM 在序列推荐中语义深度利用不足及协作信号注入缺失的问题，显著提升了 SRS 的推荐性能。

title: Towards Delta Aware Training: Efficient DNN Weight Storage for Resource-Constrained FPGAs
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, ITEM Workshop '26 at ECML-PKDD 2026 (submitted)
summary: The deployment of embedded deep neural networks on resource-constrained field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) is challenging due to limited memory and computational capacities. We introduce a new compression technique to reduce the memory footprint by saving weights in deltas with lower bitwidth and training the network to cope with compressed deltas. Two delta schemes are investigated: consecutive deltas and deltas with a fixed-reference value. We evaluate both on the FashionMNIST data set with a multi-layer-perceptron. The results indicate that fixed-reference delta compression outperforms the consecutive variant, achieving a validation accuracy of approximately 78.6 %, with 4 bit weight deltas, representing an accuracy loss of roughly 8.3 % compared to a fixed-point network with 8 bit. Our specialized hardware accelerator with a delta-compressed multiply-and-accumulate operator compresses weights by nearly 50 % and achieves a maximum throughput of 7.992M MACs/s on an AMD Spartan-7 S15 FPGA.

AI.tldr: 本文针对FPGA资源受限问题，提出一种权重增量压缩技术及配套加速器，在牺牲少量精度的情况下实现了近50%的权重压缩与高效推理。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式FPGA资源（内存和计算能力）受限，难以直接部署大规模深度神经网络。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的权重增量（delta）压缩技术，包含两种方案：连续增量法和固定参考增量法；并设计配套的增量压缩乘累加（MAC）硬件加速器。
AI.result: 固定参考增量压缩表现优于连续增量法；在4位增量下，模型在FashionMNIST上达到约78.6%的验证准确率（较8位定点数下降8.3%）；硬件加速器实现约50%的权重压缩率，最高吞吐量达7.992M MACs/s。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用基于固定参考值的权重增量压缩技术，在资源受限的FPGA上实现模型压缩是可行的，能够有效平衡内存占用与推理性能。

title: SwiftCache: Efficient LLM Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with Heterogeneous KV Cache Sharing
summary:
Multi-turn conversation is a fundamental scenario in LLM applications, widely used in chatbots and AI agents. As the conversation evolves, historical tokens accumulate continuously. Existing systems cache their key-value (KV) pairs to avoid redundant computation. However, limited GPU memory (HBM) capacity often forces these KV caches to be offloaded to CPU memory or SSD, making KV cache reloads increasingly costly in terms of latency as the context grows. Meanwhile, the constrained HBM capacity also limits the maximum inference length, thereby restricting the number of turns that can be supported in a conversation.
  To address these two challenges, we propose SwiftCache, a collaborative inference system that enables heterogeneous models to share underutilized GPU memory and NVLink bandwidth within a server. Specifically, models with low KV cache demand donate idle GPU memory to store the prefix cache of high-demand models, allowing cross-model KV cache sharing over NVLink and avoiding slow PCIe transfers. SwiftCache further reduces memory pressure by keeping only the KV cache of the currently active layer in local GPU memory, thereby enabling longer-context inference. Our experiments on real-world workloads show that SwiftCache reduces P99 time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 69% and extends maximum context length by up to 3.98x compared to vLLM and SGLang, with minimal interference to co-located models.

AI.tldr: SwiftCache 提出了一种基于 NVLink 的多模型显存协作机制，通过模型间共享显存和精细化的层级缓存管理，突破了单模型显存容量限制，显著降低了多轮对话的推理延迟并大幅提升了上下文长度。
AI.motivation: LLM 多轮对话中 KV Cache 的持续累积导致 GPU 显存（HBM）耗尽，不得不将缓存卸载至 CPU/SSD，引发严重的延迟问题，并限制了最大对话长度。
AI.method: 提出了一种协作式推理框架，利用异构模型间的 NVLink 带宽共享 GPU 显存：1. 让轻量级模型出让多余显存以存储高需求模型的 Prefix Cache；2. 采用仅在当前激活层缓存 KV 的策略，降低显存占用并支持更长的上下文推理。
AI.result: 在真实工作负载测试中，SwiftCache 较 vLLM 和 SGLang 将 P99 首字延迟（TTFT）降低了高达 69%，并将支持的最大上下文长度提升了 3.98 倍，同时对同机运行的其他模型干扰极小。
AI.conclusion: SwiftCache 是一种高效的协作式推理系统，通过异构模型间的显存共享和层级化缓存管理，有效解决了多轮对话中 KV Cache 内存瓶颈和延迟过高的问题，实现了性能与上下文长度的双重提升。

title: A nonparametric two-sample test using a parametric integral probability metric
comment: 45 pages. Accepted for publication in Statistical Analysis and Data Mining
summary: Detecting distributional differences between two independent samples is a fundamental problem in statistics and machine learning. Nonparametric two-sample testing provides a principled framework for determining whether two samples are drawn from the same underlying distribution, without assuming any specific parametric form for the distribution. In this study, we propose a new two-sample test statistic based on a newly introduced integral probability metric (IPM), using a specially designed parametric discriminator class with a single node of a neural network. We show that the resulting test statistic, called PReLU-IPM, is nonparametric and establish theoretical guarantees for the associated two-sample testing procedure, PReLU-TST, including its consistency and asymptotical equivalence to nonparametric IPM-based tests under regularity conditions. By analyzing multiple simulated and real benchmark datasets, we demonstrate that PReLU-TST achieves higher power across a range of alternatives or performs comparably to its competitors, for finite samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单节点神经网络（PReLU）的新型非参数两样本检验方法 PReLU-TST，通过引入新的 IPM 提高了在多种分布差异场景下的检验功效。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统非参数两样本检验在处理复杂分布差异时功效不足或计算复杂度过高的问题，寻找一种既能保持非参数特性又能提高检验效能的新框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于 PReLU（参数化修正线性单元）作为判别器的积分概率度量（IPM）方法，构建了 PReLU-IPM 统计量并设计了相应的 PReLU-TST 检验流程。
AI.result: 理论上证明了 PReLU-TST 的一致性及其与现有 IPM 类检验的渐近等价性；实验表明该方法在合成数据和真实基准数据集上具有更强的统计功效或相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: PReLU-TST 是一种具有更高统计功效的非参数两样本检验方法，在有限样本下表现出色，且具备理论上的渐近一致性。

title: MimicIK: Real-Time Generative Inverse Kinematics from Teleoperation with FK Consistency
summary: Inverse kinematics (IK) remains a critical bottleneck for real-time robot manipulation. Classical numerical solvers achieve high geometric precision but often suffer from discontinuous branch switching and unstable behavior near kinematic singularities during closed-loop deployment. Meanwhile, learned IK approaches frequently struggle to balance spatial accuracy, motion smoothness, and real-time efficiency, particularly when trained on noisy human teleoperation data. We present \textbf{MimicIK}, a real-time generative inverse kinematics framework that learns smooth and robust joint-space motion priors from teleoperation demonstrations through conditional flow matching. Given the current joint configuration and a target end-effector pose, MimicIK predicts continuous delta-joint commands using an efficient two-step iterative refinement process based on a Minimal Iterative Policy (MIP) backbone. To enforce physical consistency, we further introduce an FK consistency loss, a differentiable forward-kinematics regularization that penalizes task-space deviations from the target pose during training. We evaluate MimicIK on a real-world 6-DOF robot dataset containing 8,848 teleoperation demonstrations. MimicIK achieves a mean position error of 4.65 mm, a 10 mm success rate of 92.01\%, and a trajectory spike rate of only 7.99\%. Compared with a UNet diffusion baseline, our method improves both spatial accuracy and motion smoothness while reducing inference latency from 21.66 ms to 6.74 ms. Furthermore, unlike deterministic MLP baselines that catastrophically diverge under out-of-distribution deployment, MimicIK remains stable near singular configurations and enables robust 20 Hz real-time control on deployment hardware.

AI.tldr: MimicIK是一种基于条件流匹配的实时生成式逆运动学框架，通过MIP迭代细化和FK约束，在提升复杂任务空间精度与运动平滑度的同时，显著降低了推理时延并增强了奇异点处的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解决当前机器人实时操作中传统数值求解器在奇异点处不稳定，以及学习类IK方法在空间精度、运动平滑度、实时性及处理人类带噪声遥操作数据时的平衡难题。
AI.method: 提出MimicIK框架：基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）学习关节空间运动先验，采用基于Minimal Iterative Policy (MIP)的迭代细化策略，并引入可微分前向运动学（FK）一致性损失函数进行训练约束。
AI.result: 在6自由度机器人数据集上有效，平均位置误差4.65mm，10mm成功率92.01%，轨迹抖动率仅7.99%；推理延迟降至6.74ms（相比UNet Diffusion快3倍），且在奇异配置下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: MimicIK通过条件流匹配学习鲁棒的关节空间先验，在保持几何精度的同时，显著提升了IK求解的实时性、平滑性和处理奇异点的稳定性，优于现有的扩散模型和确定性MLP baseline。

title: When Cognitive Graphs Meet LLMs: BDEI Cognitive Pathways for Panic Emotional Arousal Prediction
summary: Predicting individual panic emotional arousal timing before manifestation is essential for proactive emergency intervention. Existing methods incorporate cognitive elements but none explicitly model the emotional arousal process, making them ill-suited for emotional arousal timing prediction. We argue that grounding prediction in appraisal emotion theory is necessary because it explicitly models this process, but three problems must be solved. (1) Appraisal theory posits that emotion arises from simultaneous evaluation across multiple threat dimensions, yet no prior work fuses these inputs into risk perception. (2) Existing cognitive models lack an Emotion node, decoupling threat appraisal from emotional arousal and forcing emotions to be inferred indirectly from behaviors. (3) Given their generalizable cognitive reasoning, current approaches adopt LLMs as the primary decision-maker, yet overlook the fragility and hallucination-proneness of their outputs. To address these issues, we introduce PanicCognitivePath (PCP), a framework that addresses all three. A Psychological Safety Distance (PSD) model, grounded in psychological distance theory, maps four-domain signals into a unified risk metric as the entry condition for subsequent cognitive reasoning. An explicit Emotion node grounded in appraisal emotion theory is introduced into BDI, forming a Belief-Desire-Emotion-Intention (BDEI) pathway. Agents whose risk metric exceeds the PSD threshold enter this pathway, coupling threat appraisal directly to emotional arousal. The BDEI pathway governs all state transitions while the LLM is confined to parameter estimation for the Belief-to-Desire transition, confining hallucinations to a single step and preventing error propagation. Experiments on Hurricane Sandy show PCP improves arousal timing accuracy by 10.68% over baselines, reduces peak count error to 7.07%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于评估情绪理论的 PanicCognitivePath (PCP) 框架，通过引入 BDEI 路径和 PSD 模型，在解决认知模型与情绪唤起解耦问题的同时，有效控制了 LLM 的幻觉风险，显著提升了恐慌情绪唤起时机的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有预测方法缺乏对情绪唤起过程的显式建模，难以精准预测恐慌发生的时机；此外，现有认知模型未能有效整合多维度威胁评估，且过分依赖易产生幻觉的 LLM 进行决策。
AI.method: 提出 PCP (PanicCognitivePath) 框架：1) 利用心理安全距离 (PSD) 模型将多维度信号统一为风险指标；2) 将评估情绪理论引入 BDI 模型，构建 BDEI（信念-愿望-情绪-意图）路径，实现风险评估与情绪唤起的直接耦合；3) 限制 LLM 仅用于参数估计环节，以控制幻觉并防止错误传播。
AI.result: 在飓风桑迪 (Hurricane Sandy) 数据集上的实验结果表明，PCP 在恐慌唤起时机预测的准确率上提升了 10.68%，峰值计数误差降低至 7.07%。
AI.conclusion: PCP 通过将认知模型与评估情绪理论相结合，实现了对个体恐慌情绪唤起时机的精准预测，并在飓风桑迪数据集上证明了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Transformers Learn the Mestre-Nagao Heuristic
summary: We train a two-layer transformer encoder to classify rational elliptic curves $E/\mathbb{Q}$ of conductor $\leq 10000$ as either rank 0 or rank 1 from the first 128 normalized Frobenius traces. We achieve >99% accuracy on both classes, and accuracy is essentially unchanged on test curves with no isogeny or quadratic-twist relative in the training set. We then apply techniques from mechanistic interpretability such as attention analysis, linear probing, activation patching, logit attribution, and neuron-level circuit analysis to reverse-engineer the algorithm the (centroid in function space) model learned. We find that a sparse circuit of 20 out of 512 layer-1 MLP neurons is sufficient for rank prediction under a linear probe with an AUROC of 0.992 at plateau, implementing a push-pull detector architecture of rank-0 and rank-1 detectors with a one-sided readout. However, we notice that the model has sub-optimal readout problems indicating a mismatch in rank-order between the readout pathway and the discriminative circuit. Critically, the learned input weights of the top discriminating neuron match the Mestre-Nagao sum heuristic weights $\log(p)/(p\cdot \log{B})$ with a Spearman coefficient $r = 0.997$ and Pearson coefficient $r = 0.952$: the model has learnt a result from analytic number theory from the Frobenius trace data alone. We additionally find that all 50 independently trained models concentrate CLS attention on prime positions at 2-50$\times$ the rate of composite positions. The CLS embedding encodes $\log{L(E,1)}$ with $R^2 = 0.962\pm 0.011$ across the 50 models (after controlling for the conductor). Activation patching analysis reveals that attention weights are dissociated from causal information flow. Additionally, the 50 solutions from training are near-identical in function space (with pairwise agreement $>$98.8%) despite large weight space barriers.

AI.tldr: 研究人员利用 Transformer 在数论问题上取得了突破，证明模型能仅从数据中自发通过学习相关性发现数论中的 Mestre-Nagao 和公式，并揭示了其内部由稀疏电路驱动的预测机制。
AI.motivation: 探究 Transformer 模型能否仅通过 Frobenius 迹这类数学数据习得高等数学（数论）中的解析结论，并探索模型内部处理这类任务的“算法”机制。
AI.method: 训练双层 Transformer Encoder 模型；利用机械可解释性技术（注意力分析、线性探测、激活修补、Logit 归因、神经元水平电路分析）进行机制反向工程；分析注意力模式及激活路径。
AI.result: 模型在检测椭圆曲线秩（Rank 0/1）上实现超过 99% 的精度；模型习得了一个精简的稀疏电路（20 个神经元），核心权重与 Mestre-Nagao 和启发式权重高度相关（Spearman r=0.997）；模型展现了功能性收敛特性（尽管权重不同，但功能极其相似）。
AI.conclusion: 模型通过分析 Frobenius 迹，成功自动习得了数论中经典的 Mestre-Nagao 和公式，证明了 transformer 不仅能学习数据分布，还能在数学领域发现本质的解析特征，即便训练出的权重空间存在差异，模型在功能空间上具有高度一致性。

title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
summary:
Multi-task learning (MTL) is essential in recommender systems to enable complementary learning among diverse user feedback. While modern industrial practices have shifted from DNNs to Transformer-centric architectures to strengthen sequence modeling and scaling capacity, they still decouple feature encoding from multi-task prediction, treating the Transformer as a task-agnostic encoder. This design fundamentally limits the performance and scalability by (1) creating an information bottleneck under heterogeneous task objectives, (2) inducing gradient interference that leads to the seesaw phenomenon, and (3) forcing a dataflow transition in which attention-based, context-adaptive representation learning is converted to static feed-forward task prediction with incompatible information read-write dynamics.
  We propose OneRank, a Transformer-native multi-task ranking framework that eliminates encoder-predictor separation and introduces task-private channels for forward representation learning and backward optimization, enabling task-specialized learning while reducing inter-task interference. In the forward pass, OneRank learns task-specific representations bottom-up through task-conditioned information selection, candidate-aware contextualization, and controlled cross-task interaction. In the backward pass, cross-task gradient detachment isolates task-private parameter updates from shared knowledge extraction modules, preventing negative transfer. We further replace static task-specific MLP scorers with dynamic matching-based scoring for context-aware personalized ranking. By internalizing multi-task reasoning within the Transformer stack, OneRank establishes a unified and scalable architectural paradigm. Offline and online experiments on large-scale industrial datasets show that OneRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: OneRank 是一种 Transformer 原生的多任务排序框架，通过在模型内部集成任务私有通道并实现梯度分离，解决了现有解耦架构中的信息瓶颈、梯度干扰及动态不兼容等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的推荐系统架构中，Transformer 常被作为与任务无关的编码器使用，这种“编码器-预测器”解耦设计存在以下局限：1. 在异构任务目标下存在信息瓶颈；2. 导致梯度干扰（产生“跷跷板”现象）；3. 不同范式（注意力机制与前馈网络）之间存在信息读写动态的不兼容。
AI.method: 提出了一种 Transformer 原生的多任务排序框架 OneRank：1. 引入任务私有通道（Task-private channels），在 Transformer 内部进行前向表征学习和后向优化；2. 前向层使用任务条件信息选择、候选感知上下文化和受控交叉任务交互；3. 后向层采用交叉任务梯度分离（Cross-task gradient detachment），隔离任务私有参数更新；4. 将传统的静态 MLP 评分器替换为动态匹配式评分器。
AI.result: 在离线和大规模工业在线实验中，OneRank 表现出色，能够有效缓解负迁移，显著提升了推荐系统的多任务排序效果，并保持了计算效率。
AI.conclusion: OneRank 通过将多任务推理内置于 Transformer 架构中，消除了编码器与预测器之间的脱节，实现了一种统一且可扩展的架构范式。在工业级数据集上的实验证明其显著优于现有的 SOTA 方法，且保持了高计算效率。

title: TreeGRNG: Binary Tree Gaussian Random Number Generator for Efficient Probabilistic AI Hardware
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, Proceeded by the 2024 Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference (DATE)
summary: Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) offer opportunities for greatly enhancing the trustworthiness of conventional neural networks by monitoring the uncertainties in decision-making. A significant drawback for BNN inference at the extreme edge, however, is the imperative need to incorporate Gaussian Random Number Generators (GRNG) within each neuron. State-of-the-art GRNG algorithms heavily depend on multiple arithmetic operations and the use of extensive look-up tables, posing significant implementation challenges for ultra-low power hardware implementations. To overcome this, this paper presents an innovative binary tree random number generator (TreeGRNG) allowing the use of ultra-low-cost constant comparators instead of arithmetic units. We further enhance the TreeGRNG proposal with a set of hardware-aware optimizations exploiting the Gaussian properties. The optimized TreeGRNG surpasses the State-of-the-Art (SoTA) in terms of distribution accuracy while achieving a 3.7$\times$ reduction in energy per sample and boosting the throughput per unit area by 5.8$\times$. Moreover, our TreeGRNG proposal possesses a distinct advantage over the current SoTA in terms of flexibility, as it easily enables designers to adjust the shape of the sampled probability distribution, extending beyond the capabilities of traditional GRNGs, opening the horizon towards future probabilistic AI designs. The TreeGRNG design is available open-source in the link

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 TreeGRNG 的高效二叉树随机数生成器，通过硬件优化极大降低了 BNN 推理的能耗与面积成本，并提高了生成分布的灵活性。
AI.motivation: 现有的贝叶斯神经网络（BNNs）在边缘设备推理时，因需要在每个神经元中集成高斯随机数生成器（GRNG）而面临挑战；传统 GRNG 算法依赖繁重的算术运算和查找表，难以满足超低功耗硬件的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于二叉树的随机数生成器（TreeGRNG），利用常量比较器取代了传统的算术单元和查找表；并结合了基于高斯特性的硬件感知优化技术。
AI.result: 与当前最先进技术（SoTA）相比，优化后的 TreeGRNG 在分布准确度上有所提升，同时实现了 3.7 倍的单样本能耗降低和 5.8 倍的单位面积吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种创新的 TreeGRNG 架构，通过使用低成本常量比较器替代算术单元，实现了极低功耗的贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）硬件推理，同时提供了更高的灵活性以支持多种概率分布。

title: Efficient Data Availability Sampling via Coded Distributed Arrays
comment: Full Paper, IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency (IEEE ICBC 2026)
summary: Data availability is a fundamental bottleneck in modern blockchain networks. Most blockchain systems rely on a full-replication model, which requires downloading of a full block to verify its availability. This model does not scale with block size because every node must handle large volumes of data, leading to slower block propagation, duplicated data transfer, and longer consensus agreement. This issue is well-known in Ethereum, where layer-2 rollups publish data directly into the chain. To overcome, Ethereum adopts Data Availability Sampling (DAS) to let nodes keep only a small fragment of the data while still ensuring availability. Prior work on DAS has focused on cryptographic foundations. Meanwhile, the peer-to-peer network layer that provides Byzantine-tolerant and scalable mechanisms for discovery and routing of DAS fragments is underexplored. We propose CDA, a new design for DAS based on coded distributed arrays that leverages network coding to ensure both robustness and efficiency. Our evaluation study compares CDA to RDA, the latest DAS development of Ethereum, showing an improvement of several times better.

AI.tldr: 面对区块链数据可用性带来的扩展性瓶颈，本文提出了基于网络编码的 CDA 方案，在 P2P 网络层优化了数据采样与路由，显著提升了数据可用性采样的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的区块链全备份模式存在扩展性瓶颈，随着区块增大，网络带宽和节点压力剧增；现有的 DAS 方案在 P2P 网络层的协同机制（抗拜占庭、可扩展性）研究不足。
AI.method: 提出了 CDA（基于编码分布式数组的设计），利用网络编码（Network Coding）来实现 DAS 中数据分片的发现与路由。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，CDA 在性能上优于以太坊当前的 DAS 方案（RDA），效率提升了数倍。
AI.conclusion: CDA 证明了通过结合网络编码技术，可以比目前以太坊的 RDA 方案更高效、更具鲁棒性地实现数据可用性采样（DAS）。

title: Sobolev Approximation by Fixed-Size Neural Networks with Arbitrary Accuracy
summary: In this work, we investigate new activation functions for achieving arbitrary-accuracy Sobolev approximation by fixed-size neural networks. We first show that any function in $W^{2,\infty}((a,b)^d)$ can be approximated with arbitrary accuracy, measured in the $W^{1,\infty}$-norm, by a fixed-size neural network using the Elementary Universal Activation Function ($\mathrm{EUAF}$). To extend this result to $W^{s,\infty}((a,b)^d)$ for $s\in\mathbb{N}$, we introduce a smooth activation $\mathrm{DUAF}_{\infty}$ from the family of Differentiable Universal Activation Functions ($\mathrm{DUAF}_n$). We prove that any function in $W^{s,\infty}((a,b)^d)$ can be approximated with arbitrary accuracy in the $W^{s-1,\infty}$-norm by a fixed-size $\mathrm{DUAF}_{\infty}$-activated network. We further construct sigmoidal variants $\widetilde{\mathrm{DUAF}}_n$ and show that, for every $1\leq s\leq n$, fixed-size $\widetilde{\mathrm{DUAF}}_n$-activated networks still approximate any $f\in W^{s,\infty}((a,b)^d)$ with arbitrary accuracy in the $W^{s-1,\infty}$-norm. In all these results, the width and depth bounds are computed explicitly, and the proposed activations are elementary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一系列新型激活函数（EUAF, DUAF 等），通过数学证明展示了固定大小的神经网络在这些激活函数的作用下，能够以任意精度在 Sobolev 空间中逼近函数，并推导出了明确的参数复杂度界限。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决固定大小的神经网络在 Sobolev 空间 ($W^{s,\infty}$) 中逼近函数时对激活函数的要求，特别是如何在不增加网络规模的情况下实现任意精度的逼近。
AI.method: 1. 引入并分析了基本通用激活函数 (EUAF)；2. 构造了一族可微通用激活函数 (DUAF_n) 及相应的光滑变体；3. 构造了 sigmoidal 激活函数变体 (\widetilde{DUAF}_n)；4. 通过数学证明建立了神经网络结构与 Sobolev 空间逼近误差之间的显式界限。
AI.result: 1. 证明了 EUAF 可在 $W^{1,\infty}$ 范数下以任意精度逼近 $W^{2,\infty}$ 函数；2. 证明了 $DUAF_\infty$ 可在 $W^{s-1,\infty}$ 范数下以任意精度逼近 $W^{s,\infty}$ 函数；3. 证明了 sigmoidal 变体 $\widetilde{DUAF}_n$ 同样具备上述逼近能力；4. 给出了所有结论中网络宽度和深度的显式界限。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了使用特定设计的激活函数（EUAF, DUAF, 以及 sigmoidal 变体），固定大小的神经网络可以在 Sobolev 空间 $W^{s,\infty}$ 中实现任意精度的逼近，并给出了明确的宽度和深度界限。

title: Task-Aware Environment Augmentation for Reliable Navigation via Shielded Conditional Diffusion
summary:
Reliable trajectory planning under partial observability depends not only on computing a feasible geometric path, but also on whether the robot receives informative observations while executing that trajectory. Existing approaches usually keep the environment fixed and adapt the robot through belief-space planning, active localization, or added sensing, often incurring costly uncertainty propagation and brittle behavior in observation-poor regions. We flip this perspective and address the largely open problem of \emph{task-aware environment augmentation}: given a mapped environment, a planned task trajectory, and a small budget of visual fiducial markers, where should the environment be augmented so that the planned trajectory can be executed reliably under uncertainty? Our key observation is that useful marker layouts are defined by the localization support they provide along the task trajectory: a small number of well-timed observations can be sufficient to prevent uncertainty from accumulating in regions where state-estimation error would otherwise compromise control. Building on this observation, we present \tbp{SCoDA}, $\textbf{S}$hielded $\textbf{Co}$nditional $\textbf{D}$iffusion for Environment $\textbf{A}$ugmentation. \tbp{SCoDA} learns a conditional distribution over high-performing fiducial layouts from data, using the environment, planned trajectory, disturbance context, and desired execution profile as conditioning. Its shielded sampler reasons over where along the planned execution pose corrections should occur, and steers this distribution toward task-relevant, finite-budget augmentations. Across simulated benchmarks and hardware deployments, we show that \tbp{SCoDA} improves trajectory execution reliability and completion time over strong baselines.
  Code, models and dataset available at: \hyperlink{scoda-diffusion.github.io}{https://scoda-diffusion.github.io/}

AI.tldr: SCoDA是一种通过在环境中部署少量视觉标记来增强机器人导航的新型扩散模型框架，它通过学习最优标记位置来优化路径执行，有效解决观测稀缺环境下的定位不确定性与任务执行风险。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人轨迹规划往往依赖于被动适应环境，在观测稀缺区域容易因不确定性累积导致任务失败或路径不可靠，且传统的主动定位方法计算成本高。论文旨在通过主动“环境增强”（放置视觉标记物）来提高执行的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出SCoDA（Shielded Conditional Diffusion for Environment Augmentation）。该方法利用条件扩散模型学习高表现力标记布局的分布，结合环境特征、轨迹和任务要求进行条件化，并引入屏蔽采样器（shielded sampler）对标记位置进行优化，以在有限预算下确保关键路段的定位精度。
AI.result: 在仿真测试和真实硬件实验中，SCoDA显著提高了轨迹执行的可靠性，并优化了任务完成时间，证明了该方法在处理偏观测环境下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种名为SCoDA的框架，通过在环境中战略性地放置视觉标记，有效地解决了弱观测区域下的机器人导航不确定性问题，在执行可靠性和完成时间上均优于基准方法。

title: PACUTE: Phonology-, Affix-, and Character-level Understanding of Tokens for Filipino
summary: Large language models (LLMs) process text as sequences of subword tokens, which can obscure the character-level and morphological structure that underlies word formation. This limitation is most acute for languages with non-concatenative morphology, where standard tokenizers systematically misalign token boundaries with morpheme boundaries. We introduce PACUTE, a diagnostic benchmark of 4,600 tasks designed to evaluate morphological understanding in Filipino, a language characterized by productive infixation, reduplication, and diacritic-driven lexical distinctions that are typically absent from written text. PACUTE includes a hierarchical diagnostic framework of six compositional levels that localizes where morphological understanding breaks down. Evaluating open-weight LLMs and frontier commercial models, we find that open-weight models perform near chance on morpheme decomposition regardless of scale. Frontier models perform much better, often recovering individual affixes under contains-match scoring, but remain far below their character-level ceilings on compositional tasks of morpheme transformations and syllabification. These results identify productive morphological composition, rather than character access alone, as the persistent bottleneck for Filipino word-structure understanding.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM处理非联结形态语言（如菲律宾语）时形态理解不足的问题，本文提出了评估基准PACUTE，研究发现当前模型（含前沿模型）在处理复杂的形态构成逻辑时存在显著的性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）基于子词（subword）的分词方式掩盖了词法结构，导致其在处理非联结形态语言时，分词边界与语素边界对齐困难，难以捕捉词汇形成的内在形态逻辑。
AI.method: 提出了PACUTE（Philippine morphological Understanding Task Evaluation）诊断基准，包含4600项任务；构建了涵盖六个层级的层次化诊断框架，用于定位形态理解失效的具体环节；对多个开源及闭源大模型进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 开源模型在语素分解任务上表现接近随机猜测；前沿商业模型虽在简单的语素匹配上表现较好，但在复杂的形态转换与音节划分任务中，仍远低于字符级别的理论上限。
AI.conclusion: 现有的主流LLM在处理菲律宾语这类非联结形态（non-concatenative morphology）语言时，形态理解能力存在显著不足，尤其是形态合成与分解任务表现较差。这表明形态构成能力而非简单的字符获取能力，是LLM语言理解的瓶颈。

title: Temporal Difference Learning for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are typically trained with objectives that focus on local denoising targets at individual time steps (or adjacent pairs), which do not enforce consistency between predictions along the denoising trajectory. This lack of cross-time consistency can degrade performance, especially for few-step samplers. We introduce a temporal difference (TD) objective that penalizes inconsistency of the model's multi-step progress along the denoising path. By reformulating the diffusion process as a Markov reward process and casting denoising as a policy evaluation problem in reinforcement learning, we derive a unified TD approach that applies to both discrete- and continuous-time diffusion formulations. We further propose a principled sample-based reweighting method that stabilizes training. Empirically, we show that using our TD training can significantly improve sample quality measured by FID, with stronger advantages when the number of sampling steps is small, highlighting its practical utility under low-computation-budget scenarios. We provide ablation studies to justify our design choices, including pairwise loss reweighting, regularization weight, and one-step stride. Overall, our TD approach can be a general drop-in that enforces cross-time consistency and improves generation quality across different diffusion generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习时间差分（TD）的新型扩散模型训练目标，通过增强去噪轨迹的跨时间一致性，显著提升了模型在少步采样下的生成性能。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散模型主要采用逐时间步的局部去噪目标，缺乏对整个去噪轨迹中各时间步预测结果的一致性约束，导致执行少步采样时模型性能下降。
AI.method: 1. 将扩散过程重构为马尔可夫奖励过程（Markov Reward Process）；2. 将去噪过程建模为强化学习中的策略评估问题；3. 引入时间差分（TD）目标函数以惩罚去噪路径上的不一致性；4. 提出一种基于样本的重加权（reweighting）方法以稳定训练过程。
AI.result: 在实验评估中，TD训练方法显著降低了FID分数，特别是在低计算预算（少步采样）场景下优势更加明显。通过消融实验验证了成对损失重加权、正则化权重及步长等设计要素的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的TD目标函数能够有效增强去噪路径的跨时间一致性，显著提升扩散模型在少步采样（few-step sampling）中的生成质量，且具备良好的通用性，可作为通用插件应用于各类主流扩散模型。

title: A Theoretical Framework for Risk Analysis of Stochastic Rankers
summary: Different from deterministic rankers that seek to maximize relevance at top ranks, stochastic ranking policies instead estimate distributions over permutations, from which rankings are sampled, towards obtaining diversified or fair exposure. Such policies are commonly evaluated in terms of expected effectiveness postreranking. However, the randomness inherent in these policies gives rise to a fundamental but under-explored ex ante question: prior to applying stochastic reranking, how large can the induced variation in retrieval effectiveness be in the worst case? This paper presents a theoretical analysis of reranking risk, defined as the maximum absolute change in discounted cumulative gain (DCG) resulting from a permutation sampled from a stochastic reranking policy applied to a fixed retrieved list.We derive that this risk is governed by the distribution of the recall points in the initial retrieved list. We conduct experiments on submitted runs from the TREC Fairness 2022 track that employ stochastic reranking policies and empirically demonstrate that the effectiveness variations predicted by our theory closely approximate the observed changes in DCG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“重排序风险”的概念，量化了随机重排序策略在最坏情况下对DCG的影响，并证明该风险取决于原始检索列表中相关项目的分布。
AI.motivation: 现有的随机重排序策略（用于多样化或公平性）多关注后验的预期效果，但缺乏对“先验”风险的研究，即忽视了在采样过程中检索质量可能发生的最坏情况波动。
AI.method: 定义并推导了“重排序风险”（即在固定检索列表上应用随机策略时，DCG可能发生的最大绝对变化）；通过理论推导风险边界，并利用TREC Fairness 2022赛道的提交运行数据进行了实证验证。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，风险界限与原始检索列表中相关项目的分布密切相关。实验结果显示，通过理论预测的DCG波动范围与实际观察到的变化高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 重排序风险（reranking risk）是由原始检索列表中相关性点（recall points）的分布所决定的；研究提供的理论框架能较准确地预测随机重排序策略带来的DCG波动。

title: DataGuard: Guaranteeing Private Training in Systolic-array Based Accelerators
summary: Differential privacy (DP) and federated learning (FL) have emerged as important privacy-preserving approaches when using sensitive data to train machine learning (ML) models. FL ensures that raw sensitive data does not leave the users' devices by training the model locally on the device. DP ensures that the model does not leak any information about an individual by clipping and adding noise to the gradients before updating the model. It provides formalism to constrain privacy loss during training to a privacy budget determined a priori by the owner of sensitive data. However, real-life deployments of FL algorithms typically assume that a third-party FL application can be trusted to correctly implement DP algorithms. Thus, the third-party application is given full access to sensitive data. In this work, we propose DataGuard, a hardware-based mechanism that guarantees that the only data that can leave the device is the result of computation that meets DP requirements. DataGuard can thus be used to ensure that the privacy budget defined by the data owner is not exceeded during FL training without the need to trust a third-party application. We evaluate DataGuard in simulations of four accelerators for various ML models and demonstrate only small area overheads of less than 0.01\% and performance slowdowns of less than 0.3\%.

AI.tldr: 针对联邦学习中对第三方应用实施差分隐私不可信的问题，本文提出了DataGuard硬件机制，通过在硬件层面强制执行差分隐私约束，在保持极低性能开销的同时，确保了数据隐私预算不会被第三方超越。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦学习（FL）和差分隐私（DP）结合方案通常依赖第三方FL应用正确实现DP算法。然而，这要求用户全额信任第三方，存在隐私泄露风险。作者旨在解决这一“信任基础”缺失的问题，减少对第三方实现隐私保护机制的依赖。
AI.method: 提出DataGuard：一种基于硬件的机制，旨在确保离开设备的数据仅为满足差分隐私（DP）要求的计算结果。该机制直接嵌入硬件，能够强制执行预设的隐私预算，从而消除对第三方联邦学习（FL）应用程序实施正确性及隐私保护的信任需求。
AI.result: 通过四种加速器模拟实验表明，DataGuard在各类机器学习模型上的性能表现优异，硬件计算开销极低（面积增加小于0.01%，性能减缓小于0.3%）。
AI.conclusion: DataGuard通过基于硬件的可信执行机制，成功在无需信任第三方FL应用的前提下，强制执行差分隐私约束，证明了在低性能损耗和微小面积开销下实现隐私合规的可行性。

title: Dynestyx: A Probabilistic Programming Library for Dynamical Systems
summary: State-space models (SSMs) are the standard formalism for Bayesian treatment of dynamical systems, with natural applications in statistics, signal processing, and machine learning. Despite their importance in both theory and application, dynamical systems have proven difficult to incorporate in modern probabilistic programming languages (PPLs), making state-of-the-art methods less accessible to practitioners and introducing friction in following the "Bayesian workflow." We introduce dynestyx, a probabilistic programming library with first-class support for SSMs, including state-of-the-art methods in the estimation of both states and parameters. Through a single, unified interface, users may specify arbitrary priors for discrete-time or continuous-time dynamical systems, perform inference over mixed-effect data, and make state and parameter estimates with principled uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: dynestyx 是一个全新的概率编程库，通过提供统一、易用的接口，解决了现有概率编程语言在处理状态空间模型（SSM）时的集成难题，实现了对动态系统参数与状态的高效估计。
AI.motivation: 状态空间模型（SSM）在处理动态系统时至关重要，但现有的概率编程语言（PPLs）在整合这些模型时存在困难，导致先进的建模方法难以在实际工作中应用。
AI.method: 开发名为 dynestyx 的概率编程库，专门集成针对动态系统的最先进状态与参数估计方法，支持离散和连续时间系统，并提供混合效应数据推理及不确定性量化功能。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的接口环境，使用户能够方便地设定先验、进行混合效应推断，并对动态系统进行精确的状态与参数估计。
AI.conclusion: dynestyx 通过提供统一的接口和对 SSM 的一流支持，降低了贝叶斯动态系统建模的门槛，改善了实践者的工作流程。

title: Seam-to-Graph Reconstruction for Garment Configuration Alignment
summary: Seams encode rich structural information about garments but are frequently partially observable in robotic manipulation scenarios. To robustly leverage seam information, we propose a Seam-to-Graph network based on graph neural networks and attention mechanisms. This network maps unstructured seam observations to a topology-encoded structural skeleton graph for real-time garment state estimation. Using this skeleton-graph-based state estimation, we design a deformation-aware, hierarchical visual servoing controller for garment configuration alignment. We implement this controller on a bimanual robot system to load a garment onto a screen printing platen and to align it to the desired configuration precisely. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that the robot using the proposed method not only achieves human-level alignment accuracy with reduced variance in alignment error but is also robust to different garments. These results demonstrate that the use of seam information is effective for garment manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种Seam-to-Graph网络实现实时衣物状态估计，并结合变形感知视觉伺服控制器，实现了高精度、鲁棒的机器人衣物对齐操作。
AI.motivation: 缝线蕴含丰富的衣物结构信息，但在机器人操作中常呈部分可观测状态，如何鲁棒地利用这些信息以实现精确的衣物操纵是一个核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）和注意力机制的Seam-to-Graph网络，将非结构化缝线观测映射为拓扑结构骨架图；并设计了一种变形感知（deformation-aware）、分层式的视觉伺服控制器用于衣物配置对齐。
AI.result: 在双臂机器人平台上实现了衣物放置与精确对齐；实验表明该方法达到了人类水平的对齐精度，降低了对齐误差方差，并对不同款式的衣物具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 证实了缝线信息在衣物操纵中的有效性，提出的Seam-to-Graph网络与分层视觉伺服控制方案能显著提升机器人在复杂衣物操纵任务中的精度与鲁棒性。

title: Can Agents Read the Room? Benchmarking Visual Social Intelligence in Multimodal Simulation
summary: Social interaction depends on both language and visible social signals, such as facial expressions, posture, gaze, and emotional shifts. Yet existing social-agent benchmarks are largely text-based and rarely test whether multimodal agents can use visual cues to guide interaction. We introduce \textsc{\benchmarkname{}}, a benchmark evaluating visual social intelligence in multimodal social simulation. It contains 240 scenarios, 585 role instances, and 2,340 role-task instances, combining aligned textual-visual evidence, structured role profiles, and four role-level tasks: expression task, characteristic task, interaction regulation task, and interaction outcome task. Evaluating seven recent MLLMs under verbalized-vision and direct-vision reveals a clear gap between local role enactment and interaction management: role-specific expression and conflict handling are near saturation, whereas interaction regulation and visually grounded outcome achievement remain substantially more difficult. The code is released at https://github.com/JunsWan/AgentViSS, and the dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/JunsWan/AgentViSS.
