AI.tldr: 本文提出了名为AgentViSS的多模态社交智能基准测试，揭示了当前主流多模态大模型在处理复杂视觉社交线索以引导交互时的能力偏差及瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有社交智能基准测试多过于依赖文本，缺乏对多模态社交信号（如面部表情、姿态、眼神等）整合能力的评估，导致无法有效衡量Agent在真实社会交互中的视觉社交智能。
AI.method: 构建了包含240个场景、585个角色实例及2340个角色任务实例的AgentViSS基准测试，设计了四项涵盖视觉感知的社会交互任务（表情、特征、交互监管、交互结果），并对比了主流MLLM在直接视觉和文字描述视觉输入下的表现。
AI.result: 评估显示，目前模型在角色特定表达和冲突处理任务上已接近性能饱和，但在视觉驱动的交互监管和复杂交互结果实现方面仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLM在局部角色表现方面表现较好，但在需要多模态理解的深层交互监管和结果预测方面存在显著短板和能力鸿沟。

title: Physics-conforming Latent Twins
summary: Surrogate models are central to scientific machine learning, where they enable fast prediction, simulation, inference, and control for complex physical systems. For time-dependent problems, however, accurate interpolation of training trajectories is not sufficient: reliable surrogates should also respect the conservation laws, invariants, admissibility conditions, and dissipative structures that give those trajectories physical meaning. We introduce Physics-conforming Latent Twins, a framework for learning latent surrogate solution operators whose dynamics satisfy selected physical principles by design. The method builds on the Latent Twin formulation by jointly learning an encoder, a decoder, and a latent flow map between arbitrary time-indexed states, while constraining the latent dynamics to preserve or dissipate prescribed structural quantities. We develop a constraint-transfer viewpoint that connects physical structure in the original state space with compatible constraints in latent space, and prove structure-preservation bounds showing how latent enforcement improves control of physical defects after decoding. We also derive algebraic conditions for latent flow maps that preserve linear and quadratic invariants or enforce dissipative inequalities. Numerical experiments on representative ODE and PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved constraint satisfaction, structural fidelity, and qualitative long-time behavior while maintaining accurate surrogate prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为“Physics-conforming Latent Twins”的代理模型框架，通过在潜在空间内强制执行物理守恒律和耗散结构，确保了学习到的模型不仅能准确预测，且符合物理定律。
AI.motivation: 目前的科学机器学习代理模型在处理时变物理系统时，往往仅关注轨迹插值，忽略了物理系统必须满足的守恒律、不变性、可容许性及耗散结构，导致预测结果缺乏物理意义且长期行为发散。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“Physics-conforming Latent Twins”的框架。该方法联合学习编码器、解码器及潜在空间的流映射（flow map），核心是通过“约束迁移”（constraint-transfer）视角，将原始状态空间的物理结构映射为潜在空间的兼容约束。具体实现上，导出了潜在流映射的代数条件，用于强制保持线性/二次不变量或满足耗散不等式。
AI.result: 在多项ODE和PDE基准测试中，该方法表现出更好的约束满足能力和结构保真度，特别是在长期预测中表现出更稳定的定性行为，同时保持了高效的代理预测精度。
AI.conclusion: “Physics-conforming Latent Twins”通过在潜在空间内强制执行物理约束，成功解决了传统代理模型在处理时变复杂物理系统时难以维持守恒律和耗散结构的问题。该方法在保证预测精度的同时，显著提升了结构保真度和对物理缺陷的控制，是物理信息机器学习领域的一个重要架构。

authors: Joel Machado Pires Denis Dantas Boaventura
title: How Much Do Reviews Really Contribute? A Study on Text-Enriched Matrix Factorization for Recommendations
summary: Incorporating textual reviews into a Recommender System has become a prominent strategy for enriching collaborative signals with semantic information. However, the actual contribution of review-derived representations remains an open question, particularly when strong collaborative baselines are employed. In this work, we systematically investigate the impact of textual information on Matrix Factorization by introducing and comparing three enrichment strategies over a common collaborative backbone. First, we propose a learnable gating mechanism that adaptively balances collaborative and textual signals during training. This mechanism is applied to two distinct review representations: (i) aggregated topic profiles extracted from user and item histories, and (ii) full text embedding representations derived from reviews. Additionally, we explore a cross-attention mechanism that identifies and emphasizes the most informative dimensions of the textual representation before fusion with collaborative factors. We evaluate six variants: pure, enriched with topic profiles and text via gating; enriched with topics and text via gating; and enhanced with cross-attention over textual features. Experiments across multiple review-based datasets reveal that although adaptive fusion mechanisms improve representation flexibility, the marginal contribution of textual signals remains limited compared to the collaborative backbone. These findings suggest that, under typical rating-prediction settings, collaborative information continues to dominate performance, raising important considerations for the effective integration of semantic review signals into recommendation models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比实验发现，在强协同基线模型中，引入评论文本信息带来的性能提升依然较为有限，协同过滤信号仍是推荐系统的核心驱动力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为文本评论能丰富协同信号，但其在强协同过滤基线下的实际增量贡献仍不明确，需要系统性地探究文本信息的真实价值。
AI.method: 1. 构建统一的基于矩阵分解（Matrix Factorization）的协同过滤基线；2. 提出三种增强策略：(i) 基于可学习门控机制（gating mechanism）融合主题分布和文本嵌入；(ii) 使用互注意力机制（cross-attention）强调文本特征中的关键维度；3. 在多个真实评论数据集上对比六种变体模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管自适应融合机制提升了表征的灵活性，但相比于强协同基线，从评论中提取的文本信号对推荐性能的提升非常有限。
AI.conclusion: 在典型的评分预测场景下，协同信息在推荐系统中仍占据主导地位，文本信号的边际贡献有限。未来的研究需要重新思考如何更有效地集成语义文本信号，而非仅仅依赖融合机制。

title: Architecture Carbon Tool v3: Enabling Sustainability-aware Silicon System Design Exploration
summary: As the carbon cost of manufacturing and operating semiconductor devices has come into sharper focus, sustainability has gradually emerged as a new system architecture design metric. Like power and performance modeling tools, enabling sustainability-aware silicon systems design and optimizations will require a new generation of electronic design automation and architectural modeling tools. Towards this end, we present an update to the Architecture Carbon Tool v3 (ACT3) which aims to provide an extensible and customizable modeling platform for research and advanced development to pave the path towards sustainability-aware architectural design space exploration. Compared to previous versions of ACT, ACT3 provides significantly richer modeling capabilities, enhanced collateral and analysis telemetry, and first order design space exploration capabilities. This technical brief provides an overview of these expanded capabilities and illustrates ACT3's basic utility across several case studies. Finally, we identify opportunities for research and development where we expect the research community can contribute towards continuing to improve sustainability modeling and design methodology for silicon systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Architecture Carbon Tool v3 (ACT3)，这是一个用于芯片系统设计、旨在实现可持续性感知架构探索的建模平台，通过增强建模精度和分析功能，助力半导体行业降低碳足迹。
AI.motivation: 半导体设备的制造与运行带来的碳成本日益受到关注，现有的电子设计自动化（EDA）和架构建模工具缺乏对可持续性的量化评估，无法满足可持续性感知（sustainability-aware）的芯片系统设计需求。
AI.method: 推出 Architecture Carbon Tool v3 (ACT3)，在保持可扩展性和可定制性的基础上，通过引入更丰富的建模能力、增强的辅助数据与分析遥测技术，以及一阶设计空间探索功能（DSE），实现对硅系统全生命周期的碳足迹评估。
AI.result: ACT3 比前代版本提供了更精细的建模能力，通过多个案例研究验证了其在设计空间探索中的实用性，并为科研界在提升可持续性建模方法论方面提供了切入点。
AI.conclusion: ACT3 为芯片架构设计提供了更强大的可持续性建模和探索平台，强调了可持续性与性能、功耗同等重要的设计指标地位，并为未来的研究方向指明了路径。

title: Tropical: Enhancing SLO Attainment in Disaggregated LLM Serving via SLO-Aware Multiplexing
summary:
To guarantee service quality in transformer based large language model (LLM) serving, it is essential to meet the latency constraints of both the prefill phase (measured by Time-to-First-Token, TTFT) and the decode phase (measured by Time-per-Output-Token, TPOT). Non-disaggregated serving places prefill and decode on the same worker, while disaggregated serving places the prefill and decode on isolated workers. However, no single architecture excels in both TTFT and TPOT metrics. After conducting a root cause analysis, we concluded that indisaggregated LLM serving, prefill execution has minimal interference with decode execution but result in high queuing times. In contrast,non-disaggregated LLM serving effectively reduces queuing times but introduces significant interference between prefills and decodes.
  In order to leverage the best aspects of both non-disaggregated anddisaggregated LLM serving, we have designed and implemented Tropical.Tropical introduces an sevice-level objectives (SLO)-aware multiplexing strategy that balances the queuing time and the interference, enabling the LLM serving to achieve high TTFT and TPOT SLOs simultaneously. Our evaluation of real-world datasets reveals that Tropical outperforms both state-of-the-art non-disaggregated and disaggregated LLM serving systems, achieving up to 2.09 more requests within a 90% SLO attainment. Specially, compared to the disaggregated LLM serving system, Tropicalimproves P90 TTFT performance by 9 with only an 15% reduction in P90 TPOT. Against the non-disaggregated LLM serving systems, Tropicaldelivers a 2.8 performance improvement in P90 TPOT while maintaining the same P90 TTFT.

AI.tldr: 针对 LLM 服务中预填充与解码阶段的性能权衡问题，Tropical 通过 SLO 感知的多路复用策略，有效解决了聚合/非聚合架构中的排队与干扰矛盾，显著优化了 TTFT 与 TPOT 的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统（聚合与非聚合架构）无法在预填充（TTFT）与解码（TPOT）的双重延迟约束下达到最优表现。聚合架构侧重减少排队但干扰严重，非聚合架构侧重隔离但排队延迟较高。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 Tropical 的系统，采用 SLO 感知的多路复用策略（SLO-aware multiplexing strategy），动态平衡不聚合（Disaggregated）架构的排队优势与聚合（Non-disaggregated）架构的干扰处理能力。
AI.result: 在真实数据集评估中，Tropical 的请求处理能力提升高达 2.09 倍；在满足 90% SLO 的前提下，对比非聚合系统在保持 TTFT 的同时将 TPOT 提升 2.8 倍，对比聚合系统在大幅提升 TTFT 的同时仅牺牲少量 TPOT。
AI.conclusion: Tropical 通过 SLO 感知的多路复用策略，成功平衡了预填充与解码任务的排队延迟与执行干扰，显著提升了 LLM 服务在满足 SLO 前提下的吞吐量。

title: Relational Structural Causal Models
comment: Proceedings of the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
summary: An artificial intelligence must have a model of its environment that is causal, supporting reasoning about interventions and counterfactuals, and also combinatorial, supporting generalization to unseen combinations of objects. In this work, we formally study when and how such a model can be learned. We develop relational structural causal models, extending structural causal models (Pearl 2009) to settings where objects and their relations vary. First, we show how answers to not only causal but also observational queries about unseen combinations of objects can not be identified without further assumptions. To enable such identification--including in the presence of unobserved confounding--we define relational causal graphs and derive symbolic identification criteria. Finally, we propose relational neural causal models, a provably correct approach that outperforms non-relational baselines on simulated traffic scenes with varying cars, signals, and pedestrians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种能够处理对象和关系可变环境的关系因果模型，解决了因果模型在组合泛化中的局限性，并实现了在存在未观测混杂因素下的识别。
AI.motivation: 人工智能需要具备对环境的因果建模能力（支持干预和反事实推理）以及组合泛化能力（支持对未见的对象组合进行泛化），以应对复杂多变的环境。
AI.method: 1. 提出“关系结构因果模型”（Relational Structural Causal Models），将结构因果模型扩展至对象和关系可变的场景；2. 定义“关系因果图”（Relational Causal Graphs）并推导出符号识别准则；3. 提出“关系神经因果模型”（Relational Neural Causal Models）作为具体实现方案。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在未引入额外假设的情况下无法识别观测和因果查询；在模拟驾驶场景中，所提模型在处理不同数量的车辆、信号和行人时，表现优于非关系型基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过提出关系结构因果模型及其相应的识别准则，成功实现了在对象和关系动态变化的环境中进行因果推理和反事实推理的目标，并通过关系神经因果模型证明了其在复杂场景下的优越性。

title: Rethinking Implicit Spatial Representation in Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: Generative model-based imitation learning has become a widely adopted paradigm for robotic manipulation, where policy performance depends critically on the conditioned visual representations. Although spatial softmax-based representations have been adopted in prior visuomotor policies, their effectiveness and underlying mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. This work rethinks the use of spatial softmax pooling: do such implicit spatial representations provide effective and stable visual features for robotic manipulation? Through systematic studies of different pooling methods in visual encoders, we find that this pooling operation produces compact and stable spatial representations, which outperform feature-value representations, despite using substantially fewer dimensions. Complementary saliency analysis further suggests that these spatial representations guide the encoder to focus more consistently on task-relevant regions. However, this advantage is limited by a representation bottleneck in current visual encoders: repeated downsampling operations weaken fine-grained spatial information before the action-generation module can use it, especially under low-resolution observations. Motivated by these findings, we propose PRISM, a visual encoder that preserves multiscale implicit spatial information through top-down cross-attention fusion. Experiments across multiple tasks and policy backbones show consistent improvements. In particular, on the low-resolution, high-precision ToolHang task, PRISM shows clear gains, improving the average success rate from 5.0% to 13.4% while increasing parameters by only 15.4%. These results support the use of multiscale implicit spatial representations as an effective and efficient design principle for robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了机器人操作中空间Softmax池化的有效性，指出其存在空间表示瓶颈，并提出了通过多尺度交叉注意力保留空间信息的PRISM架构，有效提升了机器人的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于空间Softmax的表示方法在机器人操作中的机制尚不清晰。虽然空间Softmax能提供紧凑且稳定的表示，但现有的下采样操作会导致细粒度空间信息丢失，特别是在低分辨率观测环境下，限制了策略性能。
AI.method: 提出PRISM视觉编码器，通过自顶向下的交叉注意力融合（Top-down Cross-attention Fusion）保留多尺度隐式空间信息。同时，对现有的池化方法进行了系统性对比与显著性分析。
AI.result: PRISM在多项任务及策略骨干网络中表现优于传统方法。在低分辨率高精度的ToolHang任务中，成功率从5.0%提升至13.4%，且参数仅增加15.4%。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度隐式空间表示是机器人操作中一种有效且高效的设计准则，通过PRISM架构可以显著提升低分辨率下的操作精度。

title: Beyond Layer Importance in Layer-wise Sparsity: An Inter-Layer Perturbation-Absorption Perspective
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to EMNLP 2026
summary: The considerable layer-wise redundancy in large language models (LLMs) has established non-uniform sparsity allocation across layers as the standard pruning approach for efficient compression. Existing layer-wise allocation methods that estimate allocation strategy from local signals such as activation outliers or weight spectra mainly derive from local layer importance, whereas the final post-pruning performance is also influenced by the network's subsequent compensatory capacity. In this paper, we directly characterize this property through controlled perturbation experiments. We make the following empirical findings. First, layers exhibit highly heterogeneous responses to pruning-scale perturbations. In most cases, early layers amplify perturbations, while middle and late layers actively absorb them, with relative L2 drift decreasing monotonically across depth and direction realigning toward the unperturbed hidden-state trajectory. Second, absorption is a large-perturbation phenomenon. Under small perturbations the network exhibits amplification across all layers, and the transition to absorption occurs smoothly as perturbation magnitude grows to pruning scale. This enriches the linearized accumulation theory underlying related works. Building on these findings, we define an absorption coefficient per layer and propose absorption-aware correction, an orthogonal augmentation that improves OWL and AlphaPruning by reducing perplexity by 7.13% and boosting zero-shot accuracy by 1.02% across multiple model families at 70% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM层级对剪枝扰动的“吸收能力”差异，并提出了一种基于吸收系数的剪枝增强策略，有效提升了模型压缩后的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的非均匀稀疏化方法主要依赖激活值异常或权重谱等局部信号来估计层重要性，忽略了网络层级在应对剪枝扰动时的后续补偿与吸收能力（compensatory capacity）。
AI.method: 1. 通过受控扰动实验表征模型对剪枝扰动的响应；2. 定义了各层的“吸收系数”（absorption coefficient）；3. 提出吸收感知校准（absorption-aware correction）方法，作为现有方法（如OWL、AlphaPruning）的增强手段。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. 剪枝扰动在不同层级表现出异质性（早期放大，中后期吸收）；2. 吸收能力是随扰动幅度增大而出现的现象。在70%稀疏度下，该方法使困惑度（Perplexity）降低了7.13%，零样本准确率提升了1.02%。
AI.conclusion: 层级的“吸收能力”是影响剪枝效果的关键因素，通过引入吸收感知校准（Absorption-aware Correction），可以显著提升现有稀疏化方法的性能。

title: Size Doesn't Matter: Cosine-Scored Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) detect features via inner product, so a feature's activation scales with both its directional alignment and the input's norm. Under BatchTopK, high-norm tokens inflate all pre-activations simultaneously, claiming dictionary slots regardless of content alignment. This matters because sublayer normalization has already discarded the magnitude the score measures, so the encoder detects a quantity the model does not read. We replace the score with a learned blend of cosine similarity and input magnitude, letting the optimizer choose how much norm to use; a per-feature extension lets each feature decide independently. In both regimes, training is free to recover inner product but never does, with no feature ever choosing more than half-magnitude dependence. At matched reconstruction, the cosine encoder learns features that align with human-recognizable concepts far more often than standard, filling dictionary slots that inner product wastes on norm detectors. Loss reweighting that equalizes gradients barely closes the gap, confirming forward-pass score geometry as the lever. The advantage is not universal across tasks or depths, but we believe cosine scoring should be the default for dictionary learning on normalized representations.

AI.tldr: 为了解决SAE中内积机制导致的“范数偏差”问题，本文提出使用余弦评分替代内积，从而在处理归一化表征时能更有效地捕捉高质量、可解释的语义特征，避免字典槽位被无效的范数检测器占用。
AI.motivation: 传统的SAE使用内积检测特征，导致特征激活程度同时受到方向对齐度和输入范数的影响。在BatchTopK机制下，高范数标记会错误地抢占字典槽位（即便与内容无关），且由于子层归一化已丢弃了范数信息，这种基于范数的计算对模型而言是冗余且干扰性的。
AI.method: 该研究提出将SAE编码器中的内积运算替换为“余弦相似度与输入幅值的学习型混合”（a learned blend of cosine similarity and input magnitude），并允许每个特征独立决定幅值的依赖比例。研究对比了该方法与传统内积方法的性能。
AI.result: 实验表明：1. 在相同重建质量下，余弦编码器学习到的特征更具有人类可解释性；2. 优化器始终倾向于降低对范数的依赖（不到一半）；3. 通过各种控制变量（如梯度加权）验证了这一改进确实源于前向传播的评分几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 使用余弦相似度（或其变体）作为稀疏自编码器（SAE）的评分机制优于默认的内积机制，因为它能更好地发现与模型特征对齐的概念，而非单纯地捕捉输入范数（Norm）。作者建议在处理归一化表征的字典学习任务中，应将余弦评分作为默认选择。

title: Edu-Theater: A Data-Efficient Agent Framework for Scalable Learner Behavior Simulation through Staging Roll-Call
comment: LLM Agent, Educational Data Mining, Data Synthesis, Human Simulation
summary: Large-scale learner-task interaction data are crucial for intelligent educational systems but are costly to collect and constrained by privacy and learner engagement. Learner simulators play a critical role in simulating scalable learner behavior without the need for continuous involvement of real learners. However, existing methods are predominantly \textbf{individual-centric}, pairing a simulator with each learner to iteratively infer latent knowledge states from dense interaction histories, which is both data- and computation-intensive, and fragile in cold-start scenarios. We propose a \textbf{cohort-aware roll-call simulation paradigm} that first constructs cohort-level proficiency priors and refines individual learner states through a small number of targeted diagnostic queries. Based on this paradigm, we introduce \textbf{Edu-Theater}, an LLM-powered agent system that performs cohort-aware learner simulation via a teacher agent and retrospective roll-call probing over learner logs. Edu-Theater enables scalable future behavior simulation without the need for dense per-learner histories. Experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that Edu-Theater achieves higher simulation accuracy with significantly fewer LLM calls, producing synthetic data that enhances downstream applications such as adaptive testing.

AI.tldr: 提出Edu-Theater，一种基于群体感知点名范式的LLM模拟系统，通过群体先验与极少量查询实现高效、准确的学习者行为模拟，克服了数据匮乏与冷启动困境。
AI.motivation: 现有学习者模拟方法高度依赖密集的个体交互数据，且存在计算开销大、冷启动效果差以及侵犯隐私等问题，限制了其在智能教育系统中的大规模应用。
AI.method: 提出“群体感知点名（Cohort-aware roll-call）”模拟范式：通过构建群体能力先验知识，仅需少量目标诊断查询即可推断个体状态；设计基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统“Edu-Theater”，利用教师智能体进行群体模拟，并通过回顾性点名探针（Retrospective roll-call probing）处理历史日志。
AI.result: 在两个真实数据集上的实验表明，Edu-Theater在显著降低LLM调用次数的前提下，提升了模拟精度，且生成的合成数据能有效增强自适应测试等下游应用的效果。
AI.conclusion: Edu-Theater通过引入群体感知模拟范式，成功解决了传统以个体为中心的模拟方法在数据稀疏和冷启动场景下的局限性，为高效、可扩展的学习者行为模拟提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: ESBMC-PLC: Formal Verification of IEC 61131-3 Ladder Diagram Programs Using SMT-Based Model Checking
summary: PLCs execute safety-critical programs across industrial sectors. The dominant PLC notation, ladder diagram (LD) per IEC 61131-3, remains absent from formal verification: SMT-based model checkers cannot process LD's rung-and-coil graphics. This paper presents ESBMC-PLC, the first open-source formal verifier with native LD support (PLCopen XML format), implemented as a new ESBMC frontend. ESBMC-PLC translates LD rungs to GOTO IR, models the PLC scan cycle as a while(true) loop with nondeterministic inputs, and checks safety properties via SMT-based bounded model checking or k-induction. A five-property YAML language (mutual_exclusion, invariant, absence, response, reachability) avoids temporal logic. A survey of 22 studies (2020-2026) identifies four research gaps; ESBMC-PLC closes two of them. Evaluation on 13 benchmarks (6 domains, 3 sources - including deployed CONTROLLINO PLCs and MathWorks Simulink PLC Coder) shows correct classification across 61 properties: all 9 author-constructed programs (Categories A/B) as expected, all 4 vendor programs (Category C) correctly unlabeled, with 8 bugs found (actionable counterexamples), 7 unbounded k-induction proofs, all runs under 60ms on Apple Silicon. Feature comparison with PLCverif shows that ESBMC-PLC is the only open-source tool that combines native LD, k-induction, and SMT bit-vector semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ESBMC-PLC，这是首个能够直接处理工业标准梯形图（LD）代码并进行形式化验证的开源工具，通过 SMT 求解器和 k-归纳法实现了高效、准确的安全属性检查。
AI.motivation: IEC 61131-3 标准中的梯形图（LD）是工业领域的主流编程语言，但由于缺乏对图形化编程的支持，现有的 SMT 模型检测器难以对其进行形式化验证。
AI.method: 1. 开发了 ESBMC 的新前端，将 PLCopen XML 格式的 LD 梯形图翻译为 GOTO 中间表示（IR）；2. 将 PLC 扫描周期建模为带有非确定性输入的 while(true) 循环；3. 基于 SMT 的有界模型检测（BMC）或 k-归纳法进行安全性验证；4. 定义了一套五种属性（互斥、不变量、缺失、响应、可达性）的 YAML 描述语言，简化了属性定义。
AI.result: 在 13 个基准测试中验证了 61 个属性，准确分类了所有作者自编程序和供应商程序，成功发现 8 个漏洞并提供计数器示例，完成了 7 个无界 k-归纳证明，且单次运行时间低于 60ms。与 PLCverif 相比，它是唯一结合了原生 LD、k-归纳和 SMT 位向量语义的开源工具。
AI.conclusion: ESBMC-PLC 是首个支持原生梯形图（LD）的开源形式化验证工具，通过结合 SMT 位向量语义和 k-归纳法，在性能和自动化程度方面优于现有工具，有效填补了 PLC 工业安全验证领域的空白。

title: Co-Creating Buildable and Open Social Robot Study Companions with University Students
comment: Accepted for 18th International Conference on Social Robotics (ICSR + ART 2026), London, UK | 1-4 July 2026
summary: Open-source social robots offer accessibility, repairability, and student empowerment, yet the build itself often presents a barrier. Existing platforms either ship pre-assembled, foreclosing hands-on learning, or expose students to unfamiliar fasteners, opaque wiring, and inaccessible service points that erode engagement. Whether targeted mechanical redesign can lower this barrier whilst maintaining structural integrity remains untested. Here we show that Design for Assembly (DfA) and Design for Disassembly (DfD) interventions reshape how a build feels before they shorten how long it takes. Working with university students in Guyana and Estonia, we applied the Double Diamond framework to co-create the Robot Study Companion (RSC) v4.1: mapping pain points, then redesigning its chassis around twist-lock fasteners, snap-fit joints, and tool-free service latches. Across two studies with developers and first-time builders, system usability climbed from Poor to Excellent (SUS 59.4 to 89.4), perceived workload trended downward (NASA-TLX 4.29 to 4.00), and mean assembly time trended downward (21.4 to 13.7 minutes, with juniors' learning effect), whilst orientation cues and navigation continuity for first-time builders emerged as the next documentation frontier. Perceived workload, not completion time, appears to govern whether students take up open hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文通过应用DfA/DfD原则重新设计开源机器人硬件，成功降低了组装难度，证明感知工作负荷是学生参与开源硬件门槛的核心，而非组装时长。
AI.motivation: 现有的开源社会机器人在构建过程中存在障碍，预组装机器人阻碍了动手学习，而复杂的装配过程（紧固件、布线、维护点）又挫伤了学习者的积极性。研究旨在通过针对性的硬件架构改造，在保持结构完整性的同时降低组装门槛。
AI.method: 研究采用了“双钻”（Double Diamond）设计框架，并结合了“面向装配设计”（DfA）和“面向拆卸设计”（DfD）原则。通过在圭亚那和爱沙尼亚与大学生共同创作（co-creation），识别痛点并对“机器人研究伴侣”（RSC v4.1）机箱进行重新设计（引入旋转锁扣、卡扣连接及免工具维护闩锁），并通过开发人员与初次构建者的对比研究进行验证。
AI.result: 经过优化设计后，系统可用性评分（SUS）从59.4（差）大幅提升至89.4（优）；感知工作负荷（NASA-TLX）有所下降；平均组装时间从21.4分钟降至13.7分钟。研究发现用户体验的改善与物理设计改进显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，降低组装难度对开源硬件的普及至关重要，且“感知工作负荷”而非“组装时长”是决定学生是否采纳开源机器人的关键因素。此外，文档编制（如组装提示与导航连续性）是未来提升用户体验的新方向。

title: AmchiBias: Measuring Stereotypical Bias in Goan Identity Groups with a Minimal Pair Dataset in English and Konkani
comment: The 1st Workshop on Stereotypes Across Cultures in Language Technologies
summary: Socio-cultural stereotypical bias is an important consideration in the development and deployment of NLP systems. It is however often considered only at the national level, despite rich subnational socio-cultural structures. We present AmchiBias, the first benchmark for measuring socio-cultural stereotypical bias for the Indian state of Goa with its unique historically multicultural setting. It covers various Goan identity groups and comprises 313 minimal pairs across eight sociodemographic dimensions in both English and Devanagari Konkani. We then evaluate stereotypical bias in five multilingual encoder models on this benchmark. We find near-chance scores in Konkani, reflecting language incompetence for general multilingual models and a lack of Goan cultural competence for Indian language models. Queried in English, models with a stronger Indian language coverage show higher bias for pan-Indian groups than hyperlocal Goan groups. This suggests the English signal reflects pan-Indian pretraining associations rather than genuine Goan cultural knowledge. Our findings highlight a critical gap in low-resource multilingual NLP evaluation for hyperlocal community identities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对印度果阿邦的社会文化刻板印象基准测试AmchiBias，研究发现主流多语言模型在处理超本地化身份时存在严重的文化理解缺失及偏见偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有的NLP系统对社会文化偏见的评估多局限于国家层面，忽略了更细微的亚国家（次国家）社会文化结构，导致模型缺乏对超本地化社区的文化理解。
AI.method: 构建名为AmchiBias的基准测试集，涵盖印度果阿邦8个社会人口统计维度、313个最小对（minimal pairs），并支持英语和天城体孔坎尼语；随后对5个多语言编码模型进行基准测试以评估其刻板印象偏差。
AI.result: 模型在孔坎尼语的测试中表现接近随机（缺乏文化和语言能力）；在英语测试中，模型对泛印度群体的刻板印象偏见高于超本地化的果阿群体，反映出预训练数据中存在强烈的泛印度化偏见而非真正的地方文化理解。
AI.conclusion: 当前的NLP模型缺乏对超本地化（超地方）社区身份的文化代表性，现有的多语言模型在处理特定区域文化敏感性时存在显著的偏差和能力不足。

title: Machine Learning and the Random Walk Puzzle: Forecasting the CAD/USD Exchange Rate with Expanding Window Evaluation and SHAP Interpretability
summary: This study examines whether machine learning (ML) models can outperform the naive random walk benchmark in forecasting the monthly USD/CAD exchange rate. Using daily data from the Bank of Canada spanning January 2017 to May 2026, resampled into 113 monthly observations, five ML models are evaluated: linear regression, random forest, gradient boosting, XGBoost, and AdaBoost. These models are benchmarked against the naive random walk model and exponential smoothing with Holt-Winters seasonality (ETS). All models are evaluated using an expanding-window framework to maintain strict out-of-sample integrity, and forecast-accuracy differences are assessed using the Diebold-Mariano (DM) test. Structural break detection identifies four significant breakpoints in the series, corresponding to the escalation of the US-China trade war in 2018, the COVID-19 economic recovery in 2020, the peak of the Bank of Canada rate-hiking cycle in 2022, and the start of the Bank of Canada rate-cutting cycle in 2024. SHAP, or Shapley Additive Explanations, analysis is applied to interpret the drivers of the best-performing ML model. The results show that the naive random walk model remains a formidable benchmark. Linear regression is the only model that statistically outperforms the naive random walk model, with a DM statistic of 3.0585 and a p value of 0.0071, whereas the ML ensemble models show only marginal differences. Random Forest with an expanding-window framework achieves the lowest MAPE of 1.17 percent among all models except the random walk. SHAP analysis confirms that short-term lags, particularly lag1 and lag2, and recent rolling means dominate predictions, consistent with the near-random-walk behavior of exchange rates.

AI.tldr: 该研究对比了多种机器学习模型与传统随机游走模型在 USD/CAD 汇率预测中的表现，结果显示除线性回归外，机器学习模型未能显著战胜随机游走基准，证实了汇率预测的高度不确定性和随机性特征。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究机器学习模型在预测月度 USD/CAD 汇率时，是否能够超越传统的朴素随机游走（naive random walk）基准模型。
AI.method: 使用 2017 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月的月度汇率数据，比较线性回归、随机森林、梯度提升、XGBoost、AdaBoost 与随机游走及 Holt-Winters 指数平滑（ETS）的预测能力；采用扩展窗口框架进行样本外评估，利用 Diebold-Mariano (DM) 检验统计显著性，并通过 SHAP 分析解释模型驱动因素。
AI.result: 线性回归通过了 DM 检验（p=0.0071），在统计上显著优于随机游走模型；随机森林在非随机游走模型中实现了最低的 MAPE（1.17%）；SHAP 分析显示 lag1 和 lag2 以及近期滚动均值对模型预测贡献最大，印证了汇率的随机游走特征。
AI.conclusion: naive random walk 模型在汇率预测中依然表现强劲，具有难以超越的基准地位。线性回归是唯一在统计学上显著优于随机游走模型的模型，而机器学习集成模型仅表现出边际差异。短期滞后项是驱动预测的主要因素。

title: Beyond Monolingual Deep Research: Evaluating Agents and Retrievers with Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus
summary: Deep research agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to search for evidence, reason over retrieved sources, and produce grounded answers. Existing browsing benchmarks, however, largely assume that the user's query and the supporting evidence are written in the same language, leaving open whether agentic search systems can operate when relevant evidence appears in another language. We introduce XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus), a controlled benchmark that preserves the English question-and-answer space of BrowseComp-Plus but varies the languages of the supporting documents. XBCP instantiates two complementary settings: in the cross-lingual setting, each query is paired with evidence in a single assigned language. In the multilingual setting, the full evidence corpus is distributed equally and randomly across 12 languages spanning high-resource and low-resource regimes. We evaluate four deep research agents using sparse and dense multilingual retrievers, measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, search behavior, calibration, citation fidelity, and oracle retrieval. Results reveal substantial degradation when evidence is translated. Even strong, dense retrievers lose evidence recall, and agents become less calibrated and cite evidence less reliably. Notably, accuracy remains lower even when all gold evidence is supplied directly. These findings suggest that cross-lingual deep research exposes both retrieval failures and an independent, agent-side difficulty in integrating language-mismatched evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个跨语言深层研究基准 XBCP。研究发现，面对非英语证据时，即便检索器性能尚可，深层研究代理在整合多语言证据、进行准确推理及可靠引用方面仍存在显著且独立的性能缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的网络浏览基准主要假设用户查询和支持证据处于同一语言环境下，忽略了现实中跨语言信息检索和整合的必要性，需探究代理在语言错配环境下的实际表现。
AI.method: 引入了名为 XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus) 的受控基准，该基准保持了原有的英文问答空间，但将支持文档转换为不同语言。评估了四种深层研究代理，涵盖跨语言（单语证据）和多语言（证据分布在12种不同语种）两种设置，并使用了稀疏和稠密多语言检索器。
AI.result: 实验发现，当证据被翻译为其他语言时，深层研究代理的性能显著下降。主要表现为：密集检索器的证据召回率损失、代理的校准能力变差、引用忠实度降低。即使直接提供所有黄金证据，代理的回答准确率依然较低。
AI.conclusion: 深层研究代理在处理跨语言证据时面临严峻挑战：包括检索阶段的性能下降，以及由于语言不匹配导致的代理端在推理、引用和校准方面的独立性能障碍。当前的跨语言研究能力尚不足以匹配单语言性能。

title: Generated, Parallel, Scalable? A Study of Agentic AI-Generated Julia Code on Supercomputers
summary:
Julia is increasingly used in hpc as a single-language alternative to combining high-level scripting with low-level systems languages, but achieving scalable performance still requires expertise in parallel programming. llms are increasingly used for code generation and are advancing rapidly with each new version. Yet, existing studies focus on single-shot prompting rather than agentic settings, in which an llm autonomously plans, generates, and refines code through tool use.
  Using an OpenCode-based agent extended with a Julia-documentation mcp server, we study agentic generation of parallel Julia code, focusing on task-based execution with Dagger.jl. We evaluate three llms, OpenAI GPT-5.5, Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7, and the open-weight Qwen3-Coder-Next, on three problems with distinct parallel structures: π approximation, tiled general matrix multiplication, and tiled Cholesky decomposition. The generated Dagger.jl implementations are compared against agent-generated Base.Threads and MPI.jl baselines, with shared-memory experiments scaling to 192 cores and distributed-memory experiments on two nodes.
  The agents reliably produce executable code for small inputs but fail at larger scales due to deadlocks, oversubscription, or out-of-memory errors, with the open-weight model affected most severely. The two commercial models scale comparably on Base.Threads and MPI.jl, while their Dagger.jl implementations expose recurring weaknesses in task dependencies, granularity, and scheduling. Agentic AI is promising for producing parallel Julia code, but generating robust, performance-aware implementations for large-scale hpc systems remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了使用智能体（Agent）生成用于HPC的并行Julia代码（基于Dagger.jl），发现虽然智能体能生成基础代码，但在处理大规模HPC系统所需的复杂任务依赖和性能优化方面仍面临显著限制。
AI.motivation: 尽管Julia在高性能计算中日益流行，但实现可扩展性能仍需专家经验。现有大模型研究多局限于单次提示，缺乏在自主规划、生成和优化代码的代理（Agentic）环境下的相关研究。
AI.method: 研究人员开发了一个基于OpenCode的代理，并扩展了Julia文档MCP服务器。评估了三种LLM（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Qwen3-Coder-Next）在三种并行问题（π逼近、平铺矩阵乘法、平铺Cholesky分解）下的表现，并与Base.Threads和MPI.jl基准进行了对比，实验规模最大达到192核及双节点。
AI.result: 智能体在小规模输入下能可靠生成可执行代码，但在大规模场景下常出现死锁、过量订阅或内存溢出问题（开源模型受影响最严重）。商业模型在Base.Threads和MPI.jl上表现相当，但在Dagger.jl任务依赖、粒度控制和调度方面仍存在共同缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 代理人工智能在生成并行Julia代码方面显示出潜力，但要为大规模高性能计算（HPC）系统生成鲁棒且具有性能意识的实现，仍然是一个尚未解决的挑战。

title: Driving, Fast or Slow? Neuro-Symbolic Guidance for Motion Prediction in Multi-Modal Ground Mobility
summary: Accurate and interpretable motion prediction for heterogeneous traffic spaces, including pedestrians, bicycles, cars, and trucks, is essential for safe autonomous navigation. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches remain predominantly black-box, lacking explicit encoding of the regulatory and behavioral constraints of real-world mobility. We propose Trajectory Compliance-Shaping (TraCS), a neuro-symbolic framework that augments existing black-box motion prediction backbones with interpretable and probabilistic first-order logic. To do so, TraCS employs an agentic code-generation pipeline to bridge the gap between natural-language descriptions of traffic regulations and probabilistic motion prediction. Furthermore, TraCS employs a reactive data-streaming inference engine that maintains and efficiently updates compliance landscapes as scenes evolve. To prevent TraCS from overconfidently steering the backbone's predictions in the wrong direction, we propose a neural confidence rating learned as a context-aware attenuation of the compliance signal. We demonstrate on the Argoverse 2 benchmark how TraCS consistently improves state-of-the-art prediction backbones, showing that probabilistic and symbolic compliance reasoning is a broadly applicable and computationally efficient complement to purely neural motion predictors.

AI.tldr: TraCS 是一种神经符号运动预测框架，通过将自然语言描述的交通规则转化为概率逻辑约束，实时引导黑盒预测模型，从而在无需牺牲计算效率的前提下，提升了自动驾驶运动预测的准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的先进运动预测方法多为“黑盒”模型，缺乏对真实世界交通规则和行为约束的显式建模，导致其在异构交通空间（人、车、自行车混行）中的可解释性和安全性不足。
AI.method: 1. 提出神经符号框架 TraCS，通过一阶逻辑约束增强黑盒模型；2. 使用基于代理的代码生成流水线将交通规则转换为形式化约束；3. 采用反应式数据流推理引擎进行实时合规性更新；4. 引入神经置信度评分机制，实现对合规信号的上下文感知衰减，防止过度修正。
AI.result: 在 Argoverse 2 基准测试中，TraCS 能够持续提升现有主流预测骨干网络的性能，并在保持计算效率的同时，显著增强了运动预测的合规逻辑。
AI.conclusion: TraCS证明了将概率逻辑与神经预测器相结合是提升运动预测性能的一种通用且高效的方法，能够显著改善现有黑盒模型的表现，增强其在复杂交通场景下的合规性与可解释性。

title: Spokes: Optimizing for Diverse Pretraining Data Selection
summary: Diversity plays a critical role in data selection, improving performance under fixed data budgets by reducing redundancy and repetition. However, optimizing for diversity is inherently challenging, as it is a set-level property that depends on interactions between data points rather than individual examples. As a result, existing approaches typically rely on proxies or approximations, which often fail to ensure sufficiently diverse subsets. In this work, we directly optimize diversity by introducing a probabilistic diversification framework based on the G-Vendi score, optimized via exponentiated gradient descent. Our method produces subsets that are substantially more diverse than those obtained via random sampling, achieving a +489 increase in G-Vendi score on a 500k-sample subset. We evaluate our approach on FineWeb and DCLM, where it consistently outperforms existing methods. Notably, SPOKES (diversity-only) improves average downstream performance by +0.4 and +0.5 points over random sampling on DCLM and FineWeb, respectively. More importantly, jointly optimizing for both quality and diversity yields the strongest results: SPOKES achieves gains of +1.5 and +1.4 points on DCLM and FineWeb, outperforming all baselines, including semantic deduplication and quality filtering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 SPOKES，一种通过直接优化 G-Vendi 分数来实现数据子集多样性的框架，并在联合质量筛选后，显著提升了大规模语言模型的训练效率和最终性能。
AI.motivation: 数据多样性对在固定预算下提升模型性能至关重要，但由于多样性是样本间的集合级属性，现有方法依赖代理指标（proxies）或近似算法，难以实现理想的数据多样性。
AI.method: SPOKES：基于 G-Vendi 分数的概率多样性框架，利用指数梯度下降（Exponentiated Gradient Descent）直接进行集合级多样性优化，并结合质量筛选指标进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在 500k 样本子集上的 G-Vendi 分数提升了 489 点；在 DCLM 和 FineWeb 数据集上，仅优化多样性即可提升下游任务性能（+0.4至+0.5），而多样性与质量联合优化则实现了更显著的性能提升（+1.4至+1.5）。
AI.conclusion: SPOKES 提出了一种直接优化多样性的概率框架。实验证明，综合优化数据质量与多样性是提升大模型训练集效能的最优策略，显著超越了传统的语义去重和质量筛选方法。

title: Phase-Localized Curation Does Not Help: A Negative Result on Per-Phase Metric Selection for Demonstration Filtering
summary: Manipulation demonstrations have temporal phase structure, and a natural hypothesis is that demonstration-curation metrics should be applied within phases rather than globally. The idea is to segment each trajectory into phases, score each phase with the metric that is locally most informative, and then aggregate. This follows directly from prior work showing that a single global metric can be the best detector of a defect and yet the worst curator of the resulting policy. We test the per-phase hypothesis on three contact-rich LIBERO pick-and-place tasks with a controlled early-release structural defect, comparing phase-gated curation against the same metrics applied uniformly and against a strong single global metric. Across all three tasks and five random seeds per condition, phase-gated curation is never the best curation strategy, and it is the worst of the three on two of the three tasks (Task 1: 86.0 vs. 92.0 for global; Task 3: 22.7 vs. 48.0 for uniform). We trace the failure to a concrete mechanism. When the defect signal is concentrated in a single phase, rank-aggregating across phases dilutes that signal with uninformative scores from defect-free phases, selecting a worse demonstration subset than simply applying the defect-informative metric everywhere. We further show that the per-phase metric selection does not transfer across tasks, since no phase shares a winning metric between any two tasks, so the selection cannot be reused and must be re-derived per task from a noisy sweep. These results bound a plausible and previously untested method, and they argue that practitioners should prefer identifying a single defect-informative metric over decomposing curation by phase. We release the full pipeline, all metric implementations, and per-seed results.

AI.tldr: 该研究反驳了“针对操作演示进行分阶段数据筛选效果更好”的假设，证明单一全局指标在剔除演示缺陷方面比分阶段度量更有效且更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 操作演示具有时间阶段性结构，传统方法通过单一全局指标筛选演示数据可能导致效果不佳。假设将轨迹划分为不同阶段，根据阶段特征应用针对性的度量方式，能够提升数据筛选及模型训练质量。
AI.method: 在三个包含接触丰富的LIBERO拾放任务上，引入受控的早期释放（early-release）结构缺陷；对比三种策展策略：(1) 分阶段门控度量（phase-gated curation）、(2) 统一的全局度量（uniform application）、(3) 强单一全局度量；通过对比评估各策略的性能（任务成功率）并分析失败机理。
AI.result: 分阶段门控度量在测试任务中表现最差，且从未优于其他基准方案。实验揭示了其失败机制：当缺陷集中于特定阶段时，聚合不同阶段的分数会稀释缺陷信号；此外，不同任务间的阶段最优度量指标缺乏迁移性，导致计算成本与工程复杂度增加。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将操作演示分阶段进行局部度量（Phase-gated curation）并非最优策略。实践中，识别并应用单一的、对缺陷具有高信息的全局指标，优于对演示轨迹进行分阶段分解和度量聚合。

title: S1-DeepResearch: Beyond Search, Toward Real-World Long-Horizon Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents aim to solve complex knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon planning, evidence gathering, reasoning, and report generation. While recent progress in search agents has demonstrated strong capabilities in information retrieval and answer verification, most existing training datasets remain search-centric, focusing primarily on closed-ended question answering and information localization. As a result, they mainly train information-seeking behavior while providing limited coverage of key deep research capabilities, including evidence integration, knowledge synthesis, planning, file understanding, and structured report generation. In this work, we propose a unified trajectory construction paradigm for deep research agents that combines closed-ended QA and open-ended exploration. The proposed framework consists of graph-grounded task formulation, agentic trajectory rollout, and multi-dimensional trajectory verification, enabling scalable synthesis of high-quality agentic trajectories spanning long-chain complex reasoning, deep research instruction following, report writing, file understanding and generation, and skills usage. Compared with existing search-oriented datasets, our synthesized trajectories place greater emphasis on knowledge synthesis, complex reasoning, and planning. S1-DeepResearch-32B achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable scale across 20 benchmarks spanning five capability dimensions, including complex reasoning, instruction following, report generation, file understanding, and skills usage. On several challenging deep research benchmarks, it approaches the performance of leading proprietary frontier models. These results highlight the importance of jointly modeling information acquisition, knowledge synthesis, and planning-oriented agent behaviors for building effective deep research agents.

AI.tldr: 针对现有训练数据不足以支持深度研究智能体的问题，本文提出了一种包含图驱动任务建模、轨迹生成与多维验证的统一合成框架，通过训练 S1-DeepResearch-32B 模型，显著提升了智能体在复杂推理与报告生成等任务上的综合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的搜索智能体训练数据集多集中于闭式问答和信息定位，缺乏对深层研究能力（如知识合成、复杂规划、报告生成等）的覆盖，限制了智能体解决复杂知识密集型任务的能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的轨迹构建范式，包含三个关键环节：1. 基于图（Graph）的深度研究任务建模；2. 智能体轨迹展开（Rollout）；3. 多维度轨迹验证。该方法实现了对长链推理、指令遵循、报告撰写、文件理解及技能使用等复杂智能体能力的规模化数据合成。
AI.result: 训练出的 S1-DeepResearch-32B 模型在涵盖复杂推理、指令遵循、报告生成、文件理解和技能使用等五大能力维度的 20 个基准测试中，表现优于同规模的其他开源模型，且在深度研究任务上表现接近顶级闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究成果证明，将信息获取、知识合成与面向规划的智能体行为进行联合建模，对于构建高效的深度研究智能体至关重要。S1-DeepResearch-32B 在同规模开源模型中达到了 SOTA 水平，并在多个挑战性基准上逼近了顶级专有模型。

title: From the NYU Ultracomputer to Modern Exascale: A Historical and Architectural Survey of In-Network Computing and Scalable Synchronization
summary:
This paper presents a historical and technical survey of the hardware architectures, interconnection networks, and synchronization primitives that have shaped massively parallel systems over the past four decades. We examine the design of the NYU Ultracomputer and the IBM Research Parallel Processor Prototype (RP3), focusing on the hardware implementation of the Fetch-and-Add primitive in multistage interconnection networks. We contrast these early attempts at fine-grained, shared-memory hardware combining with the distributed-memory architectures of the IBM SP series and the modern in-network computation models found in NVIDIA SHARP and HPE Slingshot.
  We provide a technical analysis of message-passing synchronization, presenting a complete profiling of MPI operation frequencies and detailing the low-level hardware mapping of one-sided RMA atomics to PCIe Atomics and GPU caches. We investigate the software-hardware boundary in modern deep learning, detailing how HIP translation, Triton compilation, and 4-bit quantization (W4A16) execute on modern heterogeneous silicon.
  To evaluate alternative network node designs, we present a historical hardware case study analyzing the feasibility of implementing active combining switches using message-passing Inmos Transputers programmed in Occam. Finally, we contextualize the evolution of concurrent software synchronization by examining Isaac Dimitrovsky's parallel "group lock" primitive, tracing its downstream echoes in group mutual exclusion (GME) and room synchronization, and reflect on the historical, philosophical divide between American systems engineering and European formal methods.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了过去四十年来并行计算领域从硬件辅助同步到现代网络计算的演进，深入剖析了从经典互连网络架构到现代深度学习栈的底层硬件映射，并探讨了并行编程范式背后的工程与哲学思想演变。
AI.motivation: 为了梳理过去四十年大规模并行系统在体系结构、互连网络及同步机制方面的演进脉络，并分析现代计算基础设施如何从早期设计中继承并重塑这些核心概念。
AI.method: 采用了历史调研、技术对比分析、消息传递性能分析、硬件模拟（Inmos Transputer案例研究）以及现代深度学习工作负载（编译、量化）的底层剖析。
AI.result: 完成了对并行系统架构的全面梳理；剖析了MPI消息传递、RMA原子操作的底层映射及现代深度学习执行链路（如W4A16量化）；通过Inmos Transputer案例验证了主动结合交换机的可行性，并梳理了从“群锁”到现代组互斥机制的理论脉络。
AI.conclusion: 通过回顾过去四十年的并行计算演进，强调了从早期硬件辅助同步（如Fetch-and-Add）到现代数据中心内网络计算（In-network Computing）的范式转变，并指出了美国系统工程实用主义与欧洲形式化方法之间的哲学差异。

title: Incentives and Evidence in Learned Service Orchestration
comment: To be presented at the IEEE 2026 International Congress on Intelligent and Service Oriented Systems Engineering (CISOSE 2026)
summary: Reinforcement learning for service orchestration has been the subject of sustained research for over a decade, yet it is not used in production at scale. The usual explanation is that learned controllers degrade under delayed and noisy telemetry, workload shifts, and uncontrolled tenants. We test whether existing evidence supports that explanation. We evaluate three highly influential RL-based orchestration systems spanning resource allocation, DAG scheduling, and autoscaling, using pre-registered predictions about comparative degradation under production-relevant perturbations and paired inference with family-wise error correction. Across the tests, most predicted performance reversals do not occur. Diagnostic analyses show that these outcomes often reflect comparator collapse, artefact limitations, or evaluation choices rather than evidence that learned controllers tolerate the perturbations. One apparent advantage under observation lag is roughly fortyfold compared to a Kubernetes HPA-equivalent controller. Another widely cited result cannot be reconstructed from its released artefact, and the strongest reproducible margin is far smaller than the published results. Conclusions also reverse under changes in perturbation magnitude and evaluation mode. Based on these results and broader patterns in the literature, we identify an institutional problem. Publication and review incentives favour benchmark gains against convenient comparators, even when those gains provide little evidence of deployment performance. We argue that the problem is not solely technical. Rather, it is institutional, so learned orchestration needs production-grade comparators, registered perturbation models, separate operational metrics, and publication criteria that reward reproducible operational evidence. Without these changes, the literature can grow without establishing whether learning improves orchestration.

AI.tldr: RL编排研究领域存在“虚假繁荣”，现有的性能提升往往难以在生产环境复现。研究指出，该困境是学术发表激励导向导致的制度性问题，而非单纯的技术局限，呼吁转向更严谨的生产级评估标准。
AI.motivation: 尽管强化学习（RL）在服务编排领域研究已久，但在工业界大规模应用受阻。现存观点认为其原因是控制器在面对延迟、噪声、工作负载变化和多租户干扰时性能会降级，本研究旨在验证该解释是否获得现有证据支持。
AI.method: 针对三类具有高影响力的基于RL的编排系统（资源分配、DAG调度、自动伸缩），利用预注册的性能降级预测、成对推理分析（paired inference）及家族错误率校正（family-wise error correction）进行实证评估。
AI.result: 评估发现，大多数预期的性能反转并未出现；结果往往受限于对照组失效（comparator collapse）、实验伪影限制或评估偏见。例如，某“40倍优势”在观察滞后测试中远未达到预期，部分研究结果无法复现，且结论对扰动幅度和评估模式极其敏感。
AI.conclusion: 领域存在制度性问题，偏向于追求针对便捷对比系统的性能提升而非真实部署环境下的鲁棒性。为推动学术研究转化为工业可用，必须建立生产级的对比标准、注册干扰模型、分离操作指标，并调整发表评审标准以奖励可复现的操作证据。

title: LLMs on Tabular Data with Limited Semantics: Evidence from Industrial Car Retrofit Prediction
summary: Industrial retrofit planning depends on structured operational data rather than free text: planners must estimate whether a newly registered prototype will require a retrofit, which retrofit package it will need, and how long the work will take. We study an industrial dataset linking a prototype-registration system (284,271 vehicles) with a retrofit-management system (48,716 cleaned visits), and compare strong tabular machine learning baselines with three LLM-based strategies on row-serialized inputs: embedding features (Amazon Titan), direct prompted classification (Claude Sonnet 4), and an ML+LLM stacking approach. Across binary occurrence prediction, 15-way retrofit-type classification, per-visit duration regression, and an aggregated monthly benchmark, classical tree ensembles remain the strongest standalone models. However, the LLM results reveal a consistent pattern: embeddings remain useful on tables (binary AUC = 0.982), direct prompting collapses once semantic signal is stripped by hashing (binary AUC = 0.500; multiclass weighted F1 = 0.018), and hybrid stacking yields the best manually built multiclass model (weighted F1 = 0.626). On the monthly benchmark, lag-based machine learning outperforms time-series foundation models, though Chronos-small remains competitive in zero-shot forecasting. The results suggest that on privacy-constrained industrial tables, LLMs are more effective as complementary components than as replacements for strong tabular baselines.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在工业表格数据预测中，直接使用大语言模型（LLM）效果不佳，而将其作为特征嵌入器或与传统机器学习模型进行堆叠（Stacking），能显著提升模型性能。传统树模型仍是处理此类结构化数据的基准核心。
AI.motivation: 在工业改造计划中，准确预测原型车是否需要改造、选择何种方案及预测工时至关重要。当前任务依赖结构化数据，旨在探究LLM在处理此类非文本、隐私敏感的工业表格数据时的实际效能，以辅助决策。
AI.method: 对比了三种大模型策略：(1) 嵌入特征提取 (Amazon Titan)；(2) 直接提示词分类 (Claude Sonnet 4)；(3) ML+LLM 堆叠 (Stacking)。并与传统的表格机器学习模型（树模型）及时间序列基础模型（Chronos-small）进行了基准对比。
AI.result: (1) 传统树模型预测表现最优；(2) LLM Embedding在二分类上表现出色 (AUC 0.982)；(3) 脱敏数据直接提示表现极差 (AUC 0.500)；(4) LLM与ML的堆叠模型在多分类任务中表现最佳 (F1 0.626)；(5) 时间序列任务中，滞后特征的传统机器学习优于专用时间序列基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 在处理隐私受限的工业表格数据时，大语言模型（LLM）更适合作为现有强基线的补充组件（特征提取器或堆叠模型的一部分），而非替代方案。传统的树模型在结构化工业数据任务中依然最具优势。

title: OSDAG: Online Scheduling for Efficient Multi-Robot Collaboration
summary: Coordinating heterogeneous multi-robot systems (MRS) for complex, long-horizon tasks requires both flexible high-level reasoning and efficient low-level scheduling. Existing LLM-based approaches address the reasoning side but introduce two critical bottlenecks: (1) repeated LLM inference during execution, which inflates latency with agent count, and (2) offline, pre-committed scheduling, which forces robots to idle while waiting for sequentially ordered predecessors even when independent work is available. This paper presents OSDAG, a novel framework that integrates LLM-based task reasoning with Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) representation and constraint-aware online scheduling. The LLM is invoked once to decompose a natural-language instruction into a dependency-annotated task graph, and a lightweight online scheduler then allocates ready tasks to idle agents in real time. The DAG representation encodes both precedence and resource constraints, ensuring correctness while exposing all available parallelism. Experiments across five benchmark scenarios demonstrate that OSDAG achieves 5-15x faster reasoning time compared to dialogue-based methods, reduces makespan by up to 38% over sequential baselines, and maintains competitive success rates. Both simulation and real-world experiments on dual-arm manipulation tasks validate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed approach for efficient multi-robot coordination. The website and resources are available at http://thanhnguyencanh.github.io/LLM_DAG4MultiRobot

AI.tldr: OSDAG 是一种多机器人协作框架，它通过 LLM 一次生成任务依赖图 (DAG)，并配合在线调度器实现实时任务分配，显著降低了推理延迟并提升了系统执行并行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多机器人系统存在两大瓶颈：LLM 反复推理导致的延迟问题，以及“离线/预先设定”调度机制导致的资源闲置和执行效率低下，难以处理复杂、长周期的多机器人任务。
AI.method: 提出 OSDAG 框架：1) 利用 LLM 进行预推理，将指令转化为带有依赖关系的 DAG（有向无环图）；2) 引入轻量级在线调度器，动态地将就绪任务分配给空闲机器人，实现任务的实时并行执行。
AI.result: 在五个基准场景中，OSDAG 的推理时间较对话式方法提升 5-15 倍，任务完成时间 (makespan) 缩短高达 38%，并在仿真与双臂机器人物理实验中证明了其有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: OSDAG 框架通过结合 LLM 的高层推理能力与 DAG 在线调度机制，有效解决了异构多机器人系统中的推理延迟和资源闲置问题，为复杂任务提供了高效、稳健的协调方案。

title: Evaluating and Preserving Lexical Stress in English-to-Chinese Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) systems have achieved impressive progress in semantic accuracy and speech naturalness. However, the cross-lingual transfer of lexical stress, a vital cue for emphasis and speaker intent, remains heavily underexplored, compounded by a lack of reliable automatic evaluation metrics for tonal languages like Chinese. We investigate English-to-Chinese S2ST stress transfer by constructing a stress-annotated Chinese dataset and an XLS-R-based Mandarin stress detector. Integrating this with the English EmphAssess system, we propose a novel objective metric for cross-lingual stress evaluation. Furthermore, we fine-tune CosyVoice3 to build a stress-aware S2ST system. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed S2ST architecture significantly outperforms existing systems in stress translation capability while maintaining competitive translation quality. Furthermore, our evaluation metric exhibits a strong correlation with human subjective judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对S2ST系统中重音迁移及评价匮乏的问题，提出了涵盖重音标注、客观评估指标及感知重音的S2ST模型，显著提升了跨语言重音表达效果。
AI.motivation: 当前语音到语音翻译（S2ST）在语义和自然度上已有进展，但对词汇重音（表达意图的关键）的跨语言迁移研究不足，且缺乏针对中文等声调语言的自动化重音评估指标。
AI.method:
1. 数据集构建：建立了一个带重音标注的中文数据集。
2. 评估指标：结合XLS-R构建普通话重音检测器，并整合EmphAssess系统，提出了一种客观的跨语言重音评估指标。
3. 模型优化：基于CosyVoice3进行微调，构建了感知重音的Speech-to-Speech Translation（S2ST）系统。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，所提S2ST架构在重音翻译能力上显著优于现有系统，同时保持了良好的翻译质量，且自动化评估指标与人工主观评价具有高度相关性。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建压力标注数据集和新型评估指标，证明了在S2ST系统中实现词汇重音的跨语言迁移是可行的，且提出的stress-aware模型有效提升了重音表达能力，同时也弥补了针对中文语音重音评价工具的空白。

title: TriAdReview: Triangular Adversarial Review Architecture for Multi-Model Technical Document Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for technical document generation, yet single-model outputs often suffer from over-engineering, security blind spots, and incomplete coverage. We propose TriAdReview, a triangular adversarial review architecture that employs two independent reviewer models (engineering and boundary perspectives) and a triangular judging mechanism to iteratively improve a generator model's output. We evaluate TriAdReview across five benchmark tasks - architecture design, code generation, proposal review, security audit, and requirements analysis - using three configurations: single model (baseline), dual model (single review), and triple model (full system). Results across 75 experiments (n=5 per cell) show that the triple model configuration achieves a 10.1% overall improvement over the single model baseline (26.2 vs. 23.8 out of 50; p<0.05, paired t-test), with particularly strong gains on security audit (+27.6%), code generation (+20.8%), and architecture design (+15.6%). A second scorer (mimo-v2.5-pro) confirms the direction with a smaller effect (+2.7%), suggesting moderate inter-rater agreement. However, the system shows a -7.5% degradation on requirements analysis, revealing that adversarial review architectures have a structural bias toward simplification that is counterproductive for completeness-oriented tasks. We analyze this boundary condition through a task-type framework and demonstrate that reviewer prompt adaptation partially mitigates the issue. Our findings provide the first empirical characterization of when multi-model adversarial review helps versus harms, with implications for the design of collaborative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 TriAdReview 架构，通过引入多视角对抗式评审机制提升技术文档生成质量；研究证明了该系统在提高技术准确性方面的有效性，同时也揭示了其对复杂详尽任务可能带来的结构性负面影响。
AI.motivation: 现有单体大语言模型在生成技术文档时，容易出现过度工程化、存在安全漏洞或内容覆盖不全等局限性，需要一种多智能体协作机制来提升输出质量。
AI.method: 提出一种“三角对抗式评审”架构（TriAdReview），包含一个生成模型及两个具有不同视角（工程视角与边界/安全视角）的独立评审模型，并配合三角裁决机制对输出进行迭代优化。通过五个基准测试任务对比了单模型、双模型及三模型配置下的性能。
AI.result: 在75次实验中，三模型配置整体性能较单模型 baseline 提升 10.1%；在安全审计（+27.6%）、代码生成（+20.8%）及架构设计（+15.6%）方面增益显著；但在需求分析任务中出现了 7.5% 的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: TriAdReview 架构在技术性任务（如安全审计、代码生成）中表现卓越，能有效纠正单模型的不足，但在侧重详尽性的任务（如需求分析）中存在负面影响，体现了对抗性评审在简洁化倾向与全面性需求之间的权衡。

title: Transfer Learning for FHIR Questionnaire Terminology Binding
summary: Electronic prior authorization workflows require FHIR Questionnaire items to carry LOINC codes, yet most items in the HL7 Da Vinci CDS-Library lack these bindings. We treat this as a retrieval problem: given a Questionnaire item's text, find the correct LOINC code in a pool of 97,314 active codes. We compare six methods (TF-IDF, frozen MiniLM, BioBERT, BioLORD, contrastively fine-tuned MiniLM, and a TF-IDF+GPT reranker) on a 54-item evaluation set spanning three query styles (natural question, medium, and terse). No single method wins on every metric. BioLORD, a frozen encoder pre-trained on biomedical ontology definitions, has the best top-rank accuracy (R@1 = 0.185, MRR = 0.246) despite seeing no task-specific data, while a contrastive fine-tune on raw LHC-Forms pairs takes R@5 (0.389) and R@10 (0.426). A distribution-shift ablation shows why the fine-tune in our main table is not the strongest one: adding GPT-generated paraphrases to the raw pairs drops R@5 from 0.389 to 0.296, so the augmented union underperforms raw-only training on every metric except R@1. Performance peaks at 5k training pairs. Error analysis on BioLORD's R@1 failures shows that wrong-specificity and ambiguous-text cases together account for 59% of errors.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了自动为FHIR问卷项匹配LOINC代码的方法，比较了多种检索模型。研究发现，利用生物医学本体预定义的BioLORD模型在首选匹配上最为准确，而经过适当数据量微调的对比学习模型在更广泛的预测范围上表现更好，且数据增强可能会因分布偏移带来负面影响。
AI.motivation: 电子预授权工作流（ePA）要求FHIR问卷项必须包含LOINC编码以实现互操作性，但HL7 Da Vinci CDS-Library中的现有项目大多缺乏此类绑定，需要自动化的代码匹配方案以提高医疗数据交换效率。
AI.method: 将问题定义为检索问题，在97,314个LOINC代码池中进行匹配。对比了六种方法：TF-IDF、冻结的MiniLM、BioBERT、BioLORD、对比微调的MiniLM以及TF-IDF+GPT重排序器；并在包含三种查询风格的54个项目数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: BioLORD（冻结编码器）在R@1（0.185）和MRR（0.246）上表现最优；针对原始LHC-Forms对进行对比微调的模型在R@5（0.389）和R@10（0.426）上领先。实验发现数据增强（使用GPT改写）会导致性能下降，说明存在分布偏移问题。错误分析显示约59%的错误源于代码特异性匹配错误或问卷文本歧义。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，针对FHIR问卷项的LOINC代码检索是一个极具挑战性的任务。虽然没有任何单一模型在所有指标上占优，但大规模预训练的任务无关模型（如BioLORD）在首位命中率上表现最佳，而针对特定任务进行对比微调的模型在较宽的容错范围（R@5/R@10）上更具优势；此外，数据量及数据质量（分布偏移情况）对微调效果有显著影响。

title: HAMON: Passive Optical Sequence Mixing for Long-Horizon Forecasting
summary:
Simple linear and frequency-domain models remain surprisingly competitive in long-horizon time-series forecasting, and recent mechanistic evidence suggests that standard forecasting benchmarks may not require the dense superposed representations that make transformers powerful in other domains. This raises a substrate-level question: if the core forecasting operator is often low-complexity and approximately linear, does it need to be implemented as learned digital temporal mixing? We introduce HAMON, a passive diffractive optical forecasting core in which historical values are encoded onto an optical aperture, future positions are left dark, and cascaded trainable phase masks with free-space diffraction shape the forecast directly in the output field. At inference, prediction is performed by a single passive optical propagation pass with no trainable digital sequence-mixing layer.
  Across standard benchmarks, HAMON outperforms the strongest digital baselines considered on ETTm2 at all horizons and on ETTh2 at all but the longest horizon, improving MSE by up to 14\% and doing so consistently across horizons rather than at isolated points. It is competitive on Weather and trails the strongest baselines on the remaining ETT settings and on the high-channel-count Traffic and Electricity datasets. Phase encoding, intensity-compatible readout, and phase-scrambling ablations, together with a TorchOptics cross-simulator check, indicate that the forecasts arise from the data-bearing optical field rather than from a digital forecasting head. Because the passive core uses standard Fourier optics, HAMON defines a concrete target for optical hardware and for passive physical sequence mixing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HAMON，一种利用无源衍射光学核心进行时间序列预测的新架构，证明了无需复杂的数字序列混合，利用光学物理特性即可实现高效的长序列预测。
AI.motivation: 鉴于简单的线性及频域模型在长序列预测中表现优异，且目前的基准测试可能并不需要Transformer那种复杂的重叠表示，研究人员试图探讨：核心预测算子是否可以通过物理光学实现，而非传统的数字化计算？
AI.method: 提出了HAMON（一种有源衍射光学预测核心），将历史数据编码为光学孔径上的相位，通过级联的可训练相位掩膜和自由空间衍射来直接生成预测输出，在推理阶段无需任何数字序列混合层。
AI.result: HAMON在ETTm2和ETTh2等标准基准测试中表现出色，MSE提升达14%，证明了其作为一种高效的、基于物理的预测算子的潜力。
AI.conclusion: HAMON证明了利用无源衍射光学进行时间序列预测的可行性。这不仅为光学计算提供了一个具体的硬件实现目标，还挑战了长序列预测中复杂数字序列混合模型的必要性。

title: DRIFT: Risk-Constrained Diffusion with Imitation Priors for Mixed-Autonomy Traffic Generation
summary: Future intelligent transportation systems are envisioned to evolve toward a long-term mixed-autonomy paradigm, where human-driven vehicles (HVs) and autonomous vehicles (AVs) coexist within highly coupled traffic ecosystems. Such coexistence introduces pronounced heterogeneity, amplified uncertainty, and increasingly intricate interaction dynamics. In this context, it remains fundamentally challenging to simultaneously capture the heterogeneous behavioral distribution shifts arising from dynamic AV penetration, generate diverse yet executable trajectories under strong inter-vehicle coupling, and conduct reliable closed-loop safety and stability diagnostics for rare but high-impact events. To this end, we present risk-constrained diffusion with imitation priors (DRIFT), a mixed-autonomy traffic generation framework which unifies heterogeneity-aware conditional encoding, conditional diffusion-based executable trajectory generation, and progressive adversarial alignment enhanced by risk-aware long-tail feedback, thereby enabling traffic behaviors to be iteratively generated, filtered, selected, and validated within a closed-loop execution pipeline. In addition, a unified evaluation protocol is developed to jointly characterize safety, efficiency, and closed-loop stability across representative traffic scenarios and AV penetration regimes. Experimental results demonstrate that DRIFT achieves a strong safety-efficiency trade-off in closed-loop mixed-autonomy benchmarks, while further revealing the critical influence of candidate executability, online selection, and long-tail feedback on executable traffic evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DRIFT框架，通过条件扩散模型与风险感知闭环反馈机制，解决了混合自动驾驶交通流中轨迹生成、高耦合交互与闭环安全性验证的挑战。
AI.motivation: 混合自动驾驶（AV/HV共存）环境下，交通流动系统存在高度异构性、不确定性及复杂的交互动态。现有方法难以同时处理AV渗透率变化导致的分布漂移、强耦合下的多样化轨迹生成，以及针对极端罕见交通事件的闭环安全性诊断。
AI.method: 提出DRIFT（Risk-constrained Diffusion with Imitation Priors）框架，包含：1）异构感知条件编码器；2）基于条件扩散模型的可执行轨迹生成器；3）集成风险感知长尾反馈的渐进式对抗对齐机制。此外，设计了一套联合评估实验方案，涵盖安全性、效率及闭环稳定性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DRIFT在闭环混合自动驾驶基准测试中实现了安全性与效率的良好平衡，并证实了该框架在处理可执行性、在线筛选及长尾情境方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: DRIFT框架通过集成生成模型与闭环反馈机制，有效解决了混合交通流中高复杂度的交互建模与安全性验证难题，揭示了执行约束、在线选择和长尾反馈对提升交通系统整体性能的关键作用。

title: PHINN: Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for Rare-Event Time Series Generation
summary:
Rare events in time series are critical to model but hard to learn due to data scarcity. Current generative models struggle with extreme values. We observe that rare events leave distinct topological fingerprints - transitions in Betti numbers from point-cloud embeddings - that are more stable and discriminative than statistical moments.
  We introduce PHINN, a flow-matching framework using dynamic Betti curves as conditioning signals and a persistence landscape loss for homology consistency. It scales to multivariate data, includes a natural-language interface to set Betti targets, supports cross-domain meta-learning and few-shot generation, and provides certified adversarial robustness.
  On financial, epidemiological, and multi-modal benchmarks, PHINN outperforms statistical and diffusion baselines in topological fidelity (beta-RMSE down 41-63%, transition accuracy up 84%) and matches jump-diffusion models in tail coverage while exceeding them in shape fidelity. All results have 95% confidence intervals.

AI.tldr: PHINN 是一种将拓扑数据分析与流匹配相结合的新型生成框架，通过利用稀有事件的“拓扑指纹”显著提升了极端时间序列数据的生成质量与保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型在处理时间序列中的稀有事件（极端值）时存在数据匮乏和学习困难，统计矩难以捕捉这些事件的本质特征。作者认为稀有事件在拓扑结构（点云嵌入的 Betti 数演变）上具有更稳定且可区分的“指纹”。
AI.method: 提出一种基于流匹配（flow-matching）的生成框架 PHINN，利用动态 Betti 曲线作为条件信号，并引入持久同调（persistence homology）景观损失函数以确保拓扑一致性。该方法支持多变量数据、自然语言控制及少样本学习。
AI.result: 在金融、流行病学等多模态基准测试中，PHINN 的拓扑保真度（beta-RMSE 降低 41-63%，转换精度提升 84%）优于统计和扩散模型；在尾部覆盖上与跳跃扩散模型持平，但在形状保真度上更胜一筹。具备统计显著性（95% 置信区间）。
AI.conclusion: PHINN 通过引入拓扑特征（Betti曲线）作为条件信号，有效解决了时间序列中稀有事件生成的难题，在拓扑保真度和尾部覆盖能力上均优于现有的生成模型。

title: Acting While Understanding: Asynchronous Semantic-Action Decoupling for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong task understanding and generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the high computational cost of full-model inference limits their deployment in low-latency, high-frequency closed-loop control. We propose an asynchronous semantic-action decoupling framework that separates semantic understanding from action generation along the internal semantic-action interface of existing VLAs, without redesigning the vision-language backbone or introducing an external planner. A low-frequency understanding module asynchronously updates reusable semantic conditions, while a high-frequency action module continuously outputs control actions without repeatedly invoking the full model. To mitigate the temporal mismatch between stale semantics and the current execution state, we further introduce historical action conditioning and time-misalignment training, which provide short-horizon execution context and improve feedback control robustness under stale semantic conditions. Experiments on LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$ and UniVLA, together with real-robot deployment using UniVLA, show that the proposed framework achieves up to 35.6 Hz server-side action-module inference throughput and offers a low-intrusion path to high-frequency closed-loop control without running full VLA inference at control rate.

AI.tldr: 针对VLA模型推理延迟高的问题，本文提出了一种异步语义-动作解耦方法，通过低频更新语义、高频生成动作，并结合历史动作补偿，在保证性能的前提下实现了机器人高频闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）虽然在机器人任务理解上表现出色，但全模型推理计算成本过高，限制了其在需要低延迟、高频闭环控制的机器人场景中的部署。
AI.method: 提出了一种异步语义-动作解耦框架：1. 将语义理解与动作生成分离；2. 低频异步更新语义上下文；3. 高频模块根据缓存的语义和历史动作输出控制指令；4. 通过“历史动作调节”和“时间失准训练”解决语义滞后带来的鲁棒性问题。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准测试（使用π0.5和UniVLA模型）及真实机器人实验中，该框架实现了高达35.6 Hz的服务端动作模块推理吞吐量，且无需以控制频率运行完整的VLA模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了在不重构VLA模型的情况下，通过语义与动作解耦，以极低的推理开销达成高频率（35.6 Hz）的闭环机器人控制，证明了该方法在提升VLA机器人实时性方面的有效性。

title: Adapting Reinforcement Learning with Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Explainable Detection of Hateful and Propagandistic Memes
summary: Hateful and propagandistic memes exploit the interplay between images and text to convey harmful intent that neither modality reveals alone. Although thinking-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced vision-language understanding, their application to meme content moderation remains underexplored. We propose a reinforcement learning-based post-training method that improves classification performance and reference-based explanation quality in thinking-based MLLMs via task-specific rewards and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Concretely, we (i) conduct a systematic empirical study of off-the-shelf MLLMs for hateful and propagandistic meme understanding across English and Arabic benchmarks, (ii) extend existing meme datasets with weakly supervised chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales via distillation and multi-LLM fine-grained propaganda annotations, (iii) introduce a GRPO-based objective with thinking-length regularization that jointly optimizes classification accuracy and explanation quality, and (iv) investigate self-supervised GRPO on unlabeled memes using consensus-based pseudo-labels. Experiments on the Hateful Memes and ArMeme benchmarks show that our approach improves over previously reported results on FHM accuracy (up to +2.1%, from 79.9% to 82.0%) and on ArMeme macro-F1 (up to +7.6 points, from 0.536 to 0.612 with explanations; +6.1 compared to the original ArMeme benchmark), while also generating natural-language explanations. On ArMeme, sequence-classification baselines remain stronger in terms of raw accuracy, whereas our approach provides more balanced per-class performance along with explanations. We publicly release our code, data extensions, and evaluation resources.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于GRPO的思维链后训练方法，显著增强了多模态大模型对仇恨及宣传类模因的分类准确度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型（MLLMs）在理解模因（meme）中图文结合的深层有害意图方面尚显不足，且在模因内容审核任务中的应用开发有限，缺乏高质量的表现解释能力。
AI.method: 1. 提出了基于强化学习的后训练方法，利用任务特定奖励函数和组相对策略优化（GRPO）；2. 引入思维长度正则化以平衡准确率与解释质量；3. 通过知识蒸馏和多LLM标注扩展了模因数据集的思维链理性及细粒度注释；4. 探索了利用共识伪标签进行自监督GRPO训练。
AI.result: 在Hateful Memes数据集上，准确率提升至82.0%（+2.1%）；在ArMeme数据集上，Macro-F1提升至0.612（+7.6%），并具备了生成自然语言解释的能力。研究证明了该方法在提供平衡的类间性能和可解释性方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的后训练方法通过整合思维链（CoT）推理和GRPO优化，显著提升了多模态大模型在仇恨和宣传模因识别及解释方面的能力，实现了分类准确性与解释质量的平衡，并展现了在低资源语言（如阿拉伯语）上的有效性。

title: An Integrable Token Mixing Layer from the Generalized Yang Baxter Equation
summary: The YB Mixer is a sequence token mixing layer derived from free fermion and generalized Yang Baxter structures. It applies a core principle from integrable systems where a local algebraic constraint guarantees global computational stability. By using the Ising exchange algebra the mixer creates a free fermionic structure that acts as an exactly norm preserving orthogonal map. This algebra also produces commuting transfer matrices which allow inference to be order free and adaptable to any variable budget. To ensure the model can generalize to longer sequence lengths it uses a spectral circulant generator. This generator maintains the crucial orthogonal and commuting properties of the system. The result is a highly stable and mathematically grounded architecture for sequence processing.

AI.tldr: YB Mixer 是受可积系统启发的序列混合层，通过 Ising 代数和谱循环生成器实现了精确的正交归一化和可变长的稳定推理。
AI.motivation: 传统序列建模方法在处理长序列时可能存在稳定性不足及推理灵活性受限的问题，亟需一种具有更强数学基础和计算稳定性的架构。
AI.method: 1. 引入基于自由费米子和广义杨-巴克斯特（Yang-Baxter）结构的 YB Mixer 层；2. 利用 Ising 交换代数实现正交映射，确保范数保持；3. 利用交换转移矩阵实现推理的无序性和可变预算；4. 采用谱循环生成器（spectral circulant generator）以支持长序列外推。
AI.result: 构建了一个具有全局计算稳定性、归一化性质且支持任意推理长度和预算的序列处理架构，其内部机制在数学上是精确可积的。
AI.conclusion: YB Mixer 是一种基于可积系统理论构建的高稳定性、数学严谨的序列建模架构，通过 Ising 代数和谱循环生成器确保了运算的归一化和推理的灵活性。

title: Retrievable Gradients: Continual Post-Training Without Cumulative Weight Drift
summary: Continual post-training enables models to absorb emerging knowledge after deployment, but repeatedly updating shared parameters can accumulate weight drift, potentially causing catastrophic forgetting and degrading general capabilities. Retrieval-augmented generation avoids such parameter drift, yet often lacks the depth of parametric knowledge integration. In this paper, we propose ReGrad (Retrievable Gradients), a new paradigm that treats gradients as retrievable units of knowledge. ReGrad pre-computes document-specific gradients offline, stores them in an indexed Gradient Bank, and retrieves only query-relevant gradients at inference time for temporary weight adaptation. However, raw language-modeling gradients are optimized for token-level document reconstruction rather than for query-driven knowledge use. We therefore introduce a bi-level meta-learning objective that reshapes document-derived gradients into generalizable adaptation signals for downstream tasks. Experiments across general and domain-specific settings show that \textsc{ReGrad} outperforms CPT and RAG baselines, enabling scalable and reversible parametric knowledge injection without accumulating weight drift.

AI.tldr: ReGrad 提出将梯度视为可检索的知识单元，通过双层元学习优化这些梯度，使得模型能够在推理时进行高效的临时权重适配，从而实现参数知识的动态更新且避免了长期权重漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有的持续预训练（CPT）易导致权重漂移和灾难性遗忘，而检索增强生成（RAG）难以实现深度的参数化知识融合；现有方法在处理新兴知识更新与保持模型通用能力之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 1. Gradient Bank（梯度库）：预计算并索引文档特定的梯度；2. Inference-time Adaptation：在推理阶段根据查询检索相关梯度并进行临时权重适配；3. Bi-level Meta-learning（双层元学习）：通过优化目标重塑文档梯度，使其更适用于下游任务。
AI.result: ReGrad 在通用和特定领域任务中均优于 CPT 和 RAG 基线方法，证明了该方法能够实现可缩放且可逆的参数知识注入，且不会导致权重漂移。
AI.conclusion: ReGrad 通过将梯度转化为可检索的知识单元，成功在保持模型参数稳定性的同时实现了高效、可逆的参数化知识注入，克服了持续预训练（CPT）导致的权重漂移和检索增强生成（RAG）知识深度不足的问题。

title: Robust and Automated Reconfiguration of Byzantine Wide-Area Replication
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 56th Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN 2026), Charlotte, USA, June 22-25, 2026
summary: Distributed systems handle adversarial nodes through redundancy, which imposes a significant performance overhead. In blockchain systems, Byzantine fault-tolerant state-machine replication (BFT-SMR) is the replicated service that totally orders client transactions before execution. While prior research has primarily focused on designing novel consensus algorithms with improved performance, recent studies have shown that further gains can be achieved through configuration optimization. More precisely, replicas can monitor network latency to dynamically assign the leader role and tune voting weights, thereby improving consensus performance. However, we identify three vulnerabilities in this process that Byzantine nodes can exploit. To address these weaknesses, we propose Beware, a reconfiguration framework that filters out falsified latency reports, computes robust weight distributions, and applies machine learning to converge towards Byzantine-resilient configurations. Our evaluation shows that Beware reduces consensus latency by up to 45% compared to existing solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Beware框架，通过安全过滤网络延迟报告并应用机器学习技术进行权重分配，解决了BFT-SMR系统在动态优化配置时的拜占庭攻击漏洞，并将共识延迟降低了45%。
AI.motivation: 尽管通过动态调整领导者和投票权重可以优化分布式系统（特别是BFT-SMR）的性能，但现有的优化方案缺乏对拜占庭节点的防御，容易被恶意节点利用网络延迟报告进行攻击。
AI.method: 提出一种名为Beware的重配置框架，包含三个核心机制：1. 过滤被篡改的延迟报告；2. 计算鲁棒的投票权重分布；3. 利用机器学习技术收敛至拜占庭防御能力最强的配置方案。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，与现有方案相比，Beware框架在保持拜占庭鲁棒性的同时，将共识性能延迟降低了高达45%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入Beware框架，分布式系统可以在保证拜占庭容错的前提下，安全且有效地利用网络拓扑信息优化配置，从而显著提升共识性能。

title: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts a pretrained model to each prompt via parameter updates, improving accuracy under pretraining-to-test distribution shifts. Yet, its performance often suffers from instability and sensitivity to hyperparameters such as update steps and subspace. We explain this behavior through a decision-theoretic lens, treating TTT as implicit Bayesian inference in the kernel regime. Under a Gaussian process benchmark, we show that TTT reduces prediction error when updates are spectrally matched to the prompt's signal-to-noise ratio and aligned with query-relevant eigen-directions. This perspective underpins the following results: (1) we show when fixed update steps and subspaces fail under distribution shifts, motivating adaptive strategies; (2) we prove that selecting update steps via prompt evidence admits a PAC-Bayes guarantee against overfitting; and (3) we characterize the Bayes-optimal update subspace under a linear-Gaussian correction model, yielding a scoring rule for selecting Transformer blocks and heads. Our theory helps explain the empirical instability of TTT, taking a step toward principled guidance for when, how far, and which directions to adapt.

AI.tldr: 本文运用决策理论和高斯过程分析了测试时训练（TTT）的不稳定性，证明了其为隐含贝叶斯推理，并引入了基于提示词证据的自适应更新策略和最优子空间选择机制，以提升TTT在分布偏移下的表现与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 尽管测试时训练（TTT）能提高分布偏移下的模型性能，但该方法通常表现出不稳定性，且高度依赖超参数（如更新步数和子空间选择），缺乏明确的理论指导。
AI.method: 从决策理论（decision-theoretic）出发，将TTT建模为核机制（kernel regime）下的隐含贝叶斯推理；利用高斯过程基准进行理论分析，推导出更新步数与子空间选择的理论约束。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了更新步数和子空间在分布偏移下的失效条件；2. 证明了通过提示词证据选择更新步数可提供PAC-Bayes过拟合保障；3. 给出了线性高斯修正模型下的贝叶斯最优更新子空间，并据此提出了选择Transformer模块和注意力头的评分规则。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过决策理论视角解释了测试时训练（TTT）的不稳定性，证明了其本质是核机制下的隐含贝叶斯推理。研究表明，通过基于提示词证据（prompt evidence）的自适应策略和最优子空间选择，可以有效克服TTT的敏感性问题，为模型适应提供了理论指导与原则性框架。

title: Covariance-Regulated Recursive Koopman Learning for Nonlinear Systems with Uncertain Time-Varying Dynamics
summary: Offline models for autonomous robots often fail under time-varying dynamics outside their training distribution. Koopman operator theory offers a linear representation of nonlinear dynamics via lifting, but its transition to real-time recursive estimation may suffer numerical vulnerabilities: covariance windup under low excitation when using exponential forgetting, and vanishing gain without forgetting. This paper introduces a Covariance-Regulated Recursive Koopman Learning (CR-RKL) framework with two complementary strategies--error dead-zone gating and constant-trace normalization--each independently capable of preventing covariance explosion and parameter freezing, with the latter additionally preserving the geometric structure of uncertainty. Validated on a non-holonomic differential-drive robot with wheel slip and Stribeck friction and on a 26-gram butterfly-inspired flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle, CR-RKL achieves numerically stable and accurate online modeling, and when embedded in model predictive control, it maintains reliable tracking performance under uncertain, time-varying dynamics.

AI.tldr: 针对在线 Koopman 系统辨识中的数值漂移与协方差不稳定问题，提出了 CR-RKL 框架，通过误差门控和迹归一化策略，有效提升了变动态环境下的机器人控制鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 离线机器人模型在面对训练分布之外的时变动力学时表现不佳。尽管 Koopman 算子理论可以通过提升（lifting）将非线性动力学转化为线性表示，但在实时递归估计中常面临由指数遗忘导致的“协方差缠绕（covariance windup）”或无遗忘导致的“增益消失（vanishing gain）”等数值问题。
AI.method: 提出了协方差调节递归 Koopman 学习（CR-RKL）框架。该方法包含两种互补策略：1. 误差死区门控（Error dead-zone gating），用于抑制低激励下的协方差过度增长；2. 常数迹归一化（Constant-trace normalization），用于防止参数冻结并保持不确定性的几何结构。
AI.result: 在非完整轮式机器人（包含车轮打滑和 Stribeck 摩擦）及小型仿生扑翼飞行器上进行了验证，结果表明 CR-RKL 实现了数值稳定且高精度的在线建模，并在嵌入模型预测控制时表现出优异的跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: CR-RKL 框架通过两种策略解决了递归 Koopman 学习中的数值不稳定性问题，即使在复杂的动态环境（如轮式机器人打滑或小型飞行器飞行）中，也能保证在线建模的鲁棒性和模型预测控制（MPC）的跟踪性能。

title: Prior over Evidence: Stereotype-Driven Diagnosis in LLM-Based L2 Pronunciation Feedback
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed for written pronunciation feedback in second-language (L2) English learning, under the assumption that their diagnoses are grounded in the supplied speech evidence rather than in priors from pretraining. This assumption is tested on 1,800 L2-Arctic utterances spanning six L1 backgrounds, three audio-capable LLMs, four pronunciation dimensions, and five evidence conditions ranging from a text-only baseline to numeric acoustic features and raw audio. Each (utterance x model x condition x dimension) cell is scored on three metrics: Rating Accuracy (RA) against gold labels, Evidence Coherence (EC) assessing internal consistency without ground truth, and Grounded Correctness (GC) evaluated against gold evidence. Results show three findings across models. First, rating accuracy and grounded reasoning decouple: 39.6% of judged cells contain internally coherent reasoning that supports a wrong rating, against only 15.8% where the reasoning supports a correct rating. Second, phoneme-level feedback converges to a fixed inventory of L2-English difficulty phones that recurs across all six L1 backgrounds and all evidence conditions. Third, acoustic evidence improves the rating only when the supplied feature directly probes the target dimension: textualised F0 range raises pitch-variation grounding from (0.18-0.19) to (0.45-0.62) across all three models, while stress and phoneme correctness, which require target-to-realisation alignment, remain ungrounded. The same audio waveform without textualised F0 values does not reproduce this improvement. These findings indicate that current general-purpose LLMs are more reliable as verbalisers of externally computed pronunciation evidence than as standalone diagnostic engines.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示大模型在二语发音反馈中并非真正基于语音证据进行诊断，其性能高度依赖于预处理的声学特征，直接处理原始音频表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 验证第二语言（L2）学习中大模型提供的发音反馈是否真的基于语音证据，而非仅仅依赖其预训练过程中习得的固有先验。
AI.method: 利用1,800条L2-Arctic语音数据，涵盖6种母语背景、3种音频大模型、4个发音维度及5种证据供给条件。通过评分准确性（RA）、证据一致性（EC）和证据正确性（GC）三个指标进行评估。
AI.result: 1. 评分准确性与推理逻辑脱节：近40%的情况模型推理逻辑自洽但评分错误；2. 模型无论输入何种背景，对发音难点的判断均趋于固化；3. 只有当提供直接相关的声学特征（如文本化的F0）时，表现才有所提升，否则无法有效利用原始音频进行诊断。
AI.conclusion: 通用大语言模型目前更适合作为外部计算发音证据的“阐述者”，而非独立的诊断引擎。其诊断过程缺乏足够的证据基础，往往依赖预训练先验而非实测语音数据。

title: High-Dimensional Random Projection for Activation Steering in Language Models
summary: Activation steering has emerged as a key methodology for controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Existing difference-in-means based methods, however, are fundamentally limited: they capture only mean differences between class activations and fail to recover discriminative signals that naturally exist in the nonlinear feature subspace under the superposition hypothesis. Motivated by that, we propose High-Dimensional Random-projection for Activation Steering (HiDRA), a training-free approach that integrates seamlessly with existing activation steering methods.
