By performing activation addition in the projected high-dimensional space, HiDRA can provably capture a better discriminative structure beyond the reach of linear methods. Experiments across diverse LLM families and benchmarks demonstrate that HiDRA consistently outperforms baseline counterparts, achieving stronger behavioral control without significant computational overhead.

AI.tldr: HiDRA 是一种新型激活引导技术，通过在高维投影空间进行操作，解决了传统方法难以捕捉非线性判别信号的问题，显著增强了对 LLM 的行为控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于均值差的激活引导方法存在局限性，无法恢复叠加假设下非线性特征空间中天然存在的判别信号，导致在大模型行为控制上的局限。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 HiDRA（High-Dimensional Random-projection for Activation Steering）的方法。该方法在随机投影产生的高维空间中执行激活加法（Activation Addition），从而捕捉到传统线性差值方法（Difference-in-means）无法获取的非线性特征子空间信息。
AI.result: 在多个大模型系列和基准测试中，HiDRA 始终优于现有的基准方法，在保持较低计算开销的同时实现了更强的行为控制效果。
AI.conclusion: HiDRA 是一种高效、无需训练的激活引导方法，通过在高维投影空间中进行操作，有效捕捉了大型语言模型中非线性的判别特征，显著提升了行为控制能力且不增加额外计算负担。

title: Interactor: Agentic RL oriented Iterative Creation for Ad Description Generation in Sponsored Search
summary: This paper focuses on automatically generating informative ad descriptions in sponsored search. Unlike ad titles which are usually optimized to attract user click feedbacks, ad descriptions have a longer text span and possess the potential of incorporating world knowledge to address user search intents while presenting the fine-grained selling points of the ads. We propose Interactor, a multi-turn iterative creation framework optimized with agentic RL for ad description generation. The generation model acts as a policy that interacts with a customized environment consisting of multiple generative reward models. Given initial generations by the policy, the customized GenRMs evaluate multi-dimensional qualities including knowledge capacity and landing page consistency, providing both binary signals and reasoning feedbacks. The policy then iteratively refines the descriptions based on such feedbacks to ensure continuous improvement. Experiments on industrial datasets show that the Interactor framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in generating knowledge-rich and faithful ad descriptions. Since May 2026, it has been deployed online in a leading search ads system, contributing to both ad revenue and user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Interactor框架，利用多轮迭代与智能体强化学习机制，根据多维度奖励模型反馈优化广告描述生成，显著提升了广告内容的知识含量与忠实度，并已在工业界成功部署。
AI.motivation: 针对现有广告描述生成任务存在的问题，旨在利用更长的文本空间融入先验知识，以更好地满足用户搜索意图并精细化呈现广告卖点，弥补仅关注点击反馈的广告标题在信息量和准确性上的不足。
AI.method: 提出名为Interactor的多轮迭代创作框架，引入基于智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）的训练机制，结合多个由生成式模型构成的奖励模型（GenRMs），从知识容量、落地页一致性等多维度提供反馈信号，驱动生成模型对文本进行迭代优化。
AI.result: 在工业数据集上的实验结果表明，该框架在生成内容知识丰富度和忠实度方面显著优于当前最先进的方法；自2026年5月起已在主流搜索广告系统中正式上线。
AI.conclusion: Interactor框架通过引入多轮迭代与智能体强化学习，有效解决了广告描述在知识丰富度和内容忠实度方面的挑战，并在实际工业应用中证明了其在提升广告营收与用户体验方面的价值。

title: The Data Manifold under the Microscope
summary:
A significant gap exists between theory and practice in deep learning. Generalization and approximation error bounds are often derived for simplified models or are too loose to be informative. Many rely on the manifold hypothesis and on geometric regularity such as intrinsic dimension, curvature, and reach. Progress requires insight into data-manifold geometry and suitable benchmarks, yet existing options are polarized: analytic manifolds with known geometry but limited applicability, or real-world datasets where geometry is only coarsely estimable. We introduce a benchmarking framework for studying data geometry. We repurpose and extend dSprites and COIL-20 with additional transformation dimensions and dense, axis-aligned sampling, and pair them with finite-difference estimators that recover curvature, reach, and volume at near-ground-truth accuracy in a regime where general-purpose estimators are unreliable or difficult to deploy. The framework is intended as a controlled testbed, useful as a calibration environment for geometric estimators and a sandbox for probing theoretical assumptions. To illustrate its use, we present two application studies, namely assessing the scaling behavior of the bounds of Genovese et al. and Fefferman et al., and tracking the layer-wise geometry of a $β$-VAE, highlighting the behavior of current bounds and the value of controlled benchmarks for guiding and validating future theory.
  A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/koulakis/manifold-microscope.

AI.tldr: 为了解决深度学习理论研究中几何属性评估缺乏精度的问题，本文构建了一个具备已知几何基准的数据集框架（Manifold Microscope），通过精确估计流形几何属性，为校准几何估计器和验证深度学习理论假设提供了有效的测试平台。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习理论界的泛化和近似误差界限通常基于过于简化模型或不切实际的假设；现有的几何评估基准要么分析性质强但适用性有限，要么真实世界数据几何参数难以精确估计。因此需要一个能精确控制并量化数据流形几何属性的测试环境。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于 dSprites 和 COIL-20 数据集增强版的基准测试框架；采用有限差分估计器，在已知几何特性的受控条件下，以接近真实值的精度恢复数据的曲率、可达性（reach）和体积。
AI.result: 通过该框架评估了 Genovese 等及 Fefferman 等提出的相关理论界限的缩放行为，并追踪了 β-VAE 模型在层级间的几何演化，验证了理论界限在当前模型下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基准测试框架为几何估计器的校准和深度学习理论假设的验证提供了受控的“沙盒”环境，有助于缩小理论与实践之间的差距，并为未来理论研究提供了定量依据。

title: SimWeaver: Zero-Shot RGB Sim-to-Real for Deformable Manipulation
summary: RGB sim-to-real for deformable manipulation has remained largely unsolved without real-world fine-tuning. We present SimWeaver, which trains zero-shot RGB VLA policies on 200 simulated demonstrations per task, reaching above 80% per-task and 91% average real-world success across 5 diverse deformable tasks including plastic-bag manipulation, without teleoperation or per-task calibration. SimWeaver combines a reliable measurement-backed simulator (SimWeaver-Sim) with an extensible asset framework supporting single-image generation(SimWeaver-Asset), a deterministic topology-aware trajectory synthesizer (SimWeaver-Syn), and a sim-to-real protocol with ISP-aware photometric augmentation (SimWeaver-Real). On silk grasping, the sim-trained policy reaches 100% under visual distribution shifts where real-data baselines drop to 9-70%, at two orders of magnitude lower per-trajectory cost. We will release SimWeaver and a representative asset subset. Project page: https://simweaver.github.io/

AI.tldr: SimWeaver是一个无须真实世界微调的零样本SIM-to-Real框架，通过仿真合成、资产自动化生成及光度增强技术，高效解决了RGB视觉引导下的复杂柔性物体操作问题。
AI.motivation: 解决柔性物体操作（deformable manipulation）在RGB模态下难以在不进行昂贵的真实世界微调的情况下实现SIM-to-Real迁移的难题。
AI.method: 提出了一个系统框架，包括：1. SimWeaver-Sim（基于测量验证的模拟器）；2. SimWeaver-Asset（支持单图像生成的可扩展资产框架）；3. SimWeaver-Syn（确定性拓扑感知轨迹合成器）；4. SimWeaver-Real（包含ISP感知光度增强的Sim-to-Real协议）。仅利用每项任务200个仿真演示进行训练。
AI.result: 在5项多样化柔性物体任务中实现了超过80%的单任务成功率和91%的平均真实世界成功率；在丝绸抓取任务中，在视觉分布偏移下达到100%成功率，且训练成本比真实数据基准低两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: SimWeaver提供了一种无需真实世界微调的零样本RGB VLA策略训练框架，显著降低了柔性物体操作的训练成本并提高了泛化能力，证明了通过高质量仿真生成流程实现SIM-to-Real迁移的可行性。

title: Replay What Matters: Off-Policy Replay for Efficient LLM Reinforcement Unlearning
summary: LLM unlearning has emerged as a cost-effective alternative to full retraining for removing hazardous knowledge from pretrained models while preserving general utility. Recent RL-based methods such as RULE reformulate unlearning as learning a refusal behavior, but their on-policy optimization repeatedly samples from the same forget and retain/boundary prompts throughout training. We identify a critical inefficiency in this process: easy cases quickly converge and provide little useful gradient signal, while hard cases near the forget/retain boundary continue to produce low-reward rollouts that are discarded after a single use. To address this issue, we propose ReRULE, an off-policy replay enhancement for reinforcement unlearning. ReRULE stores low-reward hard-case rollout groups in a replay buffer during early GRPO training and reuses them in later stages through importance-sampled off-policy updates, redirecting computation toward boundary cases that still require learning. Theoretically, we show that ReRULE yields a tighter hard-case convergence bound than pure on-policy RULE. Empirically, ReRULE improves MUSE-Books Retain Quality from 46.3 to 56.2 while adding only 5--11% training time across benchmarks. Its limited improvement on the simpler TOFU setting further supports the intended conditional behavior: replay is most beneficial when the hard/easy disparity is pronounced.

AI.tldr: ReRULE 是一种高效的 LLM 遗忘方法，通过离策略重放机制聚焦于“困难样本”的学习，在极低额外开销下显著提升了模型遗忘任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 RL 的遗忘方法（如 RULE）采用同策略（On-policy）优化，导致模型在简单样本上收敛后由于梯度信号无效而浪费计算，同时对处于遗忘与保留边界的困难样本学习不足。
AI.method: 提出 ReRULE 方法：在基于 GRPO 的强化学习遗忘框架中引入“回放缓冲区（Replay Buffer）”，存储并复用低奖励的困难样本（Hard-case）回放，并通过重要性采样（Importance-sampled）进行离策略更新，以增强模型对决策边界的学习效率。
AI.result: 在 MUSE-Books 数据集上，保留质量评分从 46.3 提升至 56.2，训练时间仅增加 5-11%；同时理论证明了其比纯同策略方法具有更紧密的困难样本收敛界。
AI.conclusion: ReRULE 通过引入重放机制有效解决了强化学习遗忘（Unlearning）中简单样本“无效学习”与困难样本“训练不足”的问题，在保持模型通用性的前提下，显著提升了对复杂数据集的遗忘效果与保留质量。

title: Diversity-Driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Nested Pareto Set Learning
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, accepted by ICML 2026. Project: https://github.com/YaolinWen/DOMOO
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has emerged as a powerful approach to solving complex optimization problems involving multiple objectives. In many practical scenarios, function evaluations are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, necessitating optimization solely based on a fixed offline dataset. In this setting, known as offline MOO, the goal is to find out the Pareto set without access to the true objective functions. This setting suffers from the out-of-distribution (OOD) issue, where the surrogate model is not accurate for unseen designs. Due to the OOD issue, surrogate errors may cause the optimizer to select solutions that do not lie on the true Pareto front and are biased toward its extremes. To address this, this paper proposes Diversity-driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization (DOMOO), which aims to find out a diverse and high-quality set of solutions. First, DOMOO incorporates an accumulative risk control module that estimates the potential risk of candidate solutions and alleviates the OOD issue between the training data and the generated solutions. In addition, a nested Pareto set learning (PSL) strategy is proposed to jointly learn preference and PSL parameters, then optimize them, enabling adaptation to diverse Pareto front geometries. To further enhance solution quality, we design a diversity-driven selection strategy that extracts a representative and well-distributed set of final solutions. To achieve this diversity-driven selection strategy, we propose $\text{IGD}_\text{offline}$, a tailored indicator for the offline setting that considers both diversity and convergence, and avoids the bias of hypervolume indicator. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that DOMOO achieves the best average rank across tasks in both convergence and diversity among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 针对离线多目标优化中因 OOD 导致的搜索偏差问题，本文提出 DOMOO 框架，通过风险管控、嵌套 Pareto 学习及全新的離线评价指标实现多样且高质量的 Pareto 前沿寻优。
AI.motivation: 在离线多目标优化（Offline MOO）场景中，因缺乏真实函数评估导致代理模型在 OOD 数据上产生偏差，容易使优化结果偏向帕累托前沿的极端点，无法获得高质量且多样化的解集。
AI.method: 1. 引入累积风险控制模块以缓解 OOD 风险；2. 提出嵌套帕累托集学习（PSL）策略，利用 preference-PSL 联合优化适应复杂几何形状；3. 设计多样性驱动的选择策略及专门针对离线设定的评价指标 IGD_offline。
AI.result: 在多个合成及真实世界基准测试中，DOMOO 在收敛性和多样性方面均取得了最佳的平均排名。
AI.conclusion: DOMOO 通过引入累积风险控制、嵌套帕累托集学习和专门的离线 IGD 指标，有效地解决了离线多目标优化中的分布外（OOD）偏差和多样性覆盖问题。实验证明该方法在收敛性和多样性指标上均优于现有算法。

title: Understanding the Behaviors of Environment-aware Information Retrieval
summary: Recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches have demonstrated strong capability in handling complex queries, yet current research overlooks a critical challenge: different retrievers require fundamentally different query formulation strategies for optimal performance. In this work, we present the first systematic analysis of how LLMs can learn to adapt their query formulation strategies for different retrievers via reinforcement learning (RL). Our empirical study reveals that RL effectively teaches an LLM to tailor its queries to specific retriever characteristics. We discover that different retrievers exhibit surprisingly distinct optimal query styles (e.g., descriptive vs. question-like), suggesting strategies learned for one retriever ineffective for another. We further show that performance can be enhanced by incorporating retriever-specific human guidance and by scaling model size. To facilitate learning over multi-retrieval-step trajectories, we introduce a branching-based rollout technique that improves training stability. Our work provides the first empirical evidence and actionable insights for building truly retriever-aware RAG systems. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/LCO-Embedding/Envs-aware-Information-Retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的方法，使大语言模型（LLM）能够根据不同检索器的特性自适应地生成最优查询策略，并引入了分支展开技术以增强训练稳定性，从而构建更高效的“检索器感知型”RAG系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）研究忽视了一个关键问题：不同的检索器需要截然不同的查询策略才能达到最佳性能，目前缺乏针对这一问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 1. 提出一种基于强化学习（RL）的方法，使LLM能够学习并适应不同检索器的查询生成策略；2. 引入“基于分支的展开技术”（branching-based rollout technique）以提升多步检索任务中的训练稳定性；3. 结合特定检索器的人类引导（human guidance）及模型规模扩展进行性能优化。
AI.result: 1. 不同检索器存在显著的最优查询风格（如描述型 vs. 提问型），单一策略无法通用；2. 通过RL训练出的模型能够有效针对特定检索器调整查询行为；3. 引入人类引导和扩展模型规模能进一步提升整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过实验证实了检索器感知（retriever-aware）对于RAG系统性能的重要性，RL能够成功训练LLM针对特定检索器优化查询策略，研究结果为构建更高效的自适应RAG系统提供了关键的理论依据和实践指导。

title: Proximal Policy Optimization for Amortized Discrete Sampling
summary: This paper explores policy gradient algorithms for training stochastic policies to sample from structured discrete probability distributions under the Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet) framework. Building on extensive theoretical connections between GFlowNets and entropy-regularized reinforcement learning, we derive equivalents of standard policy gradient algorithms for training GFlowNets, as well as experimentally explore their various methodological aspects, including baseline training and advantage estimation. Most importantly, our work is the first to derive and successfully apply proximal policy optimization to GFlowNets, showing its improved convergence speed and data efficiency compared to standard GFlowNet training objectives on benchmarks ranging from synthetic energies to molecular graph generation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将近端策略优化（PPO）算法成功应用于GFlowNet，并通过理论推导和实验验证，证明其在处理结构化离散概率分布采样任务时，比传统GFlowNet学习目标具有更高的效率。
AI.motivation: 探索利用策略梯度算法训练随机策略，以改进GFlowNet在采样结构化离散概率分布时的表现。
AI.method: 基于GFlowNet与熵正则化强化学习的理论联系，推导出适用于GFlowNet的策略梯度算法，并首次将近端策略优化（PPO）应用于GFlowNet训练，涉及基准线训练和优势估计等技术细节。
AI.result: 在合成能量函数和分子图生成等任务中，相比标准GFlowNet目标，PPO显著提升了训练的收敛速度和数据利用效率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将策略梯度方法（特别是PPO）引入GFlowNet框架，证明了其在收敛速度和数据效率上优于传统GFlowNet训练目标。

title: A Hybrid Model-Based and Model-Free Framework for Active Multi-View Viewpoint Optimization in Sonar Target Recognition
summary: This paper presents a hybrid model-based and model-free framework for active multi-view target recognition using forward-looking sonar. A convolutional neural network (CNN) provides data-driven observation likelihoods, while Radon-based orientation estimation enables viewpoint-aware sensing without requiring angle annotations. During training, an information-gain-based reward guides a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent to learn a belief-aware viewpoint selection policy offline. At deployment, the learned policy performs real-time viewpoint selection using only CNN-based belief updates, eliminating the need for computationally expensive online POMDP tree search. Experiments on a marine-debris forward-looking sonar dataset demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive recognition accuracy while reducing sensing steps and motion cost compared to model-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合CNN与Radon变换的混合框架，利用PPO离线学习视点选择策略，实现了高效的水下前视声纳主动目标识别，无需在线进行昂贵的POMDP树搜索。
AI.motivation: 为了解决传统部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）在水下前视声纳目标识别中计算复杂度高的问题，并克服多视角识别中视点感知困难及人工标注依赖。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于数据驱动（CNN）与模型基础（Radon变换）的混合框架。使用CNN提供观测似然，Radon变换进行无标注视点估计；利用基于信息增益的奖励机制，通过近端策略优化（PPO）离线训练智能体，实现实时且高效的视点选择策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在处理海洋碎片数据集时，识别准确率具有竞争力，且相比传统的基于模型的基准方法，大幅减少了传感操作的次数和运动成本。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架成功实现了水下前视声纳的主动多视角目标识别，在保持高识别精度的同时，显著降低了传感步数和运动成本，验证了其在实际海洋环境中的有效性。

title: Privacy-Preserving Text Sanitization for Distributed Agents Collaboration via Disentangled Representations
summary: When distributed agents exchange text across organizational boundaries, privacy leakage arises not only from explicit identifiers but also from distributional signatures such as formatting conventions, vocabulary choices, and syntactic patterns. We propose DiSan(Disentangled Sanitization), a privacy-preserving sanitization framework and a built-in component of Intern-Shannon for multi-agent collaboration. DiSan uses a two-stream encoder to factorize text into a source-invariant role subspace that preserves task semantics and a source-identifying style subspace that remains local. Federated proto-type alignment and adversarial regularization enable joint training without centralizing raw text. Experiments show that identifier-level masking is insufficient: masking 19.2% of tokens reduces TF-IDF stylometric attribution by only 18.6%. By contrast, DiSan reduces answer-level PII exposure by 20 times while maintaining 83% answer faithfulness on a distributed multi-agent RAG benchmark, and lowers Enron stylometric attribution by 73.2% under TF-IDF and 70.6% under a neural probe.

AI.tldr: 针对分布式代理协作中基于文体特征的隐私泄露，本文提出了DiSan框架，通过双流编码器分离任务语义与来源风格，在保障多智能体协作性能的同时，高效抑制了隐性PII挖掘。
AI.motivation: 在跨组织分布式代理协作中，隐私泄露源于格式、词汇选择和句法模式等分布特征，常规的标识符掩码（Identifier-level masking）手段不足以防范文体识别（Stylometric attribution）带来的匿名性风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DiSan（Disentangled Sanitization）的隐私保护框架。该框架采用双流编码器（Two-stream encoder）将文本分解为“源无关的角色空间”（任务语义）和“源相关的风格空间”（标识特征）。同时，利用联邦原型对齐（Federated prototype alignment）和对抗性正则化（Adversarial regularization）进行联合训练，无需集中原始文本。
AI.result: 实验显示，常规的标识符掩码（掩盖19.2%令牌）仅能降低18.6%的文体识别度；而DiSan通过解耦，在保持分布式RAG基准任务83%准确性的前提下，将答案层面的PII暴露减少了20倍，并将Enron数据集的文体识别率降低了约70%-73%。
AI.conclusion: DiSan通过解耦语义与风格特征，有效缓解了分布式代理协作中的隐私泄露问题，证明了在保留任务语义的同时，能够显著降低由于格式、词汇和语法习惯等“分布特征”带来的用户被追踪风险。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Measuring Bias Acknowledgment in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Responsible AI Evaluation
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good
summary: Reasoning models are increasingly used in settings where the final answer is not the only object of review: educational tools may show students intermediate steps, decision-support systems may require human oversight, and audit workflows may inspect traces for misleading or biased input. In such settings, two responses can receive the same final-answer score while differing in whether the trace explicitly flags injected biasing content. Accuracy-only evaluation collapses these cases. We study this gap as a measurement blind spot for responsible evaluation and introduce a minimal trace-level diagnostic with two axes: \emph{susceptibility} (whether the bias breaks a previously correct answer) and \emph{acknowledgment} (whether the trace contains a rubric-defined surface reference to the injected content). Across thousands of biased GSM8K trials, GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet~4 have similar susceptibility rates ($1.3\%$ vs.\ $1.2\%$) but substantially different acknowledgment rates ($13.0\%$ vs.\ $75.0\%$) under the same rubric.

AI.tldr: 本文指出评估模型仅看结果准确率是不够的，还需要评估其“推理过程”，特别是在面对偏差注入时，模型是否能识别并承认这些偏差。通过对比分析，揭示了主流模型在偏差识别能力上的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估体系过于依赖最终结果的准确率（Accuracy-only），忽略了推理过程（Trace）的透明度与安全性。在教育、辅助决策及审计等需要对推理过程进行人工审阅或透明化展示的场景下，同等准确率的模型可能存在极大的安全隐患（如未识别出偏差输入）。
AI.method: 定义了一套基于推理路径（Trace-level）的诊断指标，包含两个维度：1. 易感性（Susceptibility，指偏差是否改变了原本正确的答案）；2. 承认度（Acknowledgment，指推理过程是否识别并标记了预设的偏差内容）。通过在 GSM8K 数据集上注入偏差样本，对比测试了 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的表现。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K 的偏差实验中，GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的“易感性”表现相似（约 1.2%-1.3%），但在“承认度”上存在巨大差异（GPT-4o 为 13.0%，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 为 75.0%）。这表明目前性能相似的模型在处理偏差输入的处理机制上存在显著区别。
AI.conclusion: 仅关注最终准确率的评估存在盲点，无法反映模型在涉及敏感/偏差内容时的推理透明度与可信度。实验证明，不同模型在处理相同提示注入偏差时，其“承认（Acknowledgment）”偏差的能力存在显著差异，亟需引入细粒度的推理过程（Trace-level）评估体系，以确保模型的负责任应用。

title: How Much Can We Trust LLM Search Agents? Measuring Endorsement Vulnerability to Web Content Manipulation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents synthesize open-web content into actionable recommendations on behalf of users, creating a risk that attacker-published pages are transformed into endorsed claims. We introduce SearchGEO, a controlled evaluation framework for measuring endorsement corruption in LLM-based web-search agents, combining a web-evidence manipulation pipeline, a five-mode attack taxonomy, and multiple output-level metrics. We evaluate 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. Results show that vulnerability patterns vary across backends: overall attack success rate (ASR) ranges from 0.0% on Claude-Sonnet-4.6 to 31.4% on Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest attack mode differs by model family, and the same deployment scaffold could amplify or decrease ASR on different backends. An auxiliary agent-skill probe, where endorsement becomes an install command, exposes a sharp split among otherwise robust backends: Claude over-rejects while GPT over-trusts. These findings argue for treating recommendation reliability under adversarial search content as a first-class dimension of backend safety evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了SearchGEO框架，用于评估LLM搜索代理在面对恶意网页内容时的“背书腐蚀”风险。研究发现不同模型防御能力差异极大，GPT系列模型较易被诱导产生信任背书，而Claude系列则表现出较高的防御倾向。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的搜索代理会将互联网公开内容转化为用户建议，这会导致一种安全风险：攻击者发布的恶意页面可能被LLM转化为“受背书”的建议，从而误导用户。当前缺乏针对此类“背书腐蚀（endorsement corruption）”的系统性评估。
AI.method: 提出一个名为SearchGEO的受控评估框架，包含：（1）网络证据操纵流水线；（2）五种模式的攻击分类法；（3）多种输出层级指标。使用该框架对13个LLM后端进行了308个案例的实证评估，并引入辅助代理技能探测（将背书转化为安装指令）以测试信任边界。
AI.result: 不同LLM后端的漏洞模式存在巨大差异：攻击成功率（ASR）在0.0%（Claude-Sonnet-4.6）到31.4%（Gemini-3-Flash）之间波动；不同模型家族的最强攻击模式不同；相同的部署架构对不同模型ASR的影响截然不同。在辅助探测中，表现出严重的阵营分化：Claude模型倾向于过度拒绝（过分保守），而GPT模型则表现出过度信任（过分激进）。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在处理网络搜索内容时，其推荐可靠性应被视为后端安全评估的关键维度。研究强调了不同模型在应对对抗性搜索内容时表现出的显著差异，提示开发者需关注模型在面对恶意篡改时的鲁棒性。

title: A Unified Constant-Time Switch Rule for Constructing Edge-Disjoint Hamiltonian Cycles in Gaussian Networks
summary: Gaussian networks are degree-four symmetric interconnection networks defined over residue classes of Gaussian integers. Earlier work showed that when the generator $α=a+bi$ satisfies $\gcd(a,b)=1$, the real and imaginary dimensions directly form two edge-disjoint Hamiltonian cycles. A later construction extended the result to the non-coprime case $\gcd(a,b)=d>1$, but its proof used long node-sequence tables and separate odd/even cases for $d$. This paper gives a unified closed-form construction that covers both $d=1$ and $d>1$, and also covers both odd and even $d$, without separate case tables. In the rectangular representation with $d$ rows and $r=(a^2+b^2)/d$ columns, the construction uses a constant-time local switch rule for each $q=1,2,\ldots,d-1$ at column $a_q=q-1$. Each switch removes two horizontal edges and inserts two vertical edges. The switched horizontal structure forms the first Hamiltonian cycle, while its edge-complement in the Gaussian network forms the second Hamiltonian cycle. Thus, the full edge set is partitioned into two edge-disjoint Hamiltonian cycles. The construction requires $O(d)$ switch-generation time and $O(N)$ time to list the two cycles, where $N=a^2+b^2$. Exhaustive validation for all $1\leq a\leq b\leq 100$, excluding only the degenerate $N=2$ network, and large-scale validation up to $N=3{,}250{,}000$ confirm the construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的、简洁的构造方法，证明了所有非退化的 Gaussian 网络都包含两个边不相交的哈密顿圈，无需分情况讨论 $d$ 的值。
AI.motivation: Gaussian 网络在 $\gcd(a,b)=d>1$ 的情况下，现有的哈密顿圈构造方法依赖于复杂的节点序列表，且需要针对 $d$ 的奇偶性进行分类讨论，缺乏统一性。
AI.method: 在 $d \times r$ 的矩形表示中，引入了一种针对各 $q=1,\dots,d-1$ 在 $a_q=q-1$ 列的常数时间局部切换规则（local switch rule）。通过移除两条水平边并插入两条垂直边，构造出第一个哈密顿圈，并证明其补集构成第二个哈密顿圈。
AI.result: 给出了统一的构造公式，具备 $O(d)$ 的切换生成时间和 $O(N)$ 的圈序列列出时间；通过了 $1 \leq a \leq b \leq 100$ 的穷尽验证及高达 $N=3,250,000$ 的大规模验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种统一的封闭式构造方法，证明了在所有非退化的 Gaussian 网络（对于 $N > 2$）中，网络边集均可划分为两个边不相交的哈密顿圈，简化了此前针对 $\gcd(a,b)>1$ 的复杂证明。

title: Topological Flow Matching
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. 26 pages, 24 figures. Code: https://github.com/KacperWyrwal/topological-flow-matching
summary: Flow matching is a powerful generative modeling framework, valued for its simplicity and strong empirical performance. However, its standard formulation treats signals on structured spaces, such as fMRI data on brain graphs, as points in Euclidean space, overlooking the rich topological features of their domains. To address this, we introduce topological flow matching, a topology-aware generalization of flow matching. We interpret flow matching as a framework for solving a degenerate Schrödinger bridge problem and inject topological information by augmenting the reference process with a Laplacian-derived drift. This principled modification captures the structure of the underlying domain while preserving the desirable properties of flow matching: a stable, simulation-free objective and deterministic sample paths. As a result, our framework serves as a drop-in replacement for standard flow matching. We demonstrate its effectiveness on diverse structured datasets, including brain fMRIs, ocean currents, seismic events, and traffic flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“拓扑流匹配”，通过在流匹配的参考过程中融入基于拉普拉斯算子的拓扑信息，成功解决了传统流匹配在处理非欧几里得结构化数据时忽略拓扑特征的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配方法通常将结构化数据（如脑 fMRI 图数据）视为欧几里得空间中的点，忽略了数据背后底层的拓扑结构特征。
AI.method: 将流匹配解释为退化薛定谔桥问题（degenerate Schrödinger bridge problem），并引入基于拉普拉斯矩阵的漂移项（Laplacian-derived drift）来显式注入拓扑结构信息，从而实现拓扑感知（topology-aware）的生成模型。
AI.result: 在处理脑 fMRI、洋流、地震活动及交通流量等多种结构化数据集上，证明了该方法比标准流匹配具有更好的生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将拓扑信息整合进流匹配框架，本文提出的“拓扑流匹配”能够更有效地生成具有复杂结构依赖的数据，为处理图结构数据提供了一种通用且高效的替代方案。

title: A Corridor-Scale CARLA-VISSIM Co-Simulation Framework for Multi-Intersection Urban Traffic
summary: This paper presents an implemented CARLA-VISSIM co-simulation framework for an urban corridor comprising approximately fifteen connected intersections centered on Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard in Chattanooga, Tennessee. The system integrates CARLA 0.10.0 Unreal Engine 5 with PTV VISSIM 2026 through a bidirectional, step-synchronized interface that couples VISSIM's microscopic vehicle, pedestrian, and signal-controller logic with CARLA's high-fidelity 3D rendering. A LiDAR-derived elevation model and RoadRunner-based High Definition (HD) map provide terrain-accurate road geometry deployed consistently across both simulators. The framework incorporates explicit actor ownership, mirrored lifecycle management, coordinate reconciliation, and a latest-state-per-actor update policy, enabling stable interaction between VISSIM-controlled traffic and a CARLA-controlled ego vehicle. A corridor-scale case study demonstrates consistent traffic-signal mirroring, synchronized vehicle-pedestrian interactions, and stable mixed-authority operation under peak loads of approximately 100 vehicles and 100 pedestrians. The deployment captures the interaction of the five signalized intersections along MLK Street and their connecting upstream and downstream intersections, revealing synchronization challenges unique to multi-intersection corridors. Results indicate that this MLK-centered corridor provides an effective testbed for verifying cross-simulator consistency and that the proposed architecture supports reliable, perception-ready co-simulation for corridor-level traffic studies.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并验证了一个基于 CARLA 和 VISSIM 的协同仿真框架，通过高精地图集成及先进的状态更新机制，实现了复杂的城市走廊级交通流高保真仿真，为自动驾驶与智能交通系统的测试提供了稳定平台。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决城市交通 corridor 级仿真中跨模拟器数据一致性、多路口同步挑战以及复杂交通环境下（车辆、行人与信号灯交互）的高保真视觉与逻辑仿真融合问题。
AI.method: 构建了一个双向、步长同步的协同仿真系统，集成 CARLA（UE5）与 PTV VISSIM；统一利用基于 LiDAR 的高度模型和 RoadRunner 生成的高精地图；采用显式参与者（actor）归属管理、镜像生命周期、坐标对齐及“参与者最新状态优先”的更新策略。
AI.result: 通过对田纳西州查塔努加 MLK 大道 15 个路口的实地案例分析，证明了该架构在处理峰值负载（约 100 辆车和 100 名行人）下依然能保持稳定的信号镜像、车辆与行人互动及混合控制权限，实现了可靠的感知级联合仿真。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为城市级交通研究提供了一个有效的、跨模拟器一致的、面向感知的联合仿真实验平台，成功验证了其在高复杂度 corridor-scale 环境下的稳定性和可靠性。

title: Contextual Bandits for Maximizing Stimulated Word-of-Mouth Rewards
comment: Presented at the AAAI 2025 Workshop on Bridging the Gap Between AI Planning and Reinforcement Learning (PRL)
summary: Stimulated word-of-mouth is a strategy that promotes information sharing through prompts or incentives. Optimizing stimulated word-of-mouth through social networks requires identifying and targeting connected users who are most susceptible to spillover, a phenomenon where the influence of recommendations extends beyond the immediate audience to impact their connected users. The probability of spillover varies across individuals, and their connections, leading to heterogeneity. Understanding and accurately estimating the spillover probabilities among users in social networks is crucial for improving the effectiveness of stimulated word-of-mouth. To address this, we present a novel contextual multi-armed bandit framework that learns individual spillover probabilities and ranks connected users to maximize rewards from stimulated word-of-mouth. Experiments on real-world network datasets demonstrate that accounting for spillover heterogeneity enhances the targeting precision of top-$k$ connected users, boosting rewards and outperforming baseline methods that do not learn individual spillover effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于情境多臂老虎机的框架，通过学习和利用社交网络中用户个体溢出效应的异质性，优化了激励型口碑营销的目标用户定位，显著提升了信息传播的收益。
AI.motivation: 激励型口碑营销的效率受限于如何识别并定位那些最容易产生“溢出效应”（即推荐影响延伸至二度关联用户）的社交用户；由于不同用户及其连接的溢出概率存在显著的异质性，现有方法往往忽视了这一点，限制了营销效果。
AI.method: 采用情境多臂老虎机（Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit）框架，旨在学习并估计社交网络中不同用户的个体溢出概率，从而对目标用户的关联对象进行排序优化，实现激励收益的最大化。
AI.result: 在真实社交网络数据集上的实验表明，该算法能更准确地识别前k个高价值关联用户，其营销收益显著优于传统未考虑个体溢出效应的基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 在社交网络中，考虑用户个体间的溢出异质性可以显著提高激励型口碑营销的精准度与整体收益，验证了基于情境多臂老虎机框架进行精准化营销的有效性。

title: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Meta-Analysis Articles from Nature Portfolio
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, preprint for arXiv, dataset and code available at https://github.com/BFTree/MetaSyn
summary:
Meta-analysis is a demanding form of evidence synthesis that combines literature retrieval, PI/ECO-guided study selection, and statistical aggregation. Its structured, verifiable workflow makes it an ideal substrate for evaluating systematic scientific reasoning, yet existing benchmarks lack ground truth across the full retrieval-screening-synthesis pipeline. We introduce MetaSyn, a dataset of 442 expert-curated meta-analyses from Nature Portfolio journals. Each entry pairs a research question with PI/ECO criteria, a retrieval corpus of 140k PubMed articles, verified positive studies, hard negatives that are topically similar but PI/ECO-ineligible, and complete search strategies and date bounds.
  Benchmarking twelve pipeline configurations (nine RAG variants and a protocol-driven agent) reveals a critical screening bottleneck: despite a retrieval ceiling of 90.9% recall at K=200, no system recovers more than 52.7% of ground-truth included literature. Current LLMs fail to reliably separate eligible studies from PI/ECO-failing distractors in pools of comparable topical relevance. Stage-attributed metrics capture where systems succeed and fail; a single end-to-end score does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MetaSyn数据集，用于评估荟萃分析中的“检索-筛选-合成”全流程。研究发现当前LLM系统受限于筛选环节（不仅是检索），难以识别符合特定科学标准的文献，导致整体准确率较低。
AI.motivation: 现有的证据合成基准测试往往缺乏对“检索-筛选-合成”完整管道的覆盖，难以全面评估科学推理能力。MetaSyn旨在填补这一空白，提供可验证的Meta-analysis实验框架。
AI.method: 构建了MetaSyn数据集（包含442个专家策划的荟萃分析样本及14万篇PubMed文章），定义了包含研究问题、PI/ECO标准、检索语料、真实包含研究及困难负样本的完整基准。并在该数据集上测试了12种流水线配置（包含9种RAG变体及1种基于协议的智能体）。
AI.result: 虽然模型在检索阶段可达到90.9%的召回率（K=200），但在筛选阶段表现不佳，整体准确识别真实收录文献的比例不超过52.7%。证明了PI/ECO筛选是当前自动化系统面临的核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 现有的检索增强生成(RAG)和智能体系统在处理MetaSyn任务时，在筛选阶段存在显著短板。LLM难以将PI/ECO标准与表面上相关但实则不合格的“困难负样本”区分开来。此外，研究强调应使用阶段性指标而非单一终点度量来评估复杂流程。

title: Tangram: Hiding GPU Heterogeneity for Efficient LLM Parallelization
summary:
The scale of LLM training jobs requires parallelization planning over large GPU clusters. Due to different GPU types and interconnects added over time, these GPU clusters are increasingly heterogeneous. Automatic LLM parallelizers can search for parallelization plans but face an exploding search space with heterogeneous GPUs. To make search tractable in heterogeneous GPU clusters, parallelizers often omit types of parallelism (e.g., expert parallelism) or memory-saving techniques (e.g., ZeRO), which results in worse plans.
  We describe Tangram, a system that enables the use of existing heterogeneity-unaware LLM parallelizers in heterogeneous GPU clusters by decoupling parallelization planning from GPU heterogeneity. For this, Tangram exploits two insights: (1) since bulk purchases result in sets of GPUs with similar compute, memory, and connectivity, Tangram can expose such homogeneous GPU islands to existing parallelizers; and (2) parallelizers commonly first partition models and then parallelize partitions. Tangram can compose such model slices, assigned to GPU islands, into work-balanced pipelines for high throughput. Tangram integrates with existing parallelizers through a narrow API, which relies on the enumeration of model-slice/island pairs. Tangram achieves up to 2.3x higher training throughput than current heterogeneous parallelizers (Metis and Sailor) and scales to large GPU clusters by pruning enumerated plans.

AI.tldr: Tangram 是一种针对异构 GPU 集群的 LLM 训练并行化系统，通过将异构集群划分为同构“岛”，使得传统的同构并行器能够生成高效的并行规划，从而在兼顾复杂并行策略的同时大幅提升了整体训练吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 自动并行器在面对异构 GPU 集群时，由于搜索空间爆炸，不得不放弃某些高性能并行策略（如专家并行、ZeRO），导致训练效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了基于“GPU 岛”的抽象方法：1. 将异构集群划分为若干同构 GPU 子集；2. 利用两阶段策略，将模型切片分配到不同的岛中，并通过流水线（Pipeline）机制进行组合，实现计算负载均衡。
AI.result: Tangram 在异构集群上的训练吞吐量比现有的异构并行器（Metis 和 Sailor）高出 2.3 倍，并且具备良好的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Tangram 通过将异构集群抽象为多个同构“岛”，成功地将异构性处理与切分规划解耦，显著提升了异构环境下的 LLM 训练吞吐量，同时保持了与现有单机/同构并行器的兼容性。

title: Stop the Sampler! Classifier-Based Adaptive Stopping for Sampling Kernels
summary: Sampling from complex, unnormalized probability densities is a fundamental challenge in Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling. While Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods provide asymptotic guarantees, they often suffer from slow mixing and high computational costs due to fixed or manually tuned trajectory lengths. In this work, we propose a novel framework that treats trajectory termination as a learnable component of the sampling dynamics. By framing MCMC within the theory of non-acyclic generative flow networks (GFlowNets), we train state-dependent neural classifiers to decide when a trajectory has reached a high-density region and should terminate. We theoretically establish the connection between optimal classifiers and the target density via detailed balance conditions and introduce a multilevel training scheme to facilitate exploration in complex geometries. Experimental results across various benchmark densities demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces average trajectory lengths while improving mode coverage and mixing compared to standard MCMC baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于GFlowNets的学习型MCMC框架，通过神经网络动态决定轨迹何时终止，有效解决了传统MCMC采样效率低和混合慢的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统MCMC方法在从复杂未归一化概率密度采样时，常因轨迹长度固定或需手动调整而导致混合速度慢、计算成本高，难以有效应对复杂空间下的采样需求。
AI.method: 提出一种基于非循环生成流网络（GFlowNets）的框架，将MCMC轨迹的终止视为可学习策略；训练状态相关的神经网络分类器，依据详细平衡条件判定何时终止采样以达到高密度区域；引入多级训练方案以加速复杂几何形状下的探索。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准密度分布测试中，在显著缩短轨迹长度的同时，在模式覆盖范围和混合速度方面均优于传统的MCMC基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将MCMC轨迹终止过程建模为可学习的策略，该研究不仅显著降低了采样计算开销，还提升了在复杂几何分布下的模式覆盖能力和混合效率，证明了利用GFlowNets优化MCMC轨迹的有效性。

title: A Bilateral Teleoperation Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous teleoperation requires precise arm-hand coordination, low-latency feedback, and robust interaction in real-world contact-rich environments. This paper presents a modular bilateral teleoperation framework that integrates operator-side input interfaces with a robot-side dexterous hand and compliant robotic arm in a unified control architecture. The system supports position-based hand retargeting, differential arm control, multi-scale haptic feedback, and shared control for stable manipulation. We validate the framework through a real-world dexterous manipulation task, highlighting coordinated arm-hand control and contact-aware interaction. Beyond feasibility, we identify key design insights related to cross-embodiment mismatch, haptic feedback granularity, and shared control. The proposed platform provides a practical teleoperation system and a foundation for collecting high-quality demonstrations for future learning-from-demonstration research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化双向灵巧遥操作框架，实现了低延迟、高协同的手臂-手部控制及接触感知交互，为机器人灵巧操纵及高质量演示数据收集提供了有效平台。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧遥操作系统在面对真实世界接触丰富（contact-rich）场景时，难以同时满足精准手臂-手部协调、低延迟反馈及交互鲁棒性的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种模块化双边遥操作系统架构，集成操作端接口、灵巧手与柔性机械臂；采用基于位置的手部重映射（retargeting）、差分手臂控制、多尺度触觉反馈算法以及共享控制策略。
AI.result: 通过真实环境下的灵巧操作任务验证了系统的有效性，实现了流畅的协同控制，并总结了针对跨形态不匹配、触觉反馈粒度及共享控制的关键设计洞察。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个实用的双边遥操作系统框架，不仅验证了复杂接触任务中手臂-手部协同控制的可行性，还通过深入分析跨形态差异、触觉反馈和共享控制，为未来机器人“从演示中学习”（LfD）的数据采集奠定了基础。

title: Rethinking the Role of Efficient Attention in Hybrid Architectures
summary: Modern language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that combine full attention with efficient attention modules, such as sliding-window attention (SWA) and recurrent sequence mixers. However, how these efficient modules shape model capabilities remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic analysis across hybrid architectures from three perspectives: scaling behavior, mechanism analysis, and architecture design. First, from a scaling perspective, we find that efficient-attention design primarily affects how fast long-context capability emerges, while different hybrids eventually converge to comparable long-context performance under sufficient training. Second, mechanistically, we show that long-range retrieval is mainly carried by full attention, whereas efficient attention shapes its optimization trajectory. This explains a counter-intuitive phenomenon we call Large-Window Laziness: larger SWA windows can delay the formation of retrieval heads in full-attention layers. Third, guided by this mechanism, we show that applying NoPE to only the full-attention layers of a small-window SWA hybrid substantially improves long-context performance with negligible impact on short-context performance.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了混合语言模型中全注意力和高效注意力（如SWA）的分工机制，发现过大的SWA窗口会阻碍检索头的形成，并提出通过特定层应用NoPE优化长上下文能力的改进方案。
AI.motivation: 目前混合语言模型架构（结合全注意力和高效注意力的架构）虽然流行，但其内部机制及高效模块对模型能力的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统性分析：从扩展行为（Scaling behavior）、机制分析（Mechanism analysis）和架构设计（Architecture design）三个维度对混合架构语言模型进行实证研究。
AI.result: 1. 扩展行为：高效注意力设计主要影响长上下文能力的涌现速度，但在充分训练后最终性能趋同。2. 机制：全注意力层负责长程检索；SWA导致“Large-Window Laziness”现象，即过大的SWA窗口会延迟全注意力层中检索头（retrieval heads）的形成。3. 架构设计：在SWA混合模型中，仅在全注意力层应用NoPE（无位置编码）可有效提升长上下文性能。
AI.conclusion: 混合架构中，全注意力层负责长距离检索，而高效注意力模块（如SWA）主要影响优化轨迹。通过控制特定层的NoPE应用，可以显著提升长上下文能力而不牺牲短上下文性能。

title: False Sense of Safety in Selective Signal Classification: Auditing Bound Tightness and Exchangeability for Risk Control
summary: Selective prediction with distribution-free risk control promises that, with confidence 1-delta over the calibration draw, the error rate of accepted inputs stays below a user budget alpha. We audit this promise on signal-domain detectors -- machine anomalous-sound detection (ASD) and AI-generated-image forensics -- for four calibration rules: uncertified empirical thresholding (NAIVE) and certified Hoeffding, Clopper-Pearson (CP), and betting (WSR) upper confidence bounds. We report three findings. (i) NAIVE thresholding, common in practice, exceeds its declared budget in 49-73% of synthetic trials (n=200 calibration points) and in up to 68% of real-data splits: a false sense of safety rather than a broken theorem, since the rule never had a certificate. (ii) Tightness matters: CP and WSR certify substantial coverage where Hoeffding certifies none, with zero observed budget overruns under exchangeable splits. (iii) Under grouped deployment (unseen machine types or generators), certified rules overrun in 9-30% of trials -- far above delta -- showing the failure lies in the broken exchangeability premise, not in the bounds; a conservative per-group threshold restores validity at a severe coverage cost.

AI.tldr: 该研究审计了选择性预测中风险控制的有效性，指出常用NAIVE方法极易失效，而置信界方法（CP/WSR）仅在交换性满足时可靠；在分布偏离（分组部署）情形下，所有方法的保证均会因假设失效而失效。
AI.motivation: 选择性预测中的分布无关风险控制（distribution-free risk control）旨在保证模型在特定错误预算内运行，但该保证在实际应用场景中的可靠性有待审计，特别是在面对不同校准规则及潜在的分布漂移时。
AI.method: 对四种校准规则（NAIVE经验阈值法、Hoeffding、Clopper-Pearson (CP)、Betting (WSR)置信上界）在异常声音检测（ASD）和AI生成图像取证任务中进行审计。通过对比这四种方法在交换性假设满足与否（即独立同分布vs.分组部署）场景下的风险控制表现来评估其有效性。
AI.result: 1. NAIVE方法因缺乏形式化认证，在49-73%的模拟和68%的真实数据试验中均超出预算；2. 紧致的认证方法（CP和WSR）在交换性假设下表现优异，实现了零超预算；3. 在分组部署场景下，交换性假设失效，导致所有认证方法均出现9-30%的超预算失败。
AI.conclusion: Certified risk control methods (CP, WSR) provide reliable error guarantees under i.i.d. conditions, but their effectiveness collapses under distribution shift (grouped deployment/out-of-distribution). The problem is rooted in the violation of the exchangeability assumption rather than the limitations of the bounds themselves, and restoring validity in such cases requires significant sacrifices in coverage.

title: Re-Rooting-Based Fault-Tolerant Broadcasting in Dense Gaussian Networks
comment: Submitted to IEEE Access. Preprint also available on Zenodo:https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20690481
summary: Dense Gaussian networks provide degree-4 interconnection topologies with small diameter and regular structure, making them suitable for efficient one-to-all broadcasting. However, node failures can disrupt the broadcast process when faulty nodes occupy internal forwarding positions. This paper proposes a lightweight fault-tolerant broadcasting method based on dynamic source relocation, or re-rooting. Instead of constructing redundant spanning trees or backup routing structures, the proposed method selects a new source node so that the faulty nodes are located at graph distance \(k\), the network diameter, from the new source. Consequently, faulty nodes become leaf-level nodes in the broadcast process and are not required to forward the message. For the single-fault case, the new source is selected directly from the graph-distance-\(k\) boundary of the faulty node. For the two-fault case, we prove that for any pair of faulty nodes in \(G(k+(k+1)i)\), there exists a node whose graph distance from both faulty nodes is exactly \(k\). The source-selection procedure requires \(O(k)\) time. Since the original one-to-all broadcast completes in \(k\) parallel steps and the relocation distance is at most \(k\), the proposed method completes in at most \(2k\) steps in the worst case. We also show that the two-fault guarantee does not generally extend to arbitrary three-fault configurations by giving a counterexample in \(G(3+4i)\). Simulation results confirm complete delivery to all non-faulty nodes under the tested one- and two-node failure scenarios, while the baseline broadcast may fail when faulty nodes occur at internal forwarding positions.

AI.tldr: 针对密集高斯网络的广播容错问题，本文提出了一种无需冗余结构的动态源重定向方法，通过将故障节点转移至广播树的“叶子”位置，实现了高效的单、双节点故障容错广播。
AI.motivation: 密集高斯网络（Dense Gaussian networks）因其结构特点适合进行高效的一对多广播，但当故障节点位于网络内部转发位置时，传统的广播进程会遭到中断。现有方案通常需要构造复杂的冗余生成树或备份路由，开销较大。
AI.method: 提出一种基于动态源重定位（re-rooting）的容错广播方法：当发生节点故障时，动态重选广播源节点，使故障节点处于源节点的直径距离（$k$）处，从而将其从内部转发路径降级为叶子节点，避免故障节点阻断广播。该方法针对单故障直接选取边界节点，并证明了对于任意双故障情况，总存在一个距离两者均为 $k$ 的源节点。
AI.result: 理论分析与仿真确认，该方法在单故障及双故障场景下均能实现对所有非故障节点的完整广播。在最坏情况下，广播时间复杂度为 $2k$（原广播为 $k$），且源选择过程仅需 $O(k)$ 时间。此外，通过反例证明了该双故障保障机制无法扩展至任意三故障配置。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的动态源重定位方法为密集高斯网络提供了一种轻量级的容错广播方案。该方法无需构建冗余结构，通过巧妙选择距离故障节点为网络直径 $k$ 的节点作为新根，有效解决了单故障和特定双故障情况下的广播中断问题。研究同时指出了该双故障保证无法推广至一般的三及以上故障配置。

title: One-Step Generalization Ratio Guided Optimization for Domain Generalization
comment: 29 pages, accepted at the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)
summary: Domain Generalization (DG) aims to train models that generalize to unseen target domains but often overfit to domain-specific features, known as undesired correlations. Gradient-based DG methods typically guide gradients in a dominant direction but often inadvertently reinforce spurious correlations. Recent work has employed dropout to regularize overconfident parameters, but has not explicitly adjusted gradient alignment or ensured balanced parameter updates. We propose GENIE (Generalization-ENhancing Iterative Equalizer), a novel optimizer that leverages the One-Step Generalization Ratio (OSGR) to quantify each parameter's contribution to loss reduction and assess gradient alignment. By dynamically equalizing OSGR via a preconditioning factor, GENIE prevents a small subset of parameters from dominating optimization, thereby promoting domain-invariant feature learning. Theoretically, GENIE balances convergence contribution and gradient alignment among parameters, achieving higher OSGR while retaining SGD's convergence rate. Empirically, it outperforms existing optimizers and enhances performance when integrated with various DG and single-DG methods.

AI.tldr: GENIE是一种新型DG优化器，通过动态平衡参数对泛化的贡献度（OSGR），抑制虚假相关性，实现了更稳定、更具泛化性的深度学习训练。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于梯度的领域泛化（DG）方法往往会无意中强化虚假相关性，导致模型在处理未见目标领域时过拟合，缺乏有效的机制来平衡参数更新并抑制领域特定特征的统治地位。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为GENIE的新型优化器，引入“单步泛化比率”（OSGR）来量化各参数对损失减少的贡献及梯度一致性，并通过动态预处理因子对OSGR进行均衡化处理，防止少数参数主导优化过程。
AI.result: 在理论上证明了GENIE能保持SGD的收敛速度，实验结果表明其在多个DG和单领域DG基准测试中均超越了现有优化器，展现出极强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GENIE通过平衡参数的贡献和梯度一致性，有效地抑制了领域特定偏差的强化，从而在不牺牲收敛速度的前提下显著提升了模型的领域泛化性能。

title: Learning Context-Aware Neural ODE Dynamics for Adaptive Robotic Control
summary: Robotic systems deployed in uncertain and dynamically changing environments often face variations in contact conditions, aerodynamic effects, and external disturbances that challenge reliable control. To remain effective under model-based control, these systems require dynamics models that can adapt to such changes, especially when direct access to complete environmental information is limited. To enable adaptability and facilitate integration with model predictive control, we propose a context-aware dynamics model based on neural ordinary differential equations, which infers environmental factors from state-action histories using a two-phase training procedure. We validate the approach across diverse robotic platforms, including a quadrotor in simulation, as well as a Sphero BOLT robot and a Fanuc manipulator in real-world experiments. The results demonstrate that our method effectively adapts to temporally and spatially varying environmental changes across different tasks. Videos are available at https://youtu.be/PY0sNyF2rqE , and the source code is available at https://github.com/syyu410-yu/context-aware-neural-ode-control.git .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经常微分方程的上下文感知动态建模方法，能根据历史数据自动推断环境变化，实现机器人系统在未知或动态环境下的稳健自适应控制。
AI.motivation: 机器人系统在动态、不确定的环境中工作时，常面临接触条件变化、空气动力学效应及外部干扰，传统的固定模型难以应对这些变化，且在缺乏完整环境先验信息的情况下，亟需一种能够自适应调整的动态模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于“神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）”的上下文感知动态模型。该模型利用两阶段训练过程，通过状态-动作历史数据推断环境上下文信息，并将其整合到预测控制框架中，以适应动态环境参数的变化。
AI.result: 在模拟四旋翼飞行器、真实的Sphero BOLT机器人以及Fanuc机械臂实验中，该方法表现出良好的适应能力，能够处理时间和空间上不断变化的动态环境。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结合上下文感知的神经常微分方程与模型预测控制，能够有效适应动态环境下的模型不确定性，在多种机器人平台上验证了其通用性和鲁棒性。

title: Not All Skills Help: Measuring and Repairing Agent Knowledge
summary: LLM agents can improve without weight updates by accumulating natural-language skills from experience, but current systems entrust every decision about which skills to keep and how to apply them to LLM judgment alone. We argue that this conflates two distinct roles: generating a skill from experience is a creative act that judgment handles well, while deciding whether that skill actually helps requires empirical evidence across many tasks. Measuring per-skill causal contributions via randomized masking, we find that skill libraries exhibit pervasive causal heterogeneity: individual skills routinely help on some task types while hurting on others, yet their opposing effects cancel in aggregate, making them invisible to global curation methods. We propose ASSAY, a framework that separates generation from curation: it computes a per-skill causal attribution on a small development set, restructures the library offline, and suppresses skills with negative predicted effect for each test task. Across seven base models spanning four providers and two benchmarks (AppWorld and tau-bench), ASSAY consistently improves over prior skill-curation approaches. On AppWorld's hardest split, DeepSeek-V3 achieves 69.3% task-goal completion (47.4% relative improvement), a new state of the art among all published methods including weight-tuned approaches. On tau-bench retail, GPT-4.1 improves by 8.7% relative, advancing past o4-mini, o1, and GPT-4.5 on the public leaderboard without any weight modification. Ablation traces the dominant gain to per-task masking, confirming that the bottleneck is matching skills to tasks at inference time, not removing bad skills globally. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/assay.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM智能体技能库中存在的因果异质性，提出了ASSAY框架，通过在推理时针对不同任务动态屏蔽负贡献技能，实现了无需模型微调的显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体依赖LLM自身的判断来决定技能取舍，这种做法将“技能生成（创造）”与“价值评估（决策）”混为一谈。研究观察到技能库存在严重的因果异质性，即同一技能在不同任务间表现差异巨大，单一的全局筛选方法难以过滤掉这些负面效应。
AI.method: 提出ASSAY框架，核心是区分技能生成与技能评估：1. 使用随机屏蔽法（Randomized Masking）在小规模开发集上量化每个技能的因果贡献；2. 识别并分析技能的因果异质性；3. 在推理时，根据具体任务动态抑制负贡献技能（Per-task masking）。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和tau-bench两个基准测试上，ASSAY显著超越了现有的技能筛选方法。在AppWorld最难分支上，DeepSeek-V3的任务完成率提升至69.3%（相对提升47.4%），达到当前SOTA水平（包括微调方法）；在tau-bench零售场景中，GPT-4.1性能显著提升，超越了o1等模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了LLM智能体在无需权重更新的情况下，通过基于因果归因的技能库筛选（ASSAY框架），能显著提升性能。通过按任务进行技能屏蔽，解决了此前全局筛选方法中因果异质性导致的“部分有用部分有害”的抵消问题，证明了推理时的技能匹配是提升效能的关键。

title: Semantic Reasoning in Medicine: The Role of Knowledge Graphs Across Five Key Domains
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have emerged as a promising solution for integrating and reasoning over complex biomedical and clinical data in healthcare. By representing structured relationships among entities such as diseases, drugs, symptoms, and patient records, KGs provide a semantic backbone for decision-making, prediction, recommendation, and personalized care. Recent advances have demonstrated their utility across diverse medical applications--including clinical decision support systems, disease and treatment outcome prediction, health recommender systems, precision medicine, and medical question answering--where KGs often enhance interpretability, semantic coherence, and patient-specific reasoning. In parallel, a growing body of work focuses on medical KG generation itself, proposing frameworks that construct graphs from EHRs, clinical narratives, biomedical literature, and web resources using ontologies, semantic web technologies, deep-learning-based information extraction, and hybrid neuro-symbolic pipelines. Despite this progress, significant challenges remain, including limited and fragmented knowledge coverage, difficulties in aligning heterogeneous data sources, the fragility of current reasoning and representation-learning methods on dense multi-relational graphs, and unresolved issues related to privacy, bias, and accountability. This survey reviews and categorizes current research on KGs in medicine along both application-oriented and methodology-oriented dimensions, discusses their benefits and technical foundations, and outlines key limitations and open research directions. By analyzing trends, architectures, and evaluation practices, this work aims to guide future developments in KG-driven medical AI systems and support their safe and effective integration into healthcare environments.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于医学知识图谱应用、构建技术及未来挑战的全面综述，旨在为构建可信、高效的医疗AI提供框架性指导。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱在整合复杂生物医学数据及支持医疗决策方面价值显著，但目前针对医学知识图谱的构建技术及应用实践尚存在众多挑战（如数据偏见、隐私、可解释性），缺乏系统的梳理以指导未来的技术研发与临床整合。
AI.method: 本研究对医学知识图谱的相关文献进行了系统性综述及分类分析，主要从应用导向和方法导向两个维度展开，评估了现有架构、技术手段及评估实践，并总结了当前的技术瓶颈与研究趋势。
AI.result: 总结并分类了当前医学知识图谱的主要应用（决策支持、精准医疗等）与构建方法（本体论、信息抽取、神经符号混合等），明确了技术发展概况及当前存在的关键限制因素。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱在医疗领域展现出巨大潜力，但仍面临知识覆盖碎片化、异构数据对齐困难、推理/表征方法脆弱性以及隐私与公平性等挑战，未来研究需聚焦于构建更鲁棒、可解释且符合医疗规制的图谱系统，以实现临床安全有效落地。

title: Scalable and Interpretable Representation Alignment with Ordinal Similarity
summary: Evaluating representation similarity is fundamental to representation learning. However, existing metrics suffer from significant limitations: they lack interpretability due to shifting baselines, lack robustness to outliers, and are computationally intractable for large datasets, forcing reliance on heuristic approximations. To address this, we develop an ordinal-similarity framework, instantiated by the Triplet (TSI) and Quadruplet (QSI) Similarity Indices, which measure alignment by quantifying the consistency of ordinal relationships. We theoretically demonstrate this formulation is inherently interpretable, robust to outliers, and computationally efficient. Finally, we establish a formal equivalence between TSI and local neighborhood alignment, measured by Mutual Nearest Neighbors. Empirically, we validate these properties and show that ordinal similarity offers a scalable approach to measuring alignment, enabling practitioners to better understand and design representations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有表征度量指标的局限性，提出了一种基于“序数相似度”（TSI/QSI）的评估框架，该框架具有强可解释性、鲁棒性高且计算效率优越的特点。
AI.motivation: 现有表征相似度评估指标存在基准漂移导致缺乏可解释性、对异常值鲁棒性差以及在大规模数据集上计算复杂性高等问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于序数相似度的框架，具体实例化为三元组相似度指数（TSI）和四元组相似度指数（QSI），通过量化序数关系的一致性来评估表征对齐。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了该方法的鲁棒性与高效性，并验证了TSI与互近邻（Mutual Nearest Neighbors）等价。实验结果表明该方法具备良好的可扩展性，能有效用于理解和设计表征。
AI.conclusion: 基于序数关系（顺序的一致性）的相似度度量（TSI/QSI）为表征学习提供了一种可解释、鲁棒且高效的替代方案，并从理论上建立了其与局部邻域对齐的等价性。

title: FARM: Find Anything using Relational Spatial Memory
summary: Robots operating in homes, warehouses, and other object-rich environments need memory systems that can find specific object instances on demand. Object-level memory alone is often insufficient: scenes contain many plausibly matching objects, and users refer to the target through relations to landmarks and surrounding objects (e.g. ``the tall lamp below the dartboard and to the left of the poster''), demanding a relational spatial memory that supports retrieval through semantic, appearance, and spatial predicates over objects. To achieve this, we present FARM (Find Anything using Relational Spatial Memory), which builds, in real time at 5-10 Hz, a compact, open-vocabulary, object-level memory with geometry, visual-language descriptors, and viewpoint evidence. At query time, FARM uses VLMs to parse the query and score visual evidence, while grounding spatial constraints explicitly through object symbols and relational predicates. This structured use of VLMs enables more accurate and robust retrieval than end-to-end reasoning over frame histories or scene-graph context. In experiments on 44k language queries spanning 67 indoor and outdoor scenes, ranging from 15 to 15,000 m^2, FARM improves Recall@5 and Recall@10 over prior methods by 164% and 224%, and a final VLM reranking stage improves Accuracy@1 by 35%, while running in real time. We further demonstrate closed-loop deployment on a quadrupedal robot using onboard sensors and compute.

AI.tldr: FARM是一个能够实时构建物体级内存并支持复杂语义与空间关系查询的系统，通过显式的符号化处理与VLM结合，显著提升了机器人在复杂环境中查找物体的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的物体级内存系统难以应对复杂的、基于语义和空间关系（如“在...的下方/左侧”）的指向性查询，无法从包含大量相似物体的复杂环境中准确检索目标。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含几何信息、视觉语言描述和视角证据的紧凑型开放词汇物体级内存系统（Real-time 5-10 Hz）。查询时，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）解析查询并评估视觉证据，通过显式的物体符号和关系谓词对空间约束进行接地（Grounding）。
AI.result: 在44,000个查询实验中，FARM的Recall@5和Recall@10分别比现有方法提升了164%和224%；通过VLM重排序，Accuracy@1提升了35%。已在四足机器人上实现闭环部署。
AI.conclusion: FARM系统在室内外复杂场景中证明了其在基于关系描述的物体搜索任务上的高效性与鲁棒性，具备实时运行能力，并可在真实机器人上部署。

title: CHILLGuard: Towards Fine-Grained Chinese LLM Safety Guardrail with Scalable Data Construction and Model-aware Preference Alignment
summary: Malicious content generated from large language models (LLMs) could pose severe safety risks and ethical concerns. While existing LLM safety guardrails excel in English or multilingual settings, they lack adaptation to Chinese-specific regulatory policies, cultural context and linguistic nuances, failing to support fine-grained risk classification for diverse deployment needs. In this paper, we introduce a 5-macro, 31-micro category fine-grained risk taxonomy for Chinese scenarios, and build CHILLGuard: a dedicated Chinese LLM content safety guardrail. To address the critical scarcity of high-quality annotated Chinese safety data, we propose a scalable multi-stage data construction pipeline: we expand multi-source corpus via retrieval-augmented generation, generate implicit harmful samples through prompt engineering rewriting, and refine high-quality data via multi-model voting-based label calibration. Based on this, we build CHILLGuardTrain, a large-scale training set with 405,007 samples, and CHILLGuardTest, a rigorously curated annotated test set with 51,745 samples. We then train CHILLGuard on CHILLGuardTrain under a generator-classifier collaborative framework via Model-aware Direct Preference Optimization. Extensive experiments under multiple settings demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of CHILLGuard, e.g., a 15.92% improvement of F1 score over Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict on our benchmark. We will release our resources at https://github.com/cswbyu/CHILLGuard.

AI.tldr: 针对现有安全护栏的中文本土化不足问题，本文提出了 CHILLGuard 系统，通过构建细粒度中文风险分类体系、高质量的大规模数据集，以及基于偏好优化的训练框架，显著提升了中文大模型的内容安全检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 安全护栏在处理中文特定的监管政策、文化背景和语言细微差异方面能力不足，且缺乏针对中文场景细粒度风险分类的专门防御工具。
AI.method: 1. 提出了包含 5 个宏观和 31 个微观类别的中文细粒度风险分类体系；2. 设计了包含 RAG 语料扩充、提示词工程生成隐式有害样本及多模型投票校准的自动化数据构建流程；3. 构建了 CHILLGuardTrain (40余万样本) 和 CHILLGuardTest (5万余样本)；4. 采用生成器-分类器协同框架，结合模型感知直接偏好优化 (Model-aware DPO) 进行训练。
AI.result: CHILLGuard 在多个实验设置下表现优异，在自建测试集上的 F1 分数较 Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict 提升了 15.92%，达到行业领先水平。
AI.conclusion: CHILLGuard 填补了中文大模型内容安全防御的空白，通过更精细的分类体系和高质量的训练数据，显著提升了中文场景下的防攻击能力，为中文 LLM 的安全部署提供了先进的防御工具。

title: PolyKV: Heterogeneous Retention and Allocation for KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is essential for reducing the memory cost of long-context large language model inference. Existing approaches, however, typically apply a single compression policy and a uniform cache budget across all transformer layers. This uniform design ignores the fact that different layers can play different roles during prefill and decoding, and may therefore require different eviction strategies and cache capacities. We present PolyKV, a layer-wise KV cache optimization framework that considers design space with method selection and budget allocation. PolyKV routes each layer to a suitable KV compression policy based on layer-level signals, while assigning non-uniform budgets under a fixed total budget. This formulation enables heterogeneous compositions of existing KV cache methods. Experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B show that, under the same 512-token average KV budget, PolyKV recovers 54.5% and 25.7% of the LongBench performance gap between the strongest single-policy baseline and FullKV, respectively. Across 128-1024 budget sweep, PolyKV consistently improves over the strongest baseline by 1.7%-6.4%, corresponding to 40.0%-54.5% recovery of the FullKV gap.

AI.tldr: PolyKV 是一种通过为 Transformer 不同层级动态分配差异化压缩策略和非均匀缓存预算，从而提升长上下文大模型推理效率与性能的优化框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的 KV Cache 压缩方法通常采用统一的策略和预算，忽视了 Transformer 不同层级在预填充和解码阶段角色差异所导致的对缓存容量和策略的不同需求。
AI.method: 提出 PolyKV 框架，利用层级信号为每一层动态路由最合适的 KV 压缩策略，并根据层级重要性在总预算内进行非均匀的预算分配。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Qwen3-8B 模型上，同等平均预算下，相比最强基线，LongBench 性能差距恢复率达 25.7%-54.5%，且在不同预算区间内均保持稳健的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PolyKV 通过细粒度的层级化 KV Cache 策略分配，解决了单一缓存策略导致的性能瓶颈，在有限的缓存预算下显著提升了大模型的长文本推理能力。

title: Neural Bayesian Anomaly Mitigation: A Robust Loss that Doubles as an Unsupervised Contamination Classifier
summary: Engineered robust losses such as Huber, Student-$t$, and generalised cross-entropy make supervised models tolerant of contamination but cannot answer which observations are corrupted. We introduce Neural Bayesian Anomaly Mitigation (NBAM), a general-purpose drop-in loss derived from a Bayesian latent-switch mixture model: the marginal likelihood defines a robust supervised loss, and the associated posterior defines an unsupervised contamination classifier. Like Huber or Student-$t$, NBAM can replace the standard training loss in any supervised pipeline; unlike them, it additionally learns a structured contamination model and returns a calibrated per-sample contamination posterior. A learned input-dependent prior $π_φ(x)$ captures the spatial locality of contamination, so that samples near known corruptions are more likely to be flagged, while an Occam penalty emerges automatically and regularises against over-flagging. On CIFAR-10 with asymmetric label contamination, NBAM recovers the structure of the corruption process without supervision: the contamination posterior separates clean from corrupted samples, and the learned anomaly head identifies the direction of every label-flip pair. Alongside these capabilities, NBAM outperforms the four robust-loss baselines considered here at contamination rates 0.2-0.6.

AI.tldr: NBAM 是一种新型通用损失函数，不仅能提升监督模型对数据污染的耐受力，还能通过贝叶斯后验概率无监督地识别和解释样本污染。
AI.motivation: 现有的鲁棒损失函数（如 Huber、Student-t 等）能够减轻污染数据带来的负面影响，但无法确定具体哪些样本是受污染的，缺乏对污染原因及分布的解释能力。
AI.method: 基于贝叶斯潜在切换混合模型（Bayesian latent-switch mixture model）导出的鲁棒损失函数；引入了一个可学习的输入依赖型先验（input-dependent prior）来建模空间局部性，并利用奥卡姆剃刀惩罚（Occam penalty）防止过度标记。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 非对称标签污染任务中，NBAM 在 0.2-0.6 的污染率下均优于对比的四种鲁棒损失基线；能够无监督地恢复污染过程的结构，分离干净与受污染样本，并识别标签转换的逻辑。
AI.conclusion: NBAM 是一种通用的鲁棒性学习方法，不仅能像传统鲁棒损失函数一样提升模型对噪声数据的容忍度，还能通过学习到的后验概率自动识别并解释数据污染情况，实现训练与异常检测的统一。

title: FD-SLAM: Fast Dense Radar-Inertial SLAM with Frequency-Domain Loop Closure and Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Radar SLAM is attractive for autonomous ground vehicles operating in visually degraded environments, however, scanning radars are noisy, have low scanning rates, and their measurements are challenging to match reliably over long trajectories. This paper presents FD-SLAM, a fast dense radar-inertial SLAM system that extends dense radar-inertial odometry with frequency-domain loop closure and pose graph optimization. The proposed method preserves an image-like structure of scanning radar measurements by using a compact frequency-domain polar descriptor for loop-candidate retrieval and a multi-stage verification pipeline based on temporal filtering, phase-correlation screening, scan-alignment similarity, and geometric consistency checks. Verified loop closures are added as non-sequential constraints in an SE(2) pose graph together with radar-inertial odometry factors. FD-SLAM is evaluated on a publicly available dataset using standard KITTI evaluation metrics. The results show that FD-SLAM improves FD-RIO baseline, achieves competitive performance against current state-of-the-art radar SLAM methods, and provides favorable rotational accuracy across multiple evaluated driving trajectories. Runtime analysis further indicates that the radar-inertial front-end operates above the radar sampling rate on a CPU-only setup, while loop closure detection and graph optimization remain suitable for parallel background execution.

AI.tldr: FD-SLAM 是一个高效密集型雷达惯性 SLAM 系统，通过引入频域描述子进行回环检测及位姿图优化，解决了雷达数据在长期轨迹感知中的匹配难题，并实现了 CPU 端的实时处理。
AI.motivation: 扫描雷达具有高噪声、扫描频率低等特点，在视觉退化环境下构建长期、稳定的 SLAM 轨迹面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 1. 基于密集雷达惯性里程计 (FD-RIO) 作为前端；2. 提出一种紧凑的频域极坐标描述子用于回环检测；3. 设计了多阶段验证流水线（时间滤波、相位相关筛选、扫描对齐相似性、几何一致性检查）；4. 利用 SE(2) 位姿图进行全局优化。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 数据集评估中，FD-SLAM 相比基线 FD-RIO 有显著提升，性能优于当前主流雷达 SLAM 方法，在旋转精度上表现优异，且支持 CPU 环境下的实时运行。
AI.conclusion: FD-SLAM 是一种高效且鲁棒的雷达惯性感官 SLAM 系统，通过频域特性和位姿图优化有效解决了雷达噪声大、匹配难的痛点，兼顾了算法精度与实时性。

title: T-Mem: Memory That Anticipates, Not Archives
summary: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to remain coherent across extended dialogues, follow through on commitments made many sessions earlier, and adapt their behaviour to each user. Current LLM-backed long-term conversational memory, however, is reachability-bounded by the similarity between a query and stored content, both lexical and dense-vector. The approach is effective when query and memory share surface features such as wording or named entities (we call this descriptive). But it misses another, equally valuable class of cases, where query and memory do not share surface features and are tied only by a latent semantic arc (associative). On this regime prevailing long-term memory systems collectively fail. Covering this other half is what allows an assistant, for the first time, to actively draw on past dialogue as a semantic asset. On the memory side, this is the engineering counterpart of what cognitive science calls episodic future thinking: rehearsing past experience for the future contexts under which it will need to be found. We call these write-time rehearsals triggers. We propose T-Mem, the first long-term conversational memory architecture that covers both descriptive and associative recall. At each of two evidence granularities, single facts and full exchanges, T-Mem instantiates one descriptive trigger family and one associative trigger family, so that every memory remains reachable from both surface-similar and relevance-bound queries. As empirical validation, T-Mem reaches state-of-the-art on both LoCoMo and LoCoMo-Plus.

AI.tldr: T-Mem是一种新型长期对话记忆架构，通过在写入时进行语义预演，解决了传统基于相似度检索系统无法处理“联想式”需求的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的长期记忆系统主要依赖相似度（词汇或向量），仅能处理“描述性”检索，无法有效召回缺乏表面显式联系但语义相关的“联想式”信息，影响了对话代理的连贯性和个性化能力。
AI.method: 提出了T-Mem架构，在写入时通过两类触发器（描述性触发器和联想触发器）对记忆进行预演（Rehearsal），并分别在细粒度（事实）和粗粒度（完整对话）层面进行处理，确保记忆在语义相关的情况下也能被检索到。
AI.result: T-Mem在LoCoMo和LoCoMo-Plus数据集上达到并超越了当前的SOTA水平，证明了该架构在处理复杂长期对话记忆时的有效性。
AI.conclusion: T-Mem有效地弥补了现有长期记忆系统在“联想式”召回上的不足，通过引入“预演（rehearsals）”机制，实现了在描述性（基于表面相似度）和联想性（基于语义关联）两种检索模式下的高性能，在该领域树立了新的SOTA标准。

title: Towards a Unified Generative Model for Scarce Time Series with Domain Experts
summary: Synthesizing realistic time series with generative models has wide-ranging applications in real-world scenarios. Despite recent progress, most existing methods are trained under the assumption of abundant training data, which substantially limits their effectiveness in data-scarce settings. In this paper, we propose TimeMoDE, a novel framework that integrates Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts to exploit both domain adaptability and diffusion-stage awareness for time series generation under data scarcity. It is pre-trained on a large-scale collection of multi-domain datasets to extract domain-agnostic temporal representations and domain-specific information benefiting generalization during fine-tuning. We propose Domain Prompts to condition expert assignment for indistinguishable noised tokens, mitigating the limitations of capturing inter-dataset relationships. Moreover, we incorporate diffusion timestep signals to equip the experts with awareness of time series degradation variations, facilitating adaptive calibrate to stage-dependent denoising requirements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TimeMoDE outperforms existing methods under diverse low-data settings. It establishes an innovative paradigm for advanced time series few-shot generation.

AI.tldr: TimeMoDE 是一种用于少样本时间序列生成的新型框架，它通过结合扩散 Transformer 和混合专家模型，利用多域预训练、领域提示和扩散时间步自适应感知，在数据稀缺场景下实现了优于现有技术的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列生成模型多依赖于大量训练数据，在数据稀缺的场景下表现不佳，缺乏良好的泛化能力。因此需要一种能够在少样本条件下合成高质量时间序列的方法。
AI.method: 提出了 TimeMoDE 框架，整合了扩散 Transformer (Diffusion Transformers) 和混合专家模型 (Mixture-of-Experts)。核心创新点包括：1) 使用大规模多域数据集进行预训练以获取通用特征；2) 引入“域提示”(Domain Prompts) 来优化专家分配策略；3) 引入扩散时间步信号 (diffusion timestep signals) 以实现对阶段性去噪需求的自适应校准。
AI.result: 在多种少样本设置下的广泛实验表明，TimeMoDE 的性能优于现有的基准方法。
AI.conclusion: TimeMoDE 是解决小样本时间序列生成任务的有效框架，它通过预训练+微调的范式，结合混合专家模型与扩散模型，实现了更高效的跨域泛化和高性能生成，为少样本时间序列生成提供了新的范式。

title: MA-SBI: Misspecification-Aware Simulation-Based Inference via Side-Channel Guidance
summary: Simulation-based inference (SBI) of latent parameters is often hindered by simulator misspecification, the mismatch between simulated and real-world observations caused by inherent modeling simplifications. RoPE, the recent state-of-the-art for robust SBI, addresses this through optimal transport between learned representations of real and simulated observations, but requires ground-truth parameter calibration pairs that are typically unavailable in the very settings where SBI is needed. What practitioners do have is unstructured side-information such as regime labels, instruction text, and policy bulletins. We propose Misspecification-Aware Simulation-Based Inference (MA-SBI), a calibration-free framework that turns this side-channel into a posterior correction. A learned corrector maps side-channel text to an observation-space shift applied before any pre-trained amortized posterior, requiring no retraining and no parameter ground-truth. Our main theorem bounds achievable bias reduction by the mutual information between misspecification and side-channel, with a non-vacuous constant that extends to all sub-Gaussian noise via Donsker-Varadhan. On hide-the-calibration benchmarks, MA-SBI with text alone matches the oracle posterior across 10 seeds and two backbones (TOST equivalence), while RoPE given more data does not. The two approaches are complementary: where misspecification is structural and recoverable from parameter pairs, RoPE dominates, as the theory predicts. A stochastic variant improves posterior-predictive log-likelihood on real COVID and OxCGRT epidemiological data, and correctly leaves the posterior unchanged on a well-specified cognitive-science corpus.

AI.tldr: MA-SBI 引入了一种无需真实参数校准的后验纠正方法，利用非结构化辅助数据（如文本）弥补模拟器与真实数据间的“建模失配”，显著提升了仿真推断在现实应用中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的模拟推断（SBI）方法（如 RoPE）在处理模拟器误设时，高度依赖难以获取的真实参数校准对，限制了其在实际应用场景中的适用性。
AI.method: 提出了一种“误设感知模拟推断（MA-SBI）”框架：通过训练一个映射器（corrector），将侧向信息（文本等）转化为观测空间的偏移量，作用于预训练好的摊销后验（amortized posterior），无需重新训练原模型，也无需真实参数对进行校准。
AI.result: 1. 理论上证明了偏差缩减量受限于误设与侧向信息之间的互信息；2. 在基准测试中，MA-SBI 在无需校准的情况下达到甚至超越了 Oracle（理想）效果；3. 在 COVID-19 和行为科学数据集上验证了其能有效改善预测对数似然，且在模型无误设时表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: MA-SBI 是一种无需校准的框架，利用非结构化侧向信息（如文本、标签）纠正由模拟器误设引起的后验偏差。实验证明该方法在隐藏校准信息的基准测试中优于现有的 RoPE 方法，并能有效处理实际流行病学数据。

title: Understanding and Modeling Perceived Cognitive and Physical Strain Dynamics for Planning-Oriented Human-Robot Collaboration in Prefabricated Construction
summary: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) in prefabricated construction requires planning approaches that consider not only productivity but also time-dependent worker states during repeated work and rest. Existing planning models often rely on simplified assumptions about fatigue, workload, or recovery, with limited domain-specific empirical evidence on how perceived strain evolves. This study develops an empirically grounded, planning-oriented approach to characterize perceived strain accumulation and recovery in prefabricated construction HRC. A controlled repeated work-rest experiment assessed perceived cognitive and physical strain using the Rating Scale for Mental Effort and Borg's Rating of Perceived Exertion. Linear and exponential functional forms were evaluated, followed by mixed-effects modeling to examine collaborative conditions, session effects, and inter-individual variability. Results indicate that cognitive strain accumulation is best represented by a linear mixed-effects model, whereas rest-phase recovery follows nonlinear decay. The resulting planning-oriented models may inform future human-state-aware task allocation and scheduling research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证实验量化了建筑人机协作中工人认知与生理疲劳的累积及恢复规律，建立了可用于任务规划与调度的数学模型（认知应变呈线性累积，休息恢复呈非线性衰减）。
AI.motivation: 现有的人机协作规划模型忽略了装配式建筑重复性工作中的工人体力与脑力应变及动态恢复过程，缺乏针对性的实证数据支持。
AI.method: 开展了受控的重复工作-休息实验，使用“心理努力评定量表 (RSME)”和“博格主观劳累感觉量表 (Borg RPE)”评估工人的认知与生理应变；采用线性与指数函数形式进行建模，并利用混合效应模型 (Mixed-effects modeling) 分析协作条件、会话效应及个体差异。
AI.result: 研究发现认知应变的累积最适合用线性混合效应模型表示，而休息阶段的应变恢复遵循非线性衰减规律。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了基于实证数据的应变（strain）累积与恢复模型，能够有效预测装配式建筑人机协作中的工人类状态，为实现以人为本的任务分配与进度调度提供了关键的量化基础。

title: Few-Shot Biomedical Relation Extraction with Large Language Models: A Viable Alternative to Supervised Learning?
summary: Biomedical relation extraction (BioRE) is a key step in transforming biomedical literature into structured knowledge. However, most existing approaches rely on supervised models trained on costly annotated datasets, limiting their scalability and adaptability across relation types and domains. We investigate few-shot BioRE using prompt-based learning with large language models (LLMs) and compare two task formulations: pairwise classification, which predicts relations for individual entity pairs, and joint generation, which extracts multiple relations in a single model call. Experiments on the BioREDirect dataset reveal a clear precision-recall trade-off. Pairwise classification achieves higher recall, whereas joint generation is more precise and computationally efficient. The best-performing model achieves a micro-F1 score of 0.44, substantially outperforming previous few-shot results (0.34) while remaining below the supervised baseline (0.56). Much of this gap is attributable to a single ambiguously defined relation type. When evaluated using macro-F1, which better captures performance across relation types in an imbalanced setting, prompt-based approaches outperform the supervised baseline (0.45 vs. 0.38), particularly on rare relation types. These findings highlight the potential of LLMs for BioRE in low-resource settings and underscore the importance of well-defined relation schemas.

AI.tldr: 该文探索了使用提示学习在大语言模型中进行小样本生物医学关系抽取，并在稀有关系类型上击败了监督学习基线，证明了LLM在低资源BioRE场景中的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有的生物医学关系抽取（BioRE）方法高度依赖昂贵的有标注数据集，导致可扩展性和跨域适应性受限。研究旨在探索利用大语言模型（LLMs）和提示学习实现小样本（few-shot）下的BioRE。
AI.method: 比较了两种基于提示（prompt-based）的任务构建方式：1. 配对分类（pairwise classification）：针对单个实体对预测关系；2. 联合生成（joint generation）：单次调用模型抽取多个关系。并在BioREDirect数据集上进行实验评估。
AI.result: 1. 配对分类召回率更高，联合生成精度更高且计算效率更好；2. 最优提示模型微观F1值为0.44（对比此前的0.34有所提升，但仍低于监督基线0.56）；3. 在不平衡数据集的宏观F1指标上，提示学习模型以0.45分超过了监督基线（0.38分）。
AI.conclusion: 提示学习（Prompt-based learning）在大语言模型下显示出处理生物医学关系抽取（BioRE）的潜力，特别是在稀有关系类型的小样本场景下表现优于传统监督学习。同时，该研究强调了明确定义关系模式（schema）对于提升模型性能的重要性。

title: StarOR: Synergizing Tree Search and Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling
summary: Optimization modeling is inherently hierarchical, requiring a precise sequence of symbolic commitments. Traditional learning-based automated optimization modeling methods improve modeling policies through large-scale annotated or curated training data, but are costly to adapt to new problem distributions. Meanwhile, one-shot generation remains brittle in hierarchical modeling, where early symbolic errors can propagate into invalid formulations. Test-time scaling offers a promising alternative by enabling structural exploration with additional instance-level computation; however, existing search-based methods typically rely on a fixed policy, causing repeated rollouts to inherit similar modeling biases and providing limited credit assignment for intermediate decisions. To address these limitations, we propose StarOR, a synergistic search-and-adaptation framework that couples MCTS with Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for optimization modeling. StarOR decomposes the modeling process into four stages and updates a transient LoRA adapter via GRPO at each non-terminal node. By using MCTS-generated siblings as local comparison sets, StarOR transforms search-time exploration into instance-specific policy refinement. Moreover, an unsupervised multi-faceted reward system provides fine-grained feedback for intermediate formulation decisions without ground-truth labels. Experiments across five optimization benchmarks show that StarOR achieves state-of-the-art performance even with a 4B backbone, outperforming existing methods and the frontier LLMs.

AI.tldr: StarOR通过在MCTS搜索过程中实时利用GRPO微调提示词适配器，在无需人工奖励的情况下，实现了测试阶段的自适应优化建模，打破了传统搜索方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统的自动化优化建模依赖大规模标注数据，难以适应新分布；而一键式生成（One-shot）易产生累积误差；现有的搜索方法由于固定策略限制，搜索多样性不足且难以进行有效的中间步骤信用分配。
AI.method: 提出StarOR框架：1. 将建模过程解构为四个阶段；2. 融合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与测试时强化学习（Test-Time RL）；3. 在搜索的非终止节点利用GRPO算法实时训练一个LoRA适配器；4. 利用MCTS生成的兄弟节点作为本地比较集，并结合无监督多维度反馈系统提供细粒度奖励。
AI.result: 在五个优化基准测试中达到了SOTA（当前最佳）水平；仅使用4B参数的小模型即可超越现有方法及 frontier LLMs。
AI.conclusion: StarOR通过将搜索与针对特定实例的策略微调相结合，有效解决了分层优化建模中错误传播和单一搜索策略偏差的问题，在无需标注数据的条件下实现了优于现有模型及前沿LLM的建模性能。

title: Phantoms and Disclosures: a Causal Framework for Auditing Synthetic Data
summary: The rapid adoption of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred interest in synthetic data as a privacy-preserving alternative to sensitive real-world datasets. However, generating high-utility synthetic data often carries the risk of memorizing and regurgitating private information from the training corpus. In this work, we present a customizable empirical auditing framework designed to detect and explain such data disclosures. Our framework introduces a mechanism to distinguish between "true disclosures"-where the system directly reproduces a user's information-and "phantom disclosures''-where the system incidentally generates a user's data. By partitioning input data into training and holdout sets and applying rigorous statistical hypothesis testing, we determine if observed disclosures are consistent with strict privacy baselines, such as zero-learning or specific Differential Privacy (DP) bounds. Crucially, this approach requires no model access, no canary insertion, and no reference model training -only the synthetic output and a held-out control set. We demonstrate that this framework effectively functions as a membership inference attack, providing empirical lower bounds on privacy leakage that are tighter than prior data-based auditing methods. Our approach is model-agnostic, applies to any synthetic data generation mechanism, and requires orders of magnitude fewer computational resources than shadow-model or canary-based alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效、模型无关的合成数据隐私审计框架，仅通过统计观测输出结果即可精准区分真实的隐私泄露与偶然重合，相比传统方法计算成本更低且评价更严苛。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在利用敏感数据训练时存在隐私泄露风险，当前缺乏一种无需模型内部权限、高效且能区分“真实数据记忆”与“偶然重合”的评估方案。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于统计假设检验的审计框架：通过划分训练集和留出集（holdout set），无需模型内部访问、无需插入“金丝雀”（canary）数据、无需训练参考模型，仅通过合成输出与留出集进行对比，判断泄露是否符合特定隐私基准（如差分隐私边界）。
AI.result: 该框架不仅能有效识别数据披露，还能作为一种成员推理攻击（MIA）手段，提供比现有数据审计方法更严谨的隐私泄露经验下界，同时显著降低了计算资源消耗。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需模型访问权限且计算高效的实证审计框架，能够更精确地量化生成式模型在生成合成数据时的隐私泄露风险（特别是区分“真实披露”与“幻觉披露”）。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Retrieval with Soft Fusion for Robust Multimodal Imitation Learning under Missing Modalities
summary: Robotic systems perceive the world through multiple input modalities -- including visual camera streams and natural language instructions -- and must select appropriate actions based on these signals. However, assuming the permanent availability of all input devices is unrealistic, as sensors may fail, become occluded, or drop out entirely during deployment. Robust handling of such missing-modality scenarios is therefore essential for real-world robot operation. This paper introduces RL4IL, a reinforcement learning guided method for imitation learning that selects the most suitable action for a given observation by identifying the most relevant expert demonstrations from a training library. A reinforcement learning policy, trained via Proximal Policy Optimisation over Breadth-First Search candidate sets, ranks candidate demonstrations and a soft cross-attention fusion head aggregates their action signals to produce the final prediction. When a modality is missing at inference time, a dedicated per-modality RL retrieval policy identifies donor demonstrations from the training library, and a soft imputation head reconstructs the missing embedding via cross-attention over the top-ranked donors -- without requiring any retraining of the system. Experiments on three LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that RL4IL substantially outperforms state-of-the-art imitation learning methods under sensor dropout conditions, while requiring no policy network training. The code can be found at https://github.com/h-ismkhan/Reinforcement-Learning-via-kNN-for-Robotic-Learning-with-Missing-Camera

AI.tldr: 针对机器人模态缺失问题，RL4IL 提出了一种基于强化学习的检索式模仿学习框架，通过动态从专家库中检索并重建缺失信息，无需重新训练即可实现稳健的动作决策。
