AI.motivation: 现实世界中机器人传感器（视觉/语言）存在不可控的故障、遮挡或丢失风险。为了解决此类“模态缺失”场景下机器人仍能保持有效动作输出的问题，提出了该方法。
AI.method: 提出 RL4IL 方法：1. 利用强化学习策略（PPO算法）从专家演示库中检索相关示范；2. 使用软交叉注意力（Soft Cross-Attention）融合动作信号；3. 当模态缺失时，通过专用检索策略匹配“捐赠者”示范，并利用交叉注意力头对缺失嵌入进行重建。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 三个基准测试集上的实验结果表明，RL4IL 在应对传感器掉线（sensor dropout）情况下的表现远超当前主流的模仿学习方法。
AI.conclusion: RL4IL 通过在推理阶段使用强化学习检索库中的专家示范来填补缺失模态，无需重新训练策略网络，从而在传感器故障场景下显著提升了机器人操作的鲁棒性。

title: Encode Errors: Representational Retrieval of In-Context Demonstrations for Multilingual Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) involves detecting and correcting the wrong usage of grammar. While large language models (LLMs) with in-context learning (ICL) capabilities have shown significant progress on various natural language processing (NLP) tasks, their few-shot performance on GEC remains suboptimal. This is mainly due to the challenge of retrieving suitable in-context demonstrations that capture error patterns instead of semantic similarity. In this paper, we demonstrate that LLMs can inherently capture information related to grammatical errors through their internal states. From these states, we extract the Grammatical Error Representation (GER), an informative and semantically neutral encoding of grammatical errors. Our novel GER-based retrieval method significantly boosts performance in ICL settings on multilingual GEC datasets, improving the precision of correction. For high-resource languages, our results on 8B-sized open-source models match those of closed-source models such as Deepseek2.5 and GPT-4o-mini. For low-resource languages, our $F_{0.5}$ scores surpass the baseline by up to a factor of 1.20. This method provides a more precise and resource-efficient solution for multilingual GEC, offering a promising direction for interpretable GEC research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入从大模型内部状态提取的“语法错误表示”（GER）作为检索依据，从根本上优化了上下文学习（ICL）在语法纠错任务中的表现，在提升纠错精度的同时，在多语言环境下展现了优于传统检索方案的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM在语法纠错任务上少样本性能不佳，主要原因是传统的检索方法偏向语义相似度，无法有效获取能反映语法错误特征的上下文示例。
AI.method: 提出了从大语言模型（LLM）内部状态中提取“语法错误表示”（GER）的方法，并将该表示用于上下文学习（ICL）中的示例检索，不再单纯依赖语义相似度，而是聚焦于捕捉语法错误模式。
AI.result: 在多语言GEC数据集上显著提升了ICL性能；在8B参数模型上，对于高资源语言达到了与Deepseek2.5和GPT-4o-mini相当的水平；对于低资源语言，$F_{0.5}$分数最高提升至基线的1.20倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于语法错误表示（GER）的检索方法为多语言语法纠错（GEC）提供了一种更精确且资源高效的新方案，证明了利用大模型内部状态提取特征对于提升少样本学习性能的有效性，为可解释性GEC研究开辟了方向。

title: Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer
summary: Transformer architectures have dramatically advanced representation learning and inference in deep models through self-attention mechanisms. In parallel,associative memory (AM) frameworks map representations onto energy landscapes, offering interpretable retrieval mechanisms. However, their continuous-time inference dynamics lack the biological plausibility of classical Continuous Attractor Neural Networks (CANNs). To bridge this gap, we propose Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer (CDAT), which couples a mixture von Mises-Fisher (Mo-vMF) attention energy with a Hopfield refinement energy, while augmenting energy descent with a CANN-inspired excitation-inhibition modulation. CDAT instantiates a topology-constrained dynamical system whose couplings encode relational structure among tokens, thereby linking attractor-style dynamics to modern energy-based attention. We further provide a constructive dissipation analysis to formally establish their controlled inference dynamics. Benefiting from these robust and structured dynamics, CDAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks in graph anomaly detection and graph classification.

AI.tldr: CDAT通过将注意力机制与受生物启发的连续吸引子神经动力学相结合，在保持高可解释性的同时，实现了更鲁棒的结构化推理，并在图任务中取得SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的Transformer注意力机制缺乏类似连续吸引子神经网络（CANN）的生物学合理性，且传统联想记忆（AM）框架的连续时间推理动力学存在局限。旨在弥合Transformer表示学习与生物动力学系统之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出CDAT（Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer），核心包括：1）结合混合von Mises-Fisher（Mo-vMF）注意力能量与Hopfield细化能量；2）引入受CANN启发的外侧抑制/激发调控；3）构建拓扑约束动力系统以编码Token间的关系结构；4）利用耗散分析确保推理动力学的稳定性。
AI.result: CDAT在图异常检测和图分类的多项基准测试中达到了SOTA（最先进）性能。
AI.conclusion: CDAT通过结合能量模型与连续吸引子动力学，成功将注意力机制与生物学上更合理的神经动力学相结合，为处理结构化数据提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的新框架。

title: Filtered Conformal Ellipsoids for Graph-Native Time Series
summary: Joint prediction sets for multivariate time series should control a single event while adapting to cross-coordinate dependence. We study filtered conformal ellipsoids: a frozen state-space filter emits a one-step predictive mean and covariance, and split-conformal calibration is applied to the resulting Mahalanobis scores. The filter is used to choose the ellipsoid shape; conformal calibration chooses the scalar radius, so the construction benefits from a learned predictive covariance without relying on Gaussian tail probabilities for coverage. The main difficulty is that filtered scores are dependent and learned recurrent filters need not contract in their raw hidden state; we therefore analyse contraction in an observable predictive-law quotient that identifies hidden states producing the same future sequence of emitted Gaussian laws. Under a stable Bayes Gaussian-projection filter, covariance bounds, and a finite-horizon observability Fisher condition, small excess Gaussian negative log-likelihood implies contraction of the learned emitted laws. Combined with a threshold-autocovariance envelope this yields a Chebyshev-type approximate coverage bound for filtered split-conformal prediction under dependence; a sharper Bernstein-type bound requires an additional geometric-mixing concentration assumption. Under Gaussian oracle realisability we also obtain a near-oracle log-volume comparison within the class of conditionally valid Gaussian ellipsoid rules. We instantiate the framework with a GCN-GRU filter with diagonal-plus-low-rank covariance. On moderate-size graph-native traffic benchmarks (METRLA-$20$ and PEMSBAY-$50$), the learned filter gives sharper at-target ellipsoids than static-covariance and non-filter baselines; at full-graph scale and on non-graph-native datasets, factor and copula baselines can be stronger.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种结合状态空间滤波与分裂共形预测的框架，用于生成多变量时间序列的动态预测椭球，在保证严格覆盖率的前提下，动态调整形状以提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测需要同时满足：1. 对单次预测事件的整体覆盖率进行严格控制；2. 能够动态适应变量之间复杂的相关性依赖；3. 现有的共形预测方法需解决递归模型中隐藏状态相关性带来的校准难度。
AI.method: 提出“过滤共形椭球”方法：1. 使用冻结的状态空间滤波器（如GCN-GRU）提取预测均值和协方差；2. 使用分裂共形校准方法在马氏距离得分上计算标量半径；3. 通过对可观测预测律商空间（observable predictive-law quotient）的压缩分析，解决了滤波得分相关性及隐藏状态非压缩的问题；4. 基于协方差边界和Fisher条件，导出了覆盖率界限。
AI.result: 1. 在理论上证明了该方法在满足稳定贝叶斯高斯投影滤波和有限层可观测性条件下的覆盖率有效性；2. 获得了近最优（near-oracle）的对数体积比较结果；3. 在METRLA-20和PEMSBAY-50等交通基准数据集上，该方法生成的预测椭球比静态协方差和非滤波基准更为紧凑（sharper）。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种名为“过滤共形椭球（Filtered Conformal Ellipsoids）”的新框架，通过结合状态空间滤波和分裂共形校准，实现了在多变量时间序列预测中对单事件覆盖率的精确控制，并能有效适应维度间的相关性。该方法无需假设高斯尾部概率即可保证覆盖率，且在复杂图数据上表现优于传统方法。

title: Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion: Compliant Grasping Across Dexterous Hands
summary: Dexterous grasping depends on contact regulation, not motion alone. Stable manipulation requires fingers to maintain appropriate object loading as contacts slip, deform, or become visually occluded. Existing cross-embodiment dexterous policies unify motion through retargeted hand poses or latent actions, but force feedback remains tied to each hand's sensing and actuation, limiting transfer. This work introduces a cross-embodiment force-position interface for contact-aware manipulation across heterogeneous dexterous hands. Motion intent is represented in a shared hand-pose latent, while each hand's effort signal is calibrated through system identification into physical joint torque in N.m. These torques are mapped to fingertip forces and compact per-finger load descriptors, giving the policy comparable observations of where the hand should move and how the object is loaded. Using this interface, a flow-matching visuomotor policy is trained on vision, proprioception, and calibrated contact, with structured visual masking that encourages reliance on force under grasp-relevant occlusion. The same calibrated signal drives a hybrid force-position controller for demonstration collection and execution, keeping force targets consistent across training and deployment. Experiments across structurally different hands show that calibrated contact feedback enables transferable compliant grasping, with learned primitives reusable in long-horizon manipulation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨具身力-位置接口，通过将不同灵巧手的力反馈标准化为物理量，使策略能够在异构硬件上实现稳健的接触感知操控。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨具身灵巧操作研究多关注运动姿态的统一，忽略了受感知和驱动差异限制的力反馈迁移问题；而灵巧抓取本质上依赖于接触调节与力加载，而非单纯的动作轨迹。
AI.method: 提出了一种跨具身力-位置接口，将不同手的力反馈校准为统一的物理关节力矩（N.m）及指尖负载描述符；采用基于流匹配（flow-matching）的视觉运动策略，并引入结构化视觉掩码以强化模型对触觉/力觉反馈的依赖。
AI.result: 在多种结构迥异的灵巧手上验证了该方法的有效性，实现了跨设备的顺应性抓取，并证明了习得的操作原语可在长程任务中进行迁移。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的跨具身力-位置接口与视觉运动策略，证明了通过物理校准的接触反馈，可以实现异构灵巧手之间稳定且可迁移的抓取操作，突破了仅依赖运动规划的局限。

title: Let LLMs Judge Each Other: Multi-Agent Peer-Reviewed Reasoning for Medical Question Answering
comment: Accepted by the Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association
summary:
Objective: To enhance the accuracy, interpretability, and robustness of large language models (LLMs) in medical question answering (MedQA).
  Method: We designed a multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method in which multiple LLM agents independently generate chain-of-thought reasoning with candidate answers, then act as peer reviewers to evaluate each other's reasoning for factual correctness and logical soundness. The highest-rated reasoning chain is selected to produce the final answer. Experiments were conducted with five state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4, DeepSeek-LLM-7B, GPT-oss-20B) on three benchmark datasets: HeadQA, MedQA-USMLE, and PubMedQA. Performance was compared against single-model chain-of-thought reasoning and chain-of-thought-based majority voting.
  Results: Peer-reviewed reasoning consistently outperformed both baselines. The best model combination achieved an average accuracy of 0.820 across datasets, exceeding the strongest single model (0.777) and majority voting ensembles (up to 0.789). The method also scaled effectively with more participating models, while peer assessments reliably distinguished high- from low-quality reasoning chains.
  Conclusion: The proposed multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method enables LLMs to act as both solvers and evaluators, yielding superior performance in MedQA. By emphasizing reasoning quality rather than answer agreement alone, this approach improves accuracy, interpretability, and robustness, offering a promising direction for trustworthy biomedical AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多智能体同行评审推理框架，通过让LLM代理相互评估推理链质量而非单纯投票，显著提升了医学问答任务的准确度与可信度。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决并提升大型语言模型（LLM）在医疗问答（MedQA）任务中的准确性、结果的可解释性以及整体的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计了一种多智能体同行评审推理（Multi-agent Peer-reviewed Reasoning）框架：多个LLM独立生成思维链（CoT）与候选答案，随后相互评审推理过程的实时性与逻辑性，最终通过加权选择评分最高的推理链输出结果。
AI.result: 该方法在HeadQA、MedQA-USMLE和PubMedQA三个基准测试中均优于单模型CoT和基于投票的集成方法。最高平均准确率达0.820（超越最优单模型的0.777和多数投票的0.789），且具备良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多智能体同行评审推理方法通过赋予LLM“求解者”与“评估者”的双重身份，显著提升了医学问答的准确性、可解释性与鲁棒性，为构建可信的生物医学AI系统提供了有效方向。

title: Exact Posterior Score Estimation for Solving Linear Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-based models learn powerful data priors by training a denoiser to reverse Gaussian corruption. To use this prior to solve a linear inverse problem, one needs to sample from the posterior, but the score that the prior provides is the unconditional score, not the posterior score. Existing methods either steer a fixed pretrained denoiser with approximate measurement-matching corrections, or train a conditional restoration model that abandons the denoising structure of the prior. We derive the exact posterior score in closed form for linear Gaussian inverse problems under general Gaussian interpolants, and show that posterior sampling reduces to a denoising problem at an operator-dependent shifted pivot under an anisotropic noise covariance. We turn this identity into Exact Posterior Score (EPS), a denoising training objective that preserves the input/output structure of standard pretraining and can therefore be trained from scratch or fine-tuned from a pretrained denoiser. At inference, EPS uses the same sampler as the underlying backbone, with no likelihood gradients or projections. We evaluate EPS on five linear inverse problems across FFHQ and ImageNet, where it outperforms training-free and training-based baselines on fidelity, perceptual, and distributional metrics, while using roughly an order of magnitude fewer denoiser evaluations than gradient-based posterior samplers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Exact Posterior Score (EPS)，通过推导线性逆问题的精确后验分数，实现了一种既能利用预训练模型优势，又无需复杂梯度计算的高效逆问题求解方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型解决线性逆问题的方法存在缺陷：要么使用近似测量匹配修正（效果受限），要么训练条件生成模型但失去了原始去噪器的先验结构。作者旨在寻找一种既能利用预训练先验，又能严格满足后验分数定义的求解方法。
AI.method: 推导了高斯插值框架下线性高斯逆问题的精确后验分数闭式解，提出 EPS（Exact Posterior Score）训练目标；该方法保持了标准去噪器的输入输出结构，支持从头训练或对预训练模型进行微调，且推理过程与骨干模型采样保持一致，无需似然梯度或投影。
AI.result: 在 FFHQ 和 ImageNet 的五项线性逆问题评估中，EPS 在保真度、感知质量和分布指标上均优于现有的训练无关（training-free）和训练相关（training-based）基线模型，且推理所需的去噪器评估次数减少了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: EPS 通过推导出的精确后验分数形式，实现了在无需额外梯度计算或投影的情况下，利用预训练去噪器进行高效、高质量的线性逆问题求解，证明了该方法在计算效率和生成质量上的优越性。

title: Robots as Tokens: Unified Diffusion Transformer for Coordinated Multi-Robot Trajectory Generation
summary: The success of generative models in language and visual generation has inspired extensive applications to generative robot planning. However, most existing works either focus on single-robot planning, or generate multi-robot trajectories in a sequential manner with iterative post-processing to resolve inter-robot conflicts. In this work, we investigate whether coordinated multi-robot trajectories, as a special spatiotemporal distribution, can be learned and generated with a generative model in a feed-forward manner. We propose Robots as Tokens (Roken), a unified diffusion transformer that directly generates multi-robot trajectories that satisfy both (individual) safety and (global) connectivity constraints. The core design of Roken is to represent each robot as a discrete token, allowing them to naturally interact with each other through self-attention, and cross-attend to map tokens for environment layouts. We further introduce several auxiliary tasks based on Bayes' theorem to provide multi-scale spatial-temporal supervision for efficient learning of the conditional distribution. In training, Roken absorbs diverse expert trajectories from different team sizes. During inference, Roken behaves as a versatile multi-robot planner that can handle single-robot planning, coordinated multi-robot trajectory generation, and conditional trajectory generation by fixing some robot tokens as conditions. Experiments in diverse cluttered environments show that Roken can generate coordinated multi-robot trajectories to perform connectivity-constrained goal navigation tasks with high success rates, outperforming the baseline method used to generate the training dataset. Roken also demonstrates good scalability after training with mixed team sizes, and shows generalization to unseen or partially observed environments, verifying its potential to learn from diverse data and perform versatile tasks.

AI.tldr: Roken是一种基于扩散Transformer的多机器人轨迹生成模型，通过将机器人视为Token在自注意力机制中直接处理协同与约束，实现了无需迭代后处理的前馈多机器人轨迹规划与导航。
AI.motivation: 针对现有生成式机器人规划方法多局限于单机器人或串行规划（需额外处理冲突）的问题，研究探索是否可以通过前馈生成模型直接生成满足复杂约束（安全与全局连通性）的协同多机器人轨迹。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“Robots as Tokens (Roken)”的统一扩散Transformer架构，将每个机器人视为一个离散Token，通过自注意力机制实现机器人间的交互，并通过映射Token与环境布局进行交叉注意力交互；引入基于贝叶斯定理的辅助任务，提供多尺度时空监督。
AI.result: 在复杂拥挤环境中的实验表明，Roken在满足连通性约束的目标导航任务中表现优异，成功率超过了专家数据生成基线；同时具备良好的扩展性（适应不同团队规模）以及对未知或部分观测环境的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Roken通过将机器人表示为离散Token并利用扩散Transformer架构，实现了高效的协同多机器人轨迹生成。该方法证明了多机器人协同规划可以被建模为一种前馈生成的分布学习问题，展现了超越传统顺序规划方法的潜力和泛化能力。

title: Pepti-Agent: An AI Agent for Peptide Design and Optimization
summary: Therapeutic peptides occupy a valuable design space between small molecules and biologics, but their development requires satisfying several competing constraints at once: solubility, hemolytic activity, and nonspecific surface fouling are governed by overlapping sequence features, so improving one property often degrades another. Computational design addresses this by pairing generative models with sequence-based property predictors, iteratively proposing and refining candidates. However, these components are typically wired together as monolithic scripts that are difficult to inspect, extend, or reuse, and they often refine sequences by natural-language reasoning rather than by tracking the evolving multi-property state of each candidate. We present Pepti-Agent, a closed-loop, peptide-specific framework that exposes generation, property prediction, and single-residue mutation as independently inspectable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. A large language model controller invokes these tools and consults live predictor output between calls, so refinement is guided by each sequence's current property profile rather than by language reasoning alone. Task-specific PeptideGPT models generate candidates, ProtBERT-based classifiers score solubility, hemolysis, and non-fouling, and two interchangeable mutation operators propose sequence edits. By recording a per-step trace of controller decisions, predictor outputs, and accepted mutations, Pepti-Agent offers a reproducible substrate for benchmarking multi-objective design strategies and for prioritizing candidates for experimental validation.

AI.tldr: Pepti-Agent 是一个用于治疗性多肽设计的闭环框架，利用 LLM 控制器和 MCP 工具，通过对多属性指标的实时监测而非简单的语言概率推理，实现了更精确、可解释的序列迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 治疗性多肽设计中，溶解度、溶血性等属性往往相互制约，且现有的计算设计流程多为难以复用和监控的单体化脚本，缺乏对候选序列多属性状态的动态追踪能力。
AI.method: 构建了基于“模型上下文协议（MCP）”的闭环系统，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为控制器，集成特定的生成模型（PeptideGPT）和属性预测模型（ProtBERT），并通过单残基变异算子进行迭代优化，而非仅依赖概率预测。
AI.result: 成功实现了一个闭环系统，能够通过实时追踪每个序列的属性特征引导设计，同时记录推理过程和变异轨迹，支持多目标设计策略的基准测试和实验验证优先级排序。
AI.conclusion: Pepti-Agent 提供了一个可解释、可复现且灵活的框架，通过多模型协作与主动反馈机制，有效解决了治疗性多肽设计中多个属性（溶解度、溶血性、非特异性污染）间的权衡难题。

title: SAPS: Shared Autonomy for Policy Steering by Blending Teleoperation with a Pretrained VLA
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive generalist capabilities in robot manipulation, yet these policies can be brittle under out-of-distribution spatial and semantic perturbations. While human teleoperation offers reliable recovery, it can demand high cognitive load and precise manual control, and existing policy steering methods often require auxiliary models or sampler modifications. In this work, we introduce Shared Autonomy for Policy Steering (SAPS), a framework that blends real-time human teleoperation commands with pretrained policy actions at the action level. SAPS requires no policy retraining, auxiliary dynamics models, or architectural modifications. We propose and evaluate three arbitration strategies to balance human and VLA policy control, including a dynamic Cosine-similarity arbitration strategy that computes the geometric agreement between human and policy actions. Across evaluations in simulation (LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, CALVIN) and on real-world robot hardware, SAPS improves task success rates over autonomous execution by up to 82% in both simulation and the real world. Furthermore, our approach drastically reduces human intervention compared to pure teleoperation, while simultaneously achieving faster task completion times than both autonomous execution and pure teleoperation. These results demonstrate that action-level shared autonomy is a practical, model-agnostic approach for reliably deploying generalist robot policies in real-world contexts involving a human operator,with promising applications in assistive teleoperation and scalable data collection.

AI.tldr: SAPS 是一个模型无关的共享自主框架，通过动作级融合人类指令与 VLA 策略，解决了机器人策略在 OOD 环境下的脆弱性问题，实现了更高的成功率和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型在面对分布外（OOD）环境时表现脆弱，而传统的远程操作或策略干预方法通常存在认知负载高、需求复杂或需要模型结构修改等痛点。
AI.method: 提出 SAPS 框架，在动作层面融合人类远程操作指令与预训练 VLA 策略动作。包含三种仲裁策略，其中核心为利用几何一致性（余弦相似度）进行动态调整的仲裁机制。无需额外的动力学模型或策略微调。
AI.result: 在模拟环境（LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, CALVIN）和真实机器人硬件上验证，任务成功率最高提升 82%。在减少人工介入的同时，任务完成速度优于纯自动执行或纯人工操作。
AI.conclusion: SAPS 是一种无需模型重新训练或结构修改的通用共享自主框架，能够有效结合人类干预与 VLA 策略，显著提升了机器人操作任务的成功率、效率及鲁棒性，并在辅助远程操作和数据采集方面具有广泛应用潜力。

title: EnvShip-Bench: An Environment-Enhanced Benchmark for Short-Term Vessel Trajectory Prediction
summary: Vessel trajectory prediction is important for intelligent shipping, maritime surveillance, and navigation safety. However, existing public maritime AIS resources are often limited by inconsistent forecasting protocols, uneven data quality, and the lack of benchmark-ready contextual annotations, which hinder fair comparison and context-aware modeling. To address this gap, we present EnvShip-Bench, a unified benchmark for short-term vessel trajectory prediction built from large-scale raw AIS data from the Danish Maritime Authority (DMA) and NOAA through a common processing pipeline. EnvShip-Bench adopts a standardized forecasting protocol with 10 minutes of observation, 10 minutes of prediction, and 20-second sampling in vessel-centric local metric coordinates. Beyond the large-scale core benchmark, it provides a quality-first compact subset for efficient and reproducible experimentation, together with synchronized environmental and nearby-vessel context extensions. As a result, EnvShip-Bench supports trajectory-only, environment-aware, and interaction-aware forecasting under a unified evaluation framework. Extensive benchmark statistics and analysis demonstrate that EnvShip-Bench offers a standardized, extensible, and context-aware foundation for maritime trajectory forecasting research.

AI.tldr: 针对船舶轨迹预测领域数据碎片化的问题，本文提出了 EnvShip-Bench 基准，通过统一的数据处理协议和丰富的上下文注记，为航运智能与安全研究提供了一个标准化评估平台。
AI.motivation: 现有海上 AIS 数据源存在格式不统一、数据质量参差不齐及缺乏基准化上下文标注等问题，限制了该领域研究的公平比较与模型性能提升。
AI.method: 建立统一处理流水线，使用丹麦海事局（DMA）和 NOAA 的大规模原始 AIS 数据构建数据集；采用标准化实验协议（10分钟观测、10分钟预测、20秒采样间隔）；提供核心基准，并配套环境与交互上下文信息。
AI.result: 构建了 EnvShip-Bench 基准，支持轨迹预测、环境感知、交互感知三种任务模式，并提供了基准统计分析，为实验的可重复性和研究评估提供了统一框架。
AI.conclusion: EnvShip-Bench 为船舶轨迹预测研究提供了一个标准化、可扩展且具备上下文感知的基准平台，推动了该领域公平对比与深层建模的发展。

title: Perfect Demo Makes Poor Teacher: Learning Robust Alignment from Critical Motion Segments
summary: Expert demonstrations are widely assumed to be the gold standard for robot imitation learning. Yet for fine-grained manipulation such as insertion, stacking, and alignment, we uncover a counterintuitive failure mode: fluent demonstrations can be poor teachers. A skilled teleoperator compresses the decisive moments of alignment and recovery into a brief temporal window, leaving the policy flooded with redundant free-space motion and starved of supervision exactly where precision determines success. We address this bottleneck at two levels. At the data level, slowing down near alignment and resampling critical segments both help, yet the gain comes mainly from broadening the coverage of recovery states the policy must learn, not from reweighting frames it already has. Such data-side fixes, however, leave the policy's per-frame view untouched: a single image still maps directly to an action, and the local motion that governs correction stays implicit. We therefore turn to the representation level and introduce STAIR (\textbf{S}patio-\textbf{T}emporal feature \textbf{A}s an \textbf{I}nterface for \textbf{R}obot learning), a compact dynamic feature that bridges the vision-language model and the action expert, distilling the short-horizon motion already recorded in each trajectory into dense, motion-aware supervision. Trained on fluent data alone, STAIR recovers most of the deliberate-demonstration gain ($50.0$ to $62.2\%$ overall, approaching the $64.4\%$ of deliberate demonstrations). These results call for a more pedagogical view of robot data, optimized for machine learnability rather than human efficiency alone.

AI.tldr: 流畅的机器人专家示范在精细动作中可能因信息密度分布不均导致学习效果不佳，本文提出的STAIR方法通过提取时空特征，为机器人策略学习提供了更有效的监督信号，弥补了流畅数据在关键动作识别上的不足。
AI.motivation: 在机器人模仿学习中，专家流畅的示范看似是“金标准”，但在精细操作任务中，流畅的演示往往压缩了关键的对齐和纠正动作，导致策略学习在关键时刻监督信息不足，而充满了冗余的自由空间运动。
AI.method: 提出STAIR（Spatio-Temporal feature As an Interface for Robot learning），这是一种紧凑的动态特征表示方法，旨在弥合视觉语言模型与动作专家之间的鸿沟。它将轨迹中记录的短时程运动信息蒸馏为密集的、运动感知的监督信号，而非依赖于传统的逐帧映射。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，仅使用流畅数据训练的基线模型成功率仅为50.0%，而使用故意放慢动作的“教学式”示范可达64.4%。引入STAIR模型后，在仅使用流畅数据的情况下，成功率显著提升至62.2%，接近最优的教学式示范效果。
AI.conclusion: 机器人专家示范的数据质量并不完全等同于其在学习中的有效性。针对精细操作任务，通过STAIR将时空动态特征引入策略学习，能够有效弥补流畅演示中关键运动信息缺失的缺陷，使模型在仅使用流畅数据的情况下，达到接近甚至媲美慢速“教学式”演示的性能。未来机器人数据收集应从追求“人类效率”转向“机器可学习性”。

title: M-CTX: Exact and Scalable Spatial Context Retrieval for Trajectory Analytics
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to ICDE 2027
summary: Modern trajectory predictors increasingly condition on external spatial context, such as map geometry, signed distance fields (SDFs), and nearby moving agents. While this context improves prediction quality, constructing it for every training anchor has become a hidden systems bottleneck. In a representative maritime AIS pipeline, spatial context construction requires roughly 17 CPU-days for a 5.48M-anchor corpus, dominating the cost of the downstream predictor. We present M-CTX, an exact and scalable spatial context-retrieval framework for trajectory analytics. M-CTX recasts context construction as an ingest-once, query-many spatial database workload and replaces three brute-force stages -- OSM range retrieval, SDF computation, and moving-vessel neighbour lookup -- with composable, index-backed operators. Its learned range-index backend, BR-LZ, provides recall-complete MBR-overlap range retrieval and reduces candidate amplification by 1.1x--2.7x relative to global-expansion one-curve baselines. Across four maritime regions, eight baseline systems, synthetic workloads with up to 40M spatial features, and 10^7-record AIS streams, M-CTX reproduces the reference context exactly. On the 5.48M-anchor corpus, it reduces context construction from about 17 CPU-days to 1.8 hours, a measured 226x end-to-end speed-up. An optional storage mode further compresses SDF context by 64x with only a 0.04 m ADE change. These results establish exact spatial context retrieval as a first-class database problem in modern trajectory analytics. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/mark000071/M-CTX-Traj.

AI.tldr: 针对轨迹预测中空间上下文构建计算代价过高的瓶颈，M-CTX通过引入索引算子将构建过程优化为“一次摄入，多次查询”的数据库任务，实现了226倍的速度提升并保证了结果精度。
AI.motivation: 现代轨迹预测模型高度依赖外部空间上下文，但目前的上下文构建过程极其耗时（如在海事AIS任务中需17个CPU日），成为制约预测性能的系统瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出M-CTX框架，将传统暴力计算（OSM检索、SDF计算、邻近船舶查找）转化为基于索引的可组合算子查询；引入学习型范围索引（BR-LZ）以实现高效的MBR重叠检索，并提供可选项对SDF上下文进行压缩。
AI.result: 在海事AIS数据集上，将上下文构建时间从17 CPU日缩短至1.8小时（提速226倍）；检索实现了完全召回（Recall-complete）；SDF压缩模式可实现64倍压缩且仅产生0.04m的ADE误差。
AI.conclusion: M-CTX成功将高昂的时空上下文构建过程从离线预计算范式转变为高效的数据库查询任务，证明了精确的时空上下文检索可以作为现代轨迹分析中的核心数据库问题解决，极大地提升了处理规模与效率。

title: Pixels to Proofs: Probabilistically-Safe Latent World Model Control via Parallel Conformal Robust MPC
summary: We present SLS^2, a framework for safe feedback motion planning from pixels using robust model predictive control (MPC) in learned latent world models. Our approach trains an action-conditioned joint-embedding world model with compact Markovian latent states, enabling efficient gradient-based trajectory optimization through learned latent dynamics. To enforce safety for the true system despite imperfect latent predictions, we inform a GPU-accelerated system level synthesis (SLS) robust MPC scheme with conformal prediction to obtain calibrated latent error bounds and robust latent-space constraint sets. We further learn and conformalize a latent constraint checker, allowing the SLS planner to impose probabilistic safety constraints during closed-loop execution. We evaluate our method on vision-based control tasks, where it improves both goal-reaching performance and safety over latent world-model and safe-planning baselines.

AI.tldr: SLS^2 是一种利用学习到的潜在世界模型进行视觉反馈控制的架构，它通过共形预测量化不确定性，并结合 GPU 加速的系统级合成（SLS）鲁棒 MPC 实现了端到端的安全运动规划。
AI.motivation: 现有的从像素空间进行运动规划的方法往往难以在保证封闭环路系统安全性的同时，处理复杂的高维视觉输入和潜在动力学模型的不确定性。
AI.method: 1. 使用动作调节的联合嵌入（joint-embedding）世界模型学习紧凑的马尔可夫潜在状态；2. 采用共形预测（Conformal Prediction）对潜在动力学预测误差进行校准，获得鲁棒的界限；3. 集成 GPU 加速的系统级合成（SLS）鲁棒 MPC 进行轨迹优化；4. 学习并共形化一个潜在约束检查器以施加概率安全性约束。
AI.result: 在视觉驱动的控制任务中，SLS^2 相比现有的潜在世界模型和安全规划基线方法，在目标到达性能和安全性方面均表现出显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SLS^2 框架通过结合学习到的世界模型、共形预测和系统级合成（SLS）鲁棒 MPC，成功解决了从像素空间进行安全反馈运动规划的问题，在保证安全性的同时提升了任务执行性能。

title: Evaluative Judgement in Teaching AI-based Translation: A Class-room Case Study of AI-Mediated Translation and Post-Editing
comment: Workshop on Teaching AI-based Translation and Technologies (TAITT 2026) - EAMT 2026
summary: Drawing on 23 anonymized student pro-jects from a fourth-year Machine Transla-tion and Post-editing course in a BA-level translation programme, this paper exam-ines how structured comparison of gen-eral-purpose LLMs and online MT sys-tems can elicit evaluative judgement in AI-mediated translation. Students translat-ed short specialised English Wikipedia texts into Catalan or Spanish, generated four system outputs, evaluated them using automatic metrics and human adequa-cy/fluency assessment, selected one output for post-editing, and justified their deci-sion in written reports. Descriptive counts are reported for all 23 projects, while qualitative interpretation is based on the 22 cases accompanied by written reports. Results show that students did not treat automatic metrics as final authority: final post-editing selections often diverged from metric rankings and were justified through adequacy, fluency, terminology, naturalness, and expected post-editing ef-fort. The study therefore does not bench-mark systems under controlled conditions; it analyses how students justified system choice within an authentic classroom as-signment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析本科翻译专业学生的课程项目，探讨了学生如何利用结构化方法对比大语言模型与传统机器翻译系统。结果表明，学生能够超越自动化指标，基于多维标准对翻译输出做出自主评估与决策。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的普及，翻译教育需要探讨学生如何对通用大模型与传统机器翻译（MT）系统的输出进行差异化评估，以及这些系统如何影响学生在AI辅助翻译过程中的评价性判断。
AI.method: 本研究选取了某本科翻译专业“机器翻译与译后编辑”课程中23份匿名学生项目报告。学生需将专业英语维基百科文本翻译为加泰罗尼亚语或西班牙语，生成四种系统输出，利用自动化指标及人工评估（准确性与流畅度）对比评估，最终选择一个版本进行译后编辑，并提交书面报告说明理由。研究对23个项目进行了定量分析，并结合22个包含书面说明的项目进行了定性分析。
AI.result: 研究发现，学生并未将自动化评估指标视为翻译质量的“最终权威”；相反，他们在译后编辑阶段的选择往往与指标排名不一致，其决策过程体现了对翻译质量多维度（如专业性、语境契合度等）的审慎考量。
AI.conclusion: 本研究指出，翻译专业的学生在使用AI辅助翻译时，并不盲目依赖自动化评价指标，而是通过综合考量准确性、流畅度、术语准确性、自然度及预期译后编辑工作量来做出最终决策。真实课堂环境下的批判性评估过程对于培养学生在AI时代下的翻译决策能力至关重要。

title: Exploring Starts Are Not Enough: Counterexamples and a Fix for Monte Carlo Exploring Starts
summary: The asymptotic behaviour of Monte Carlo Exploring Starts (MCES) is a long-standing open question in reinforcement learning, even in the tabular setting. We investigated the convergence properties of tabular MCES by constructing examples in which the algorithm converges to suboptimal solutions. This paper presents new counterexamples for both initial-visit and first-visit MCES and gives a convergence-restoring modification for the initial-visit case. We show that stable suboptimal solutions may exist for initial-visit MCES with sample-average updates even when greedy actions are updated more often than non-greedy actions on average. However, by scaling learning rates inversely to update frequencies on a state-by-state basis, convergence to optimality is guaranteed. Unlike previous uniformisation methods, this modification is applicable to large-scale problems that require approximating the estimated value function. We then extend the example to show that sample-average first-visit MCES may also converge to suboptimal solutions. This largely settles a fundamental open problem and shows that exploring starts alone do not guarantee convergence to optimality. More broadly, these results highlight that convergence depends critically on the relative size and frequency of updates applied to different actions, making the choice of learning rates and the balance between exploration and exploitation central to the analysis of MCES and the implementation of scalable Monte Carlo control methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文解决了 MCES 算法收敛性的长期疑虑，证明了仅靠 Exploring Starts 无法保证收敛至最优，并提出了基于状态更新频率的学习率修正方案以确保收敛性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中 MCES（Monte Carlo Exploring Starts）算法的渐近收敛性长期以来是一个未决问题，即使在表格（tabular）设置下也是如此。研究旨在探索该算法是否存在收敛到次优解的可能性，并寻找修正方法。
AI.method: 1. 构建了针对初始访问（Initial-visit）和首次访问（First-visit）MCES 的反例，证明其会收敛到次优解。2. 提出了一种修改方案：基于状态的更新频率，按比例缩放学习率（learning rates），以恢复算法的收敛性。
AI.result: 1. 证明了 MCES 在使用样本均值更新时，即使贪婪动作的更新频率高于非贪婪动作，仍可能稳定在次优解。2. 验证了通过特定学习率缩放，初始访问 MCES 可以保证收敛到最优。3. 确认首次访问 MCES 同样存在收敛至次优解的问题。
AI.conclusion: MCES 算法在 tabular 设置下不能保证收敛到最优解（存在收敛至次优解的反例）。通过按状态比例缩放学习率，可以使初始访问 MCES 收敛到最优解，且该方法可扩展至大规模近似问题。

title: Retrieve, Don't Retrain: Extending Vision Language Action Models to New Tasks at Test Time
summary: Extending a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a new task typically requires task-specific teleoperated demonstrations and per-task fine-tuning, making adaptation costly in both data collection and compute. In this paper, we show that this target-side per-task adaptation cost can be replaced by retrieval. Our retrieval-augmented policy is trained once on paired demonstrations from the target embodiment (query) and a cheaper embodiment (pool, e.g., human-hand video), then frozen. New tasks are added at deployment by appending pool-side demonstrations to a retrieval pool. The frozen policy conditions on retrieved trajectories at every control step, so new tasks are absorbed by indexing data rather than updating parameters. Fine-tuning is needed only to take on a new, unseen embodiment, not for each new task. We show that retrieval improves policies beyond a specific backbone, including standard VLA policies, but its effect is especially pronounced in Cosmos Policy, a video-generation-based world-action model (WAM). In this setting, retrieval supplies coarse task progression, while the WAM's future-image objective provides an additional visual consistency signal that strengthens the retrieval-conditioned actions. On PushT, we study how retrieval provides a reusable high-level motion prior for cross-embodiment generalization to unseen goal angles, while on RoboTwin 2.0 our method outperforms cross-embodiment baselines on unseen tasks, and we additionally demonstrate the method on a real robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种检索增强的VLA策略，通过将新任务适配过程从“模型参数微调”转变为“演示数据检索”，消除了按任务微调的需求，大幅提升了机器人面对新任务的迁移效率与跨具身泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在新任务迁移时，往往依赖于昂贵的特定任务远程操作演示采集和计算密集型的微调过程，适配成本过高，限制了机器人的广泛应用。
AI.method: 1. 训练一个冻结（frozen）的策略，该策略以目标具身演示（查询）和廉价具身演示（检索池，如人类视频）作为条件；2. 部署时，不再更新参数，而是通过检索任务演示并将其作为控制步骤的输入，实现新任务的即时迁移；3. 结合Cosmos Policy（一种基于视频生成的行动世界模型，WAM），利用视频生成提供的时序一致性信号强化检索增强的动作预测。
AI.result: 1. 在PushT任务中，该方法为跨具身泛化提供了可复用的高层运动先验；2. 在RoboTwin 2.0任务中，该方法在未见任务的表现上超越了现有的跨具身基准模型；3. 通过实机部署验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了基于检索增强（Retrieval-augmented）的VLA策略，证明了通过将“每任务微调”替换为“检索数据”，可以显著降低机器人策略在新任务上的适配成本。该方法在跨具身（cross-embodiment）泛化和零样本任务部署方面展现了巨大潜力，特别是在结合视频生成模型（WAM）时表现出更优的控制性能。

title: AthDGC: An Open Diachronic Greek Treebank with Indo-European Parallels
comment: 16 pages. Data paper for the v0.4 release of AthDGC. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20439182. Companion site: https://athdgc.github.io
summary: AthDGC ("Athens-PROIEL") is an open, end-to-end workflow and dataset. It is, to the best of our knowledge, the first openly licensed dependency-parsed treebank of Greek that spans eight diachronic periods, namely Archaic, Classical, Koine, Late Antique, Byzantine, Late Byzantine, Early Modern, and Modern Greek, under a single PROIEL XML 2.0 schema, with verse-level cross-alignment of the New Testament to Latin (Vulgate), Gothic (Wulfila), Old Church Slavonic (Marianus), and Classical Armenian. AthDGC builds on the PROIEL Treebank Family (Haug and Johndal 2008; Eckhoff et al. 2018), which established the schema and the Koine-Greek reference set for the project. Annotation uses the Stanford Stanza PROIEL-trained workflow; sentence-level alignment uses LaBSE, a multilingual sentence-embedding model; word-level alignment uses multilingual-BERT attention through the AwesomeAlign procedure. The v0.4 release provides curated samples and the open-source toolkit; the full annotated corpus partitions remain under v0.5 audit on the Greek national HPC. Quantitative scale, per-witness verse counts, and per-period annotated-row counts are reported in the v0.5 release notes, after the audit pass completes. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20439182.

AI.tldr: AthDGC 是首个涵盖希腊语八个历史时期的开源、跨语言对齐依赖句法树库，通过自动标注流水线和多语言嵌入模型，实现了希腊语与其他四种古代语言的文本资源互通。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立首个涵盖从古希腊语到现代希腊语共八个历史时期的开放、一致且跨语言对齐的依赖句法树库，以支持多语言和历时语言学研究。
AI.method: 基于 PROIEL XML 2.0 模式构建；利用 Stanford Stanza 进行依赖句法分析；采用 LaBSE 进行句级对齐，并通过 AwesomeAlign（基于 mBERT 注意力机制）实现词级对齐。
AI.result: 发布了 v0.4 版本（包含受控样本和工具包）；完成了涵盖八个历史时期的跨语言文本对齐（含新约圣经及其拉丁语、哥特语、古教会斯拉夫语和古典亚美尼亚语版本）。
AI.conclusion: AthDGC 作为一个开源、端到端的希腊语历时句法树库，填补了跨八个历史时期希腊语标注数据的空白，为多语言比较研究提供了宝贵的资源和工具。

title: AI for Social Good: An Investigation of the Causal Relationship Between Environmental Regulations and Their Effects on Air Pollution in London, UK
summary: Air pollution regulation is central to urban public health governance, but estimating its effects is difficult because policies are implemented non-randomly and pollution trajectories are shaped by meteorology, socioeconomic change, temporal trends, and overlapping interventions. This study develops an uncertainty-aware Bayesian deep learning framework to estimate the aggregate effect of air pollution regulations on PM$_{2.5}$ concentrations in London from 2010 to 2020. The framework integrates daily PM$_{2.5}$ observations from Inner London monitoring stations, meteorological covariates, annual socioeconomic indicators, month-of-year and day-of-week indicators, and daily regulation status data for 32 policy measures. A Bayesian LSTM captures temporal dependencies in environmental and socioeconomic covariates, Bayesian embedding layers represent temporal and regulation status inputs, and a regulation status prediction branch supports propensity score-based adjustment for non-random policy implementation. Regulatory effects are estimated by comparing observed PM$_{2.5}$ concentrations with counterfactual predictions under a hypothetical no-regulation scenario, with uncertainty summarized across repeated Bayesian training runs and bootstrap resampling. Results show that London's regulations were associated with an average PM$_{2.5}$ reduction of 1.88 $μ$g/m$^3$, a relative reduction of 12.35%, with a 95% confidence interval of 1.64-2.12 $μ$g/m$^3$. Estimated effects were limited before 2013, became clearer from 2013 to 2017, and were strongest in 2018 and 2019. The findings suggest that sustained and cumulative regulatory interventions contributed to measurable improvements in London's air quality. This study demonstrates how uncertainty-aware causal AI can support environmental accountability, public health protection, and evidence-based governance for environmental decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用贝叶斯深度学习模型量化伦敦空气治理政策的效果，通过反事实分析确认政策有效地将PM$_{2.5}$降低了1.88 μg/m³，为环境公共卫生决策提供了可解释的因果依据。
AI.motivation: 空气污染政策的实施往往是非随机的，且受气象、社会经济和多元叠加因素影响，准确评估其因果效应具有挑战性。
AI.method: 开发了一种不确定性感知贝叶斯深度学习框架，集成贝叶斯LSTM处理时序特征，利用嵌入层表征输入，并通过策略倾向评分调整非随机干预的影响；通过对比观察值与反事实推演评估监管效果。
AI.result: 2010-2020年间，伦敦空气污染法规使PM$_{2.5}$平均浓度降低了1.88 μg/m³（相对降幅12.35%），其中2018-2019年效果最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，伦敦持续且累积的空气污染监管政策有效降低了PM$_{2.5}$浓度，证明了不确定性感知因果AI在环境治理和循证决策中的应用价值。

title: TO-SoFiT: Topology Optimization of Hydraulic Soft Fish Tail Design for programmable undulating locomotion
comment: Accepted for publication at the Advances in Robotics (AIR), 2025, IIT Jodhpur
summary: Soft robots leverage compliant materials to generate motion through controlled elastic deformation, making them ideal for delicate tasks such as underwater exploration and biomimetic marine systems. Although hydraulic/pneumatic actuation remains pivotal for such systems, the lack of systematic design frameworks has hindered the development of robots capable of complex 3D motion, such as fish-like swimming. This work introduces a topology optimization method to automate the design of a hydraulic soft fish tail, explicitly addressing the design-dependent coupling between fluidic actuation and structural deformation. We use a Darcy law-based model augmented with a drainage term to simulate spatially varying hydraulic pressure loads, translating these into consistent nodal forces via finite element analysis. The employed robust multi-criteria optimization formulation balances deformation efficiency, fluid-structure interaction, geometric manufacturability, and required stiffness for optimizing a bioinspired soft fish tail for 3D swimming kinematics. The optimized tail topology is incorporated into a pneumatic network actuator and computationally validated under various hydraulic loads, achieving tunable undulatory amplitudes and multiaxis bending for depth adjustment. The optimized 2D tail outperforms its rectangular counterpart. By cascading optimized tail segments, we demonstrate programmable swimming patterns in soft robotic fish tails at different hydraulic loads. This work advances the systematic codesign of hydraulic actuators and soft structures, offering a pathway to automate underwater robots with optimized design and vertebrate-like agility in confined aquatic environments. Our implementations and simulations are publicly available at 'https://github.com/PrabhatIn/TO-SoFiT'.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种自动化拓扑优化方法，用于设计具有类生物灵活性和复杂3D游动能力的液压驱动软体鱼尾，通过协同优化执行器结构显著提升了软体机器人的运动性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的软体机器人设计缺乏系统性框架，导致难以实现复杂的3D运动（如鱼类游动），且难以处理液压驱动与结构变形之间复杂的耦合关系。
AI.method: 引入了一种基于达西定律（Darcy law）并带有排水项的力学模型来模拟空间变化的液压负载，并通过有限元分析（FEA）将其转化为节点力。采用多准则鲁棒优化算法，在变形效率、流固耦合、制造约束及刚度之间寻求平衡。
AI.result: 成功设计出一种生物启发式软体鱼尾，与传统矩形设计相比表现更优；通过级联优化的尾部段落，实现了在不同液压负载下的可编程游动模式，并在计算中验证了其具有多轴弯曲和可调振幅的能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种针对液压驱动软体机器人（如仿生鱼尾）的系统化拓扑优化框架。该方法通过联合设计执行器与结构，成功实现了复杂的三维游泳运动（如波状运动和多轴弯曲），证明了计算驱动设计在提高软体机器人灵活性和性能方面的有效性。

title: SHARD: Safe and Helpful Alignment via Self-Reframing Distillation
summary: Large language models often struggle with sensitive prompts. They may refuse outright, provide generic safety boilerplate, or fail to address the user's legitimate informational needs that can be answered safely. We introduce SHARD, a self-reframing distillation method to improve safe-helpfulness. It first rewrites sensitive prompts to surface benign intent using philosophical guidelines, then reframes its original responses into safe, more helpful ones, and finally fine-tunes the model on its self-reframed responses. Across DNA and the English subset of LINGUASAFE, SHARD improves helpfulness for most model families while preserving safety. It also remains competitive with distillation from a larger teacher model, suggesting that models can internalize safe and helpful behavior elicited from their own. Warning: This paper contains content that may be offensive or harmful.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型面对敏感提示词时拒绝回答或表现不佳的问题，论文提出 SHARD 蒸馏方法，通过自我重构和微调，在保持安全性的前提下显著提升了模型对敏感问题的实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在面对敏感提示词时，往往表现出过度防御（如直接拒绝或提供无效的套话），无法满足用户合法的、可被安全解答的信息需求。
AI.method: 提出 SHARD（Self-reframing Distillation）方法：1. 基于哲学指南重写敏感提示词以挖掘良性意图；2. 将原始回答重构为更安全、更有益的版本；3. 使用这些重构后的数据对模型进行微调。
AI.result: 在 DNA 和 LINGUASAFE 数据集上测试表明，SHARD 在大多数模型系列中显著提升了实用性（helpfulness），同时保持了原有的安全性，且与使用大模型蒸馏的方法表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 模型能够通过自身的“自我重构”能力内化安全且有益的行为模式，无需完全依赖更大规模的教师模型，从而在保持安全性的同时显著提升对敏感提示词的回复质量。

title: Trust-Region Diffusion Policies for Massively Parallel On-Policy RL
summary: Reinforcement learning with massively parallel simulations has become a standard framework for developing robust, deployable policies; however, most existing approaches still rely on simple Gaussian policy parameterizations. Diffusion models provide a more expressive policy class and have shown strong performance on challenging control problems, yet most diffusion-based RL methods are designed for offline or off-policy training. In this work, we ask whether diffusion policies can be trained effectively in the massively parallel, on-policy regime. To this end, we introduce Trust-region Diffusion Policies (TruDi), which enables diffusion policies for on-policy RL with massively parallel simulations. This setting is particularly challenging because the data distribution changes quickly across updates, making stable training with complex policies difficult. TruDi addresses this by integrating a trust-region optimization rule to enforce a KL-divergence constraint over the entire diffusion trajectory. Empirically, we evaluate TruDi on a diverse set of 4 massively parallel RL benchmarks comprising a total of 73 tasks. Across these tasks, TruDi consistently outperforms or is on-par with strong baselines on standard tasks and achieves clear gains on more challenging humanoid control tasks, establishing a strong new baseline for massively parallel on-policy RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Trust-region Diffusion Policies (TruDi)，通过在在线强化学习的扩散模型训练中引入信赖域约束，有效解决了大规模并行环境下策略训练的不稳定性，实现了优于现有 Gaussian 策略的训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的在大规模并行环境下训练的强化学习策略多采用简单的 Gaussian 分布，表达能力有限。尽管扩散模型在离线强化学习中表现优异，但在需要频繁更新策略的在线并行训练环境下，如何保持训练的稳定性仍是一个亟待解决的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 Trust-region Diffusion Policies (TruDi) 的方法，通过在扩散轨迹上集成信赖域优化规则（Trust-region optimization）来施加 KL 散度约束，从而解决在线强化学习中数据分布快速变化导致的训练不稳定性问题。
AI.result: 在涵盖 4 个大规模并行基准测试的 73 个任务中，TruDi 在标准任务上与顶级基线持平，并在人形机器人等复杂控制任务中表现出显著的性能优势。
AI.conclusion: TruDi 成功将扩散模型引入大规模并行在线强化学习，通过引入信赖域优化策略，显著提升了复杂控制任务（如人形机器人）的学习表现，建立了一个强大的新基线。

title: PO-PDDL: Learning Symbolic POMDPs from Visual Demonstrations for Robot Planning Under Uncertainty
summary: Real-world robot task planning must operate under both stochastic action execution and partial observability, yet constructing Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) models for real robotics domains remains difficult and labor-intensive. We introduce PO-PDDL, a symbolic formulation of POMDPs that preserves the relational structure and LLM-friendly syntax of the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), while explicitly modeling partial observability, stochasticity, and beliefs. Building on this formulation, we propose a demonstration-driven pipeline for learning PO-PDDL models. The proposed method reconstructs latent symbolic state trajectories from real-robot execution videos, identifies partial observability via inconsistencies between inferred states and visual observations, and learns stochastic transition and observation models accordingly. The resulting PO-PDDL domains are reusable across tasks and enable online belief-space planning under both perception and execution uncertainty. Experiments on real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks show that our method consistently outperforms existing PDDL and POMDP model-learning approaches, achieving robust task planning under uncertainty with significantly lower planning cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 PO-PDDL，一种旨在降低 POMDP 建模难度的符号化框架，并开发了一个能从真实机器人视频中学习随机模型和观测模型的流程，显著增强了机器人处理不确定环境的能力。
AI.motivation: 在真实机器人任务中，构建处理随机动作执行和部分可观测性的 POMDP 模型非常困难且耗费人力，现有方法难以兼顾表达能力与学习效率。
AI.method: 1. 提出 PO-PDDL：结合 PDDL 的逻辑结构与 POMDP 处理随机性和部分可观测性的能力；2. 演示驱动流程：通过真实机器人执行视频重构潜在符号状态轨迹，对比推断状态与视觉观测以识别部分可观测性，并学习随机转移和观测模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在真实世界的长周期操作任务中表现优异，能提升任务规划的鲁棒性并显著降低规划成本。
AI.conclusion: PO-PDDL 是一种有效的符号化 POMDP 建模框架，通过从真实机器人演示视频中学习，实现了在不确定环境下的鲁棒任务规划，优于现有的 PDDL 和 POMDP 学习方法。

title: Emergent retokenization symmetry in large language models: phenomenology and applications
summary: Tokenization introduces representational redundancy: under a fixed token vocabulary, every byte string admits many valid token encodings, or segmentations, that decode to the same surface string. However, given a prompt, most language model tokenizers break this representational symmetry by returning a canonical segmentation. Training only on canonical segmentations should influence inference behavior, and there is little reason to expect models to respect segmentation symmetry on downstream tasks. We find that this symmetry partially emerges during training. Here, we probe this emergent symmetry through experiments testing token compositional understanding, representation diversity, and task focused benchmark performance. We primarily use \textbf{retokenization} -- replacing a prompt's canonical tokenization with an alternative segmentation while preserving its bytes exactly. Relative to other prompt perturbations, retokenization is unusually clean because it isolates segmentation effects without changing syntax, semantics or surface form. We use retokenization to study sensitivity and robustness to semantically identical input representations across pretraining and post-training. Moreover, this partial retokenization symmetry suggests a distinct inference-time sampling axis. While temperature sampling generates diverse outputs from the model using its next-token probability distribution, retokenization generates diversity from the model's internal computations through semantically equivalent input representations. We find that while this retokenization sampling strategy can hurt performance on easy problems, it can also recover solutions that conventional sampling does not find. Overall, our work presents retokenization as a simple yet powerful probe of large language models, shedding light on compositional understanding and prompt sensitivity, and offering a novel sampling strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型对“分词冗余”的敏感性，通过引入“重分词”（在保持内容一致的前提下改变分词方式）作为一种探测工具，发现模型存在部分分词对称性。研究表明，重分词不仅是理解大模型组合能力的出色探针，还可作为一种提升模型推理多样性的有效采样策略。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型分词器通常采用固定的“规范分词”（canonical segmentation），忽略了字节字符串存在多种有效分词方式的对称性。研究旨在探究模型是否对这种语义等价但分词不同的表示具有稳健性，以及这种潜在的对称性如何影响模型的组合理解与任务表现。
AI.method: 提出“重分词”（retokenization）技术：在保持字节序列不变的前提下，通过显式改变提示词的分词方式（替代模型默认的规范分词），来量化模型对不同输入表示的稳健性和对称性。该方法用于测试模型在组合理解、表示多样性及基准测试中的表现，并提出了一种基于重分词的推断时采样策略。
AI.result: 研究发现大模型在训练过程中部分涌现了对重分词的对称性；实验证明，相比其他提示词干扰，重分词能有效隔离分词效应；作为一种推断采样策略，重分词采样能够产生模型内部计算的多样性，从而在部分困难问题上检索出传统采样无法覆盖的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 重分词（retokenization）是探测大语言模型组合理解能力和提示词敏感性的强大工具；虽然重分词敏感且可能影响简单任务性能，但它提供了一种基于输入表示对称性的全新采样维度，有助于模型寻找到传统采样方式无法发现的解决方案。

title: When to use what Schatten-$p$ norm in deep learning?
summary: Schatten-$\infty$ based optimizers such as Muon have shown promising empirical performance, but there remains seemingly conflicting observations regarding whether they are beneficial. We resolve this conflict by showing that the conclusion is regime dependent. Even when the objective is smooth in the Schatten-$\infty$ geometry, smaller Schatten-$p$ geometries can be optimal, specifically in the low-dimensional regime, which we show includes Chinchilla scaling. This conclusion follows from a new noise-robust acceleration result for the SODA framework for $p>2$. The same analysis explains why Muon-like methods do not require warmup, why they naturally favor large batches, and yields a batch size scaling rule for arbitrary $p$.

AI.tldr: 研究明确了Schatten-p优化器性能的“制度依赖性”，指出Muon等Schatten-∞方法的优势主要在于高维训练，而在低维（Chinchilla）环境下较小的p值更具竞争力，并为优化算法的大批量训练提供了理论缩放准则。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Schatten-∞的优化器（如Muon）在经验上表现优异，但关于其有效性的研究观点存在冲突。本文旨在明确评估此类优化器在不同训练阶段下的表现差异，并从理论上统一这些看似矛盾的观察结果。
AI.method: 该研究引入了一个针对SODA（Schatten-p Operator Descent for Adam）框架下 $p>2$ 得出的噪声鲁棒加速结果。通过理论分析不同Schatten-p范数在不同维度制度下的性能，推导出了适用于任意 $p$ 的批量缩放规则。
AI.result: 本文证明了在低维制度下（如Chinchilla缩放），较小的Schatten-p范数比Schatten-∞更优；在高维制度下，Schatten-∞则更佳。此外，研究揭示了Muon类算法因其内在的噪声鲁棒性和优化轨迹特性，无需像传统算法那样进行学习率预热。
AI.conclusion: Schatten-p优化器的最优性是依赖于机制的。在高维制度下，Schatten-∞范数（如Muon）确实有优势，但在类似Chinchilla缩放的低维制度下，较小的Schatten-p范数反而表现更优。该分析还解释了Muon类算法无需预热（warmup）的原因及其对大批量训练的偏好。

title: Learning New Tasks via Reusable Skills: Skill-Compositional Experts for Embodied Continual Learning
summary: Embodied Continual Learning (ECL) aims to enable robots to continually acquire new manipulation tasks while retaining previously learned behaviors under closed-loop control. Compared with conventional continual learning, ECL suffers from more severe catastrophic forgetting. Feature drift accumulated under closed-loop control progressively propagates through sequential decision-making, leading to degradation of previously learned behaviors. A key challenge in ECL lies in structured skill reuse across continually evolving tasks, since existing methods primarily focus on skill learning without explicitly organizing them for coherent task execution. To address this issue, we propose SCE, a Skill-Compositional Experts framework for ECL. SCE builds a skill base via Compositional Skill Grounding (CSG), which decomposes task demonstrations into reusable skills. Based on this, Dual Execution-and-Transition Experts (DETE) enable new task learning through skill composition, where one branch ensures skill execution and the other supports transitions between skills for coherent behavior. Experiments on LIBERO benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SCE consistently improves retention and overall task performance. Further feature drift analyses and ablation studies verify the effectiveness of our method. Project website: https://eqcy.github.io/sce/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCE框架，通过将任务拆解为可组合的技能并引入双专家机制（执行+转换），解决了具身持续学习中因特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘和技能重用困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 具身持续学习（ECL）面临严重的灾难性遗忘，闭环控制下的特征漂移会随序列决策累积并导致先前技能退化。现有方法缺乏对技能结构的显式组织，难以实现有效的技能重用与任务间的相干性执行。
AI.method: 提出名为SCE（Skill-Compositional Experts）的框架，包含两个核心组件：1. 合成技能基础（CSG）：将任务演示分解为可重用的基础技能；2. 双执行与转换专家（DETE）：包含两个分支，分别负责技能的精准执行和技能间的平滑转换，实现任务的组合式学习。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准测试和真实世界的操作任务中，SCE在保持旧技能性能和提升任务整体成功率方面均优于现有方法，实验分析验证了其对特征漂移的抑制作用。
AI.conclusion: SCE框架通过将任务分解为可重用的技能并利用双专家机制，有效解决了具身持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，并提升了复杂任务的执行性能与迁移能力。

title: EIBench: A Simulator-Based Benchmark and Turn-Credit RL for Emotion Management
summary: Emotional intelligence (EI) in Large Language Models (LLMs) is often evaluated through static understanding tasks or single-response dialogue generation. However, emotion management is interactive: a good model should not only recognize a user's emotion, but also improve the user's emotional and relational state over several turns. We introduce EIBench, a simulator-based benchmark for interactive emotion management. EIBench contains 2,222 scenarios, with 2,009 for training and 213 for held-out testing. The scenarios are organized by a 2x2 taxonomy covering Support, Defense, Repair, and Charm, which together capture different forms of support, boundary maintenance, trust repair, and rapport building. In each scenario, an LLM simulator plays the user, updates an emotion-relation state after each turn, and maps the final state to an anchor-based score. This design makes EIBench both an evaluation benchmark and a training environment: the final state gives the outcome reward, while the per-turn state updates provide dense feedback for RL. We evaluate 15 open- and closed-source LLMs. Current models perform well on support and rapport-building scenes, but struggle with boundary maintenance under user pressure. To improve the EI ability of LLMs, we propose Centered Turn-Credit GRPO (CTC-GRPO), a GRPO extension that reuses the simulator's per-turn state updates as dense turn-level feedback while preserving the final outcome reward. CTC-GRPO improves Qwen3-8B from -22.4 to +22.4 on EIBench and also improves on out-of-distribution evaluations including SAGE (+12.4) and EQBench3 (+20.9%). Our results show that simulator-tracked user states can support both evaluation and training for multi-turn emotion management.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM在多轮交互中缺乏实时情感管理能力的问题，本文提出了EIBench交互式基准测试和CTC-GRPO训练算法，通过利用模拟器的动态状态反馈，显著提升了模型在复杂情感场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的情感智能（EI）评估主要局限于静态理解或单轮对话，缺乏对多轮交互中如何改善用户情感和关系质量的评估与训练机制。因此，需要一个能够模拟交互并提供实时反馈的系统来提升LLM在动态情感场景中的表现。
AI.method: 1. 构建EIBench基准：包含2,222个交互场景，涵盖Support, Defense, Repair, Charm四大分类；2. 机制设计：利用LLM模拟器扮演用户，进行多轮对话，并实时更新情绪-关系状态；3. 提出CTC-GRPO算法：一种基于GRPO的扩展方法，通过利用模拟器提供的密集轮次反馈（turn-level feedback）和最终产出奖励进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 1. 现有模型在支持与建立融洽关系方面表现尚可，但在边界维护（boundary maintenance）任务上存在不足；2. 通过CTC-GRPO训练，Qwen3-8B在EIBench的表现从-22.4提升至+22.4；3. 该方法在SAGE和EQBench3等分布外数据集上亦取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: EIBench作为评估和训练工具，有效解决了多轮交互中情感管理能力的评估缺失问题。CTC-GRPO算法通过利用模拟器提供的逐步反馈，显著提升了LLMs在复杂情感交互任务中的表现，证明了基于模拟器状态追踪的方法在增强模型情感智能方面的有效性。

title: RECTOR: Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling for Affective and Cognitive Representation Learning
summary: Affective and cognitive disorders manifest as distributed, time-varying brain network dynamics across regions, channels, and time, challenging robust representation learning from EEG/sEEG for clinical diagnosis. We propose RECTOR (Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling), an end-to-end self-supervised framework that unifies joint region-channel-temporal representation learning beyond fixed anatomical priors. At its core, RECTOR-SA is a hierarchical, block-sparse self-attention induced by Adaptive Functional Partitioning that evolves region structures from static anatomical definitions to adaptive functional regions. The self-supervision is driven by Masked Topology and Representation Learning, which jointly optimizes three complementary objectives: Masked Predictive Modeling, Topological Structure Modeling, and Cross-View Consistency. Across diverse benchmarks, RECTOR sets a new state-of-the-art in EEG emotion recognition and sEEG task-engagement classification. Crucially, its strong robustness to missing channels and cross-montage generalization underscores its potential for large-scale pre-training on heterogeneous EEG/sEEG, providing interpretable insights at both region and channel levels.

AI.tldr: RECTOR 是一种用于 EEG/sEEG 的自监督学习框架，通过自适应功能分区和多重掩码建模优化，克服了传统方法对解剖先验的依赖，在脑信号表示学习中实现了更高的鲁棒性与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的EEG/sEEG方法难以有效处理分布式、时变的脑网络动态特征，且往往受限于固定的解剖先验，导致在临床诊断中的鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出RECTOR（Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling）框架，核心包括：1. RECTOR-SA：一种分层块稀疏自注意力机制，通过自适应功能分区将解剖结构转化为动态功能区域；2. 掩码拓扑与表示学习：通过掩码预测建模、拓扑结构建模和跨视图一致性三个互补目标进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中达到了EEG情感识别和sEEG任务参与度分类的最优性能（SOTA），并表现出良好的缺失通道鲁棒性和跨蒙太奇（cross-montage）泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RECTOR通过自适应功能分区和多任务自监督学习，实现了在大规模、异构EEG/sEEG数据上的鲁棒表示学习，为神经精神疾病的临床诊断提供了高效、可解释的框架。

title: Can Causal Models Enhance Robot Navigation? Online Causal Adaptation for Real-Robot Navigation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN)
summary: Causality in robotics aims to produce more interpretable and flexible robot behaviours by enabling robots to predict the consequences of their actions; however, deploying causal models with existing systems (e.g., navigation) operating in real environments remains understudied. This paper addresses the challenging problem of transferring causal models in real-robot experiments for a navigation scenario. We study this problem in two ways: (i) using the causal model as an offline evaluation module that predicts the competence of recorded real-robot navigation trajectories and relates it to quantitative navigation performance, and (ii) using the causal model as an online adaptation module that intervenes when the predicted competence of the default navigation is low. We validate our approach in a physical service robot that patrols around corridors. We show that the predicted competence correlates positively with path efficiency, and negatively with path irregularities (suboptimal behaviour). The model predictions also show strong agreement with human annotations (Cohen's kappa value of 0.88). In online experiments, the proposed method improves navigation performance in complex scenarios such as cornering and obstacle avoidance, yielding higher predicted competence and better navigation metrics than the default navigation baseline. In simpler scenarios, where the baseline already performs near-optimally, the causal adaptation provides limited benefit. These results indicate that causal models are particularly effective in enhancing navigation under increased task complexity. Overall, our results demonstrate that causal models developed for behavioural interpretation can be successfully integrated into real-robot navigation systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究将因果模型集成到机器人导航系统中，不仅能离线评估导航轨迹，还能在线实时介入以优化复杂场景下的导航性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人因果建模旨在实现更具可解释性和灵活性，但目前因果模型在现实环境下的部署研究尚不充分。本研究旨在解决如何将因果模型迁移并应用于现实机器人的导航场景中。
AI.method: 提出了两种利用因果模型的方法：1. 作为离线评估模块，预测并定量分析真实机器人轨迹的性能（能力）；2. 作为在线自适应模块，在预测到默认导航表现不佳时介入并调整行为。在物理服务机器人走廊巡逻场景中进行了验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，预测的“能力值”与路径效率正相关，与路径不规则性负相关；与人类标注的一致性高（Cohen's kappa=0.88）；在线实验中，在避障和转弯等复杂场景下，该方法优于默认导航基线。
AI.conclusion: 因果模型能够成功集成到现实机器人导航系统中，对于提升复杂环境下的机器人导航性能和行为可解释性具有显著效果。

title: LLM-Assisted Stance Detection in Scientific Discourse: A Test Case in Bayesian Cognitive Science
summary: Qualitative coding is central to social science, but expert annotation is difficult to scale. LLMs offer a possible extension, yet require careful validation when the target construct is interpretive, theoretically loaded, and only indirectly expressed. We study this problem in a difficult case: detecting whether authors treat Bayesian models as descriptions of mental and neural mechanisms (realism) or as useful mathematical tools (instrumentalism). Our method combines a theory-driven codebook, expert-coded reference annotations, a diagnostic-gated prompt-optimization search yielding a shared zero-shot prompt for three frontier LLMs (GPT-5.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro Preview), and multi-rater reliability analysis. The final prompt achieved a held-out combined reliability score of 0.76 (harmonic mean of ICC = 0.79 and $α$ = 0.74), with all diagnostics satisfied. Deployed on 6,858 quotes from 210 articles, the three LLMs reached substantial quote-level agreement (ICC = 0.80; $α$ = 0.76; combined = 0.78) and near-perfect article-level rank stability ($r$ = 0.96-0.97 across rater pairs). The corpus was predominantly weakly realist, but article-level stances were rarely uniform: only 1.4% of articles used a single band, while 59.5% spanned four or more. Low-level perception/motor articles scored 8.8 Realism points higher than high-level cognition articles ($p < .001$, $d = 0.60$), quantifying a long-held qualitative intuition. We present this as an expert-led case study; the framework is intended to generalize to similar theoretically demanding tasks, not to all qualitative analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一个专家引导的框架，证明通过诊断驱动的提示词优化，大模型能够可靠地执行深度的理论定义定性编码任务，并成功将其应用于量化学术文章中的贝叶斯建模现实主义立场。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决社会科学中定性编码难以扩展的问题，探索大模型在处理需要高度解释性、理论深度且表达间接的复杂概念时的效能与验证逻辑。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合理论驱动编码本、专家标注参考集、诊断门控提示优化（diagnostic-gated prompt-optimization）搜索流程，并对三个前沿大模型进行多评分者可靠性分析的系统性方法。
AI.result: 最终优化提示词在Held-out数据集上达到0.76的综合可靠性。在6,858条引用测试中，模型间达成显著共识（ICC=0.80），文章级排名稳定性极高（r=0.96-0.97）。研究还量化了不同领域（感知/运动层级 vs 认知层级）在贝叶斯建模现实主义立场上的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在经过精心设计和验证的专家引导下，大型语言模型能够可靠地编码复杂的、理论驱动的社会科学定性概念。该框架为处理具有解释性要求的研究任务提供了一种可扩展的方法。

title: Rethinking Structural Anomaly Detection: From Decision Boundaries to Projection Operators
summary: Most existing anomaly detection methods rely on estimating a probability density or learning an enclosing decision boundary, implicitly assuming that normal data occupies a region of non-zero volume in the ambient space. In contrast, structural anomaly detection considers data that lies near a low-dimensional manifold, creating a mismatch between the inductive bias of existing methods and the structure of the data, often resulting in degraded performance. To address this mismatch, we introduce a geometric perspective. Specifically, we learn a projection operator onto the manifold of normal samples and define a sample as anomalous if it is altered by this projection. This formulation naturally integrates the inductive bias of manifold-supported data and reframes anomaly detection in terms of a projection residual, thereby resolving issues arising from modeling degenerate distributions. Notably, it provides a unifying interpretation of reconstruction-based methods by explaining their success and failure in terms of projection quality. In particular, it explains the strong generalization ability of projection-aligned models as a consequence of contraction behavior toward the manifold. Moreover, by decoupling anomaly detection from probabilistic modeling, it reduces the tendency to misclassify rare but normal samples, a widely recognized limitation of existing approaches. Empirically, we demonstrate that projection-aligned methods achieve strong performance, outperforming boundary-based methods while improving upon existing reconstruction-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 针对现有异常检测方法无法有效处理低维流形数据的问题，本文提出了一种基于流形投影算子的几何视角方法，通过分析投影残差进行异常判断，实现了更优的检测效果和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数异常检测方法（如基于概率密度或边界的方法）隐含假设正常数据在全维空间中占据非零体积，这与实际数据通常分布在低维流形上的特征不符，导致模型存在诱导偏差（inductive bias）的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于“投影算子”的几何视角方法：学习一个将样本投影到正常数据流形上的算子，通过度量样本在该投影下的“投影残差”来定义异常。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在异常检测任务上表现优异，不仅超越了传统的基于边界的方法，也改进了现有的基于重构的异常检测模型，同时减少了将罕见但正常的样本误判为异常的现象。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了基于投影的异常检测方法在处理流形支持的数据时优于基于边界和概率的方法，并为重构类方法提供了理论支撑，证明了其泛化能力源于对流形的收缩特性。

title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

AI.tldr: LaWAM 是一种高效的潜空间机器人操控模型，它通过预测紧凑的潜视觉子目标替代视频生成，在提升机器人任务执行成功率的同时，大幅降低了推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）缺乏对操作结果的预测能力，而现有的世界模型（WAM）通常依赖昂贵的像素级视频生成，导致高延迟且存在冗余，不适合实时机器人控制。
AI.method: 提出一种潜空间世界动作模型 (LaWAM)。该方法的核心是潜状态动作条件潜世界模型 (LaWM)，即利用预训练视觉模型提取的潜特征进行预测，生成紧凑的“潜视觉子目标”（Latent Visual Subgoals）以指导动作生成，而非直接生成像素级的视频。
AI.result: LaWAM 在 LIBERO (98.6% SR) 和 RoboTwin (91.22% SR) 等基准测试中达到了顶尖或极具竞争力的成功率，且单次动作预测仅需 187ms，推理延迟较像素空间 WAM 模型降低了最高 24 倍。
AI.conclusion: LaWAM 通过在视觉基础模型的潜空间中进行预测，成功解决了传统世界模型（WAM）计算开销过大的问题，在保持高性能的同时实现了极低的推理延迟，为机器人操控提供了一种高效且具备动态感知能力的新方案。

title: LLM Judges Have Dark Current: A Psychometric Datasheet for LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
summary: LLM-as-a-judge systems are now routinely used for open-ended model evaluation, where human preference annotation is costly, slow, and difficult to reproduce. Yet these judges are often reported as scalar accuracy, win-rate, or agreement devices. We argue that a judge should instead be reported as a measurement instrument. We introduce a Judge Datasheet protocol that measures dark current under true-vacuum inputs, stable cross-sensitivity to same-quality surface variation, positional false preference, target sensitivity on a controlled quality ladder, and the criterion or operating point induced by tie instructions. The direction-stability decomposition reveals that apparent Delta0 preference can be stable surface response or disguised position bias. In a three-judge open-weight case study, Llama-3.1-8B shows high dark current and presentation-conflicted Delta0 behavior, Qwen2.5-14B is vacuum-clean and target-sensitive but mixes stable and positional over-discrimination, and Qwen2.5-32B is vacuum-clean with low stable cross-sensitivity and low positional false preference. A strict tie criterion eliminates Qwen32B Delta0 false preference but absorbs marginal Delta1 target signals into ties while preserving Delta5 sensitivity. The results show that prompting moves the criterion, not the resolution. We do not claim that the downstream mechanism hypothesis that motivated this work is confirmed; the contribution is a metrological protocol for measuring the measuring device before downstream claims are made.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计量学视角审视“LLM-as-a-judge”技术，提出一套评估评测器自身质量的“Judge Datasheet”协议，并揭示了现有大模型在作为自动评测工具时存在的暗电流、位置偏置及标准漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 目前“LLM-as-a-judge”被广泛使用，但对其性能的评估通常简化为标量指标（如胜率、准确率）。作者认为需将LLM视为“测量仪器”，而非简单的分类器，缺乏严谨的计量程序会导致评估结果不可靠。
AI.method: 引入并应用“评测器数据页（Judge Datasheet）”协议，该协议包含：测量无输入时的暗电流（Dark Current）、对相同质量参考输入的交叉敏感度、位置偏置（Positional false preference）、受控质量阶梯下的目标敏感度以及指令诱导的决策阈值（Criterion）。通过方向-稳定性分解方法对Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B及Qwen2.5-32B进行了对比实证研究。
AI.result: 研究发现不同模型存在显著的计量学缺陷：Llama-3.1-8B表现出严重的随机噪音（暗电流）和位置偏置问题；Qwen2.5-14B虽然较好，但在稳定性和位置偏置间表现不均；Qwen2.5-32B表现最佳，具有良好的 vacuum-clean 特性和较低偏置。增加严格的“平局（tie）”指令能减少错误偏好，但在高难度区分任务中会丢失部分真实信号。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了“评测器数据页（Judge Datasheet）”协议，强调在利用LLM作为评测器进行评估前，必须对其进行严格的计量学验证。研究表明，提示词（Prompting）主要改变评测器的判断标准（Criterion），而非提升其分辨率（Resolution）。该方法学为评估LLM作为“测量仪器”的性能提供了标准化的基准。

title: Hybrid NARX-LLM for Greenland Iceberg Discharge: Prompt-Driven Residual Correction
summary: Greenland iceberg discharge exhibits complex nonlinear dynamics with limited observability, challenging traditional predictive models. We present a Hybrid NARX-LLM framework that combines a nonlinear autoregressive model with exogenous inputs (NARX) and a large language model (LLM) for residual correction. We further propose a Physics-Informed Prompt (PIP) method that transforms unstructured physical knowledge into structured prompts for zero-shot in-context reasoning. The primary objective is to explore the corrective potential of this framework for modeling Greenland iceberg discharge, rather than merely optimizing predictive accuracy. The NARX component captures intrinsic temporal dependencies, while the LLM, guided by PIP, encodes glacier dynamics and environmental drivers and perceives key trend patterns to correct systematic prediction errors. This integration allows the model to reason about unmodeled factors and produce interpretable residuals, enhancing overall predictive accuracy. Applied to Greenland iceberg discharge time series, our approach addresses extreme events that are difficult to predict due to rare variations and nonstationary trends, a limitation often overlooked by traditional methods. By fusing structured time-series modeling with knowledge-driven foundation AI, the framework offers a scalable and interpretable pathway to bridge data-limited climate forecasting with physics-informed LLM reasoning. The code is available.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合NARX模型与物理知识引导大模型（LLM）的混合架构，通过物理信息提示（PIP）进行残差修正，解决了冰山排放预测中观测数据有限及极端事件难预测的问题。
AI.motivation: 格陵兰岛冰山排放具有复杂的非线性动力学且观测数据有限，传统模型难以捕捉极端事件及非平稳趋势，亟需一种能融合物理先验知识和数据驱动预测的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合框架 Hybrid NARX-LLM，其中NARX负责捕获时间依赖性，LLM通过“物理信息提示”（Physics-Informed Prompt, PIP）方法将非结构化物理知识转化为结构化提示，对NARX的系统偏差进行残差修正。
AI.result: 该框架能有效捕获传统方法难以预测的极端气候事件，减少系统性预测偏差，并在提升预测精度的同时增强了模型结果的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了将物理知识驱动的LLM与统计时间序列模型（NARX）结合，能够有效弥补传统模型在处理极端非平稳气候数据时的不足，提供了一种可解释且具有扩展性的气候预测新范式。

title: FlashNav: Ultra-Fast Policy Training for Robot Navigation within 20 Seconds
summary: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for robot navigation, but its practical deployment is still limited by the long wall-clock cost of policy training. This paper presents FlashNav, a GPU-first framework for ultra-fast range-based robot navigation training. To the best of our knowledge, FlashNav is the first DRL-based robot navigation framework that reaches seconds-level policy training, with the fastest deployable policy trained in less than 20 seconds. The key idea is to align simulation with the navigation MDP: FlashNav preserves the essential components for velocity-level navigation, including occupancy geometry, range sensing, goal-conditioned control, robot motion dynamics, collision handling, termination, and reset, while removing unnecessary rendering and high-fidelity physical details from the training loop. Built on a batched bitmap simulator and a fully GPU-resident training pipeline with our FastDSAC learner, FlashNav generates massive parallel navigation transitions entirely on GPU. Experiments on TurtleBot2 and Unitree Go2 show that FlashNav achieves a 100\% success-rate below 20 seconds on an RTX 5090 and remains within tens of seconds across desktop GPUs. The learned policies further transfer to physical wheeled and legged robots in static and dynamic indoor scenes, demonstrating that DRL-based navigation can be trained at seconds-level speed while preserving deployable obstacle-avoidance behavior.

AI.tldr: FlashNav是一个创新的GPU优先DRL框架，通过对训练环境的极简优化和全GPU流水线设计，将机器人导航策略的训练速度缩短至20秒以内，并验证了其在现实世界机器人上的有效迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习（DRL）在机器人导航领域虽具潜力，但长期训练时间（wall-clock cost）成为其实际大规模部署的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出FlashNav框架：1. 简化模拟环境，仅保留速度级导航的核心要素（占用几何、测距、目标控制等），剔除冗余渲染与高保真物理细节；2. 使用批处理位图模拟器；3. 构建完全驻留在GPU上的训练流水线（FastDSAC算法），实现海量并行的导航转移数据生成。
AI.result: 在RTX 5090上实现了20秒内100%成功率的策略训练；在TurtleBot2（轮式）和Unitree Go2（足式）上验证了其在静态及动态复杂环境下的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: FlashNav证明了机器人导航DRL策略训练可以达到秒级，且训练出的策略能够高效迁移至桌面级GPU并部署到真实机器人平台上，打破了传统DRL训练耗时的限制。

title: Distilling Examples into Task Instructions: Enhanced In-Context Learning for Real-World B2B Conversations
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2026
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is the standard method for low-resource classification, yet its efficacy in specialized domains remains largely unexplored. We address the challenge of classifying semantically complex, multi-party B2B conversations, where traditional ICL encounters significant limitations, especially as context length increases due to the concatenation of multiple few-shot examples. We introduce the \texttt{Call Playbook} dataset, featuring five classification tasks derived from real-world B2B conversations targeting core sales concepts. To bridge the gap between performance and practical utility, we propose novel knowledge extraction methods that distill verbose examples into compact, interpretable representations of structured classification criteria and precise task descriptions. Our approach achieves a 99\% reduction in token usage and improves macro-averaged AUC by up to 7\% over traditional ICL. Notably, it remains robust as context grows, unlike advanced token compression baselines which degrade by over 9 F1 points. Importantly, our framework enables direct refinement of classification logic, addressing critical needs for transparency, efficiency, and user interaction in real-world NLP applications.

AI.tldr: 针对B2B对话分类任务，提出了通过高度压缩和结构化知识提炼来优化ICL的方法，实现了大幅降低推理成本与性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 在处理高语意复杂度的B2B多方对话分类时，传统ICL在长上下文下的性能下降和高令牌损耗问题限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 提出了名为“Call Playbook”的数据集；引入了知识提取方法，将复杂的少样本示例提炼为紧凑、可解释的结构化分类准则及精确任务描述。
AI.result: 令牌使用量减少了99%，宏平均AUC提升了7%，且在处理长上下文时表现极其稳健（优于现有的令牌压缩基线）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将冗长的示例提炼为结构化的分类标准和任务描述，该方法在保持高解释性的同时，显著提升了资源消耗效率和模型推理性能，克服了传统ICL在处理长上下文时的局限性。

title: Discovering Lattice Reduction Strategies via Self-Play
summary: The Lenstra-Lenstra-Lovász (LLL) algorithm is a seminal contribution to computer science used for lattice basis reduction, yet its polynomial-time outputs produce bases that are far from optimal as the dimension grows. We show that deep reinforcement learning can discover strictly superior, generalizable reduction strategies by interacting with the primitive action space of LLL. We formulate lattice reduction as a single-player Markov Decision Process (MDP) and train a deep residual network using an AlphaZero-style self-play pipeline augmented with adaptive-horizon MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search), which couples multi-step network predictions with an entropy-gated expansion mechanism. The resulting policy, DeltaStar, is trained exclusively on small $8$-dimensional $q$-ary lattices and requires fewer primitive row operations than LLL. Crucially, it generalizes zero-shot to unseen moduli and higher dimensions up to $n=32$ without retraining.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种基于深度强化学习的格基约简方法DeltaStar，通过AlphaZero风格的训练，其在处理效率和高维泛化性能上均优于经典的LLL算法。
AI.motivation: LLL算法虽是格基约简领域的基石，但在高维情形下产生的基向量远非最优，亟需探索更优的约简策略。
AI.method: 将格基约简建模为马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)；利用AlphaZero风格的自我博弈管道结合自适应视界蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)；使用深度残差网络进行训练。
AI.result: DeltaStar模型在仅训练于8维小规模格的情况下，较LLL算法使用了更少的原始行操作，并成功推广至高至32维的未见格，展现了跨维度的卓越泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过DeltaStar模型证明了深度强化学习能够发现比LLL算法更优、具有更强泛化能力的格基约简策略，且在不重训的情况下展现了显著的零样本泛化能力。

title: LoComposition: Terrain-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion without Gait Priors
summary: Learning-based quadrupedal locomotion typically relies on complex reward formulations that entangle task specification, operational limits, gait preference, and terrain adaptation within a single optimization objective. We instead treat these functions through distinct mechanisms: rewards for task specification, constraints for operational limits, energy minimization for gait preference, and exteroceptive perception for adapting energy use to terrain difficulty. We show that these components jointly enable efficient, terrain-adaptive locomotion, and that removing each component exposes a distinct failure mode. Our formulation removes explicit gait priors (including air-time, contact-count, and foot-clearance targets) in favor of emergent behavior. Compared to a conventional complex-reward baseline, our formulation achieves comparable terrain traversal while reducing cost of transport by 56% and operational-limit violations by 96%. The resulting policies transfer zero-shot to a physical Unitree Go2 using LiDAR-based elevation mapping. Project website with videos: https://tinyurl.com/locomposition.

AI.tldr: 通过将运动控制中的任务奖励、物理约束、能量优化和地形感知进行解耦，实现了四足机器人高效、鲁棒的自主步态演化，显著降低了能耗和违规率。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习型四足运动通常依赖复杂的奖励函数，将任务目标、约束、步态和地形适应混合，导致训练困难且难以平衡各目标，限制了性能与可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了一种模块化的控制架构：1. 任务指定采用奖励函数；2. 操作限制采用约束机制；3. 步态偏好通过能量最小化实现（而非硬编码）；4. 地形适应基于外感受感知进行能耗优化。去除了空时、接触计数等显式步态先验，依赖强化学习实现突现行为。
AI.result: 与传统复杂奖励基准相比，该方法在保持相同地形穿越能力的同时，能耗（Cost of Transport）降低了56%，操作限制违规降低了96%，并实现了Unitree Go2的零样本实机部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务指标、操作约束、步态偏好和地形感知解耦，研究实现了无需显式步态先验的鲁棒、高效四足机器人运动控制，且在物理机器人上验证了零样本迁移能力。

title: Extending Item Response Theory for Efficient and Meaningful Multilingual Evaluation
summary: Multilingual benchmarks are central to evaluating large language models (LLMs) across languages, but they suffer from three issues: exhaustive evaluation scales linearly with the number of languages, automatic translation introduces errors that are easily missed at scale, and some items conflate general and culture-specific knowledge. We address all three with a unified statistical framework, Multilingual-IRT, which extends Item Response Theory with per-language difficulty deviations, split discriminability separating content from language effects, and per-language ability residuals. Fitting Multilingual-IRT on 25 LLMs across 29 languages of MMLU-Pro-X, we show that its fitted parameters support three practical applications: predicting unobserved (item, LLM, language) instances with 11-16% lower binary cross-entropy than the strongest accuracy-based baseline, surfacing candidate translation errors distributed across all 28 non-English languages, whereas accuracy-based baselines concentrate detections in a few languages, and recovering culture-specific items that accuracy-based baselines miss.

AI.tldr: 针对现有 LLM 多语言评测在扩展性、翻译质量和文化偏差方面的问题，本文提出了 Multilingual-IRT 统计框架，通过模型化语言难度、判别力和能力残差，显著提升了多语言评估的预测准确度与诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言 LLM 基准测试存在三个核心痛点：评估成本随语言数量线性增长、自动翻译引入隐蔽错误、以及题目混淆了通用知识与特定文化知识，缺乏有效的统一评估框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于项目反应理论（IRT）的统一统计框架 Multilingual-IRT。该方法通过引入每种语言的难度偏差、区分内容与语言影响的可分离判别力（split discriminability）以及每种语言的能力残差，构建多语言评估模型。
AI.result: 在 29 种语言的 MMLU-Pro-X 数据集上对 25 个 LLM 进行测试，结果表明：预测未观测到的实例时，二元交叉熵比基于准确率的基线降低了 11-16%；能够高效发现跨 28 种非英语语言的翻译错误；并能有效识别纯粹依赖准确率无法发现的文化特定性题目。
