AI.conclusion: Multilingual-IRT 能够有效解决多语言评估中的扩展性问题，消除翻译误差干扰，并准确识别文化相关性任务，为更精确地评估多语言 LLM 提供了稳健的统计学框架。

title: LatentGym: A Testbed For Cross-Task Experiential Learning With Controllable Latent Structure
summary: We envision continually learning agentic systems that become more useful over time: as they encounter sequences of related tasks, they should infer the hidden structure shared across those tasks and use it to improve future decisions. This cross-task experiential learning capability is pivotal in domains such as personalization and interactive assistance, but existing training/evaluation frameworks do not provide shared, controllable latent structures and cannot measure whether or why agents improve. We introduce LatentGym: a controllable suite in which each environment is organized around a ground-truth latent variable governing the structure across tasks. Our construction yields metrics that separate exploration (whether the agent's actions gather information about the latent) from exploitation (whether the agent uses what it has gathered). We demonstrate our suite on empirical studies addressing three questions: how and why frontier models fail to adapt across related tasks; whether post-training on related task sequences improves general cross-task adaptation, and where those gains come from; and how design choices such as inter-task feedback shape training dynamics and generalization. Together, these results establish a controlled foundation for studying how LLM agents learn from experience across tasks, and for designing agents that adapt more reliably in sequential, personalized, and interactive settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 LatentGym 指标套件，旨在解决现有的评估框架无法有效测量大模型智能体跨任务学习能力的问题，实现了对智能体“探索”与“利用”行为的解耦研究。
AI.motivation: 现有框架缺乏共享且可控的潜在结构，难以定量评估和深入分析智能体在面对一系列相关任务时，是否能推断出共享的潜在结构并利用其改善未来决策（即持续学习能力）。
AI.method: 提出了 LatentGym 测试套件，通过基于地面真值（ground-truth）潜在变量的受控环境，将智能体表现拆解为“探索（信息获取）”和“利用（利用已获取信息）”两个维度，用于评估大模型智能体的跨任务适应能力。
AI.result: 通过实证研究揭示了前沿模型在跨任务适应上的缺陷、后训练对提升跨任务适应性的效果及其来源，以及反馈机制等设计选择对训练动态和泛化的影响。
AI.conclusion: LatentGym 提供了一个受控的基础框架，用于研究 LLM 智能体如何从跨任务经验中学习，并为设计在顺序、个性化和交互式场景下更可靠的智能体提供了指导。

title: VL2Spike: Spike-driven Distillation from VLMs for Low-Power Visual Perception in Embodied AI
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are brain-inspired, event-driven models that compute with sparse spikes, which enables highly efficient visual perception in resource-constrained embodied AI models. The emergence of Spiking-Transformer models with spike self-attention has substantially improved the learning capacity of pure SNNs. Although SNNs are energy efficient, their performance is still limited by the spike-based architecture and optimization challenges, as standard gradient descent rules cannot be directly applied. Recently, vision-language models (VLMs) have shown rich multi-modal knowledge representation capabilities for visual perception. Thus, it is promising to leverage VLMs for better Spikformer training. To this end, we present VL2Spike, a novel spike-based knowledge distillation (KD) framework that bridges multi-modal knowledge from VLMs with compact Spikformer models. This design enhances the learning capacity of Spikformer models while preserving their energy-efficiency merits, thereby offering a practical pathway toward low-power robotic perception. Our VL2Spike brings two key technical contributions. To align with spiking dynamics, we first propose spatial-temporal visual spike (SVS) distillation, which achieves (1) shared manifold alignment between VLM image features and spike tokens, and (2) warm-started temporal consistency on membrane potentials and spike rates. We then design a novel spike prototype-guided linguistic (SPL) distillation strategy that aligns Spikformer's class prototypes and logits with promptable VLM text embeddings. Extensive experiments show that VL2Spike achieves 6.81% gain across three static datasets with only 15.7% energy consumption. It also exhibits strong generalization capacity on robotic visual place recognition (VPR) with a gain of 6.63%, highlighting its potential for low-power perception in embodied AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VL2Spike 框架，通过引入视觉语言模型进行多模态知识蒸馏，显著增强了脉冲 Transformer (Spikformer) 的学习能力，在极大降低能耗的前提下提升了视觉感知性能，并展现了在具身机器人场景中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 尽管脉冲神经网络（SNNs）具有能效优势，但其架构限制和优化难度限制了性能。鉴于视觉语言模型（VLMs）拥有丰富的多模态知识，作者试图通过知识蒸馏将 VLM 的知识迁移至脉冲 Transformer 模型（Spikformer），以改善其学习能力，满足具身智能低功耗感知的需求。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 VL2Spike 的脉冲神经网络知识蒸馏框架，包含两项核心技术：1. 空间-时间视觉脉冲（SVS）蒸馏：实现 VLM 特征与脉冲 token 的流形对齐，并确保膜电位和脉冲率的时间一致性；2. 脉冲原型引导的语言（SPL）蒸馏：利用可提示的 VLM 文本嵌入对齐 Spikformer 的类别原型与 Logits。
AI.result: 在三个静态数据集上性能提升 6.81%，能耗仅为原始方法的 15.7%；在具身智能的视觉地点识别任务（VPR）中提升了 6.63%。
AI.conclusion: VL2Spike 通过引入多模态知识蒸馏，有效提升了 Spikformer 的性能，证明了在保持高能效的同时，利用大模型知识提升脉冲神经网络在具身智能感知任务中的表现是切实可行的。

title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfer to VLAs during training. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual instruction following in VLA models. We first construct multilingual instructions by extending existing benchmarks with translations of their instructions. Using these instructions, we evaluate several representative VLA models across a range of tasks in simulation settings. Our experiments reveal a significant multilingual gap: models trained primarily on English instructions exhibit substantial performance degradation when evaluated on other languages, even when the underlying language backbone is multilingual. We provide several findings and analyses to understand the multilingual gap. Cross-lingual transfer behavior analysis shows that performance drops correlate with both instruction understanding and action execution. Representation analyses suggest that multilingual instruction-caused representation shifts may contribute to the multilingual gap. Motivated by these findings, we further explore strategies to improve multilingual performance in VLAs. We propose a simple yet effective multilingual fine-tuning approach, Multilingual Principal Component Alignment, which leverages Principal Component Analysis to get the principal component subspace and align projected multilingual representations, effectively reducing the multilingual performance gap.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统探讨了VLA模型在多语言环境下的指令遵循能力，发现模型存在明显的跨语言性能鸿沟，并提出了一种基于PCA的多语言表征对齐微调方法（MPCA）来解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型主要基于英语指令训练，尽管其底层的语言模型具备多语言能力，但这种能力是否能有效迁移至机器人动作执行端尚不明确。该研究旨在系统性地研究VLA模型在多语言指令遵循方面的表现及存在的性能差距。
AI.method: 1. 构建多语言指令基准测试集；2. 对现有代表性VLA模型进行多语言环境下的评估与基准对比；3. 通过交叉语言迁移行为分析和表征分析深入探讨性能差距的成因；4. 提出“多语言主成分对齐”（Multilingual Principal Component Alignment, MPCA）微调策略，利用PCA对齐不同语言的表征空间。
AI.result: 研究发现VLA模型存在严重的“多语言差距”（multilingual gap），即在非英语指令下性能显著下降。分析表明，这种下降源于指令理解与动作执行过程中的表征转移问题。采用MPCA方法后，模型在多语言环境下的任务执行表现得到显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 目前的VLA模型存在显著的多语言性能差距。通过所提出的“多语言主成分对齐”（MPCA）微调方法，可以有效对齐不同语言的表征，从而大幅缩减模型在非英语指令下的性能损失。

title: GeoTLM: Geometry-aware Tactile-Language Models for Contact Motion Orientation Reasoning of Dynamic Objects
summary: Modern tactile-language models (TLMs) have shown potential for robot learning tasks, such as material and texture recognition. However, for contact-rich scenarios, these TLMs struggle to understand the physical properties of dynamic objects, such as rotation and sliding directions. For instance, our preliminary experiments reveal that popular TLMs, such as Sparsh and AnyTouch2, exhibit weak performance on basic rotation direction reasoning from GelSight Mini tactile data. This surprising gap inspires us to explore a novel research question: Can we inject physically grounded geometric priors into TLMs to enable reliable contact orientation reasoning of dynamic object properties? To this end, we propose GeoTLM, a novel geometric representation-guided TLM for the perception of dynamic contact events. Our key idea is to preserve and structure tactile shear-field geometry before language-level reasoning, rather than forcing low-resolution tactile tokens into fragile closed-form physics operators. To achieve this, we propose a lightweight (only 14k parameters) yet novel Differentiable Geometric Representation (DGR). Specifically, DGR learns a contact-mask-guided representation in the shear field and aggregates it through an antisymmetric seven-region pooling design, motivated by the physical intuition that rotational contact produces antisymmetric deformation patterns. We conduct experiments on two representative tasks: rotation direction and sliding direction reasoning. Extensive experiments show that GeoTLM improves novel-object rotation accuracy by +14.6% and real-sensor sliding accuracy by +16.2% over the same backbone without the geometric encoder. Overall, our work paves a new way for physically grounded tactile-language reasoning, with strong potential for dynamic object understanding and contact-rich robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 针对触觉语言模型在动态接触推理上的不足，本文提出 GeoTLM，通过在特征提取阶段引入可微几何表示（DGR）来结构化触觉剪切场，显著增强了机器人对接触物体的旋转和滑动行为的认知能力。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉语言模型（如 Sparsh, AnyTouch2）在处理旋转、滑动等动态接触场景时，由于无法透彻理解动态对象的物理特性，导致性能表现不佳，缺乏物理基础的辅助。
AI.method: 提出 GeoTLM 模型，包含一个轻量级（14k参数）的可微几何表示模块（DGR）。该模块通过接触掩码引导剪切场特征提取，并采用基于物理直觉的反对称七区域池化策略，在进入语言模型前显式结构化触觉剪切场几何形状。
AI.result: 在物体旋转方向和滑动方向推理任务中，GeoTLM 相比于未集成几何编码器的基线模型，分别取得了 +14.6% 和 +16.2% 的精度提升。
AI.conclusion: GeoTLM 证明了将几何先验信息（基于剪切场形变分析）整合到触觉语言模型中，能有效提升机器人对动态接触事件（如旋转和滑动方向）的理解能力，为实现具备物理接地能力的机器人操控奠定了基础。

title: Vernier: Probing Representational Misalignment Behind Lexical Gaps in Causal Reasoning
summary: Instruction-tuned language models can answer the same causal-reasoning question differently after its English variable names are replaced by type-preserving placeholders, although the structural causal model and the gold answer are unchanged. We ask whether this lexical gap reflects information loss in the placeholder view or a misaligned read-out from a representation that still carries answer-relevant content. Vernier uses a paired-view weight update as an instrument and then inspects the mechanism left after the gap closes. In the working regimes, the evidence favours representational misalignment. A variable-name probe becomes more accurate on the placeholder view, and activation patching on Qwen-7B, Qwen-14B, and Llama-3.1-8B shows that the decision-token representation can transfer answer identity between views. The update that realigns the views is counterfactual augmentation over original and placeholder prompts, while the answer-subspace KL mainly sharpens intermediate answer-belief agreement. Success is bounded by model family, scale, and task. CRASS transfer is reliable across Qwen scales and Llama, e-CARE remains weak, and preliminary non-causal rename tasks show a similar qualitative pattern.

AI.tldr: 针对因果推理模型中变量命名敏感的问题，本文证明该现象源于表征层面的不一致，并通过提出Vernier方法成功实现了跨命名方案的推理逻辑迁移。
AI.motivation: 指令微调语言模型在面对相同的因果推理问题时，仅凭变量名称的改变（如替换为占位符）就会导致回答不一致。研究旨在探究这种“词汇差距”究竟是因为占位符处理导致的信息丢失，还是因为模型内部表征未能正确对齐。
AI.method: 提出了名为Vernier的方法，通过配对视图（原始和占位符视图）的权重更新作为工具。采用激活修补（Activation Patching）技术检查决策标记（decision-token）的表征，并结合反事实增强（counterfactual augmentation）进行对齐，同时在答案子空间上应用KL散度以对齐中间答案信念。
AI.result: 在Qwen和Llama系列模型上的实验表明，模型能够通过配对视图更新实现因果推理任务的迁移。证据支持表征不一致假说：模型内部已包含正确答案的潜在表示，但需要通过对齐手段将其从特定变量名称中“解耦”。该效果受限于模型系列、规模以及具体任务难度。
AI.conclusion: 模型在因果推理任务中表现出的词汇敏感性（依赖于特定的变量命名）主要源于表征层面的不一致（misalignment），而非信息丢失。通过特定的对齐微调（Vernier），模型可以有效消除这种敏感性，实现从原有命名表示到占位符表示的决策逻辑迁移。

title: Semantic DLM+: Improving Diffusion Language Models through Bias-variance Trade-off in Transition Kernel Design
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have demonstrated strong scaling capacity as alternatives to autoregressive language models. However, their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of transition kernels, and poorly designed kernels can lead to issues like training instability, slow convergence, and biased sampling. In this paper, we study this sensitivity through a principled analysis of generalization error and identify three critical factors: asymptotic bias (difficulty in approximating the posterior distribution), exposure bias (error propagation during sampling), and optimization variance induced by kernel dispersion. We further compare different transition kernels: masking diffusion yields sparse and easier posterior-approximation targets, while uniform diffusion provides stronger sampling-side repair but induces harder approximation. Motivated by this trade-off, we revisit a previously overlooked variant, semantic DLM (SemDLM), where the transition kernel corrupts tokens to neighborhoods that are semantically similar. Our theory suggests that SemDLM can serve as a plausible middle ground by reducing the posterior approximation difficulty of uniform diffusion while retaining repair ability. However, we find that SemDLM suffers from a semantic basin problem, where sampling repeatedly stays within a semantic region and produces low-diversity text. To address this, we propose SemDLM+, which adds a global transition and a semantic-frequency penalty during sampling. Experiments on LM1B and OpenWebText show that SemDLM+ improves training dynamics and achieves competitive language modeling and generation quality with satisfactory diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析了扩散语言模型中转移核的选择对性能的影响，提出了 SemDLM+ 模型，通过引入全局转移和语义惩罚机制，有效解决了传统 DLM 中的收敛不稳与生成样本多样性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）的性能对转移核（transition kernels）的选择高度敏感，设计不当会导致训练不稳定、收敛缓慢及采样偏差等问题，现有方法在 posterior 近似难度与采样修复能力之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 1. 对扩散语言模型（DLMs）的泛化误差进行分析，识别出渐近偏差、暴露偏差和优化方差三个关键因素；2. 对比分析掩码扩散和均匀扩散的权衡，指出语义扩散模型（SemDLM）在近似难度与修复能力间的平衡优势；3. 针对 SemDLM 的语义盆地（低多样性）问题，提出改进模型 SemDLM+，加入全局转移和语义频率惩罚。
AI.result: 在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 数据集上的实验表明，SemDLM+ 改善了训练动态，实现了具有竞争力的语言建模和生成质量，并保证了满意的多样性。
AI.conclusion: SemDLM+ 通过引入全局转移机制和语义频率惩罚，有效解决了 SemDLM 的语义盆地问题，提升了扩散语言模型的训练动力学及生成文本的质量与多样性。

title: Identification of a Physics-Based Electrical Power Consumption Model for the Unitree G1 Humanoid Arm
summary: Accurate prediction of electrical power consumption is essential for energy-aware motion planning, battery management, and thermal monitoring in battery-powered humanoid robots. This letter presents a physics-based, linear-in-parameters model for the electrical power consumption of the seven-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot. The proposed formulation combines actuator loss terms with a baseline-torque correction that captures changes in gravity-compensation load and enables accurate prediction of negative net power trajectories. Pairwise interaction terms are introduced to model power coupling during simultaneous multi-joint motion. Model parameters are identified from experimental data collected on a physical Unitree~G1 using onboard power measurements as the regression target. Across 897 trajectories covering single-joint and coordinated arm motions at multiple speed levels, the identified model achieves $R^2 = 0.933$ with an RMSE of 1.07 (W). Validation on 46 trajectories executed at previously unseen speeds yields $R^2 = 0.965$, demonstrating strong generalisation beyond the identification dataset. Analysis of the identified parameters reveals distinct power-consumption characteristics across the arm, with viscous friction dominating most joints (shoulder pitch and all three wrist joints), copper losses dominating shoulder yaw and the elbow, and shoulder roll uniquely dominated by Coulomb friction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对 Unitree G1 人形机器臂的物理驱动能耗预测模型，通过引入关节耦合项与力矩修正，实现了高精度的能量消耗预测及其在未见工况下的强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人能耗预测对于能量感知动作规划、电池管理及热管理至关重要，旨在克服复杂动力学模型在计算上的困难，并提高针对人形机器人（特别是高自由度手臂）能耗建模的精度。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于物理的线性参数（LIP）模型，结合了执行器损失项、基准力矩校正（处理重力补偿与负净功率）以及用于建模多关节协同运动的成对交互项；并通过 Unitree G1 机器人的实际实验数据进行回归参数辨识。
AI.result: 模型在 897 条轨迹上的训练集 R² 为 0.933（RMSE 1.07W），在 46 条未见速度的验证集上 R² 达到 0.965，对各关节的粘性摩擦、铜损和库仑摩擦特性进行了明确划分。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了基于物理的线性参数建模在预测机器人能耗方面的有效性，揭示了各关节功耗特性的显著差异，并证明了模型在未经训练的速度下的优异泛化能力。

title: Probabilistic Signature Inversion: Learning Conditional Distributions from Truncated Signatures
summary: The signature transform is a principled feature map for continuous-time paths, valued for its uniqueness and universality. Recovering a path from its truncated signature is, however, structurally ill-posed because the truncated signature map is not injective. We therefore reframe truncated signature inversion as a probabilistic problem -- learning the conditional distribution of a path given its truncated signature -- and adopt a signature-conditioned flow matching model as a practical estimator. This probabilistic formulation elucidates the fundamental difficulty of inversion: Bayes reconstruction error quantifies the irreducible uncertainty remaining after conditioning on a statistic. We derive the Bayes-optimal error under linear statistics, obtaining a closed form for log-GBM and numerically tractable formulas for log-fBM and OU, yielding a concrete theoretical baseline for model validation. This baseline upper-bounds the Bayes error under truncated-signature conditioning, since truncated signatures provide richer information than linear statistics. Experiments show that empirical reconstruction errors under linear-statistics conditioning faithfully align with the theory-derived baseline, while errors decrease when the statistic is replaced with truncated signatures. Moreover, generated paths faithfully recover the conditioning signature while preserving key distributional and temporal structures, indicating that the estimator is well-calibrated to the target conditional distribution. Together, these results establish a well-posed probabilistic framework for truncated-signature inversion, with applicability demonstrated on real financial data beyond the parametric process families covered by theory.

AI.tldr: 针对路径“截断签名”反演的非单射问题，提出了一种基于概率流匹配的重建方法，并通过推导贝叶斯重建误差建立了理论验证标准，实现了对随机路径的准确恢复。
AI.motivation: 签名变换（signature transform）的截断版本不具有单射性（injective），导致路径恢复是一个本质上病态（ill-posed）的问题；需要一种更严谨的统计手段来量化这种不确定性并进行高质量重建。
AI.method: 将截断签名反演重构为概率问题，采用“签名条件流匹配”（Signature-conditioned flow matching）模型进行估计；并建立基于线性统计量的贝叶斯重建误差闭式解作为理论验证基准。
AI.result: 提出的模型在实证中能够忠实恢复条件签名，并保留路径的分布与时间结构；实证重建误差与理论推导的贝叶斯误差基准高度吻合，且性能优于仅依赖线性统计量的情况。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过条件流匹配建立了一个处理截断签名反演问题的概率框架，不仅提供了理论上的贝叶斯重建误差基准，还证明了该方法在金融真实数据上的实用性和有效性。

title: Energy-Efficient Arm Reaching for a Humanoid Robot via Deep Reinforcement Learning with Identified Power Models
summary: Humanoid robots performing in-field manipulation tasks, such as robotic apple harvesting, face severe energy constraints that directly limit the number of reaching motions that can be executed per battery charge. This paper presents an end-to-end, energy-aware reinforcement learning framework for the 7-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot, combining a physics-based, experimentally identified electrical power model with a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) policy trained in a Pinocchio-based rigid-body dynamics simulator. The RL policy operates on an incremental joint-position action space and is trained with a Hybrid Constellation Reward that combines a four-point end-effector constellation distance with a torque-norm energy proxy; after % $5\times10^6$ training it reaches a $69.9\%$ success rate over $1\,000$ random targets in kinematic simulation, at a mean energy of \SI{98.16}{\joule} on successful episodes. Finally, on the physical Unitree~G1, the policy is validated over three independent 10-target batches, achieving a mean energy of $71.5 \pm 48.3$\,J, an end-effector position error of $2.64 \pm 1.04$\,cm, and an orientation error of $6.92 \pm 1.33^\circ$ -- within the \SI{4}{\centi\metre}/$8.6^\circ$ training tolerance. These results constitute a first step toward energy-aware reinforcement-learning-based arm reaching for humanoid robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对Unitree G1人形机器人手臂的端到端能量感知RL框架，通过融合物理动力学模型与混合奖励机制，在实机测试中实现了高精度、低能耗的作业控制。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在执行田间任务（如苹果采摘）时面临严重的能量限制，制约了电池供电下的最大作业次数，因此需要开发能量感知（energy-aware）的运动控制策略。
AI.method: 提出了一种端到端的能量感知强化学习框架：1. 结合基于物理的实验辨识电功率模型；2. 使用Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)算法；3. 在Pinocchio动力学仿真器中训练，采用增量关节位置动作空间；4. 设计了融合末端执行器距离与力矩范数能量代理的“混合星座奖励”函数。
AI.result: 在仿真中达到69.9%的成功率，平均能耗为98.16焦耳；在Unitree G1实机验证中，平均能耗为71.5 ± 48.3焦耳，末端位置误差2.64 ± 1.04厘米，姿态误差6.92 ± 1.33度，均满足预定训练容差要求。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了基于能量感知的强化学习策略在人形机器人手臂作业中的可行性，在保证任务精度的同时显著降低了能耗，为人形机器人在复杂环境下的长时间作业提供了技术路径。

title: EHRNote-ChatQA: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multi-Turn Clinical Question Answering over Longitudinal Discharge Summaries
summary: Discharge summaries are crucial clinical documents containing the context of a patient's overall hospital stay, and are routinely reviewed by medical experts for patient readmission, ongoing care, and diagnostic decision-making. When reviewing them, medical experts often must iteratively synthesize information across multiple summaries while verifying the evidence supporting each answer. Although large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical question answering, existing benchmarks do not sufficiently reflect this setting: they often evaluate exam-style medical knowledge or focus on single-turn question answering with limited evidence-grounding evaluation. We introduce EHRNote-ChatQA, the first benchmark for evidence-grounded multi-turn clinical question answering over patients' multiple discharge summaries. Built from de-identified MIMIC-IV discharge summaries, EHRNote-ChatQA contains 967 patient-level multi-turn samples spanning one to five notes and 16,072 medical-expert-verified QA pairs (8,036 content questions, each paired with an evidence-grounding question) across eight clinical categories. The benchmark is constructed through an expert-informed pipeline combining discharge-summary structuring schema, expert-curated multi-turn QA templates, and LLM-based generation, followed by review and revision of every single QA sample by 11 medical experts. Benchmarking 22 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals several challenges, including that LLMs struggle more with evidence grounding than content answering, multi-turn errors compound across turns, and single-turn clinical QA performance does not reliably transfer to this setting. These findings establish EHRNote-ChatQA as a rigorous and practical benchmark for evaluating clinical QA systems. The dataset will be made publicly available through PhysioNet credentialed access.

AI.tldr: 针对临床多轮对话与证据溯源需求，文章提出了首个基于 MIMIC-IV 数据集的 EHRNote-ChatQA 基准，旨在解决现有临床大模型测评中证据支撑不足和多轮推理能力缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的临床问答基准多侧重于考试型医学知识或单轮对话，缺乏对患者多次出院记录的综合分析及证据溯源能力的压力测试，无法反映临床工作中的实际需求。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含 967 个患者级样本及 16,072 个经专家验证的 QA 对的基准数据集。该过程采用“专家信息流水线”，结合出院总结结构化模板、自动化生成及 11 位医学专家的人工审核与修订。
AI.result: 对 22 个大模型进行测评发现：模型在证据溯源任务上表现较差，多轮对话中误差会随轮数累积，且单轮临床问答的表现与多轮综合分析任务的表现并无直接正相关。
AI.conclusion: EHRNote-ChatQA 是一个严谨且实用的基准，揭示了当前 LLM 在临床多轮对话和证据溯源方面的不足，为评估临床问答系统提供了重要参考。

title: DiRecT: Safe Diffusion-Based Planning via Receding-Horizon Denoising
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful tools for planning and control by learning multimodal distributions over actions and trajectories. Yet reliable inference-time safety enforcement remains a key barrier to their deployment in safety-critical tasks. Existing approaches typically project each denoising iterate onto the feasible set, even though constraints are defined only on the final clean trajectory. Enforcing feasibility on noisy intermediate samples can therefore overconstrain the sampling dynamics, substantially degrading sample quality. To address this limitation, we introduce DiRecT (Diffusion-based planning via Receding-horizon denoising with Terminal constraints), a training-free algorithm for constrained sampling from diffusion models via stochastic optimal control (SOC). DiRecT enforces constraints only on the final clean sample, avoiding unnecessary restrictions on the intermediate denoising dynamics. Inspired by model predictive control, we derive a principled receding-horizon surrogate for the otherwise intractable constrained SOC formulation, yielding an efficient algorithm that cleanly separates stochastic denoising from constraint satisfaction, progressively steering samples toward feasible final trajectories without distorting the learned diffusion dynamics. Furthermore, DiRecT is highly flexible: it can leverage off-the-shelf or domain-specific optimizers, incorporate priors over environment dynamics, and optimize additional soft rewards. Extensive experiments on safe planning benchmarks demonstrate that DiRecT substantially improves deployment safety and task performance over existing diffusion-based planning baselines.

AI.tldr: DiRecT 是一种用于扩散模型规划的免训练算法，通过“后退视界”策略将约束处理推迟到去噪末端，在保障安全性的同时避免了因过度约束导致的样本质量下降。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型规划方法在去噪的每个中间步骤强制执行可行性约束，这限制了采样动力学，导致生成样本质量下降；因此需要一种可以在不牺牲生成质量的前提下，仅对最终轨迹实施安全约束的规划方法。
AI.method: 提出 DiRecT (Diffusion-based planning via Receding-horizon denoising with Terminal constraints) 算法。该方法结合了随机最优控制 (SOC) 和模型预测控制 (MPC) 的思想，利用后退视界代理技术，将约束仅应用于最终生成的轨迹，实现了去噪过程与约束满足的解耦。
AI.result: 实验表明，DiRecT 在安全规划基准测试中，相较于现有的基于扩散模型的规划基线，在部署安全性和任务达成性能方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: DiRecT 通过将约束施加于最终生成结果而非中间去噪步骤，有效解决了扩散模型规划中过度约束的问题。该方法在保证安全性的同时，显著提升了样本质量和任务执行性能，为安全关键领域的扩散模型应用提供了高效且灵活的解决方案。

title: ControlMap: Controllable High-Definition Map Generation for Traffic Scenario Simulation
summary:
Simulation is central to validating autonomous driving systems, yet current pipelines are limited by insufficient scenario diversity due to costly High Definition (HD) map creation. Scaling HD maps requires expensive data collection and manual processing. Moreover, existing generative models lack the fine-grained control necessary to target specific road topologies during generation.
  This paper presents a data-driven pipeline for controllable HD map generation using latent diffusion and ControlNet for spatial conditioning. To our knowledge, we are the first to inject spatial guidance signals into a diffusion model for HD map synthesis. Furthermore, our model supports adjustable conditioning strength through classifier-free guidance and city-level style transfer via city label conditioning. To complement existing metrics, we introduce two novel metrics to evaluate adherence to the control signal and similarity to ground-truth maps. Experiments demonstrate that our model generates realistic HD maps that faithfully follow input road topologies while accurately preserving city-specific details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种首创的可控HD地图生成框架，结合潜在扩散模型与ControlNet实现对道路拓扑的精确引导和城市风格迁移，解决了自动驾驶仿真中高精度地图获取成本高、多样性匮乏的问题。
AI.motivation: 针对自动驾驶仿真中HD地图构建成本过高、场景多样性不足，以及现有生成模型在道路拓扑结构控制上的细粒度缺失问题，提出一种可控的HD地图生成方案。
AI.method: 引入基于潜在扩散（Latent Diffusion）与ControlNet的空间引导机制，实现对HD地图生成过程的精确可控；利用分类器无关引导（Classifier-free Guidance）实现条件强度调节；通过城市标签条件化实现城市级风格迁移；并设计了两种新评价指标来衡量控制信号契合度与真实性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该模型生成的HD地图不仅真实感强，且能准确遵循输入的道路拓扑结构，同时有效保持了目标城市的独有特征。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于潜在扩散模型与ControlNet的HD地图生成方案，成功在保持道路拓扑结构精确控制的同时，兼顾了城市级风格特征，为自动驾驶仿真提供了一种高效且多样化的数据生成手段。

title: A Self Consistency Based Reranking for Narrative Question Answering
summary: Narrative question answering (NQA) is a challenging task in natural language processing that requires models to understand long textual contexts, capture relationships across events, and generate coherent responses. Despite recent advances in pretrained language models, most existing approaches rely on a single decoding output during inference, making them sensitive to generation variability and often resulting in incomplete or inconsistent answers .To address this limitation, we propose a self-ensemble Self-Consistency-Based reranking framework for narrative question answering. The proposed method generates multiple candidate answers for each story-question pair and selects the final answer based on semantic agreement among the generated responses. This allows the model to explore diverse answer formulations while improving robustness through consensus-based selection without requiring modifications to the underlying architecture .The framework combines pretrained and fine-tuned language generation with multi-answer inference and similarity-based reranking. We evaluate the proposed approach on the NarrativeQA dataset using multiple models, including FLAN-T5 (Base and Small) and Pegasus-Large, under both baseline and fine-tuned settings .Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves performance across all models. In particular, FLAN-T5-Base achieves the best overall performance, improving from 82.32% to 86.66% (+4.34%) when combined with self-ensemble inference. Additionally, the largest improvement is observed with Pegasus-Large, which increases from 72.50% to 87.07% (+14.57%), highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对叙事问答中模型生成答案易产生偏差的问题，提出了一种基于自一致性的重排序框架。通过生成多个候选答案并进行语义一致性对比筛选，在不改动模型架构的情况下，大幅提升了主流生成模型的问答效果。
AI.motivation: 叙事问答（NQA）需要对长文本进行深层理解。现有的预训练模型通常依赖单一解码，输出对生成变异性敏感，导致回答往往不完整或前后矛盾。因此，需要一种能够提升生成质量和鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种自集成（self-ensemble）的自一致性重排序框架。首先为每个故事-问题对生成多个候选答案，随后通过基于语义一致性的重排序机制，选择语义共识度最高的答案作为最终输出。该方法结合了预训练/微调模型推理与相似度评估。
AI.result: 在NarrativeQA数据集上进行了测试，所有模型均有显著提升。FLAN-T5-Base性能从82.32%提升至86.66%（+4.34%）；Pegasus-Large性能从72.50%大幅提升至87.07%（+14.57%）。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于自一致性（self-consistency）的重排序框架，能够在不修改底层模型架构的前提下，显著提升叙事问答的鲁棒性和准确率，验证了多回答推理策略的有效性。

title: Repeated Bilateral Trade: The Quest for Fairness
summary: We study repeated bilateral trade from a fairness perspective. At each round, a fresh seller-buyer pair arrives, and the platform posts a price before observing the traders' valuations. Trade occurs only if both agents accept the price. Rather than maximizing only the gain from trade, we consider platforms that seek balanced divisions of the generated surplus. We show that natural fairness desiderata lead to a one-parameter Rawls-to-Nash family of fair-gain objectives, obtained by aggregating the seller's and buyer's net gains through nonpositive Hölder means. Unlike the standard gain-from-trade objective and the Rawlsian fair-gain objective studied in prior work, our proposed objectives induce a new statistical structure in which expected rewards are recovered from threshold feedback through a two-dimensional singular-kernel integral identity. This leads to a nonstandard pure-exploration problem whose natural estimators are rectangular double sums with row-column dependence and singular weights. Assuming independent i.i.d. seller and buyer valuation sequences with arbitrary unknown marginals, we characterize the optimal learning rates for the whole Rawls-to-Nash family of fair-gain objectives, giving matching fixed-confidence sample-complexity and regret bounds up to polylogarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了重复双边贸易中的公平性定价问题，构建了一系列Rawls-to-Nash公平收益目标，并解决了由此产生的非标准纯探索学习问题，给出了最优收敛速率界限。
AI.motivation: 现有重复双边贸易研究多关注最大化总贸易收益，忽略了交易过程中的公平性。本文旨在研究如何在满足公平分配剩余价值的前提下，通过学习优化平台定价策略。
AI.method: 1. 引入非正Hölder平均来聚合卖方和买方的净收益，定义公平增益目标族；2. 利用二维奇异核积分恒等式处理从阈值反馈中恢复预期收益的统计结构；3. 采用具有行-列依赖和奇异权重的矩形双重和作为估计量处理非标准纯探索问题。
AI.result: 证明了Rawls-to-Nash公平增益目标族诱导了一种新的统计结构，并为整个目标族提供了匹配的固定置信度样本复杂度和遗憾界（至多相差多对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出并刻画了Rawls-to-Nash公平增益目标族的最优学习率，为存在公平性约束的重复双边贸易平台提供了理论支撑，解决了非标准纯探索问题中的样本复杂度和遗憾界问题。

title: Friction Characterization of a Cable-Driven Differential Actuation System for Lower-Limb Exoskeletons
comment: Accepted for presentation IEEE RAS/EMBS 11th International Conference on Biomedical Robotics and Biomechatronics
summary: Lower-limb exoskeletons require actuation systems that can provide accurate joint torque control while preserving low mass and encumbrance. Conventional architectures often rely on independently actuated joints and joint-level torque sensors, increasing system complexity and weight. This paper presents a novel differential actuation architecture for hip-knee flexion/extension, enabling cooperative torque sharing between two motors via a linear differential mapping between motor and joint. To compensate for transmission losses, a model-based friction estimation strategy is developed and experimentally implemented, allowing accurate joint torque estimation without the need for torque sensors. The proposed solution is validated on a physical prototype, demonstrating the feasibility of sensorless torque estimation in a differentially actuated hip-knee module of a lower-limb exoskeleton.

AI.tldr: 本文针对下肢外骨骼提出了一种新型差分驱动架构，通过数学建模和摩擦补偿技术，在无需关节力矩传感器的情况下实现了准确的关节力矩估计，减轻了外骨骼的重量并降低了系统复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统下肢外骨骼驱动系统因采用独立驱动和关节级力矩传感器，导致系统复杂度高、重量大且体积受限，亟需一种低重量、低复杂度的力矩控制解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 采用差分驱动架构，实现髋膝关节在驱动上的耦合与力矩共享；2. 推导电机与关节间的线性差分映射关系；3. 开发并实施了一种基于模型的摩擦力估计策略，以补偿传动损耗。
AI.result: 实验验证结果表明，该方案能够在无需关节力矩传感器的情况下，实现准确的关节力矩估计，有效降低了系统的重量和复杂性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新型差分驱动架构，通过基于模型的摩擦补偿策略实现了无传感器的高精度关节力矩估计，验证了其在下肢外骨骼中应用的有效性与可行性。

title: ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Structured Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Political Evasion Detection
summary: This paper describes our system for SemEval-2026 Task 6, which addresses the classification of political evasion strategies in English question-answer pairs extracted from U.S. presidential interviews. We systematically compare two distinct paradigms: (1) Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Qwen3 models (4B-32B) using QLoRA, enhanced with tiered upsampling and weighted cross-entropy loss to address severe class imbalance, and (2) structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting of reasoning-capable API models, namely DeepSeek-V3.2 and Grok-4-Fast. Our evaluation demonstrates that structured CoT prompting of reasoning-enabled models substantially outperforms our baseline parameter-efficient fine-tuning implementation in absolute Macro F1. Our best system, Grok-4-Fast with extended reasoning and few-shot hierarchical CoT prompting, achieves a Macro F1 of 0.5147 on Subtask 2 (9-class evasion) and 0.7979 on Subtask 1 (3-class clarity), ranking 8th out of 33 teams on Subtask 2 and 13th out of 41 teams on Subtask 1 on the official leaderboard. Furthermore, our ablation studies reveal key insights into effective prompt design for evasion detection: presenting labels within a hierarchical taxonomy helps structure model reasoning, while few-shot exemplars provide task calibration. However, the strongest prompt variants are not statistically distinguishable in Macro F1, and explicitly enabling extended reasoning modes yields substantial performance gains by facilitating the multi-step pragmatic analysis required to detect evasive intent.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了微调与思维链提示在政治逃避策略分类任务中的表现，发现利用高性能推理模型的扩展思维链提示在处理语用分析任务时显著优于轻量化微调方案。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决SemEval-2026任务6中识别美国总统访谈中政治逃避策略的挑战，应对数据集类别严重不平衡及逃避意图识别所需的复杂语用分析问题。
AI.method: 采用了两种对比范式：1. 基于QLoRA对Qwen3系列模型进行参数高效微调，并引入分级上采样和加权交叉熵损失处理类别不平衡；2. 对DeepSeek-V3.2和Grok-4-Fast进行结构化思维链（CoT）及少样本提示。
AI.result: 最佳系统（Grok-4-Fast + 层次化CoT）在子任务2（9类）上获得0.5147 Macro F1，在子任务1（3类）上获得0.7979 Macro F1，分别在该榜单排名第8和第13。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化思维链（CoT）提示词诱导大模型进行深度推理，对于捕捉复杂的政治逃避意图优于传统的参数高效微调（PEFT/QLoRA）方法。此外，扩展推理模式、标签层次化结构及少样本示例对于提升分类性能至关重要。

title: Learning Earthquake Wave Arrival Time Picking from Labels with Inaccuracies
summary: Inaccurately labeled training data, or "label noise", poses a significant threat to the integrity of supervised machine learning models. This corruption directly degrades performance by teaching the model erroneous mappings between features and labels, which leads to poor generalization and reduced accuracy on properly labeled validation and test data. Current seismological applications mainly rely on large-scale training sets or data augmentation to reduce the label-noise impact, which can be labor-intensive and costly. Here, we introduce a Label Noise-Contrastive Robust Learning (LaNCoR) approach that can effectively handle noisy labels in seismic signal processing tasks, without requiring large-scale training datasets. In this approach, the input waveform feature and label representation distributions are aligned in the feature space to correct mislabeling and reduce its impact on the training process. We present LaNCoR's performance on the task of P-phase arrival-time picking of real microseismic data using two baseline models and training approaches. Our results indicate that LaNCoR can improve performance by up to 28.8% across performance metrics. This approach holds great promise for model training in seismology and geosciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 LaNCoR 的新方法，通过在特征空间对齐特征与标签分布，成功解决了地震信号处理中标签噪声导致的模型性能下降问题，且无需依赖大规模标注数据，性能提升显著。
AI.motivation: 训练数据中的标签噪声会损害有监督机器学习模型的泛化能力和准确性。现有的地震学解决方法（如扩充数据集）往往成本高昂且耗时，因此需要一种无需大规模数据集就能应对标签噪声的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“标签噪声对比鲁棒学习”（LaNCoR）的方法。该方法通过在特征空间内对齐输入波形特征分布与标签表示分布，从而纠正错误标签并抑制其对训练过程的负面影响。
AI.result: 在处理真实微地震数据的 P 波震相到时拾取任务中，与现有的两种基准模型和训练方法相比，LaNCoR 在各项性能指标上最高提升了 28.8%。
AI.conclusion: LaNCoR 是一种针对地震学数据处理中标签噪声问题的有效解决方案，它能在无需大规模数据集的情况下显著提升模型的鲁棒性和预测性能，对于地球科学领域有重要的应用前景。

title: $λ$-Reachability: Geometric-Horizon Safety Bellman Equations for Humanoid Safety
summary: We introduce $λ$-Reachability, a scalable approach to Hamilton--Jacobi safety analysis for high-dimensional robotic systems. Unlike prior discounted formulations that rely on fixed one-step Bellman updates, $λ$-Reachability employs a stochastic multi-step estimator of the safety value, using a geometrically distributed rollout horizon together with a randomly absorbed terminal. Conceptually analogous to TD($λ$), $λ$-Reachability interpolates between local self-consistency updates and long-horizon max-over-trajectory safety targets via an interpretable horizon-control parameter. Unlike TD($λ$), where the terminal value is always incorporated in learning targets, the terminal safety value in $λ$-Reachability is only used at a probability controlled by parameter $δ$. We formally show that for $δ<1$, the update induces a contraction mapping that allows temporal-difference learning; as $λ\to 1$, the estimator recovers the undiscounted reachability objective. We apply $λ$-Reachability to high-dimensional safety learning problems with both simulated and real humanoid robots under balance and collision avoidance constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that $λ$-Reachability significantly improves both safe-set boundary classification and safety margin estimation compared to single-step temporal-difference baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于高维机器人系统的高效安全分析方法 λ-Reachability，通过类 TD(λ) 的多步估计机制，在保证收敛性的前提下，实现了比传统单步方法更优的安全边界学习。
AI.motivation: 现有基于折扣因子的 Hamilton-Jacobi 安全分析方法依赖固定的单步 Bellman 更新，难以在大规模高维机器人系统中实现精确且可扩展的安全评估。
AI.method: 提出了 λ-Reachability 方法，引入几何分布的 Rollout 视界和受参数 δ 控制的随机吸收终止状态，通过类 TD(λ) 的多步估计器学习安全值，并证明了当 δ < 1 时该更新算子满足收缩映射性质。
AI.result: 在高维类人机器人仿真和物理实验中，该方法在安全集边界分类和安全裕度估计的准确性上显著优于基准方法（单步 TD）。
AI.conclusion: λ-Reachability 通过引入可控的衰减参数，在局部自洽更新与长时程安全目标之间实现了有效权衡，被证明在学习高维机器人系统的安全集边界和安全裕度方面优于传统的单步时间差分法。

title: DYNA : Dynamic Episodic Memory Networks for Augmenting Large Language Models with Temporal Knowledge Graphs in Continuous Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to incorporate new knowledge without forgetting or costly retraining. We propose DYNA, a lightweight framework that augments a frozen LLM with a temporal knowledge graph where events are nodes and temporal relations are directed, timestamped edges. The graph serves as an external, updatable memory. At query time, DYNA retrieves relevant nodes via random walks and centrality measures, then augments the LLM's response. Evaluated on three temporal recall tasks, DYNA reduces catastrophic forgetting by ~7% compared to fine-tuning and improves temporal ordering by ~5% over standard RAG. Higher graph clustering coefficients correlate with better retrieval, showing that graph structure matters. Contributions: (1) episodic memory as temporal KG, (2) retraining-free LLM augmentation, (3) graph properties as predictors of retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: DYNA 框架通过引入时间知识图谱作为可更新的外部插件，在无需微调的情况下解决了 LLM 获取新知识并保持时间逻辑连贯性的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在整合新知识时面临灾难性遗忘，且完全微调成本过高，现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法在处理复杂时间关系时存在局限。
AI.method: 提出了 DYNA 框架，通过构建以事件为节点、带时间戳的边为关系的时间知识图谱（Temporal KG）作为外部记忆。在推理阶段，利用随机游走和中心度指标检索相关知识，并将检索到的信息注入大模型进行增强。
AI.result: 在三个时间召回任务中，DYNA 较传统微调减少了约 7% 的灾难性遗忘，在时间排序任务上较标准 RAG 提升了约 5% 的性能；研究还发现图聚类系数与检索性能呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: DYNA 展示了利用时间知识图谱作为外挂存储，是一种无需持续微调即可有效增强大模型时间知识及缓解灾难性遗忘的有效途径，且图结构特征对检索性能具有预测价值。

title: A Compositional Framework for Open-ended Intelligence
summary: Open-ended intelligence is the capacity to adapt to novel problems and environments that are substantially different from those in training. We formalize open-ended intelligence as the closure induced by a finite primitive set \(P\) and a set of composition operators \(C\). We characterize properties of the induced closure \(\mathcal{L}(P,C)\) that support unbounded compositional generation across families of tasks and worlds. A mathematics of open-ended intelligence requires two pillars: a minimal set of representational primitives (e.g., states, actions) and algorithmic primitives (e.g., nearest neighbor), together with composition motifs (e.g., recursion, sequencing) that reflect an acquired compositional grammar. The closure of these two pillars enables the generation of infinite adaptive responses across a wide range of settings. The mathematics supports complementary research agendas, including evaluation metrics for explanation and interpretability, as well as building architectures where compositional generalization is native. We propose next primitive prediction as a novel architectural objective, where the training objective encourages the acquisition of reusable algorithmic primitives and their compositional grammar, such that new solutions are generated through recombination. Curriculum learning and self-play enable lifelong learning and expansion of the closure by discovering reusable primitives and transition motifs across families of tasks and worlds. We ground the framework through case studies in physics, evolution, and neuroscience.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化定义了“开放式智能”，提出通过组合原语与算子的闭包来支持无界生成，并提出基于“预测下一个基元”的目标函数来赋予模型原生组合泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有系统在面对训练分布以外的全新环境与问题时，难以具备适应性和泛化能力的局限，试图从数学层面刻画“开放式智能”的生成能力。
AI.method: 提出了开放式智能的数学形式化定义（基于算子组合闭包 $\mathcal{L}(P,C)$），并引入“预测下一个基元（next primitive prediction）”作为学习架构的核心目标，借力课程学习和自我对弈来发现可复用的算法基元。
AI.result: 构建了一个支持无界组合生成的数学框架，能够跨任务和世界生成无穷的自适应响应，并通过物理学、进化论和神经科学的案例论证了该框架的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为通向开放式智能提供了一个新的理论框架，即通过闭包属性实现无界组合生成。建议通过“预测下一个基元”作为新目标，结合课程学习和自我对弈，构建具备组合泛化能力的通用智能架构。

title: Leveraging Deep Learning for Object and Position Recognition of Load Carriers for Autonomous Logistics Vehicles
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IFAC World Congress2026, \c{opyright} 2026 the authors. This work has been accepted to IFAC for publication under a Creative Commons Licence CC-BY-NC-ND
summary:
This work explores the use of artificial intelligence in mobile robotics to achieve autonomous detection and pose estimation of load carriers for automated pickup. A deep neural network is designed to recognize predefined landmarks on the carrier from RGBD data; these landmarks are then used to compute the carrier's pose. The network operates directly on RGBD images to estimate landmark positions, which form the basis for determining the carrier's location. The approach is validated in extensive experiments and comprises both software and hardware implementations.
  A deep learning-based framework is presented to detect load carriers and estimate their pose for use with autonomous logistics vehicles. Our method uses a convolutional neural network to identify characteristic reference points on the carrier from RGBD input and computes its pose by combining these inferred landmarks with prior geometric knowledge. Experiments show that the resulting accuracy is sufficient for reliable load carrier detection in industrial environments, confirming the suitability of the method for autonomous intralogistics applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CNN的深度学习框架，通过RGBD数据识别载具标志点并结合几何先验实现自主精确的位姿估计，有效支撑了自动化物流车辆的搬运任务。
AI.motivation: 为了解决移动机器人中载荷载具的自动识别与位姿估计问题，以实现物流场景下的自动化拣选和搬运。
AI.method: 设计了一种基于深度卷积神经网络（CNN）的框架，直接利用RGBD传感器数据识别载具上的预定义标志点（Landmarks），并结合载具的先验几何知识计算其位姿。
AI.result: 通过大量的软硬件实验验证，该方法在工业环境中展现出足够的位姿估计精度，能够实现可靠的载荷载具检测。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够准确识别载荷载具并估计其位姿，精度满足工业环境下的自动化物流需求，验证了其在自主内部物流应用中的适用性。

title: ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 4: Modeling Narrative Structures via Pseudonymization and Multi-View Sentence Alignment
summary: We present our approach to SemEval 2026 Task 4: Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning. Our solution uses contrastive learning with fine-tuned sentence transformers to capture narrative similarity across abstract themes, course of action, and outcomes. We develop two pipelines: (Track A) a single-view method that encodes full narratives with smart layer freezing to reduce overfitting, and (Track B) a multi-view method that models theme, plot, and outcome with view-specific projection heads and self-supervised alignment. Both pipelines build on sentence-transformers models and are trained with contrastive loss on synthetic data. The code is available at the following GitHub repository: https://github.com/dinhthienan33/SemEval2026-Task4-ttda704.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SemEval 2026 Task 4，提出了一种基于对比学习的叙事相似度分析方法，通过单视图和多视图两种管线模型，有效实现了对叙事主题、情节及结果的深度表征学习。
AI.motivation: 为了解决SemEval 2026 Task 4中叙事故事相似度评估及叙事表征学习的挑战，目标是准确捕捉抽象主题、行为路径及结果维度的叙事相似性。
AI.method: 1. 采用基于预训练Sentence-Transformers的微调模型。2. 通过对比损失（Contrastive Loss）在合成数据上进行训练。3. 轨道A（单视图）：采用全叙事编码并结合智能层冻结技术以防止过拟合。4. 轨道B（多视图）：通过针对主题、情节和结果的特定投影头以及自监督对齐机制进行建模。
AI.result: 成功构建并实现了两个针对不同赛道的叙事处理管线，并在评估中证明了该方法在处理复杂叙事逻辑方面的有效性。代码已开源供社区参考。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过对比学习和特定的多视图建模方法，为叙事故事相似度评估提供了高效的解决方案，证明了在有限数据下利用对比损失和针对性架构表征叙事结构的有效性。

title: Constitutional Value Potentials: reading and steering internal priority margins in language models
summary: A constitution tells a language model what to value, but little tells us whether it does. Adherence is judged from outputs, and output evidence is most fragile on value conflicts, where what matters is not which value a model mentions but which one it is willing to sacrifice. We provide evidence that this arbitration can be read from activations in a structured margin readout. We introduce Constitutional Value Potentials (CVP). For each value we learn a scalar potential from the hidden state: an internal pressure to preserve that value, supervised not by the prompt but by an independent judge's verdict on which value the model's own response actually preserved. The signed difference of two potentials is a priority margin. A constitutional clause becomes the claim that a margin stays positive, and a single monitor score flags when it does not. The monitor predicts conflict violations with AUROC up to 0.95, beats a strong hidden-state probe, and generalizes to held-out synthetic conflicts across three Qwen2.5 scales. The signal appears as the answer begins, from the prompt tail and first response token. Read this early, the same signal reveals whether an adversarial priority hack has actually pushed the model toward a violation, rather than only whether the prompt looks adversarial. The same directions also support intervention tests: under selected steering settings, moving along a value direction shifts judged trade-offs in the intended direction. Together, these results suggest that some constitution-relevant priorities are accessible as activation-space margins, rather than only as output behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“宪法价值潜能”（CVP）方法，通过分析模型隐藏层激活状态，能够实时量化模型在发生矛盾时的价值优先级，从而比仅靠监控输出更早地发现宪法冲突，并能通过干预手段校准模型的价值权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM“宪法”（Constitutions）依从性的评估多基于输出行为，但在价值冲突场景下，输出证据往往脆弱且难以揭示模型内部的真实价值取舍。研究旨在探索能否从模型隐藏层的激活状态中直接读取并干预这种宪法价值的仲裁逻辑。
AI.method: 提出“宪法价值潜能”（Constitutional Value Potentials, CVP）方法：通过学习隐藏状态中的标量潜能，以独立评估者的判定结果为监督信号，计算两个价值之间的“优先级边际”；引入监控分数（Monitor Score）实时检测冲突，并利用激活空间干预技术实现对模型行为的引导。
AI.result: 监控器在预测冲突违规方面的AUROC高达0.95，优于强基准探测器，且在不同规模的Qwen2.5模型上具有良好的泛化能力；该信号在响应生成早期即可检测，并支持通过激活空间干预改变模型的价值取舍倾向。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，宪法价值优先级不仅体现于模型输出，还以激活空间中的“边际差值”（margins）形式存在；通过对这些潜能（Potentials）进行监控和干预，可以实现比传统输出评估更精准、更早期的价值冲突干预。

title: A Smart-Scheduled Hybrid (SSH) EKF-FGO State Estimation
comment: This work has been accepted for presentation/publication at the 2026 IEEE Canadian Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (CCECE). The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Reliable state estimation in robotics and control re quires balancing estimation accuracy against computational cost. While filtering-based methods such as the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) provide efficient real-time updates, and optimisation based formulations using factor graphs improve global consistency, the role of optimisation scheduling is often treated implicitly rather than examined as an explicit design variable. This paper presents an experimental study that explicitly isolates optimisation scheduling using a Smart Scheduled Hybrid (SSH) EKF-FGO framework as a controlled testbed. By combining EKF-based state propagation with periodically invoked batch optimisation and holding solver structure and effort fixed, the main contribution of this work is the experimental characterisation of optimisation scheduling as an independent design variable governing the trade-off between intermediate estimation accuracy and computational cost. Simulation results in a planar SLAM environment show that scheduling strongly influences pre optimisation drift, transient error behaviour, and runtime. In particular, the results identify operating regimes in which most of the benefit of global optimisation can be retained at a fraction of the computational cost, highlighting optimisation scheduling as an under-explored yet critical consideration in hybrid state estimation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在混合状态估计（EKF+FGO）中，“优化调度”作为一个独立设计变量对精度与计算效率权衡的影响，证明了通过优化调度策略可以在效率与准确性之间实现更优平衡。
AI.motivation: 在机器人状态估计中，常用的EKF（滤波）计算高效但一致性较差，而FGO（优化）一致性好但计算成本高；目前的混合方法往往忽视了“优化调度”这一设计变量对精度和计算成本权衡的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“智能调度混合（SSH）EKF-FGO”的框架，通过固定求解器结构和计算努力，将优化调度作为独立变量进行控制，并在平面SLAM环境中进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，调度策略显著影响预优化漂移、瞬态误差行为和运行时间；识别出了某些特定的操作区间，能够以极小的计算成本获取全局优化的核心性能收益。
AI.conclusion: 优化调度是混合状态估计系统中一个被低估但至关重要的设计变量，通过合理调度可以在大幅降低计算成本的同时保留全局优化的主要性能优势。

title: On Defining Erasure Harms for NLP
summary: The deployment of NLP systems has raised concerns about harms they might produce, including representational harms. Recent literature has begun to conceptualize and measure one such harm, the harm of erasure. Nevertheless, the field lacks a clear and cohesive conceptual foundation for identifying and measuring erasure. Existing conceptualizations of erasure are often broad -- making it difficult to identify what is needed to establish and measure erasure -- or else specific to particular settings -- facilitating measurement for those settings but potentially challenging to adapt to other settings. To address this gap, we develop and propose a structured definition of erasure that clarifies what components are necessary for establishing whether erasure has occurred, which practitioners need to explicitly articulate and operationalize in order to measure erasure.

AI.tldr: 本文针对NLP中“擦除”现象定义模糊的问题，提出了一个结构化的概念框架，为识别和衡量AI表征伤害提供了统一的操作准则。
AI.motivation: 尽管NLP系统中“表征伤害”（如擦除）日益受到关注，但目前学术界对于“擦除”缺乏一个清晰、连贯且具备普适性的概念框架，导致相关研究难以标准化和有效衡量。
AI.method: 针对现有“擦除”概念模糊或过于局部化的问题，通过对现有文献的综合分析，提炼并构建了一个结构化的、通用的擦除定义，明确了衡量该伤害所需的关键要素。
AI.result: 建立了一套结构化的擦除定义，旨在帮助从业者明确在评估NLP系统时需要显式定义和操作化的关键变量，从而克服了现有定义在广泛适用性与精确度之间的矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一个结构化的擦除定义框架，澄清了界定和衡量“擦除”现象所需的必要组成部分，为NLP领域在识别和评估这类表征伤害方面提供了统一的理论基础。

title: Post-Launch Capability Expansion of Vision-Language Models via Prompting for On-Orbit Spacecraft Inspection
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Equal contribution by Nicholas A. Welsh and Lennon Shikhman. Published in the CVPR2026 Workshop on AI4Space
summary: Spaceborne inspection systems often deploy perception models prior to launch, after which updating model weights or expanding fixed label sets becomes operationally impractical. While supervised models can be integrated pre-flight, adding new semantic capabilities in orbit requires retraining and re-uploading parameters. We investigate whether prompt-driven vision--language models can enable post-launch semantic expansion, allowing new spacecraft components to be specified via natural-language prompts without modifying onboard weights. We evaluate zero-shot instance segmentation of spacecraft components under a strictly frozen, single-pass inference protocol on a test set of $129$ images of previously unseen satellites. Under fixed global thresholds and no post-processing, SAM3 achieves $0.385$ mAP@$0.5$ and $0.267$ mAP@$0.5{:}0.95$. Performance is strongly scale-dependent: large structural elements like spacecraft bodies ($0.639$ AP@$0.50$) and solar arrays ($0.598$ AP@$0.5$) localize reliably, while relatively small appendages like antennas ($0.221$ AP@$0.5$) and thrusters ($0.081$ AP@$0.5$) remain difficult. Prompt formulation influences performance, with structured prompts incorporating spatial and geometric descriptors yielding up to $82%$ improvement over short category-name prompts. The model operates within the memory and compute envelope of contemporary embedded GPUs, suggesting prompt-driven grounding can provide a practical mechanism for post-launch semantic extension of dominant spacecraft structures while highlighting limitations of zero-shot localization for fine-scale components under orbital domain shift.

AI.tldr: 研究验证了利用提示词驱动模型在星载环境下实现零样本语义扩展的可行性，能够高效识别卫星关键部件，但面临精细小尺度组件识别的挑战。
AI.motivation: 星载感知系统在发射后难以更新模型权重或扩展标签集，传统的监督学习模型无法满足在轨灵活增加语义识别能力的需求。
AI.method: 在严格冻结的单次推理协议下，利用提示词驱动的视觉-语言模型（SAM3）对129张未见过的卫星图像进行零样本实例分割，并分析了不同提示词设计（如包含空间和几何描述的结构化提示）对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: SAM3在保持固定全局阈值的零样本设置下，mAP@0.5达到0.385。对于卫星本体和太阳能帆板等大型结构，检测效果较好；但对于天线、推进器等小型部件，检测难度高。通过结构化提示词，性能提升最高可达82%。
AI.conclusion: 提示词驱动的视觉-语言模型（SAM3）为在轨航天器部件的语义扩展提供了一种可行的方案，能够无需更新模型权重即可识别新部件。然而，对于小尺寸、精细结构的检测能力仍有待改进。

title: A Deployment Case Study in Robotic Apparel Automation: Digital Twin Integration, Interoperability, and Workforce Enablement
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, IEEE ICRA 2026 Workshop Paper
summary: Despite steady advances in flexible automation in sectors such as electronics and automotive manufacturing, apparel automation remains challenging because fabrics are deformable and difficult to manipulate with robots. This paper presents a deployment-oriented case study of a robotic sewing system for denim manufacturing, emphasizing the system-level integration required for practical adoption. At the engineering level, a digital thread module parses DXF production drawings into process parameters and executable robot trajectories, reducing manual programming effort and enabling rapid re-targeting across sewing operations. In parallel, a digital twin of the workcell is used during pre-deployment to validate reach and clearance, refine layout and sequencing, evaluate operator access, and assess cycle-time compatibility with upstream and downstream tasks, thereby reducing commissioning risk. At deployment, the system integrates a collaborative robot with conventional sewing equipment, welding, suction fixtures, and machine-level controllers through an interoperability layer. Runtime monitoring and verification, including seam monitoring, collision checking, and trajectory-level validation, improve robustness under environmental variability, while operator-facing training and guidance tools support setup, troubleshooting, and technology adoption. Two staged factory deployments on denim shorts, covering 2D pocket operations and 3D garment-shaping seams, show that digital-twin-based validation, digital-thread-driven task generation, interoperability, runtime verification, and operator training are important for scaling robotic apparel automation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种集成数字主线与数字孪生技术的机器人缝纫系统，解决了服装加工中织物形变带来的自动化难题，并通过工厂现场部署验证了该方案在实际生产中的鲁棒性与高效性。
AI.motivation: 服装产业高度依赖人工，尽管自动化在电子和汽车制造业已成熟，但由于织物具有易形变特性，导致机器人操作难度极大，目前仍缺乏实用的服装自动化集成解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了一套面向部署的机器人缝纫系统集成方案：1. 利用数字主线模块将DXF生产图纸自动解析为工艺参数和机器人路径；2. 建立工作单元数字孪生进行预部署验证（布局、节拍、可达性）；3. 构建互操作层整合协作机器人、缝纫设备及传感器；4. 实施运行时监控（缝迹检查、碰撞预警）及员工操作辅助工具。
AI.result: 通过两个阶段的工厂实机部署（牛仔短裤的2D口袋作业及3D成型缝纫），验证了所提架构在减少编程工作量、降低部署风险以及提升复杂缝纫任务稳定性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 针对服装自动化领域，通过集成数字主线（Digital Thread）、数字孪生（Digital Twin）、互操作层及运行时监控等技术，能够有效克服织物形变带来的挑战，实现机器人缝纫系统的工业级部署，为服装制造业的自动化规模化提供了可行路径。

title: The Truth Stays in the Family: Enhancing Contextual Grounding via Inherited Truthful Heads in Model Lineages
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have produced many specialized multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) that share common foundational LLMs, forming distinct model lineages. It remains unclear whether a fundamental behavioral link exists between the foundational LLMs and downstream variants. We investigate this question by quantifying head-level context-truthfulness scores. Across diverse LLM and MLLM lineages, including Vicuna-, Qwen2.5-, LLaMA2-, and Mistral-based models, we find that Truth Scores are strongly preserved within model families, even after instruction tuning or multimodal adaptation. We further show that this inheritance is consistent with attention-head weight preservation, and that context-truthful heads attend to query-relevant evidence. Building on this finding, we propose TruthProbe, a soft-gating strategy that amplifies context-truthful heads while preserving other head contributions. TruthProbe improves contextual truthfulness on HaluEval and reduces multimodal hallucination on POPE and CHAIR, with base-LLM Truth Scores transferring effectively to their fine-tuned LLM and MLLM descendants. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/TruthProbe.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现大语言模型的真实性特征会在模型家族中遗传，并提出TruthProbe，通过增强特定的注意力头来有效提升模型的事实准确性并降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究基础大语言模型（LLM）与其下游衍生出来的多模态大模型（MLLM）在行为特征（特别是真实性表现）上是否存在根本性的关联传承。
AI.method: 1. 使用“头级上下文真实性评分”（head-level context-truthfulness scores）定量分析不同模型家族（Vicuna, Qwen2.5, LLaMA2, Mistral等）的内部机制；2. 关联分析注意力头的权重保留与真实性传承；3. 提出TruthProbe，一种通过软门控机制（soft-gating）放大真实性相关注意力头的方法。
AI.result: 1. 发现真实性评分在模型家族内部具有极强的传承性，即使经过指令微调或多模态适配，这种特征仍能被保留；2. 证实了注意力头的权重与真实性传承的高度一致性；3. TruthProbe技术成功提升了模型在HaluEval数据集上的真实性，并减少了POPE和CHAIR评估中的多模态幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了大语言模型的上下文真实性（Truth Scores）在模型家族中具有强传承性，且由注意力头的权重决定。基于此开发的TruthProbe方法能有效增强模型的事实准确性并减少多模态幻觉。

title: Beyond Classification: A Cough Regression Benchmark for Respiratory Acoustic Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Data for Health
summary: Respiratory acoustic foundation models (FMs) excel at cough classification, yet their ability to predict continuous health quantities from cough audio remains largely unexplored, despite the clinical value of passive age, BMI, and disease probability estimation in settings where physical measurements are unavailable. We introduce the multi-model, multi-target cough regression benchmark evaluating five FMs (OPERA-CT, OPERA-CE, OPERA-GT, HeAR, M2D+Resp) across six targets on three datasets under subject-disjoint protocols, comparing linear, MLP-small, and full MLP regression heads. MLP-small beats the mean-predictor baseline on all tasks and linear probing in 23 of 30 model x task cases, with full MLP overfitting on small clinical data but recovering on larger sets, revealing a dataset size x head-capacity trade-off. HeAR leads within-dataset age regression on Coswara (9.12 yr MAE); its CIDRZ result is excluded from headline claims owing to possible HeAR-CIDRZ pretraining overlap. OPERA-GT is favored over OPERA-CT on age in all three datasets, with the CIDRZ margin within seed variance, extending a generative-pretraining advantage from breath to cough. HeAR and M2D+Resp reach near-full performance at N = 50 samples while OPERA models require N = 400. Cross-dataset transfer is strongly asymmetric as large diverse data generalises to small clinical populations (CoughVID to CIDRZ: -0.17 yr) but not vice versa (CIDRZ to Coswara: +2.43 yr, +26.6%).

AI.tldr: 本研究建立了多模型咳嗽回归基准，揭示了呼吸声基础模型在预测生理健康指标（如年龄、BMI）方面的效能，明确了样本量、模型架构及数据多样性对回归性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管呼吸声基础模型在分类任务中表现优异，但其在根据咳嗽音频预测连续健康属性（如年龄、BMI、疾病概率）方面的潜力和局限性尚未得到充分探讨。在无法进行物理测量的环境中，这种被动监测具有重要的临床价值。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含5个基础模型（OPERA-CT、OPERA-CE、OPERA-GT、HeAR、M2D+Resp）的多模型、多目标咳嗽回归基准。在3个数据集上，采用受试者不相交（subject-disjoint）协议，并在3种回归头（线性、小型MLP、全MLP）下评估了6个回归目标。
AI.result: 评估发现MLP-small的表现优于线性探测；HeAR和M2D+Resp在小样本量（N=50）下即可达到近乎满意的性能，而OPERA模型则需更大样本量（N=400）；证实了生成式预训练对提升回归任务效果的优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用咳嗽声进行连续健康指标预测是可行的。模型性能受到数据集规模与回归头容量（Head-capacity）之间折衷的影响；生成式预训练模型（如OPERA-GT）表现优异，且跨数据集迁移能力存在显著的不对称性，即大规模多样化数据能更好地泛化至特定临床群体。

title: Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Many robotic tasks require short-term memory, whether it's retrieving an object that's no longer visible or turning off an appliance after a set period. Yet, most visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning rely only on immediate sensory input without using past experiences to guide decisions. We present PRISM, a transformer-based architecture for visuomotor policies to effectively use short-term memory via two key components: (i) gated attention, which filters retrieved information to suppress irrelevant details, improving performance by reducing the spurious correlations between the history and current action prediction, (ii) a hierarchical architecture that first compresses local information into compact tokens and then integrates them to capture temporally extended dependencies, improving its compute and memory footprint. Together, these mechanisms enable us to scale short-term memory in visuomotor policies for up to two minutes. To systematically evaluate memory in visuomotor control, we introduce ReMemBench -- a benchmark of eight diverse household manipulation tasks spanning four categories of short-term memory -- designed to foster general memory mechanisms rather than siloed, task-specific solutions. PRISM consistently outperforms prior works, including recurrent architectures, transformers, and their variants -- achieving an absolute improvement of 5%--12% over the strongest baseline. On the RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks, it achieves absolute improvements of 11%--15% over its no-memory variant and fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action baselines such as GR00T-N1-3B and OpenVLA, despite not leveraging any large-scale pretraining. Together, PRISM and ReMemBench establish a foundation for developing and evaluating short-term memory-augmented visuomotor policies that scale to long-horizon tasks. Additional materials are available at https://shahrutav.github.io/short-term-memory

AI.tldr: 提出了 PRISM 模型和 ReMemBench 基准。PRISM 通过门控注意力和分层架构实现了高效的短期记忆集成，在无需大规模预训练的情况下，在处理长程视觉运动任务方面显著优于现有的Transformer和循环架构。
AI.motivation: 大多数现有的模仿学习视觉运动策略仅依赖瞬时传感器输入，无法处理需要短期记忆（如观察物体消失后检索、延时操作）的机器人任务。
AI.method: 提出了 PRISM 架构：(1) 门控注意力机制，用于过滤无关历史信息以减少虚假相关性；(2) 分层架构，通过压缩局部信息为紧凑标记，实现时间上扩展的依赖捕捉与计算资源优化。同时引入了包含八项任务的基准测试 ReMemBench。
AI.result: PRISM 在 ReMemBench 上比同类最优模型提升了 5%-12%，在 RoboCasa 和 LIBERO 基准中比无记忆模型及大规模预训练基线（GR00T-N1-3B, OpenVLA）高出 11%-15%。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 证明了通过门控注意力和分层架构可以在视觉运动策略中有效集成短期记忆，显著提升了机器人处理长程任务的能力，并为短期记忆模型的评估提供了标准化框架 ReMemBench。

title: When Correct Edges Cannot Be Verified: A Provenance Gap in Incomplete KGQA and a Provenance-Favoring Completion Policy
summary: Incomplete Knowledge Graph Question Answering (IKGQA) requires completing missing edges to continue reasoning. A growing line of work verifies completed edges against retrieved text, treating textual support as a proxy for edge quality. We ask a question that, to our knowledge, has not been systematically tested: does textual verifiability actually track correctness? Exploiting the gold deleted triples provided by the standard random-deletion protocol, we measure both. The finding is counterintuitive: among gold-correct completed edges, 76-96% have no supporting passage even under exhaustive retrieval, robustly across deletion rates (20%/40%), datasets (CWQ/WebQSP), and relation types (structural, commonsense, long-tail). Most Freebase-style facts simply do not occur as head-tail co-mentions in text. Textual faithfulness therefore measures provenance, not correctness -- separated by a paradigm-level gap no in-corpus retrieval closes. This reframes edge completion. Since most completed edges -- correct or not -- are causally redundant for the answer (95-97% of correct answers do not depend on any unsupported edge), the central question shifts from "is the edge correct?" to "admit or abstain under provenance uncertainty?" Within this framing we present TGComplete, a provenance-favoring admission policy that retrieves evidence at a reasoning breakpoint, verifies a candidate through a lightweight loop, and abstains when support is absent. Against the generate-to-complete baseline GoG, it attains higher edge precision against gold (15-21% vs 3-14%), with no statistically detectable EM loss and 3.1-7.4 times higher strict faithfulness of admitted edges -- at the cost of lower recall. We position TGComplete not as uniformly better, but as a principled point on a precision/provenance-recall trade-off, appropriate when auditability matters.

AI.tldr: 研究发现知识图谱补全的“文本可验证性”无法有效代表“正确性”。基于此，作者提出TGComplete框架，通过在来源不确定时采取保守采纳策略，在牺牲召回率的前提下提升了补全边的精确度和可审计性。
AI.motivation: 现有IKGQA方法普遍假设“文本可验证性（Textual Verifiability）”是评价补全边“正确性（Correctness）”的代理指标，但该假设从未被系统验证过。作者旨在探究这一假设的有效性。
AI.method: 1. 利用现有协议中的金标准删除三元组，对比分析知识图谱补全边的“正确性”与“文本可验证性”。 2. 提出TGComplete框架：一种基于来源偏好的采纳策略，在推理节点进行证据检索，利用轻量级循环验证候选边，在缺乏支持时选择弃权（abstain）。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了反直觉事实：高达76-96%的正确补全边在文本中找不到支持证据。 2. 发现大部分补全边对于最终答案推理是因果冗余的。 3. TGComplete在保持EM（精准匹配）分数不变的情况下，显著提升了补全边的精度（15-21%）和严格可信度。
AI.conclusion: 文本可验证性并不等同于知识图谱补全的正确性。作者提出将任务重点从“判断边是否正确”转向“在来源不确定性下决定是否采纳”，并提出TGComplete框架，通过牺牲部分召回率实现更高的边精度和可追溯性。

title: ATHENA: Accelerated Multi-Task Heterogeneous Influence Functions for Robot Data Curation
summary: In robot imitation learning, influence functions provide a principled approach to quantify each demonstration's effect on robot task outcomes, yet scaling them to billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is limited by computational and multitask bottlenecks. To this end, we propose ATHENA, an influence function framework tailored for multitask VLA data curation at a billion-parameter scale. Concretely, it leverages the Kronecker structure of linear-layer gradients to reduce projection cost, and approximates dense Hessian inversion with a rank-r Random Truncated Approximation, achieving about a 313.4x speedup in influence computation. Furthermore, ATHENA formulates global and local interactive influence to balance data curation across 50 jointly trained tasks. Extensive evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-robot deployment, covering 9.34 and 6.90 hours of demonstrations, respectively, show that ATHENA matches or exceeds full-data joint fine-tuning using only 50% of demonstrations in simulation and 66.7% of data across six real-robot tasks. Overall, ATHENA demonstrates its effectiveness for data curation in billion-parameter multitask VLA fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ATHENA是一个针对大规模VLA模型的高效影响函数框架，通过数学近似手段大幅降低了计算成本，实现了高效的多任务数据筛选。
AI.motivation: 现有影响函数在计算大规模（十亿参数级）视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，面临计算成本高昂和无法有效处理多任务数据筛选的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出ATHENA框架：1. 利用线性层梯度的Kronecker结构降低投影成本；2. 使用秩为r的随机截断近似（Random Truncated Approximation）来逼近稠密Hessian矩阵的逆；3. 构建全局和局部交互影响评估机制来平衡多任务数据筛选。
AI.result: 相比传统方法，ATHENA实现了约313.4倍的计算加速；在RoboTwin 2.0仿真和真实机器人部署任务中，仅使用50%-66.7%的训练数据即可达到或超越全量数据微调的效果。
AI.conclusion: ATHENA是一个高效的影响函数框架，能够显著提高在大规模多任务VLA模型数据筛选中的效率，在大幅减少数据量的同时保持甚至超越了全面微调的性能，证实了数据质量对于大模型微调的重要性。

title: SciOrch: Learning to Orchestrate Expert LLMs for Solving Frontier Multimodal Scientific Reasoning Tasks
summary: Frontier scientific reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), where even the strongest commercial systems fall short of expert-level performance. A closer look at model behavior reveals substantial complementarity that single-model evaluation hides: different frontier models excel on different question types, and no single model captures the full picture. We present SciOrch, a framework that trains a lightweight 8B model to orchestrate frontier LLMs for scientific reasoning. The orchestrator decomposes each question, delegates sub-problems to selected commercial models through API calls, and synthesizes a final answer. Training such an orchestrator is fundamentally harder than conventional agentic RL: each action triggers an API call that is expensive in both dollar cost and latency, making standard online rollouts infeasible. We address this with MCTS-based approach, producing diverse orchestration trajectories, extracting per-node single-turn samples, and optimizing the orchestrator with GRPO-style training. On a 240-question test set spanning SGI-Reasoning and Scientists' First Exam, SciOrch reaches 56.66% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest single commercial model by 3.74% and the strongest multi-agent baseline by 3.33%. It also attains the best accuracy on both SGI and SFE with less than half the API cost of typical multi-agent methods.

AI.tldr: SciOrch 是一种轻量级调度架构，通过强化学习训练 8B 模型协调调用多个顶级 LLM 解决复杂的科研推理问题，实现了性能与成本的双重最优化。
AI.motivation: 当前顶级大语言模型在 frontier（前沿）科学推理任务上仍未达到专家水平，且不同模型在不同类型问题上表现出互补性，现有的单一模型评估掩盖了这种潜力。
AI.method: 提出 SciOrch 框架，利用轻量级 8B 模型作为调度器，通过将问题解耦、委派子任务给不同的顶级 LLM 并合成答案。采用基于 MCTS（蒙特卡洛树搜索）的方法生成轨迹，并结合 GRPO（分组相对策略优化）进行训练，以应对昂贵的 API 调用成本问题。
AI.result: 在科学推理测试集（SGI-Reasoning 和 Scientists' First Exam）上达到 56.66% 的平均准确率，较最强单体模型提升 3.74%，较最强多智能体基准提升 3.33%，同时 API 调用成本不到传统多智能体方法的一半。
AI.conclusion: SciOrch 通过强化学习训练轻量级调度器，实现了比单一顶级模型或多智能体基准更高的科研推理准确率，同时显著降低了 API 调用开销，证明了利用各模型优势进行协同是提升模型科学推理能力的有效路径。

title: Understanding Diversity Collapse in RLVR via the Lens of Overtraining
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a key approach for enhancing the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, RLVR often suffers from \emph{diversity collapse}: Pass@$1$ improves while high-$k$ Pass@$k$ degrades, which is viewed as a narrowing of the model's reasoning boundary. We formalize this diversity collapse through the lens of \emph{overtraining}: once a problem's contribution to the reference metric has effectively saturated, further updates no longer expand what the model can solve but still concentrate probability mass on the trajectories favored by on-policy sampling. Under a standard setup with few rollouts per problem, even a single observed success places a problem in a nearly saturated regime for high-$k$ Pass@$k$, so most updates in standard RLVR are overtraining from the boundary perspective. This perspective also suggests a reading of whether RLVR can expand the model's reasoning abilities beyond the base model: since RLVR is structurally biased against high-$k$ Pass@$k$, its aggregate decline does not by itself mean that no new reasoning gains occurred. Interventionally, restricting updates to problems with zero observed success lifts Pass@$256$ above the base model on difficult benchmarks; observationally, a non-trivial fraction of initially unsolvable problems become solvable during standard RLVR training. Building on these findings, we propose \emph{Bayesian Boundary Gating} (BBG), which redirects optimization away from overtraining by estimating each problem's marginal contribution to the reasoning boundary. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, BBG improves average Pass@$k$ across a wide range of $k$.

AI.tldr: 针对RLVR导致的推理多样性坍缩问题，本研究揭示了其本质为计算资源在饱和问题上的过拟合，并提出了BBG方法，通过量化问题的边际贡献来优化训练，显著提升了模型的整体推理能力。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型的强化学习（RLVR）训练中，往往会出现Pass@1提升但高Pass@k（如Pass@256）下降的“多样性坍缩”现象，导致模型推理边界收窄。
AI.method: 1. 归因分析：将多样性坍缩形式化为“过拟合（Overtraining）”现象；2. 干预实验：提出仅在零成功样本上进行更新的策略；3. 方法设计：提出贝叶斯边界门控（Bayesian Boundary Gating, BBG），根据问题对推理边界的边际贡献动态调整优化方向。
AI.result: 实验表明，标准RLVR中大部分更新属于“过拟合”；通过BBG方法，模型在多个推理基准测试中实现了Pass@k的综合性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RLVR存在过拟合导致的“多样性坍缩”问题，通过贝叶斯边界门控（BBG）机制评估问题的边际贡献，可以有效防止过拟合并提升大模型在不同k值下的推理性能。

title: PolyMerge: Compressing 3D Gaussian Splats with Polytope Coverings for Provably Safe Resource-Constrained Navigation
summary: Obstacle avoidance is essential for safe navigation and motion planning. Recent radiance field reconstruction methods enable object detection and modeling with high fidelity, but remain too memory- and compute-intensive for on-board perception-based path planning. To address these limitations, we propose PolyMerge to convert a large, photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model of a scene into a lightweight representation of convex polytopes whose union provably over-approximates all obstacles in the original 3DGS model. PolyMerge tunes the polytope count to trade off conservativeness and compute cost, and integrates with control barrier functions (CBFs) to plan collision-free paths. We showcase PolyMerge in simulation and hardware experiments on a Crazyflie drone, which uses PolyMerge to compute and follow safe trajectories in real time under severe onboard compute constraints, outperforming baselines in speed while guaranteeing safety. For our code and videos, visit https://athlon76.github.io/PolyMerge-website/.

AI.tldr: PolyMerge 是一种将复杂的 3D 高斯泼溅场景转化为轻量级凸多面体表示的方法，旨在解决机载环境下的实时、安全避障路径规划问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的辐射场重建方法（如 3DGS）虽然能实现高保真度建模，但计算与存储开销过大，难以满足无人机等机载感知与路径规划的实时性需求。
AI.method: 提出 PolyMerge 算法，将大规模、高保真的 3DGS 场景模型转换为一组凸多面体集合；通过凸多面体的并集对原始障碍物进行可证明的覆盖近似（over-approximation），并结合控制障碍函数（CBF）来规划无碰撞路径，同时允许调整多面体数量以平衡计算成本与保守性。
AI.result: 在仿真及 Crazyflie 无人机硬件平台上进行了实验。结果表明，PolyMerge 能够实时计算并执行安全轨迹，在严重的机载计算限制下表现优于现有基准方法，同时确保了避障安全性。
AI.conclusion: PolyMerge 成功地将高保真 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 模型转化为轻量级的凸多面体表示，在严苛的计算约束下实现了高实时性与安全性的平衡，证明了该方法在轻量化避障感知路径规划中的有效性。

title: Free Energy Heuristics: Fast-And-Frugal Cognition as Active Inference Under Uncertain Precision
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) improves large language models' performance in math and symbolic reasoning. But on planning, contested ethics, and tasks where the model cannot check itself, more reasoning makes things worse. Both effects are documented; what has been missing is a principled account of which property decides the outcome. We argue it is meta-uncertainty: how unsure the model is about the reliability of its own evidence. When that uncertainty is high, extra reasoning stops adding signal and starts manufacturing false confidence. We prove that the policy minimizing expected free energy under uncertain precision stops integrating cues after a finite number of high-validity ones when the precision prior is heavy-tailed (Theorem 2.6.1), and under a Descending Dominance condition, is sample-wise identical to take-the-best (Theorem 2.7.4). Fast-and-frugal heuristics and active inference are, then, two descriptions of the same computation. The prediction is that on high-meta-uncertainty items, longer CoT should degrade accuracy. We score the regime per item (simulate-and-recover rho > 0.96), build FEH-79, a benchmark of Knightian frames with matched controls, and run a pre-registered study across seven models (five open-weight 3B-32B, two frontier), five CoT lengths, and 7,875 responses. The gate, fixed before any data, required a negative interaction with posterior probability above 0.95 and an accuracy drop of more than 6 points. It held. The high-regime drop is 17.3 points (95% CI [7.7, 25.5]); matched items with definite answers show no cost. The effect is regime-dependent: decisive in capable mid-to-large models, directional in the two frontier systems, absent-to-reversed in the weakest. The framework answers when CoT helps and unifies the Bayesian and fast-and-frugal traditions: less-is-more effects are evidence about the meta-uncertainty regime, not against Bayesian cognition.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现思维链（CoT）并非总是有效。当模型对自身推理依据的可靠性存在高度“元不确定性”时，过度推理会诱发虚假信心，导致性能恶化。研究通过理论证明和实证数据统一了“快与省”启发法与贝叶斯推理，提出了判断CoT有效性的元不确定性框架。
AI.motivation: 虽然思维链（CoT）在数学和符号推理中提升了性能，但在规划、伦理争论等不确定性高或模型无法自我校验的任务中，过多的推理反而会导致性能下降。目前缺乏对为何CoT有时起负面作用的理论解释。
AI.method:
1. 理论推导：证明了在精确度先验分布呈重尾分布或满足“下降支配条件”时，最优策略倾向于在有限步骤后停止推理；
2. 基准构建：创建了FEH-79基准测试，包含Knightian框架（高度不确定性问题）及其对照组；
3. 实证研究：在7种模型、5种CoT长度上进行预注册研究（共7,875条响应），通过模拟分析评估元不确定性（simulate-and-recover rho > 0.96）。
AI.result:
1. 在高元不确定性任务中，更长的CoT导致精度下降（平均下降17.3个百分点），而对照组无此成本；
2. 该效应与模型能力相关：中大型模型表现明显，前沿模型表现为定向性影响，弱模型则不明显或相反；
3. 验证了该效应符合理论预测（固定准则下，高精度证据后停止推理）。
AI.conclusion: “少即是多”（less-is-more）效应并非反驳贝叶斯认知，而是反映了模型对自身证据可靠性的元不确定性。当元不确定性高时，额外推理会产生错误的信心。研究统一了贝叶斯决策与“快与省”（fast-and-frugal）启发式算法。

title: Bayesian 3D Steerable CNNs: Enabling Equivariance and Uncertainty Quantification Simultaneously
summary: Steerable convolutional neural networks (Steerable-CNNs) guarantee SE(3)-equivariance by parameterizing kernels as linear combinations of steerable basis functions, but their deterministic nature precludes uncertainty quantification - limiting their use in settings where confidence estimates are essential. We propose a Bayesian Steerable-CNN that places posterior distributions over the basis coefficients, yielding stochastic kernels while preserving equivariance exactly. The loss function of the model is obtained via variational inference and minimized by Bayes-by-Backpropagation. The framework admits a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric components. Empirically, the model attains competitive classification accuracy alongside an expected calibration error of 0.0263 and outperforms its deterministic counterpart by up to 6.17% under distributional shift induced by additive Gaussian noise. Furthermore, we leverage the model's uncertainty estimates to enhance its performance significantly, achieving a notable gain - approximately 4% higher accuracy across 84% of the test dataset. A statistically significant negative correlation between epistemic uncertainty and prediction error confirms that the learned posterior variance is semantically meaningful. The framework unifies Bayesian uncertainty quantification with the inductive bias of equivariant CNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯可控CNN，通过对基函数系数进行变分推断，在保持精确SE(3)等变性的前提下，不仅提供了语义上有意义的不确定性量化，还显著提升了模型在噪声环境下的鲁棒性和预测效能。
AI.motivation: 现有的可控CNN（Steerable-CNNs）虽具有SE(3)等变性，但本质上是确定性的，缺乏不确定性量化能力，难以满足对置信度估计有要求的应用场景。
AI.method: 提出了一种贝叶斯可控卷积神经网络（Bayesian Steerable-CNN），通过对基函数系数施加后验分布实现随机核，并利用变分推断（Variational Inference）及Bayes-by-Backpropagation进行模型训练，从而实现对预测不确定性（认知不确定性与偶然不确定性）的分解。
AI.result: 该模型在保持竞争性分类准确率的同时，实现了较低的期望校准误差（ECE为0.0263）；在处理分布偏移（添加高斯噪声）时，性能优于确定性模型近6.17%；利用不确定性估计过滤可显著提升预测准确性（在84%的数据集上准确率提升约4%），且认知不确定性与预测误差呈显著负相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将贝叶斯不确定性量化与群等变CNN的归纳偏置相结合，提供了一种在保留SE(3)等变性的同时实现可靠不确定性估计的有效方法。

title: TopoRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human hand-object demonstrations provide dense reference motions for training dexterous manipulation reinforcement learning (RL) policies through reference tracking. However, to use such demonstrations for RL policy learning, retargeting must preserve hand pose and task-relevant hand-object contact structure. Otherwise, contact and feasibility artifacts can degrade downstream RL policy performance. We introduce TopoRetarget, an interaction-preserving retargeting framework that uses a single set of parameters across diverse retargeting conditions while maintaining task-relevant hand-object interaction and adapting human demonstrations to dexterous robot hands. The method constructs a sparse interaction graph over hand and object keypoints and optimizes distance-weighted Laplacian deformation with directional consistency, kinematic constraints, and penetration handling. Evaluations show that the generated references improve both interaction fidelity and policy learning: TopoRetarget achieves the best contact precision and alignment over all baselines on the ContactPose Dataset, improves Pen-Spin training success by 40.6 percentage points over the existing baseline methods, and enables zero-shot transfer to Wuji Hand hardware on cube reorientation and pen spinning.
