AI.tldr: TopoRetarget 是一种交互保持型动作重定向框架，通过交互图优化提升了人手动作到机器人灵巧手的重定向质量，显著增强了强化学习策略的训练效果与跨硬件迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的动作重定向方法在处理手-物交互时，难以同时保持手部姿态和任务相关的接触结构，导致重定向后的动作存在伪影，进而影响强化学习策略的训练效果。
AI.method: 提出了 TopoRetarget 框架，通过构建手部和物体关键点的稀疏交互图，利用距离加权的拉普拉斯变形，结合方向一致性、运动学约束和穿透处理，实现动作的重定向。
AI.result: 在 ContactPose 数据集上表现最优；在 Pen-Spin 任务中将训练成功率提升了 40.6 个百分点；实现了向 Wuji Hand 硬件的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: TopoRetarget 是一种有效的动作重定向框架，通过保持交互拓扑结构，能够显著提升机器人灵巧手进行强化学习时的性能，并支持跨平台的零样本迁移。

title: Koshur Diacritizer: A Byte-Level Sequence-to-Sequence Model for Kashmiri Diacritic Restoration
summary: Kashmiri, an Indo-Aryan language written in a modified Perso-Arabic script, frequently omits diacritic marks in digital text, creating ambiguity and challenging downstream NLP applications. We present Koshur Diacritizer, a ByT5-small byte-level sequence-to-sequence model for restoring diacritics in Kashmiri text. To support this task, we release a publicly available dataset of 23.7k aligned undiacritized diacritized Kashmiri sentence pairs. The proposed framework combines script-aware normalization, alignment validation, and skeleton-preserving inference to ensure reliable restoration while maintaining the original base-letter sequence. Experimental results on a held-out test set achieve a DERm of 0.2012 and a WER of 0.2159. Additionally, evaluation by a native Kashmiri linguistic expert yields a mean accuracy of 77.5%. The dataset, model, and source code are publicly released to provide a reproducible baseline for Kashmiri diacritic restoration and future low-resource language research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Koshur Diacritizer，这是一个基于 ByT5 的克什米尔语变音符号还原模型，通过发布数据集和框架解决了由于符号缺失导致的文本歧义问题。
AI.motivation: 克什米尔语在数字文本中常省略变音符号，导致语义歧义，阻碍了下游 NLP 任务的应用。
AI.method: 基于 ByT5-small 的字节级序列到序列（byte-level seq2seq）模型；采用了脚本感知归一化、对齐验证及保持骨架的推理策略。
AI.result: 在测试集上取得 0.2012 的 DERm 和 0.2159 的 WER；经母语专家评估，平均准确率为 77.5%。同时也发布了 2.37 万对已对齐的数据集。
AI.conclusion: Koshur Diacritizer 在克什米尔语声调还原任务上展现了有效性，为该语言及其他低资源语言的相关研究奠定了基准。

title: Model Stealing Through the Lens of Model Multiplicity
summary: Model stealing attacks, where adversaries create high-fidelity surrogate models, are a significant threat to the intellectual property of machine learning services. Conventional wisdom suggests these surrogates could provide adversaries with economic leverage comparable to the original service providers. This paper challenges this assumption by evaluating model stealing attacks beyond mere fidelity to the target model. Because query-based extraction provides only partial supervision of the target's input-output behavior, the surrogate is not uniquely identified: many near-optimal surrogates can achieve comparable fidelity while differing in deployment-relevant properties. Instead of performing a classic learning-based model stealing attack, we compute the Rashomon Set (i.e., the set of almost-equally-accurate models) of surrogate models, and evaluate its diversity using multiplicity metrics (ambiguity, discrepancy, and Rashomon Capacity) and group fairness metrics. Across tabular, medical imaging, and NLP tasks, our experiments on real-world datasets reveal that despite exhibiting similar fidelity to the target model, surrogate models can display significant variances in other critical performance metrics. These findings cast doubt on the presumed equivalence between high-fidelity surrogates and the target model in practical deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析“Rashomon集”发现，模型窃取攻击产生的替代模型虽然能模仿目标模型的高保真度，但在关键的部署指标（如公平性）上存在广泛差异，从而质疑了高保真度即代表攻击成功的传统假设。
AI.motivation: 挑战关于模型窃取攻击的传统观点（即高保真度替代模型具有与原始模型相当的经济杠杆作用），探索在查询受限情况下，由于模型的不唯一性，替代模型是否真的与目标模型表现一致。
AI.method: 研究者并未采用传统的基于学习的窃取攻击，而是通过计算“Rashomon集”（即所有几乎等准确度的模型集合），利用多重性指标（歧义性、差异性和Rashomon容量）以及群体公平性指标，评估了替代模型在多种任务（表格、医学影像、NLP）中的表现多样性。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管多个替代模型对目标模型的保真度相似，但它们在关键性能指标（如公平性）上表现出巨大差异。因此，单一高保真度并不保证替代模型在实际应用中具有与原始模型相同的影响力。
AI.conclusion: 在实践中，高保真度的替代模型并不等同于目标模型。由于机器学习模型的“Rashomon效应”（即多个不同模型可达到相似的预测精度），替代模型在部署相关的关键指标（如公平性）上可能与原始模型存在显著差异，这意味着仅仅依靠“保真度”来衡量模型窃取攻击的危害具有局限性。

title: Is Your Trajectory Displacement Safe in Long-tail?
summary: Long-tail scenarios remain a major bottleneck for autonomous driving evaluation, even as datasets grow by orders of magnitude. Existing evaluation pipelines are rarely human-aligned, safety-aware, verifiable, and explainable at the same time: closed-loop metrics often saturate among strong planners, while unstructured human ratings can be noisy without a carefully designed protocol. We formulate planning evaluation as additional-threat detection: given a planner trajectory and an expert reference, does the planner's displacement introduce new unsafe driving behavior? We propose FluidTest, an evaluation pipeline with three components: a pairwise WebUI protocol for reliable human annotation; a taxonomy of 32 semantic threats with evidence-grounded decision graphs; and a three-agent verification system with reflection for precision and auditability. Experiments on the WOD-E2E dataset show that FluidTest produces consistent labels among trained annotators and identifies additional threats in 65% of Poutine trajectories and 51% of RAP trajectories. These results show that state-of-the-art planners can still exhibit substantial safety-relevant failures despite high Rater Feedback Scores (RFS) and low Average Displacement Error (ADE). Additional details, guidance, and code are available at https://fluidtest.web.app.

AI.tldr: FluidTest 是一种针对自动驾驶规划器的评估框架，通过引入人工标注协议、语义威胁分类和多智能体验证，有效发现了现有指标难以捕捉的长尾安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动驾驶规划评价体系在长尾场景中存在不足，指标容易饱和或缺乏可解释性，同时由于缺乏人机对齐和安全感知能力，导致难以发现高质量规划器在特定长尾情况下的安全失效。
AI.method: 提出 FluidTest 框架：1) 基于成对比较的 WebUI 协议用于获取可靠人工标注；2) 构建包含 32 类语义威胁的分类学及证据导向决策图；3) 引入具备反思机制的三智能体验证系统，确保标注的精度与可审计性。
AI.result: 在 WOD-E2E 数据集上的实验显示，即使在 ADE 低、RFS 高的场景下，FluidTest 仍能识别出 Poutine 和 RAP 规划器中分别高达 65% 和 51% 的潜在额外安全威胁。
AI.conclusion: FluidTest 证明了现有的自动驾驶规划评价指标（如ADE和RFS）存在局限性，无法有效捕捉长尾场景下的安全风险。该框架通过结合人工评估、威胁分类学和多智能体验证，能更精确识别规划器隐藏的安全隐患。

title: Neuron Level Analysis of Large Language Model in Legal Domain Reasoning
summary: We presented a neuron-level analysis of legal-domain reasoning in LLMs, comparing it with other applied domain tasks across seven open-weight models. Using neuron attribution scores to rank and suppress influential neurons, we confirmed that suppressing the identified neurons collapses accuracy on the target task, whereas suppressing the same number of random neurons does not. We further found a small subset of neurons influential across all seven tasks; once these are removed, suppressing the remaining neurons degrades only the task they were identified from, revealing genuinely task-specific neurons in every model studied. Within the legal domain, the three benchmarks exhibit relatively high neuron overlap and tend to be affected jointly, suggesting of legal components neurons that span jurisdictions. The distribution of identified neurons in our experiments suggests that the hypothesis that influential neurons are concentrated in middle MLP layers may depend on the input format and content, rather than being a universal phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过神经元归因分析发现，LLM在法律推理中存在特定的组件神经元，且关键神经元的位置和分布高度依赖于任务内容，挑战了“关键神经元集中在中间MLP层”的普遍性观点。
AI.motivation: 旨在深入理解大语言模型（LLM）在特定领域（如法律领域）进行推理的神经元级机制，解决关于关键神经元定位的通用性假设验证问题。
AI.method: 使用了神经元归因分值（Neuron Attribution Scores）对影响模型预测的关键神经元进行排序和抑制实验，并对比了七个不同开源权重模型在多个任务下的神经元重叠情况。
AI.result: 抑制关键神经元会导致任务准确率崩溃；识别出了跨任务的通用神经元以及特定于任务的专属神经元；法律领域内部的基准测试显示出高度的神经元重叠。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了法律领域推理任务中存在具有跨司法管辖区通用性的法律组件神经元，并指出神经元分布特征受输入格式和内容的影响，而非仅限于中间MLP层。

title: Towards Data-Efficient Cross-Device Generalization of Grad-Shafranov Equilibria via Transfer Learning Neural Operator
summary: Real-time reconstruction of magnetohydrodynamic equilibria is essential for plasma shaping, stability assessment and feedback control in magnetic confinement fusion. However, Grad-Shafranov equilibrium calculations remain largely device-specific and iterative, limiting their use in latency-constrained control settings. Existing neural approaches can accelerate individual equilibrium predictions, but they do not generally provide reusable models across changing plasma boundaries or tokamak geometries. Here we show that equilibrium reconstruction can be recast as a cross-device operator learning problem. We develop a domain-specific neural operator framework that maps geometry and profile parameters directly to the poloidal flux field, replacing repeated solve-on-demand computation with amortized operator inference. Using the analytically tractable Solov'ev family as a controlled Grad-Shafranov testbed, we generate equilibria across eight geometrically distinct tokamak-like configurations and benchmark five neural operator architectures under four transfer-learning strategies. Single-geometry pretraining gives poor transfer to unseen devices, whereas multi-geometry pretraining enables data-efficient adaptation. The Wavelet Neural Operator gives the strongest cross-geometry performance, reaching mean relative L2 errors below 4% with 100 labelled target equilibria and below 2% with full fine-tuning. The predicted magnetic fields satisfy the divergence-free constraint to numerical precision, and four architectures achieve millisecond or sub-millisecond inference. These results identify neural operator pretraining as a route towards reusable, real-time equilibrium inference across fusion device configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经算子的通用框架，实现了磁流体动力学平衡的实时推理；通过跨几何构型的预训练，模型不仅能实现毫秒级快速计算，还展现了优异的跨设备迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的Grad-Shafranov平衡计算方法具有高度设备依赖性且计算量大，难以满足磁约束核聚变中实时控制的延迟需求；现有的深度学习方案缺乏跨装置的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种领域特定的神经算子框架，将平衡重构建模为跨装置的算子学习问题；利用Solov'ev解析解生成八种不同几何构型的基准数据集，对比了五种神经网络架构和四种迁移学习策略。
AI.result: Wavelet Neural Operator (WNO)表现最优，在仅需100个目标样本的情况下相对L2误差低于4%，充分微调后低于2%；模型推理速度达到毫秒级甚至亚毫秒级，且能满足物理上的无散度约束。
AI.conclusion: 神经算子预训练是实现跨不同托卡马克装置的通用、实时磁流体动力学平衡重构的可行路径。

title: ART-Glove: Articulated Tactile Glove for Contact-Grounded Dexterous Interaction Capture
summary: We present ART-Glove, an articulated tactile glove designed to capture contact-grounded dexterous demonstrations while preserving human dexterity. ART-Glove makes hand-side contact geometry explicit with 16 rigid functional surfaces covering the fingers, thumb, and palm. Twenty-two anatomically aligned joints connect these surfaces and allow them to follow human hand motion during dexterous manipulation. Encoder-based sensing tracks surface motion, while dense piezoresistive tactile sensing records contact over the same surfaces. The complete system captures synchronized 22-DoF joint measurements and 2048-taxel tactile measurements at 120 Hz. We evaluate ART-Glove across experiments on motion freedom, joint sensing, tactile sensing, and contact-rich interaction capture, demonstrating its ability to preserve human dexterity while recording contact-grounded information that can support downstream dexterous robot learning.

AI.tldr: ART-Glove 是一款新型铰链式触觉手套，通过 22 自由度关节和高密度触觉阵列，在保持人类手部灵活性的同时，实现了高精度的运动与接触信息同步采集，为机器人灵巧操作学习提供了高质量数据。
AI.motivation: 现有的手套设备在记录人类灵巧操作演示时，往往在“保留人类灵活性”与“获取精确接触信息”之间难以平衡，限制了机器人灵巧操作学习的数据质量。
AI.method: 设计了一款具备 22 个解剖学对齐关节的铰链式触觉手套，通过 16 个刚性功能表面覆盖手部关键部位；结合编码器进行运动追踪，利用高密度压阻式传感器进行触觉记录，实现 22-DoF 运动与 2048 触觉阵列的 120Hz 同步采集。
AI.result: 实验验证了该装置在运动自由度、关节传感精度、触觉灵敏度以及复杂接触交互捕捉方面的出色表现，能够有效支持机器人灵巧手学习下游任务。
AI.conclusion: ART-Glove 成功实现了一种高通透性、高自由度的手部传感解决方案，为获取高质量、具身接触信息的机器人灵巧操作学习提供了新型数据采集范式。

title: BALTO: Balanced Token-Level Policy Optimization for Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle to deploying large language models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive settings, where generated responses must be faithfully grounded in provided evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising direction for hallucination mitigation, but response-level faithfulness rewards suffer from a granularity mismatch: localized hallucinations can cause supported content to receive spurious penalties. Although recent work introduces fine-grained feedback such as claim-level verification and token-level rewards, unbalanced credit assignment can still induce length, verbosity, or optimization-noise biases. We propose BALTO, a Balanced Token-level Policy Optimization framework for hallucination mitigation. BALTO extracts checkable factual claims, verifies them against the reference context, and projects claim-level judgments to token-level labels. A balanced token-level credit assignment mechanism is introduced into the framework. This design redistributes probability mass from unsupported content toward faithful content, rather than suppressing the entire response. We systematically analyze the limitations of response-level rewards from a theoretical standpoint, and prove BALTO's advantages in training stability and optimization efficiency for hallucination mitigation. Experiments on ConFiQA, RAGTruth, and FinLLM-Eval show that BALTO achieves the highest faithfulness across all six model--benchmark settings and consistently outperforms existing post-training baselines in Q-Score, demonstrating a stronger faithfulness--informativeness trade-off.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型幻觉问题，BALTO 通过引入平衡的令牌级信用分配策略，克服了传统 RL 奖励机制的粒度 mismatch 和信用偏差，在保持信息量的同时显著提升了生成内容的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在知识密集型场景下存在幻觉；现有的基于响应级的强化学习奖励机制存在粒度不匹配问题，而细粒度的信用分配往往因不平衡导致偏见（如长度、冗余或优化噪声）。
AI.method: 提出 BALTO 框架：1) 提取可验证事实陈述并与参考上下文对比；2) 将陈述级判断映射为令牌级标签；3) 引入平衡的令牌级信用分配机制，将概率权重从不支持的内容重分配至忠实内容。
AI.result: 在 ConFiQA、RAGTruth 和 FinLLM-Eval 三个基准测试中，BALTO 在所有六个模型配置下均达到了最高的忠实度，并且在 Q-Score 指标上优于现有基准方法，实现了更好的忠实度与信息量平衡。
AI.conclusion: BALTO 框架通过平衡的令牌级信用分配机制，有效解决了强化学习在减少大模型幻觉时的粒度不匹配和信用分配不均问题，在保持信息量的同时显著提升了生成的忠实度。

title: Greedy Coordinate Diffusion: Effective and Semantically Coherent Adversarial Attacks via Diffusion Guidance
summary: Fine-tuning aligned language models on benign tasks (e.g. math tutoring) systematically breaks safety guardrails, even when training data contains no harmful content. While mechanistic approaches have shed light on where alignment resides in model weights, they do not by provide a general formal framework for deriving guarantees about when fine-tuning degrades it -- leaving the field without principled tools for predicting or preventing alignment collapse. We develop a local geometric framework through geometric analysis of parameter-space trajectories and apply it to understand the fragility of alignment in fine-tuning. While first-order analysis suggests orthogonal updates are safe, we prove this is illusory: the curvature of the fine-tuning loss induces second-order acceleration that can induce second-order drift into alignment-sensitive regions. We formalize a construct of our framework as the Alignment Instability Condition (AIC), three geometric properties that, when present, are sufficient to guarantee degradation. Our main result proves quartic onset of alignment degradation along gradient-flow trajectories, determined by how sharply alignment depends on specific parameters and how strongly tasks couple to these parameters. These findings yield formal sufficient conditions under which static first-order protection can fail under gradient descent. We further empirically validate the framework's foundations, showing that the Fisher Information Matrix provides a proxy for the degree of safety degradation across diverse fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 微调语言模型时，由于参数空间的几何曲率导致二阶效应，即便任务良性也会导致安全对齐失效；研究提出了AIC框架来预测及理解这一现象。
AI.motivation: 微调对齐语言模型时，即使是良性任务也会系统性地破坏安全护栏，但目前缺乏关于“何时微调会导致对齐崩溃”的通用形式化框架和预测工具。
AI.method: 构建了一个局部几何框架，通过参数空间轨迹分析fine-tuning过程；利用二阶导数分析取代传统的线性（一阶）近似； formalize 了对齐不稳定性条件（AIC）；并结合费舍尔信息矩阵（Fisher Information Matrix）进行实证验证。
AI.result: 证明了对齐退化的四次项触发机制，揭示了一阶分析的局限性；确定了对齐退化的充分几何条件；实证显示FIM可以有效预测不同微调任务中的安全退化程度。
AI.conclusion: 提出并验证了对齐不稳定性条件（AIC），证明了训练损失的曲率引起的二阶效应会导致对齐的退化，即使任务本身是良性的。费舍尔信息矩阵（FIM）被证实是衡量对齐退化程度的有效代理指标。

title: SemGeoNav:A Safety-Guided Visual Navigation Approach with Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Planning
comment: The paper has been accepted by ICGNC 2026
summary: Learning-based visual navigation has enhanced semantic goal-reaching capabilities. However, due to their black-box nature, purely end-to-end models often lack explicit geometric constraints, leading to unpredictable and unreliable obstacle avoidance in open environments. Conversely, traditional geometric planners ensure safety but struggle with high-dimensional visual targets. To address these limitations, we propose SemGeoNav, a novel hierarchical visual navigation framework.It tightly integrates the high-level semantic reasoning of end-to-end models with the reliable local planning ability of geometry-based methods, achieving robust image-based navigation while significantly improving obstacle avoidance. Furthermore, we introduce a temporal trajectory smoothing mechanism to ensure continuous and stable robot motion. We evaluated SemGeoNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot in real-world environments. The results demonstrate that SemGeoNav outperforms existing representative methods, including ViNT and NoMaD, achieving higher success rates and shorter navigation times.

AI.tldr: SemGeoNav是一种结合语义推理与几何规划的分层视觉导航框架，通过引入轨迹平滑机制，解决了传统端到端模型避障不可控的问题，并在真实世界机器人平台上实现了更稳健、高效的导航表现。
AI.motivation: 纯端到端模型缺乏几何约束，导致避障不可靠；而传统几何规划方法难以处理高维视觉目标。需要一种既具备语义理解能力又具备安全避障能力的导航方案。
AI.method: 提出了名为SemGeoNav的分层视觉导航框架：将端到端的语义推理与基于几何的局部规划相结合，并引入了时间轨迹平滑机制以保证运动的稳定性。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2四足机器人上的真实环境实验表明，该方法在导航成功率和耗时方面均优于ViNT和NoMaD等主流方法。
AI.conclusion: SemGeoNav通过结合语义推理与几何规控的优势，在真实环境的移动机器人导航中，展现出了比纯端到端模型更优越的成功率、效率及避障可靠性。

title: Control-Plane Placement Shapes Forgetting: An Architectural Study of Agent Memory Across Thirteen System Configurations
comment: 23 pages including appendices. Code, benchmark, and adapters released under MIT at https://github.com/deeplethe/lethe
summary:
Where an LLM sits in an agent memory pipeline -- between the recall plane that retrieves stored facts (extensively benchmarked) and the control plane that mutates them via supersede, release, purge (largely untested) -- shapes which forgetting failure modes the system recovers. Comparing thirteen system configurations on a 385-case adversarial surface, we observe three placement regimes with partly complementary coverage: deterministic primitives suffice for lexical/temporal categories but fail canonicalization (5% on identifier-obfuscation, 0% on cross-lingual); inscribe-time LLM recovers canonicalization (100%) but cannot help intent-aware deletion (0% on prefix-collision and compound-fact); a mutation-time hook recovers intent-aware deletion (78-85%) and brightens nearly all categories simultaneously (91.7-93.2% overall, $0.17 per 385-case run, 2.3s/case mutation latency vs. 64-191ms/case deterministic, recall path unchanged).
  We expose the trade-off via ForgetEval, a 1000-case templated suite plus a 385-case adversarial layer (132 hand-crafted + 253 LLM-drafted oracle-validated) scored by deterministic substring match, paired with a six-method Adapter Protocol with honest N/A scoring that lets heterogeneous memory stores enter in 130 lines. Admission is corroborated by 10-annotator IAA (Fleiss' kappa = 0.958) and a 77-case external-authored subset (four blind contributors) that replicates the canonicalization asymmetry and amplifies the joint-placement lift (+27.8 pt). Production failures are predominantly forgetting failures rather than recall failures, yet existing benchmarks measure only recall. ForgetEval and all adapters are released under MIT.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大模型代理的遗忘失效主要源于控制策略缺陷。通过新开发的评估框架ForgetEval，证实了在内存变更（突变）阶段引入LLM钩子是解决复杂遗忘任务的最优方案。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型代理研究主要关注“召回”性能，而忽视了对代理内存进行有效控制（如覆盖、释放、清除）引起的“遗忘”失败模式。需要一种评估和优化代理内存遗忘机制的方法。
AI.method: 提出了ForgetEval评估基准（包含1000个模板案例及385个对抗性案例），并设计了6种不同策略的适配器协议（Adapter Protocol）进行对比实验；分析了三种放置方案（确定性原语、写入时LLM、突变时钩子）在不同遗忘分类下的表现。
AI.result: 在385个对抗性测试案例中，突变时（mutation-time）钩子表现最优，总体覆盖率达到91.7%-93.2%；而纯确定性原语在处理跨语言等复杂逻辑时表现较差（0%），写入时LLM则无法解决意图敏感的删除问题。
AI.conclusion: 当前代理系统中的遗忘失败主要源于控制平面失效而非召回失效。通过在突变时（mutation-time）部署LLM钩子，系统能在保持低延迟和经济性的前提下，实现对意图感知删除及其他各类遗忘任务的高效覆盖。

title: A Bifurcation Theory Framework for Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability
summary: The Edge of Stability (EoS) phenomenon, where gradient descent operates with sharpness exceeding the classical convergence threshold yet the loss decreases over long timescales, is ubiquitous in modern deep learning but remains poorly understood in realistic settings. Prior rigorous analyses have been largely confined to scalar or low-dimensional losses with specific structural forms. In this work, we develop a bifurcation theory framework for gradient descent on the edge of stability that applies directly to overparameterized neural networks. By decomposing the training dynamics into components normal and tangent to the manifold of minimizers, we show that stable EoS training arises from a flip bifurcation in the normal direction, governed by the sign of the first Lyapunov coefficient, while the tangent dynamics drift toward regions of decreasing sharpness. Under mild spectral and geometric assumptions on the loss landscape, we prove convergence to the minimizing manifold when training at the EoS threshold. As a corollary, we recover and unify prior results: we show that the product-stability condition of Gan (2026) is an instance of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文为深度学习中的“稳定边缘”（EoS）现象提供了一个基于分岔理论的通用分析框架，解释了过参数化神经网络在超阈值步长下如何通过翻转分岔实现稳定收敛。
AI.motivation: 为了在实际的高维过参数化神经网络设置中解释“稳定边缘”（Edge of Stability, EoS）现象（即梯度下降在超过经典收敛阈值的情况下，损失函数仍能长期下降）。
AI.method: 利用分岔理论（bifurcation theory）分析梯度下降动力学，将训练过程分解为损失最小化流形（manifold of minimizers）的法向与切向分量。
AI.result: 证明了训练稳定性源于法向的翻转分岔，同时切向动力学向更低锐度方向偏移；在温和的谱和几何假设下，证明了EoS训练会收敛至最小化流形。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过分岔理论证明了在EoS训练下神经网络的收敛性，统一了现有理论，并揭示了稳定EoS训练归因于法向的翻转分岔（flip bifurcation）。

title: An Augmented Reality Brain-Robot Interface for Generalist Robot Arm Manipulation
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN)
summary: The integration of augmented reality (AR) and EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offers a promising path for enabling intuitive control of robots for assistive purposes. However, existing AR brain-robot interface (BRI) systems are often constrained to task-specific structures, limiting their utility in real-world environments. We present an AR BRI designed for generalist robot arm manipulation that combines gaze-based object selection with motor imagery action control. Our system uses eye-tracking for intuitive object targeting and context-aware visual overlays ("Place" and "Use") to guide the user through tasks within a shared autonomy framework. We evaluated the interface through a feasibility study with 18 healthy participants performing three multi-step activities of daily living: drinking, using a drawer, and operating an oven. Our results demonstrate that this interaction paradigm enables effective sequential task execution and high user engagement, achieving a "Good" usability rating (SUS > 70). These findings support the feasibility of the proposed interaction paradigm for complex BCI-driven robotic assistance, and motivate future evaluation with the intended target population. Project website: https://ar-bri-manip.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合AR、眼动追踪与脑电信号（EEG）的通用机器人手臂控制系统，通过视觉引导和共享自主框架，使用户能够通过意念和注视点直观且高效地完成复杂的多步日常任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的增强现实（AR）脑机接口（BRI）系统往往局限于特定任务结构，难以适应现实世界的多变环境。因此，研究旨在开发一种支持通用机器人臂操控的AR BRI系统，以提升辅助机器人的实用性与灵活性。
AI.method: 提出了一种联合系统：利用眼动追踪（Eye-tracking）进行直观的物体选择，结合运动想象（Motor Imagery）进行动作指令控制，并通过共享自主（Shared Autonomy）框架和任务上下文视觉引导（"Place"和"Use"）辅助用户完成多步日常活动任务。
AI.result: 通过18名健康参与者进行的喝水、使用抽屉和操作烤箱三项日常任务测试显示，该系统能够有效实现任务序列化执行，用户参与度高，系统可用性评分（SUS）超过70分（评级为“良好”）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了结合眼动追踪与运动想象（Motor Imagery）的AR脑机接口系统在执行复杂日常任务中的可行性，展现了其在通用辅助机器人控制领域的应用潜力，并为后续针对目标群体（残障人士）的测试奠定了基础。

title: Calibrated Triage, Not Autonomy: Confidence Estimation for Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: A vision-language model can answer a question about a medical image fluently and confidently while barely using the image, leaning instead on language priors. In medicine this is the failure that matters most, because the answer looks trustworthy and is not, and the only protection is a confidence score reliable enough to tell the system when to abstain. We ask a deployment question rather than an accuracy one: how much imaging work a model can safely handle alone, and which confidence signal makes that possible. We evaluate seven confidence estimators across five open-weight LVLMs and three medical visual-question-answering datasets spanning broad clinical imaging, radiology, and pathology, with every probe trained only on natural images and applied without adaptation. Recast as bounded selective prediction (automate a case only when confidence clears a threshold, defer the rest), the comparison is cautionary. The standard metrics are poor guides: discrimination barely separates the methods, and the weak calibration of a cheap self-report is cheaply removed by off-domain temperature scaling without changing deployable yield. What distinguishes a usable estimator is the high-confidence region a clinician acts on: the weakest baselines are confidently wrong on 41 to 45 percent of their errors against 1 to 4 percent for the best probe, and no estimator is reliably best across domains or models. Safe handoff is governed at two levels: base-model competence sets a ceiling, so a well-calibrated score recovers roughly a third of radiology cases at a 20 percent error tolerance but almost none of pathology; the confidence layer then decides how much of that ceiling is reachable. The usable role today is calibrated triage, not autonomy: automate the cases a calibrated score marks safe, route the rest to a clinician. We release all outputs, correctness judgments, and confidence scores, with code.

AI.tldr: LVLM在医疗任务中容易过度依赖语言先验产生幻觉；现有的置信度估计器在医疗安全性上表现不稳定，因此LVLM目前仅适用于校准后的辅助分诊，而非全自动化诊断。
AI.motivation: 医疗LVLM存在严重倾向于依赖语言先验而非图像内容的现象，导致模型可能给出听起来可信但事实错误的回答。研究旨在解决如何通过可靠的置信度信号确定模型何时应当“弃权”（abstain），从而在临床上安全地部署自动化分诊。
AI.method: 评估了5个开放权重LVLM在3个医疗数据集上的表现，测试了7种置信度估计器。通过将任务转化为“有界选择性预测”（Bounded Selective Prediction）问题，对比模型在设定错误容忍度（如20%错误率）下的可自动化覆盖范围（Deployable Yield）。
AI.result: 研究发现，常用置信度指标（如Discrimination或简单的自我报告）在预测准确性方面表现糟糕；最佳方法能将“自信的错误”占比从41%-45%降低至1%-4%；模型的能力存在上限（放射学任务表现好于病理学）；没有一种单一估计器能在所有领域或模型中始终表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 当前通用视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在医疗场景下尚不具备完全自主能力。最现实且安全的应用角色是“校准后的分诊”，即通过可靠的置信度评估，仅自动处理极少量的安全案例，其余必须转交给医生。

title: Distilling Drifting Transformers with Representation Autoencoders
summary: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) have improved diffusion and flow models by semantically richer latent space owing to the strongly label-wise clustered DINO features in the pretrained encoders. Yet in the distillation stage, the severe anisotropy and large curvatures caused by the rich semantic representations would hinder the convergence and performance, making the trajectory-based distillation unstable. In this work, we argue that the RAE latent space is compatible with distillation via the newly proposed Drifting Models. We first quantitatively study the curvatures and isotropy statistics across different autoencoders, and theoretically reveal that Drifting Model itself is highly likely to fail on extremely scattered spaces like reconstruction-based VAEs. These motivate us to apply the drifting paradigm directly to representation autoencoders. Our proposed method, Drift-RAE, distills pretrained flow models in RAE latent spaces using Drifting, together with insightful modifications that improve training stability by thereotically aligning drifting fields with other frameworks. Regarding the experimental evidences, we achieve 1.77 FID on ImageNet 256 dataset using only 10k distillation steps, surpassing state-of-the-art RAE distillation methods and appearing comparative with the original Drifting Model without requiring an auxiliary MAE feature extractor. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 针对RAE潜空间蒸馏不稳定的问题，本文提出Drift-RAE，通过对齐Drifting场实现了快速、高效且稳定的流模型蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 尽管RAE因其丰富的语义特征提升了扩散/流模型性能，但其内在的各向异性（anisotropy）和大曲率（large curvatures）导致轨迹蒸馏过程不稳定且难以收敛。
AI.method: 提出Drift-RAE方法：在RAE潜空间进行流模型蒸馏，并通过理论分析与调整，实现Drifting场与其他框架的对齐，以提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256数据集上，仅需10k步蒸馏即可达到1.77 FID，优于现有的RAE蒸馏方法，且无需额外的MAE特征提取器。
AI.conclusion: Drift-RAE通过引入Drifting机制，有效解决了RAE在蒸馏过程中的不稳定性问题，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，证明了RAE潜空间与Drifting范式的兼容性。

title: V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
summary: Achieving autonomous robotic dexterous manipulation requires precise, human-like action sequences at scale. As a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data, extracting trajectories with both visual fidelity and physical plausibility from monocular videos represents a promising frontier in embodied AI. To this end, we introduce V2P-Manip, an efficient framework designed to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from human demonstration videos. We establish an efficient, integrated pipeline encompassing 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and dexterous policy learning. To bridge the gap between visual perception and physical constraints, we introduce a two-stage refinement process to enforce spatial alignment and physical consistency. Evaluations on the TACO and OakInk benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods in pose accuracy, adaptability to unstructured environments, and training efficiency. Ultimately, experimental results confirm an average success rate of over 75% across multiple synthetic manipulation tasks and validate the adaptability of the extracted manipulation priors across diverse dexterous hand embodiments.

AI.tldr: V2P-Manip框架通过从单目视频中高效提取并精炼物理一致的轨迹，实现了机器人灵巧操作任务的高效策略学习。
AI.motivation: 针对机器人灵巧操作缺乏大规模高质量数据的问题，旨在无需昂贵的人类遥操作的情况下，从单目视频中提取兼具视觉逼真度与物理合理性的轨迹，以支持灵巧操作策略的学习。
AI.method: 构建了集3D资产获取、轨迹估计和灵巧策略学习于一体的完整流水线，并引入了“两阶段精细化（two-stage refinement）”过程，以确保轨迹的视觉对齐与物理一致性。
AI.result: 在TACO和OakInk基准测试中，表现优于现有模型；在合成操作任务中平均成功率超过75%，并验证了该方法对不同灵巧手形态的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: V2P-Manip通过两阶段优化有效弥补了视觉感知与物理约束之间的鸿沟，在多种灵巧手形态上实现了高效的策略迁移，为利用单目视频数据进行大规模灵巧操作学习提供了可行方案。

title: Training and Evaluating Diffusion Policies with Long Context Lengths
summary: Imitation learning has enabled highly-dexterous robotic manipulation from RGB observations. Policies trained with these methods, however, typically condition robot actions on only a short history of observations. These policies cannot solve tasks that require memory and can get stuck repeatedly executing the same failing motions. In this work, we first benchmark policy performance as context length is incrementally increased from short to long, across a spectrum of tasks with varying local stability and memory requirements, and in multiple data regimes. To our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate context length in imitation learning at this level of detail. Our results challenge prior claims: naively scaling context length is not as brittle as advertised in literature. With an appropriate conditioning method and denoising backbone (UNet+Cross-Attention), single-task policies achieve high success rates on many tasks in the usual data regime even with naive scaling. Next, we propose a training algorithm to jointly train policies at multiple context lengths, further reducing the sample complexity of long-context learning. Finally, we apply our findings to re-evaluate some previously proposed solutions to long-context imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究重新评估并挑战了模仿学习中“长上下文扩展脆弱”的既有观点，证明通过合适的模型架构（UNet+交叉注意力）和联合多上下文训练策略，可以高效实现长记忆任务的鲁棒控制。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习策略通常仅依赖短时间观测，导致无法解决需要长期记忆的任务，且在失败时容易陷入循环执行失败动作的困境。此外，关于长上下文学习是否脆弱的问题在学术界尚存在争议。
AI.method: 1. 对不同任务、不同数据规模下上下文长度（从短到长）的性能进行基准测试；2. 采用 UNet 加交叉注意力（Cross-Attention）作为去噪主干网络；3. 提出一种联合训练多上下文长度策略的训练算法。
AI.result: 研究表明适当的上下文建模方法可以显著提升模型表现，且证明了 naive 扩展上下文长度的可行性，同时多上下文联合训练进一步降低了样本需求。
AI.conclusion: 单纯增加上下文长度并非文献中所述的那样脆弱。通过适当的建模方式（UNet+交叉注意力机制），可以在常规数据量下实现良好的性能。提出的多上下文长度训练算法能有效降低长上下文学习的样本复杂度。

title: Contaminated Collaboration: Measuring Gender Bias Transfer in LLM-Assisted Student Writing
summary: Gender bias in LLMs has been studied extensively in model outputs, with biased prompts shown to amplify stereotyped generations. Whether such bias propagates into text produced by humans who use these systems, however, remains underexplored. We investigate whether gender bias in an LLM writing assistant transfers into career plan essays written by students. We first verify that a gender-biased prompt induces gender-differentiated language in LLM-generated essays, while a neutral prompt does not. We then recruited participants (N = 123) in a controlled environment to write career plan essays for paired biographical profiles differing only in gender under three conditions: no AI assistance, neutral LLM assistance, or gender-biased LLM assistance. Students in the biased condition produced essays with a significantly larger agentic gap and more gender-stereotypic occupation suggestions than those in the control and neutral conditions. Our results also reveal that this bias transfer is asymmetric: agency is suppressed in female-target essays while male-target writing remains largely unaffected. Our findings highlight the risk of bias propagation in AI-assisted writing, calling for fairness-aware design in educational AI tools.

AI.tldr: 研究发现AI写作助手不仅会产出偏见内容，还会将这种性别偏见传递给使用者，使学生在撰写职业规划时对女性表现出更强的刻板印记，从而引发了对教育类AI工具公平性设计的担忧。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究多关注LLM输出结果本身的性别偏见，但鲜有研究探讨这种偏见是否会进一步通过AI辅助工具传导给人类用户，从而改变人类的创作偏好。
AI.method: 通过受控实验评估AI偏见对人类写作的影响。实验分为三个环节：首先验证LLM在偏见提示词下的输出差异；其次招募123名学生，在三种条件（无辅助、中性AI辅助、偏见AI辅助）下为不同性别的假设人物撰写职业规划；最后通过文本分析比较代理感差距（agentic gap）和职业建议的刻板印象水平。
AI.result: 在受到性别偏见AI辅助时，学生创作的作文表现出明显的性别刻板印象倾向，且偏见传递具有不对称性：即偏见倾向于压制女性目标人物的代理感，而对男性目标人物的描写则基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助写作存在明显的性别偏见传递风险，尤其是偏见会不对称地压制表现出女性目标主体的代理感（agency），这要求在教育类AI工具的设计中必须引入公平性考量。

title: Localizing Credit at the Divergence: Path-Conditioned Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns a single scalar to each rollout, leaving token-level credit assignment underspecified in long reasoning traces. On-policy self-distillation addresses this by letting the same model act as a teacher conditioned on privileged information, producing a dense per-token signal. But the common choice of a ground-truth answer is only an endpoint cue: on terse-answer tasks, the teacher falls silent at the intermediate positions where path-level guidance matters most. We propose Hindsight Self-Distillation (HSD), which conditions the teacher on a successful peer rollout drawn from the current training group. Such a peer is an exact sample from the success-conditioned policy, requiring no additional sampled rollouts. By providing a full successful continuation rather than only the final answer, the resulting credit signal concentrates at the divergence position between a failed rollout and a successful peer. Across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on math and code benchmarks, HSD obtains the best result against GRPO variants and on-policy distillation baselines, with the largest gains on terse-answer tasks such as AIME.

AI.tldr: 针对长链推理中奖励信号稀疏的问题，本文提出 HSD 方法，通过利用批次内的成功示例作为教师参考，实现了更精准、密集的逐 token 信用分配，显著提升了模型在复杂推理任务中的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习奖励仅提供最终标量结果，在长链推理中存在信用分配不足的问题；现有的自我蒸馏方法在简短答案任务中因缺乏中间步骤监督而效果受限。
AI.method: 提出“后见之明自我蒸馏”（Hindsight Self-Distillation, HSD）。核心策略是利用当前训练批次中其他成功的回合（Peer Rollout）作为教师模型参考，通过将成功路径作为条件提供给教师，实现在失败路径与成功路径发散点处的细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 模型上，HSD 在数学和代码基准测试中均取得了最优性能，特别是在如 AIME 这类简短答案的复杂推理任务中收益最为显著。
AI.conclusion: HSD 利用成功同行样本提供密集的逐 token 信用分配，有效解决了长推理任务中因缺乏中间奖励信号导致的学习效率低下问题，在数学和代码基准测试中显著优于现有方法。

title: RHO: Your Coding Agent is Secretly a Roboticist
comment: 46 pages, 9 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://rho-robotics.github.io
summary: Code-as-Policies (CaP) has shown that large language models (LLMs) can write code to solve robotics tasks by composing perception, planning, and control primitives. Recent CaP systems, however, rely on multi-turn code-generation loops at test time, which is often infeasible for real-time robot control. We introduce Robotics Harness Optimization (RHO), a novel paradigm in which tool-enabled coding agents, at training time, propose and search for interpretable, neurosymbolic multi-file policy repositories (Repositories-as-Policies) that compose these primitives rather than a single prompt, function, or file. RHO searches with reflective feedback from environment reward and execution rather than teleoperation demonstrations. It generalizes to perturbed pick-and-place settings like LIBERO-PRO, where OpenVLA scores 0.0% and $π_{0.5}$ averages 12.83%. Using the same low-level primitives, RHO reaches a 45.0% success rate, 2.5x higher than the strongest multi-turn agentic system, and 3.5x higher than $π_{0.5}$. On Robosuite, RHO sets a new state-of-the-art of 70.0%, exceeding the prior multi-turn record of 68.29% using single-turn execution with no corrective LLM code edits at deployment. When an LLM is used in the control loop, as on RAI's O3DE benchmark, RHO optimizes the deployed agent's multi-file harness of prompts, tools, and control code, improving held-out success from 23.5% to 44.3% with 20% less wall-clock time and 27% fewer tool calls.

AI.tldr: RHO 是一种机器人策略训练范式，它将“代码即策略”从实时多轮LLM交互转化为训练时对神经符号策略库的优化，从而显著提升了机器人任务执行的成功率、效率和实时性。
AI.motivation: 现有的“代码即策略”（Code-as-Policies, CaP）方法依赖于测试时的多轮代码生成循环，这导致了高延迟，难以满足机器人实时控制的需求。
AI.method: 提出 Robotics Harness Optimization (RHO)，这是一种工具增强型编码代理框架；在训练时，利用环境奖励和执行反馈进行反射式搜索，构建由多个文件组成的神经符号策略库（Repositories-as-Policies），而非单一LLM指令；在部署时，仅进行单轮执行或轻量级推理。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 任务中达到 45.0% 的成功率（超越当前基准线 3.5 倍以上）；在 Robosuite 上创下 70.0% 的新 SOTA；在 O3DE 任务中将成功率从 23.5% 提高至 44.3%，同时减少了部署时间和工具调用次数。
AI.conclusion: RHO 提出了一种在训练阶段而非测试阶段优化策略库的新范式。通过将策略表示为神经符号多文件库（Repositories-as-Policies），RHO 实现了高性能、实时控制和卓越的泛化能力，证明了通过离线搜索优化策略代码库比依赖实时多轮LLM交互更有效。

title: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
comment: Work completed in January 2026. Updating now
summary: While LLMs have substantially advanced text-to-code synthesis, many real programming tasks specify intent through visual artifacts such as screenshots, charts, documents, vector drawings, videos, and interactive states. These tasks require models to connect visual perception to executable programs, because correctness depends not only on syntax but also on layout, geometry, data semantics, editability, interaction behavior, and domain-specific constraints that apply after execution. This survey examines Multimodal Code Intelligence, covering systems that generate, edit, refine, execute, or reason with code under visually grounded inputs and outputs. We first formulate the field by the role that code plays in each task, distinguishing code as a rendered artifact, an editable symbolic structure, a scientific representation, an intermediate reasoning trace, or an executable policy or tool interface. We then organize benchmarks and methods into four domains: Graphical User Interface, Scientific Visualization, Structured Graphics, and Frontier Tasks and Frameworks. This taxonomy connects mature artifact-generation problems to emerging agentic and unified settings and allows us to compare how different tasks treat evidence of correctness. Looking ahead, we argue that future research may benefit from four verification-centered directions. Multi-signal validation can combine complementary evidence of correctness, multi-state verification can test behavior across execution trajectories, cross-task transfer testing can probe reusable visual-code skills, and verifiable agent traces can reveal whether agent actions are grounded in visual evidence. Together, these directions may move multimodal code generation from single-output imitation toward evidence-grounded executable systems.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统梳理了多模态代码智能领域，通过定义代码在多模态任务中的不同角色及分类框架，分析了当前技术瓶颈，并提出了以验证为核心的未来研究路径，旨在实现更具可靠性的视觉驱动代码生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM在代码合成方面已取得显著进展，但在处理依赖视觉输入（如截图、图表、视频等）的真实编程任务时存在局限，需要解决视觉感知与可执行程序之间的映射问题。
AI.method: 对多模态代码智能领域进行了系统性的文献综述，提出了一套基于代码角色的任务分类框架，并将基准测试与方法划分为用户界面、科学可视化、结构化图形以及前沿任务与框架四个领域。
AI.result: 构筑了多模态代码智能的分类学框架，明确了代码在不同任务中的角色，总结了当前技术的不足，并指出了提升代码生成正确性的四个验证中心方向。
AI.conclusion: 多模态代码智能（Multimodal Code Intelligence）正从单一输出模仿向证据导向的可执行系统演进。作者提出未来研究应重点关注多信号验证、多状态验证、跨任务迁移测试及可验证的智能体轨迹。

title: Is Code Better Than Language for Algorithmic Reasoning
summary: For tool-augmented language models, comparing natural-language reasoning with code-execution pipelines is difficult because the comparison changes both the intermediate representation and the execution mechanism. We separate these factors with an intermediate intervention: the model expresses its reasoning as executable code, and the language model simulates that code in context to produce an answer. On a 40-task verifiable algorithmic benchmark, deterministic code execution outperforms natural-language reasoning by +31.6pp. We observe that the intermediate intervention is not meaningfully different from natural-language reasoning (+0.15pp). These results suggest that, in our evaluated setting, changing the intermediate representation alone does not explain the tool-use advantage, providing evidence for the performance gains requiring reliable external execution. We formalize this intuition with a simple statistical decision-theoretic model that characterizes when execution dominates end-to-end risk in our disentangled trace-generation/execution regime. We validate our theory using a reconstruction intervention that leverages a proxy language model to infer natural-language reasoning traces from code representations, recovering performance comparable to the original natural-language reasoning pipeline. All experiments are at https://github.com/TerryTong-Git/ToolProj.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过解耦实验证明，工具增强模型性能的提升核心在于“外部运行代码”的可靠性，而非代码本身作为表示形式的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究难以区分工具增强语言模型性能提升是源于“代码”这一中间表示更优，还是源于“可靠执行”这一机制。因此，需要解耦这两个因素以明确工具使用的核心驱动力。
AI.method: 通过“中间干预”方法（让模型生成代码，但由模型在上下文中模拟执行以模拟自然语言推理）解耦中间表示与执行机制；利用重建干预（通过代理模型将代码回推为自然语言推理）进行验证；构建统计决策理论模型量化执行表现与风险。
AI.result: 在40项算法任务中，确定性代码执行比自然语言推理高出31.6个百分点；而模拟执行（中间干预）相较于自然语言推理仅有0.15个百分点的差异，证明表示形式的影响微乎其微。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强语言模型的性能提升主要归功于可靠的外部执行机制，而非仅仅是中间表示形式（代码或自然语言）的改变。作者通过统计决策理论模型证明了在执行风险低于端到端风险时，外部执行具有明显优势。

title: HOLO-MPPI: Multi-Scenario Motion Planning via Hierarchical Policy Optimization
summary: Robots deployed in the real world must plan motions across diverse scenarios without per-scenario retuning. End-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) can generalize across scenarios but often becomes brittle under distribution shift, reward misspecification, and stochastic interactions. Model predictive path integral (MPPI) control enables strong real-time refinement without gradients, but its performance depends on a well-shaped sampling prior, while manually designing the priors does not scale to multi-scenario deployment. We present HOLO-MPPI (High-level Offline, Low-level Online MPPI), a multi-scenario motion planning framework that combines high-level policy learning with low-level stochastic optimal control. Offline, we learn a high-level policy that proposes scenario-robust plans in an abstract action space, with a learned world model for online rollout. Online, the policy serves as a data-driven prior generator that parameterizes MPPI's sampling distribution conditioned on the current observation and goal. MPPI then optimizes low-level control sequences around this prior in real time to adapt to local disturbances. We instantiate HOLO-MPPI in autonomous driving by designing an effective high-level action space and tailored model architectures. Our evaluation across diverse driving scenarios shows that HOLO-MPPI improves upon MPPI and end-to-end RL baselines while maintaining real-time control.

AI.tldr: HOLO-MPPI 结合了高层离线策略学习（用于提供稳健动作先验）与低层在线 MPPI 优化（用于实时局部纠偏），从而解决了机器人运动规划在多场景泛化与扰动适应性之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 纯端到端强化学习在分布偏移下鲁棒性差，而传统 MPPI 严重依赖人工设计的采样先验，难以在多场景中扩展。需要一种既能利用数据驱动学习泛化能力，又能保持在线优化鲁棒性的架构。
AI.method: 提出 HOLO-MPPI 框架：离线训练策略模型生成抽象行动空间的方案作为 MPPI 的采样先验（Prior），在线利用 MPPI 在此先验基础上进行扰动优化，并结合学习到的世界模型进行前向模拟。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶多场景评估中，HOLO-MPPI 在安全性、泛化性及性能指标上均优于现有的 MPPI 和端到端 RL 方法，并满足实时控制需求。
AI.conclusion: HOLO-MPPI 通过结合高层离线策略学习和低层在线随机最优控制，成功实现了多场景下的稳健运动规划，在保持实时性的同时，超越了纯 MPPI 和端到端强化学习基线方法。

title: FinBalance: A Multi-Document Accounting Reconciliation Benchmark
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/Devansh1105/finbalance
summary: Existing financial-NLP benchmarks mostly evaluate prepared artifacts such as filings, tables, or extracted values. Real accounting begins earlier: source documents must be reconciled into cited journal entries, aggregated into a balance sheet, and checked for contradictions. We introduce FinBalance, a multi-document accounting reconciliation benchmark built from source-document bundles across eight industries, three period types, and five difficulty levels. Human-authored business scenarios, accounting policies, tax/FX treatments, document schemas, distractors, and inconsistency templates are composed by a deterministic generator whose ledger produces journal entries,balance sheets, and 23 inconsistency-code labels. On a 710-record evaluation split, six contemporary LLMs reach at most 46% exact final-balance-sheet accuracy. Four models show a 26-41 pp gap between BS_exact, the model's reported balance sheet, and BS_recon, the balance sheet obtained by replaying its entries through our ledger. Models often recover numerically plausible entries but fail to bind them to supporting documents and aggregate them consistently. Citation-pressure prompting barely changes document-linking errors, while ledger-feedback ablations substantially improve reported balance sheets and expose inconsistency-detection trade-offs. Expert finance reviewers validate the benchmark design and labels.

AI.tldr: FinBalance是一个针对会计核对全流程的多文档基准，旨在评估模型从原始凭证生成一致性会计报表的能力；评估显示当前LLM普遍难以应对此类复杂的财务逻辑推导。
AI.motivation: 现有金融NLP基准多关注已整理好的数据，缺乏对会计全流程（从原始凭证到核对、汇总、一致性检验）的评估能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含八个行业、三种周期类型和五种难度等级的FinBalance基准；开发了一个确定性生成器，利用业务场景、会计准则和干扰项生成多文档数据，并自动生成凭证、资产负债表及23种不一致性标签。
AI.result: 在710条记录的评估集中，主流LLM的资产负债表最终准确率最高仅为46%；模型在从凭证到账目的逻辑一致性上表现出严重问题，即报告的报表与其实际记账逻辑存在巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有的LLM在处理复杂的会计核对任务时仍存在显著的逻辑推理和一致性能力瓶颈，难以准确执行从原始凭证到资产负债表的全流程会计处理。

title: MoECa: Aligning Feature Reuse with Expert Decomposition in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (DiT-MoE) improve model capacity under sparse activation, but diffusion inference is still bottlenecked by redundant computation across timesteps. Existing caching methods mainly operate at the token level, which becomes suboptimal in DiT-MoE because each token update is internally decomposed into multiple routed expert branches. Our analysis shows that cross-timestep redundancy in DiT-MoE is better characterized at the expert-branch level than at the whole-token level. Based on this observation, we propose MoECa, a fine-grained caching framework that performs branch-level feature reuse across timesteps. MoECa further introduces expert-aware adaptive control and synchronized cache updates across MoE and attention paths to maintain stable intermediate states. Experiments on multiple DiT-MoE models show that MoECa consistently achieves a better speed-quality trade-off than prior caching methods, with up to 2.83$\times$ inference speedup and minimal quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 针对 DiT-MoE 扩散模型推理中的跨时间步冗余，提出 MoECa 缓存框架，通过细粒度的专家分支级别特征重用，在大幅提升推理速度的同时保持了高质量生成。
AI.motivation: DiT-MoE 虽提升了模型容量，但推理仍受限于时间步间的冗余计算。传统 Token 级别缓存方法在内部路由架构下变得次优，未能有效利用专家分支间的冗余特征。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 MoECa 的细粒度缓存框架：1. 专家分支级重用：将缓存粒度从 Token 级别细化到专家分支级别；2. 专家感知自适应控制：动态管理缓存；3. 同步缓存更新：协调 MoE 与注意力路径的状态，确保生成的稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个 DiT-MoE 模型上实验表明，MoECa 实现了高达 2.83 倍的推理加速，且仅伴随极小的生成质量下降。
AI.conclusion: MoECa 通过在专家分支层面进行细粒度缓存，有效地解决了 DiT-MoE 模型在扩散推理过程中的跨时间步冗余计算问题，实现了显著的加速且保持了高质量。

title: Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
summary: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch,insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.Project page:http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出了SAI方法，通过一种分阶段、非对称的模仿学习课程，使机器人能学习在无需同步操作演示或直接通信的情况下，高效完成复杂的物理协作任务。
AI.motivation: 协作式移动操作中，协作失败常源于机器人间动作时序（等待、让步、牵引等）失调，而非单机技能不足。传统的协作策略学习依赖复杂的同步演示或显式通信，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出了“序列非对称模仿”（Sequential Asymmetric Imitation, SAI）：1. 机器人A通过与人类协作的单边演示进行训练；2. 机器人B在部署好的机器人A策略基础上进行训练；3. 通过针对协作失败点的稀疏干预对机器人A进行精调。
AI.result: 在真实世界的双臂移动操作任务中，SAI在任务成功率、阶段同步性和协作让步方面均优于独立模仿及消融基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过序列化模仿课程学习可实现机器人间的物理协作，无需同步的多人演示或显式通信即可解决协作中的时序与交互冲突问题。

title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers an effective approach for large language models to access external knowledge. However, existing methods rely on dense similarity retrieval and face inherent limitations in handling structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning. Incorporating knowledge graphs partially alleviates these issues, but at the cost of semantic fragmentation, high maintenance overhead, and difficult incremental updates. This paper introduces SAG (SQLRetrieval Augmented Generation), a structured architecture for retrieval and agent systems. Instead of pre-building a global static graph, SAG converts each chunk into one semantically complete event and a set of indexing entities, then uses SQL join queries to dynamically link events that share entities into local hyperedges,constructing, at query time, a dynamically instantiated local index structure. This design avoids the need for global graph rebuilding and ongoing maintenance; the system naturally supports incremental writes, concurrent processing, and continuous scaling through its reliance on standard database infrastructure. Across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHop, and MuSiQue, three standard multi-hop benchmarks,SAG achieves the best results on 8 out of 9 Recall@K metrics, reaching 80.0% Recall@5 on MuSiQue, the benchmark with the highest multi-hop reasoning demands.SAG has also been deployed at a production scale of hundreds of millions of data items, with online retrieval latency kept within seconds. Project site and code are available at https://github.com/Zleap-AI/SAG-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: SAG提出了一种基于SQL的动态检索架构，无需预构建复杂的图谱，通过查询时的动态SQL联结实现多跳推理，在性能、扩展性和维护性上均优于现有的集成知识图谱的RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在处理结构化查询和多跳推理时表现欠佳；引入知识图谱虽能缓解问题，但存在语义碎片化、维护成本高及增量更新困难等痛点。
AI.method: 提出了SAG (SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation) 架构。核心思想是将文档块转换为“完整事件+索引实体”，并将这些实体存储在SQL数据库中；在查询时，利用SQL JOIN操作动态构建即时的局部超图，以支持多跳逻辑推理和关系检索。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHop和MuSiQue三个多跳推理基准测试中，SAG在9项指标中拿下了8项第一；在MuSiQue基准上实现了80.0%的Recall@5；并在处理亿级数据规模的生产环境中保持了秒级检索延迟。
AI.conclusion: SAG通过引入动态SQL联结查询代替静态全局图结构，有效解决了RAG在多跳推理和实时更新方面的瓶颈，为大规模、高性能的知识检索提供了可行方案。

title: Re-feeding Is Not Replaying: Measuring Replay Noise in Counterfactual Token-Credit Estimation
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Code, per-pivot data, logs, and registration: https://github.com/thaw-ai/thaw (benchmarks/, paper/refeed-drift/)
summary: Per-token counterfactual credit estimation asks which token in a language-model rollout caused the final answer to be right or wrong: cut the transcript at a pivot, substitute an alternative token, replay continuations, and compare outcomes. Published methods re-feed the transcript prefix as a fresh prompt, assuming this reproduces the state the model passed through during generation. We measure what that assumption costs on a stock inference engine, with a three-pass design: continuations resumed from the verified decode-time KV state, an identical second exact pass (a replica noise floor), and a re-feed pass. Across six configurations and three models (including a GRPO-trained checkpoint), at low-margin decision tokens, re-feeding changes the credit estimate at rates 14-28 percentage points above the replica floor (7-21pp under a treatment-independent conditioning; problem-clustered t = 2.9-6.4). Most changes are zero-boundary crossings of the quantized estimator rather than polarity reversals, and the perturbation is consistent with mean-zero, so averaged quantities are largely safe; but selection is not: a critical-token set chosen by thresholding $|\hat{A}_t|$ under re-feed overlaps the exact-resume selection at Jaccard 0.34-0.90, versus a 0.63-0.96 replica ceiling. A causal confirmation closes the loop: under vLLM's batch-invariant kernels all three passes are identical on every measured channel, with both disagreement rates exactly zero. Replica passes themselves disagree on 9-23% of eligible estimates: single-sample credit measurements at decision tokens are unreliable under any replay. Settings were fixed in advance; exact-pass cache hits in the second campaign are instrumented (100% hit rate, 3,434 pivots); total compute was under 10 USD. We recommend that counterfactual credit studies resume decoder state or use batch-invariant kernels, and report a replica floor.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了现有反事实信用估计中“重新填充前缀”方法的局限性，证明其会导致不准确的Token归因。研究建议采用恢复KV状态或使用批处理不变内核来提高归因科学性。
AI.motivation: 现有的每Token反事实信用估计方法通常采用“重新填充前缀”（re-feed）来模拟模型状态，但这种假设在实际推理引擎中是否成立且精确尚不明确，存在潜在的测量偏差。
AI.method: 通过三步实验设计（从验证的解码时间KV状态恢复、精确重复、重新填充）对比观察模型行为；在vLLM批处理不变内核下进行因果验证；检查量化估计器在不同方法下的差异及重叠度（Jaccard相似度）。
AI.result: 在低边际决策Token上，重新填充导致信用估计偏离程度显著；虽然平均量基本安全，但对单个“关键Token”的选择与真实恢复状态相比差异巨大（Jaccard系数较低）；此外，单一采样测量本身存在不确定性（9-23%的重复率差异）。
AI.conclusion: 重新填充（Re-feeding）方法存在偏差，导致对关键Token的归因选择不准确。作者建议在进行反事实信用估计时，应直接恢复解码器状态或使用批处理不变内核（batch-invariant kernels），并报告参考底线（replica floor）。

title: HATS: A Human-Agent Teleoperation System for Multi-Arm Data Collection
summary: Many real-world manipulation scenarios, such as handling complex collaborative tasks and dealing with large workspaces, require coordination of more than two robotic arms. Consequently, an effective multi-arm teleoperation system is required to collect demonstrations for training coordinated multi-arm manipulation policies. However, existing teleoperation frameworks mainly focus on single-operator or multi-operator setups, facing a practical trade-off between the cognitive load placed on a single operator and the coordination cost incurred by multiple operators. To address this problem, we introduce HATS, a human-agent teleoperation system that enables a single human operator, assisted by an MLLM-based agent, to collect data for multi-arm manipulation tasks. Our system decouples the control space: two primary arms are directly teleoperated by the human, while two assistive arms are controlled by a training-free agent that handles sub-tasks. In addition, the human operator can use voice commands to prevent collisions and correct assistive arm behaviors during execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HATS achieves data collection efficiency and success rates comparable to expert dual-human teams. Moreover, downstream policy evaluations demonstrate the efficacy and quality of the data collected through HATS.

AI.tldr: HATS 是一种人机协作遥操作系统，通过 MLLM 辅助让单名操作者即可完成多机械臂任务的数据采集，解决了多操作者协作的复杂性，并保持了高数据质量。
AI.motivation: 解决现有机器人多臂遥操作架构在“单人操作者认知负荷”与“多人协作的通讯/调度成本”之间的权衡矛盾，旨在实现高效、高质量的多臂操纵任务数据采集。
AI.method: 提出 HATS 系统：采用“人-代理（Human-Agent）”协同模式。将控制空间解耦，由单个人类操作员直接控制两台主机械臂，利用基于多模态大模型（MLLM）的智能体控制辅助机械臂执行子任务；并引入语音指令机制用于实时纠偏与防碰撞。
AI.result: 实验表明，HATS 的数据采集效率和成功率与双人类专家团队相当；下游任务评估证实了所采集数据的有效性和高质量。
AI.conclusion: HATS 成功展示了单人操作员在 MLLM 辅助下即可高效进行多机械臂任务的数据采集，其表现与双人协作专家团队相当，且采集的数据能有效提升下游策略的性能。

title: Formalize Once, Edit the Rest: Efficient Lean-Based Answer Selection for Math Reasoning
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure. Code available at https://github.com/ucr-rai/base-and-edit
summary: With large language models (LLMs) increasingly applied to mathematical reasoning, formal proof assistants such as Lean can be leveraged to verify reasoning outputs with machine-checkable rigor, enabling use cases such as answer selection in test-time scaling with K sampled candidate answers. However, employing Lean requires that LLM outputs, originally in natural language, first be formalized. Existing Lean-based answer-selection work uses an autoformalization model to generate a formal statement in Lean for each candidate answer independently, incurring a significant computational cost. We propose BASE, a base-and-edit pipeline that formalizes a single base candidate per problem and derives the remaining K-1 statements by editing the answer expression in place. To facilitate this, we train a rewriter model LEANSCRIBE to localize the answer in the base formalization and generate a reusable edit function for the other K-1 candidates. BASE simultaneously improves selection accuracy and reduces formalization cost - a Pareto improvement that holds on all 12 (dataset, solver) configurations across four benchmarks and three solvers, cutting autoformalizer calls by about 5x at K=8, with the reduction expected to become larger as K grows. Code is available at https://github.com/ucr-rai/base-and-edit.

AI.tldr: BASE是一个创新的数学推理验证框架，通过复用单一基础形式化结果并进行局部编辑，在大幅降低Lean形式化计算成本的同时，提升了LLM数学答案的选择精度。
AI.motivation: 现有利用Lean辅助验证LLM数学推理的方法中，对每个候选答案独立进行自动形式化存在高昂的计算成本，限制了测试时扩展（Test-time scaling）的应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种“基础与编辑”（Base-and-Edit）流水线，通过训练名为LEANSCRIBE的重写模型：首先对每个问题仅进行一次基准形式化，随后通过定位并编辑答案表达式来衍生其余K-1个候选答案的形式化表达，无需对每个答案单独调用自动形式化模型。
AI.result: 在4个基准测试和3个求解器上的12种配置中均实现了帕累托改进；在K=8时，自动形式化模型的调用次数降低了约5倍。
AI.conclusion: BASE是一种能够实现帕累托改进的框架，在提升数学推理答案选择准确性的同时，显著降低了自动形式化（Autoformalization）的计算开销。随着候选答案数量K的增加，该方法的效率优势愈发明显。

title: Surprise-Guided MergeSort: Budget-Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Ranking via Adaptive Comparison Scheduling
summary: Pairwise comparison is the gold standard for subjective ranking tasks; however, exhaustive annotation requires a massive number of human comparisons ($O(n^2)$). While sorting-based methods have reduced this burden to $O(n\log n)$, they still require expensive human judgment for every single comparison. To further improve annotation efficiency, we propose leveraging a Vision-Language Model (VLM) not as an annotator replacement, but as a \emph{question prioritizer} to identify which comparisons genuinely require human judgment. The proposed \textbf{Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS)} framework achieves this through three integrated components: (1) a bottom-up MergeSort scheduler that structures comparisons and exploits transitivity, (2) a composite Surprise Scorer -- combining position-bias-cancelled VLM confidence, Elo gap, and vote entropy -- to quantify comparison ambiguity, and (3) an adaptive budget allocator that routes high-surprise pairs to humans while automating low-surprise pairs via transitivity inference. Validation was conducted on six diverse benchmarks spanning text similarity (STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS) and image quality assessment (KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge). SGS effectively identified and skipped up to 535 non-informative comparisons per session. Consequently, it achieved Kendall's $τ{\times}100$ improvements of $+6$ to $+12$ over Active Elo under the same total budget. These results demonstrate that combining VLM-guided surprise metrics with algorithmic sorting provides a generally consistent accuracy-efficiency trade-off across diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SGS的框架，利用VLM量化比较的“惊喜度”，由模型自动处理低难度比较，人类仅处理高难度比较，在保持主观排序任务准确性的前提下显著降低了人工成本。
AI.motivation: 成对比较是主观排序的黄金标准，但传统方法（$O(n^2)$）和排序优化方法（$O(n \log n)$）成本过高；需减轻人类标注负担并提高效率。
AI.method: 提出了“惊喜引导归并排序（SGS）”框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于归并排序的调度器以利用传递性；(2) 综合“惊喜评分器”（结合去偏差VLM置信度、Elo分差和投票熵）以量化比较的不确定性；(3) 自适应预算分配器，将高不确定性比较留给人类，自动处理低不确定性比较。
AI.result: 在六个文本相似度和图像质量评估基准上，SGS每轮最多可跳过535个非必要比较，且在同等预算下，Kendall's $\tau \times 100$ 较 Active Elo 提升了 +6 至 +12。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉语言模型（VLM）作为“问题优先级排序器”而非完全替代人工，结合算法排序和主动学习策略，能够显著提升主观排序任务的标注效率和准确性，在不同领域展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: APEX: Adaptive Policy Execution for Precise Manipulation
summary: Modern imitation learning methods, including visuomotor and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, typically output high-level action references that are executed by low-level controllers. However, the absence of higher-order reference signals, together with the policy's lack of awareness of the underlying low-level control dynamics during training, inevitably induces an execution gap. As a result, realized actions deviate systematically from policy-commanded ones, with a critical impact on precision-sensitive manipulation. Prior work either modifies the policy architecture or the low-level controller, both requiring intrusive changes to the pretrained policy or packaged controller. This raises a natural question: when the policy and controller are both treated as inaccessible black boxes, can we bridge the execution gap? We propose Adaptive Policy Execution (APEX), a plug-and-play framework inserted between the policy and the controller that reconstructs a dynamically feasible reference from policy outputs and adapts at test-time according to low-level state feedback, with a provable convergence guarantee. Extensive empirical studies show that APEX reduces controller-induced tracking error by 41.2% on demonstration replay and improves manipulation success by 4.8--25.8 percentage points across four visuomotor and VLA policy classes.

AI.tldr: 针对模仿学习中策略输出与低层控制器执行之间存在的偏差问题，本文提出 APEX 框架，作为一种插件式解决方案，在不入侵原始模型前提下，通过在线自适应调整显著提升了机器人复杂操作的精准度。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习方法在执行时存在“执行差距”（execution gap），即策略输出的高层指令与控制器实际执行动作之间存在偏差，且现有方法修改模型结构的方式不灵活或不可行。
AI.method: 提出 APEX（Adaptive Policy Execution）框架，置于策略（Policy）与低层控制器（Controller）之间，通过实时处理策略输出，结合低层状态反馈进行动态自适应重建，实现对参考轨迹的纠偏。
AI.result: 在演示回放中将控制器引入的跟踪误差降低了 41.2%，并在四种常见的视觉动作（visuomotor）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略模型中，将操作成功率提升了 4.8 至 25.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: APEX 作为一种无需修改策略或控制器架构的插件式框架，能够显著弥合执行差距，提高机器人操作任务的精度与成功率，并具备理论上的收敛性保障。

title: A Large-Scale Multi-Dimensional Empirical Study of LLMs for Conversation Summarization
summary: Despite the significant advancement of LLMs in conversation summarization, their evaluation remains limited by insufficient scenarios, input lengths, and sample sizes. Furthermore, existing benchmarks often omit frontier reasoning systems and efficient small models, or lack fine-grained, multi-dimensional assessments. To bridge these gaps, we propose OmniCSEval, a unified benchmark comprising 1,800 diverse conversations across six real-world scenarios, featuring context lengths ranging from 128 to 32k tokens. For fine-grained evaluation, we employ a bidirectional fact-checking framework that integrates key fact matching to assess completeness and conciseness, alongside summary fact verification to evaluate faithfulness. To ensure reliable assessment, we establish a human-LLM collaborative pipeline for key fact extraction and a multi-LLM consensus verifier for summary fact decomposition. Leveraging this framework, we evaluate 28 LLMs across four distinct categories grouped by reasoning capability and model scale. Our extensive empirical study reveals critical insights regarding the cross-scenario challenges current LLMs continue to face, the impacts of reasoning and scale, and the efficiency and adaptability of reasoning models. We also provide guidance for system selection in real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: OmniCSEval是一个综合性对话摘要评估基准，通过大规模、多场景、长上下文及双向事实核查方法，系统评估了28个大模型在摘要生成中的真实表现与能力边界。
AI.motivation: 现有对话摘要评估存在场景单一、上下文短、样本少的问题，且缺乏对前沿推理模型和小参数模型的细粒度多维评估。
AI.method: 提出OmniCSEval基准测试框架，包含1800个覆盖六大场景的对话数据（上下文长度128-32k）；采用双向事实核查框架（包含关键事实匹配与摘要事实验证），并结合“人机协作+多LLM共识”的验证流程。
AI.result: 通过对28个不同类型和规模的LLM进行评估，识别出模型在处理对话摘要时的局限性，特别是在推理能力和效率方面的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前大模型在对话摘要任务中面临的跨场景挑战，确立了模型推理能力与规模对摘要质量的影响，并为实际部署中的模型选型提供了指导建议。

title: Conflict-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models with Mixture-of-Experts
summary: The continuous scaling of large language models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational costs, making Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) a scalable alternative for efficient fine-tuning via sparse activation. While federated learning (FL) emerges as the paradigm for privacy-preserving collaborative optimization, integrating MoE into FL under data heterogeneity may trigger conflicting expert optimizations. Client-specific data distributions force same-indexed experts to optimize under inconsistent or even conflicting feature-label correlations. This mismatch induces destructive interference during aggregation, thus destabilizing the optimization trajectory and degrading model performance. To address this issue, we propose FC-MoE, a federated conflict-aware framework for MoE fine-tuning. It employs an importance aware weighting scheme to prioritize reliable local updates and utilizes gradient consensus projection to suppress conflicting updates, ensuring a stable global optimization path. Moreover, a local knowledge retention mechanism further preserves specialized client expertise by re-anchoring domain-specific residuals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FC-MoE accelerates convergence and enhances both global and local model performance in non-IID federated environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FC-MoE 框架，通过冲突感知机制（梯度投影、重要性权重）解决联邦 MoE 学习中的专家冲突干扰，显著优化了非 IID 场景下的模型性能与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 在大规模语言模型（LLM）背景下，MoE 虽提升了效率，但将其应用于联邦学习时，客户端数据的异构性会导致相同索引的专家出现冲突优化，引发聚合时的破坏性干扰，从而影响模型性能。
AI.method: 引入 FC-MoE 框架，包含：1. 基于重要性的加权方案以优先考虑可靠更新；2. 梯度共识投影以抑制冲突更新；3. 本地知识保留机制以锚定领域特定知识残差。
AI.result: 实验表明，FC-MoE 在非独立同分布（non-IID）的联邦学习环境中，能够加速模型收敛，并同时提升全局模型和本地模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: FC-MoE 通过重要性加权、梯度共识投影和本地知识保留机制，有效解决了联邦学习中 MoE 模型因数据异构导致的专家冲突和聚合不稳定问题，显著提升了模型性能。

title: Agile Fall Recovery for Quadrotors with Bidirectional Thrust via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous fall recovery is a critical capability for quadrotors operating in real-world environments, where collisions or failures may leave the vehicle resting on the ground in an arbitrary attitude. This problem is challenging because recovery must be achieved under limited onboard sensing, in constrained free space, with ground contact, and in the presence of unknown disturbances. In this letter, we present an RL-based framework for autonomous fall recovery of a quadrotor from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors. To address severe partial observability and intermittent sensor invalidity, we train a recurrent policy within an asymmetric actor--critic architecture, leveraging an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller to track the policy output. Combined with high-fidelity simulations of motor response and optical flow, the overall training framework significantly reduces the sim-to-real gap. Simulation ablation studies validate the importance of the main design choices, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer and robust recovery under different initial attitudes, wind disturbances, and additional payloads. These results demonstrate that agile quadrotor fall recovery can be achieved without explicit state estimation using only limited and unreliable onboard sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于强化学习和INDI控制器的四旋翼无人机自主坠落恢复框架，仅利用轻量级传感器在复杂干扰下实现实机零样本恢复。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼无人机在现实场景中易因碰撞或故障坠落，需具备在未知姿态下自主从地面恢复至稳定悬停的能力。现有方法在处理有限机载感知、受限空间、地面接触及未知干扰时面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 基于强化学习（RL）的框架，采用异步执行者-评论者（Asymmetric Actor-Critic）架构，结合递归策略（Recurrent Policy）以应对部分可观测性；使用增量非线性动态逆（INDI）控制器跟踪策略输出；在包含电机响应与光流高保真度仿真的环境中进行训练，以缩小实机差距。
AI.result: 通过消融实验验证了设计选择的有效性。真实环境实验证明了该方案在不同初始姿态、风扰和负载条件下均能实现稳健的“零样本”（zero-shot）迁移与恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在仅使用有限且不可靠的机载传感器、无需显式状态估计的情况下，四旋翼无人机可以实现敏捷的自主翻转恢复，具备良好的鲁棒性和零样本迁移能力。

title: ROMPAR: Morphological Completion and Demographic Unlearning for Romanian-Accented Speech Recognition
summary: Automated transcription of parliamentary proceedings faces significant hurdles due to demographic bias, dialectal variation, and technical artifacts such as utterance truncation during segmentation. This paper introduces the ROManian PARliamentary Speech Corpus (ROMPAR) dataset, a 17.80-hour corpus of Romanian and Moldavian parliamentary speech, featuring double-annotated ground truth and explicit labels for reconstructed word fragments. To build a robust ASR system, we propose a multi-task adversarial training framework that enforces demographic invariance across age, gender, and dialect. We address the inherent instability of adversarial objectives in generative architectures by introducing an exponential decay mechanism for the adversarial coefficients. Furthermore, we implement an LLM-guided decoding strategy with position-dependent weighting to facilitate morphological completion of truncated terminal words. Our results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly reduces WER and achieves an F1-score of 96.6% in morphological reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文针对罗马尼亚议会语音识别中的偏差与词汇截断问题，构建了ROMPAR数据集，并提出了一种结合多任务对抗训练与LLM引导解码的框架，显著提升了识别准确率与形态重建能力。
AI.motivation: 现有议会语音自动转写在人口统计学偏见、方言差异及分段过程中产生的语词截断（utterance truncation）方面效果不佳。
AI.method: 1. 构建ROMPAR数据集：包含17.8小时罗马尼亚语和摩尔多瓦语议会语音，含双重标注及词汇截断重建标签。2. 多任务对抗训练：通过指数衰减对抗系数确保年龄、性别及方言的不变性。3. LLM引导解码：利用位置依赖加权策略进行截断尾词的形态重建。
AI.result: 显著降低了词错误率（WER），并在语词形态重建任务上达到了96.6%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多任务对抗训练框架及LLM引导的解码策略有效提升了罗马尼亚议会语音识别系统的鲁棒性，特别是在处理语词截断和跨人口统计学偏差方面表现优异。

title: Formalizing and Mitigating Structural Distortion in LLM Attention for Zero-Shot Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs). However, applying LLMs to graphs requires linearizing their structure into sequences, introducing distortion rooted in the graph bandwidth problem. While this distortion has been shown to degrade performance, it is often attributed to prompt design or model scale, leaving the underlying mechanism unclear. In this work, we show \textit{how} rotary positional embeddings turn graph linearization into bandwidth-dependent attention decay, suppressing attention between graph-adjacent nodes that are forced far apart in the serialized sequence. This shifts the focus of LLM-based graph reasoning from prompt engineering and scaling toward correcting attention misalignment. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \textbf{G}raph-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{A}ttention (\textbf{GaLA}), a lightweight, inference-time modification for LLMs. GaLA biases attention toward graph-adjacent nodes while preserving the LLM's sequential inductive biases. Across TAG benchmarks, GaLA improves performance with negligible overhead, demonstrating that distortion is a correctable bottleneck in LLM-based graph reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了 LLM 处理图数据时，线性化序列中的旋转位置编码会导致邻接节点注意力衰减。作者提出了 GaLA 方法，通过修正推理时的注意力偏置，有效解决了这一错位问题并提升了图推理性能。
AI.motivation: 探讨大型语言模型（LLM）处理带属性图（TAGs）的固有缺陷：图结构的线性化序列引入了带宽限制问题；现有研究多归咎于提示词或模型规模，忽略了位置编码带来的机制性注意力错位。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：揭示了旋转位置编码（RoPE）如何导致线性化图结构中的注意力衰减。2. 算法设计：提出 GaLA（Graph-aligned Language Attention），在推理阶段通过偏置注意力机制，增强邻接节点间的交互，同时保留模型的顺序归纳偏差。
AI.result: 在多个 TAG 基准测试中，GaLA 在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下显著提升了模型在图推理任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 图表线性化导致的性能下降主要源于旋转位置编码引起的注意力衰减，而非单纯依赖提示词设计或模型规模。GaLA 是一种无需训练的轻量化修复方案，证明了注意力错位是可以通过修正解决的瓶颈。

title: ADAPT: Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training for Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humanoids deployed in human-centered environments must handle force-interactive tasks, where external contacts introduce unexpected disturbances that disrupt locomotion accuracy and stability. Existing learning-based approaches rely on broad domain randomization, task-specific force objectives, or learning-based force estimators from motion history, each of which compromises accuracy, task transferability, or out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. We present Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training (ADAPT), a framework that equips humanoid policies with a physically grounded disturbance observer. The core of ADAPT is an analytical whole-body disturbance observer that estimates residual force/torque online with the accessible robot dynamics, without requiring force/torque sensors. Fed directly into the policy, the estimated disturbances give the humanoid an explicit, physics-derived sense of external force/torque that can generalize across diverse unseen scenes. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that ADAPT achieves accurate disturbance prediction and stronger robustness than a proprioception-only baseline under torso perturbations, standing pushes, and asymmetric hand payloads, with improved velocity tracking even on OOD disturbances. Moreover, ADAPT enables penalizing inferred disturbances at lower-body joints to encourage lighter locomotion.

AI.tldr: ADAPT框架通过集成分析型物理干扰观测器，赋予人形机器人无需特殊传感器即可感知外部力的能力，大幅提升了其在交互任务中的鲁棒性与泛化表现。
AI.motivation: 人机交互场景中，外部接触带来的意外干扰会破坏人形机器人的运动精度与稳定性。现有的学习方法在准确性、任务泛化性及分布外（OOD）鲁棒性之间难以平衡，且往往过度依赖传感器或繁琐的训练策略。
AI.method: 提出ADAPT（Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training）框架。核心是引入了一个分析型全身干扰观测器，利用机器人动力学模型在线估算残余力和力矩，并将该实时估算值作为输入提供给强化学习策略，替代了传统依赖大量域随机化或基于历史运动的隐式估计方法。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人上的实验表明，ADAPT在躯干扰动、推搡及不对称负载测试中，干扰预测准确性表现优异，显著优于仅依赖本体感觉的基准模型。此外，该方法在OOD任务中表现出更好的速度跟踪性能，并能通过抑制下肢关节干扰来优化运动姿态。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT通过结合物理分析式干扰观测器与强化学习，证明了在无需外部力传感器的情况下，通过显式引入物理可解释的干扰感知，能够显著提升人形机器人在复杂动态环境下的鲁棒性和运动精度。

title: GRACE-DS: a Guarded Reward-guided Agent Correction Environment in Data Science
summary: We introduce GRACE-DS, a Guarded Reward-guided Agent Correction Environment in Data Science for pre-deployment evaluation of LLM-powered AutoML agents. GRACE-DS is a set of evaluation metrics in an isolated environment that can be applied to tabular ML tasks specific to a particular organization. It exposes agents to realistic workflow stages, from planning and data inspection through feature engineering, model development, validation, and code repair to final submission, while hidden executable validators measure not only final predictive performance but also leakage avoidance, reproducibility, protocol validity, correction behavior, and reward alignment. The strongest structured regime, flexible iterative interaction (our approach), achieves higher end-to-end normalized hidden-test quality than single-shot generation, unstructured interaction, and restart-based baselines, while also improving protocol-valid completion. Validated across more than 7,000 episodes, these results establish GRACE-DS as a robust platform for assessing the capacity of LLM-based AutoML agents to execute machine learning workflows under production-like conditions and in accordance with organization-specific requirements.

AI.tldr: GRACE-DS 是一个用于评估 LLM-AutoML 代理的受限环境，通过引入全流程监控和多维性能指标，证明了迭代交互机制在提升 AutoML 任务执行的质量与合规性方面显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM-AutoML 代理缺乏在模拟生产环境（如企业特定数据科学任务）下的系统性评估，现有的评估指标多仅关注最终预测性能，忽视了工作流中的合规性、鲁棒性及可迭代纠错能力，因此需要一个受限的、全流程的评估环境。
AI.method: 提出了基于“受限奖励引导”的评估环境，涵盖数据科学工作流的全流程（规划、特征工程、建模、验证、修复等），并引入了包含泄露检测、可复现性、协议合规性及奖励对齐在内的多维度执行验证器；采用灵活的迭代交互（Flexible Iterative Interaction）作为核心运行机制。
AI.result: 在超过 7,000 个任务剧集中通过实验证明，GRACE-DS 框架下的迭代交互方案在测试集质量和协议合规性方面均优于单次生成、非结构化交互及重启模式等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GRACE-DS 是一个针对 LLM-AutoML 代理的鲁棒性评估平台，证明了灵活的迭代交互优于单次生成或非结构化交互，且通过多维评估指标能有效衡量代理在实际生产环境中的执行能力。

title: HAPI-EP: Towards Hybrid, Adaptive, and Predictive Digital Twins of Cardiac Electrophysiology
summary: A digital twin (DT) of a patient-specific heart offers significant potential in personalized medicine. However, its rapid and dynamic adaptation to an individual's live data and its predictive capability after adaptation remains central challenges. We examine this challenge from its two building blocks: DT formulation where mechanistic and data-driven models show competing merits and limitations, and DT optimization strategies that are largely driven by a reconstruction objective leading to un-identifiable models. We address both bottlenecks via HAPI -- an AI framework for building hybrid, adaptive, and predictive DTs with three key enablers. First, HAPI constructs a physics-integrated gray-box model in which an interpretable mechanistic backbone is augmented by a neural component that models its residual to the observed data. Second, rather than attempting to pre-encode all possible variations in a static hybrid model, HAPI enables rapid on-the-fly adaptation of the hybrid model to few-shot live data, achieved by feedforward meta-learners realizing amortized inference of both mechanistic and neural parameters of the hybrid model trained with predictive objectives. Finally, we show that this adaptivity corresponds to the construction of a conditional generative model (i.e., the hybrid DT) that endows it with theoretical identifiability and thus strong performance in predictive scenarios. We demonstrate the proof-of-concept of HAPI in cardiac electrophysiology using a hybrid monodomain model with mechanistic reaction kinetics and neural graph diffusion. Across synthetic and real-data studies, we show that HAPI's mechanistic-neural hybridization and predictive adaptation are critical for obtaining identifiable DTs with strong predictive and out-of-distribution capabilities.

AI.tldr: HAPI是一个创新的患者数字孪生框架，通过整合物理机制与神经网络，并利用元学习实现快速精准的个体化数据适配，克服了传统模型在可辨识性和预测能力上的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的数字孪生（DT）模型在个体化医疗应用中面临两大困境：一是模型构建中机制模型与数据驱动模型各有利弊，无法兼顾；二是传统的以重构为目标的优化策略会导致模型不可辨识，从而削弱了其预测准确性。
AI.method: 提出一种名为HAPI的AI框架：1. 采用“物理整合灰盒模型”，即以可解释的机械模型为骨干，结合神经网络建模残差；2. 使用前馈元学习器实现模型参数的快速少样本即时自适应；3. 通过预测目标而非重构目标进行训练，从而确保模型具备理论上的可辨识性。
AI.result: 在心脏电生理学（基于混合单域模型）的合成及真实数据测试中，HAPI展现了卓越的性能，其混合架构和预测导向的自适应能力显著提升了DT的可辨识性及预测精度。
AI.conclusion: HAPI框架证明了物理机制与神经网络的混合建模以及基于预测目标的元学习适应性，是构建具有可辨识性和优异预测能力（含分布外预测）的患者数字孪生（DT）的关键。

title: Elastic ODYN: Differentiable Optimization for Infeasible Control and Learning in Robotics
summary: Robotic systems routinely encounter conflicting objectives, modeling errors, and degenerate contact conditions that render quadratic programs (QPs) infeasible. Yet most optimization solvers and differentiable QP layers assume feasibility, leading to numerical failures, unstable gradients, or solver breakdown when constraints cannot be simultaneously satisfied. We present Elastic ODYN, a primal--dual non-interior-point QP solver that handles infeasibility through smooth squared-$\ell_2$ elastic relaxations. The resulting formulation remains well posed under ill-conditioning and degeneracy, supports warm starting, and converges to closest-to-feasible solutions when no feasible point exists. A lightweight refinement stage recovers physically meaningful dual variables from the elastic solution. Building on this framework, we develop Elastic OdynLayer, a differentiable QP layer with stable gradients under infeasibility, and Elastic OdynSQP, an infeasibility-aware SQP method that resolves inconsistent subproblems and intrinsically infeasible optimal control tasks through selective constraint relaxation. We evaluate the framework on benchmark QPs, singular contact mechanics, differentiable parameter identification, and quadrupedal and humanoid trajectory optimization.
