Across all settings, Elastic ODYN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art elastic QP solvers in robustness, warm-start performance, and convergence reliability, enabling optimization, simulation, control, and learning beyond the feasibility assumptions of existing methods.

AI.tldr: Elastic ODYN 是一款能够稳健处理不可行二次规划问题的求解器，通过弹性松弛技术解决了机器人系统中常见的约束冲突和退化问题，并为可微控制和学习任务提供了稳定的梯度计算。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人优化求解器和可微 QP 层多假设问题是可行（feasible）的，但在处理存在冲突目标、建模误差和退化接触情况时常导致求解器崩溃或数值不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了一种原始-对偶非内点法（non-interior-point）QP 求解器，通过平滑的 squared-$\ell_2$ 弹性松弛技术处理不可行性；结合轻量级修正阶段恢复双重变量；并开发了可微层 Elastic OdynLayer 和顺序二次规划方法 Elastic OdynSQP。
AI.result: 在基准 QP 问题、奇异接触力学、参数辨识及四足/人形机器人轨迹优化任务中，Elastic ODYN 在鲁棒性、热启动性能和收敛可靠性方面均优于现有的前沿算法。
AI.conclusion: Elastic ODYN 提供了一种在处理不可行二次规划（QP）问题时具有鲁棒性、可微性和高效性的通用解决方案，突破了以往优化方法对可行性的依赖，在处理退化接触和复杂控制任务中表现优异。

title: Bridging the Usability Gap: Lessons from Interpreting Studies for Machine Interpreting Design
summary: Machine interpreting (MI), the live, real-time branch of speech translation, has achieved remarkable progress on standard benchmarks, with some systems approaching human parity on textual fidelity. Yet the user experience remains far inferior to interpreter-mediated communication, revealing what we term the \emph{accuracy illusion}: systems that appear accurate on paper but fail in practice to support smooth, goal-oriented interaction. This paper defines MI as a distinct subfield of speech translation, with its own characteristics and the need for evaluation methods grounded in communicative effectiveness rather than isolated fidelity metrics. Drawing on insights from interpreting studies, we identify critical dimensions of professional interpreting practice that are overlooked by current systems, and consolidate them into three interdependent design priorities for future MI: \emph{agency} (context-sensitive initiative and repair), \emph{grounding} (multimodal and discourse-level situational awareness), and \emph{experience} (adaptive improvement through real interaction). Together, these priorities chart a path toward closing the usability gap and enabling systems that can sustain authentic multilingual communication in real time.

AI.tldr: 机器同传（MI）在测试中虽表现出色，但在实际应用中因脱离真实沟通场景而面临“准确性幻觉”；研究指出应跳出静态保真度指标，转而通过关注主体性、共识性和体验感来提升机器同传的交互效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管机器同传在标准测试集上表现优异，但在实际应用中仍面临严重的“准确性幻觉”，即系统表现出的技术指标（保真度）与用户实际的交互体验和沟通效果存在显著脱节。
AI.method: 提出了将 MI 作为语音翻译的一个独立子领域，并引入口译研究（Interpreting Studies）的视角，将评估重点从孤立的忠实度指标转向沟通有效性；定义了三个核心设计优先级：主体性（Agency）、共识性（Grounding）、体验感（Experience）。
AI.result: 揭示了现有 MI 系统在应对真实沟通需求时的局限性，并为未来实现高质量、交互式机器同传提供了理论框架与核心设计导向。
AI.conclusion: 目前的机器同传（MI）评价体系存在“准确性幻觉”，即指标上的高保真度无法转化为实际交互中的有效性。未来的 MI 系统通过聚焦“主体性”、“共识性”和“体验感”三个设计维度，才能真正弥合可用性差距，实现真实的实时多语种沟通。

title: Multi-Agent Framework for Audit Risk Assessment with Explicit Uncertainty and Evidence Conflict Modeling
summary: Audit risk assessment increasingly benefits from combining heterogeneous evidence sources, yet existing approaches typically produce point predictions without quantifying how well different evidence streams agree. We propose UMAR (Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Risk Assessment), a framework that employs three specialized agents: an MD&A Text Agent, a Financial Ratio Agent, and a CAM Agent, each producing independent risk scores with calibrated uncertainty estimates. An Uncertainty Aggregator based on Dempster-Shafer evidence theory fuses these scores while explicitly measuring inter-agent conflict. We evaluate UMAR on a U.S. dataset of 3,200 firm-year observations from SEC 10-K filings (2019-2023), with financial restatement as the target label. Experimental results show that UMAR achieves an AUROC of 0.782 and a PR-AUC of 0.341, outperforming logistic regression, XGBoost, FinBERT, and single-agent and dual-agent LLM baselines. UMAR attains the lowest expected calibration error (ECE = 0.052) among all methods and identifies evidence-conflict patterns that correlate with actual restatement risk, offering auditors potentially actionable and interpretable risk signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UMAR框架，通过融合多种审计证据源并引入基于Dempster-Shafer理论的不确定性量化机制，在财务重述风险识别任务中实现了比现有模型更高的准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的审计风险评估缺乏对来自不同证据源（如文本、财务比率等）之间一致性的度量，且多为单一的点预测，难以提供可解释的决策支持。
AI.method: 提出UMAR（不确定性感知多智能体风险评估）框架，包含MD&A文本、财务比率和CAM三个独立智能体，利用Dempster-Shafer证据理论进行预测融合，并不仅生成风险评分，还通过不确定性校准量化证据间的一致性。
AI.result: 在3,200份SEC 10-K文件的测试集上，UMAR在AUROC（0.782）和PR-AUC（0.341）上均优于包括XGBoost和FinBERT在内的基准模型，且实现了最低的预期校准误差（ECE = 0.052）。
AI.conclusion: UMAR通过引入不确定性量化和跨主体冲突检测，显著提升了审计风险评估的性能与可解释性，是多源证据融合在财务审计领域的一次有效应用。

title: Automated Digital Twin Construction for Highway Scenarios Using LiDAR Point Clouds and OpenStreetMap
summary: Accurate road environment modeling is fundamental to the simulation and validation of automated driving systems. However, constructing road maps in standardized formats such as ASAM OpenDRIVE from real-world sensor data remains a time-consuming and costly process. Mobile mapping LiDAR captures accurate lane-level geometry but is confined to the driven corridor, while OpenStreetMap (OSM) provides broad road network topology but lacks geometric precision at the lane level. To address this, an automated workflow is proposed to fuse LiDAR point clouds with OSM data to generate georeferenced ASAM OpenDRIVE maps of highway environments, requiring minimal manual intervention. The pipeline reconstructs mainline roads from LiDAR-derived measurements and infers ramp geometry and topology from the OSM road graph, enabling complete highway interchange modeling without full sensor coverage. Experiments demonstrate a mean lateral RMSE of 0.740 m, and the generated maps are directly usable in mainstream simulation platforms including IPG CarMaker and Esmini. These results validate the effectiveness of combining measurement-derived geometry with map-derived topology for automated OpenDRIVE digital twin generation. The project code is available at https://github.com/ftgTUGraz/opendrive-digital-twin-generator

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动将激光雷达点云与OSM数据融合生成ASAM OpenDRIVE地图的流程，实现了低人工成本、高精度的自动驾驶高速公路场景数字孪生建模。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶仿真依赖准确的道路环境模型，但现有的手动构建OpenDRIVE格式映射过程成本高、效率低，且单一的数据源（如仅激光雷达或仅OSM）在覆盖范围与精度上存在局限。
AI.method: 提出一种自动化工作流，融合激光雷达点云（用于获取主路车道级几何细节）与OpenStreetMap数据（用于获取路网拓扑及推断匝道几何），实现地理空间坐标系下的ASAM OpenDRIVE地图生成，大幅减少人工干预。
AI.result: 生成的地图在高速公路场景中表现出良好的精度（平均横向均方根误差RMSE为0.740米），且无需完整传感器覆盖即可完成交互式路网建模，并已验证可直接集成至IPG CarMaker和Esmini等仿真软件中。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合基于激光雷达的几何精度与OSM的拓扑信息，该方法能够高效、自动化地生成适用于主流仿真平台的ASAM OpenDRIVE地图，解决了自动驾驶仿真中高精度地图制作耗时与昂贵的问题。

title: Who Flips? Self- and Cross-Model Counterarguments Reveal Answer Instability in LLMs
comment: Accepted to the non-archival workshops AI4Good and AIWILD at ICML 2026
summary: Standard accuracy benchmarks are designed to test how closely large language models (LLMs) approach correct answers, but are not suitable for testing whether LLMs stick with a correct answer when that answer is challenged by a plausible counter-argument. We introduce a controlled protocol for evaluating answer stability: after a model answers a multiple-choice question correctly, we challenge the model's answer with a coherent argument for an incorrect option and measure whether the model flips. The setup a) isolates argumentative content from overt social pressure and b) varies argument length, self-attribution, and cross-model source. Across seven frontier models and 57 MMLU subjects, flip rates range from 17.5% to 97.3%, revealing large differences in stability that are not captured by accuracy metrics alone. We find that self-attribution consistently increases flip rates (mean +7.1pp, up to +18.7pp). Also, pooling wrong-answer arguments across models and selecting the most effective one per question yields stronger adversarial challenges than relying on any single source model. We further construct MaxFlip, a curated challenge set that amplifies flips by up to +23.6pp over standard self-generated challenges. We release the protocol, challenge records, and MaxFlip to support stability evaluation alongside standard accuracy benchmarks. Materials are available at https://github.com/nafisenik/WhoFlips and https://hf.co/datasets/nafisehNik/WhoFlips.

AI.tldr: 研究指出LLM面对错误反驳时极易动摇，不仅提出了一种衡量模型回答稳定性的评估协议，还发布了MaxFlip数据集，旨在弥补现有准确率基准测试的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型（LLM）基准测试仅侧重于“准确性”，无法衡量模型在面对具有说服力的错误反驳时，是否能保持正确答案的坚定性（稳定性）。
AI.method:
1. 建立控制实验：模型先回答MMLU题目，随后注入针对错误选项的合理逻辑论证，观察模型是否改动答案。
2. 变量分析：控制论证长度、来源（自生成vs交叉模型）及自我归因（self-attribution）。
3. 构建MaxFlip挑战集：通过挑选最高效的对抗性论证来量化并放大模型的不稳定性。
AI.result:
1. 模型动摇率极高：在测试的7个前沿模型中，动摇率从17.5%到97.3%不等。
2. 干扰因素影响：自我归因会导致动摇率显著提升（平均提升7.1个百分点）。
3. 对抗策略：通过混合跨模型论证及构建MaxFlip集，能有效探测模型的脆弱性，MaxFlip比单纯的模型自生成挑战更能大幅提高动摇率（最高达+23.6pp）。
AI.conclusion: 准确率指标不足以衡量LLM在面对质疑时的表现。本研究提出的评估框架揭示了模型稳定性在不同模型间差异巨大，并证实了“自我归因”等因素会显著增加模型的动摇率（flip rates），为评估模型鲁棒性提供了新维度。

title: CIWI-CKT: Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion and Cross-City Knowledge Transfer for Traffic Flow Forecasting
summary: Accurate traffic flow prediction remains challenging in cross-city, data-scarce scenarios where limited historical data hinders model generalisation. The chaotic nature of traffic dynamics, complex spatio-temporal dependencies, and heterogeneous urban networks complicate few-shot learning across cities. Existing deep learning approaches either treat traffic as purely deterministic or lack mechanisms to model wave-like interference patterns essential for cross-regime traffic dynamics. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CIWI-CKT, a novel Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion framework with Cross-City Knowledge Transfer. Our framework introduces three core innovations: chaos-informed wave generation that extracts measurable chaos invariants and models traffic as adaptive wave components; meta-interference processing that captures wave interactions between support and query regimes while producing a predictability score for confidence estimation; and chaos-aware meta-learning that enables efficient cross-city knowledge transfer while preserving chaotic characteristics. We establish theoretical guarantees including chaos-to-wave stability, wave-induced dimension reduction, and meta-learning generalisation bounds. Extensive experiments on four real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that CIWI-CKT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art spatio-temporal graph learning, transfer learning, prompt-based, and few-shot methods, improving prediction accuracy while substantially reducing required training data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种引入混沌理论和波干涉机制的跨城市交通预测框架 CIWI-CKT，有效解决了数据匮乏场景下的少样本预测与知识迁移难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的交通流量预测模型在数据匮乏的跨城市场景下泛化能力差，且未能充分建模交通动力学中波状干涉模式和混沌特性。
AI.method: 提出 CIWI-CKT 框架，包含三个核心创新：1. 混沌感知波生成（Chaos-Informed Wave Generation）：捕获混沌不变量并构建自适应波组件；2. 元干涉处理（Meta-Interference Processing）：建模支持集与查询集间的波交互并进行置信度评估；3. 混沌感知元学习（Chaos-Aware Meta-Learning）：实现高效的跨城市知识迁移。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界交通数据集上的实验证明，该框架在精度上显著优于现有的时空图学习、迁移学习和少样本学习等前沿方法，并减少了训练数据需求。
AI.conclusion: CIWI-CKT 提供了一种通过混沌理论和波干涉模型解决跨城市少样本交通流量预测的有效方案，不仅提升了预测精度，还显著降低了对标注数据的依赖，并提供了扎实的理论保障。

title: Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller
summary: Diffusion and flow-based generative policies provide a powerful policy class for reinforcement learning by inducing rich stochastic exploration through iterative action generation. However, the stochasticity of diffusion policies is not suitable for stable and precise control in high-dimensional robotic systems, where small action variations can accumulate into inconsistent motion and reduced robustness. To address this issue, we propose SteerGenPO, a latent-space reinforcement learning framework that steers a trained generative policy into a robust deterministic robotic controller. The key idea is to replace stochastic latent sampling of the trained generative policy with a learned latent actor that predicts a state-dependent latent input for the generative policies. This separates exploration and control: stochastic generative sampling provides diverse action proposals during policy learning, while deterministic latent steering provides stable and adaptive control at deployment. We evaluate SteerGenPO on six Isaac Lab benchmarks and a Unitree G1 locomotion task. The results show SteerGenPO improves over both classical RL and generative RL baselines, while its deterministic latent steering produces more stable inference-time behaviors and more reliable command responses.

AI.tldr: SteerGenPO 旨在解决生成式强化学习策略在高维机器人控制中的随机不稳定性问题。通过学习一个确定性的潜空间映射器取代随机采样，实现既能利用生成模型的探索能力，又能确保部署时的可控性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型等生成式策略虽然在大空间提供丰富探索，但其固有的随机性导致在高维机器人控制中动作不一致，难以满足精确、稳定的部署需求。
AI.method: 提出了 SteerGenPO 框架，在潜在空间进行强化学习。核心在于用学习到的“潜在动作发生器”（Latent Actor）取代了原始生成策略中的随机潜在采样，由该 Actor 根据当前状态预测确定的潜在输入，从而实现从随机生成到确定性控制的平稳过渡。
AI.result: 在六项 Isaac Lab 基准测试和 Unitree G1 运动任务中，SteerGenPO 均优于传统的强化学习和生成式强化学习基线模型，表现出更高的运动稳定性和更可靠的指令响应。
AI.conclusion: SteerGenPO 有效地将强大的生成式策略转化为鲁棒的确定性控制器；通过分离训练时的探索（随机生成）与部署时的控制（确定性潜空间引导），成功解决了高维机器人控制中随机性带来的不稳定性问题，在复杂运动任务中展现出卓越的性能。

title: Scaling Human and G2P Supervision for Robust Phonetic Transcription
summary: Expert phonetic annotation is costly, especially for non-standard dialects and atypical speech. A common alternative is using Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) models to auto-generate phonetic labels from text transcripts at scale. We study how automatic phonetic transcription performance scales with human and G2P supervision in English. Using a curated 80-hour benchmark spanning native, non-native and post-stroke speech, we identify a supervision quality threshold: G2P supervision helps only when fewer than 20-30 hours of human annotation are available. Beyond this threshold, it provides no significant benefit and can reduce cross-dialect robustness. What is effective after this threshold is ASR pretraining which we use to achieve a 2.3x reduction in weighted phone feature error rate over prior systems, with strong gains on non-native and aphasic speech. These results suggest that quantity-driven G2P scaling may yield diminishing returns for robust generalization.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现G2P辅助标注存在“阈值效应”（约20-30小时人类标注），超过此规模后G2P不再有效且可能损害鲁棒性；此时，利用ASR预训练更能显著提升对非典型语音的转写性能。
AI.motivation: 专家级语音转写成本高昂，尤其针对方言及病理语音。研究旨在探索自动化的Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) 转写模型在不同规模人工标注补足下的性能表现，以确定规模化标注的最优策略。
AI.method: 基于一个包含80小时母语、非母语及中风后病理语音的基准数据集，对比分析了G2P自动标注与人工标注不同比例组合对音素转写性能的影响，并引入ASR预训练方法进行性能验证。
AI.result: 确定了一个监督质量阈值：当人工标注少于20-30小时时，G2P具有辅助作用；超过此阈值后，G2P不仅无明显助益，甚至会降低跨方言鲁棒性。采用ASR预训练后，加权音素特征错误率（WFER）降低了2.3倍，在非母语和失语症语音上表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 基于G2P的自动化标注在达到一定人类标注数据量后会产生边际效用递减，甚至损害模型鲁棒性。研究建议在高数据量场景下，应转而采用ASR预训练来提升发音特征标注的准确性，特别是在处理非母语和病理语音时。

title: MosaicQuant: Inlier-Outlier Disaggregation for Unified 4-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: 4-bit quantization significantly reduces the memory footprint and accelerates the inference of large language models (LLMs). However, its limited bit-width representation struggles to faithfully capture both dense common values (\emph{inliers}) and rare large-magnitude values (\emph{outliers}), causing substantial accuracy degradation. Existing mixed-precision methods mitigate this by retaining outliers in high precision, but at the cost of breaking the uniformity of low-bit execution, introducing precision conversion and extra data movement that undermine practical speedup. We propose \textbf{MosaicQuant}, a unified 4-bit LLM quantization paradigm built on a novel principle of \emph{inlier--outlier disaggregation}. Rather than elevating outlier precision, MosaicQuant quantizes the full weight matrix into a dense 4-bit base component, where inliers are captured faithfully while outlier are inevitably quantized. A sparse 4-bit residual component is then introduced to compensate for these quantization errors, selectively targeting the most error-critical weight blocks where output distortion is shown to be concentrated. However, a unified representation alone is insufficient, as naïvely executing the sparse residual as a separate kernel still breaks the unified low-bit inference pipeline. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{ZipperEngine}, which fuses sparse block computation into the dense 4-bit GEMM kernel via an overlapped pipeline, unifying not only the representation but also the execution into a single coherent low-bit inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on LLaMA3 and Qwen3 demonstrate that MosaicQuant preserves near-FP16 accuracy while achieving up to $1.24\times$ speedup over the W16A16 baseline.

AI.tldr: MosaicQuant 提出了一种在 4-bit 量化中通过“稀疏残差补偿”处理离群点误差的方案，并利用 ZipperEngine 将残差计算融合到 GPU 密集计算流水线中，在实现 LLM 高精度量化的同时保持了硬件的高效执行速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的 4-bit LLM 量化方法在处理离群点（outliers）时，通常通过提升精度（mixed-precision）来降低误差，但这会导致计算不统一及额外的内存移动，从而抵消了低比特带来的推理解析速度提升。因此，亟需一种能保持低比特统一执行流程并有效处理离群点误差的方法。
AI.method: 1. 提出 MosaicQuant：采用“内点-离群点分解”原则，将权重矩阵全量化为 dense 4-bit 基底，并引入 sparse 4-bit 残差分量来补偿关键权重的量化误差。2. 提出 ZipperEngine：设计了一种重叠执行管道，将稀疏残差计算融合进 dense 4-bit GEMM 算子中，实现了统一的低比特推理流水线。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA3 和 Qwen3 模型上的实验表明，MosaicQuant 在保持接近 FP16 精度的同时，相较于 W16A16 基线模型实现了最高 1.24 倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: MosaicQuant 通过“内点-离群点分解”策略与 ZipperEngine 算子融合技术，在不提升精度的前提下有效地弥补了 4-bit 量化带来的精度损失，在保持近 FP16 对标精度的同时，实现了显著的推理加速，提供了一种兼顾精度与计算效率的 LLM 量化新方案。

title: WaveSync: Constrained Wavefront Optimization for Synchronized Co-Speech Gestures in Humanoid Robots
summary: Expressive co-speech gestures are crucial for natural human-robot interaction, but generating them on physical humanoid robots is difficult because gesture strokes must align with speech emphasis while satisfying strict kinematic and dynamic constraints. Unlike virtual avatars, humanoid robots cannot freely execute rapid or overlapping motions, making word-level synchronization and hardware-safe motion planning a coupled problem. We present \textbf{WaveSync}, a hybrid framework in which a Large Language Model decomposes dialogue responses into structured semantic schemas and assigns per-word importance weights, constructing a continuous Semantic Importance Wave. Gesture trajectories are shaped through Dynamic Movement Primitives, enforcing kinematic feasibility while enhancing expressiveness. A Wavefront Optimization stage aligns peak-to-peak gesture-speech synchronization and resolves residual kinematic violations through gesture-duration compression and forward propagation. Experimental evaluation based on five dialogue scenarios shows that our method achieves high synchronization accuracy and outperforms three baselines in both objective and subjective evaluations. Each component in WaveSync plays a necessary role in producing gestures that are expressive, semantically grounded, and kinematically compliant. The code, resources, and videos are available at \href{https://github.com/pairs-lab/WaveSync}{WaveSync}

AI.tldr: WaveSync 是一个用于人形机器人的共语手势生成框架，它通过大模型构建语义重要性波，结合动态运动基元与波前优化，解决了手势节奏同步与硬件安全运动规划之间的耦合难题。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人生成共语手势存在两大痛点：一是手势节奏需与语音强调精准对齐，二是必须满足严苛的硬件运动学与动力学约束，且两者往往是耦合的，传统方法难以有效平衡。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为 WaveSync 的混合框架：1. 利用大语言模型（LLM）将对话分解为语义模式并生成“语义重要性波”；2. 使用动态运动基元（DMP）构建轨迹并确保运动可行性；3. 采用波前优化（Wavefront Optimization）机制实现手势与语音的精确同步，并通过持续压缩与前向传播解决运动学冲突。
AI.result: 在五种对话场景的实验中，WaveSync 在客观同步准确度以及主观听感/视觉评估方面均优于三个对比基准模型，证明了其各组件在保证手势表现力与合规性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: WaveSync 是一个有效的框架，能够成功实现人形机器人共语手势的语义同步与运动规划的耦合，在兼顾硬件安全约束的同时，显著提升了手势的表达力与准确性。

title: In-Domain Supervised Pathology Report Classification: A Reproducible Pipeline from Data Curation to Production-Matched Evaluation
summary: We introduce an in-domain supervised pipeline designed to counter the out-of-distribution performance drop that hampers supervised biomedical NLP models, a problem observed when models trained on pathology reports are moved across cancer registries. Our contribution is a reproducible recipe for training a supervised classifier from routinely collected cancer registry data. It describes how to build the in-domain training set and a production-matched holdout, and to choose operating points that keep the false-negative rate (FNR) very low while keeping reviewer workload manageable. The pipeline standardizes data curation with facility-stratified sampling and separate handling of reports linked to registry cases, and includes a blinded manual audit to estimate positive-case prevalence and label noise. On a 418k-report holdout set, the Kentucky model achieved FNR 0.003 and false-positive rate (FPR) 0.097, improving over the Seattle-trained MOSSAIC OncoID baseline (FNR 0.010, FPR 0.183) and raising F1 from 0.860 to 0.922. In a blinded manual review of 600 reports, estimated positive prevalence declined from 0.500 to 0.398, indicating substantial label noise with errors concentrated in rare primary sites.

AI.tldr: 针对生物医学NLP模型跨机构应用时性能下降的痛点，论文提出了一套标准化的领域内监督学习流水线，通过严谨的数据策划和审计，显著提升了癌症报告分类的准确性并有效管控了假阴性率。
AI.motivation: 生物医学NLP模型在从特定癌症登记处（如西雅图）迁移到其他数据库（如肯塔基）时，因数据分布差异导致性能显著下降，迫切需要一种稳健的领域内建模方法以保障其实用性。
AI.method: 提出了一套可复现的领域内监督训练流水线，包括基于机构分层采样的数据集构建、生产环境匹配的数据集划分、低假阴性率（FNR）运行点选择，以及用于评估标签噪声的盲法人工审计。
AI.result: 肯塔基模型在41.8万条报告的测试集上，将FNR降至0.003，FPR降至0.097，F1分值由0.860提升至0.922，优于基线模型；盲审发现标签噪声较多，且主要集中在罕见原发部位。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线有效解决了生物医学NLP模型在跨癌症登记处应用时的分布外（OOD）性能下降问题，通过领域内监督学习显著提升了分类准确性（F1从0.860提升至0.922），并证明了严谨的数据策划和盲审对降低标签噪声的关键作用。

title: Z-Plane Neural Networks: Bounded Geometric Activation Replaces ReLU and LayerNorm
summary: Modern deep neural networks rely on Euclidean scalar activations (e.g., ReLU) and global normalization techniques (e.g., LayerNorm) to prevent gradient instability in deep architectures. However, these mechanisms inherently cause dead neurons, discard critical directional information, and destroy the orthogonality of feature representations. Inspired by the frequency-modulation transmission of biological axons, we propose the Z-Plane Neural Network, which maps hidden states into 2D phasor bundles on a hypersphere. We introduce a novel geometric activation function, Radial Bounding($\mathbf{x} / \max(1, \|\mathbf{x}\|_2)$), which limits the energy magnitude while preserving the phase (direction). We demonstrate mathematically that this isotropic activation maintains 1-Lipschitz continuity and prevents gradient vanishing by preserving tangential gradients. Empirically, a 100-layer Z-Plane Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-entirely devoid of ReLU and LayerNorm-successfully converges on the MNIST dataset with 98.34% accuracy and absolute numerical stability, proving that bounded geometric activation alone is sufficient for stable deep learning.

AI.tldr: 提出Z-Plane神经网络，通过几何相量映射和径向界限激活函数，在剔除ReLU和LayerNorm的前提下，解决了深度网络训练中的梯度稳定性与特征信息丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法依赖ReLU和LayerNorm，虽然能缓解梯度不稳定，但会导致神经元“死亡”、丢失方向信息并破坏特征正交性。受生物轴突频率调制启发，作者旨在寻找一种能保持特征方向性且梯度稳定的深度模型架构。
AI.method: 1. 将隐藏层状态映射为超球面上的2D相量束；2. 提出“径向界限（Radial Bounding）”几何激活函数（x / max(1, ||x||2)），用于控制能量幅值并保持方向信息；3. 利用该机制构建100层深度的无ReLU、无LayerNorm的MLP网络。
AI.result: 在MNIST数据集上，一个100层的Z-Plane MLP无需ReLU和LayerNorm即可成功收敛，达到98.34%的准确率，并表现出极高的数值稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何界限激活（Radial Bounding）替代标量ReLU和全局归一化，证明了在无需传统归一化手段的情况下，深度神经网络依然可以实现高效且稳定的训练。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Inner-loop Dynamics Estimator for Aerial Manipulation under Uncertainty
summary: Aerial manipulators enable physical interaction in hard-to-reach environments; however, the combined problem of direct whole-body aerial manipulation under rapid arm motion, payload changes, and related unknown dynamic uncertainty remains a largely unsolved problem. We present a hierarchical control framework that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) with an inner-loop dynamics estimator to address this problem. The RL outer loop maps desired 6-degrees-of-freedom (DOF) end-effector targets to coordinated whole-body commands, enabling direct task-driven control without relying on a fully accurate coupled dynamic model in the policy layer. An inner loop then tracks these commands while compensating for transient inertial shifts and uncertainty during execution via a dynamics estimator scheme without requiring system model knowledge. We validate the proposed approach on a custom quadrotor equipped with a 3-DoF manipulator through hardware experiments under varying payload conditions. Compared with RL+PID and RL+INDI+PID baselines, the proposed method reduces end-effector tracking error and improves task success rate across the tested hardware conditions. These results show that combining learned whole-body coordination with estimator-based low-level compensation improves the precision and robustness of aerial manipulation under changing operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将强化学习与动力学估计器相结合的分层空中操作控制框架，解决了空中机械臂在复杂动态环境下的全身协调控制难题。
AI.motivation: 现有空中机械臂在面对快速手臂运动、有效载荷变化以及未知动力学不确定性时，难以实现高精度的全身交互控制。
AI.method: 提出了一种分层控制架构：(1) 外层采用强化学习（RL），直接将末端执行器目标映射为全身指令，无需依赖精确的耦合动力学模型；(2) 内层采用无模型动力学估计器（Dynamics Estimator），实时补偿机械臂运动产生的惯性偏移及不确定性。
AI.result: 在配备3自由度机械臂的四旋翼无人机硬件实验中，该方法相比RL+PID和RL+INDI+PID基准方案，显著降低了末端执行器的跟踪误差并提升了任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结合基于学习的全身协调与基于估计器的底层补偿控制机制，能够显著提升空中操作任务在动态变化环境下的精度与鲁棒性。

title: From Argument Components to Graphs: A Multi-Agent Debate with Confidence Gating for Argument Relations
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of KES 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly assessed and utilized in the field of Argument Mining (AM), thanks to their strong general reasoning capabilities. However, standard training-free models often miss sophisticated details, specifically in contexts where two parts of the text have to be analyzed together. Furthermore, self-correction mechanisms tend to reinforce initial hallucinations in reasoning. Overcoming these limitations typically requires expensive, domain-specific supervised fine-tuning. Recent work has shown that a multi-agent paradigm can address such weaknesses for the component classification task through dialectical refinement with a Proponent-Opponent-Judge architecture, setting a promising direction for training-free approaches in the field. In this paper, we extend and evaluate this framework on the Argument Relation Identification and Classification (ARIC) task, reformulating it as a debate over component pairs. Besides that, we introduce a confidence gating mechanism that enables debating only on the uncertain cases and accepting the initial prediction when confidence is high. On the UKP Argument Annotated Essays v2 corpus, we demonstrate that the selective debate achieves the highest Macro F1 among all training-free methods, while debate over all samples degrades performance below that of one of the baselines. All generative approaches also outperform fine-tuned RoBERTa models on Macro F1, suggesting that the under-representation of the Attack class was more damaging to supervised fine-tuning than to inference-only models. Additionally, our framework produces human-readable debate transcripts, offering interpretability absent from both single-agent and supervised classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对论证关系识别的免训练多智能体辩论框架，通过引入置信度门控机制优化了性能与效率，并证明了在类不均衡数据集上，该方法优于传统的监督微调方式。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在论证挖掘（AM）中存在难以处理跨文本上下文、自纠错机制易强化幻觉以及监督微调成本高昂等问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于“支持者-反对者-裁判”（Proponent-Opponent-Judge）架构的多智能体辩论框架，用于处理ARIC任务；并引入了置信度门控（Confidence Gating）机制，仅对模型不确定案例触发辩论流程。
AI.result: 在UKP数据集上，该方法在所有免训练（training-free）方法中取得了最高的Macro F1，优于全样本辩论及监督微调的RoBERTa模型，同时生成了人类可读的辩论记录。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体辩论框架应用于论证关系识别与分类（ARIC）是有效的，特别是结合置信度门控机制，既能保持高性能又能兼顾效率。此外，相比监督微调方法，生成式模型在处理数据分布不均（如Attack类别不足）的问题上表现更优，且提供了更好的可解释性。

title: The Reservoir Attention Network: Cross-Pass State in Pretrained Transformers via Content-Addressable Reservoir Injection
summary: A feasibility and dynamics study of the Reservoir Attention Network (RAN), an architecture that injects a fixed, randomly-initialized reservoir into the mid-layer attention of a pretrained transformer to carry state across forward passes. Experiments span GPT-2 (124M, 355M) to Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B) on a single consumer GPU. The tasks are minimal probes chosen to isolate individual mechanisms; the broader always-alive agent vision is treated throughout as compute-limited future work, not a claim of this paper. The reservoir is left untrained (fixed random) by design: this isolates whether untrained recurrent dynamics alone suffice to carry usable cross-pass state, leaving trained recurrence as a complementary, more expensive direction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了“联想注意力网络（RAN）”，通过在Transformer中间层注入随机初始化的联想库，证明了即便不进行训练，递归动力学也能有效实现跨前向传播的状态记忆功能。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索如何在保留预训练Transformer能力的同时，通过引入低成本的递归动力学（Recurrent Dynamics）赋予模型跨序列/长时间步维持状态的能力，以实现计算受限环境下的长效智能体交互。
AI.method: 提出“联想注意力网络（RAN）”架构，将固定的、随机初始化的联想库（Reservoir）注入到预训练Transformer的中间层注意力机制中，以实现跨前向传播的状态保持。通过GPT-2和Qwen2.5模型在消费级单显卡上进行受控的机制探测实验。
AI.result: 实验证实了RAN架构能够通过固定、未训练的递归联想库有效地处理跨序列状态信息，且在计算资源受限的情况下执行表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: 未训练的随机初始化联想库（Reservoir）足以在Transformer的前向传播之间携带可用的状态信息，证明了该架构在具备计算约束的场景下作为代理模型（Agent）具有可行性。

title: PATCH: Action-Chunk-Conditioned Latent Patch Innovation Monitoring for Robot Manipulation
summary: Learning-based manipulation policies have made substantial progress in real-world robot manipulation, particularly for short-horizon action generation. However, deployment in open workspaces remains fragile under unexpected local scene dynamics, such as moving objects, transient occlusions, or disturbances near the intended motion. Existing runtime monitors often rely on global observation anomalies, policy uncertainty, or frame-level visual changes, and struggle to distinguish task-relevant execution risk from benign visual variation. We introduce PATCH, an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch innovation monitor for deployment-time intervention. Given the active action chunk, PATCH defines a projected execution corridor, predicts latent patch evolution inside it, and accumulates persistent residuals unexplained by the robot's own motion. These residuals form a localized intervention signal that allows PATCH-Router to pause execution, select an available recovery source, and resume the original policy once localized innovation subsides. Experiments on real robot rollout data show that PATCH produces more stable and context-relevant triggers than competing runtime monitors. Real-robot deployment further demonstrates monitor-driven intervention and policy resumption for disturbance-aware manipulation. Project Page: https://yananzhou5555.github.io/PATCH/.

AI.tldr: 针对机器人操作在动态环境下的不稳定性，本文提出了 PATCH。它通过监控动作执行廊道内的潜在演变并识别异常余量，实现比现有方法更精准的实时操作干预与故障恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人操作策略在面对开放空间中的意外动态（如移动物体、遮挡、干扰）时表现脆弱。现有的运行监控方法往往难以区分任务相关的执行风险与环境中的良性视觉变化（如无关干扰）。
AI.method: 提出了 PATCH（针对动作分块的潜在补丁创新监控器）。该方法基于当前动作分块构建投影执行廊道，通过预测廊道内的潜在补丁演变，累积无法被机器人自身运动解释的残差，生成局部化干预信号（PATCH-Router），实现任务暂停、自动恢复源选择及策略恢复。
AI.result: 在真实机器人执行数据上的实验表明，PATCH 比现有实时监控方法产生更稳定且与上下文相关的触发信号；在实机部署中，PATCH 有效实现了干扰感知下的操作干预与策略恢复。
AI.conclusion: PATCH 通过引入动作分块条件的潜在补丁演变监测，有效区分了真实执行风险与无关视觉变化，从而提升了机器人操作在动态环境下的鲁棒性和自主恢复能力。

title: PVminerLLM2: Improving Structured Extraction of Patient Voice via Preference Optimization
summary:
Motivation: Patient-generated text contains critical information on patients' lived experiences, social context, and care engagement, but remains largely unstructured, limiting its use in patient-centered outcomes research. Prior work introduced the PV-Miner benchmark and PVMinerLLM models for structured extraction. However, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone struggles with rare, fine-grained, and unevenly distributed errors, particularly in token-critical structured outputs.
  Results: We present PVminerLLM2, an improved set of LLMs for structured patient voice extraction that applies preference optimization to address token-critical errors beyond the reach of supervised fine-tuning. Our method introduces (i) a preference objective with token-level gated stabilization term that prevents degradation of absolute token likelihood under preference optimization, and (ii) confusion-aware preference pair construction to better capture low-separation distinctions. We further incorporate token-importance weighting and inverse-frequency reweighing to address token imbalance and class skew. Across multiple model sizes, PVMinerLLM2 consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving gains of up to 4.43% (Code), 3.50% (Sub-code), and 1.55% (Span), and outperforms baseline LLM trained with existing preference optimization methods.
  Availability and Implementation: The supplementary material, code, evaluation scripts, and trained models for PVminerLLM2 are publicly available at: https://github.com/Data-Mining-Lab-Yale/PVminerLLM2

AI.tldr: 针对患者非结构化文本的提取任务，本文提出了 PVminerLLM2，通过融合混淆感知偏好优化与概率稳定机制，有效解决了细粒度 Token 级别提取中的数据偏斜与准确性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 患者生成的非结构化文本文中蕴含关键的社会背景与护理参与度信息，对以患者为中心的研究（PCOR）至关重要。但现有监督微调（SFT）在大模型处理罕见、细粒度及 Token 级别非均匀分布的错误时效果有限。
AI.method:
1. 提出了带有门控稳定项的偏好优化（Preference Optimization with token-level gated stabilization）以防止模型偏好对齐过程中的概率衰退；
2. 构建了基于“混淆感知”（confusion-aware）的偏好对偶以增强底层辨识能力；
3. 集成了 Token 重要性加权和逆频率加权（inverse-frequency reweighing）机制来应对类别倾斜和分布不均。
AI.result: PVminerLLM2 在多个模型规模上表现优于现有基线，在 Code、Sub-code 和 Span 三项指标上分别获得了高达 4.43%、3.50% 和 1.55% 的性能提升，且优于现有的其他偏好优化方法。
AI.conclusion: PVminerLLM2 通过引入带置信门控稳定项的偏好优化策略，有效解决了大模型在处理非结构化患者文本提取任务时面临的细粒度误差和 Token 不平衡问题，显著提升了结构化输出的准确性。

title: ReQAT: Achieving Full-Precision Reasoning Accuracy with 4-bit Floating-Point Quantization-Aware Training
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong problem-solving through long chain-of-thought, but their deployment is constrained by the high cost of full-precision inference and growing KV cache footprints. Microscaled FP4 formats enable efficient FP4 deployment; however, fully quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches (W4A4KV4) causes severe reasoning degradation that existing PTQ and QAT fail to recover. We identify that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens--precise symbolic commitments such as digits and operators--where quantization noise inflates sampling errors that cascade through reasoning traces. Based on this insight, we propose ReQAT, a reasoning-centric FP4 training framework with three components: (i) Trace-Aligned QAT (TAQ), which revisits identical reasoning traces to focus updates on critical low-entropy decisions; (ii) Selective Entropy Minimization (SEM), which reinforces confidence at low-entropy positions; and (iii) Q-FIT, a quantization-friendly initialization that jointly calibrates RoPE-consistent KV cache transformations to stabilize QAT. Under the same training budget, ReQAT not only recovers but surpasses BF16 fine-tuning accuracy, while delivering up to 3.9x throughput speedup on NVIDIA DGX Spark and 3.1x on B200.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型在 W4A4KV4 量化下推理性能严重下降的问题，本文提出了 ReQAT 框架，利用针对关键逻辑节点的量化训练策略，在大幅降低推理成本的同时实现了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在长思维链推理中表现出色，但全精度推理成本高且 KV 缓存占用大。现有的 FP4 量化方法在 W4A4KV4 设置下会导致严重的推理能力下降。
AI.method: 提出 ReQAT（Reasoning-centric FP4 Training）框架，包含三部分：1. Trace-Aligned QAT (TAQ)：聚焦关键的低熵推理步骤进行更新；2. Selective Entropy Minimization (SEM)：提升低熵位置的置信度；3. Q-FIT：一种保持 RoPE 一致性的量化友好初始化方法，用于稳定 KV 缓存转化。
AI.result: ReQAT 在同等训练预算下实现了比 BF16 微调更高的准确率，并在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上实现了 3.9 倍的吞吐量提升，在 B200 上实现了 3.1 倍的提升。
AI.conclusion: ReQAT 框架通过针对性地优化关键逻辑节点的量化精度，成功在实现 W4A4KV4 低精度部署的同时，不仅恢复了推理性能，甚至超越了 BF16 微调的准确率，并显著提升了推理吞吐量。

title: VENOM: Versatile Embodied Network for Omni-bodied Motion tracking
summary: Achieving expert-level expressive full-body motion tracking across multiple humanoids solely from demonstration data remains a challenging and relatively an underexplored problem in humanoid robot learning. Cross-embodiment motion tracking policies are mostly trained by decoupling the control problem into upper and lower body control. This work proposes VENOM, a cross-embodiment full-body motion tracking model for humanoids in simulation. VENOM is a GPT-based motion tracker trained on multiple humanoid data that can track the entire body without the requirement to split into upper and lower body control. We curate a multi-humanoid motion tracking dataset called the VENOM dataset that contains states, actions, and rewards and train VENOM and the baselines on this dataset. In this letter, we evaluate VENOM's performance against baselines and show that we can achieve a stable motion tracker across different humanoids more capable than an MLP trained on multiple humanoid data with supervised learning alone, and also show that despite lack of reward feedback, VENOM closely matches the tracking capability of experts that were trained using asymmetric-actor critic reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VENOM，一种基于GPT架构的跨形态类人机器人全身运动追踪模型，通过统一建模实现高质量全身动作模仿，性能优于传统多层感知机（MLP）且具备接近强化学习专家的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有跨形态运动追踪多采用解耦控制策略，复杂且开发不足；缺乏从演示数据直接进行专家级全身全身运动追踪的统一学习框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于GPT架构的全局运动追踪模型VENOM，摒弃了传统的上下肢解耦控制策略，支持端到端的全身运动追踪；构建了包含状态、动作和奖励的跨形态类人机器人运动数据集。
AI.result: 在VENOM数据集上的实验表明，VENOM在多个类人机器人模型上表现出比MLP更稳定的追踪性能，且在无额外奖励反馈的情况下，其追踪能力接近使用非对称演员-评论家（Asymmetric Actor-Critic）强化学习训练出的专家模型。
AI.conclusion: VENOM证明了基于Transformer（GPT架构）的序列建模方法在跨形态全身运动追踪任务中优于传统MLP模型，且无需依赖强化学习中的奖励反馈即可达到接近专家水平的性能，为类人机器人模仿学习提供了一种高效、统一的解决方案。

title: Long-Context Modeling via GSS-Transformer Hybrid Architecture with Learnable Mixing
summary: Modeling long-range dependencies remains a central challenge in natural language processing. Transformer architectures achieve strong performance via self-attention but scale quadratically ($O(N^2)$) with sequence length, while State Space Models (SSMs) scale linearly ($O(N)$) but suffer from a selective recall bottleneck, struggling to retrieve precise information from compressed states. This creates a fundamental tradeoff between efficiency and perplexity. To tackle these challenges, we propose the \textit{Parallel Hybrid Architecture (PHA)}, which runs Gated State Spaces (GSS), Grouped Query Attention (GQA), and Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) as independent parallel branches fused by a learnable mixing mechanism. Instead of forcing SSMs to approximate attention or serializing the two paradigms, PHA allows each branch to specialize: GSS captures global context, while attention performs selective retrieval, with FFN providing complementary processing. On WikiText-103, PHA achieves 16.51 PPL at 125M parameters, outperforming Hedgehog (16.70) and H3-125M (23.70). Scaling to 180M parameters yields 16.42 PPL, which gives comparable results with the pure attention baseline while delivering 24\% higher throughput and up to 40\% lower memory usage at long contexts. On OpenWebText, our 125M model achieves 19.72 PPL, outperforming standard Transformers (20.60) and GSS hybrid baselines (19.80). These results demonstrate that separating sequence modeling paradigms into parallel specialists enables Transformer-level perplexity with substantially improved efficiency for long-context language modeling.

AI.tldr: PHA是一种并行混合架构，通过并行化GSS、GQA和FFN，在保持Transformer高质量表现的同时，显著降低了长文本任务中的计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: Transformer架构在长距离依赖上虽然表现优异，但存在$O(N^2)$的二次复杂度问题；而状态空间模型（SSM）虽具有$O(N)$的线性效率，但在特定信息检索存在“选择性回忆瓶颈”。该研究旨在解决效率与困惑度（Perplexity）之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出了Parallel Hybrid Architecture (PHA)，将门控状态空间（GSS）、分组查询注意力（GQA）和前馈网络（FFN）作为独立的并行分支运行，并通过可学习的混合机制进行融合。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103数据集上，125M参数的PHA达到16.51 PPL，优于Hedgehog和H3。在OpenWebText数据集上，其性能超越了标准Transformer和GSS基线，同时在长上下文中实现了高出24%的吞吐量和低至40%的内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将序列建模范式拆分为并行的专家模型（GSS、GQA、FFN），PHA成功平衡了计算效率与信息回忆能力，实现了在保持Transformer级困惑度的同时，显著提升了长上下文推理的效率。

title: Multi-Fidelity SINDy: Sparse Discovery of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems with Fidelity-Weighted Measurements
summary: Data from simulations and experiments are rarely noise-free and often exhibit heterogeneous levels of fidelity. Measurement uncertainty may vary across repeated observations, sensing devices, or even within a single experiment. This work addresses the problem of discovering nonlinear dynamical systems from such inhomogeneous data. We extend the Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems (SINDy) framework to account for variable noise levels by combining Ensemble SINDy and Weak SINDy within a weighted regression formulation derived from generalized least squares. A statistical justification for the weighting strategy is also provided. The methodology is validated on several benchmark systems, including ordinary and partial differential equations. In addition, we show the benefit of multi-fidelity integration for forecasting the dynamics of a double pendulum system. The results confirm that the proposed approach mitigates the adverse effects of heteroscedastic noise and that repeated, low-cost, low-quality measurements can improve model recovery, in some cases matching or outperforming reconstructions obtained using only high-fidelity data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对异方差噪声及多保真度数据的扩展 SINDy 框架，通过广义最小二乘法加权回归，有效提升了非线性动力系统识别的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的非线性动力系统识别方法在处理现实中常见的非平稳噪声（异方差性）及不同数据来源间的高低保真度（heterogeneous fidelity）差异时效果欠佳，亟需一种能够适应这种不确定性的稳健识别框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于广义最小二乘法（Generalized Least Squares, GLS）加权回归框架的 SINDy 扩展方法，将集成 SINDy（Ensemble SINDy）与弱形式 SINDy（Weak SINDy）相结合，以处理异方差噪声，并提供了相关的统计学理论支持。
AI.result: 在多个基准系统（ODE 和 PDE）及双摆系统预测实验中，该方法成功减轻了异方差噪声的负面影响，证实了多保真度数据集成在模型恢复和动力学预测中的显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了通过加权回归整合多源、异构噪声数据可有效提高模型恢复的鲁棒性。低成本、低质量的多次测量数据在特定条件下能显著改善对非线性动力系统的恢复效果，甚至达到或超过仅使用高质量数据重构的水平。

title: Pride and Prejudice: Toward an Information-Theoretic Framework for Mutually Communicative Driver Behavior Modeling
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for the IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITS), June 2026
summary: Mixed autonomy driving becomes unsafe and inefficient when autonomous vehicles (AVs) and human-driven vehicles (HVs) misread each other's intentions. We study this problem as implicit mutual communication in lane changes. The proposed framework models how the ego vehicle both expresses its intent and probes the other driver's preference under epistemic uncertainty. It combines a level-k Bayesian persuasion game with virtual features for proactive signaling, information-theoretic rewards for mutual communication, and adaptive weights of communication affordances. We further introduce the Pride-Inquiry (P-I) and Pride-Prejudice (P-P) planes to analyze communication intensity and tendency. The model is calibrated with a Communication-Based Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning algorithm (C-MIRL) on the naturalistic NGSIM dataset. Compared with the non-communicative baseline, the proposed model reduces the prediction error of mandatory lane changes by up to 20% while maintaining strong generalization. Driver-In-the-Loop questionnaire scores are positively correlated with the calibrated communication variables, supporting the subjective validity of the model. The learned rewards further show that inquiry and listening affordances contribute more than pride and expression alone, and that inquiry preference varies more strongly across drivers. These results support explicit modeling of mutual communication and epistemic uncertainty in interactive driving.

AI.tldr: 针对自动驾驶与人类驾驶交互中的互信缺失问题，本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯博弈和逆向强化学习的隐性沟通框架，通过主动信号探测与意图交互，显著提升了变道行为的预测准确度与交互自然度。
AI.motivation: 在混合交通流（自动驾驶汽车与人类驾驶汽车共存）中，由于双方对彼此意图的误判，导致变道行为变得不安全且低效。研究旨在通过建模“隐性相互沟通”来解决驾驶交互中的认知不确定性问题。
AI.method:
1. 提出一种基于level-k贝叶斯说服博弈（Bayesian persuasion game）的框架，融合虚拟特征实现主动信号传递；
2. 利用信息论奖励机制量化相互沟通；
3. 引入“Pride-Inquiry (P-I)”和“Pride-Prejudice (P-P)”平面分析沟通的强度与倾向；
4. 使用基于沟通的多智能体逆向强化学习（C-MIRL）算法在NGSIM数据集上进行模型校准。
AI.result:
1. 相比非沟通基准模型，强制变道预测误差降低了20%；
2. 具有良好的泛化能力；
3. Driver-In-the-Loop（驾驶员在环）问卷评估显示主观评分与沟通变量呈正相关；
4. 实验发现“询问（inquiry）”和“倾听（listening）”功能比单纯的“表达（expression）”对交互贡献更大，且不同驾驶员在询问倾向上的差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在自动驾驶中显式建模“相互沟通（implicit communication）”和“认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）”对于提升交互安全性和效率至关重要，同时也验证了该建模框架在模拟自然驾驶行为方面的有效性。

title: Towards Pareto-Optimal Tool-Integrated Agents with Pareto Ranking Policy Optimization
summary: Recent advances in tool-integrated language agents have significantly improved their ability to solve complex reasoning tasks. However, existing alignment methods predominantly focus on maximizing task accuracy, while overlooking auxiliary objectives such as tool-use efficiency, which are essential for practical deployment. To address this gap, we introduce ParetoPO, a two-stage multi-objective optimization framework for aligning tool-using large language models (LLMs) under competing objectives. In the first stage, ParetoPO leverages hypervolume-guided dynamic scalarization to adapt reward weights based on global Pareto frontier progress. In the second stage, it replaces scalarized learning signals with Pareto-ranking-based advantage computation, promoting nondominated trajectories through dominance-aware credit assignment. This design enables fine-grained, action-level optimization across multiple conflicting objectives. Experimental results on mathematic reasoning and multi-hop QA tasks show that ParetoPO consistently discovers policies with superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to static and heuristic baselines.

AI.tldr: ParetoPO 是一种针对工具使用型大语言模型的多目标优化框架，通过动态权重调整和 Pareto 排序策略，在提升任务准确性的同时优化了工具使用的效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言代理对齐方法过度关注任务精度，忽视了实际部署中至关重要的工具使用效率，且难以处理多目标（准确性 vs. 效率）之间的冲突。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段多目标优化框架 (ParetoPO)：第一阶段利用“基于超体积导向的动态标量化”来根据 Pareto 前沿的进展动态调整奖励权重；第二阶段采用“基于 Pareto 排序的优势计算”，通过支配感知信用分配来优化具体的动作序列。
AI.result: 在数学推理和多跳问答任务中，ParetoPO 显著优于现有的静态和启发式基线方法，能够发现更具竞争力的准确率-效率权衡策略。
AI.conclusion: ParetoPO 提出了一种有效的多目标优化框架，通过在训练中结合动态标量化和基于 Pareto 的优势计算，成功在语言代理的准确性和工具使用效率之间取得了更优的平衡（Pareto 前沿）。

title: When Generator Replay Degrades: Projected Rehearsal Orchestration for Heterogeneous Federated Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Federated class-incremental learning (FCIL) becomes substantially harder when clients observe different label subsets, progress through tasks at different stages, and provide uneven supervision for the same semantic concepts. Existing FCIL methods often preserve old knowledge through input-space synthesis, but they can be fragile under heterogeneous task streams and difficult to transfer across modalities. To alleviate such issues, we propose PRO, a framework that replaces synthetic input replay with projected rehearsal orchestration. To remove external pretraining, we evaluate all methods under the same warmup. After this, PRO maintains compact class-level projected memories on the server and allows clients perform balanced pseudo multi-task training over current examples and old projected memories. To handle stronger representation drift, we further introduce PRO-MAX, which augments PRO with neighborhood-weighted memory alignment while preserving the same server-light principle that the server only aggregates model updates and memory statistics. Across image, text, and graph benchmarks, PRO and PRO-MAX improve retention and final utility under heterogeneous streams while remaining competitive in homogeneous FCIL. Even when baselines are given expanded replay budgets, they degrade under supervision imbalance and stage misalignment, indicating that replay quantity alone does not resolve replay-quality failures. Additional weak-task diagnostics further show that larger replay mismatch is associated with larger downstream degradation, while our method keeps projected memories better aligned with the evolving representation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对联邦类增量学习（FCIL）中面对异构任务流时的性能衰退问题，提出了“投影重放编排”（PRO）框架，通过服务器维护类级投影记忆而非合成输入，有效解决了传统重放方法在面对数据异构性时的脆弱性，在多模态基准测试中显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦类增量学习（FCIL）方法在处理异构任务流（标签子集不同、阶段不同、监督不平衡）时表现脆弱，且基于合成输入重放的方法难以跨模态迁移，导致模型极易产生严重遗忘和表征漂移，难以从高质量数据中获得持续学习能力。
AI.method:
1. 提出 PRO 框架：用“投影重放编排”（Projected Rehearsal Orchestration）代替合成输入重放。
2. 保持紧凑的类级投影记忆：在服务器端维护类级别的投影信息，并在客户端进行平衡的伪多任务训练。
3. 提出 PRO-MAX：在 PRO 基础上引入邻域加权记忆对齐，以应对更强的表征漂移，同时遵循“服务器轻量化”原则（仅聚合模型更新和记忆统计信息）。
4. 对比实验：在图像、文本和图数据基准上进行评估，并引入弱任务诊断以验证重放质量与下游性能间的关联。
AI.result: PRO 和 PRO-MAX 在异构 FCIL 环境下表现优于现有重放基准，且在同构环境下也保持竞争力。即便 baselines 拥有更大的重放预算，在面临监督不平衡和阶段错位时表现依然退化，证实了重放质量（而非数量）是解决问题的关键。实验还表明，PRO 能使投影记忆与不断演进的表征保持更好的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，在联邦类增量学习（FCIL）中，仅增加重放数据的数量无法解决非同源任务流引起的问题。相比基于合成输入重放的方法，基于投影重放编排（PRO）的方法能更好地应对异构数据分布、阶段错位和监督不平衡，在保持较小服务器负载的同时，显著提升了模型的记忆保持能力和最终效用。

title: DataLadder: A Simulation-Enabled Interconversion Toolchain for the Embodied Data Pyramid
summary: Generalist robot policies require trustworthy evaluation and robot-usable training data, but both are difficult to scale with physical robots alone. Real-robot trials and demonstrations remain the most faithful source of deployment signals, yet they are slow, costly, and hard to reproduce. We present DataLadder, a simulation-enabled interconversion toolchain for human-robot aligned model evaluation and data generation, denoted as Robot $\rightleftharpoons$ Simulation $\rightleftharpoons$ Human. On the one hand, the Robot $\rightarrow$ Simulation $\rightarrow$ Human pathway supports human-robot aligned model evaluation by reconstructing real-robot tabletop organization tasks as calibrated digital twins for scalable evaluation, while using human embodied feedback to inspect and refine the naturalness of simulated motions. On the other hand, the Human $\rightarrow$ Simulation $\rightarrow$ Robot pathway supports human-robot aligned data generation: it lifts ego-centric human demonstrations into simulation, checks them under robot physical constraints, and converts them into robot-centered trajectories, annotations, and visual observations. Together, these pathways use the JoySim simulator as both a scalable evaluation layer and a physical consistency filter for robot data generation. We further package the core reconstruction, simulation, rendering, and realism-augmentation modules as cloud services on JD Cloud, turning the system into reusable infrastructure for robot data generation and model evaluation.

AI.tldr: DataLadder 是一个利用仿真技术连接人类演示与机器人数据的双向转化与评估系统，旨在解决机器人训练中数据稀缺和评估困难的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略的评估和训练数据获取难以仅依靠实机进行大规模扩展，实机训练不仅成本高、效率低，且难以复现。
AI.method: 提出 DataLadder 工具链，通过“机器人$\rightleftharpoons$仿真$\rightleftharpoons$人类”的三向交互模式：1. Robot→Simulation→Human：通过构建物理任务的数字孪生实现可扩展评估，并引入人类具身反馈优化仿真动作；2. Human→Simulation→Robot：将人类演示迁移至仿真环境，经物理一致性过滤后生成机器人可用的轨迹与标注。均基于 JoySim 仿真器。
AI.result: 建立了一套完整的仿真辅助评估与数据生成工具链，支持以低成本、高效率的方式获取与人类行为对齐的数据，并已部署在 JD Cloud 上作为可复用基础设施。
AI.conclusion: DataLadder 通过提供一套可复用的云端基础设施，高效解决了通用机器人策略评估难与高质量训练数据获取难的问题，实现了现实世界与虚拟仿真之间的数据双向转化与评估闭环。

title: AuAu: A Benchmark for Auditing Authoritarian Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: The worldwide surge of authoritarianism, combined with the increasing central role in users' everyday lives, raises the question of to what extent specific models exhibit or promote authoritarian attitudes and characteristics. We introduce AuAu, a comprehensive benchmark that aims to assess the risk of LLMs generating responses with authoritarian tendencies. This benchmark combines three evaluation approaches: (i) psychometric questions from an extensive pool of 15 human validated instruments; (ii) contextual behavior vignettes probing intended actions in concrete situations; and (iii) responses to realistic user prompts. Unlike prior work, AuAu evaluates not only a general closeness towards authoritarianism but also the established sub-concepts Authoritarian Aggression, Authoritarian Submission, and Conventionalism. Evaluating 17 models from China, the EU, Russia, and the USA, we find that all tested models exhibit substantial authoritarian response rates under the psychometric evaluation, though rates drop significantly in increasingly more realistic downstream task. We further find that an authoritarian system prompt easily manipulates 15 out of 17 models to promote increased authoritarianism. Our results underscore the need for continued, systematic auditing of LLM-based AI systems to detect and ultimately mitigate undesired authoritarian tendencies in generated output. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/andreaseinwiller/AuAu

AI.tldr: 本文提出了名为AuAu的综合基准，用于评估LLM生成内容中的威权主义倾向。研究发现，虽然不同模型在真实情境下的表现各异，但它们普遍存在被威权提示词操纵的风险，凸显了对AI系统进行持续审计的紧迫性。
AI.motivation: 随着威权主义在全球的兴起以及大语言模型（LLM）在用户日常生活中作用的日益增强，研究者旨在量化这些模型在多大程度上展现或助长了威权主义态度与倾向。
AI.method: 提出了名为“AuAu”的综合基准测试，包含三种评估方法：(i) 基于15个经人类验证的心理测量问卷；(ii) 基于具体情境的行为推断小插曲；(iii) 基于现实用户提示词的响应测试。同时评估了涵盖威权攻击性、威权服从性和传统主义三个子维度。
AI.result: 对来自中国、欧盟、俄罗斯和美国的17个模型进行了测试，发现所有模型在心理测量评估中均表现出显著的威权响应率，但随着任务趋于现实化，响应率有所下降；此外，15个模型可通过威权系统提示词被轻易操纵，表现出更强的威权倾向。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了对大型语言模型进行持续、系统性审计的必要性，以识别并减轻模型输出中潜在的威权主义倾向。研究结果表明，现有模型容易受到系统提示词操纵，表现出威权主义特征。

title: Robust Transformer-Based One-Step Stock Index Forecasting via Shifted Data Augmentation
summary: Transformers have shown remarkable success in sequence modeling, yet their direct application to financial time series remains challenging due to noisy signals, short-memory dynamics, and distributional shifts. This paper proposes a modified Transformer architecture for one-step stock index forecasting, combined with advanced learning-rate scheduling and a novel Shifted Data Augmentation (SDA) technique. We evaluate the proposed framework on two benchmark stock index datasets, VN30 and S&P 500. Experimental results demonstrate that cosine annealing with warmup consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the generalized inverse-power scheduler. Furthermore, SDA substantially reduces forecasting errors and run-to-run variability while improving robustness to hyperparameter selection. The combination of cosine annealing scheduling and SDA achieved the best performance on both datasets, indicating that data augmentation can play a more important role than increasing model complexity in Transformer-based financial forecasting. These findings provide a practical and computationally efficient approach for robust stock index forecasting in noisy financial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的 Transformer 框架，通过引入余弦退火学习率调度和移位数据增强（SDA）技术，有效解决了金融时间序列预测中的噪声和不稳定问题，证明了数据增强在提升预测性能方面比增加模型复杂度更为关键。
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列数据存在噪声大、短记忆特性和分布偏移等问题，导致标准 Transformer 在该领域的直接应用效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出了一种改进的 Transformer 架构；引入了余弦退火热身（cosine annealing with warmup）学习率调度器；开发了一种新型移位数据增强（Shifted Data Augmentation, SDA）技术。
AI.result: 余弦退火热身策略优于广义反幂调度器；SDA 显著降低了预测误差并减少了运行波动性，增强了超参数选择的鲁棒性。该组合在 VN30 和 S&P 500 数据集上均取得了最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 在股票价格预测中，数据增强（SDA）的重要性超过了增加模型复杂度。该方法为噪声金融环境下的稳健预测提供了一种实用且高效的方案。

title: DIFF-IPPO: Diffusion-Based Informative Path Planning with Open-Vocabulary Belief Maps
summary: Exploration and object search require robots to perceive their environment, identify regions of interest, and plan trajectories that improve target-detection likelihood or maximize information gain. Many IPP methods, especially in continuous environmental monitoring, rely on Gaussian-process belief models, while object-search settings often produce complex, multimodal belief maps from semantic or open-vocabulary perception. Global trajectory generation directly conditioned on such non-Gaussian belief maps remains comparatively underexplored. Although diffusion-based planners offer strong capabilities for modeling such distributions, their use in informative path planning remains limited. In this work, we propose DIFF-IPPO, a pipeline that integrates an open-vocabulary belief map generator with a diffusion-based planner for global trajectory generation over belief maps. The method generates trajectories that concentrate sensor coverage over high-belief regions, achieving normalized detection scores between 81.49% and 86.55% across different dataset scenarios. We validate the system in a simulated search-and-rescue scenario where the planner searches candidate building regions to locate a burning building. In this setting, a team of five drones using batched belief-map-conditioned trajectory generation achieves first detections in 3.5 minutes.

AI.tldr: 为解决复杂非高斯信念地图下的目标搜索问题，论文提出了 DIFF-IPPO 系统，通过集成开放词汇感知与扩散模型规划器，实现了高效的全局轨迹生成。
AI.motivation: 现有路径规划方法（IPP）多依赖高斯过程，难以有效处理目标搜索中常见的复杂、多模态信念地图（如语义或开放词汇感知产生的结果），且基于扩散模型的规划器在 IPP 中的应用尚处于起步阶段。
AI.method: 提出 DIFF-IPPO 系统：结合了开放词汇信念地图生成器与基于扩散模型的规划器，直接在非高斯信念地图上生成全局轨迹，并引入批处理机制以优化多无人机协作。
AI.result: 在模拟搜索与救援场景中，该方法实现了 81.49% 到 86.55% 的归一化检测分数；五架无人机团队可在 3.5 分钟内完成首次目标发现。
AI.conclusion: DIFF-IPPO 能够有效处理非高斯、多模态的信念地图，在复杂环境中的目标搜索任务中表现优异，证明了扩散模型应用于信息路径规划（IPP）的有效性。

title: XAI-Grounded Explanation Generation for Speech Deepfake Detection with Training-Free Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Speech deepfake detection (SDD) systems require trustworthy explanations for reliable decision-making. Existing explanation ways mainly fall into two categories. Traditional explainable AI (XAI), such as gradient-based attribution, produces low-level attribution signals tightly coupled with model decisions, and harder to be understood by human than natural language explanations. Meanwhile, large language model (LLM)-based explanation generation often produces generic and ungrounded descriptions due to the lack of heuristic evidence and task-specific supervision, stemming from limited grounded explanation datasets for SDD. We therefore propose a training-free explanation framework that integrates XAI evidence with multimodal LLMs to generate grounded and specific explanations. Using the PartialSpoof dataset, we construct a grounded explanation dataset and show that methods with XAI increase inside accuracy by over 45\%, verified through human evaluation and faithfulness checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的解释框架，通过集成XAI特征信号与多模态大模型，实现了对语音伪造检测结果的深入、可信且符合人类认知的解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音伪造检测（SDD）解释方法存在矛盾：传统XAI方法产生的信号难以被人类直观理解，而LLM生成的解释往往因为缺乏任务特有的监督证据而显得空洞、不接地气。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的解释框架，将传统的XAI（基于梯度的归因）证据与多模态大语言模型（LLM）相结合；利用PartialSpoof数据集构建了一个有据可查的解释数据集用于验证。
AI.result: 与现有的解释方法相比，该方法在内部准确度（inside accuracy）上提升了超过 45%，并通过人类评估和忠实度检查得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的无需训练的解释框架通过结合 XAI 可解释性信号与多模态大模型，有效解决了语音伪造检测中现有解释方法要么过于简单、要么泛泛而谈且缺乏依据的问题，显著提升了决策的可信度。

title: How to Score Experts for One-Shot MoE Expert Pruning: A Unified Formulation and Selection Principle
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making one-shot expert pruning a practical approach for reducing memory usage. Although effective, existing criteria are largely heuristic, and no single criterion is universally optimal. Thus, establishing a principle for selecting pruning criteria suited to different deployment objectives remains an important yet largely underexplored problem in one-shot expert pruning. To this end, we introduce a unified formulation for one-shot MoE expert pruning organized around three factors: routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength. The formulation yields a criteria selection principle: task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, whereas task-specific pruning can benefit from retaining routing-frequency and gate-weight information. Beyond this principle, the formulation also provides a systematic view of existing heuristic criteria and gives rise to two new task-agnostic criteria, Mean Activation Norm (MAN) and Mean Squared Activation Norm (MSAN). Across four representative MoE models and 16 diverse benchmarks, MAN and MSAN are consistently strong in the task-agnostic setting, obtain the top-two average ranks, and improve average performance by up to 8.8 points over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 针对MoE模型内存占用大的问题，本文提出了通用的专家剪枝框架，建立了剪枝准则选型原则，并开发了MAN和MSAN两种高效的剪枝标准，显著提升了模型剪枝后的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝方法多基于启发式，缺乏理论指导且普适性不足，难以平衡不同部署场景下的性能与内存需求。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含“路由频率”、“门控权重”和“激活强度”三个维度的MoE专家剪枝统一框架，并据此推导出针对任务不可知（优先考虑激活强度）和任务特定（结合路由与门控）场景的选型原则；同时提出了两个新标准：平均激活范数（MAN）和平均平方激活范数（MSAN）。
AI.result: 在4个代表性MoE模型和16个基准测试中，MAN和MSAN在任务不可知场景下表现最强，综合排名位居前二，平均性能较现有最优基线提升达8.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的统一剪枝框架和新标准（MAN/MSAN）为MoE模型在不同部署目标下的专家剪枝提供了原则性指导，不仅在任务不可知场景下表现优异，还提升了剪枝的系统性和可解释性。

title: SoK: Security and Privacy of Foundation-Model-Powered Robots
summary: Foundation models are reshaping robotics by enabling robots to interpret open-ended instructions, reason over multimodal contexts, and operate in complex, open-world environments. However, their integration also introduces security and privacy (S&P) risks that extend beyond the FMs themselves to embodied execution pipelines, supporting ecosystems, and broader governance impacts. Existing literature reviews provide valuable insights but often focus on specific FM types, risk categories, mitigation strategies, or trust boundaries. Consequently, the field lacks a unified structure for analyzing where risks originate, how they propagate across robotic systems, and where mitigations should intervene. To address this gap, we propose a progressive F-E-S-G structural boundary framework for analyzing the S&P of FM-powered robots. The framework comprises four layers: the Foundation model layer (F), Embodied system layer (E), Supporting ecosystem layer (S), and Governance impact layer (G). Building on this structure, we develop a multi-level taxonomy that organizes prior studies along three levels: F-E-S-G trust boundary, security-privacy concerns, and risk-mitigation perspectives. We further annotate each study using fine-grained coding attributes, including target, lifecycle stage, mechanism, system access, and effect. Guided by this framework and taxonomy, we systematize 96 papers. Our analysis uncovers multiple threat patterns, defense mismatches, and evaluation gaps that are difficult to identify from a single-boundary perspective. Based on these findings, we identify open challenges and future directions to provide a research agenda for developing secure, privacy-preserving, and responsibly governed FM-powered robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基础模型驱动机器人引入的安全与隐私风险，提出了 F-E-S-G 四层框架及分类标准，通过对 96 篇文献的系统分析，识别了当前研究的防御差距与评估盲点，并提出了未来研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注特定模型或风险维度，缺乏一个统一的框架来分析基础模型驱动机器人在复杂环境下的安全与隐私风险来源、传播路径及防御干预点。
AI.method: 提出了 F-E-S-G（基础模型层、具身系统层、支撑生态层、治理影响层）结构边界框架；建立了一个包含信任边界、S&P 关注点及风险缓解维度的多级分类学；对 96 篇精选论文进行了基于细粒度属性（目标、生命周期、机制等）的编码与系统性分析。
AI.result: 系统总结了 96 篇相关研究，揭示了当前领域存在的多种威胁模式、防御手段与实际风险之间的错位，以及在系统评估方面的显著缺口。
AI.conclusion: 该论文通过 F-E-S-G 框架系统地梳理了基础模型驱动机器人的安全与隐私（S&P）研究现状，通过识别现有研究中的防御错位和评估盲区，为未来开发安全、可信的具身智能系统指明了方向。

title: GRACE: Step-Level Benchmark for Faithful Reasoning over Context
summary: Many reasoning tasks require models to reason over input context, from document-grounded question answering to rule-based deduction. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting produces traces that appear transparent, yet individual steps can silently deviate from the source evidence, even when the final answer is correct. Existing methods detect hallucinations at the response level but fail to identify where in the chain a failure occurs or what type it is. We introduce GRACE, the first human-annotated step-level faithfulness benchmark with a data-driven error taxonomy for context-grounded textual reasoning. GRACE covers CoT traces from 10 models across 4 source datasets, with each step annotated for faithfulness, error category, and natural language explanation. A data-driven taxonomy, discovered bottom-up via unsupervised clustering, organizes failures into two tracks: GRACE-Inference (deductive errors) and GRACE-Grounding (factual grounding errors), with four categories each. The evaluation set is human-annotated and challenging by design. Our experiments reveal substantial headroom for current models. In addition, integrating step-level faithfulness signals into reinforcement learning pipelines improves both downstream accuracy and reasoning reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 GRACE 基准，用于检测思维链（CoT）推理过程中的步级忠实度问题，并构建了分类体系。研究发现当前模型推理不仅存在准确度问题，还存在深层的推理与落地错误，通过引入步级忠实度反馈可提升模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的思维链（CoT）推理虽然看似透明，但推理步骤往往可能偏离原始证据产生幻觉。现有的检测方法仅局限于响应层面，无法精准识别推理链中具体的错误位置和错误类型。
AI.method: 构建了名为 GRACE 的数据集，这是首个针对上下文引导文本推理的、包含人类标注的“步级（step-level）”忠实度评测基准。通过无监督聚类建立数据驱动的错误分类体系，包含“GRACE-Inference（推理错误）”和“GRACE-Grounding（事实落地错误）”两条轨道，每条轨道下各四个类别。
AI.result: GRACE 基准通过对 10 个模型在 4 个数据集上的表现进行深度解析，揭示了当前主流模型在推理忠实度方面存在显著问题，并证明了步级忠实度监督信号在优化模型过程中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了当前大语言模型在思维链（CoT）推理忠实度方面仍有巨大改进空间；此外，将步级忠实度信号整合进强化学习管线，能有效提升模型的下游任务准确率与推理可靠性。

title: InstantForget: Update-Free Backdoor Unlearning with Inference-Time Feature Reset
summary: Backdoor unlearning aims to remove a malicious trigger behavior from a deployed model while preserving clean utility. We study the update-free inference-time setting, where model parameters remain frozen. First, we audit a common projection assumption under oracle paired clean and triggered features. Projection succeeds mainly on BadNets and leaves WaNet, Blended, and SIG at 0.683, 0.888, and 0.941 ASR on CIFAR-10 ResNet-18. This failure is not explained by spectral compactness, spatial locality, or subspace misalignment. It is predicted by a logit-triplet gap involving the target margin, target-logit drop, and non-target logit rise. We then introduce InstantForget, a clean-calibrated gated reset that flags anomalous features with a Mahalanobis score and moves only flagged features toward a neutral non-target representation. With one fixed operating point selected on held-out triggered validation, InstantForget reduces average ASR to 0.071 across four non-adaptive CIFAR-10 triggers without triggered samples or parameter updates at deployment. It also reaches 0.981 detection AUROC and transfers to six of eight tested backbones. Reported failures under WaNet, ModelNet10 point blend, two backbone geometries, and adaptive feature-compactness attacks define the method's scope.

AI.tldr: 针对后门移除难题，本文提出 InstantForget 在模型推理时通过特征检测与重置来中和后门攻击，无需参数调整，在多种场景下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在部署阶段，针对参数冻结的已部署模型，如何有效且低成本地移除后门触发行为，同时保持模型的原始分类性能。
AI.method: 提出 InstantForget 方法：利用马氏距离（Mahalanobis score）识别异常特征，将 flagged 特征向中性非目标表征偏移；且全程保持模型参数冻结（不需要反向传播或训练）。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，平均攻击成功率（ASR）从基准降至 0.071，检测 AUC 达到 0.981；该方法在多数骨干网络上具有通用性，但在 WaNet 等复杂触发器及自适应攻击下存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了 InstantForget 方法，通过马氏距离检测异常特征并将其重置为中性表征，在无需参数更新和触发样本的情况下，有效缓解了推理阶段的后门攻击，同时指出了该方法在处理自适应攻击及复杂几何分布数据时的局限性。

title: ATOM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Atomic Skills and Compositional Generalization in Manipulation Policies
summary: Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but their real-world generalization remains difficult to diagnose. A policy may succeed on demonstrated tasks while still failing to execute fine-grained atomic skills or recombine learned skills in new task structures. We introduce \textbf{ATOM-Bench}, a real-world benchmark for evaluating both atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies. ATOM-Bench factorizes tabletop manipulation into motor atoms and instruction atoms, and contains 30 atomic tasks and 24 held-out compositional tasks across paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks. We collect 3,000 human demonstrations for atomic fine-tuning and release both the demonstration data and evaluation rollout data to support reproducible real-world evaluation. Policies are fine-tuned on atomic tasks and evaluated on both atomic skill acquisition and held-out compositional tasks. We further introduce Atomic Score (AS) and Compositional Failure Share (CFS) to distinguish failures caused by weak atomic skills from failures caused by limited compositional reuse. Through 2,700 physical rollouts on five representative manipulation policies, we find that current policies can acquire simple instruction-grounding skills, but still struggle with fine-grained motor atoms, counting, and logical filtering. More importantly, strong atomic performance does not reliably transfer to held-out compositional tasks. ATOM-Bench provides a diagnostic testbed for studying whether failures arise from weak motor execution, poor instruction grounding, or limited compositional reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ATOM-Bench 基准，首次系统量化了机器人策略在“细粒度原子运动”和“组合任务泛化”两方面的能力，通过专门设计的评价指标帮助研究人员定位机器人模型是“技能没学会”还是“不会灵活重组”。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人操纵策略（通用基础模型）在处理细粒度原子技能或在新任务结构中重组已学技能时效果不佳，但缺乏有效的诊断工具来区分到底是哪一环节出了问题。因此，需要一个专门的基准来评估机器人的原子技能水平及其组合泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为 ATOM-Bench 的真实物理世界测评基准。该基准将桌面操纵任务拆解为“运动原子”和“指令原子”，包含 30 项原子任务和 24 项保持不变的组合任务（涵盖单/双臂）。同时引入了“原子分（AS）”和“组合失败份额（CFS）”两个评价指标，用于诊断模型失败的根本原因（是原子技能不足还是组合能力受限）。此外，该研究提供了 3,000 条人工示范数据及 2,700 次物理实测数据供复现评价。
AI.result: 通过对五种代表性操纵策略进行 2,700 次物理实测，发现当前模型在原子技能学习和组合任务泛化上存在差异化瓶颈，证实了原子性能优异并不意味着具备可靠的组合泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 现有的通用机器人操纵策略在获取指令引导技能方面表现尚可，但在处理细粒度运动原子、计数和逻辑过滤方面仍存在显著困难。此外，强大的单一原子技能表现并不等同于在组合任务中的泛化能力，提示研究界需从原子技能获取与组合能力两个维度分别优化。

title: Weaving Multi-Source Evidence for Biomedical Reasoning: The BioMedHop Benchmark and BioWeave Framework
summary: Biomedical question answering (QA) increasingly requires reasoning over interacting entities, where supporting evidence is scattered across biomedical knowledge graphs, literature documents, and web-accessible resources. However, existing biomedical QA benchmarks mainly focus on exam-style knowledge, literature comprehension, or short-range multi-hop inference, leaving source-conditioned graph reasoning and evidence topology construction underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BioMedHop, a multi-source graph-grounded benchmark for evaluating biomedical reasoning over structured evidence topologies. BioMedHop contains 10,045 instances across KG, document, web, and hybrid evidence settings, covering shared-neighbor matching, intersection reasoning, path-based reasoning, and counting, with option-based, open-ended, and numeric count renderings. To support this benchmark, we further propose BioWeave, a source-aware reasoning framework that retrieves biomedical KG paths, gathers supporting clues from documents and web sources, assembles them into a unified evidence graph, and verifies answers through entity-level evidence support. Comprehensive experiments show that BioWeave achieves the best overall performance among compared methods on BioMedHop, outperforming the strong hybrid baseline ToG-2 by 10.5% in the overall average. Moreover, BioWeave consistently improves different LLM backbones and enables smaller models, such as Qwen3-4B, to achieve reasoning performance comparable to GPT-4-Turbo.

AI.tldr: 本文推出了 BioMedHop 基准以填补复杂生物医学多源推理的空白，并提出了 BioWeave 框架，该框架通过构建统一证据图实现了优于现有主流模型的高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学问答基准大多局限于单点知识、文献理解或简单的多跳推理，缺乏对多源环境下的复杂图推理及证据拓扑构建的评估。因此，亟需一个能够跨越知识图谱、文献和Web资源的综合性推理基准及配套框架。
AI.method: 提出了多源图基准测试 BioMedHop，并开发了 BioWeave 推理框架。BioWeave 包含三个核心步骤：1) 检索生物医学知识图谱路径；2) 从文献与网络源搜集线索；3) 将上述信息组装为统一证据图，并进行实体级证据支持验证。
AI.result: BioWeave 在 BioMedHop 上的整体平均表现比最强基准 ToG-2 高出 10.5%。实验表明，BioWeave 能显著增强多个 LLM 主干模型的性能，使如 Qwen3-4B 等小参数模型达到与 GPT-4-Turbo 相当的推理水平。
AI.conclusion: BioWeave 框架在 BioMedHop 基准测试中展现了卓越的推理能力，显著优于现有基线方法，并证明了通过整合多源异构证据构建统一推理图对于解决复杂生物医学问题的有效性。此外，该框架能显著提升不同规模大模型的逻辑推理能力。

title: Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multimodal Learning
summary:
This paper addresses the missing-modality challenge in multi-modal learning by introducing Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multi-Modal Learning (UL4M4), a flexible framework that imputes missing feature embeddings in a task-independent manner before supervised prediction. We propose modality-specific
  normalization and a novel partial-modality distance metric to enable fair clustering of incomplete observations, capturing cross-modal structures while preserving scale-invariance across varying dimensionalities and modality counts. Cluster centers from this unsupervised stage guide an iterative greedy imputation process for any
  missing modalities during training or inference, supporting arbitrary numbers of modalities and arbitrary missing patterns per sample. The imputation module is lightweight, uses frozen encoders, and decouples from the downstream task, allowing easy integration with any fusion/prediction architecture. Extensive experiments under diverse and highly incomplete regimes demonstrate UL4M4's robustness, achieving, to
  the best of our knowledge, the first consistent F1-Micro scores above 0.7 on challenging missing configurations even when more than 50\% of modality slots are missing. Results are also stable across cluster sizes and significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available here: https://github.com/h-ismkhan/Multimodal-Learning-with-Missing-Modalities-via-Unsupervised-Learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UL4M4 框架，通过无监督的聚类指导迭代贪婪填充，有效解决了多模态学习中的模态缺失问题，具有高鲁棒性与架构通用性。
AI.motivation: 解决多模态学习中存在的模态缺失挑战，特别是如何在缺乏监督信号的前提下，为任意缺失模式提供一种与任务无关（task-independent）且灵活通用的特征填充方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 UL4M4 的框架，包含：1. 模态特定归一化和部分模态距离度量（实现缺失数据下的公平聚类）；2. 基于聚类中心的迭代贪婪填充机制（支持任意缺失模式和多模态组合）；3. 冻结编码器与下游任务解耦的轻量化设计。
AI.result: 在多种高缺失率配置下，F1-Micro 分数首次稳定超过 0.7，显著优于现有最先进的基线方法，且结果对聚类规模具有良好的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: UL4M4 是一种有效且灵活的缺失模态填充框架，能够与多种下游架构无缝集成，在极高缺失率（>50%）的情况下仍表现出卓越的鲁棒性和性能，并达到了多模态缺失学习领域的新基准。

title: Video-Based Optimal Transport for Feedback-Efficient Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Conveying complex objectives to reinforcement learning (RL) agents often requires meticulous reward engineering. Preference-based RL (PbRL) offers a promising alternative by learning reward functions from human feedback, but its scalability is hindered by high labeling costs. Inspired by advances in Video Foundation Models (ViFMs), we present Video-based Optimal Transport Preference (VOTP), a semi-supervised framework that learns effective reward functions from only a handful of labels. By leveraging optimal transport to align visual trajectories within the rich representation space of ViFMs, VOTP effectively generates high-fidelity pseudo-labels for large amounts of unlabeled data, substantially reducing human supervision. Extensive experiments across locomotion and manipulation benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of VOTP, which outperforms state-of-the-art offline PbRL methods under limited feedback budgets. We also showcase the robustness of VOTP in the presence of visual distractors and validate its utility on real robotic tasks, where it learns meaningful rewards with minimal human input.

AI.tldr: VOTP 是一种新型半监督偏好强化学习框架，通过利用视频基础模型和最优传输技术，仅需极少量人类反馈即可从大量无标注数据中学习高质量奖励函数。
AI.motivation: 偏好强化学习（PbRL）虽然省去了繁琐的奖励工程，但存在高昂的人类标注成本问题，难以扩展到复杂任务。
AI.method: 提出了一种半监督框架 VOTP：1. 利用视频基础模型（ViFMs）提取丰富的视觉特征表示；2. 结合最优传输（Optimal Transport）算法对视觉轨迹进行对齐并生成高置信度的伪标签；3. 利用这些伪标签减少对真实人类反馈的依赖，从而高效学习奖励函数。
AI.result: 实验证明在运动和操作基准测试中，VOTP 在有限的人类反馈预算下优于当前的离线 PbRL SOTA 方法；同时展示了其在视觉干扰环境下的鲁棒性以及在现实机器人任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VOTP 通过整合视频基础模型（ViFMs）和最优传输（Optimal Transport），成功解决了偏好强化学习中昂贵的标注成本问题，在有限的人类反馈预算下表现出卓越的性能和强大的现实应用潜力。

title: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
summary: Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framework for multi-turn tool-use agents. The key idea is to use expert traces only as training-time optimization signals rather than rollout-time hints. PACT keeps rollout generation prompt-only, then uses expert traces to guide optimization through two complementary signals: a trace-conditioned RL surrogate that evaluates prompt-only rollouts under expert-trace context, and a component-aware SFT loss that supervises reasoning prefixes and tool-calls with annealed strength. To reduce over-reliance on the training-only trace context, PACT further introduces a prompt-only anchoring. We also provide a latent-trace view that connects the two trace-based objectives and explains how expert traces can guide optimization without being used during rollout generation. Experiments on FTRL, BFCL, and ToolHop show that PACT consistently improves over strong SFT- and RL-based baselines, highlighting the value of privileged trace co-training for multi-turn tool-use learning.

AI.tldr: PACT 是一种多轮工具使用代理的协同训练框架，通过在训练期引入特权专家轨迹进行优化引导，同时保持推理期的纯提示输入，解决了 RL 奖励稀疏与 SFT 过度约束的问题。
AI.motivation: 多转工具使用代理的训练面临挑战：强化学习（RL）存在稀疏奖励和信用分配问题，而监督微调（SFT）通过专家轨迹提供过程监督但容易导致模型过度拟合固定路径，限制了模型的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出了 PACT（特权轨迹协同训练）框架，包括：1. 轨迹条件化的强化学习代理（Trace-conditioned RL surrogate），评估无提示推理过程；2. 组件感知监督微调损失（Component-aware SFT loss），对推理前缀和工具调用进行退火强度监督；3. 无提示锚定（Prompt-only anchoring），减少对轨迹上下文的过度依赖。
AI.result: 在 FTRL、BFCL 和 ToolHop 基准测试中，PACT 表现均优于强 SFT 和 RL 基线，证明了利用特权轨迹进行协同训练在多轮工具使用学习中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PACT 通过利用特权专家轨迹作为优化信号而非推理提示，成功平衡了推理灵活性与奖励引导，在多轮工具使用任务中显著优于传统的 SFT 和 RL 基线。

title: From Correlation to Causation in Lane Change Prediction for Automated Driving: A Causal Explanation Framework
summary: Lane-change prediction is a central task in intelligent vehicles, where early maneuver anticipation can support safer decision-making. However, many existing approaches mainly learn statistical associations between observed driving variables and future maneuvers, while overlooking the causal dependencies among the input variables themselves. This limits interpretability, especially when physically related variables such as longitudinal gap, relative longitudinal velocity, and Time-To-Collision (TTC) are treated as independent flat inputs. This article presents a causal-inference-based framework for lane-change prediction and explanation. The proposed approach combines linguistic feature construction, expert-constrained causal discovery, deep structural causal modeling with Deep End-to-end Causal Inference (DECI), intervention-based effect analysis, refutation testing, and recursive causal-chain explanation. The objective is not only to predict the future maneuver, but also to identify candidate variables that directly contribute to the prediction, the upstream factors influencing them, and the causal chains through which these effects propagate. The framework achieves average F1-scores above 95% during the first three seconds before the lane-marking crossing event. Beyond prediction accuracy, the framework uses intervention-based effect analysis to distinguish influential from weakly influential variables under the learned causal structure. It further distinguishes candidate direct contributors from mediated effects and generates contrastive causal-chain explanations that clarify why the predicted maneuver is favored and why the alternative maneuvers are less supported. The main contribution is therefore a mechanism-aware lane-change prediction pipeline that moves beyond correlation-based classification toward more interpretable causal reasoning for maneuver prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于因果推理的换道预测与解释框架，通过深度结构因果模型替代单纯的相关性学习，在实现高精度预测的同时（F1 > 95%），通过因果链分析和干预实验提供了深度可解释的决策依据。
AI.motivation: 现有的换道预测方法多依赖驱动变量与机动之间的统计相关性，忽视了变量间的因果依赖关系，导致模型缺乏解释力，无法理清物理变量（如纵向间距、相对速度等）对换道行为的内在影响机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合多种因果推理技术的框架，具体包括：1. 语言特征构建；2. 专家约束的因果发现；3. 深度结构因果模型（DECI）；4. 基于干预的效果分析；5. 反驳测试（refutation testing）；6. 递归因果链解释。
AI.result: 该框架在换道标记跨越事件发生前3秒的预测任务中，平均F1分数超过95%。此外，模型能有效区分强/弱影响变量，识别因果链，并生成对比性的因果解释，说明为何支持预测的机动而否定其他机动。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种机制感知（mechanism-aware）的换道预测框架，将换道预测从基于相关性的分类提升到了基于因果推理的解释性决策，显著增强了自动驾驶决策的可解释性和鲁棒性。

title: ExoTraj: A General Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance Policy for Complex Environments
summary: Adaptive torque prediction in dynamic exoskeleton scenarios requires expensive motion capture systems, which are infeasible in complex outdoor environments. Trajectory prediction has emerged as one of the effective approaches to address such an issue. However, the core challenges of exoskeleton trajectory prediction are twofold: establishing the mapping from multi-modal features to trajectory information; constructing the mapping from trajectory to torque. For the former, most existing methods perform only single-step prediction and neglect inter-subject trajectory variability, thereby limiting the trajectory optimization space and prediction generalization. To address this, this paper proposes a fast flow matching method that enables accurate trajectory prediction and better generalization for real-time performance, where trajectory generation errors and encoded observations are used to guide the training direction. For the second challenge, due to the high dynamics of the human-robot system and the strong coupling between perception and control, simple control methods struggle to achieve efficient assistance based on the predicted trajectory.
