This paper utilizes model predictive control and designs a novel optimization objective to optimize torque, ensuring the exoskeleton achieves comfortable and robust assistance. By integrating the above two components, the unified policy, denoted as ExoTraj, is developed to enable adaptive assistance in complex outdoor scenarios without high data acquisition cost. Experimental results show that compared to traditional methods, ExoTraj reduces cross-subject prediction error by 14.0% during the online phase and maintains robustness against external noise. Relative to the zero torque condition, ExoTraj decreases metabolic rate by 11.5-24.4%, heart rate by 1.7-19.5%, and peak muscle activation levels by 10.9-41.3%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExoTraj框架，通过流匹配轨迹预测与模型预测控制（MPC）的结合，解决了外骨骼在复杂户外环境中由于缺乏昂贵感知设备而导致的辅助适应性不足的问题，实现了高效且鲁棒的实时辅助。
AI.motivation: 现有的外骨骼适应性力矩预测依赖昂贵的动捕系统，难以应对复杂的户外环境；现有的预测方法存在单步预测局限性、跨对象泛化能力差及人机系统紧耦合导致控制效率低等问题。
AI.method: 1. 轨迹预测：采用快速流匹配（fast flow matching）方法，利用轨迹生成误差和编码观测值引导训练，解决多模态特征映射及单步预测的局限性；2. 力矩控制：结合模型预测控制（MPC）并设计新型优化目标，解决人机系统高动态耦合下的辅助效率问题。
AI.result: 与传统方法相比，ExoTraj将在线预测误差降低了14.0%，具备良好的抗噪性能；相较于零力矩模式，该方法显著降低了代谢率（11.5-24.4%）、心率（1.7-19.5%）及峰值肌肉激活度（10.9-41.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一套统一的策略框架ExoTraj，证明了在无需昂贵动捕设备的情况下，通过结合流匹配轨迹预测与模型预测控制，能够实现复杂户外场景下的实时、鲁棒且高效的外骨骼辅助。

title: Creative Collision: Directorial Persona Steering and Competition in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Co-Creativity
summary: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful tool for shaping the behaviour of large language models at inference time, yet most prior work injects a \emph{single} semantic direction into the residual stream. We study the richer setting in which two semantically opposing steering vectors are superimposed -- a regime we call \textbf{Creative Collision}. Concretely, we construct directorial persona vectors for Steven Spielberg (optimistic, redemptive moral valence) and Martin Scorsese (dark, morally ambiguous) via mean-difference activation contrast on curated screenplay-derived corpora, then interpolate between them with a scalar mixing parameter $α\in [0,1]$ and a steering coefficient $λ$. Across five evaluation axes -- moral valence, generation coherence, surface style, directional dominance, and vector geometry -- three principal findings emerge: (i)~Spielberg's representational signature exhibits robust \emph{directional dominance}, suppressing Scorsese's moral influence across almost the entire interpolation range; (ii)~intermediate collision points paradoxically \emph{improve} generation coherence relative to pure single-director steering at high $λ$; and (iii)~both personas localise maximally to layer~28 of a 40-layer decoder-only transformer, revealing a shared \emph{moral-tone substrate}. These results illuminate the geometry of competing semantic directions in transformer residual streams and have direct implications for controllable creative generation and value-aligned narrative synthesis.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了在大语言模型中叠加两个对立“导演人格”激活向量（创意碰撞）的效果，发现斯皮尔伯格的道德倾向具有主导性，且向量混合能在保持控制的同时提升生成连贯性，并定位到了模型中负责抽象道德基调的特定层级。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导（Activation steering）方法多局限于单一语义方向。论文旨在探索将两个语义对立的转向向量叠加（“创意碰撞”）时，模型行为如何演变，以及这种机制在可控创意生成和价值对齐叙事合成中的潜力。
AI.method: 通过均值差异激活对比（mean-difference activation contrast）构建史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格和马丁·斯科塞斯的导演人格向量，采用线性插值（混合参数α）和标量转向系数（λ）在残差流中进行叠加（即“创意碰撞”），并在五大轴向（道德效价、生成连贯性、表面风格、方向主导性、向量几何）进行评估。
AI.result: (1) 斯皮尔伯格的表征在插值范围内具有显著的“方向主导性”，压制了斯科塞斯的道德影响；(2) 在高系数λ下，中间的碰撞点反而改善了生成的一致性；(3) 两种人格向量均在40层Transformer的第28层达到峰值，表明模型存在共享的“道德基调基质”。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了Transformer残差流中竞争语义方向的几何结构。通过“创意碰撞”（Creative Collision）实验，发现不同角色向量存在共享的“道德基调基质”（moral-tone substrate），且通过混合两种对立的转向向量可以在保持方向主导地位的同时，优化生成的一致性（coherence）。

title: SGM-SLAM: Scene Graph Matching for Data-Efficient Distributed SLAM
summary: We introduce a data-efficient distributed Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) framework designed for a team of robots equipped with LiDAR, cameras, and inertial sensors. Our framework uses scene graph matching to identify inter-robot measurement constraints. Unlike prior approaches that rely on feature-level matching, our framework is the first to perform scene graph matching using only object labels and centroids. Our approach constructs a scene graph by using fused RGB-LiDAR point clouds to generate both a semantically segmented point cloud layer, and a layer of discrete bounded objects, to accompany estimated robot trajectories. Scene graph matching is performed collaboratively through exchanging and matching object data with neighboring robots. To maximize communication efficiency, we utilize a multi-step data exchange and optimization process. We demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach using both simulation and real-world datasets collected by legged robots in indoor and outdoor environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种首创的使用对象标签和质心进行场景图匹配的分布式SLAM框架，通过多步优化策略实现了低带宽需求下的高效多机器人协同感知。
AI.motivation: 现有的多机器人SLAM方法多依赖于特征级匹配，通信成本高且对算力要求大；现有方案缺乏一种能在数据效率与感知精度之间取得平衡的框架。
AI.method: 1. 构建场景图：融合RGB-LiDAR点云，生成语义分层点云及离散对象层；2. 分布式匹配：在机器人间交换对象标签和质心，通过场景图匹配识别跨机器人约束；3. 通信优化：采用多步数据交换与优化机制以最大程度减少带宽占用。
AI.result: 成功实现了仅依赖对象标签和质心的协作定位与建图；在实验中证明了该框架在机器人团队中具有高度的通信效率和良好的环境适应性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于场景图匹配的分布式SLAM框架，通过仅利用对象标签和质心进行匹配，在保持通信效率的同时实现了跨机器人协作建图，在室内外环境下验证了其鲁棒性与高效性。

title: Who Should Lead Decoding Now? Tracking Reliable Trajectories for Ensembling Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have emerged as a distinct paradigm for sequence generation. As MDLMs become diverse in capabilities and knowledge coverage, an important question is how to combine their knowledge. Toward this, we first investigate the unique decoding dynamics of MDLMs. We find that successful generations exhibit stable confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions, while unreliable trajectories can often be corrected by injecting promising intermediate states from other models. Guided by this observation, we propose $\textbf{TIE}$ ($\textbf{T}$rajectory-based $\textbf{I}$terative $\textbf{E}$nsembling), a knowledge fusion framework in which MDLMs iteratively identify reliable decoding trajectories and relay them across models. TIE tracks confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions to determine which model currently follows a more reliable trajectory and selectively transfers partially denoised sequences across models. As the model on the more promising trajectory often changes across denoising steps, TIE allows different models to contribute complementary strengths at different stages of generation. Strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, along with our analyses, suggests that TIE offers a practical approach to the underexplored problem of MDLM ensembling.

AI.tldr: 本文针对掩码扩散语言模型提出了 TIE 集成框架，通过在去噪迭代过程中实时评估模型轨迹的置信度，动态整合多个模型的预测结果，显著提升了模型在复杂推理任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）的多样化，如何有效整合不同模型的知识以提升序列生成性能，是一个亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 TIE (Trajectory-based Iterative Ensembling) 的知识融合框架。该方法追踪生成过程在答案相关位点上的置信度动态，识别各阶段表现最可靠的模型轨迹，并以此为导向在不同模型间交互地转移和注入部分去噪序列。
AI.result: 实验证明，TIE 在多种推理任务中均表现出色，有效地捕捉到了不同模型在生成阶段的互补性，证实了其作为一种 MDLM 集成方案的可行性。
AI.conclusion: TIE 框架为掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）提供了一种有效的融合策略，通过在去噪过程中动态选择最可靠的轨迹并进行跨模型转移，实现了不同模型间优势互补的效果。

title: Visualizing Uncertainty: Spatial Maps of Missing and Conflicting Evidence in Deep Learning
summary: Understanding when and why deep neural networks are uncertain is crucial for deploying reliable machine learning systems in safety-critical domains. While existing uncertainty quantification methods provide scalar measures of model confidence, they offer limited insight into which spatial regions of an input contribute to different types of uncertainty. We propose a novel visualization framework, Uncertainty Activation Map (UAM), that combines Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) with Full-Gradient Class Activation Mapping (FullGrad) to generate interpretable spatial uncertainty activation maps. Our approach distinguishes between two fundamental types of uncertainty: vacuity, representing lack of evidence, and dissonance, capturing conflicting evidence between competing hypotheses. By leveraging the complete gradient decomposition property of FullGrad and the principled uncertainty quantification of Subjective Logic, our method produces theoretically grounded visualizations that highlight specific image regions responsible for model uncertainty. With this framework, vacuity and dissonance activation maps are generated by computing belief-weighted attributions, enabling identification of where models lack knowledge versus where they encounter ambiguous evidence. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively addresses the critical gap between uncertainty quantification and explainability, providing intuitive visual feedback to assess model reliability in complex visual recognition tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合证据深度学习与全梯度技术的不确定性激活图（UAM）框架，通过可视化手段将输入空间的模型不确定性清晰划分为“证据缺失”与“证据冲突”，从而提高了深度学习模型在关键领域的可解释性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的不确定性量化方法多为标量输出，缺乏对输入空间中导致不确定性的具体区域的解释能力，难以满足安全关键领域的可靠性需求。
AI.method: 结合证据深度学习（EDL）与全梯度类激活映射（FullGrad），提出了一种名为“不确定性激活图（UAM）”的框架。通过计算信念加权后的归因，将不确定性分解为“空缺（缺乏证据）”和“冲突（证据矛盾）”两种类型，并利用FullGrad的梯度分解属性实现空间可视化。
AI.result: 通过在多个基准数据集上的广泛评估，证实了UAM能够准确地定位导致模型产生空缺或冲突不确定性的图像区域，实现了不确定性量化的可解释化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功填补了不确定性量化与可解释性之间的空白，提供了一种能明确区分“空缺不确定性（Vacuity）”与“冲突不确定性（Dissonance）”的可视化框架（UAM），为评估复杂视觉任务中的模型可靠性提供了直观、理论扎实的工具。

title: LOPAL: Local Performance-Aware Active Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RAL), 2026
summary: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) enables intuitive robot skill acquisition by allowing robots to learn directly from human task demonstrations. However, current methods often fail to address the fact that due to suboptimal and inconsistent human behavior, the quality of the demonstration can vary within each demonstration. Therefore, we introduce LOPAL (LOcal Performance-aware Active Learning), an active learning approach that leverages this local demonstration quality information. Our approach consists of two synergistic components. First, a local performance-driven LfD method uses a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to encode both the demonstrated trajectories and their associated local quality assessments. This enables the generation of trajectories that outperform the imperfect demonstrations by utilizing complementary local data of high performance. Second, active data acquisition allows to improve beyond the imperfect demonstrations by collecting additional informative samples. In areas missing good data, the user is actively requested to provide corrections through a shared autonomy (SA) mechanism, while the robot autonomously executes the learned behavior. The efficacy of LOPAL was validated in both a simulation and a real-world experiment. The results from a real-world pipe inspection task showed that the proposed approach can achieve up to 27.31 % improvement in task performance while also reducing the effort required to collect the demonstrations.

AI.tldr: LOPAL 是一种结合局部质量评估与主动学习的 LfD 框架，通过识别并优化演示数据中的性能瓶颈，并利用共享自治机制进行修正，从而实现比人类原演示更好的机器人表现。
AI.motivation: 人类演示数据往往存在不一致性和次优性（suboptimal），导致机器人模仿学习的效果受限，且现有的 LfD 方法缺乏对演示内局部质量差异的感知与处理。
AI.method: 1. 局部性能驱动的 LfD：利用高斯混合模型（GMM）对轨迹及其局部质量评估进行编码，通过加权融合高质量局部数据来优化轨迹；2. 主动学习与共享自治（SA）：在模型性能不足区域主动向用户请求修正，结合机器人自主规划，实现样本采集的效率最大化。
AI.result: 在模拟环境及真实管道检测任务中验证了该方法，任务表现提升了 27.31%，同时减少了演示者所需的交互工作量。
AI.conclusion: LOPAL 有效地利用局部性能评估来提升机器人学习效果，不仅在任务成功率上实现了显著提升（高达 27.31%），还降低了人工演示的负担，实现人机协同优化。

title: HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents rely on memory mechanisms to compress interaction history, but optimizing memory writing faces a distinct credit assignment challenge: a memory update may be rewarded or penalized due to downstream tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution. This causally entangled credit can lead agents to discard useful evidence or preserve irrelevant information. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework for assigning less-entangled credit to memory-writing actions in long-horizon agents. HiMPO first estimates the local utility of a memory update by comparing the task-relevant information recoverable from the previous and updated memories under the same pre-write state. It then uses hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter that attenuates memory credit when local utility is not supported by the target outcome. The resulting memory-specific advantage is applied only to memory tokens, while trajectory-level rewards optimize the rest of the agent behavior. Across judge-based open-domain tasks and objective compressive-memory QA, HiMPO improves over strong memory-based and RL-based baselines while preserving compressed-context efficiency. Controlled interventions further show that HiMPO reduces blame leakage from tool-induced errors and improves attribution fidelity of memory updates.

AI.tldr: 针对长周期智能体记忆更新带来的复杂信用分配问题，HiMPO通过局部效用评估与事后回溯过滤，实现了对内存写入行为的精准优化，有效提升了智能体的决策质量和信息留存能力。
AI.motivation: 长周期智能体在记忆压缩过程中面临信用分配难题：内存写入的成败往往受噪声观测、工具接口调用失败或后续逻辑错误的影响，导致智能体无法准确评估记忆更新本身的价值，从而倾向于保留无效信息或丢弃关键证据。
AI.method: 提出HiMPO（事后知情记忆策略优化）框架：1. 利用“局部效用”评估：通过重构对比前后的内存信息来估计记忆更新的即时贡献；2. 引入“事后相关性”过滤器：基于最终任务结果对局部效用进行回溯性约束；3. 差异化信用分配：将记忆专用优势（memory-specific advantage）仅应用于内存令牌，将全局轨迹奖励用于常规行为优化。
AI.result: 在基于评审的开放域任务和客观压缩记忆问答任务中，HiMPO的表现优于强基准模型；受控实验表明，HiMPO有效减少了因工具错误导致的“归因泄露”，提高了对内存更新贡献度归因的准确性。
AI.conclusion: HiMPO通过解耦内存写入操作的信用分配，显著提升了长周期智能体在复杂环境下的任务成功率和记忆利用效率，验证了事后回顾机制在处理因果纠缠信用分配问题上的有效性。

title: Bayesian Networks with Latent Time Embedding for Stage-Aware Causal Modeling of Alzheimer's Disease Progression
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression is often described through the amyloid-tau-neurodegeneration, or AT(N), cascade. However, most longitudinal models represent this cascade either as a fixed sequence of biomarkers or as a black-box forecasting task. This makes it difficult to determine when biologically guided biomarker relationships influence future regional pathology. In this study, we introduce Bayesian Networks with Latent Time Embedding (BN-LTE), a Bayesian structural framework for stage-aware modeling of AD progression. BN-LTE estimates disease pseudotime from baseline biomarker profiles and constrains directed dependencies according to biologically plausible AT(N) ordering. Posterior spline-varying structural equations are then used to link initial multimodal measurements with future annualized regional tau-PET change. Across repeated subject-disjoint evaluations using ADNI data, BN-LTE shows strong spatial reconstruction of tau progression compared with the included forecasting baselines. Beyond spatial reconstruction, BN-LTE recovers posterior stage-varying AT(N)-constrained effects and identifies a mid-pseudotime window of amyloid sensitivity. This window is supported by model-implied g-formula contrasts, root-adjusted AIPW, mechanism-sensitive ablations, and robustness analyses across spline and prior specifications. Overall, these findings position BN-LTE as a Bayesian structural framework for forecasting tau progression while examining stage-dependent AT(N)-cascade mechanisms in observational longitudinal neuroimaging data. Our code is available at https://github.com/danleneurocom/BN-LTE.

AI.tldr: BN-LTE 是一种融合生物学假设的贝叶斯结构模型，它通过潜在时间嵌入技术，既能高精度预测 AD 患者的 tau 蛋白病理演变，又能通过机制分析揭示淀粉样蛋白在 AD 进展过程中的关键驱动窗口。
AI.motivation: 现有的 AD 进展模型要么假设固定的生物标志物序列，要么作为黑箱预测任务，难以分析生物学指导的生物标志物关系如何具体影响未来的区域病理变化。
AI.method: 提出“具有潜在时间嵌入的贝叶斯网络”（BN-LTE）模型：1. 基于基线基准资料估计疾病伪时间；2. 根据 AT(N) 生物学假设约束有向依从关系；3. 利用后验样条可变结构方程将多模态基线测量与未来的年度 tau-PET 变化关联。
AI.result: 在 ADNI 数据集上的实验表明：BN-LTE 在 tau 蛋白进展的空间重构方面优于现有的预测基准模型；成功提取了阶段性的 AT(N) 约束效应，并识别出一个淀粉样蛋白敏感性的“伪时间中期窗口”。
AI.conclusion: BN-LTE 提供了一个有效的贝叶斯结构框架来模拟阿尔茨海默病（AD）的进展，不仅能高精度地预测 tau 蛋白空间进展，还能识别特定阶段的生物学机制（如淀粉样蛋白的敏感窗口），弥补了现有模型在生物学可解释性上的不足。

title: Binary Tracking for Spatial QA and Navigation with Open Vision-Language Models
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://ndb796.github.io/BinaryTracking ; Code and dataset: https://github.com/ndb796/BinaryTracking
summary: This work addresses spatial question answering for service robots traversing long egocentric routes. Given a query such as "where can I find a dry cleaner on the way back home?", the system returns a metric coordinate that downstream navigation components can act on. Prior Spatial Question Answering approaches leverage retrieval-augmented agents built on closed-source models such as GPT-4o for path exploration. However, robots operating in the real world often cannot reliably depend on online closed-source models due to network instability, communication latency, and deployment cost. It creates a need for open-source based Spatial Question Answering approaches that can run onboard the robot, yet prior research in this direction remains limited. This work proposes BinTrack, a simple yet effective, fully open-source spatial-localization agent that leverages the temporal ordering of a robot's trajectory. BinTrack performs a binary search over the trajectory segments between two anchor landmarks identified from a query. It improves overall accuracy by up to 22.8% over other open-source implementations and even matches the reported closed-source model result on the global category of the SpaceLocQA benchmark, the most challenging setting that has so far required strong reasoning agents such as GPT-4o. Furthermore, its optimized inference strategy consistently yields more than a 1.5x inference speedup over previous approaches. Finally, this work releases GangnamLoop, a novel and practical multi-trip outdoor benchmark collected by deploying a real quadruped robot on public streets with the anonymization policy. It revisits the same locations under different outdoor conditions and pairs the robot's low viewpoint with the human owner's. The source codes and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/ndb796/BinaryTracking

AI.tldr: 针对机器人空间问答对闭源模型的依赖问题，本文提出了 BinTrack，这是一种高效的开源二分搜索定位方法，在保持高性能的同时显著提升了推理速度，并公开了真实场景下的户外导航数据集 GangnamLoop。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间问答方法多依赖 GPT-4o 等闭源模型，无法满足现实世界机器人对低延迟、离线运行和低成本部署的需求，而现有的开源方案性能有限。
AI.method: 提出 BinTrack 方法：一种完全开源的板载空间定位代理。它通过识别查询中的两个锚点地标，并在其轨迹段之间执行二分搜索（Binary Search）来精确定位目标位置，优化了推理效率。
AI.result: BinTrack 在 SpaceLocQA 基准测试中将精度提升了最高 22.8%，在全局类别上达到了闭源模型的水平，推理速度较现有方法提升了 1.5 倍以上；同时提出了全新的户外多行程基准测试集 GangnamLoop。
AI.conclusion: BinTrack 证明了利用轨迹的时间顺序进行简单的二分搜索，可以以更低的推理成本实现与大型闭源模型相媲美的空间问答性能。GangnamLoop 数据集的发布为户外机器人长期导航和空间定位研究提供了重要的基准。

title: PaperJury: Due-Process Review for Bounded LaTeX Revision
summary: Pre-submission hardening of human-authored LaTeX computer science papers differs from drafting assistance because it requires adversarial whole-paper review, explicit no-fix outcomes, and bounded artifact-safe revision. Existing writing assistants, critique generators, and judge-centered loops lack durable issue identity across rounds, deterministic routing from critique to adjudication, and manuscript control that can reject invalid concerns or defer author-dependent ones. We present PaperJury, a closed-loop review-verdict-revise-verify system built on a deterministic-versus-semantic split: deterministic orchestration manages decomposition, a frozen claim spine, a durable ledger, routing, stopping, and exact-once patch application, while semantic agents are limited to bounded review, judgment, and repair. PaperJury combines bounded holistic review, contestability-based routing, a due-process trial, and risk-proportional guard chains for anchor-bounded edits, yielding terminal outcomes of invalid-drop, valid-fixable, and author-required. In a two-arm expert-review evaluation on held-out Vision, natural language processing, and machine learning papers against four baselines, we assess issue quality, verdict and routing quality, edit safety, convergence behavior, and cost, supporting the thesis that load-bearing safety and completion logic should reside in deterministic orchestration rather than model discretion. PaperJury is available at https://github.com/u7079256/paperjury.

AI.tldr: 针对计算机科学论文的发布前“硬化”需求，PaperJury通过确定性编排与语义模型分离的闭环架构，实现了对论文评审、裁决、修订与验证的全流程控制，有效解决了当前AI辅助工具在逻辑稳定性、编辑安全和争议处理上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的写作助手和审稿工具缺乏跨轮次的议题稳定性、从批评到裁决的确定性路径，以及对无效或作者依赖性建议的控制机制。需要一种能够进行“对抗性硬化”而非单纯辅助写作的闭环系统。
AI.method: 提出了PaperJury系统。该系统采用了“确定性 vs. 语义”的框架：通过确定性编排（负责分解、逻辑锚定、账本追踪、路由和修补逻辑）与语义Agent（受限负责审稿、判断和修订）分离，结合对抗性全面评审、争议路由和因果逻辑，实现对论文的安全性硬化。
AI.result: 与四个基线系统相比，在视觉、NLP和机器学习论文的专家评审实验中，PaperJury在议题质量、裁决路由准确性、编辑安全性、收敛行为及成本控制方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 负载承担的安全性和完成逻辑应存在于确定性编排中，而非模型决策中。PaperJury通过这种架构证明了其在处理学术论文硬化（Hardening）任务中的有效性。

title: Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
summary: We present Unified Motion-Action (UMA) Model, an approach that uses 3D object motion trajectories as a shared interface to bridge visuomotor control and dynamics modeling. UMA treats object motion and robot actions as co-evolving variables under a masked generative objective, in which the mask pattern determines both the supervision regime during pretraining and the inference mode at deployment. Using hindsight-relabeled motion contexts and a contrastive objective that disentangles task intent from scene geometry, UMA enables multi-task pretraining across heterogeneous data sources without requiring manually annotated task instructions. At deployment, the same pretrained parameters support motion-conditioned visuomotor control, motion-based dynamics modeling, and task adaptation from few-shot demonstrations. Pretrained on a mixture of robot demonstrations, human videos, and simulated data, UMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines specialized for each inference mode.

AI.tldr: UMA 提出了一种以 3D 物体运动轨迹为核心接口的统一模型，通过遮蔽生成式学习和无指令多任务预训练，实现了在异构数据上的高效泛化及多功能推理能力。
AI.motivation: 克服现有具身智能模型在处理异构数据源（机器人演示、人类视频、仿真数据）以及多任务通用性上的局限，解决控制与动力学理解割裂的问题，并减少对昂贵的人工标注指令的依赖。
AI.method:
1. 将 3D 物体运动轨迹作为视觉运动控制和动力学建模的共享接口。
2. 提出遮蔽生成式目标（Masked Generative Objective），实现预训练与推理模式的统一。
3. 引入 hindsight-relabeled（事后重标记）运动上下文。
4. 使用对比学习目标解耦任务意图与场景几何。
AI.result: 在预训练后，UMA 在多种推理模式（基于运动的视觉运动控制、基于运动的动力学建模、少样本任务适应）上均一致优于专门针对各模式训练的先进基准模型。
AI.conclusion: UMA 是一种通用的具身智能模型，证明了 3D 物体运动轨迹可以作为连接视觉运动控制和动力学建模的统一接口，且在无需人工标注指令的情况下实现了跨异构数据的多任务预训练及多种推理模式的最优性能。

title: TMASC: Transmasculine Attitude and Speech Corpus
summary: We introduce the Transmasculine Attitudes and Speech Corpus (TMASC), a multimodal corpus of 196 transmasculine individuals, including questionnaire responses and 66 audio recordings. The questionnaire includes items exploring the vocal health of transmasculine individuals. The audio recordings include cough and throat-clearing samples, a reading passage, and additional session-specific questions. This paper outlines the development of this corpus and the data collection procedures. To illustrate the utility of this corpus, we present three case studies demonstrating how this crowd-sourced multimodal corpus can be used to support transmasculine individuals. These include the integration of perceptual and acoustic data, the identification of group-level characteristics, and the calibration of acoustic measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了跨性别男性语料库（TMASC），这是一个包含196名跨性别男性问卷数据和66份语音记录的多模态数据集，旨在通过语音分析支持该群体的健康与福祉。
AI.motivation: 目前针对跨性别男性群体语音健康及特征研究的数据资源稀缺，旨在通过构建TMASC语料库，为该群体的语音需求及相关研究提供支持。
AI.method: 收集了196名跨性别男性的问卷调查数据，并从中获取了66份包含咳嗽、清嗓、阅读片段及针对性问题的录音，通过众包方式构建数据集，并进行了三项案例研究来验证其应用潜力。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含问卷与音频的多模态语料库，并通过案例展示了该库在整合感知与声学数据、识别群体特征以及声学测量校准方面的实用性。
AI.conclusion: TMASC是一个有价值的多模态资源，能够为跨性别男性群体的语音健康研究、社会语言学分析及听觉/声学测量校准提供重要支持。

title: Mean-Field Parallel Decoding for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a pathway to low-latency decoding. However, selecting tokens independently by marginal confidence limits effective parallelism: tokens that appear reliable in isolation can form incompatible configurations when several positions are updated at once. We introduce a training-free decoding framework that coordinates these parallel updates. At each forward pass, the method assigns a commit score to each masked position and refines these scores using pairwise interactions derived from the model's predictive distributions. A variational relaxation yields a simple fixed-point update that suppresses conflicting simultaneous commitments within a single forward pass. This mechanism allows the decoder to commit more tokens in parallel while maintaining competitive generation quality. The method is lightweight, requires no auxiliary model or retraining, and drops into existing diffusion decoding pipelines without modification. Experiments on reasoning and code-generation benchmarks show consistent improvements in the quality-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 针对离散扩散语言模型并行生成中的标记冲突问题，提出了一种轻量级、无需训练的协同解码机制，利用变分松弛抑制位置间冲突，显著提升了生成质量与解码效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散扩散语言模型虽然支持并行生成以降低延迟，但由于独立选择标记导致缺乏位置间的协同，往往产生不兼容的配置。需要一种机制来在保持并行性的同时确保生成的一致性。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的解码框架，核心在于通过模型预测分布计算出的成对交互来精炼每个掩码位置的“提交分数”（commit score），并利用变分松弛推导出简单的不动点更新机制，以抑制并行更新时的冲突。
AI.result: 在推理（reasoning）和代码生成任务上，该方法在质量-延迟权衡方面均表现优于现有基线，且可以无缝集成到既有的扩散解码管道中。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无训练解码框架能够有效协调离散扩散语言模型中的并行标记生成，在不增加训练成本或额外模型负担的前提下，通过抑制冲突的并行提交，实现了质量与延迟的最优平衡。

title: CrossMaps: Confidence-Aware Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping for Rover Navigation
comment: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026: ROSE International Workshop on Robotics Software Engineering, June 01, 2026, Vienna, Austria
summary: Rovers rely on perception to maintain spatial maps that encode both objects and sensor quality (e.g., range reliability, lighting artifacts, data density), guiding data fusion, embedding updates, and navigation under partial observability. To study these coupled perception-navigation processes, we present CrossMaps, a real-time confidence-aware open-vocabulary semantic mapping pipeline that constructs language-queryable maps from RGB-D data. Building on VLMaps-style approaches, CrossMaps integrates multi-scale CLIP embeddings with confidence-aware fusion and a dual-memory architecture consisting of Short-Term Memory (STM) and Long-Term Memory (LTM). The STM aggregates noisy visual observations using geometric, semantic, and temporal confidence cues, while confident and coherent cells are promoted to the LTM as persistent semantic landmarks. Designed for deployment with a Jetson Orin-powered UGV alongside SLAM, CrossMaps runs in real time and produces semantic heatmaps that can be queried with natural language to guide rover navigation.

AI.tldr: CrossMaps 是一个实时、置信度感知的语义建图管道，通过双重记忆架构处理多尺度 CLIP 特征，让机器人能够利用自然语言查询进行鲁棒的导航。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人（火星车等）在进行路径规划和感知时面临部分观测挑战，现有的语义地图缺乏对传感器质量和语义置信度的综合考量，导致在复杂环境下的导航鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种双重记忆架构（STM 和 LTM），结合了多尺度 CLIP 嵌入与置信度感知融合机制。系统利用几何、语义和时间维度的置信度权重处理来自 RGB-D 的噪声数据，并将置信度高的信息从 STM 提升至 LTM 作为持久性地标。
AI.result: CrossMaps 在 Jetson Orin 平台上实现了实时运行，能够生成可交互的语义热力图，有效支持基于自然语言查询的移动机器人导航任务。
AI.conclusion: CrossMaps 成功实现了一个实时、置信度感知且支持开放词汇查询的语义建图系统，证明了在资源受限的移动机器人平台上，通过双重记忆架构处理多源感知数据能有效提升导航决策能力。

title: Tyler: Typed Latent Reasoning for Language Models -- When to Think, What to Compute, and How Much to Allocate
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs) by externalizing intermediate computation as discrete text tokens, but this textual interface also introduces redundancy and inference overhead. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by carrying part of the computation in continuous representations. However, existing methods typically predefine when latent computation is invoked and how it is allocated during decoding, leaving a key problem unresolved: when to invoke latent computation, what type of computation to perform, and how much budget to allocate. We propose \textbf{Ty}ped \textbf{L}at\textbf{e}nt \textbf{R}easoning (Tyler), a typed and budget-aware framework for latent reasoning during autoregressive decoding. Tyler learns a policy that, at each decoding step, chooses between emitting a text token and switching to a latent computation module specialized for a particular reasoning function. Once invoked, an operator maps the current reasoning state into latent tokens that support global planning, local state updates, or reusable procedural abstraction. Across extensive experiments on three backbone LLMs, Tyler improves accuracy by up to 14.49 points over CoT and by up to 4.30 points over the strongest competing baseline. It further generalizes across diverse reasoning domains and achieves the best final-stage performance with the lowest forgetting.

AI.tldr: 针对思维链（CoT）的冗余问题，Tyler 提出了一种支持动态调用、多类型算子映射及预算感知的“类型化潜在推理”框架，实现了推理性能与效率的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统思维链（CoT）推理虽有效但存在冗余和推理开销大的问题；现有的潜在推理方法缺乏动态调度（何时调用、调用类型及分配多少预算），限制了推理效率和灵活性。
AI.method: 提出名为“Tyler”的分类潜在推理框架。它通过学习一种决策策略，在每个解码步骤决定是生成文本还是调用专门的潜在计算模块；该模块通过算子将推理状态映射为潜在 tokens，以支持全局规划、状态更新或过程抽象。
AI.result: 在三个骨干大模型上的实验表明，Tyler 的准确率较传统 CoT 提升最高达 14.49 个百分点，较最强基线提升 4.30 个百分点，且具有良好的泛化能力和较低的知识遗忘率。
AI.conclusion: Tyler 通过引入类型化与预算感知的潜在推理机制，证明了在保持高性能的同时优化计算效率的可行性，为大模型推理提供了超越传统文本化思维链（CoT）的可扩展解决方案。

title: Continuous Cross-Domain Traffic State Prediction via Memory-Augmented Graph Liquid Time-Constant Networks
summary: Traffic state prediction is a fundamental task in intelligent transportation systems. In practical applications, some regions suffer from limited traffic observations due to insufficient sensing infrastructure, making cross-domain knowledge transfer an important solution for data-scarce traffic prediction. However, existing cross-domain traffic prediction methods still face several limitations, including coarse-grained source-target adaptation, limited capability in handling unseen target-domain patterns, and insufficient modeling of continuous traffic dynamics under irregular or heterogeneous temporal conditions. To address these issues, this paper proposes a continuous cross-domain traffic prediction framework, termed Memory-Augmented Graph Liquid Time-Constant Network (MA-GLTC). Specifically, we first construct spatio-temporal units (STUs) to decompose traffic networks into transferable local units, enabling fine-grained knowledge alignment across domains. Then, a graph liquid time-constant network (GLTC) is developed to model graph-coupled traffic evolution in continuous time. Different from generic graph neural ODE-based models, GLTC introduces graph-coupled recurrent conductance into liquid time-constant dynamics, allowing node states to evolve with leakage, adaptive time constants, and neighborhood-aware feedback. Furthermore, a Memory-based Transfer Storage (MTS) mechanism is designed to preserve source-domain knowledge, retrieve matched traffic patterns, and update reliable target-domain patterns when unseen states emerge. Experiments on five public traffic datasets demonstrate that MA-GLTC consistently outperforms representative innerdomain and cross-domain baselines in both short-term and longterm prediction tasks. Compared with the second-best method, MA-GLTC reduces the average prediction errors by 3.02%, 0.33%, 8.92%, 10.09%, and 2.11%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 MA-GLTC 的跨域交通预测框架，通过细粒度时空单元对齐、图液态时间常数网络模拟连续交通动态，以及记忆增强传输机制，提升了数据稀缺区域交通流的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 解决当前跨域交通预测中存在的领域适配粗糙、难以处理未知目标域模式，以及难以有效建模不规则或异构时序下的连续交通动态等问题。
AI.method: 提出一种记忆增强图连续时间神经网络（MA-GLTC）框架，包含：1. 时空单元 (STU)：将交通网络分解为可迁移的局部单元，实现细粒度知识对齐；2. 图液态时间常数网络 (GLTC)：结合图耦合循环电导与液态时间常数动力学，实现连续时间内的交通演化建模；3. 记忆转移存储 (MTS) 机制：利用记忆模块存储源域知识，并检索或更新目标域的模态。
AI.result: 在五个交通数据集上的实验表明，MA-GLTC 在短时和长时预测任务中均优于代表性基线模型，平均误差相比次优方法降低了约 0.33% 至 10.09%。
AI.conclusion: MA-GLTC 通过细粒度时空单元对齐、连续时间动态建模和记忆增强机制，有效解决了跨域交通预测中的数据稀缺、长尾模式识别和非均匀时间序列处理难题，在跨域交通预测任务中具有显著的优越性。

title: SidewalkBench: Benchmarking Visual Navigation on Urban Sidewalks
summary: Urban sidewalk navigation presents significant challenges due to complex structural layouts, dynamic pedestrian behaviors, and long distances. While recent visual navigation models offer a promising solution, the lack of a unified benchmark hinders quantitative and reproducible evaluation. To bridge this gap, we propose SidewalkBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed for visual navigation on urban sidewalks. Built upon NVIDIA Isaac Sim, SidewalkBench brings GPU-accelerated simulation of diverse, high-fidelity sidewalk environments, including both procedurally generated and real-world scanned scenes. We further populate the scenes with rich, reactive event-based pedestrian behaviors and flexible, efficient animation, enabling standardized model evaluation under realistic real-world settings. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 9 visual navigation models on 330 unit-test scenarios, 800 pedestrian-reactive scenarios, and 105 long-horizon scenarios. Our findings highlight that pedestrian interaction and long-horizon robustness remain critical bottlenecks for existing models, and scaling up sidewalk training with synthetic data emerges as a promising solution.

AI.tldr: SidewalkBench 是首个针对城市人行道视觉导航的综合基准平台，基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 提供高保真环境与交互模拟，揭示了当前模型在处理动态人流与长程任务时的局限性。
AI.motivation: 城市人行道导航面临结构复杂、行人动态多变及长距离导航的挑战，但目前缺乏统一的基准测试平台来实现量化且可复现的评估。
AI.method: 基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 构建，包含程序化生成与真实场景扫描；引入基于事件的响应式行人行为模拟；对 9 种视觉导航模型进行 330 个单元测试、800 个行人交互场景及 105 个长程场景的基准评估。
AI.result: 提出了 SidewalkBench 基准，包含高保真模拟环境与多样化行人行为设置；完成了对主流视觉导航模型的全面性能分析。
AI.conclusion: 行人交互能力与长程鲁棒性是现有视觉导航模型的关键瓶颈；利用合成数据扩展训练规模是提升模型性能的有效途径。

title: Evaluating LLM Personalization via Semantic Constraint Verification
summary: Current evaluation paradigms for Large Language Model (LLM) personalization rely heavily on brittle surface-matching metrics or computationally expensive LLM-as-a-judge protocols, both of which lack interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce Natural Language Inference Constraint Verification (NLICV), a scalable, semantically invariant framework that maps sentence meanings to truth-condition sets to verify personalization constraints via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model. Moving beyond binary scoring, NLICV categorizes LLM behaviors into four distinct modes: personalization, generalization, sycophancy, and failure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NLICV aligns closely with human annotations while drastically reducing the latency and token costs associated with LLM judges (up to 2100 inference speedup). Finally, through an ablation-based procedure, NLICV pinpoints the exact sentences driving the constraint verification, yielding faithful, understandable evidence for its evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NLICV框架，通过自然语言推理技术实现了大模型个性化评估的低成本、高效率和高可解释性验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）个性化评估方法存在局限性：简单的表面匹配指标不够稳健，而基于LLM作为裁判的方法计算成本高昂且缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于自然语言推理（NLI）的约束验证框架（NLICV）。该方法将句子含义映射为真值条件集，通过NLI模型验证个性化约束，并将LLM行为分类为个性化、泛化、谄媚和失败四种模式。
AI.result: 实验表明，NLICV与人类标注高度一致，显著降低了延迟和Token成本（推理速度提升达2100倍），并能通过消融分析精确定位影响验证结果的语句，提供可靠的可解释证据。
AI.conclusion: NLICV通过将验证任务转化为逻辑推理任务，实现了在降低评估成本的同时，提供高可解释性和与人类判断一致的个性化评估能力。

title: Brownian Kernel Ladders
summary:
Constructing mathematically tractable function spaces that capture hierarchical compositional representations remains a central challenge in statistical learning theory. We introduce Brownian kernel ladders (BKLs), a recursively defined hierarchy of integral reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces generated through Brownian-kernel integral constructions. Starting from linear functionals, each layer is obtained by integrating Brownian kernels over probability measures supported on subsets of the previous layer, yielding a recursive function-space model in which depth is encoded directly through the hierarchy.
  Based on this framework, we define canonical BKL spaces together with an associated complexity functional. We establish several analytical and statistical properties of these spaces. In particular, we show that BKL spaces form quasi-Banach spaces, satisfy depth-dependent Hölder regularity estimates, and exhibit strict monotonicity with respect to depth. We further prove existence results for regularized empirical risk minimization and derive Gaussian complexity bounds that remain uniformly controlled with respect to both the ambient dimension and the hierarchy depth.
  A key ingredient of the analysis is a combinatorial proof technique based on recursive subset decompositions and Brownian-kernel threshold representations. These estimates yield excess-risk guarantees of near-parametric order for regularized empirical risk minimization over BKL spaces. Our results provide a mathematically tractable hierarchical function-space framework for studying compositional representations in deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“布朗核梯子”（BKLs），这是一种通过递归积分构建的函数空间层次结构，旨在从理论上解释深度学习中的层次化组合表示，并对其正则性、复杂性和泛化误差提供了严格的数学保证。
AI.motivation: 在统计学习理论中，构建既能捕捉层次化组合表示又具备数学可处理性的函数空间是一个主要挑战。
AI.method: 建立了基于布朗核（Brownian-kernel）积分递归定义的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）层级结构，定义了与之相关的复杂性泛函，并采用了基于递归子集分解和布朗核阈值表示的组合证明技术。
AI.result: 证明了 BKL 空间构成拟 Banach 空间，满足深度依赖的 Hölder 正则性估计，表现出关于深度的严格单调性，并获得了维度与深度一致收敛的高斯复杂性界，实现了近参数化阶数的经验风险最小化（ERM）过剩风险保证。
AI.conclusion: BKL 为研究深度学习中的组合表示提供了一个数学上易于处理的函数空间框架，通过递归结构实现了对深度和正则性的理论刻画。

title: When Should a Robot Replan? Regret-Guided Update Scheduling in Time-Varying MDPs
summary: Robots operating in non-stationary environments must continually adapt their policies as the dynamics drift, but onboard energy and compute budgets cap how often a full state estimation and re-planning step can be performed. This raises a question: \emph{when}, along a horizon, should a robot spend its limited budget? We formulate this problem in time-varying Markov decision processes (TVMDPs) with a known bound on the rate of transition drift. We model execution as a \emph{skip-update} scheme in which, at chosen update times, the agent estimates the transition kernel by maximum likelihood and computes a finite-horizon policy, and between updates reuses this policy under a propagated state estimate. We analyze the dynamic regret of this scheme and show how it grows during skip intervals in terms of the properties of the TVMDP and the skip lengths; the resulting bound answers the opening question via an online, regret-guided update rule that allocates the budget adaptively. We evaluate the rule in a simulated Mars-rover navigation task with time-varying slip dynamics and on a Crazyflie quadrotor in indoor obstacle fields. Adaptive allocation outperforms other budgeted baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对机器人计算资源受限且环境动态演变的挑战，本文提出了一种基于遗憾分析的自适应策略更新机制，通过在线动态分配计算预算，实现了在非平稳环境下的高效策略优化。
AI.motivation: 在非平稳环境中运行的机器人需要持续适应动态变化，但机载计算和能源预算的限制使得无法随时进行完全的状态估计和重新规划。核心问题在于：机器人应如何根据有限预算选择“何时”进行更新以最大化性能。
AI.method: 1. 将问题形式化为时变马尔可夫决策过程（TVMDP）；2. 设计了一种“跳过式更新”（skip-update）方案，仅在特定时刻执行状态估计和计算策略；3. 推导了动态遗憾随跳过间隔增长的界限；4. 提出了一种基于遗憾引导（regret-guided）的在线自适应预算分配规则。
AI.result: 实验表明，该自适应分配策略在模拟火星车导航任务（处理时变滑移动态）和 Crazyflie 四旋翼飞行器室内避障任务中，均优于其他受预算限制的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于遗憾引导的自适应更新策略，能够在计算资源受限的情况下，通过动态决策更新时间点，有效解决非平稳环境中机器人策略自适应的难题，优于传统的固定间隔或启发式基线方法。

title: Surpassing Scale by Efficiency: A Compact 135M Parameter Foundational LLM Natively Adapted for the Bangla Language
summary: While the NLP landscape is dominated by multi-billion parameter architectures, their deployment in low-resource, non-Latin scripts remains computationally prohibitive for edge configurations, mobile systems, and decentralized local hardware. This paper presents bangla-smollm-135m, a highly compact 135-million parameter decoder-only foundational model engineered explicitly for high-efficiency language modeling in the Bangla script. By leveraging a deterministic intersect-and-append token merging strategy between TituLLMs and SmolLM2-135M, the model overcomes subword script fragmentation without destabilizing early pretrained parameter states. In zero-shot multi-task benchmark evaluations (PIQA_bn, OpenBookQA_bn, CommonsenseQA_bn, and Bangla_MMLU), bangla-smollm-135m matches or outperforms models twice its size (Gemma-3-270m) and achieves parity with models in the 1B parameter tier. The model is available at rnnandi/bangla-smollm-135m

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 bangla-smollm-135m，这是一个专为孟加拉语优化的 1.35 亿参数轻量级模型，通过创新的分词合并技术，以极小的计算代价实现了超越其参数体量的多任务语言处理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前 NLP 领域的大型模型对于边缘计算、移动端及去中心化设备来说计算成本过高，特别是在孟加拉语等低资源、非拉丁语系场景下，部署难度更大。
AI.method: 提出了一种参数量仅为 1.35 亿的解码器架构模型 bangla-smollm-135m；采用确定性的“交叉合并（intersect-and-append）”分词合并策略，融合 TituLLMs 与 SmolLM2-135M，以解决孟加拉语的子词碎片化问题并保留预训练状态。
AI.result: 在多个孟加拉语零样本（zero-shot）多任务基准测试（如 PIQA_bn, OpenBookQA_bn 等）中，该模型表现优于两倍体积的模型（如 Gemma-3-270m），并达到了与 10 亿（1B）参数规模模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 对于低资源或非拉丁语系（如孟加拉语）而言，通过高效的轻量化模型架构取代超大规模模型是可行的。bangla-smollm-135m 证明了在参数量极小的情况下，通过优化的分词与迁移策略，能够实现与远超其体量的模型相当的性能。

title: SILAGE: Memory-Efficient, Full-Gradient-Free Nonconvex Optimization for Nested Finite Sums
comment: 80 pages, 3 algorithms, 4 theorems, 2 corollaries, 11 lemmas, 2 figures, 12 tables
summary: Empirical risk minimization on massive datasets naturally exhibits a nested double finite-sum structure, where $N=nm$ total samples are logically or physically partitioned into $n$ blocks of size $m$ (e.g., in pooled data silos, out-of-core learning, or deliberate stratification). While variance-reduced methods achieve optimal oracle complexities for nonconvex objectives, they suffer from severe scaling bottlenecks in this centralized regime. Recursive estimators, such as PAGE, require periodic global full-gradient refreshes over all $nm$ samples, which are computationally expensive. Conversely, single-loop methods, such as SILVER, avoid such refreshes but require an impractical $\mathcal{O}(nm)$ memory footprint to store a control variate for every sample. In this paper, we propose SILAGE, a variance-reduced algorithm that addresses this trade-off. By actively exploiting the double-sum structure, SILAGE eliminates periodic global full-gradient refreshes over all $nm$ components (evaluating at most one local group gradient per iteration) while requiring only $\mathcal{O}(n)$ memory. Furthermore, we provide a tight convergence analysis that avoids pessimistic worst-case Lipschitz constants. Instead, SILAGE's complexity natively adapts to the underlying data geometry via nested functional similarities: across-group ($δ_1$) and within-group ($δ_2$) heterogeneity. Our results improve existing state-of-the-art bounds in several practically relevant regimes.

AI.tldr: SILAGE 是一种新型方差缩减算法，专门用于解决嵌套双有限和结构的大规模优化问题，它在保持计算效率的同时，大幅降低了内存需求，并适配不同层次的数据异构性。
AI.motivation: 在大规模经验风险最小化任务中，现有的方差缩减方法存在局限：递归估计器（如 PAGE）需要昂贵的全局梯度刷新，而单循环方法（如 SILVER）虽然避免了刷新，却需要 $\mathcal{O}(nm)$ 的巨大内存开销。现有方法难以在内存限制和高效计算之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 SILAGE 的方差缩减算法。该算法利用数据的“双重求和结构”（double-sum structure），通过分层计算梯度（每轮最多评估一个局部组梯度），实现了仅需 $\mathcal{O}(n)$ 的内存占用，且无需全量梯度刷新。同时，引入了基于嵌套函数相似性（组间相似性 $\delta_1$ 和组内相似性 $\delta_2$）的非悲观收敛分析。
AI.result: SILAGE 在保持高效收敛的同时，显著降低了内存需求（从 $\mathcal{O}(nm)$ 降至 $\mathcal{O}(n)$），并消除了周期性全局梯度刷新。其复杂性分析能够自适应于数据几何特征（组间与组内异构性），在多个实际场景中优于现有的最先进算法。
AI.conclusion: SILAGE 是处理具有嵌套双有限和结构的大规模数据优化的关键算法，通过利用数据层级结构实现了存储与计算效率的平衡，为处理具有异构特征的大规模数据集提供了更优的理论保证和实际表现。

title: Task-Error Residual Learning for Real-Robot Five-Ball Juggling
comment: Submitted to the 2026 International Symposium on Robotics Research (ISRR)
summary: For residual learning that refines existing behavior, sample efficiency depends on two things: how much information each rollout returns, and how efficiently the learner uses that information. Reinforcement learning's standard scalar reward carries far less information than the directional task error that defines the task. Random exploration further discards whatever information each rollout returns. Through residual learning with directional task-error supervision and a task error model that drives sample selection, we achieve stable three-, four-, and five-ball juggling on anthropomorphic Barrett WAM arms. Despite planning and controlling through a simple, idealized stack, the system converges from the second attempt. The first attempt drops, after which task error decreases monotonically without further failures. In comparison, five-ball juggling typically takes humans years of practice. We compare residual learners across two ternary axes, the directional information in the learning feedback and the commitment of the analytic prior, spanning Newton-style Jacobian updates, Composite Bayesian Optimization, and stochastic search methods. Both axes prove necessary: neither directional feedback nor an informative prior suffices alone, and the simplest method that combines them, a fixed-Jacobian Newton update, is the most reliable. The learned residual tolerates substantial prior misalignment and degraded joint tracking, affecting mainly convergence speed. The bottleneck for residual learning on real robots is therefore the information content of the supervision signal and how the learner uses it, not the accuracy of the surrounding stack. Video documentation of all experiments is available at https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种利用定向误差监督的残差学习方法，通过高效利用任务反馈信息，成功实现了在机械臂上极速收敛的多球杂耍。研究证明，结合定向反馈与先验控制模型是实现机器人复杂任务高样本效率学习的核心。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习（RL）使用信息量极低的标量奖励，且随机探索浪费了大量回放信息。研究旨在解决残差学习中的样本效率问题，探讨如何通过更有效的信息反馈和先验知识结合，实现复杂动态任务（如多球杂耍）的快速收敛。
AI.method: 提出了一种残差学习框架，利用“定向任务误差监督”（directional task-error supervision）代替传统的标量奖励，并结合“任务误差模型”进行样本选择。通过该方法，系统在拟人化机械臂上实现了3至5球的杂耍，并与牛顿式雅可比更新、复合贝叶斯优化及随机搜索方法进行了对比分析。
AI.result: 该系统能够仅从第二次尝试开始实现稳定杂耍，从第一次尝试失败后，任务误差单调递减，不再出现失败。该方法在处理先验误差和关节跟踪退化方面表现出很强的鲁棒性，显著优于传统的学习范式。
AI.conclusion: 除了依赖周围控制系统的精度外，残差学习在真实机器人上的瓶颈主要在于监督信号的信息含量以及学习器如何利用这些信息。研究表明，结合定向反馈（directional feedback）与信息丰富的先验（informative prior）是实现高效、稳定学习的关键，其中由定向误差指导的固定雅可比牛顿更新（fixed-Jacobian Newton update）最为可靠且高效。

title: A Mechanistic Understanding of Pronoun Fidelity in LLMs
summary: Faithful and robust pronoun use is important for fair and coherent generations, yet large language models largely fail when multiple referents use different pronouns. To study the interplay of reasoning, repetition, and bias in this task, prior work relies exclusively on behavioural approaches, which may not reflect a model's internal workings. Therefore, we provide a mechanistic, model-internal perspective on pronoun fidelity, testing whether three mechanisms -- group entity binding (G), recency bias (R), and stereotypical bias (S) -- are causally implemented across several SOTA language models. Using Boundless Distributed Alignment Search, we find all three coexist as causal subspaces distributed across network depth. No single mechanism fully explains model behaviour, but a combination of the three consistently accounts for 91-99.5%. An attention head analysis further reveals two competing copying routes; group binding and stereotype share a localized concept-level route that retrieves a bound occupation-pronoun unit, while recency uses a distributed token-level route that repeats surface forms. In sum, pronoun fidelity arises from competition between simultaneously active causal subspaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过因果分析方法揭示了大模型处理代词指代的内部机制，证实了由群体绑定、近因偏差和刻板印象偏差构成的多个子空间在模型内部通过竞争共同决定了代词的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多依赖行为学测试，无法揭示大模型在处理复杂指代（多个指代对象使用不同代词）任务时的内部运作逻辑与失败原因。本研究旨在通过机制解释学方法，探究代词忠实度背后的因果机制。
AI.method: 使用“无界分布式对齐搜索”（Boundless Distributed Alignment Search, B-DAS）进行因果干预分析，通过探究模型内部表征来识别三种机制（G, R, S）的因果作用；并结合注意力头分析对比概念级（处理群体绑定与刻板印象）与词元级（处理近因）两种不同的复制路径。
AI.result: 研究发现G, R, S三种机制共同作为因果子空间存在，组合起来可解释模型91%-99.5%的行为。进一步发现，群体绑定和刻板印象共享一种概念级检索路径，而近因偏差则通过分布式的词元级路由实现。
AI.conclusion: 代词忠实度并非由单一机制决定，而是由群体实体绑定（G）、近因偏差（R）和刻板印象偏差（S）三个因果子空间在网络深层竞争的结果。研究揭示了代词指代背后的复杂认知路径，为理解大模型的内部逻辑提供了新视角。

title: Wasserstein Convergence of ODE-Based Samplers in Decentralized Diffusion Model via Velocity Field Decomposition
summary: Diffusion models have achieved impressive empirical success in generative tasks, and their convergence theory is now relatively well understood. Motivated by privacy and scalability, recent decentralized diffusion architectures replace a single global velocity field with multiple local experts and a routing mechanism, yielding a sampling dynamics with stochastic expert switching that falls outside standard diffusion convergence analyses. In this work, We study a decentralized diffusion framework with stochastic velocity fields and ODE-based sampling. We establish a convergence guarantee in Wasserstein-2 distance, showing that the distribution of the $N$-step discretization converges to the analytical solution at rate $\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/2}+\varepsilon)$ in $W_2$, where $\varepsilon$ captures the neural approximation errors. To our knowledge, this is the first $W_2$ convergence result for decentralized diffusion models with an ODE-based sampling scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文为带有随机路由的分散式扩散模型建立了首个基于Wasserstein-2距离的ODE采样收敛性解析框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型收敛理论多针对单一全局速度场，而分散式扩散架构引入了多个局部专家和路由机制，导致抽样动力学具有随机切换特性，现有的理论无法直接应用，因此需要建立新的收敛性分析。
AI.method: 研究了带有随机速度场的分散式扩散框架及其ODE采样机制；通过数学分析推导了离散化过程的Wasserstein-2距离收敛界。
AI.result: 证明了N步离散化分布收敛到解析解的Wasserstein-2距离误差上界为 $\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/2}+\varepsilon)$，其中$\varepsilon$表示神经网络的逼近误差。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为具有随机速度场和ODE采样方案的分散式扩散模型提供了Wasserstein-2距离下的收敛性保证，证明了其在理论上的可行性。

title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.

AI.tldr: ROVE 是一种针对人形机器人 VLA 模型后训练的强化学习框架，利用乐观价值估计从非理想的人类干预数据中提取高质量动作，并通过跨本体数据增强，实现了比直接模仿更优的操控策略。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人操作复杂，现有人类干预数据往往存在犹豫、低效或错误，直接监督学习会导致模型“继承”这些负面行为，且现有方法难以处理非理想的干预轨迹。
AI.method: 1. 构建一个人机交互流水线以收集机器人部署和干预数据；2. 提出“乐观价值估计”(OVE) 技术，从混合质量的轨迹中筛选和优先学习高质量动作；3. 引入跨本体人类视频数据，以增强对长尾失败及恢复场景的监督。
AI.result: 在接触丰富且精细的人形机器人操作任务中，ROVE 在性能上超越了传统的经验学习基准，并能在多轮部署-干预循环中持续提高性能。
AI.conclusion: ROVE 框架通过优化价值估计和引入跨本体经验，有效解决了人形机器人 VLA 模型在处理非理想人类干预数据时的性能瓶颈，显著提升了复杂操作任务的表现。

title: PathRouter: Aligning Rewards with Retrieval Quality in Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Agentic GraphRAG trains language-model agents to iteratively retrieve and reason over graph-structured evidence, enabling more accurate and context-aware decision-making by efficiently navigating complex information networks. However, outcome-only reinforcement learning suffers from \textit{\textbf{answer-path reward aliasing}}, where correct answers may come from shortcuts rather than useful evidence paths. It also exhibits \textit{\textbf{search-update ambiguity}}, as scalar trajectory-level feedback does not indicate which retrieval actions to adjust. To mitigate these shortcomings, we present PathRouter, a path-aware training framework for agentic GraphRAG. PathRouter jointly evaluates each trajectory along answer correctness and evidence-path overlap, yielding four trajectory categories with differentiated GRPO advantage scaling that suppresses shortcut reinforcement while preserving evidence-seeking behavior. For evidence-poor trajectories, a frozen gold-evidence teacher provides token-level KL guidance on reasoning and search-query tokens, excluding answer tokens to avoid direct response imitation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks across three model sizes show that PathRouter consistently improves answer F1 and evidence-path overlap, achieving average F1 gains of 3.1 on 3B and 4.9 on 7B models compared to a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: PathRouter 提出一种针对 Agentic GraphRAG 的路径感知训练框架，通过组合路径重叠度反馈和教师指导机制，解决了传统 RL 中常见的快捷方式偏见和信用分配难题，显著增强了链路推理质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Agentic GraphRAG 使用仅关注结果的强化学习存在两大问题：“答案路径奖励混淆”（模型通过捷径猜对）和“搜索更新模糊”（标量反馈无法指明具体检索错误的步骤）。
AI.method: 提出 PathRouter 框架，核心包含：1. 路径感知偏好优化（基于答案正确性和证据路径重叠度的四分类 GRPO 优势缩放）；2. 基于冻结“黄金证据”教师模型的词元级 KL 散度约束，对推理和查询路径进行引导，同时排除答案词元以防模仿。
AI.result: 在六个 QA 基准测试、三种模型规模上表现优异，相比基线模型，3B 模型 F1 分数平均提升 3.1，7B 模型平均提升 4.9，且在证据路径重叠度上有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: PathRouter 通过路径感知的奖励机制和细粒度的监督信号，有效解决了 Agentic GraphRAG 在强化学习训练中的“奖励混淆”和“搜索反馈模糊”问题，显著提升了模型在复杂知识图谱上的推理和证据检索能力。

title: David vs. Goliath in Next Activity Prediction: Argmax vs. LSTM, Transformer, and LLM
comment: Accepted for 24th International Conference on Business Process Management (2026) Forum
summary: Next activity prediction (NAP) is a cornerstone of predictive process monitoring (PPM), enabling organizations to move from retrospective analysis to proactive process steering. The PPM field has progressed from classical machine learning through deep learning architectures such as LSTMs and Transformers to large language models (LLMs). Despite growing model complexity, no benchmark jointly compares LLMs, Transformers, LSTMs, and simple baselines in a direct sequence modeling setting for NAP. In this paper, we fill this gap with a systematic benchmark. We compare vocabulary-adapted LLMs, Transformers trained from scratch, LLM-distilled Transformers, and LSTMs against a simple counting-based argmax baseline across seven real-life event logs. Our results tell a David vs. Goliath story: pretraining confers no consistent improvement over training from scratch, model size shows little effect on performance, and on most datasets the argmax baseline matches or approaches the performance of billion-parameter LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统性基准测试发现，在下一活动预测（NAP）任务中，简单的统计基准模型往往能达到与复杂的大型语言模型相近的性能，表明当前行业对复杂深度学习模型的过度追求可能缺乏必要性。
AI.motivation: 尽管流程预测（PPM）领域的研究已从传统机器学习演进至大语言模型（LLM），但缺乏一个涵盖从简单基准到复杂模型的多维度直接比较研究，无法明确模型复杂度的提升是否真正带来了预测能力的显著增长。
AI.method: 建立了一个系统性的基准测试框架，在七个真实事件日志上对比了四类方法：词表适配的LLM、从头训练的Transformer、LLM蒸馏得出的Transformer、LSTM，以及基于计数统计的argmax基准方法。
AI.result: 实验结果呈现出“大卫与歌利亚”式的反差：预训练模型并未表现出持续性的性能优势；模型规模对预测指标影响微乎其微；简单的基于频率的argmax基准方法在大多数数据集上的表现与复杂LLM相当。
AI.conclusion: 在下一活动预测任务中，模型的复杂度和预训练并非性能的绝对保证。极其简单且高效的统计基准（argmax）在多数数据集上能够媲美甚至超越千亿参数的大模型，强调了在流程挖掘领域根据任务特性选择方法论的重要性。

title: R2RDreamer: 3D-aware Data Augmentation for Spatially-generalized 2D Manipulation Policies
summary: Spatial generalization is critical for imitation-learned manipulation policies, but achieving it typically requires scaling demonstrations across diverse object poses, robot configurations, and camera viewpoints. Data augmentation from a few source demonstrations offers a practical alternative to costly real-world collection. Simulation-based augmentation can create controllable variation, but requires complex environment and object setup and may introduce a sim-to-real gap. Recent real-to-real methods avoid these issues by jointly editing 3D observations and action trajectories from real demonstrations, yet they still rely on strong 3D scene parsing and geometry completion, and often produce observations tailored to 3D pointcloud policies rather than RGB-based 2D policies. We propose R2RDreamer, a real-to-real demonstration augmentation framework that preserves the geometric consistency of 3D action-observation editing while moving visual completion to 2D video space. Specifically, R2RDreamer first performs lightweight 3D augmentation by editing incomplete object pointclouds and end-effector trajectories in a shared 3D frame; it then projects the edited scene into masked image-space control videos with occlusion-aware reasoning and uses a dense-control image-to-video model to complete temporally coherent RGB observations. Experiments on spatially shifted manipulation tasks with both 2D diffusion-style policies and vision-language-action policies show that R2RDreamer improves spatial generalization from limited source demonstrations, with analyses validating the contributions of 3D editing, occlusion-aware projection, and video completion.

AI.tldr: R2RDreamer提出了一种创新的实对实（Real-to-Real）演示观测增强框架，通过轻量级3D编辑与2D视频生成模型的结合，弥补了传统数据增强在几何一致性与RGB观测适配方面的缺陷，提升了机器人操作策略的空间泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习中空间泛化能力不足，现有的模拟增强存在Sim-to-Real差距，而现有的真实数据增强方法（Real-to-Real）依赖复杂的3D场景解析，且难以适配基于RGB的2D策略。
AI.method: R2RDreamer框架：1. 轻量化3D增强：在共享3D空间中编辑不完整的点云与末端执行器轨迹；2. 遮挡感知投影：将编辑后的场景投影至受控视频空间；3. 视频填充：利用基于密集控制的图像到视频生成模型，补全具有时间连贯性的RGB观测数据。
AI.result: 在空间偏移的操作任务中，R2RDreamer显著提升了2D扩散策略（Diffusion-based）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的泛化表现，且证明了其核心模块（3D编辑、遮挡感知投影、视频补全）的有效性。
AI.conclusion: R2RDreamer成功结合了3D几何编辑的精确性与2D视频生成的视觉连贯性，显著提升了模仿学习策略在空间视角偏移任务中的泛化能力，为解决机器人操作任务中数据稀疏与泛化难题提供了一种高效的实对实（Real-to-Real）增强方案。

title: LectūraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching
summary: Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 LectūraAgents，这是一个基于多智能体协作的个性化教育框架，通过具身化的教学动作生成和智能的动作-语言对齐算法，实现了高度定制化的交互式教学。
AI.motivation: 现有的 AI 教育智能体大多侧重于课程内容的自动化或模拟，缺乏对多模态和具身化教学方法的有效建模，难以满足多样化学习者的个性化教学需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种层次化的多智能体框架（LectūraAgents），包括负责统筹的 ProfessorAgent 和各专项子智能体；引入了“自适应具身教学机制”以执行可视化教学动作；设计了“教学动作-语言对齐（TASA）算法”，通过显著性启发和语义分割实现动作与语音的精准同步。
AI.result: 在高中、本科及研究生课程的实验中，经教育专家评估，LectūraAgents 在课程内容质量、具身教学表现、评估效果及个性化适应性方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LectūraAgents 通过其多智能体架构和具身教学机制，有效地提升了教学内容的质量、具身教学表现及个性化水平，为大规模个性化教育提供了一个具备坚实教育理论基础的框架。

title: Intelligence Is Not the Bottleneck: Validating an LLM First-Pass Manuscript Score Against Peer-Review Outcomes
summary: Large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly proposed to assist peer review, yet most evaluations judge the prose of machine-generated review text, not the validity of the numeric score a system assigns. We validate AIPR, which reads a submitted manuscript and emits five 0-100 quality dimensions and a weighted overall score, against the public decision outcomes of a major machine learning venue. AIPR grades by prompting alone, with no fine-tuning on reviews or decisions. Across 300 ICLR submissions with public decision tiers and reviewer ratings, graded under a frozen pipeline with hypotheses pre-registered before any score met any outcome, the overall score separates rejected from accepted submissions (AUROC 0.82, 95% CI 0.78-0.87), rises monotonically across tiers, and tracks the mean reviewer rating. The signal is strongest where we claim it: the lowest-scoring fifth is rejected far above the base rate, with oral papers absent. The validity comes mostly from the model: a one-paragraph prompt on the same model discriminates almost as well as the full pipeline (the small gap favours the pipeline but does not meet the pre-declared criterion, p = 0.09). What the engineering adds is reliability and a grounded review: AIPR's score barely moves across repeated runs (0.7 vs. 2.8 points within-paper SD) where the bare prompt swings, and the same pass returns a rubric-structured, evidence-grounded review rather than a bare number, with the human keeping the decision.

AI.tldr: 研究验证了一种名为 AIPR 的论文评审辅助系统，证明其在无需微调的情况下，能仅凭 Prompt 实现对论文质量的准确评估（AUROC 0.82），并提供稳定、结构化、证据充分的评估意见。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 同行评审研究多关注生成文本的质量（流畅度、语气），而忽略了评分的“有效性”。本文旨在验证大模型直接给出的数字评分是否真的能反映论文的学术价值及最终录用结果。
AI.method: 采用“零样本提示”（zero-shot prompting）方法，构建了一个固定的推断流程（pipeline）。系统阅读论文原文，输出五个维度的 0-100 评分及加权总分，并生成结构化、有证据支持的评审意见。测试样本为 300 篇 ICLR 论文，并对模型结论进行了预注册分析（pre-registered analysis）。
AI.result: 1. 在区分录用与拒绝论文方面表现出色（AUROC 0.82）；2. 得分随录用层级单调递增，并与人类评审员的平均打分高度相关；3. 系统在识别低质量稿件方面具有极高准确性；4. 多次运行评分波动极小，具备高度稳定性；5. 完整的管道处理在可靠性上优于单纯 Prompt，且能提供有证据支撑的评审文本。
AI.conclusion: AIPR 展示了利用大模型预评估学术论文的潜力。其核心价值不在于完全取代人类评审，而在于通过“可靠性”和“有据可查的评价”来辅助评审过程，并在筛选低质量稿件方面具备高区分度。

title: Hierarchical Advantage Weighting for Online RL Fine-Tuning of VLAs from Sparse Episode Outcomes
summary: When pretrained VLA policies are fine-tuned through online RL, each rollout episode produces only a single binary outcome (success or failure), yet the actor update requires per-transition supervision. Existing approaches commonly reduce this sparse outcome to a single scalar reward or advantage signal, which conflates distinct forms of transition-level feedback and provides limited guidance once basic task success becomes achievable. First, a single scalar signal conflates the two objectives of viability and efficiency; once basic success is achieved, the binary label provides no gradient to distinguish efficient completions from slow ones. Second, real-world rollouts mix autonomous and intervention segments; naively assigning episode outcomes across these boundaries introduces incorrect credit assignment. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Advantage-Weighted Behavior Cloning (HABC), which trains separate critic heads for these two objectives on different data subsets and combines their outputs with a state-adaptive balance. A state-adaptive gate $g_t$ merges their one-step advantages, prioritizing viability when success is uncertain and shifting to efficiency only when viability is high, and converts the result into per-transition weights on the actor loss. Intervention-aware credit assignment further restricts outcome labels to segments executed by the current policy, preventing supervision from leaking across intervention boundaries. In real-robot experiments on three contact-rich bimanual tasks, HABC raises success from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines of 36%, 44%, and 12% to 92%, 88%, and 38%.

AI.tldr: 针对 VLA 微调中稀疏反馈和错误信用分配问题，提出 HABC 框架，通过分离可行性和效率优化及精细化的片段归因，显著增强了真实机器人任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习微调 VLA 模型时，稀疏的二进制奖励难以区分执行好坏（效率），且在包含人工干预的实验中存在错误的奖励归因，导致策略学习效率低下或收敛困难。
AI.method: 提出分层优势加权行为克隆（HABC）：1. 设计双任务评论模型，分别预测可行性与效率；2. 采用基于状态的自适应门控机制动态合并优势信号，生成逐个时间步的权重；3. 引入干预感知归因方法，限制奖励信用仅分配给模型自主执行的片段。
AI.result: 在三个接触式双手动任务的真实机器人实验中，HABC 将成功率从基线（SFT）的 36%、44%、12% 分别提升至 92%、88%、38%。
AI.conclusion: HABC 通过分离“可行性”与“效率”评估以及优化干预期间的归因方式，显著提升了 VLA 模型在线强化学习微调的成功率与效率。

title: ACCORD: Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding for Language Agents
summary: User instructions are often underspecified because humans rely on implicit assumptions about the surrounding environment. For large language model (LLM) agents operating in information-rich digital and physical environments, these assumptions cannot be inferred from the instruction alone; they must be recovered from the current state of tools, data, interfaces, and observations. Effective execution therefore requires agents to identify missing context, ground it in observed evidence, and carry it forward into subsequent actions. We show that current agents often fail to do so. They act from assumed rather than observed specifics, overlook information they could have gathered, and fail to incorporate evidence that has already been returned. Building on this insight, we propose ACCORD (Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding), a simple and effective agent framework for adaptive grounding. Before each action, ACCORD actively probes the environment for missing information and integrates relevant context from the agent's trajectory that would otherwise be overlooked. Requiring no additional training or task-success signals, ACCORD improves task-goal completion on AppWorld by up to +20.6 points with GPT-5-mini, from 42.0% to 62.6%, compared to strong baselines. These gains persist with a substantially stronger base model (+10.8 with Claude-4.5-sonnet), an open-weight model (+10.1 with Qwen3.5-27B-FP8), and on the embodied AlfWorld benchmark (+7.4 success rate with GPT-5-mini).

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型代理在复杂环境中因“上下文接地”不足导致执行失败的问题，本文提出 ACCORD 框架，通过行动前的主动探测与上下文整合机制，显著提升了代理的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 用户指令往往存在语义不完整且依赖隐式环境假设，而 LLM 代理难以仅凭指令推断环境状态，常因缺乏上下文感知而导致行动失败。
AI.method: 提出名为 ACCORD (Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding) 的代理框架。该框架在代理执行每个行动前，主动探测环境以获取确实的上下文信息，并将轨迹中被忽略的相关证据整合到当前的决策路径中。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 基准测试中，使用 GPT-5-mini 将任务完成率从 42.0% 提升至 62.6%（+20.6点）。在 Claude-4.5-sonnet、Qwen3.5-27B-FP8 以及具身任务 AlfWorld 上均取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 在大语言模型代理中引入 ACCORD 框架，通过在动作执行前主动探测环境并整合缺失上下文，能显著提升代理在数字和具身任务中的任务完成率。该方法无需额外训练，具有极强的通用性和泛化能力。

title: Scalar-pathway fidelity improves physical accuracy in short-range equivariant interatomic potentials
summary: Accurate interatomic potentials enable molecular dynamics of materials, molecules, and interfaces beyond density-functional-theory length and time scales. Equivariant neural network potentials have improved the representation of local geometry. However, their deployable energy surfaces ultimately manifest through invariant scalar channels, whose aggregation and spectral resolution remain comparatively underexamined. Here we use Physics-Aware Neighborhood (PAN) pooling and Physics-Guided Spectral (PGS) mixers as controlled scalar-pathway probes: lightweight, symmetry-preserving modifications that act only on \(\ell=0\) channels while leaving the equivariant tensor backbone unchanged. Using MACE as a high-body-order mechanistic scaffold, PAN adds coordination-sensitive amplitude modulation, whereas PGS augments edge and readout scalar features with radial and tapered spectral bases. Across metallic Ag, covalent Si, a short-range ionic LiF/Li--F subset, and MD17/rMD17 molecules, this scalar-pathway correction reduces MACE force errors by 22--27\% and energy errors by 19--22\%; on systems with stress labels, stress errors decrease by 27--28\%, at approximately 5\% additional inference-FLOPs cost. Directionally consistent gains in Allegro and NequIP further indicate that the correction is portable across distinct short-range equivariant backbones, although effect sizes remain architecture-dependent. These results identify scalar-pathway fidelity as a practical design dimension for short-range equivariant interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对等变神经网络原子间势的标量路径优化方案（PAN 与 PGS），通过改进 $\ell=0$ 通道的聚合与谱解析能力，在极低的推理成本下显著提升了力、能量和应力的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的等变神经网络原子间势主要关注局部几何的等变表示，但其能量表面最终通过标量通道（invariant scalar channels）输出，而这些通道在聚合与谱分辨率方面的处理尚不充分，限制了模型的精度上限。
AI.method: 提出了“物理感知邻域（PAN）池化”和“物理引导谱（PGS）混合器”作为标量路径的探测与修正手段。这些方法是轻量级、保持对称性的修改，专门作用于等变神经网络中的标量通道（$\ell=0$），而不影响底层的等变张量骨架。研究在 MACE、Allegro 和 NequIP 等多个主流架构上进行了验证。
AI.result: 在金属 Ag、共价 Si、离子 LiF 和分子数据集 MD17/rMD17 上，该方法使 MACE 的力预测误差降低了 22–27%，能量误差降低了 19–22%，应力误差降低了 27–28%，且仅增加约 5% 的推理计算开销。在 Allegro 和 NequIP 模型上的测试同样取得了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 标量路径（scalar-pathway）忠实度是短程等变原子间势设计中的一个关键维度。通过在保持原有等变张量骨架不变的前提下，针对 $\ell=0$ 通道进行优化，可以显著提升模型表现，为开发更高效、更精确的原子势提供了新的设计方向。

title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
summary: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: GAM是一种新型机器人操纵策略，通过复用预训练几何基础模型（GFM）并集成语言条件下的时序世界建模，克服了传统2D模型在3D物理操作中几何推理能力的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型多基于2D图像或2D特征，缺乏处理接触丰富型操作任务所需的显式3D几何推理能力。
AI.method: 提出几何动作模型（GAM），将预训练的GFM拆分为观察编码器和因果未来预测器。模型通过在GMF中间层插入预测模块，实现对未来潜空间标记的预测，并利用GFM骨干网完成特征传播与动作解码，从而实现几何感知、时序建模与动作控制的统一。
AI.result: 在多项仿真和真实机器人操纵基准测试中，GAM在精度、鲁棒性、推理速度及模型轻量化方面均优于现有的基础模型级基准（Baselines）。
AI.conclusion: GAM通过利用GFM（几何基础模型）作为统一底座，证明了在无需大规模重训练的情况下，将显式3D几何先验与语言条件下的时序预测结合，是提升机器人操纵任务性能的有效路径。

title: From Awareness to Adherence: Bridging the Context Gap in Spoken Dialogue Systems via Context-Aware Decoding
summary: Despite the success of end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems, maintaining strict context adherence in multi-round conversations remains a challenge. While prior works attribute these failures to models forgetting dialogue history, we highlight an equally critical but overlooked bottleneck: a gap between latent context awareness and active adherence. Although models internally recognize relevant past utterances, strong parametric priors often overshadow these signals during decoding. To bridge this gap, we propose an audio-adapted Context-Aware Decoding (CAD) approach. By leveraging internal attention mechanisms to isolate key historical rounds, our approach contrasts output distributions with and without this key context during inference, directly amplifying multimodal contextual signals. Evaluations on the Audio MultiChallenge benchmark demonstrate significant improvements in Semantic Memory and Self Coherence subtasks, successfully enforcing strict, context-faithful adherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 CAD 的解码策略，通过对比推理机制放大模型的关键历史上下文信号，解决了端到端语音对话模型因参数先验过强而无法有效利用上下文的问题，提升了对话的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端语音对话系统在多轮对话中难以严格遵循上下文，过往研究多将其归咎于“遗忘”，但本文指出更根本的问题在于模型虽然具备潜在的上下文感知能力，但其内在的强参数先验在解码过程中掩盖了这些关键信号。
AI.method: 提出了一种音频自适应“上下文感知解码”（Context-Aware Decoding, CAD）方法。利用模型的内部注意力机制隔离关键的历史轮次，并在推理阶段通过对比“包含关键上下文”与“不包含该上下文”的输出概率分布，主动放大模型的多模态上下文信号。
AI.result: 在 Audio MultiChallenge 基准测试中，该方法在“语义记忆”（Semantic Memory）和“自洽性”（Self Coherence）子任务上均取得了显著提升，实现了严格且忠实于上下文的回复生成。
AI.conclusion: “上下文感知解码”（CAD）能够有效缓解端到端对话系统中参数先验对上下文信号的干扰，显著提升模型在多轮对话中的语义记忆与自洽性，证明了通过增强推理阶段的对比解码机制是解决该瓶颈的有效途径。

title: Human Universal Grasping
summary: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/

AI.tldr: 该文提出HUG框架，通过从海量人类第一人称抓取数据（1M-HUGs）中学习，利用流匹配模型生成高质量的人类手部抓取姿态，并成功迁移至多类机器人手部，实现了跨场景的通用零样本抓取。
AI.motivation: 机器人多指抓取在通用性方面远落后于人类，为了缩小这一差距，作者提出利用人类日常抓取的大规模数据来提升机器人抓取能力。
AI.method: 1. 数据集构建：使用智能眼镜采集了包含100万帧（1M-HUGs）、6707个物体的第一人称抓取数据集；2. 模型架构：提出一种融合RGB和深度信息的流匹配（Flow-matching）模型，输出包含腕部位置、旋转及MANO手部姿态的抓取参数；3. 基准测试：构建了包含90个未见物体的标准化仿真基准HUG-Bench。
AI.result: HUG模型在挑战性测试集中较现有先进抓取方法性能提升了23%和34%，并在真实世界的多种机器人形态和环境下展现出稳健的零样本抓取能力。
AI.conclusion: HUG通过从人类第一人称抓取数据中学习，实现了在复杂现实场景下更具通用性、更高精度的机器人抓取任务，且具备良好的零样本迁移能力。

title: Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Under review at EMNLP 2026
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) lets vision-language systems answer questions that exceed their parametric knowledge by conditioning a reader on passages retrieved from a Wikipedia-scale knowledge base. In pure-text long-context LLMs, retrieved-context use follows the U-shaped "lost-in-the-middle" effect of Liu et al. (2024): information at the start and end of context is used, the middle is lost. Whether this transfers to deployed multimodal KB-VQA is open. To close this gap, we design the first controlled probe of reader-side position dependence in multimodal KB-VQA: a gold-position protocol in which only the gold passage's prompt slot varies within question. We run it on three open-source 7B/8B VLM readers and two KB-VQA benchmarks at k up to 20. The shape flips from U to primacy: gold-at-first beats gold-at-last by 16 to 26 points on every reader-by-benchmark cell, an effect we call "Lost at the End". Three targeted ablations narrow the cause: a text-only control shows the multimodal setting amplifies an already-present text-mode primacy 2.2 to 4.5 times, and image-position and distractor-shuffle ablations together pin the locus to prompt slot 0 of the instruction-tuned reader. On a frozen reader, three retrieval-side fixes (MMR, oracle reranking, rank-based reordering) all leave the gap intact (no separable improvement). Our findings indicate that recall@k is the wrong metric for deployed KB-VQA and that closing the gap requires reader-side intervention; we release our protocol as a controlled instrument for evaluating such interventions.

AI.tldr: 多模态知识问答模型存在严重的“末端丢失”现象：它们更倾向于利用Prompt起始位置的检索知识，而非结束位置；该研究证明单纯提升检索召回率无效，需从模型读取器侧进行干预。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究多模态知识库问答（KB-VQA）中大型多模态模型（VLM）在处理检索增强内容时，是否会出现类似于纯文本LLM的“迷失在中间（lost-in-the-middle）”现象，并验证这些模型对长上下文信息的利用效率。
AI.method: 提出了“黄金位置协议（gold-position protocol）”作为受控探针，通过改变检索知识在Prompt中的位置来测试模型表现；并在三个基准模型（7B/8B VLM）和两个KB-VQA数据集上进行了受控测试，同时辅以文本对照、图像位置消融和干扰项重排等实验分析。
AI.result: 发现KB-VQA存在显著的“末端丢失（Lost at the End）”现象，与纯文本的U型分布不同，多模态模型表现出强烈的首位优势（Primacy），即金标准知识位于第一个位置的效果显著优于位于最后一个位置（领先16-26个百分点）。此外，多模态交互放大了这一偏见，且检索侧的重排优化无法解决此问题。
AI.conclusion: 在多模态KB-VQA中，检索并单纯提升Recall@k指标并不能解决性能瓶颈。目前的基座模型存在严重的“末端丢失”现象，必须通过对读取器（Reader）侧进行显式的架构或训练干预，才能改善对长上下文信息的整合能力。

title: On-Policy Distillation with Curriculum Turn-level Guidance for Multi-turn Agents
summary: Multi-turn agents that plan, invoke tools, and interact with environments offer a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks, yet their capabilities typically rely on very large models whose inference cost is prohibitive in practice.On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is a natural recipe for transferring such capabilities to smaller students, but we find that it suffers a characteristic failure mode in this setting: small student errors compound across turns and push the trajectory out of the teacher's familiar state distribution, so the teacher's supervision becomes least reliable precisely where the student needs it most.We propose Guided On-Policy Distillation (Guided-OPD), a simple yet effective algorithm that mixes teacher- and student-generated turns within each rollout and schedules the teacher's intervention probability along a curriculum that decays to zero.Strong guidance keeps early trajectories close to the teacher distribution and is then gradually withdrawn to recover the purely on-policy regime used at inference.On ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, distilling Qwen3 students from a Qwen3-30B-A3B teacher, Guided-OPD improves Score by 21.1\% and Success Rate by 25.5\% over vanilla OPD on average, with larger gains on smaller students.

AI.tldr: 针对多轮智能体蒸馏中“误差累积导致偏离分布”的顽疾，Guided-OPD 通过动态混合教师干预机制，实现了对轻量化学生模型的高效训练。
AI.motivation: 现有的多轮智能体蒸馏方法（OPD）存在误差累积问题，导致学生模型容易偏离教师的分布，使得关键时刻的教学指导失效，且大模型推理成本难以满足实际应用需求。
AI.method: 提出“引导式在线策略蒸馏”（Guided-OPD）：在单次 Rollout 中混合教师模型与学生模型的反馈，并采用随训练进度衰减的教师干预概率（退火调度）方案，确保学生模型既能维持在教师的分布区域，又能逐步过渡到自主执行模式。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 WebShop 等基准测试中，相较于传统 OPD，Guided-OPD 将分数提高了 21.1%，成功率提高了 25.5%，且模型越小，增益越显著。
AI.conclusion: Guided-OPD 通过引入混合式引导和动态调度机制，有效解决了小模型在复杂任务中因误差累积导致的训练不稳定性，是实现高效大模型知识蒸馏到小模型的有效途径。

title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
summary: The ability to react dynamically to tactile signals has long been considered crucial to agile human-level dexterity. Yet contemporary learning-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation generally either overlook the tactile modality or are limited to encoders with static cues, due in part to the scarcity of diverse training data and standardized evaluation, architectural constraints in current VLA models, and limitations of static tactile encoders. In this paper, we push the frontier of tactile-reactive manipulation by addressing all of these limitations. We propose a large-scale, 100-hour tactile-rich dataset collected via a novel, data-efficient recipe that prioritizes elementary motor primitives. To effectively exploit naturally high-frequency touch signals without sacrificing the existing capabilities of existing VLAs, we introduce a variable-rate Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture equipped with a novel temporal tactile VQ-VAE encoder. We demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-reactive policies on 12 manipulation tasks requiring delicate force control and deformable object manipulation, achieving over 30% higher average success rate than the strongest baseline.
