AI.tldr: 本文通过构建大规模触觉数据集并提出新型MoT与时间触觉VQ-VAE架构，使VLA模型具备了动态触觉反应能力，显著提升了机器人灵巧操作的成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型在触觉模态上的缺失或对静态触觉编码器的依赖，难以支持人类水平的灵巧操作，亟需解决训练数据匮乏及架构限制问题。
AI.method: 1. 构建了包含100小时数据的触觉数据集（基于基本运动图元）；2. 提出变分率混合专家Transformer (MoT) 架构，结合新型时间触觉VQ-VAE编码器以处理高频信号；3. 实现了触觉感知与VLA模型的深度融合。
AI.result: 在12项复杂操作任务（涉及精细力控与物体形变）中，对比最强基线算法，平均成功率提升了30%以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入高质量数据集、变分率MoT架构和高性能时间触觉编码器，成功缩小了VLA模型在触觉处理上的短板，显著提升了机器人在需要细腻力控及形变操作任务中的表现。

title: REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience
summary: Large multimodal language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for guiding evolutionary search toward interpretable programmatic policies. However, existing frameworks rely on a monolithic model call to simultaneously interpret visual behavioral evidence and synthesize corrective code. This diagnosis-repair entanglement creates an opaque feedback loop, obscuring the rationale behind mutations and preventing the retention of algorithmic insights across independent runs. To achieve auditable and efficient policy search, we argue that visual diagnosis must be structurally decoupled from code generation. We present REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework that operationalizes this decoupling. In REFLEX, a vision-enabled Critic first distills task-specific behavioral evidence into structured, auditable diagnoses. Subsequently, a text-optimized Actor synthesizes child policies using these diagnoses alongside a persistent, self-evolving Skill Memory of reusable code snippets. This architecture not only provides transparent mutation traces but also enables cross-run programmatic knowledge transfer. Extensive evaluations across control benchmarks (Lunar Lander, Acrobot, Pendulum) and a 36-dimensional antenna array synthesis task demonstrate exceptional sample efficiency. Notably, REFLEX solves Acrobot and Pendulum in under 10 LLM calls and reaches a best Normalized Weighted Score of 1.092 on Lunar Lander, achieving highly competitive final performance while significantly accelerating the early-stage discovery of transparent policies.

AI.tldr: REFLEX 是一种模块化的进化策略搜索框架，通过将视觉诊断从复杂的代码生成过程中解耦，实现了透明、高效且具备知识积累能力的程序策略合成。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型（LLM）驱动的进化搜索通常将视觉诊断和代码合成融合在单一模型调用中，导致反馈循环不透明、推理逻辑缺失且无法在多次运行间累积算法经验。
AI.method: 提出了 REFLEX 框架，其核心是将“视觉诊断”与“代码合成”解耦：1. 视觉评论者（Critic）将行为证据转化为结构化诊断；2. 文本优化执行者（Actor）结合诊断与可重用的“技能记忆（Skill Memory）”合成新策略。
AI.result: 在 Lunar Lander、Acrobot、Pendulum 及天线阵列合成任务中表现优异；在 Acrobot 和 Pendulum 上实现 10 次内 LLM 调用即解决任务，并显著提升了早期策略发现的速度与质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉诊断与代码生成解耦，REFLEX 框架提高了策略搜索的透明度、可审计性和样本效率，并展示了在不同任务中跨运行积累程序知识的有效性。

title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Event Forecasting
comment: Submitted internally at the University of Oxford in Oct 2025, migrated to arXiv on Jun 2026
summary:
We use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a recently devised sample and memory efficient reinforcement learning method, to finetune pretrained LLMs in the range of 1.5B to 14B parameters equipped with the ability to get current information through the use of a Wikipedia revisions tool, or news summaries, to forecast real events beyond the knowledge cutoff of the LLM, as well as problems made to simulate different aspects of the dynamics of that training.
  We use the results of these experiments to comment on the scaling capability of LLMs for forecasting, as well as classify how judgmental forecasting fits into the verifiable/unverifiable domain taxonomy, considering the impact of the inherent aleatoric uncertainty when forecasting future events (e.g. the roll of a die).
  As a result of the GRPO training, we manage to bring a 1.5B parameter transformer (Qwen 2.5 1.5B) to forecasting performance superior to Claude Sonnet 3.5 over the same dataset as measured by cross entropy from the market agreed probabilities. We also discuss various dead ends on the path to this result.

AI.tldr: 本文通过使用GRPO强化学习算法微调小型LLM，展示了其在获取实时信息后实现超越大模型（如Claude 3.5）的预测能力，并深入探讨了判断性预测与不确定性之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 探讨并验证LLM在利用实时信息进行未来事件预测（超越知识截止日期）的能力，分析其在大规模训练下的扩展性，并评估这类判断性预测（Judgmental Forecasting）在可验证性领域分类中的地位，特别是应对本质不确定性的能力。
AI.method: 使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）方法对1.5B至14B规模的LLM进行微调；模型配备Wikipedia修订工具和新闻摘要工具以获取实时信息；通过模拟不同动态的预测问题进行训练。
AI.result: 经过GRPO训练的1.5B参数模型（Qwen 2.5 1.5B）在预测性能上（基于市场一致概率的交叉熵指标）超越了Claude Sonnet 3.5。同时，作者记录并讨论了探索过程中的多种失败路径。
AI.conclusion: 通过GRPO强化学习训练，较小的模型（如Qwen 2.5 1.5B）在外推预测任务上能够超越行业领先的大模型（如Claude Sonnet 3.5）。研究指出JUDGMENTAL预测属于存在本质不确定性（Aleatoric uncertainty）的领域，并验证了LLM在超越预训练知识截止日期后的预测扩展能力。

title: SkillWiki: A Living Knowledge Infrastructure for Agent Skills
summary: While knowledge is managed through Wikipedia and software through GitHub, agent skills still lack an infrastructure for large-scale production, governance, and evolution. SkillWiki is a living knowledge infrastructure that supports the organization, grounding, and continuous evolution of agent skills by transforming heterogeneous knowledge into reusable skill assets linked to their originating evidence. Our demonstration presents the complete skill lifecycle, from knowledge ingestion and skill production to provenance-aware exploration, governance, and execution-driven evolution. SkillWiki highlights a future in which knowledge, skills, and execution experience co-evolve within a shared infrastructure. The live demonstration and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/Huangdingcheng/SkillWiki.

AI.tldr: SkillWiki 是一个为智能体技能打造的基础设施，旨在通过构建“知识到技能”的转化、管理与演化闭环，解决智能体技能在生产与治理方面的碎片化问题。
AI.motivation: 针对目前智能体技能缺乏大规模生产、治理和演化基础设施的问题，模仿 Wikipedia 和 GitHub 对知识和软件的管理方式，旨在构建一个支持智能体技能持续进化的共享基础设施。
AI.method: 提出 SkillWiki 基础设施，通过整合知识摄入、技能生产、来源溯源管理、治理及基于执行反馈的进化机制，建立了一套完整的智能体技能全生命周期管理框架。
AI.result: 实现了一个公开可用的 SkillWiki 系统，涵盖了从知识提取到技能执行演化的完整闭环，并提供了源代码和演示平台，验证了跨来源、可溯源的技能资产管理的可行性。
AI.conclusion: SkillWiki 提供了一种将知识转化为可重用智能体技能的范式，通过构建基础设施实现技能的生产、治理与持续进化，推动智能体技能生态的协同发展。

title: An Exploratory Study of Blood Glucose Estimation from Photoplethysmography Signals using Machine Learning
summary: Diabetes and extreme blood sugar levels are some of the major health problems faced by humans today across the world. While Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) has emerged as an effective technology for management of diabetes as well as for monitoring blood sugar levels, this technology has traditionally been invasive (that is, requiring the piercing of the skin) and carries the risk of irritation, induration, etc. This highlights the need for accurate and non-invasive CGM methods that can be deployed at scale. With the emergence of various sensing technologies and their integration in wearables like the smart-watch, we now have the capability to continuously monitor body signals like the Photoplethysmogram (PPG) in a non-invasive manner. Having the ability to continuously monitor blood glucose through CGMs and continuously monitor PPG signals through a smart-watch offers an opportunity to get dense data on these two, opening the possibility of building machine learning and deep learning based models to estimate blood glucose level from PPG signals. In this work, we first present a paired dataset comprising continuous PPG signals from a smartwatch along with glucose values recorded using a CGM device. We also present the results of some preliminary experimental explorations performed on our dataset. These preliminary results suggest that some predictive signals may exist, though more exploration is needed with more data from a larger number of individuals. The dataset can be accessed at https://zenodo.org/records/20577959

AI.tldr: 本文旨在解决传统侵入式血糖监测的局限性，提出了一种利用智能手表PPG信号进行非侵入式血糖估测的方法，并公开了相关的配对数据集以促进该领域的研究与模型开发。
AI.motivation: 传统连续血糖监测（CGM）技术具有侵入性，易引起皮肤不适或炎症，因此亟需一种基于可穿戴设备（如智能手表）的非侵入式、可大规模部署的血糖监测方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含智能手表采集的连续PPG信号与CGM设备记录的实时血糖值的配对数据集，并利用机器学习/深度学习模型对该数据集进行了初步探索性实验。
AI.result: 初步实验结果显示，PPG信号中可能包含反映血糖变化的预测特征，验证了利用PPG估计血糖水平的潜力，同时也指出了现有数据仍不足以构建高精度的预测模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号进行无创血糖监测具有可行性，但在实现临床级准确度之前，仍需扩大数据集规模并进行更深入的机器学习研究。

title: Can LLM Coding Agents Reason About Time Series?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for automated decision-making systems in finance, healthcare, or environmental monitoring. Time series data are ubiquitous in these fields, yet hard to process automatically. Can time series be analyzed by LLM agents? We examine three approaches: providing the agent with raw numerical data, using the LLM as a coding agent, or a combination of both. In the coding agent setup, the model iteratively queries the data using Python code. Using two time series understanding benchmarks, we show that agents with code access can outperform models processing raw data by up to 10%. However, even the best performing agent still answers about 22-34% of the questions incorrectly. To get insights into models' strategies and reasoning gaps, we analyze the model outputs with a strong LLM judge. Our analysis reveals that coding agents can select appropriate statistical tests, but often miss important nuances. Meanwhile, models with access to raw data can reach the right conclusions using back-of-the-envelope calculations.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了LLM处理时间序列的三种策略，发现使用编码代理（Python辅助）不仅性能更优，且能显著改善分析准确性，但目前的模型在逻辑推理和复杂细微问题的处理上仍存在显著瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在金融、医疗等领域的自动化决策中应用日益广泛，但时间序列数据的处理仍是一个难题。研究旨在探索LLM代理分析时间序列的能力及最佳策略。
AI.method: 对比了三种使大模型（LLM）分析时间序列的方法：1. 提供原始数值数据；2. 使LLM作为编码代理（通过Python代码查询数据）；3. 上述两者的结合，并利用强大的LLM评测器对模型输出进行深入分析。
AI.result: 编码代理模式比处理原始数据的模型性能提升了约10%，但所有模型在时间序列理解基准测试中仍有22-34%的错误率。分析显示，编码代理擅长选择统计方法但易忽略细微差别，而直接处理原始数据的模型则依赖经验性计算。
AI.conclusion: 虽然编码辅助代理在处理时间序列任务上优于单纯处理原始数据的模型，但两者在复杂分析上仍有显著局限性。未来需要解决模型在统计细微差别理解及复杂推理方面的不足。

title: Causal-Privacy Audit Workflow for Synthetic and Distilled Data in Dropout Support
summary: Synthetic and distilled student data are increasingly used to enable privacy-conscious learning analytics, yet their suitability for decision-facing institutional support remains uncertain. In dropout support, generated data must preserve not only predictive utility or distributional resemblance, but also the financial-status evidence used to guide advising, payment-plan assistance, and scholarship-related decisions. Method: This study introduces CaP-Eval, a decision-facing causal-privacy audit workflow for evaluating generated student data under a fixed estimand, timing-aware adjustment design, estimator set, and empirical privacy-governance screen. The workflow compares original, distilled, adversarial synthetic, statistical synthetic, and DPGNet privacy-oriented generated data on predictive utility, treatment-effect fidelity, robustness to alternative estimators, and local training-record proximity. Results: DPGNet and distilled data preserved the original financial-status treatment-effect structure more reliably than the adversarial and Gaussian Copula baselines. DPGNet preserved full direction and rank agreement across epsilon levels; epsilon = 10 produced the smallest non-original IPW and DML deviations, while epsilon = 1 and epsilon = 5 amplified several financial-status contrasts. Distilled data remained highly faithful but retained the strongest local training-record proximity signal. TabularGNet preserved qualitative directions with moderate attenuation, and Gaussian Copula compressed effect magnitudes. Conclusions: Predictive utility, privacy orientation, empirical disclosure signals, and causal fidelity diverged; generated student data require joint audits of direction, magnitude, overlap, and release-governance risk before decision use.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了CaP-Eval框架，用于审计合成数据在教育决策中的应用潜力。结果表明，仅凭预测精度不足以保障决策安全，必须联合评估数据的因果保真度与隐私风险；其中DPGNet在因果结构保留与隐私均衡方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 随着合成数据在隐私保护学习分析中的应用增加，目前尚不清楚这些数据是否足以支撑需要高度准确性的机构决策（如辍学预防、经济状况评估等），尤其是现有评估往往忽略了决策所需的因果效应保真度。
AI.method: 提出了“CaP-Eval”框架，这是一个面向决策的因果隐私审计工作流。该方法基于固定的被估计量、时间感知调整设计、估计器集合和经验隐私治理屏障，对比了原始数据与多种生成式数据（蒸馏、对抗性合成、统计合成、DPGNet）在预测效用、处理效应忠实度、估计器鲁棒性及本地训练记录接近度方面的表现。
AI.result: DPGNet和蒸馏数据在保持财务状况处理效应结构方面表现最佳；DPGNet在各种隐私预算（epsilon）下不仅保持了方向和秩的一致性，还在epsilon=10时最小化了偏差。相比之下，蒸馏数据存在较高的本地训练记录泄露风险，而其他基线模型（如TabularGNet、Gaussian Copula）在因果方向或量级上表现出明显的偏差或压缩。
AI.conclusion: 为了确保生成式学生数据在教育决策（如经济援助、奖学金支持）中的安全性和有效性，必须在投入使用前进行综合评估，涵盖预测效用、隐私保护、因果忠实度和发布治理风险的联合审计。

title: Towards Next-Generation Healthcare: A Survey of Medical Embodied AI for Perception, Decision-Making, and Action
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive performance in enhancing healthcare efficiency across a wide range of medical applications. Nevertheless, their limited ability to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world significantly constrains their effectiveness in real-world clinical workflows, where safety-critical decision-making and physical execution are tightly coupled. Recently, embodied artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising physical-interactive paradigm for intelligent healthcare, enabling agents to operate in complex medical environments. As research in this area rapidly expands, understanding how intelligent agents function as integrated, end-to-end systems in clinical environments becomes increasingly critical. However, existing surveys on medical embodied AI largely emphasize individual aspects or functional components, lacking a unified system-level organization of the field. To support and consolidate recent advances, we systematically survey the core components of medical embodied AI, with a particular emphasis on the coordinated integration of perception, decision-making, and action. We further review representative medical applications and relevant datasets, and we analyze the major challenges encountered in real-world clinical practice. Finally, we discuss key directions for future research in this rapidly evolving field. The associated project can be found at https://github.com/VMVLab/Medical_Embodied_AI_Paper_List.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了医疗具身智能领域，提出从单纯的AI模型转向感知、决策与物理交互深度集成的端到端系统架构，以应对临床环境中的安全与实践挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型（Foundation Models）虽在医疗数据处理上表现优异，但缺乏对物理世界的感知与交互能力，难以满足临床安全关键（safety-critical）场景的动态协同需求。针对当前相关研究缺乏系统性梳理的问题，本文旨在提供一个统一的医疗具身智能概念框架。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述（Systematic Review）：从系统工程的角度，分析感知（Perception）、决策（Decision-making）与执行（Action）的集成机制；涵盖了代表性医疗应用场景、相关数据集、临床实践的主要挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.result: 构建了一个医疗具身智能的系统性框架，明确了以感知-决策-交互为核心的集成架构，梳理了领域内的主要挑战（如环境复杂性、安全性）并展望了未来技术趋势。
AI.conclusion: 医疗具身智能（Medical Embodied AI）是实现临床医疗自动化的关键范式，未来的研究应重点关注感知、决策与执行的高度集成，以应对复杂临床环境中的安全与执行挑战。

title: The BD-LSC Dataset: Facilitating the Benchmarking of Models for Lexical Semantic Change Detection in Slang and Standard Usage
summary: Automatic semantic change detection aims to identify how word meanings shift over time, offering insights into both linguistic and societal change. Despite recent progress in computational lexical semantic change (LSC), existing benchmarks and methods struggle to capture bi-directional semantic change, particularly cases where words simultaneously gain and lose senses. This problem is especially challenging for words that have both slang and standard meanings. To address these gaps, we introduce two complementary benchmark datasets. The Bi-Directional Lexical Semantic Change (BD-LSC) dataset captures sense gain, sense loss, and stability across three time periods, enabling the study of complex semantic trajectories. The SlangTrack Word Sense Disambiguation (ST-WSD) dataset provides fine-grained, instance-level sense annotations for words combining slang and standard usages, supporting systematic benchmarking of WSD and semantic change detection models. Using these benchmarks, we systematically evaluate models across different methodological families: unsupervised clustering using contextualised embeddings, supervised machine learning, transformer-based models, and state-of-the-art large language models. Among the evaluated systems, the few-shot GPT-4o model achieved the strongest aggregate performance on Exact Sense Match (ESM) and multi-label accuracy; however, Macro-F1 scores near 0.5 across all systems show that rare slang senses remain difficult, which we identify as the central open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对双向词汇语义变化和俚语词义消歧的两个新基准数据集，评估发现大型语言模型表现领先，但识别罕见俚语仍是当前技术瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算词汇语义变化（LSC）方法难以捕捉“双向”语义变化（即词汇同时获得和失去意义），尤其是在处理俚语与标准意义并存的复杂情况时。
AI.method: 构建了两个基准数据集：BD-LSC（双向词汇语义变化数据集）和 ST-WSD（俚语导向的词义消歧数据集）；利用这些数据对无监督聚类、监督学习、Transformer 和大语言模型（如 GPT-4o）进行了系统评估。
AI.result: GPT-4o（少样本学习）在精确语意匹配和多标签准确率上表现最佳；但在所有模型中，宏观 F1 分数仍然较低，反映出识别罕见俚语语义存在显著困难。
AI.conclusion: 目前的模型在处理包含俚语的复杂语义变化时表现有限（Macro-F1 约为 0.5），识别罕见的俚语语义仍是该领域的核心挑战。

title: Scalar-Stepsize Nonuniform Monte Carlo Optimistic Policy Iteration: A Certified Counterexample
summary: Tsitsiklis proved convergence of Monte Carlo optimistic policy iteration under a uniform update structure and identified nonuniform update frequencies as a delicate obstruction. We give a certified negative answer for the natural scalar-stepsize, unnormalized asynchronous state-value recursion with fixed nonuniform state-selection probabilities. In a three-state, two-action discounted MDP, the nonuniform update frequencies induce a diagonally scaled greedy-policy mean field with a certified nonconstant attracting hybrid periodic orbit. With a bounded unbiased geometric-horizon estimator and Robbins--Monro stepsizes, the original stochastic recursion remains trapped near the cycle with positive probability and therefore fails to converge. The example pinpoints a geometric obstruction: uniform sampling gives radial residual contraction, whereas scalar nonuniform sampling anisotropically distorts the residual dynamics and can generate switched attracting cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文通过反例证明，在异步策略迭代中，非一致的状态更新采样会导致系统动力学出现各向异性畸变，从而产生吸引性循环周期，导致算法无法收敛。
AI.motivation: Tsitsiklis 曾证明了统一更新结构下蒙特卡洛乐观策略迭代的收敛性，但非一致更新频率的影响尚不明确。本文旨在探讨非一致采样是否会破坏这一随机递归算法的收敛性。
AI.method: 构建了一个具体的三状态、双动作折扣马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）反例；分析了该系统在非一致更新频率下形成的对角缩放贪婪策略平均场（mean field）动力学；通过证明该系统存在不变量为非恒定的吸引周期轨道（periodic orbit）来验证结论。
AI.result: 证明了在使用标量步长和固定非一致状态选择概率的情况下，即便采用有界无偏几何视界估计器和 Robbins-Monro 步长，该算法仍有正概率陷于周期轨道而无法收敛。
AI.conclusion: 非一致性采样会导致递归动力学产生各向异性的形变，从而诱发吸引性的周期轨道，导致随机递归算法无法收敛。因此，在非一致更新频率下，标准的标量步长异步策略迭代存在根本性收敛障碍。

title: Fast When, Careful Who: Dual-Process Multiparty Turn-Taking with Diffusion Augmentation
summary: Reliable turn-taking is essential for spoken dialogue systems. However, most existing methods are designed for two-speaker interaction and struggle with realistic multiparty audio containing overlap and rapid speaker changes. We study multiparty turn-taking on the VoxConverse dataset and propose an audio-only two-stage pipeline that separates when to trigger a turn boundary from whether the floor is actually transferring. A fast trigger scans the audio and proposes candidate end-of-turn times, while a lightweight verifier runs only at those times to decide \textsc{Hold} or \textsc{Shift} and support next-speaker prediction. We report results in the full multiparty setting and a controlled dyadic top-2 projection for comparability. We also investigate diffusion-based, label-preserving background-audio mixing as a data augmentation strategy. Results show improved shift detection over a baseline, with further improvements from diffusion augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多人对话这一挑战，提出了一种双阶段音频轮流交替检测系统（触发+验证），并通过扩散模型增强数据，实现了比传统方法更优的多人场景交互控制。
AI.motivation: 现有轮流交替检测方法主要针对双人对话，在多人音频（包含重叠和快速发言人切换）环境下的表现不够理想，缺乏对复杂交互场景的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1. 两阶段管线：包含一个快速扫描音频的“触发器”（Trigger）用于候选时刻检测，以及一个轻量级的“验证器”（Verifier）用于判定会话转移（Shift）或保持（Hold）及预测下一发言人。2. 数据增强：采用基于扩散模型（Diffusion-based）的标签保留背景音频混合策略。
AI.result: 在VoxConverse数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在多人对话设置下有效提升了切换点检测性能，通过扩散模型进行数据增强后效果进一步增强。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种专为多人对话场景设计的高效两阶段轮流交替（turn-taking）检测管线，通过将“边界触发”与“占位/交替判定”解耦，显著提升了在复杂声学环境下的检测性能，且数据增强技术进一步优化了模型表现。

title: Do Safety Monitors Stay Reliable After an Update? Benchmarking and Predicting Activation-Monitor Staleness
summary: Activation monitors-lightweight probes trained on a language model's internal representations-are an increasingly common layer in deployment safety stacks. Deployed models however are rarely static: they are quantized, fine-tuned, adapted with LoRA, or served with merged adapters while the monitor remains frozen. We present the first systematic test of whether this implicit contract holds: whether activation monitors trained on a base model remain reliable after these routine model updates. Across multiple safety-relevant monitors, model depths, update families, and open-weight models, we find a sharp split: quantization-style updates largely preserve frozen probe performance, while fine-tuning-style updates frequently make probes stale. Fragility is highly monitor-dependent, with privacy/PII probes most affected and refusal-compliance probes comparatively stable, showing that retraining a behavior need not stale its corresponding monitor. QLoRA is especially damaging despite NF4 quantization alone being relatively benign, suggesting that quantization becomes riskier when combined with adaptation. We further show that degradation is predictable from pre-deployment features, enabling revalidation budgets to be triaged toward the monitors most likely to fail. These results suggest that fine-tuning should trigger activation-monitor revalidation by default, while prediction can help prioritize which monitors to check first.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了冻结的激活监测器在模型微调后会频繁失效，因此在模型更新时必须触发重新校验，且可利用预测模型来精简校验成本。
AI.motivation: 当前安全架构常使用激活监测器来监控大模型，但在实际部署中，模型会频繁进行量化或微调等更新，而监测器通常处于冻结状态。本文旨在系统评估这种“固定监测器”方案在模型更新后的可靠性。
AI.method: 通过对多个开源大模型进行实验，测试不同类型的模型更新（量化、微调、LoRA适配等）对预训练激活监测器性能的影响，并分析了监测器失效的规律及其可预测性。
AI.result: 量化类更新通常对监测器性能影响较小；但微调类更新（特别是QLoRA）会显著导致监测器失效；监测器失效的程度具有特征依赖性（如PII监测器更脆弱），且这种失效可以通过预部署特征进行预测。
AI.conclusion: 激活监测器在模型进行微调（尤其是引入LoRA等适配器）后往往会失效，因此模型更新后必须进行重新校验。文中提出的基于特征的预测方法可用于优化重新校验的资源分配。

title: FlowMPC: Improving Flow Matching policies with World Models
summary: Flow Matching (FM) is a powerful approach for behavior cloning in multimodal action spaces [Jiang et al., 2025], but because it is not trained to directly maximize expected return, there is still room to improve how FM policies act at test time. This work investigates whether a learned world model can improve FM policies by enabling Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) planning over candidate action sequences proposed by the policy. Building on TD-MPC2 [Hansen et al., 2024], I introduce FlowMPC, a framework that combines an imitation-learned FM policy with a learned world model for test-time planning in ManiSkill manipulation tasks [Tao et al., 2025]. Across PickCube and PickSingleYCB, adding the world model improved performance over the FM policy alone, with especially clear gains in end-of-episode success. These results suggest that world-model-based planning can effectively complement flow-based imitation policies without modifying the FM training objective.

AI.tldr: FlowMPC将Flow Matching策略与世界模型规划（MPPI）相结合，在不调整训练目标的情况下，显著提升了模仿学习在机器人操作任务中的测试性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的Flow Matching（FM）策略虽在多模态动作空间中表现出色，但其训练目标并非直接针对最大化预期收益，导致其在测试时的决策能力仍有优化空间。
AI.method: 提出FlowMPC框架：结合模仿学习训练的Flow Matching（FM）策略与基于TD-MPC2学习到的世界模型，在测试时利用模型预测路径积分（MPPI）对FM策略生成的候选动作序列进行优化规划。
AI.result: 在ManiSkill的PickCube和PickSingleYCB任务中，FlowMPC在性能上优于单一的FM策略，并在任务末期的执行效果上表现出明显的增益。
AI.conclusion: 在不改变Flow Matching训练目标的前提下，引入基于世界模型的测试时规划（MPPI）能够有效增强多模态行为克隆策略的决策能力，尤其是在任务结束阶段表现出显著的成功率提升。

title: Can LLM Agents Infer World Models? Evidence from Agentic Automata Learning
summary: We propose agentic automata learning to evaluate the extent to which tool-calling LLM agents can uncover hidden environments through interaction. In our setup, an agent should uncover a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA) by interacting with an oracle through (1) membership queries ("Does this string belong to the target language?") and (2) equivalence queries ("Is this the target DFA?"). This yields a scalable testbed with controlled task complexity, measurable interaction efficiency, and strong baselines (classic automata-learning algorithms). Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that performance drops sharply as DFA size increases. Reasoning models are markedly stronger than non-reasoning models, yet trajectory analyses reveal recurring failures in query planning, evidence integration, and hypothesis construction. Overall, our results show that current LLM agents can sometimes perform non-trivial interactive discovery, but remain far less robust and efficient than classic algorithms for the task.

AI.tldr: 研究通过自动机学习任务评估LLM智能体的交互探索能力，发现模型在处理复杂环境时仍逊色于经典算法，且在逻辑规划与证据推理方面存在显著局限。
AI.motivation: 评估工具调用型大模型（LLM Agents）在通过交互揭示隐环境方面的能力，并量化其交互效率与推理能力。
AI.method: 提出“智能体自动机学习（Agentic Automata Learning）”评估框架，即通过成员查询（Membership Queries）和等价查询（Equivalence Queries）让LLM智能体去反推隐含的确定性有限自动机（DFA），并与经典自动机学习算法进行对比。
AI.result: LLM的性能随DFA规模增大而急剧下降；推理模型表现优于非推理模型，但所有模型在查询规划、证据整合与假设构建上均暴露出持续的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前的大模型智能体在进行交互式探索任务时，虽能完成简单的发现任务，但在复杂度和健壮性上远不及经典的自动机学习算法；模型在规划、信息整合与假设构建方面存在明显缺陷。

title: Decomposing one-class support vector machine into an ensemble of one-data support vector machines
summary: One-class classification (OCC) is a classification problem in which the training data contains only one class. The one-class support vector machine (OCSVM) is one of the most competitive OCC algorithms. However, OCSVM has scalability issues with large-scale datasets. This paper proposes the acceleration strategy of OCSVM. The idea is to decompose the dataset into samples and train OCSVM models for single data points. Subsequently, ensemble learning is applied to combine all models to compute the OCSVM model for the dataset. In addition, further acceleration is achieved through a data-reduction strategy with an OCSVM model trained on the average of the training samples. The experiment compared the proposal and traditional OCSVM using the Python package. The proposed strategy is faster than traditional OCSVM, while achieving similar classification results. Moreover, the proposed strategy can create one-to-one correspondence between samples and models. Source code is uploaded at https://github.com/ToshiHayashi/ODSVM

AI.tldr: 针对OCSVM在大规模数据集上计算效率低下的问题，本文提出了一种基于集成学习的分解与数据约简加速策略，在兼顾分类性能的同时大幅提升了处理速度。
AI.motivation: 传统一类支持向量机（OCSVM）在面对大规模数据集时存在可扩展性（性能与效率）不足的问题，需要有效的加速方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于集成学习的分解策略：将数据集拆解为单个样本进行模型训练，并通过集成学习合并结果；同时引入了一种基于训练样本均值的数据约简策略以进一步加速。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持与传统OCSVM相当的分类性能的同时，显著提高了训练速度。
AI.conclusion: 该文提出的加速策略有效地解决了OCSVM在处理大规模数据集时的可扩展性问题，在保持分类准确性的前提下显著提升了训练效率，并具备样本与模型的一一对应特性。

title: Direction-Conditioned Policies via Compositional Subgoal Scoring for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
comment: 17 pages, Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning at ICML 2026 (Seoul, South Korea)
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman theory implies that the optimal goal-conditioned action depends on the goal only through the gradient of the goal-reaching distance at the current state, yet standard online GCRL still conditions the actor on the raw goal -- a signal that is geometrically uninformative when the goal is far from the data distribution. We propose Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a fully online method that decomposes goal-reaching into two components sharing one InfoNCE representation $ψ$: a subgoal-scoring step that selects a visited state $z_t$ aligned with the final goal $g$ in $ψ_g$, and a direction-conditioned actor that consumes the unit direction $d_t$ and magnitude $r_t$ from $ψ(s_t)$ to $ψ(z_t)$. The two components train jointly, factor cleanly at deployment (subgoal scoring is removed, while direction conditioning remains with $g$ in place of $z_t$), and admit independent modification at the same $(d_t,r_t)$ interface. We prove three results. First, direction sufficiency under HJB: the optimal action under control-affine dynamics depends on the goal only through the value gradient. Second, a quantitative bound showing that, under mild conditions on the learned representation and assuming the scoring rule returns an on-path $z_t$, the actor's conditioning input at training and at deployment coincide up to representation error and geodesic slack. Third, a controllable-subspace characterization of when directional conditioning fails. Across nine environments, DCP improves over Contrastive RL on most final metrics, with the largest gains on manipulation and obstacle-interaction tasks; a qualitative analysis of the learned $ψ$-distance landscape shows the contrastive representation behaves as an online quasimetric encoding environment topology, and the single failure case (AntSoccer) localizes to a learned-gradient pathology that the theory anticipates.

AI.tldr: 针对传统 GCRL 中目标输入几何信息匮乏的问题，本文提出 DCP 方法，通过将目标转化为路径方向和距离进行条件化决策，在保持理论稳健性的同时显著提升了在该复杂几何环境下的学习效果。
AI.motivation: 标准目标条件强化学习（GCRL）直接将原始目标作为输入，但在目标远离数据分布时，该信号缺乏几何信息，难以引导优化方向。研究利用 HJB 方程指出最优动作仅依赖于目标达成距离的梯度。
AI.method: 提出了方向条件策略（DCP），将目标达成过程解耦为两部分：1. 基于 InfoNCE 表示的学习 subgoal 选择机制；2. 基于路径向量（方向 d_t 和距离 r_t）的条件策略网络。两者联合训练，部署时利用表示空间中的方向和距离进行决策，而非直接使用目标状态。
AI.result: 在九个环境的实验中，DCP 优于基准方法（Contrastive RL），且在操作和避障任务中增益最为显著。证实了表示学习能够编码环境拓扑（准度量），并从理论和实验上解释了模型在特定任务（AntSoccer）中表现不佳的原因。
AI.conclusion: DCP 利用方向和距离信息替代原始目标输入，实现了更稳健的 GCRL。理论证明了在控制仿射动力学下方向的充分性，且实验验证了该方法在复杂任务中的优势，同时通过理论分析指出了该方法的局限性（可控子空间限制）。

title: Uncertainty Is Not a Safety Net for Clinical VQA, but Can It Anticipate Model Failure?
summary: Safe deployment of clinical vision-language models (VLMs) requires reliable uncertainty estimation (UE): a signal indicating when predictions should be trusted or escalated to a clinician. We test whether current UE methods actually deliver this signal. Benchmarking 8 methods across 12 VLMs on clinical visual question-answering (VQA), we find that UE quality is not an intrinsic property of the UE method: it tracks model accuracy, degrading precisely where the model performance is weakest, and therefore where reliability is most needed. When we stress-test models by hiding the correct option among the multiple-choice answers (NOTA perturbations), accuracy collapses while uncertainty barely changes, leaving models systematically miscalibrated. Yet, we find that uncertainty on the unperturbed input reliably anticipates which predictions will collapse under NOTA, indicating that UE in current VLMs carries diagnostic information about model fragility. Our results position UE as a diagnostic tool for identifying fragile predictions and motivate perturbation-based evaluation as a path toward safe clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了临床视觉语言模型中的不确定性估计（UE）在面对模型性能崩塌时往往失效，指出UE更适用于作为诊断模型脆弱性的工具，而非单一的置信度信号，并提倡引入扰动测试以确保临床部署安全。
AI.motivation: 临床医学领域对视觉语言模型（VLM）的部署要求极高的安全性，需要可靠的不确定性估计来判断模型何时应由医生介入，但目前缺乏对现有UE方法在临床场景下可靠性的系统基准测试。
AI.method: 在临床视觉问答（VQA）任务中，对12种VLM应用了8种不同的不确定性估计（UE）方法，并通过“无上述选项”（NOTA）扰动测试来评估模型性能与不确定性信号的变化情况。
AI.result: 实验发现，现有UE方法的效果不佳，且其质量高度依赖模型本身的准确性，在模型表现最差时UE反而失效。特别是在NOTA扰动下，模型表现崩塌但不确定性缺乏响应（系统性校准失效），但原始输入的非预期性可作为模型潜在脆弱性的预警指标。
AI.conclusion: 当前临床视觉语言模型（VLM）的不确定性估计方法在模型脆弱性预测方面虽有潜力，但在处理对抗性分布偏移时的可靠性不足。研究建议将不确定性评估作为一种诊断工具，而非仅仅作为置信度指标，并强调基于扰动的评估对临床应用安全至关重要。

title: IBAD: Interpretable Behavioral Anomaly Detection on Human Mobility Data
summary: Human mobility appears highly diverse, yet much of a person's daily mobility can be explained by a small set of recurring behavioral templates, such as commuting, school-centered activities, caregiving, nightlife, or errand patterns. We present \texttt{IBAD} (\underline{I}nterpretable \underline{B}ehavioral \underline{A}nomaly \underline{D}etection), a framework that learns interpretable daily mobility templates and represents each individual as a distribution over mixtures of these templates. Rather than focusing on specific locations, IBAD characterizes activities that individuals perform across locations. This approach first discovers global behavioral templates using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), then employs a hierarchical self-supervised model to learn normal behavior of individuals from their soft behavioral templates. We also introduce a \emph{splicing benchmark} that creates controlled behavioral mismatches between an individual's historical profile and injected mobility patterns. Experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets show that daily behavior can be effectively decomposed into a small number of interpretable templates. Crucially, we show that the learned behavioral archetypes \emph{transfer} across distinct geographic and demographic contexts. Furthermore, IBAD maintains a robust competitive performance across all settings. For reproducibility purposes, the code is accessible at ~\href{https://github.com/USC-InfoLab/IBAD}{https://github.com/USC-InfoLab/IBAD}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 IBAD 框架，通过 LDA 和分层自监督学习将人类移动性分解为可解释的日常行为模板，有效捕捉并检测行为异常，并验证了模型的跨域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类移动性分析往往侧重于特定地点，缺乏对个人日常活动模式（如通勤、照料、娱乐等）的整体性、可解释性描述，且难以捕捉行为层面的异常。
AI.method: 1. 使用潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）发现全局行为模板；2. 采用分层自监督模型，基于模态化（soft）行为模板学习个体正常行为分布；3. 引入“拼接基准（splicing benchmark）”以通过受控行为不匹配进行异常检测评估。
AI.result: 证明了日常行为可以被有效地分解为少量可解释的模板，且这些模板在不同场景下具有良好的跨域迁移性，同时在异常检测任务中保持了鲁棒的性能。
AI.conclusion: IBAD 提供了一种基于可解释行为模板的移动性分析方法。实验证明，所学习的行为原型具有跨地理和人口统计背景的迁移能力，且在异常检测任务中表现稳健且具有竞争优势。

title: ROSA-RL: Uncertainty-Aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Copyright 2026 IEEE. This is the accepted manuscript for 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), not the final published version
summary: Roundabouts challenge automated driving in mixed traffic, as heterogeneous and non-deterministic human behavior, unknown driving intentions, and high interaction complexity create uncertainty about whether the conflict zone will be blocked or available at the moment of entry. We present ROSA-RL -- uncertainty-aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning. It enables safe and efficient roundabout entry for automated and human-driven vehicles in mixed traffic through probabilistic conflict forecasting. A Transformer-based model predicts conflict zone occupancy over a five-second horizon, capturing multi-agent interactions to anticipate upcoming conflicts and available gaps. The prediction outputs encode uncertainty in future motion and intent, and augment the state of a classical RL framework, enabling uncertainty-aware speed coordination. Evaluated in simulations grounded in real-world data, ROSA-RL can effectively handle uncertainty and outperform a comparable model-based baseline, closing the gap to an ideal setting assuming fully known occupancy while improving traffic efficiency and safety. The source code of this work is available under: github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA-RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ROSA-RL，一种利用 Transformer 进行概率冲突预测并结合强化学习的环岛通行规划框架，有效解决了混合交通中人类驾驶行为不确定性对自动驾驶车辆造成的进入难题。
AI.motivation: 在混合交通环境中，由于人类驾驶员的行为具有非确定性和交互复杂度，自动驾驶车辆在进入环岛时难以判断冲突区域是否可用，亟需一种能处理此类不确定性的通行策略。
AI.method: 提出 ROSA-RL 框架：1. 使用 Transformer 模型预测未来 5 秒内冲突区域的占用情况，并对不确定性进行编码；2. 将预测结果引入经典的强化学习（RL）框架中，实现不确定性感知下的速度规划。
AI.result: 在基于真实数据构建的仿真中，ROSA-RL 表现优于传统的基于模型的方法，其性能表现接近于完全获知交通占用信息的理想状态，显著提升了通行效率与安全性。
AI.conclusion: ROSA-RL 成功通过引入概率冲突预测和强化学习，在混合交通环境中实现了比传统基线模型更安全、高效的环岛通行，有效缓解了由于人类驾驶行为不确定性带来的通行障碍。

title: SING: Synthetic Intention Graph for Scalable Active Tool Discovery in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on agent harnesses that manage context, tools, and multi-turn execution, making tools a central interface for acting in realistic digital environments. As harness-connected tool ecosystems expand to hundreds or thousands of APIs, services, and task-specific skills, exhaustive tool schema injection becomes costly and imposes a closed-world assumption that limits agents to a predefined static inventory. Retrieval-augmented tool selection offers a natural alternative, but existing one-shot retrieval methods often fail to align isolated tool descriptions with the agent's true task intention, especially in long-horizon tasks where required capabilities emerge through decomposition, observations, and newly induced subgoals. We propose SING, an intention-aware active tool discovery framework that builds an intention-tool graph linking user intentions, tool capabilities, and tool collaboration patterns, and dynamically retrieves tools according to evolving task states. Using a unified corpus of 7,471 tools, we evaluate SING on three real-world tool-use benchmarks. SING improves Global Recall@5 by up to 59.8% and downstream success rate by up to 28.9% over baselines, while reducing full-corpus tool-schema exposure by 99.8%, demonstrating that intention-aware graph structure enables more accurate and context-efficient tool discovery in large-scale agentic ecosystems.

AI.tldr: SING 是一个意图感知的智能体工具发现框架，通过动态构建“意图-工具图”，极大提升了大规模工具库中工具检索的精准度与效率。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 代理调用的工具规模扩大，传统的穷举式注入方案导致成本高昂且受限于静态清单；现有的一跳式 (one-shot) 检索方法难以处理长程任务中复杂、演进的意图需求。
AI.method: 提出了 SING (Intention-aware active tool discovery) 框架，该框架构建了一个连接用户意图、工具能力和工具协作模式的“意图-工具图”(intention-tool graph)，并根据任务演进状态进行动态工具检索与发现。
AI.result: 在三个真实工具使用基准测试中，SING 将 Global Recall@5 提升了高达 59.8%，下游任务成功率提升了 28.9%，同时将工具模式(schema)的暴露量降低了 99.8%。
AI.conclusion: SING 通过意图感知图结构解决了大规模工具生态中工具发现的准确性与效率问题，证明了动态、上下文感知的检索机制优于传统的静态或一次性检索方法。

title: The Information-Theoretic Benefit of Shared Representations under Orthogonality Constraints
summary: Modern deep learning architectures are increasingly multi-task and multi-modal, using a pretrained foundation model combined with task-specific, fine-tuned models. Empirically, exploiting similarity across different problems, instead of solving them individually, can significantly improve overall performance. While the generalization and sample complexity properties of multitask learning have been widely studied, the parametric complexity of joint approximation in comparison to separate approximation remains less well understood. The question is particularly relevant in modern deep learning, where models are increasingly required to satisfy structural constraints such as equivariance, conservation laws, or orthogonality. We prove lower and upper bounds on the description-length for separate and joint approximation classes, respectively, in uniform norm. We build a class of orthogonal functions by composing a shared hard feature, realized by a Rademacher-Haar wavelet series, with Sawtooth-Walsh readouts to enforce orthogonality of output coordinates. The dyadic tree structure of the Rademacher-Haar wavelet concentrates the approximation hardness in the common feature component, while the readouts act as task-specific heads. Using an information-theoretic framework, we obtain a sharp gap between the optimal approximation rates achievable by joint and separate coding. Finally, we realize this separation in a neural network model using Heaviside activations via reduction to triangle-wave approximation. Our results show that even under an orthogonality constraint joint approximation requires strictly fewer bits in compositional architectures, provided the tasks share a latent hard feature. This provides theoretical insight into the description-length-efficiency of compositional multi-output architectures and clarifies how neural networks can retain expressivity under geometric constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论角度证明了，对于具有共享潜在特征的任务，使用共享骨干的联合学习架构比独立学习架构在参数量（描述长度）上更高效，即使在施加正交约束的情况下依然成立。
AI.motivation: 尽管多任务学习的泛化和样本复杂度已被广泛研究，但多任务联合近似相比于独立近似在参数复杂度（描述长度）上的差异仍不明确，特别是在满足结构约束（如正交性）的现代深度学习模型中。
AI.method: 使用信息论框架分析描述长度（description-length）；构造了一类利用 Rademacher-Haar 小波序列作为共享特征、Sawtooth-Walsh 读取层作为任务特定头的正交函数类；并将其实现为具有 Heaviside 激活函数的级联神经网络模型。
AI.result: 证明了联合近似与独立近似在一致范数下的最优近似速率存在显著差距；展示了在复合架构中，联合学习能够以更低的描述长度（参数量）实现与独立学习相同的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究探讨了复合架构在多任务学习中的参数效率。结果表明，当任务共享潜在的困难特征（latent hard feature）时，即使在正交性约束下，联合近似在描述长度上比独立近似具有显著的优势（需要更少的比特）。这为深度学习中多输出架构的有效性提供了理论支撑。

title: How Far Can Machine Translation Quality Take You? Extrinsic Discourse Evaluation in Goal-Oriented Setups
summary: Existing machine translation (MT) metrics and discourse-focused evaluations primarily assess translation quality intrinsically, without measuring the downstream consequences of translation errors. In this work, we focus on extrinsic discourse evaluation of machine translation under two distinct regimes: static and interactive. Under the static regime, we propose an entity counting task as a probe of referential consistency in discourse. We show that high intrinsic MT quality does not reliably predict downstream discourse success and strong MT systems still produce referential inconsistencies. For the interactive regime, we study the goal-oriented multi-agent Welfare Diplomacy game as a probe of long-horizon communication and coordination. We find that interaction-specific translation failures impact downstream coordination. Our results highlight goal-oriented environments as a viable framework for discourse-sensitive extrinsic MT evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种评估机器翻译外在语篇质量的新方法，通过静态实体计数和交互式博弈任务，证明了翻译质量与下游任务表现之间存在差异，并指出了目标导向环境对评估翻译实用性的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器翻译评估指标（如BLEU、BERTScore等）过于依赖内在质量评估，忽略了翻译错误在下游任务中产生的实际负面影响。
AI.method: 提出了两种评估机制：1. 静态评估：利用“实体计数任务”探测语篇中的指称一致性；2. 交互评估：利用“福利外交（Welfare Diplomacy）”多智能体博弈游戏考察长程交流与协作能力。
AI.result: 研究表明，高内在翻译质量并不能准确预测下游语篇任务的成功，且强劲的MT系统仍存在指称不一致问题；此外，在交互式任务中，特定的翻译错误会直接导致下游协作失败。
AI.conclusion: 以目标导向的环境作为评估机器翻译（MT）语篇性能的有效外在评估框架，并揭示了现有评估指标无法衡量MT对下游任务影响的局限性。

title: Inference-Time Decision Calibration for Temporal Classification
summary: Temporal classification errors are often treated as representation failures, but they can also arise from how available evidence is converted into decisions. This paper proposes a representation--calibration decomposition for temporal classification. We keep a trained native classifier frozen and separate two inference-time interventions: a conservative residual multi-scale branch that adds auxiliary logits to the native prediction, and a post-hoc branch-aware calibrator that recombines native and residual evidence at decision time. This design distinguishes missing temporal evidence from underused decision-level evidence without retraining the backbone. Across FI-2010, PTB-XL, UCI-HAR, MHEALTH, and HARTH, we find that gains are strongly regime-dependent. Residual multi-scale evidence is most useful in noisy or representation-limited settings, especially short-horizon FI-2010 and weaker recurrent backbones, while branch-aware calibration helps when native and auxiliary logits contain complementary evidence not fully exploited by the raw decision rule. Near-saturated settings show limited gains from either intervention. These results suggest that temporal classification should be understood not only as representation learning, but also as the problem of trusting, combining, and calibrating evidence from multiple views.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入残差分支和事后校准模块，将时间序列分类解耦为表征与校准两个维度，在不更新骨干网络的前提下提升了多尺度证据的利用效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列分类错误通常被归结为表征失败，但其实也源于证据如何被转化为决策。现有方法缺乏对“证据不足”与“决策层证据利用不足”的区分。
AI.method: 提出一种“表征-校准”分解框架：保持预训练分类器固定，引入两个推理时干预模块：1) 保守的残差多尺度分支（提供辅助 Logits）；2) 事后分支感知校准器（在决策时刻重新组合原生与残差证据）。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（FI-2010, PTB-XL, UCI-HAR, MHEALTH, HARTH）上的实验表明：残差多尺度证据在噪声大或表征受限场景下效果显著；分支感知校准在原生证据与辅助证据互补时有效；在性能近饱和场景下提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列分类不仅是表征学习的问题，还涉及对多视角证据的信任、组合与校准。该工作证明了通过解耦表征与校准，可以在不重训练回溯骨干网络的情况下提升性能。

title: VeriGraph: Towards Verifiable Data-Analytic Agents
summary: LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in data-intensive analytical tasks, yet their outputs are rarely verifiable: a reliance on linear text trajectories makes their reasoning difficult to audit. In particular, deterministic computations over raw data and semantic deductions over natural-language claims are often entangled in an unstructured stream, leaving numerical conclusions hard to reproduce and qualitative judgments hard to inspect. To address this, we propose VeriGraph, a traceable neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that enables agents to construct an explicit heterogeneous evidence directed acyclic graph (DAG) during execution. VeriGraph introduces three evidence-expansion primitives, namely computational, grounding, and derivational expansion, to connect raw data, interpreter variables, computed results, and natural-language claims in a unified graph. Under this formulation, structural traceability is reduced to graph reachability from raw data sources to terminal claims, while semantic support is measured by claim-level evidence evaluation. To improve graph construction, we further design a graph-based policy optimization strategy with a composite reward that jointly supervises answer correctness, computational integrity, and derivational coherence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that VeriGraph-8B achieves the highest overall score among all baselines. More importantly, VeriGraph produces auditable evidence graphs with substantially stronger claim grounding, achieving a 87.61\% Grounding Rate under our claim-level evidence support evaluation. These results suggest that explicit evidence-graph construction is a promising path toward verifiable data-analytic agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/ignorejjj/VeriGraph.

AI.tldr: 为了解决LLM数据分析智能体推理过程“难以审计”的问题，VeriGraph通过神经符号方法将推理过程转化为可验证的异构有向无环图（DAG），显著提高了结果的可追溯性和语义支撑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体在处理数据密集型任务时，推理过程是线性的、非结构化的，导致数值计算和语义推导混杂，使得结果难以验证和审计。
AI.method: 提出了一种可溯源的神经符号推理框架VeriGraph：1) 将执行过程建模为异构证据有向无环图（DAG）；2) 引入计算、接地和推导三种证据扩展原语；3) 设计了基于图的策略优化及复合奖励机制（涵盖准确性、完整性和一致性）。
AI.result: VeriGraph-8B在四个基准测试中表现最佳；在 claim-level 评估中达到了 87.61% 的接地率（Grounding Rate），证明了其构建高可信、可审计证据图的能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的证据图构建，VeriGraph为大模型实现数据分析任务的可验证性提供了有效途径，显著提升了推理的可审计性和论断的接地性（grounding）。

title: Circuit Tracing in Autoregressive Protein Language Models
comment: Accepted into the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026. 24 pages, 14 figures
summary: Protein language models (pLMs) can generate novel protein sequences with properties beyond those observed in nature, yet the mechanisms underlying protein generation remain poorly understood. Existing mechanistic interpretability methods based on sparse autoencoders and transcoders primarily focus on protein representation learning models and do not capture the computation required for autoregressive generation. Here, we introduce ProGenMech, a mechanistic interpretability framework for generative protein language models that extends cross-layer transcoders (CLTs) to ProGen3, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model trained for both causal generation and span infilling. Unlike per-layer approaches, CLTs reconstruct each layer using sparse latent variables from all preceding layers, enabling faithful recovery of inter-layer generative computation. We further develop a zero-shot circuit discovery framework to identify sparse latent circuits responsible for protein generation and fitness prediction. In causal generation and zero-shot fitness estimation tasks, ProGenMech outperforms local transcoder baselines in recovering ProGen3's probability distribution and functional scoring behavior, while matching the original model's generative distribution in span infilling tasks. Moreover, the recovered circuits reveal biologically meaningful motifs and functional regions associated with conserved sequence patterns and protein fitness landscapes, establishing a foundation for interpretable and steerable protein generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ProGenMech框架，通过跨层转码器和电路发现技术，深入揭示了生成式蛋白质语言模型（如ProGen3）的内部生成机制，成功关联了稀疏潜在电路与生物学功能结构。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型的可解释性方法大多局限于表征学习，无法捕捉自回归生成过程中的复杂计算机制；亟需一种能精准还原生成过程并定位底层功能机制的解释框架。
AI.method: 引入ProGenMech框架，扩展跨层转码器（CLT）以捕获跨层信息流；开发零样本电路发现框架，用于识别负责蛋白质生成和适应性预测的稀疏潜在电路。
AI.result: ProGenMech在概率分布还原和函数评分任务中优于局部转码器基线，能够准确恢复模型在任务中的行为，并识别出与生物学意义上的基序（motifs）和功能区域相关的稀疏电路。
AI.conclusion: ProGenMech通过跨层转码器（CLT）和零样本电路发现框架，有效揭示了生成式蛋白质语言模型（ProGen3）的计算机制，为实现可解释且可控的蛋白质设计奠定了基础。

title: Sycophancy as Material Failure under Pushback Loading: A Multi-Axis Characterization Across Three Loading Cases and up to Seventeen Material Charges
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Code, data, and pre-registrations: https://github.com/FerdinandSchessl/sycophancy-note-companion
summary: Sycophancy in LLMs is documented across 70+ papers, but expert agreement on construct boundaries remains low (ICC=.184; Ye et al., 2026). The construct fragments because behavioral classification depends on which surface form is privileged. We adopt a materials-science framing: conversation as test specimen under load, LLM-model as material charge, pushback as progressive load, stance-flip as material failure. We characterize this failure across three loading cases (debate n=1000; false-presuppositions n=3400; ethical-setting n=3400; 10-17 material charges per case; 7800 specimens total) using 14 turn-level axis-measurements spanning velocity, damage accumulation, frame-drift, brittleness, and direction stability, plus three speaker-resolved axes from an independent pipeline. The measurements are Hooke-coupled ($σ= E \cdot \varepsilon$ analog) and reproduce across loading cases with effects up to $|r_{rb}| = 0.35$ on debate; the sign structure adds a second pattern: the ethical-setting case inverts the velocity and accumulation blocks. Variance composition partitions into two profiles: debate is charge-dominated (brittle-fracture-like: the material grade decides), false-presuppositions and ethical-setting are topic-dominated (creep-like: the load decides); the ratios (2.03 vs 0.13/0.17) are estimator-dependent, for debate even in direction. Cross-judge reliability (GPT-4o vs Haiku 4.5) shows debate scoring is judge-robust (Cohen's $κ= 0.88$) while false-presupposition scoring is judge-sensitive ($κ= 0.36$) -- a caveat single-judge benchmarks must report. This is the methodological move Ye et al.'s diagnosis calls for: a multi-axis characterization that does not depend on which surface form of the construct one privileges.

AI.tldr: 为解决LLM谄媚行为定义混乱的问题，本研究借鉴材料力学框架，通过多轴量化指标表征模型在不同受压场景下的“力学响应”，揭示了谄媚行为的本质差异，并强调了评估模型时必须报告评判者的敏感度差异。
AI.motivation: 目前学术界对LLM“谄媚”（Sycophancy）的定义存在严重分歧（专家一致性低），且现有的分类方法过于依赖表象，缺乏统一的定性定量框架。
AI.method: 采用材料科学的分析框架，将对话视为受力试样，LLM视为材料，通过 pushback（反驳/施压）量化 stance-flip（立场翻转），并在辩论、错误预设、伦理设置三种场景下进行大规模测试（7800个样本），通过14个转向层面的轴测度（如速度、损伤积累、脆性等）进行多维度表征。
AI.result: 研究发现辩论场景以模型本身性质决定（材料主导型表现），而错误预设和伦理设定场景则主要由话题决定（加载主导型表现）；此外揭示了评估的一致性在不同任务下差异巨大（辩论任务评判者稳健性高，而错误预设任务则极度依赖评判者）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入多轴表征框架，成功解决了LLM谄媚行为定义模糊的问题，通过类比材料力学，验证了不同场景下谄媚行为的动力学特征，并指出了评估模型鲁棒性时需考虑评判者敏感度的必要性。

title: Islamic Large Language Models: From Knowledge Acquisition to Trustworthy and Hallucination-Resistant AI
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for knowledge-intensive question answering, including religious and legal questions. Islamic knowledge is a particularly demanding setting: answers are expected to be grounded in authoritative sources, citations must be exact, Arabic varieties differ substantially from the language of classical sources, and legitimate jurisprudential disagreement must be represented rather than collapsed into a single answer. This survey reviews the emerging field of Islamic LLMs and trustworthy Islamic AI. We organize the literature around Arabic NLP and Arabic-centric LLMs, Islamic NLP resources, Qur'anic question answering, Islamic knowledge benchmarks, retrieval-augmented generation, Islamic legal reasoning, inheritance reasoning, hallucination evaluation, and trustworthiness. We argue that fluency in Arabic is not sufficient for Islamic AI. Reliable systems require curated sources, retrieval and verification modules, citation-aware generation, madhhab-aware reasoning, human expert evaluation, and benchmarks that measure not only answer accuracy but also faithfulness, source validity, and reasoning quality. The survey concludes with a research agenda for hallucination-resistant Islamic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了面向伊斯兰教领域的LLM发展，指出单一语言能力不足以支撑该领域严苛的宗教与法律要求，强调了构建“可信、引用准确且具备教法分歧意识”的检索增强型AI系统的必要性。
AI.motivation: 伊斯兰知识领域对问答的严谨性、来源权威性、引用的准确性以及对教法分歧的包容性有极高要求，现有的通用大语言模型难以直接满足这些需求，迫切需要构建可信的伊斯兰AI系统。
AI.method: 通过文献综述（Survey）的方法，对伊斯兰大语言模型及其相关技术进行系统梳理，涵盖阿拉伯语NLP、伊斯兰知识基准、检索增强生成（RAG）、法律推理、幻觉评估及信任体系等多个维度。
AI.result: 归纳了伊斯兰NLP的当前研究与资源现状，指出了当前模型在处理经典宗教文本、法律推理和事实校验方面的局限性，并提出了一套旨在对抗幻觉、增强系统稳健性的构建原则。
AI.conclusion: 伊斯兰AI的发展不能仅依赖于阿拉伯语流利度，必须建立以信任为核心的系统，包括精选知识库、受控检索与验证机制、引用溯源、流派（Madhhab）感知推理，以及涵盖准确性、忠实度与推理质量的多维度评估框架。

title: ALCL: An Adaptive Log-Correntropy Loss for Robust Learning under Non-Gaussian Noise
summary: Robust deep learning under heavy-tailed and impulsive noise remains challenging because conventional losses such as mean squared error (MSE) exhibit unbounded sensitivity to outliers. Although correntropy-based objectives improve robustness, existing formulations rely on fixed kernel parameters that must be empirically tuned and remain static during training. To address these limitations, we propose an Adaptive Log-Correntropy Loss (ALCL), a heavy-tailed loss formulation that adaptively learns its robustness geometry during optimization. ALCL introduces a logarithmic residual model whose shape and scale parameters are learned jointly with network weights through differentiable reparameterization. This yields a principled maximum likelihood formulation whose influence function is formally bounded and redescending, allowing the loss geometry to adapt dynamically to evolving residual statistics while suppressing extreme outliers. Comparative experiments on four widely used benchmark datasets spanning grayscale and red-green-blue (RGB) image data under mixed heavy-tailed and impulsive noise demonstrate that ALCL consistently outperforms MSE and optimally tuned generalized correntropy losses in both reconstruction fidelity and downstream classification accuracy. While performance differences remain small under low-noise conditions, under high-noise regimes ALCL improves median accuracy by up to 4.75% on grayscale benchmarks and 4.51% on RGB datasets, with reduced variance across runs. These results demonstrate that adaptive robustness through joint learning of loss parameters provides a computationally efficient alternative to static correntropy-based losses for deep learning in non-Gaussian environments.

AI.tldr: 针对深度学习在复杂噪声下的鲁棒性问题，本文提出了一种可动态自适应学习参数的“自适应对数相关熵损失（ALCL）”，通过联合学习损失函数的几何形状，实现了对极端离群点的有效抑制，显著提升了模型在强噪声环境下的训练效果。
AI.motivation: 传统的均方误差（MSE）对离群点过度敏感，而现有的基于相关熵（correntropy）的鲁棒损失函数依赖于经验性的、静态的核参数调试，难以应对深度学习训练过程中演化的残差分布。
AI.method: 提出一种“自适应对数相关熵损失”（ALCL），引入对数残差模型，通过可微重参数化（differentiable reparameterization）技术，将损失函数的形状和尺度参数与网络权重共同学习，使其影响函数（influence function）具备有界且红降（redescending）的特性。
AI.result: 在四个包含重尾和脉冲噪声的基准数据集（含灰度及 RGB 图像）上进行测试，ALCL 表现优于 MSE 及最优调参后的通用相关熵损失。在高噪声场景下，其准确率中位数最高分别提升了 4.75%（灰度）和 4.51%（RGB），且运行方差更低。
AI.conclusion: 研发的 ALCL（自适应对数相关熵损失）通过端到端的参数联合学习，为深度学习在强噪声环境下的鲁棒性训练提供了一种高效、 principled 的选择。相比静态损失函数，该方法在保持实现简单的同时，显著提升了模型在极端噪声条件下的泛化性能和稳定性。

title: FraudSMSWalker: Benchmarking Agentic Large Language Models for SMS-to-Webpage Fraud Detection
summary: SMS fraud is increasingly cross-channel: a message directs the user to a webpage, and the final risk depends on how the SMS claim aligns with the page content and requested user action. However, existing evaluations either focus on message-only smishing classification or expose URL and domain cues that allow models to rely on reputation shortcuts. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{FraudSMSWalker}, a controlled benchmark for URL-masked SMS-to-webpage fraud judgment. FraudSMSWalker contains 699 bilingual chains, including 332 fraudulent and 367 benign cases, across ten service scenarios. The model-visible input consists of the SMS context and sanitized webpage evidence, while raw URLs, hosts, domains, IPs, redirects, and reputation metadata are withheld. The benchmark further includes hard benign cases whose pages contain login, payment, verification, or account-management elements that are plausible under the service context but also appear in scam flows. We evaluate nine web agents under masked browser-agent protocols and conduct URL-visibility ablations. The results show that current agents can detect suspicious cues, but struggle to preserve benign recall and often produce positive predictions that are weakly supported by the observed evidence. These findings position FraudSMSWalker as a benchmark for measuring whether web agents can make fraud judgments that remain both accurate and evidence-grounded when direct reputation shortcuts are suppressed. The associated code and dataset are accessible at the \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/w/FraudMessageWalker-Bench}{anonymous link}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FraudSMSWalker基准，通过掩盖URL等声誉线索，在受控环境下评估Web智能体进行跨渠道（短信+网页）欺诈判断的能力，发现当前智能体过度依赖捷径，在缺乏证据时难以准确区分良性与欺诈。
AI.motivation: 现有欺诈检测多侧重于单一SMS文本分析，或过度依赖URL/域名特征等“声誉捷径”，无法应对跨渠道欺诈的实时判定需求。需建立一个剥离此类外部暗示、侧重内容语义关联与逻辑一致性的欺诈评估基准。
AI.method: 引入了FraudSMSWalker基准测试，包含699个双语（SMS+网页）链，采用URL掩码技术（剔除域名、IP、重定向等声誉信息），并设置了包含敏感元素（如支付、登录）的“极难良性”样本，通过受控浏览器智能体协议评估了九种Web智能体。
AI.result: 实验显示，现有智能体能识别部分可疑迹象，但在处理“极难良性”案例时表现欠佳（召回率低），且判定结论往往缺乏充分的网页证据支持，显示出当前模型在复杂欺诈推理上的局限性。
AI.conclusion: FraudSMSWalker揭示了当前Web智能体在没有域名/URL声誉捷径的情况下，难以平衡欺诈检测的精确度和证据支持的合理性，证明了该基准对于推动更具证据导向的防欺诈研究的必要性。

title: Beyond the Blood Draw: Explainable Machine Learning for Non-Invasive Dysglycemia Risk Screening
summary: Dysglycemia, encompassing both prediabetes and diabetes, affects huge numbers of adults worldwide, yet many of them remain undiagnosed. We developed and validated machine-learning (ML) models for non-invasive screening of dysglycemia risk that require no laboratory tests. Pooling data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017--2023 (n=14,352), we trained six ML models with stratified 5-fold cross-validation and compared them with two established clinical risk scores. LightGBM achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC=0.820, 95% CI: 0.806--0.835), outperforming the Finnish Diabetes Risk Score (0.745) and American Diabetes Association Risk Test (0.783). SHAP analysis identified age, race/ethnicity, and waist-to-height ratio as the most influential predictors. Subgroup analyses confirmed consistent performance across demographic strata (AUC: 0.735--0.832). These results demonstrate the feasibility of explainable, laboratory-free dysglycemia screening for deployment in community settings and self-tracking health applications.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了一种无需实验室血液检测的机器学习模型，通过分析年龄、腰高比等非侵入性指标，在预测糖尿病风险方面优于传统临床评分工具，为社区及个人提供了更高效的血糖筛查解决方案。
AI.motivation: 全球范围内大量成年人患有糖尿病前期或糖尿病但未被诊断，现有的筛查手段依赖实验室检查或低效手动评分，亟需一种可广泛应用于社区和个人的非侵入性、高效且准确的筛查方案。
AI.method: 研究利用 NHANES（2017-2023）数据（n=14,352），训练了六种机器学习模型（以 LightGBM 为最佳）进行非侵入性血糖异常风险筛查，并与芬兰糖尿病风险评分（FINDRISC）和美国糖尿病协会（ADA）风险测评进行了比较；通过 5 折交叉验证进行评估，并使用 SHAP 方法对模型进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: LightGBM 模型表现最优（AUC=0.820），显著优于 FINDRISC (0.745) 和 ADA 风险测评 (0.783)；SHAP 分析表明年龄、种族/族裔以及腰高比是影响预测的关键因素；该模型在不同人口统计学亚组中表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: 所开发的无需实验室检查的机器学习筛查模型在识别血糖异常风险方面优于现有的临床风险评分工具，具有在社区环境和个人健康管理应用中大规模部署的潜力与可行性。

title: Progressive Knowledge-Guided Large Language Model Framework for Bearing Fault Diagnosis
summary: Vibration-based bearing fault diagnosis requires resolving three interrelated measurement challenges, including the trade-off between global statistical feature efficiency and local transient signal fidelity, insufficient traceability of measurement features to underlying fault physics, and ineffective multi-source measurement information fusion across diagnostic scales. This paper presents a progressive physics-guided multi-scale vibration signal processing framework that addresses all three challenges within a unified diagnostic pipeline. An 81-dimensional measurement descriptor, derived from bearing kinematic theory and characteristic defect frequencies, establishes a physically traceable feature space enabling real-time fault screening at approximately 20 ms per sample. A fault-adaptive signal segmentation mechanism then directs analytical attention toward fault-relevant waveform regions guided by physics-based priors, without manual feature engineering. Structured fault mechanism knowledge is further encoded implicitly in model parameters during training, enabling autonomous multi-scale measurement fusion without external knowledge dependencies at inference. Validated on four public benchmark datasets under diverse operating conditions, the framework achieves 98.49% diagnostic accuracy with a 12.6-fold reduction in computational cost relative to signal-level baselines. Interpretability analysis confirms that diagnostic feature activations align with established bearing fault mechanics, supporting measurement traceability in safety-critical industrial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合物理机理与深度学习的轴承故障诊断框架，通过引入运动学特征和故障自适应分割，解决了传统方法在可解释性、计算效率与特征融合上的矛盾，实现了高精度、低延迟的工业故障诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有基于振动的轴承故障诊断存在三个核心挑战：1) 全局统计特征效率与局部瞬态信号保真度之间的权衡；2) 测量特征对底层故障物理机制的可追溯性不足；3) 跨诊断尺度的多源测量信息融合机制低效。
AI.method: 提出了一种“渐进式物理引导的多尺度振动信号处理框架”。核心包含三个关键部分：1) 基于轴承运动学理论和特征缺陷频率构建的81维物理可追溯特征描述符；2) 利用物理先验的故障自适应信号分割机制；3) 将结构化故障机理知识隐式编码至模型参数的自动多尺度融合机制。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准数据集上验证，诊断准确率达到98.49%，且相较于基线模型计算成本降低了12.6倍，单样本故障筛查时间约20毫秒。同时，可解释性分析证实了诊断特征与轴承故障力学的匹配度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持物理可解释性的同时，实现了高性能与高效率的轴承故障诊断。通过物理知识引导，不仅提升了诊断精度，还显著降低了计算开销，为工业安全关键系统提供了一种鲁棒且高效的解决方案。

title: Mojo: A Promising Tool for Scalable Financial AI Efficiency
summary: For thirty years, quantitative finance has paid a costly two-language tax: models researched in Python are rewritten in C++ for production, often introducing numerical discrepancies. GPU-accelerated deep learning exacerbates this problem, as nondeterministic floating-point reductions can produce drift in long backtests, challenging regulatory reproducibility and auditability expectations. This article surveys Mojo, Modular's 2026 Python-like systems language, as a structural response for capital markets engineering. While closing the Python-to-C++ performance gap, Mojo uniquely combines native interoperability with the low-level systems control required to construct bit-exact deterministic kernels. Its MLIR compilation infrastructure further allows a single codebase to target scalar, SIMD, multicore, and GPU execution, reducing the translation bottleneck between research and production. We benchmark four core financial AI workloads: Monte Carlo option pricing, LLM sentiment inference, multi-asset backtesting, and portfolio Value at Risk. On Apple Silicon, Mojo demonstrates 20x to 180x speedups over pure Python on directly measured kernels; larger-scale GPU workload results are projections calibrated from published benchmarks. Alongside transparent performance data, we introduce mojo-deterministic, an open-source library of reproducible reduction kernels, and provide a candid assessment of the problems Mojo does and does not yet solve.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了 Mojo 语言如何通过统一 Python 的易用性与 C++ 的高性能，解决定量金融中模型开发与生产环境转换导致的性能损耗及数值不确定性问题。
AI.motivation: 解决定量金融领域“Python 研究、C++ 生产”导致的“双语言税”问题、避免浮点计算非确定性带来的回测漂移，以及满足金融监管对于模型可复现性和可审计性的高要求。
AI.method: 通过引入 Mojo 这种类 Python 的高性能系统编程语言，利用其 MLIR 编译基础设施实现跨硬件（标量、SIMD、多核、GPU）的统一代码库；通过开发 `mojo-deterministic` 开源库来解决浮点运算的非确定性问题；并在蒙特卡洛定价、LLM 推理等四个典型金融 AI 工作负载上进行了全面基准测试。
AI.result: 在 Apple Silicon 上，Mojo 在核心金融内核中实现了比纯 Python 快 20 倍至 180 倍的性能，证明了其在消除研究与生产转化瓶颈方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: Mojo 是一种通过统一研究与生产语言栈来解决定量金融中“双语言税”及数值不确定性问题的可行方案，特别适用于需要高性能、比特级确定性和硬件异构计算的金融场景。

title: Multi-Turn Reflective Masking Elicits Reasoning in Mask Diffusion Models
summary: While reasoning on autoregressive (AR) models is often performed by chain-of-thought reasoning and reflection, their refinement of previous outputs still relies on fully sequential generation, even when only local edits are needed. In contrast, the masking mechanism in Mask Diffusion Models (MDMs) naturally supports explicit local edits on previous outputs, allowing selective refinement without discarding previous answers and generating another from scratch. While this property more closely aligns with how humans correct mistakes by iterative local refinement, existing MDMs do not support multi-turn masking and denoising. We propose Reflective Masking (RM), which elicits such an intrinsic reasoning capability in MDMs via lightweight post-training. RM provides a native test-time scaling, where an MDM iteratively revisits and revises its prior outputs based on evolving context. To exploit insights from previous turns like AR reasoning, we further introduce History Reference, a parameter-free mechanism that leverages intermediate denoising states during revision. Our approach requires no architectural changes and is easily applicable to existing MDMs. Across diverse tasks and modalities, including text generation, Sudoku, and image editing, Reflective Masking consistently outperforms standard masking-based baselines and demonstrates strong generality, positioning RM as a fundamental primitive for reasoning on MDMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Reflective Masking (RM)，这是一种通过轻量级后训练使掩码扩散模型（MDM）具备迭代局部修订能力的方法，成功实现了比传统自回归模型更高效的推理及任务修正。
AI.motivation: 自回归（AR）模型在修正输出时通常需要重新生成，忽略了局部编辑的需求；而掩码扩散模型（MDM）虽天生适合局部编辑，但缺乏处理多轮掩码和迭代推理的机制。为此，作者旨在利用 MDM 的掩码机制实现更符合人类逻辑的高效推理手段。
AI.method:
1. Reflective Masking (RM)：提出了一种轻量级的后训练方案，使 MDM 具备多轮掩码和去噪能力，实现基于上下文的推断和修订；
2. History Reference：提出了一种参数无关的机制，在修订过程中利用中间去噪状态作为上下文，从而整合前序步骤的推理洞察。
AI.result: 在文本生成、数独求解和图像编辑等多样化任务中，RM 方案始终优于标准的掩码基线；实验表明该方法具有极强的泛化性和可扩展性（Native test-time scaling）。
AI.conclusion: Reflective Masking (RM) 是一种在大规模掩码扩散模型（MDM）上实现高效、迭代局部细化推理的通用方法。该方法不需要改变模型架构，且在多模态和多任务场景中展现了优于标准掩码基线的性能，证明了 MDM 在迭代推理中的潜力。

title: P3B3: A Multi-Turn Conversational Benchmark for Measuring European and Brazilian Portuguese Variety Bias in LLMs
comment: Accepted at MeLLM Workshop at ACL 2026
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become embedded in everyday communication, capturing regional linguistic variation is essential for reliable and equitable language use. In Portuguese, European (pt-PT) and Brazilian (pt-BR) varieties remain unevenly represented, with pt-BR dominating in data quantity, while LLM preference for Portuguese variants remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce P3B3, an expert-curated language variety agnostic benchmark of conversational prompts, along with an evaluation framework for measuring variety bias and controllability. Experiments on several models show that most LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward pt-BR, with variation in controllability across models. These results highlight the need for more balanced multilingual representation across language varieties.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对大语言模型在葡萄牙语变体（pt-BR vs pt-PT）上的处理不平衡问题，发布了 P3B3 基准测试集，并证实了当前模型普遍存在偏向巴西葡萄牙语的现象，呼吁提升多语言模型的变体表达均衡性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型中葡萄牙语语料存在严重的不平衡，巴西葡萄牙语（pt-BR）占据主导地位，而欧洲葡萄牙语（pt-PT）被边缘化，导致模型在处理特定葡语变体时存在偏见，且缺乏相关的评估基准。
AI.method: 1. 构建了 P3B3：一个专家策划的、语言变体中立的对话提示词基准测试集；2. 设计了一套用于评估语言变体偏见及模型可控性的评估框架；3. 在多个大语言模型上进行了实验，量化对比了其在葡萄牙语（pt-PT）和巴西葡萄牙语（pt-BR）上的表现。
AI.result: 大多数大语言模型对巴西葡萄牙语（pt-BR）表现出强烈的偏见，不同模型在对不同语言变体的控制能力上也存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型在处理葡萄牙语变体时存在显著的地域偏见，这种不平衡的语料分布及模型表现限制了语言使用的公平性。研究强调，在多语言模型开发中需重视内部语言变体的平衡性，以提高模型在全球范围内的普适性与合规性。

title: AME: A Multi-Type Contributor Attribution Framework in Generative AI Markets
summary: Generative AI enables value creation through multi-stage collaboration among heterogeneous contributors, including training data, base models, fine-tuning behaviors, and prompts. However, how to fairly allocate the data value remains largely unexplored. This paper formulates multi-stage generative AI value allocation as a new research problem and identifies three core challenges: heterogeneous data contribution valuation, data rights mapping, and trustworthy execution. We propose AME (Attribution-Mapping-Execution) framework, a unified framework that integrates data contribution valuation, data rights mapping, and trustworthy execution into a single workflow. Experimental results demonstrate that AME framework achieves data value allocation outcomes more consistent with human reference judgments while maintaining low-cost trustworthy execution. Our work provides an initial foundation for value assessment and revenue allocation in generative AI data markets.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式AI多阶段协作中的公平价值分配问题，提出了AME框架，旨在解决异构数据贡献评估、权益映射及可信执行的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI价值创造涉及多种异构贡献者（数据、模型、微调、提示词），但缺乏公平分配数据价值的成熟研究，存在价值评估困难、权益映射不明及执行不可信等挑战。
AI.method: 提出了AME（Attribution-Mapping-Execution）框架，整合了数据贡献评估、数据权益映射和可信执行，形成了一个统一的工作流。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与人类参考评价相比，AME框架能实现更一致的分配结果，并保持了低成本的可信执行。
AI.conclusion: AME框架为生成式AI数据市场的价值评估与收益分配提供了坚实的基础，能有效实现数据价值的公平分配。

title: The Art of Mixology: Mixup-based Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving Split Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Split learning provides a practical paradigm for resource-constrained users to train Large Language Models (LLMs) by offloading computation-intensive layers to a server while keeping raw data local. However, existing privacy-preserving split learning methods still face a difficult trade-off among utility, privacy, efficiency, and stability. Specifically, these methods often suffer from substantial utility degradation, remain vulnerable to advanced data reconstruction attacks, incur prohibitive computational and communication overhead, or exhibit unstable performance across different tasks. In this paper, we propose MIXGUARD, a novel mixup-based privacy-preserving split learning framework for LLMs. MIXGUARD introduces token-level obfuscation, representation-level obfuscation, and adaptive gradient perturbation mechanisms, which operate jointly to preserve useful learning signals while preventing privacy leakage to the server. Technically, MIXGUARD first constructs a lightweight calibration model on a public dataset to refine the approximated target representation, and then applies this model during privacy-preserving fine-tuning on private data. We conduct extensive experiments on four classification tasks and four text generation tasks across multiple LLM families, model sizes, architectures, and fine-tuning strategies. The results show that MIXGUARD preserves model utility comparable to non-split training baselines, consistently achieves stronger privacy protection than existing split learning defense methods against state-of-the-art data reconstruction attacks, and remains robust under adaptive attack settings.

AI.tldr: MIXGUARD是一种用于大语言模型的高效拆分学习框架，通过多层次数据混淆和自适应梯度扰动，在确保隐私防御能力的同时，维持了与非拆分训练相当的模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的拆分学习方法在处理大语言模型时，难以在效用（Utility）、隐私（Privacy）、效率（Efficiency）和稳定性（Stability）之间取得平衡，往往导致性能严重下降或对数据重构攻击缺乏防御能力。
AI.method: 提出了基于Mixup的隐私保护拆分学习框架，包含三个核心机制：1. 令牌级混淆（token-level obfuscation）；2. 表示级混淆（representation-level obfuscation）；3. 自适应梯度扰动（adaptive gradient perturbation）。此外，利用公共数据集预训练一个校准模型，用于在私有数据微调阶段精炼目标表示。
AI.result: 在四项分类任务和四项文本生成任务中，MIXGUARD实现了与非拆分训练相媲美的模型效用，在防御最先进的数据重构攻击方面表现优于现有方法，且在自适应攻击环境下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: MIXGUARD通过多层次的混淆与扰动机制，有效解决了拆分学习中效用、隐私、效率与稳定性之间的权衡难题，为大语言模型提供了一种高效、高隐私性的分布式训练方案。

title: Phys-JEPA: Physics-Informed Latent World Models for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
comment: Submitted to arXiv as a preliminary manuscript. 10 figures
summary: Multivariate forecasting in physical systems requires models that predict coupled temporal variables while preserving meaningful state evolution. Deep forecasters can fit temporal correlations, and physics-informed models can regularize predictions with scientific constraints, but these directions are often connected only at the decoded-output level. As a result, the hidden predictive state that generates future trajectories may remain statistically useful but physically unstructured. We introduce Phys-JEPA, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting. Phys-JEPA learns a latent world model in which predictive states are decomposed into physical and residual components, and physical consistency is imposed directly on latent states and latent transitions rather than only on decoded forecasts. This formulation uses known physical variables to organize the representation space while retaining residual capacity for unresolved dynamics. On Jena Climate 2009--2016, Phys-JEPA reduces aggregate MSE from 0.12482 to 0.12273 and temperature MSE from 0.01892 to 0.01831 at H=24. On Traffic, full Phys-JEPA improves aggregate MSE over the supervised baseline across all tested horizons, reducing H=192 MSE from 0.800784 to 0.773873. On Electricity, the best variant depends on horizon: static latent consistency is strongest at H=24 and H=48, while full Phys-JEPA gives the best aggregate and target-variable MSE at H=192. These initial results suggest that moving physics-informed learning from output space to latent predictive state space is a promising direction for interpretable temporal world models.

AI.tldr: Phys-JEPA 将物理约束引入潜在预测空间，通过分解物理与残差成分改善了多变量时间序列预测的物理结构性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习预测模型多在解码端应用物理约束，导致模型隐藏的预测状态可能缺乏物理意义，无法有效捕捉复杂的耦合系统动态。
AI.method: 提出了 Phys-JEPA，一种物理信息联合嵌入预测架构。该方法将隐藏预测状态分解为“物理成分”和“残差成分”，通过在潜在表示和状态转换过程中直接应用物理约束（Physics-informed constraints），从而构建更有结构性的世界模型。
AI.result: 在 Jena Climate、Traffic 和 Electricity 数据集上，Phys-JEPA 在多个预测时段（H）均实现了比基准模型更低的均方误差（MSE），验证了该架构在多变量时间序列预测中的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将物理一致性约束从解码输出空间迁移到潜在预测状态空间（Latent Predictive State Space）是构建可解释时间序列世界模型的有效路径，能显著提升长期预测性能。

title: LLM-based Visual Code Completion for Aerospace Geometric Design
summary: Recent advances in both Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) have seen a step change in their ability to perform visual code completion, but the aerospace industry, which prioritizes safety and explainabilty over rapid LLM adoption, currently has no publicly announced LLM-based geometric design copilot systems in commercial use by aerospace Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). This paper presents a LLM-based visual programming copilot application for aerospace engineering design tasks, using a visual programming variant of the ReAct methodology and GPT 5.4. In addition to the copilot, we describe Wingbuilder, a new Grasshopper plugin library with custom components for aerospace-specific geometry abstraction, and an associated Aerospace Visual Programming Dataset (AVPD) with 18 aerospace expert designed tasks at different levels of difficulty alongside ground truth solutions. We evaluate our copilot application with a user trial involving two experienced aerospace engineers from a large aircraft manufacturing company. We find our copilot visual programming ReAct methodology was successful in generating suggestions that participants found helpful, but slow ReAct inference times limit its usefulness to more complex time-consuming tasks where waiting for good copilot solution suggestion was worthwhile. Participants reported they liked the tool and would be willing to use it in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向航空航天工程设计的LLM驱动视觉编程Copilot及其配套插件Wingbuilder和数据集AVPD。经专家验证，该系统在处理复杂设计任务时表现出良好的辅助能力，尽管推理延迟仍是其实际应用中的主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 航空航天工业由于对安全性、可解释性的高要求，目前尚无用于商业的LLM驱动几何设计Copilot，现有的LLM/VLM在视觉代码补全领域虽有进展，但缺乏针对该垂直领域的专业工具和数据集。
AI.method: 1. 基于LLM（GPT-4/5.4）的视觉编程Copilot应用，采用变体ReAct方法；2. 开发了名为“Wingbuilder”的Grasshopper插件库，用于航空航天几何抽象；3. 构建了包含18个航空航天专家级任务及其基准解的“航空航天视觉编程数据集（AVPD）”。
AI.result: 用户试验显示，航空航天专家认为该Copilot能够生成有用的设计建议；然而，由于ReAct方法推理速度较慢，该工具目前更适合处理复杂、耗时的设计任务，而非快速迭代任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于ReAct方法的视觉编程Copilot能够为航空航天设计任务提供有价值的建议。尽管推断速度限制了其在快速任务中的应用，但专家工程师对其表现出积极的使用意愿，并认为该工具在复杂任务中具有潜力。

title: Auditing Machine Unlearning: A Systematic Research on Whether Models Truly Forget
summary: Machine unlearning has been extensively studied in response to growing privacy concerns and regulatory requirements. However, auditing whether unlearning algorithms have truly erased the influence of specific data remains an open challenge. The lack of reliable and practical auditing mechanisms can lead to critical privacy risks, such as residual information leakage. This paper initiates a systematic investigation into whether existing unlearning algorithms can truly forget the designated data. We propose the first practical and general-purpose auditing framework for machine unlearning, inspired by the concept of proof of ignorance. Our framework addresses the key practicality limitations of existing methods by eliminating the need for retraining-from-scratch baselines, avoiding the training of large numbers of shadow models, and requiring no intrusive intervention in the original training process. To evaluate the effectiveness of our framework, we first conduct validation experiments to verify its soundness and completeness. We then perform comprehensive experiments across six datasets and ten representative unlearning methods. The results demonstrate that our framework reliably distinguishes between successful and failed unlearning. In particular, we observe that retraining-based and fine-tuning-based methods can achieve effective unlearning, even when the target data remain in the original dataset. In contrast, de-optimization-based methods fail to achieve true unlearning and instead degrade the model's performance. Fisher/Hessian-based methods also fail to unlearn requested data, even formal certification is provided. Moreover, we show that our framework is robust against fake unlearning attempts and generalizes well to large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种首创且实用的机器学习遗忘审计框架，揭示了主流遗忘算法的实际效能差异，有效解决了如何验证模型真正“遗忘”数据的行业难题。
AI.motivation: 目前机器学习遗忘领域缺乏可靠且实用的审计机制，导致难以确定模型是否真正“遗忘”了特定数据，存在隐私信息泄露的风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于“无知证明”（proof of ignorance）概念的通用审计框架。该框架无需从零开始重新训练基准模型，无需训练大量影子模型，也不需要对原始训练过程进行干预，实现了实用且高效的遗忘效果验证。
AI.result: 通过在 6 个数据集和 10 种代表性遗忘方法上的实验，验证了该框架的有效性。研究发现重训练和微调方法通常可行，而去优化方法及基于 Fisher/Hessian 的方法（即使有形式化证明）在实际操作中往往无法真正遗忘目标数据；此外，该框架对虚假遗忘尝试具有鲁棒性，并能泛化至大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的审计框架能够有效区分成功与失败的机器学习遗忘（Machine Unlearning），揭示了现有遗忘算法在实际效果上的显著差异（如重训练和微调方法通常有效，而去优化和基于 Fisher/Hessian 的方法往往失效），为评估隐私保护提供了可靠工具。

title: Connecting Speech to Words through Images
comment: Accepted at EUSIPCO 2026 - 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
summary: How can we learn the mapping between written words and their spoken counterparts in the absence of explicit textual supervision? We present a visually grounded method for building a vocabulary of spoken words using only images and their spoken descriptions. First, image captioning systems are used to build a vocabulary of written words representing salient visual concepts in the images. For each word, we then find utterances whose image captions contain that word. Then we use an unsupervised word discovery technique to align these utterances to locate instances of the target word. The result is spoken word segments that are linked to written words -- all accomplished without any text supervision. In spoken word retrieval and keyword spotting experiments, the proposed approach outperforms a strong neural baseline while being more interpretable. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the approach in English and motivate future work on low-resource languages without transcripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉接地的创新方法，通过图像和对应的语音描述，在完全没有文本监督的情况下，自动实现语音片段与书面词汇的对齐与构建，为语音处理提供了高效且可解释的新路径。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏文本转录监督的情况下，实现书面词汇与口语词汇之间的映射学习。
AI.method: 1. 利用图像描述系统（Image Captioning）从图像中提取描述显著视觉概念的文本词汇；2. 提取包含这些词汇的语音片段；3. 利用无监督词汇发现技术（Unsupervised Word Discovery）对这些语音片段进行对齐，定位目标单词的语音段。
AI.result: 在语音检索和关键词定位实验中，该方法性能优于强神经基线模型，并表现出更高的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉接地方法，无需任何文本转录监督即可成功构建语音-文本映射。该方法在语音词汇检索和关键词定位任务中表现优于强基线模型，且具有更好的可解释性，为低资源语言的语音处理提供了可行方案。

title: Scaling Adaptive Depth with Norm-Agnostic Residual Networks
summary: Residual architectures are ubiquitous in deep learning, but they suffer from a subtle structural limitation: the norm of the residual stream can grow rapidly with depth. As a result, updates from later layers become small relative to the accumulated residual state. This reduces their impact on the representation and limits the benefits of scaling models in depth. To address this, we introduce NAG, a norm-agnostic residual architecture that separates magnitude from directional information in the residual stream, preserving meaningful layer contributions throughout depth and preventing later updates from being systematically suppressed by residual-norm growth. Importantly, NAG introduces only a negligible number of additional parameters and relies on simple operations that are easily kernel-fusible, preserving training efficiency in practice. We show that this architecture outperforms baseline Transformers, with gains that increase substantially as depth grows, enabling effective training of much deeper models.
