The norm-agnostic formulation also leads to an interpretable Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) mechanism that adaptively skips both attention and MLP layers. Beyond serving as a post-training accuracy-compute tradeoff, this mechanism can be used as a pretraining-time scaling strategy: under iso-FLOP training, compute saved by reducing per-token forward-pass cost can be reinvested into training on more tokens while keeping the total parameter count and KV-cache budget fixed. In our experiments, moderate Mixture-of-Depths rates of approximately 20%-25% match full-depth baseline performance under equal training compute while substantially reducing the number of executed layer parameters and forward-pass FLOPs. These results identify sparsity in depth as a new scaling axis for fixed-compute training, enabling very deep yet FLOP-efficient models.

AI.tldr: 针对深层神经网络残差范数爆炸问题，提出 NAG 架构以解耦残差幅值与方向，并衍生出高效的 Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) 稀疏化策略，实现了深层模型的高效训练与推理。
AI.motivation: 传统残差架构中残差流的范数会随深度快速增长，导致深层更新对表征的影响被抑制，从而限制了模型深度扩展的收益。
AI.method: 提出了 NAG (Norm-Agnostic) 架构，通过分离残差流的幅值（magnitude）与方向（directional）信息来保持层级贡献的稳定性；并引入了 Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) 机制，支持动态跳过注意力层和 MLP 层。
AI.result: NAG 在多种测试中超越了基准 Transformer，且模型越深优势越明显；MoD 机制实现了在保持性能的前提下显著降低推理 FLOPs 和活跃参数量。
AI.conclusion: NAG 通过解耦残差流中的幅值与方向信息，有效解决了传统残差网络随深度增加而导致的性能瓶颈。该架构不仅支持训练更深的模型，还催生了 Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) 机制，为固定算力下的模型扩展提供了一种新的稀疏化策略。

title: A Gradient Perspective on RLVR Stability and Winner Advantage Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but GRPO-style optimization remains prone to collapse. We analyse this instability through token-level gradient dynamics, deriving a taxonomy that predicts how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. The taxonomy shows that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and token distribution under the current policy. Motivated by this finding, we propose Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO), a simple online clipped policy-gradient objective that updates only on positive-advantage completions. Across mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, WAPO improves training stability and matches or outperforms baselines across multiple model families. Full code can be found at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/wapo.

AI.tldr: 针对RLVR训练中的不稳定问题，本文提出了WAPO优化目标，通过仅更新正优势样本，显著增强了语言模型推理训练的稳定性与性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管RLVR能提升语言模型的推理能力，但现有的GRPO类优化方法极易出现模型崩塌（collapse）等不稳定现象。
AI.method: 基于对token级梯度动态的分析，推导出一种预测更新如何影响下一个token概率和熵的分类体系。据此提出了Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO)，这是一种在线裁剪策略梯度目标函数，仅对正优势的补全样本进行更新。
AI.result: 在数学推理和多跳问答基准测试中，WAPO显著提升了训练稳定性，并在多个模型系列中达到或超过了现有基准方法。
AI.conclusion: WAPO通过只对具有正优势的补全样本进行更新，有效地解决了RLVR训练中的不稳定性和模型崩塌问题，在推理任务中表现出更强的稳定性和性能。

title: A comparative and critical study of EEGNet for fNIRS-driven cognitive load classification
summary: Accurately classifying cognitive load from functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) signals remains a significant challenge due to temporal variability, inter-subject differences, and sensitivity to preprocessing choices. This study provides a comprehensive evaluation of EEGNet for fNIRS-based cognitive load classification by systematically examining the effects of temporal segmentation strategies (overlapping vs. non-overlapping), window lengths (10s, 20s, 30s), feature extraction methods (Analysis of Variance (ANOVA), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Fast Independent Component Analysis (FastICA)), learning rate configurations (fixed and adaptive), and evaluation protocols (random split vs. subject-independent (SI)). Results from random-split experiments show that overlapping segmentation, combined with smaller fixed learning rates (0.01-0.001), yields the highest accuracies, due to temporal redundancy and dense sampling of hemodynamic transitions. However, SI evaluation reveals a substantial drop in accuracy, demonstrating limited generalization to unseen participants. Under SI evaluation, non-overlapping segmentation outperformed overlapping windows, with the best accuracy of 56.11% achieved using PCA features with a 20-second window and a 0.1 learning rate. These findings indicate that eliminating temporal redundancy helps the model learn more robust and generalizable representations of cognitive load across individuals. Although adaptive learning rate strategy improved training stability, it did not surpass the performance of optimally selected fixed learning rates. The study highlights the critical role of segmentation strategy and learning rate selection in improving model generalization and identifies methodological considerations essential for developing reliable, real-time, and SI cognitive load classification systems using fNIRS.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了EEGNet在fNIRS认知负荷分类中的应用，发现非重叠分割策略能有效提升模型在受试者独立场景下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决fNIRS信号在处理时间变异性、受试者间差异以及预处理选择敏感性时存在的挑战，并探索如何提升认知负荷分类的准确性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 系统评估了EEGNet在fNIRS数据上的表现，涵盖了时间分割策略（重叠与非重叠）、不同窗口长度（10s, 20s, 30s）、特征提取方法（ANOVA, PCA, FastICA）、学习率策略（固定与自适应）以及两种评估协议（随机划分与受试者独立划分）。
AI.result: 随机划分下，重叠分割配合较小固定学习率效果最佳；但在更具挑战性的受试者独立（SI）评估中，性能大幅下降。此时，非重叠分割表现更佳，采用PCA特征、20s窗口和0.1学习率达到了56.11%的最高准确率。此外，固定学习率在优化参数下优于自适应学习率。
AI.conclusion: 在fNIRS认知负荷分类中，消除时间冗余（非重叠分割）对提升模型泛化能力至关重要。研究强调了分割策略和学习率选择对构建可靠且具备受试者独立（SI）能力系统的重要性。

title: Tying the Loop -- Tied Expert Layers in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures efficiently scale Large Language Models (LLMs) by activating only a small fraction of their experts per token, yet the full parameter count - dominated by the expert parameters - must be held in training and inference memory. To address this, we introduce Expert Tying, an architectural modification that shares expert parameters across consecutive transformer layers while preserving independent, layer-wise routing and attention.
  We evaluate this approach across common, state-of-the-art architectures, including OLMoE, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-style MoEs. Our pretraining experiments demonstrate that tying experts can reduce memory footprint by almost 2x at virtually no degradation in perplexity or downstream quality. By exploiting the parameter redundancy inherent in MoE pathways, our method provides a highly favorable compute-to-memory trade-off, advancing efficient training and scaling of next-generation LLMs.

AI.tldr: 为解决 MoE 模型参数庞大导致的内存瓶颈，本文提出了 Expert Tying 技术，通过在连续层间共享专家参数，在几乎无损精度的情况下实现了约 2 倍的内存节省。
AI.motivation: MoE 架构虽能通过稀疏激活提高效率，但庞大的总参数量导致训练和推理时需要占用极高的内存。现有架构中专家参数存在冗余，需要一种能降低内存开销同时保持模型性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出“Expert Tying”（专家绑定）架构。该方法在保持层级独立路由（routing）和注意力机制（attention）的前提下，在连续的 Transformer 层之间共享专家参数，从而减少总参数量。
AI.result: 在 OLMoE、Qwen3 和 DeepSeek 等主流 MoE 架构上的评估显示，通过 Expert Tying，在几乎不降低困惑度（perplexity）和下游任务质量的情况下，内存占用减少了近 2 倍。
AI.conclusion: Expert Tying 能够以几乎不损失性能的前提，实现 MoE 模型参数存储空间的显著压缩（近 2 倍），为大模型的训练与推理提供了更高性价比的计算访存比，是提升下一代 LLM 扩展效率的有效手段。

title: LLM-Powered Virtual Population for Demand Simulation and Pricing
summary: We develop an LLM-powered virtual population model that simulates demand for pricing decisions, in settings where products are described by rich unstructured information, such as text descriptions and images, and where decision makers need not only mean-demand predictions but also uncertainty estimates for counterfactual prices. Our model represents exposed customers as draws from a finite mixture of customer personas. For each persona, product, and candidate price, an LLM elicits a persona-level purchase probability using both structured persona information and unstructured product information. These probabilities are aggregated through calibrated mixture weights to form a predictive distribution of aggregate demand. The resulting simulator can evaluate counterfactual prices under various pricing objectives, including expected revenue and risk-aware criteria such as conditional value at risk. We test the framework on an online H&M fashion dataset with product descriptions and images. The calibrated LLM-based simulator achieves the best overall predictive performance among the models considered, and supports sample-efficient pricing decisions. Our framework provides a practical way to use LLMs as demand simulators for products with limited historical demand data but rich product information. By producing a full predictive demand distribution rather than only a point forecast, it enables managers to compare candidate prices, quantify demand uncertainty, and choose prices that target either average-case revenue or risk-aware objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合LLM的虚拟人口模拟器，通过整合多模态产品描述与Persona信息，为缺乏历史数据的产品生成完整需求分布，从而实现更精准且风险可控的定价决策。
AI.motivation: 在当前许多实际商业场景中，产品通常拥有丰富但非结构化的信息（如图片和描述），但却缺乏足够的历史交易数据，导致传统的定价决策模型（主要依赖历史销售数据）难以精准预测需求及应对定价不确定性。
AI.method:
1. 构建基于LLM的虚拟人口模型（Virtual Population Model）；
2. 使用混合模型（Finite Mixture of Personas）表征客户群体；
3. 利用LLM结合产品多模态信息（文本/图像）和结构化Persona属性预测购买概率；
4. 通过校准后的混合权重聚合预测结果，不仅生成点预测，还提供需求概率分布，以量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在H&M在线时尚数据集的实测中，该模型表现出最优的预测性能，且能够有效支持样本受限情况下的定价决策，实现了收益最大化与风险可控（如CVaR）的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了利用LLM构建虚拟人口模型是解决冷启动问题（历史数据有限）及实现复杂、跨模态产品定价决策的有效方法，且其定价表现优于传统模型。

title: Does Traversal Order Matter? A Systematic Study of Tree Traversal Methods in Transformer Grammars
summary: Transformer Grammars (TGs) enhance language modeling by incorporating syntactic tree structures. Despite the potentially significant impact on model performance of how syntactic trees are linearized in TGs, existing studies rely solely on Depth-First Traversal (DFT) for linearization. In this paper, we expand the traversal design space by exploring Breadth-First Traversal (BFT) and a novel hybrid traversal strategy, Production-Rule Traversal (PRT), which combines the structural lookahead of BFT with the early lexical generation of DFT. We integrate these traversal methods with varying tree configurations and masking strategies, and empirically evaluate their performance on language modeling, syntactic generalization and summarization. We reveal the inherent trade-offs between nested composition and global lookahead, providing actionable recommendations for designing task-aware Transformer Grammars.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了语言模型中句法树线性化的新途径（BFT与PRT），打破了传统仅使用DFT的限制，为构建性能更优的Transformer Grammars提供了策略指导。
AI.motivation: 现有的Transformer Grammars研究仅局限于深度优先遍历 (DFT) 一种方式，忽略了树结构线性化策略对模型性能的潜在优化空间。
AI.method: 在保持原有TGs框架的基础上，引入了广度优先遍历 (BFT) 和一种新的混合遍历策略——产生式规则遍历 (PRT)，并结合不同的树配置和掩码策略进行了对比实验。
AI.result: 揭示了嵌套组合与全局前瞻之间的内在权衡，并验证了不同遍历策略在语言建模、句法泛化和摘要任务中的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，语法树的线性化策略对Transformer Grammars (TGs) 的性能有显著影响，并以此提出了针对不同任务的TGs设计建议。

title: When Confidence Lacks Concepts: Interpretable OOD Detection via Representation Perturbations
summary: Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable performance across medical imaging tasks, yet their tendency to overgeneralize under distributional shifts poses a major obstacle to safe clinical deployment. Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection methods aim to mitigate this risk, but most existing approaches rely on opaque internal signals with poorly understood semantic meaning, limiting trust in safety-critical settings. In this work, we propose an interpretable OOD detection framework that probes the stability of model predictions under class-conditioned semantic perturbations. Leveraging sparse autoencoders (SAEs), we learn class-specific concept vectors from in-distribution data that disentangle dense intermediate representations into sparse, semantically meaningful components. At inference, we perturb deeper-layer representations using the concept vectors associated with the model's predicted class and measure the class logits stability. We hypothesize that in-distribution samples exhibit low sensitivity to such perturbations, as their representations align with class-specific semantic directions, whereas OOD samples show amplified deviations due to representational misalignment. By framing OOD detection as a concept conditioned stability analysis, our approach provides both a discriminative OOD signal and an interpretable lens into the internal mechanisms driving model uncertainty, making it particularly suitable for high stakes medical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏自动编码器（SAE）的可解释OOD检测框架，通过分析模型在类条件语义扰动下的稳定性，在提升医疗诊断鲁棒性的同时，为模型预测提供了可解释的分析视角。
AI.motivation: 现有的医疗成像OOD检测方法往往依赖于黑盒模型内部信号，缺乏语义可解释性，难以在医疗等高风险场景中建立信任，无法有效解决模型在分布偏移下的过拟合问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种可解释的OOD检测框架：1. 使用稀疏自动编码器（SAE）从训练数据中学习类别特有的语义概念向量；2. 在推理阶段，通过这些概念向量对深度特征表示进行扰动，并观察类逻辑（class logits）的稳定性；3. 基于“分布内样本对语义扰动更稳健，而OOD样本更敏感”这一假设进行判别。
AI.result: 该方法能够有效地对分布内样本与OOD样本进行判别，同时通过分析模型在不同语义概念下的稳定性，揭示了导致模型不确定性的深层特征机制。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于概念条件的稳定性分析，该方法不仅提高了OOD检测的性能，还为识别模型不确定性的来源提供了可解释的机制，增强了深度学习模型在医疗临床环境中的可靠性与透明度。

title: Data-Driven Decoding of Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Affective computing increasingly relies on deep learning to represent emotions, yet latent spaces often remain opaque, high-dimensional black boxes. This paper investigates whether Transformers' embeddings recover the geometric regularities of Russell's circumplex model. We unify two complementary experiments testing the hypothesis that, after training models on text and speech, their resulting latent spaces encode a topology consistent with valence-arousal and reproduce human-like neighborhood relations. Specifically, we evaluate deep representations extracted from Transformer-based text (RoBERTa) and speech (wav2vec 2.0) encoders, along with a multimodal Transformer fusion architecture, across naturalistic datasets like MSP-Podcast and controlled LLM-generated stimuli. Our analysis reveals that multimodal fusion of text and audio yields perfect topological alignment with Russell's primary emotion ordering. Furthermore, in a zero-shot setting using generic text embeddings, projected fine-grained emotion terms fall close to their established human-mapped coordinates. Our contribution is a novel, data-driven framework for validating emotion models, demonstrating that Russell's circumplex structure is intrinsically encoded in the embeddings of these modalities rather than being solely an artifact of human labeling, thereby bridging the gap between psychological theory and representation learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用拓扑分析证实了基于 Transformer 的情感模型（尤其是多模态架构）在潜空间内内在地编码了罗素的环状情绪模型，从而在心理学理论与深度学习表示之间架起了桥梁。
AI.motivation: 情感计算中基于深度学习的潜空间通常被视为不透明的“黑盒”，目前的挑战在于验证这些高维向量表示是否真正捕捉到了心理学中经典的情绪理论（如罗素的环状模型）。
AI.method:
1. 实验材料：使用 RoBERTa (文本)、wav2vec 2.0 (语音) 及多模态融合 Transformer。
2. 数据集：自然数据集 (MSP-Podcast) 及 LLM 生成的受控刺激数据。
3. 分析方法：通过拓扑分析验证潜空间是否符合罗素的效价-唤醒度（valence-arousal）结构；在零样本（zero-shot）设置下，评估词嵌入向量与人类心理学坐标的邻近关系。
AI.result:
1. 多模态融合模型能够完美实现与罗素情感模型的情感顺序拓扑对齐。
2. 即使在零样本设置下，通用的文本嵌入也能将细粒度的情感术语准确映射至人类预期的坐标附近。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明情感模型中的潜空间并非黑盒，它们内在地编码了罗素的情绪环状模型（Circumplex Model）。多模态融合能实现与心理学模型的拓扑对齐，证明了这种结构是模型学习到的内在表示，而非仅仅是人类标签的产物。

title: Calibrated Sampling-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Bayesian Deep Learning
summary: Modern deep learning models remain notoriously prone to overconfidence, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Bayesian methods aim to counter this by learning a distribution over model parameters, and recent advances now make this feasible for large-scale architectures at costs comparable to AdamW. However, a challenge remains at test time: predictions must be averaged across many forward passes with weights sampled from the posterior, which is prohibitively expensive. Variance propagation offers an efficient alternative, computing layer-wise analytical approximations of uncertainty in a single forward pass. While such techniques are effective for MLPs, their extension to modern architectures remains challenging, due to increased depth and diversity of layer types. To fill this gap, we propose Calibrated Variance Propagation (CVP), which introduces a new propagation method for normalization layers, combines it with recent techniques for handling activation functions, and absorbs residual error through a light calibration step. CVP yields comparably accurate uncertainty estimates to MC sampling across transformers and CNNs, at a fraction of the cost. Against prior variance propagation work, CVP improves coverage at $0.5\%$ risk from $8.2\%$ to $14.6\%$ with BEiT-3 on Visual Reasoning (NLVR2) and from $2.6\%$ to $10.8\%$ with ViLT on VQAv2, with gains extending to convolutional architectures.

AI.tldr: 针对深度学习模型的不确定性估计，本文提出CVP技术，通过改进方差传播算法，实现了在Transformer和CNN架构下低成本、高精度的不确定性预测，克服了传统贝叶斯MC采样计算昂贵的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型存在过度自信问题。尽管贝叶斯方法可行，但其测试时需要多次前向传递（MC采样），计算成本高昂。现有的方差传播方法虽然高效但主要局限于多层感知机（MLP），难以扩展到现代复杂架构。
AI.method: 提出校准方差传播（CVP）框架：1. 为归一化层设计新型传播方法；2. 集成现有的激活函数处理技术；3. 引入轻量级校准步骤以吸收残差误差。
AI.result: CVP在Transformer（BEiT-3, ViLT）及卷积神经网络上实现了与MC采样相当的不确定性估计精度，但计算成本显著降低。在特定基准测试（NLVR2, VQAv2）中，相较于以前的方差传播方法，显著提高了预测覆盖率（如在0.5%风险水平下，覆盖率显著提升）。
AI.conclusion: CVP成功填补了方差传播技术在复杂深度学习架构（如Transformer和CNN）中应用的空白，通过更精确的层级不确定性估计，为高风险应用提供了一种高效、可靠的替代贝叶斯模型平均的方法。

title: Robust Dual-Signal Fusion: Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Gating with Compressed Chain-of-Thought Refinement for Irony Detection in Social Media Texts
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) natively default to literal semantic interpretations, making zero-shot irony detection a persistent challenge. We introduce the Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that compresses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories without Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Evaluated on a strictly held-out TweetEval test set (N=734), RDS achieves 78.1% accuracy and a Macro F1 of 0.777, matching the absolute performance ceiling of the fine-tuned BERTweet. On the heavily imbalanced iSarcasm dataset, the frozen CoT pipeline filters 22.5% of out-of-distribution hallucinations, yielding a zero-shot Macro F1 of 0.6726 and Ironic F1 of 0.4821, outperforming multiple heavily supervised SemEval transformer ensembles. A statistical ablation confirms this structural synergy: adding the symbolic prior to the neural baseline yields no significant gain (p = 0.242), and the marginal benefit of adding the CoT pipeline to that prior is heavily compressed (p = 0.149). Only the complete, concurrent fusion of all three signals achieves a statistically validated improvement over the baseline (p = 0.005).

AI.tldr: RDS框架通过神经-符号融合与CoT技术，在无需微调的情况下解决了LLM在反讽检测中的字面语义偏见，实现了与微调模型媲美的零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）天然倾向于字面语义理解，导致在零样本反讽检测任务中表现不佳，难以识别非字面表达。
AI.method: 提出Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion框架，这是一个混合神经-符号架构；利用思维链（CoT）推理轨迹压缩技术，无需监督微调（SFT）即可处理语义分析；将神经基线、符号先验与CoT流水线进行并发融合。
AI.result: 在TweetEval数据集上达到78.1%的准确率和0.777的Macro F1，追平了微调后的BERTweet；在iSarcasm数据集上实现0.6726的零样本Macro F1，表现优于多个强监督Transformer集成模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种通过神经-符号融合实现反讽检测的新范式，证明了该框架在零样本环境下无需微调即可达到与全监督模型相当的性能（在某些指标上甚至超越），且各模块间存在显著的协同效应。

title: Prediction of Runtime Parameters of Parallel Chemistry Applications via Active and Generative Learning
summary: In this work, we develop two main Machine Learning based approaches to predict the runtime parameters of highly scalable parallel chemistry computations.These approaches employ active and generative learning together with the empirically determined gradient boosted regression tree models chosen among a rich suite of machine learning models. When evaluated on Coupled-Cluster with Singles and Doubles computations, our models achieve a mean absolute error percentage (MAPE) as low as 0.023 and a coefficient of determination as high as 99.9%. Furthermore, when combined with active learning to mitigate the lack of large amounts of training data, our models score a MAPE about 0.2 with 20-25% of the original dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出利用改进的梯度提升回归树结合主动学习，高效预测大规模并行化学计算的运行参数，在显著降低数据依赖的同时保持了极高的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 大规模并行化学计算的运行参数预测复杂，且通常面临训练数据不足的问题，需要高效的机器学习方案来优化性能。
AI.method: 结合主动学习（Active Learning）与生成式学习（Generative Learning），并从多种机器学习模型中选定梯度提升回归树（Gradient Boosted Regression Trees, GBRT）作为核心模型。
AI.result: 在耦合簇（Coupled-Cluster）计算中，模型取得了0.023的平均绝对误差百分比（MAPE）及99.9%的决定系数；在主动学习辅助下，使用20-25%的数据即可将MAPE控制在0.2左右。
AI.conclusion: 结合主动学习与梯度提升回归树模型，能够显著减少训练数据需求，同时保持高精度的运行参数预测，提升大规模并行化学计算的效率。

title: Follow the Latent Roadmap: Navigating Revocable Decoding for Diffusion LLMs with Anchor Tokens
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a promising avenue for parallel generation but face a trade-off between decoding speed and quality. While revocable decoding strategies attempt to mitigate errors by verifying and remasking tokens, they typically operate within a mixed-quality context. This leads to two critical failures: \textit{Error Propagation}, where new tokens absorb toxic information from erroneous context, and \textit{Local Error Reinforcement}, where errors mutually reinforce each other to evade detection. To alleviate these challenges, we propose ASRD (Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding), a training-free framework that operates within the embedding space. ASRD explicitly decouples the decoding context into trusted \textit{Anchor Tokens}, which are identified via temporal consistency, and uncertain candidates. Leveraging a dynamic Anchor Tokens Cache, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: (1) Anchor-Guided Generation, which injects entropy-weighted anchor signals into masked positions to implicitly rectify attention toward the reliable global skeleton; and (2) Anchor-Perturbed Verification, which applies orthogonal perturbations to uncertain candidate tokens, destabilizing and remasking errors driven by fragile local consensus. Extensive experiments on math and coding benchmarks demonstrate that ASRD outperforms recent remasking baselines, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 6.4\% while accelerating inference throughput by up to 7.2$\times$.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散语言模型并行生成中的质量下降瓶颈，提出 ASRD 框架，通过引入锚点引导机制与扰动验证，显著提升了解码精度并加速了推理效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）虽然支持并行生成，但存在解码速度与质量的权衡问题。现有的可撤销解码策略在处理混合质量上下文时，容易产生“错误传播”和“局部错误强化”，导致模型难以纠偏。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的框架 ASRD（锚点监督可撤销解码），包含两个核心机制：1. 锚点引导生成（Anchor-Guided Generation）：通过熵加权将锚点信号注入掩码位置以纠正注意力；2. 锚点扰动验证（Anchor-Perturbed Verification）：对候选标记施加正交扰动，以检测并重新掩码脆弱的局部错误。
AI.result: 在数学和编程基准测试中，ASRD 相比现有的重掩码基线性能更优，精度提升高达 6.4%，推理吞吐量提升高达 7.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: ASRD 通过在嵌入空间中利用时间一致性，将解码上下文解耦为“锚点标记”和“不确定候选”两部分，有效解决了扩散语言模型（dLLMs）在并行生成中的错误传播与局部错误强化问题，实现了质量与推理速度的双重提升。

title: From Tokens to Regions: CUDA-Sensitive Instruction Tuning for GPU Kernel Generation
summary: High-performance CUDA kernels are essential for scalable AI systems, while Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle to generate correct kernels due to strict and implicit execution constraints. Existing LLM-based approaches either rely on costly agentic or reinforcement-learning (RL) pipelines, or adopt supervised fine-tuning (SFT) objectives that fail to explicitly model CUDA sensitivity, namely code tokens or regions tightly coupled with execution constraints. In this work, we investigate CUDA sensitivity from the perspective of token confidence patterns, showing that CUDA sensitivity appears at both token and region levels, where most CUDA-sensitive tokens are predicted with high confidence, while a smaller low-confidence subset forms regions corresponding to execution-critical structures. These findings suggest that effective CUDA kernel generation should both leverage high-confidence CUDA-sensitive tokens and preserve low-confidence CUDA-sensitive regions. Building on these insights, we propose \textbf{\underline{CU}DA-\underline{Se}nsitive Instruction \underline{T}uning (CuSeT)}, a low-cost post-training method within a simple SFT framework. CuSeT follows the principle of ``from tokens to regions'' by combining \emph{adaptive token-level masking} with \emph{region-aware sample reweighting}. Experiments show that CuSeT consistently improves functional correctness across multiple model families and scales, outperforming standard SFT and advanced SFT variants, while achieving competitive performance against frontier CUDA kernel generation models with substantially lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CuSeT的低成本SFT方法，通过洞察CUDA代码的“敏感度”模式，利用自适应掩码和样本重加权技术，显著提升了大模型生成正确高性能CUDA内核的能力，无需高昂的RL或Agent流水线。
AI.motivation: 大模型生成高性能CUDA内核时面临严格且隐含的约束，现有的基于Agent/RL的方法成本高昂，而传统SFT无法显式建模“CUDA敏感度”（即对执行约束极为关键的代码片段）。
AI.method: 提出CuSeT（CUDA-Sensitive Instruction Tuning）方法。核心策略包括：1. 自适应标记级掩码（Adaptive token-level masking）：针对性处理高/低置信度的CUDA敏感标记；2. 区域感知样本重加权（Region-aware sample reweighting）：根据执行关键区域对样本进行差异化处理。
AI.result: 在多个模型系列和规模上，CuSeT在功能正确率上均优于标准SFT及高级SFT变体，且能以极低的推理成本达到与前沿专用内核生成模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: CuSeT通过在简单的SFT框架内结合自适应标记级掩码和区域感知样本重加权，有效地解决了LLM生成高性能CUDA内核的准确性问题，验证了建模CUDA敏感度对于代码生成的关键作用，且具有极高的成本效益。

title: Revisiting the Systematicity in Negation in the Era of In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to the 6th Workshop Natural Language Meets Logic and Machine Learning (NALOMA2026) at ESSLLI2026
summary: Understanding the meaning of negated sentences remains one of the challenges for language models, even in the era of large language models (LLMs). We analyze systematicity regarding LLM understanding of negation from two perspectives: behavioral systematicity and representational systematicity. For behavioral systematicity, we confirm that through demonstrations and in-context learning, LLMs can recognize negation expressions and scope within sentences to some extent, but they fail to achieve perfect performance. In particular, the difficulty of the negation scope recognition for models varies depending on the output format. For representational systematicity, we analyze the extent to which function vectors can be robustly constructed from in-context examples for tasks that are essential to understanding negation. The experiments suggest that while function vectors can be composed for negation cue extraction tasks, extracting function vectors for recognizing scope is more challenging.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了LLM对否定句理解的系统性局限，发现模型在行为表现和表征构建上仍难以完美处理否定范围的识别与理解。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型取得了巨大进步，但在理解否定句（negated sentences）这一核心逻辑任务上仍表现出不稳定性，研究旨在探究这种缺陷背后的系统性原因。
AI.method: 该研究从“行为系统性”和“表征系统性”两个维度进行分析：通过行为测试评估LLM在不同提示格式下对否定表达及作用域的识别能力；通过构建功能向量（Function Vectors）分析模型在上下文学习中提取否定线索及逻辑作用域的建模能力。
AI.result: 在行为层面，LLM在否定范围识别上受输出格式影响较大且表现不完美；在表征层面，虽然从上下文样本中提取否定线索的功能向量相对可行，但在捕捉复杂的逻辑作用域方面表现出明显困难。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM在上下文学习下能一定程度上处理否定，但在否定范围识别（尤其是不同输出格式下）和表征合成方面仍存在显著局限，表明其尚未达到真正的系统性理解。

title: Evolutionary Bilevel Reward Shaping for Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) often suffers from performance degradation when deployed in environments that differ from those encountered during training. Existing techniques such as domain randomization (DR) mitigate this, but require access to diverse training environments and full trajectory observability, assumptions that fail in privacy-preserving or restricted scenarios where only scalar performance metrics are available. We propose Generalization via Evolutionary Reward Shaping (GERS), a bilevel optimization approach to improve generalization on unseen test environments using only scalar feedback from validation environments. At the lower level, an RL agent guided via a reward function shaped by the upper level learns a policy on a limited set of training environments with accessible trajectory data; at the upper level, CMA-ES optimizes the reward shaping parameters to maximize the cumulative unshaped reward on separate validation environments for which trajectory access is unavailable. Results on continuous control tasks indicate that GERS outperforms the standard RL baseline on unseen test environments. GERS performance is comparable to DR, despite DR treating the combined set of training and validation environments of GERS as a single training set that requires trajectory access, whereas GERS cannot access validation trajectories. These results confirm that GERS effectively enhances generalization under restricted data access constraints.

AI.tldr: 针对强化学习泛化性差且数据受限的问题，研发了 GERS 算法，利用双层优化和演化算法，仅需少量验证环境的标量表现指标即可显著提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习模型在训练环境与测试环境分布不一致时性能会显著下降，现有的域随机化（DR）方法需要访问多样化的训练环境及完整的轨迹数据，在涉及隐私保护或数据受限的场景下难以实施。
AI.method: 提出了一种“通过演化奖励塑造实现泛化”（GERS）的双层优化框架：下层使用经过上层奖励塑造的函数训练策略；上层利用 CMA-ES 演化算法，通过验证环境仅提供的标量性能指标来优化奖励函数的参数。
AI.result: 在持续控制任务的实验中，GERS 在未见测试环境中的泛化性能优于标准 RL 基准，且在仅拥有验证环境标量反馈的情况下，其性能接近需要轨迹访问权限和更多训练信息的 DR 方法。
AI.conclusion: GERS 能够通过标量反馈有效提升强化学习在未见环境下的泛化能力，即使在无法获取验证集轨迹数据的限制性条件下，其表现也优于标准强化学习基准，并可媲美需要更全面信息的域随机化（DR）方法。

title: Understanding Scam Trends and Rail Paths from Reddit Self-Disclosure Narratives
comment: 6 pages, International Conference on AI and the Digital Economy (CADE) 2026
summary: Online scam behavior is inherently multi-stage, and the lifecycle includes temporally ordered rails and events rather than isolated signals. Existing works analyze characteristics of scam types and rails, but they do not track scam trends across years. Moreover, the work on the relations between rails is hampered due to the lack of open-source datasets with annotations and coverage of different scam types. To address these gaps, we build a dataset to analyze the yearly trend of scam characteristics and rail paths using Reddit self-disclosure narratives from 2023 to 2025. We collect 21,304 posts from scam-related subreddits with at least one rail among identity, communication, platform, and payment for trend analysis by heuristic annotation. Then, we label 1,800 posts containing explicit or recoverable scam chains by an LLM-assisted method for scam path analysis. The method is evaluated with human annotation. Lastly, we run a topic model on the comments of the posts to analyze the community support behavior. The results reveal that scam processes are predominantly multi-rail. Across years, different scam types and rail components dominate. Different scam types vary systematically in path complexity. Reddit support behaviors have become more detailed over time. This work supports synthetic scam chain data simulation and AI-related scam risk assessment, though findings may not generalise to other platforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个涵盖2023-2025年Reddit诈骗叙述的数据集，通过分析诈骗的多阶段特征及轨道演变，揭示了诈骗行为的复杂性和动态趋势，为防范诈骗提供了新的数据支持和实证分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的诈骗研究多关注孤立的信号，缺乏对诈骗生命周期的时间序列分析，且由于缺乏公开的高质量标注数据集，难以深入探究诈骗“轨道（rails）”间的复杂关系。
AI.method:
1. 数据构建：从2023-2025年的Reddit诈骗相关板块收集并处理了21,304篇包含身份、通信、平台、支付等轨道的叙述帖。
2. 标注与分析：利用LLM辅助标注了1,800个具有完整诈骗链的帖子，并由人工进行验证。
3. 社区行为分析：通过主题模型（Topic Model）分析相关帖子的评论，以量化社区支持行为的变化。
AI.result:
1. 证实了诈骗过程主要由多个轨道组成。
2. 明确了诈骗特征和轨道组件在不同年份的演变趋势。
3. 发现不同诈骗类型的链条复杂度具有系统性差异。
4. 观察到Reddit社区对诈骗受害者的支持反应在近年来变得更加详细。
AI.conclusion: 诈骗活动本质上是多阶段的“多轨道（multi-rail）”过程。研究发现，不同诈骗类型的演变具有显著的年度趋势和不同的路径复杂度，且Reddit社区的支持行为随着时间推移变得更加精细和具体。本研究为诈骗链数据模拟及AI风险评估提供了数据基础。

title: Rapid Poison: Practical Poisoning Attacks Against the Rapid Response Framework
summary: The Rapid Response (RR) framework, deployed in production systems, including Anthropic's ASL-3 safeguards, continuously improves jailbreak-detection classifiers. When new jailbreaks emerge that bypass these classifiers, Rapid Response generates synthetic variants for training, helping the model generalize from the new attacks and quickly adapt. We reveal that prompt injection can infiltrate this pipeline to deliver poisoned samples into the classifier's training set, enabling two attack objectives: (I) targeted poisoning attacks that create false positives on harmless samples by categorizing them as a jailbreak, with a specific desired feature (e.g., certain formatting, subject, or keyword), (II) concept-based backdoor attacks that induce false negatives on jailbreak inputs, generalizing even to jailbreaks from attack strategies the defender explicitly trained against, when the backdoor trigger is present. Importantly, our threat model restricts adversaries to modifying only jailbreak samples (not benign data or labels), a constraint unexplored by prior work that makes the second objective particularly challenging. We address this with Omission Attack, which exploits a new phenomenon: when training on concept-absent unsafe samples, the classifier misassociates that concept's presence with the safe label. Both attacks cause substantial and in some cases near-complete label flipping at only a 1% poisoning rate, achieving up to 100% false positive rates and up to 96% false negative rates.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现生产级自动防御流程（RR）易受“中毒攻击”影响。攻击者通过构造特殊的越狱样本，能够诱导模型在监测中产生严重的误报或漏报，即使在极其有限的操作权限（仅修改少数越狱样本）下，也能以极低的成本造成系统性安全崩溃。
AI.motivation: 随着生产级系统（如Anthropic的ASL-3）采用Rapid Response（RR）框架来实现对越狱攻击的自动防御和持续迭代，研究人员旨在探讨这种闭环训练流程是否存在被对抗性注入篡改的风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种Omission Attack（遗漏攻击）策略：利用模型在训练时将特定的“概念缺失”片段误判为安全标签的机制，通过只修改极少数的越狱样本（而非无害或带标签数据），将攻击意图植入模型的训练集，从而跨越不同攻击策略实现后门攻击。
AI.result: 在仅注入1%毒化数据的情况下，攻击者能够成功实现：(1) 将特定的无害输入分类为越狱（目标误报攻击）；(2) 在触发特定后门时，即使是防御者已训练覆盖的攻击类型也会被漏判（目标漏报攻击）。实验表明，该攻击可达到100%的误报率和96%的漏报率。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了Rapid Response（RR）自动化防御流程中存在的安全隐患。攻击者可以通过操纵注入样本，在无需控制标注数据或无害样本的前提下，诱导分类器产生误报（拒绝正常服务）或漏报（规避监测），破坏生产级大模型的安全性，且仅需1%的毒化率即可达到极高的效果。

title: Compositional Reasoning Depth Predicts Clinical AI Failure: Empirical Evidence Consistent with Transformer Compositionality Limits in Electronic Health Record Question Answering
summary: Aggregate accuracy benchmarks conceal a systematic structure in how large language models fail at electronic health record (EHR) question answering: questions requiring more inferential steps produce disproportionately more errors. Motivated by theoretical results on transformer compositionality limits, we introduce a pre-specified hop-count taxonomy -- the number of distinct reasoning steps required to answer a clinical question from an EHR -- as a principled predictor of model failure. We annotate 313 clinician-generated MedAlign EHR question-answer pairs across four hop levels and evaluate 301 questions in a within-model ablation (claude-sonnet-4-6, zero-shot vs. extended thinking) and cross-architecture replications (gpt-4o and gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, zero-shot). All three models, spanning two providers and two OpenAI generations (GPT-4 and GPT-5), show monotone accuracy decline with hop count: Claude Sonnet zero-shot falls from 30.6% (hop=1) to 17.6% (hop=4) (Cochran-Armitage z=-2.30, p=0.011; OR per hop 0.72, 95% CI [0.56,0.92], p=0.008); GPT-4o replicates this (37.8% to 14.7%; OR 0.58 [0.45,0.75], p<0.001); and gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 confirms it (37.8% to 23.5%; OR 0.80 [0.66,0.98], p=0.027). A pre-specified context-sufficiency audit shows higher-hop questions are not differentially disadvantaged by EHR truncation (answerability 93-95% at hops 2-4 vs. 79% at hop=1), so the decline reflects compositional reasoning difficulty. Extended thinking did not significantly flatten the accuracy-depth curve across three reasoning conditions, and thinking-token usage scaled with hop count (r=0.31, p<0.0001), consistent with the predicted O(k) computational requirement. Hop count is thus a theory-motivated, cross-architecture predictor of large-language-model error on EHR question answering, with direct implications for deployment risk stratification of clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 大模型在 EHR 问答中的准确率随推理复杂度的增加而显着下降，Hop count 是预测此类系统性失效的可靠指标。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型准确率基准测试掩盖了模型在处理电子健康记录（EHR）时失效的系统性结构。研究旨在基于 Transformer 模型的组合性限制理论，验证“推理步数”是否是导致模型失效的潜在核心因素。
AI.method: 1. 建立了基于“推理步数”（hop-count taxonomy）的分类框架；2. 对 313 个临床医生生成的 MedAlign EHR 问题对进行标注；3. 在 Claude 3.5 Sonnet、GPT-4o 和 GPT-5.4 等多种模型上进行零样本（zero-shot）及扩展思维（extended thinking）的消融与对比实验；4. 执行 EHR 上下文充分性审计（Context-sufficiency audit）以排除信息截断干扰。
AI.result: 所有模型在不同推理步数（hop 1-4）上呈现准确率单调下降（如 Claude Sonnet 从 30.6% 降至 17.6%）；上下文审计显示性能下降并非由信息丢失引起；扩展思维策略虽增加了推理令牌的消耗，但未能显著改变准确率随推理深度下降的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 模型在处理电子健康记录（EHR）问答时存在系统性的性能下降问题，即随着推理步骤（hop count）的增加，准确率单调递减。这一现象跨越不同模型架构，证实了模型在组合推理任务上存在根本限制，且当前的扩展思维（extended thinking）策略未能有效解决此问题。 hop count 可作为评估临床 AI 部署风险的有效预测指标。

title: LiFT: Local Search via Linear Programming for Overfitting-Controlled Transformers
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, published in The 20th Learning and Intelligent Optimization Conference (LION 2026)
summary: This paper proposes a Linear Programming (LP)-based local search framework for fine-tuning pretrained transformer models with explicit control against overfitting. The approach formulates transformer fine-tuning as a bilevel optimization-based regularization problem, in which model parameters and regularization hyperparameters are jointly updated. Information collected during initial warm-up iterations, including validation gradients and training Hessian information, is used to construct a local descent direction by solving an LP that minimizes a scaled directional derivative while preserving training optimality. This validation-aware descent direction enables focused local updates of both parameters and regularization hyperparameters, reducing overfitting without requiring repeated full retraining cycles. The resulting method, termed Linear Programming-based Fine-Tuning (LiFT) for transformers, differs from conventional fine-tuning by systematically identifying task-specific updates rather than relying on heuristic or grid-based hyperparameter selection. Experiments on GPT-2 Small fine-tuned on WikiText-2 demonstrate that LiFT enables effective adaptation through selective tuning of transformer blocks and regularization parameters, yielding consistent improvements in test perplexity across multiple layer configurations and regularization settings, with particularly pronounced gains in overfitting-prone scenarios. Beyond empirical performance, LiFT establishes a principled connection between transformer fine-tuning, bilevel optimization, local search, and regularization theory.

AI.tldr: LiFT通过引入线性规划驱动的双层优化，实现了Transformer微调过程中参数与超参数的联合协同更新，在无需反复重训练的情况下有效缓解了过拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决预训练Transformer在微调过程中容易发生的过拟合问题，并克服传统方法中依赖试探性或网格搜索超参数调整的低效性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为LiFT的线性规划局部搜索框架：将微调建模为双层优化问题；利用预热阶段收集的验证梯度和Hessian信息构建局部下降方向；通过求解线性规划（LP）问题，在保持训练最优性的同时，同时更新模型参数和正则化超参数。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 Small及WikiText-2数据集上的实验表明，LiFT实现了更有效的模型适应，在各种层配置和正则化设置下均显著优化了测试集困惑度（Perplexity），特别是在易发生过拟合的场景中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: LiFT为Transformer微调提供了一种基于双层优化的原则性方法，通过线性规划确定参数更新方向，有效缓解了过拟合，并避免了低效的手动超参数网格搜索。

title: Contrastive-Difference CKA Reveals Concept-Specific Structural Alignment Across Language Model Architectures
summary: Do different LLM architectures encode high-level concepts in structurally compatible ways? We systematically characterize a geometric-functional universality dissociation: across multiple concept domains and architectural families, moderate geometric convergence coexists with near-perfect functional transfer. Using contrastive-difference CKA (CKA_Delta), a training-free diagnostic that computes kernel alignment on per-sample contrastive differences, we isolate concept-specific convergence from generic similarity -- achieving significant discrimination where standard CKA cannot. The dissociation replicates across all six concept domains we test (five with p <= 0.017 geometric discrimination and safety as a converging-functional trend, p = 0.08), including two non-instruction concepts (code-vs-NL, reasoning-vs-recall) validated without system prompts; a single 70B--70B pair provides an observational note that universality may strengthen with scale, requiring replication with additional >=70B models. We position CKA_Delta as a practical regime classifier and architectural outlier detector (Gemma: d = 1.08, AUC = 0.79) rather than an absolute transfer-accuracy predictor, providing a training-free diagnostic for cross-architecture concept monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CKA_Delta诊断工具，发现LLM在处理高级概念时表现出“几何结构差异但功能高度一致”的特性，并证明CKA_Delta可用于免训练的架构异常检测和概念监测。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究不同大语言模型（LLM）架构在编码高级概念时，其内部表征是否存在结构上的兼容性，以及这种结构收敛性与其实际功能表现之间的关系。
AI.method: 1. 提出“对比差异中心核对齐”（CKA_Delta）：利用每样本对比差异计算核对齐，相较于标准CKA，能更有效地从通用相似性中分离出特定概念的收敛性。2. 实验设计：跨多个概念域和架构家族，测试概念分类及其在不同模型间的迁移能力。3. 性能验证：通过对六个概念域的测试进行验证，并评估了其作为架构异常检测器（如识别Gemma）的效果。
AI.result: 1. 存在几何-功能普适性解离：尽管几何结构收敛有限，但功能迁移接近完美。2. CKA_Delta具有显著的辨别能力，优于标准CKA。3. 发现模型规模越大，普适性可能越强（基于70B模型观察）。4. 该方法有效识别出了架构异常（如Gemma，AUC=0.79）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了LLM架构中存在“几何-功能普适性解离”，即模型尽管在内部几何结构上存在显著差异（适度收敛），但能实现近乎完美的功能迁移。CKA_Delta可作为一种有效的免训练诊断工具，用于跨架构的各种概念监测、架构异常检测及机制研究。

title: Data Augmentations for Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining
summary: As AI labs approach a data ceiling where compute capacity outpaces the rate of new high-quality text generation, language model pretraining is shifting toward a data-constrained, compute-abundant regime that demands productive multi-epoch training on fixed corpora. Standard autoregressive (AR) pretraining overfits severely in this setting, reaching its optimum early and then continuously deteriorating. We investigate data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate this overfitting and enable productive training for hundreds of epochs on the same data. We introduce three orthogonal categories of augmentation for AR pretraining: token-level noise (masking, random replacement), sequence permutations (right-to-left prediction, Fill-in-the-Middle), and target offset prediction ($x_{t+i}$ for $i > 1$). Through systematic ablations, we find that individual augmentations delay overfitting and lower validation loss relative to the baseline, with random token replacement achieving the best minimum loss among individual methods. Combining augmentation categories further lowers the minimum validation loss. Our experiments demonstrate that data augmentations mitigate AR pretraining's data inefficiency and offer a promising solution to the data-constrained regime. All code and data are available at https://github.com/michaelchen-lab/data-augmentations-for-pretraining

AI.tldr: 面对高质量数据匮乏现状，本文引入三类数据增强技术（噪声、重排、偏移预测）来缓解自回归模型在多轮预训练中的过拟合问题，证明了通过合理增强可实现固定语料下的长时间高效训练。
AI.motivation: 随着算力超过高质量文本的生成速度，AI领域面临“数据墙”（data ceiling）问题。在计算资源充足但数据受限的场景下，标准自回归预训练极易过拟合，导致模型性能在训练后期不升反降。
AI.method: 提出三类正交数据增强方法用于自回归（AR）预训练：1. token级噪声（掩码、随机替换）；2. 序列重排（从右向左预测、填充中间内容FIM）；3. 目标偏移预测（预测第t+i个词，其中i>1）。通过系统性消融实验对比各方法及其组合的效果。
AI.result: 单一增强方法均能延缓过拟合并降低验证损失，其中随机token替换效果最佳；结合多种增强方法能进一步降低最小验证损失，从而打破数据限制对模型训练的约束。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强是解决语言模型在计算资源充足但数据匮乏环境下进行多轮预训练（multi-epoch pretraining）所面临的过拟合问题的有效策略，能显著提高数据效率，使模型在固定语料库上训练数百轮次成为可能。

title: Speaking the Language of Science: Toward a General-Purpose Generative Foundation Model for the Natural Sciences
summary: In this report, we present LOGOS (Language Of Generative Objects in Science), a scientific generative language model that unifies heterogeneous tasks across the natural sciences within a single autoregressive framework based on a shared scientific grammar. It encodes diverse scientific objects and their spatial interactions as token sequences over a common vocabulary. By representing spatial contact and constraint patterns as discrete tokens, the model captures complex structural interactions in a purely sequential manner, without relying on explicit coordinates or geometric neural networks. This unified representation enables a wide range of downstream tasks to be formulated consistently as next-token prediction in the same grammar space, creating strong alignment between continued multi-domain pre-training and downstream objectives. Across diverse tasks, LOGOS consistently matches or outperforms domain-specific baselines, providing preliminary evidence for the feasibility of "one model fits all" in the natural sciences. We train LOGOS models at different scales (1B, 3B, and 8B parameters) and find a consistent positive correlation between model size and performance. This suggests that the future of AI for Science (AI4S) may not lie in building an independent technical stack that is separated from large language models (LLMs). Instead, it may depend on deeply aligning scientific foundation models with LLMs through shared architectures, shared training paradigms, and shared inference infrastructure, so that LLMs can truly become a new entry point for AI4S. We release the model weights and associated resources to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: LOGOS模型通过将复杂的科学空间交互转化为统一的离散Token序列，成功在单一自回归框架内实现了多种科学任务的建模，证明了构建“通用科学基础模型”并将其与大语言模型深度整合的可能性。
AI.motivation: 解决当前科学人工智能（AI4S）碎片化现状，探索能否通过统一的生成式框架处理不同科学领域的异构任务，避免构建独立的、割裂的AI4S技术栈。
AI.method: 提出LOGOS（科学生成对象语言），将异构科学对象及其空间交互转化为统一词表下的离散Token序列，采用自回归大语言模型架构，通过序列预测任务实现跨领域科学知识建模。
AI.result: LOGOS模型在多个科学任务上匹配或超过了领域专用模型基准；实验表明性能与参数规模（1B至8B）呈正相关；验证了通过共享语法统一多领域科学建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 科学智能（AI4S）的未来通过与大语言模型（LLM）深度融合（共享架构、训练范式及推理设施）实现，证明了通用科学基础模型在跨学科任务中的可行性。

title: Variance Reduction for Non-Log-Concave Sampling with Applications to Inverse Problems
comment: Accepted to Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
summary: Sampling from high-dimensional, non-log-concave distributions with unnormalized densities is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, particularly when the exact gradient of the potential is unavailable and must be approximated via stochastic gradients that exhibit high variance under a fixed budget of gradient computations per iteration. Although variance reduction techniques such as SGD with momentum, STORM, and PAGE have demonstrated improved convergence properties in non-convex optimization, their implications for sampling from non-log-concave distributions remain largely unexplored. In this work, we develop the first unified analysis of these estimators for sampling from non-log-concave distributions. We establish improved non-asymptotic convergence rates in $\varepsilon$-relative Fisher information and, under a Poincaré inequality assumption, in squared total variation distance, and further prove weak convergence to the target distribution. We extend our analysis to solving inverse problems with score-based generative priors. We empirically validate our theory and demonstrate that, under a fixed gradient computations per iteration, variance-reduction techniques consistently improve sample quality in two standard imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析和实验证明，在采样高维非对数凹分布时，引入方差缩减技术（如STORM和PAGE）可以克服随机梯度高方差的限制，从而在固定计算开销下获得更高质量的样本，并有效应用于图像逆问题。
AI.motivation: 在高维、非对数凹分布中，当密度函数未归一化且仅能获得高方差的随机梯度时，现有的采样算法收敛性较差，且方差缩减技术在采样领域的应用尚不明确。
AI.method: 将方差缩减估计器（Variance Reduction estimators）引入采样算法（如Langevin动力学）；在$\varepsilon$-相对Fisher信息和平方总变差距离（在Poincaré不等式假设下）框架下进行非渐近收敛性分析；将该方法扩展至得分基生成先验的逆问题求解。
AI.result: 建立了方差缩减估计器在采样任务中的首个统一分析；导出了改进的非渐近收敛速率；通过实验验证了在固定梯度预算下，方差缩减技术能够显著提升采样质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了将方差缩减技术（如SGD动量法、STORM、PAGE）应用于高维、非对数凹采样问题的理论框架，证明了这些技术在固定梯度计算预算下能有效提高采样质量，并成功应用于求解带得分基生成先验的逆问题。

title: LESS Is More: Mutual-Stability Sampling for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive decoding by iteratively refining masked sequences, enabling parallel token updates and bidirectional conditioning. Their practical efficiency, however, is limited by sampling procedures that execute a fixed number of reverse denoising steps selected before decoding, spending computation on already-stable positions and sometimes committing unstable ones too early. We present \textsc{LESS}, a training-free, model-agnostic adaptive sampler that treats token commitment as an online stopping problem. \textsc{LESS} implements mutual-stability sampling through a joint stability rule that makes a masked position eligible for unmasking only when its top-1 prediction has high confidence, its top-1 token persists across recent reverse steps, and its predictive distribution is stable under top-$K$ inter-step Jensen--Shannon divergence. We evaluate \textsc{LESS} on Dream-7B, LLaDA-8B, and LLaDA-1.5-8B, covering full-sequence diffusion and semi-autoregressive blockwise sampling regimes, across seven benchmarks spanning general knowledge, math, and code. \textsc{LESS} improves average accuracy over strong training-free adaptive samplers while using $72.1\%$ fewer reverse steps than fixed-budget decoding. Since each reverse step requires a Transformer forward pass, these step-count reductions translate into fewer forward evaluations, lower measured wall-clock latency, and lower estimated inference compute.

AI.tldr: LESS 是一种用于扩散 LLM 的自适应采样算法，通过在线评估 Token 预测的稳定性来动态跳过不必要的计算，在提高生成质量的同时大幅降低了推理所需的算力开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的 dLLM 推理通常使用固定步数的逆向去噪，导致计算资源浪费在已稳定的 Token 上，且对未稳定位置过早确认，影响生成质量。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 LESS 的训练无关、模型无关的自适应采样器，核心机制是“互稳采样”（mutual-stability sampling），即基于 Token 的置信度、历史一致性及预测分布的 JS 散度稳定性来动态决定何时终止特定位置的去噪过程。
AI.result: 在 Dream-7B 和 LLaDA 等模型上进行评估，LESS 在七个基准测试中提升了准确率，且在推理过程中减少了 72.1% 的逆向步数，显著降低了计算延迟和推理成本。
AI.conclusion: LESS 证明了将 Token 确立视为在线停止问题能够有效提升扩散大模型 (dLLM) 的推理效率，通过在保持性能的同时动态减少迭代步数，实现了计算资源的大幅节省。

title: IMPACTeen: Intentions, Manipulation, Persuasion, Annotations, and Consequences in Teen Communication Dataset
summary: IMPACTeen is a dataset of textual social influence scenarios spanning interpersonal, media-based, and digital settings in an adolescent context. It contains 1,021 texts, 5,100 individual annotation records, and gold labels for social influence techniques, with each text annotated from five distinct perspectives: teenagers, parents, psychologists, communication experts, and teachers. The resource was constructed through constrained LLM generation, followed by a two-step human editing and validation phase aimed at ensuring youth-context realism. A multi-dimensional annotation covered influence presence, techniques, intentions, consequences, resistance, reactions, and annotation confidence. The dataset supports research on social influence detection, annotator disagreement, cross-lingual modeling, and the training and evaluation of language models. The dataset was created in Polish and is accompanied by a corresponding English version.

AI.tldr: IMPACTeen 是一个针对青少年社交影响的多语言、多维度标注数据集，通过专家协同构建，旨在支持社交影响分析、大模型训练及跨领域研究。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集在青少年特定语境及多维社交影响（人际、媒体、数字）的细粒度分析方面存在缺失，缺乏针对青少年面临的复杂社会影响的综合性数据集。
AI.method: 采用“受限 LLM 生成 + 两阶段人工编辑校验”的方法构建数据集，邀请五类不同背景的专家（青少年、家长、心理学家、传播学专家、教师）进行多维度标注。
AI.result: 构建了包含 1,021 条文本、5,100 条注解数据的中英双语数据集，涵盖了影响存在性、技巧、意图、后果、抵制策略及反应等多个维度。
AI.conclusion: IMPACTeen 是一个高质量、多维度的社交影响数据集，旨在促进青少年语境下的社交影响检测、跨语言建模以及大模型的技术验证，填补了在复杂社会互动分析方面的研究空白。

title: An affordable hardware-aware neural architecture search for deploying convolutional neural networks on ultra-low-power computing platforms
summary: Hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS) allows the integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in microcontrollers devices by automatically designing neural architectures that can fit prearranged hardware constraints. However, state-of-the-art HW-NAS target high-performance microcontrollers, whose power consumption does not meet sensing nodes requirements. This work presents a HW-NAS generating tiny CNNs that can run on ultra-low-power microcontrollers, featuring a lightweight search procedure enabling its execution even on embedded devices. Empirical results on three well-known benchmarks for tiny computer vision proved that the proposed HW-NAS was able to generate tiny CNNs while preserving state-of-the-art classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型轻量级HW-NAS，能够自动为超低功耗微控制器设计高效的CNN架构，在满足严苛功耗要求的同时保持了高分类精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的HW-NAS主要针对高性能微控制器，其功耗无法满足传感节点（sensing nodes）对超低功耗的需求。因此，需要一种专门为极度有限资源环境设计的NAS技术。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对超低功耗微控制器的硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）方法，并设计了一种轻量化的搜索算法，使其能够直接在嵌入式设备上执行。
AI.result: 在三个主流微型计算机视觉测试集上进行了验证，结果表明该方法生成的Tiny CNN不仅能满足硬件约束，还保持了业界顶尖的分类准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功展示了一种能够为超低功耗微控制器生成Tiny CNN的HW-NAS框架，在显著降低能耗的同时保持了与最先进方法相当的分类精度，为边缘设备上的高效视觉应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Exploring Extrinsic and Intrinsic Properties for Effective Reasoning with Code Interpreter
summary: Reasoning with a Code Interpreter (CI) has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through executable computation and iterative verification. Despite its growing adoption, the behavioral properties underlying effective code reasoning remain largely underexplored. In this work, we investigate code reasoning from two distinct perspectives inspired by prior studies of natural language reasoning: extrinsic properties, represented by crucial tokens, and intrinsic properties, represented by code-specific cognitive behaviors. Across multiple LLMs, we find that stronger CI reasoning models consistently exhibit a higher prevalence of crucial tokens and cognitive behaviors, particularly verification, backtracking, and backward chaining. Building on these observations, we examine how these properties can be leveraged during both inference and training. At inference time, appending code-specific crucial tokens improves performance on several reasoning capabilities, including mathematical, ordering, and optimization, while yielding limited benefits elsewhere. At training time, augmenting a state-of-the-art framework with code-specific cognitive behaviors improves supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning performance in two of three evaluated models. Further analysis shows that these behaviors reduce overthinking in incorrect responses and improve token efficiency, while also revealing factors that limit gains in a certain model. Our findings provide the first systematic characterization of effective reasoning with CI and demonstrate both the potential and limitations of leveraging key properties to improve CI-based reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了通过代码解释器提升大模型推理能力的内在机理，发现“关键Token”和“认知行为（验证、回溯等）”是提升性能的关键，并将这些发现应用于推理和训练策略中以改善模型表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管通过代码解释器（CI）进行推理已成为提升大模型推理能力的有效范式，但其背后的深层行为机理尚不明确。因此，本文旨在系统性地探索支持有效代码推理的关键行为属性。
AI.method: 研究人员从外在属性（关键Token）和内在属性（代码特定认知行为，如验证、回溯、反向链推理）两个维度分析代码推理；在推理阶段通过追加关键Token进行干预，在训练阶段通过增强认知行为来优化监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。
AI.result: 实验发现更强的CI推理模型表现出更高频的关键Token和特定的认知行为（验证、回溯、反向链）。在推理阶段引入关键Token可提升数学、排序和优化任务性能；在训练阶段增强认知行为能提升模型表现、减少错误响应中的“过度思考（overthinking）”并提高Token效率。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统地刻画了代码解释器（CI）辅助推理的有效行为特征，证明了利用这些特征（关键Token和认知行为）可以在推理和训练阶段提升大模型性能，同时也揭示了其应用的局限性。

title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents are deployed in long-horizon sessions, context accumulation drives up inference costs. Existing approaches utilize text pruning or dynamic memory eviction to minimize token footprints; however, their unconstrained sequence mutations alter layouts, introducing prefix mismatches and cache invalidation. This reveals a critical trade-off between text sparsity and prompt cache continuity. To address this, we present TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework. Globally, Ingestion-Aware Compaction acts as a framework harness to stabilize prompt prefixes and eliminate open-world environmental noise at the ingestion gate. Locally, Lifecycle-Aware Eviction monitors the ongoing residual utility of context segments, enforcing a conservative batch-turn schedule to offload content segments only when task relevance expires. Experiments on PinchBench and Claw-Eval under both isolated and continuous modes demonstrate that TokenPilot reduces costs by 61% and 56% in isolated mode, and 61% and 87% in continuous mode, while maintaining competitive performance compared to prior systems. TokenPilot has been integrated into LightMem2 at https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem2.

AI.tldr: TokenPilot 通过一种双粒度上下文管理策略，在减少 LLM 长程推理成本（最高达 87%）的同时，有效避免了因内存剪枝导致的缓存失效问题。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长程部署时，上下文积累导致推理成本激增。现有的文本剪枝或内存驱逐方法会引起序列结构改变，导致缓存失效（Cache Invalidation）和前缀不匹配，从而影响系统效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 TokenPilot 的双粒度上下文管理框架：1. 全局上采用“摄入感知压缩”（Ingestion-Aware Compaction）来稳定提示词前缀并过滤环境噪声；2. 局部上采用“生命周期感知驱逐”（Lifecycle-Aware Eviction），根据任务相关性，通过保守的批量调度机制选择性移除不再需要的上下文片段。
AI.result: 在 PinchBench 和 Claw-Eval 测试中，TokenPilot 在独立模式下实现了 61% 和 56% 的推理成本降低，在连续模式下实现了 61% 和 87% 的推理成本降低，且性能表现优于或持平现有主流系统。
AI.conclusion: TokenPilot 提供了一种在长程会话中平衡上下文稀疏性和提示缓存连续性的有效方案，在降低推理成本的同时保持了性能，显著提升了 LLM 智能体的部署效率。

title: pFedUL: Layer-Aware Federated Unlearning for Personalized Federated Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in CMC-Computers, Materials & Continua
summary: Federated unlearning (FU) enables the removal of specific data contributions from federated learning (FL) models to comply with regulations such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). However, most existing FU methods are designed for the FedAvg paradigm, where all clients share a single global model. In practice, personalized federated learning (pFL) methods such as FedPer, FedRep, Ditto, and FedBN have become widely adopted due to their superior handling of non-IID data. These methods decompose the model into shared global layers and client-specific personalized layers, fundamentally altering the semantics of unlearning, yet this setting has received little attention. We formalize FU under the pFL paradigm, identifying a tension between unlearning completeness on shared layers and personalization preservation for remaining clients. We then propose pFedUL, a layer-aware selective unlearning framework comprising three components: (1) gradient-based layer-wise contribution attribution that separately quantifies the target client's influence on shared and personalized parameters, (2) adaptive selective unlearning that applies differentiated forgetting strategies across layer types, and (3) a lightweight recalibration protocol enabling remaining clients to restore personalization with minimal overhead. We further introduce two new metrics, Personalization Preservation Score (PPS) and Cross-client Fairness Index (CFI), to evaluate pFL-specific unlearning quality. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and FEMNIST under varying non-IID settings indicate that pFedUL achieves unlearning effectiveness comparable to full retraining while maintaining an average of 97.3\% personalized accuracy for remaining clients. Compared with six state-of-the-art FU methods adapted to the pFL setting, pFedUL consistently achieves superior personalization preservation.

AI.tldr: 针对个性化联邦学习（pFL）中数据遗忘难题，本文提出了 pFedUL 框架，通过层级感知的贡献度量化与差异化遗忘策略，实现了在有效卸载特定数据贡献的同时，最大程度保护剩余客户端的个性化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦遗忘（FU）研究主要集中在 FedAvg 范式，忽略了在处理非独立同分布（non-IID）数据时更具优势的个性化联邦学习（pFL）范式。在 pFL 中，模型被拆分为共享层和个性化层，这改变了遗忘的语义，使得如何在实现彻底遗忘的同时保持模型个性化成为一个挑战。
AI.method: 提出了 pFedUL 框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于梯度的层级贡献度归因，量化目标客户端对共享层和个性化层的影响；(2) 自适应选择性遗忘策略，针对不同层类型实施差异化遗忘；(3) 轻量级再校准协议，高效恢复剩余客户端的个性化能力。此外，引入了 PPS 和 CFI 评估指标。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 FEMNIST 数据集上的实验表明，pFedUL 的遗忘效果可媲美全量重训练，同时使剩余客户端保持了平均 97.3% 的个性化精度，优于现有的六种先进 FU 方法。
AI.conclusion: pFedUL 通过层级感知的选择性遗忘策略，成功解决了在个性化联邦学习（pFL）场景下实现数据遗忘的难题，在保证遗忘效果的同时，最大程度地维持了剩余客户端的个性化精度。

title: DEEPRUBRIC: Evidence-Tree Rubric Supervision for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents synthesize long-form reports by searching and reasoning over retrieved evidence. Reinforcement learning with rubric-based rewards improves these agents by optimizing them against checkable criteria that translate report quality into reward signals, but its efficiency depends on whether those criteria reliably capture the task scope and evidence needs. Most existing studies ask an LLM to generate rubrics for a given query, but when the model fails to infer the underlying information needs, the generated rubrics may be incomplete and reduce RL efficiency. To obtain more reliable query--rubric supervision, we introduce DeepRubric, a data construction framework that reverses this process: instead of inferring evaluation criteria for a given query, it first determines what an evidence-backed report should be evaluated on and then synthesizes aligned query--rubric pairs from those evaluation targets. Starting from a sampled seed topic, DeepRubric builds an evidence tree by recursively expanding evidence-backed sub-questions, whose leaves serve as atomic and verifiable evaluation targets. It then uses the evidence tree to synthesize the training query and rubrics, ensuring that the reward evaluates exactly the information requested by the query. Using DeepRubric, we construct 9K query--rubric supervision examples and train DeepRubric-8B with rubric-based GRPO, achieving comparable performance to prior open state-of-the-art deep research models across three benchmarks with roughly 13x fewer RL GPU-hours.

AI.tldr: DeepRubric 通过反向构建“查询-评价准则”对，解决了深度研究 Agent 强化学习中评价指标覆盖不全的问题，在保持高性能的同时，实现了训练效率的跨越式提升。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究 Agent 利用强化学习（RL）进行优化时，主要依赖 LLM 生成准则（rubric）。由于 LLM 难以完全推断用户的底层信息需求，导致生成的准则不完整或不准确，进而降低了 RL 的训练效率。
AI.method: 提出 DeepRubric 框架：从抽样的核心主题出发，递归构建“证据树”（evidence tree）以确定可验证的评价目标，随后反向合成训练所需的查询语句（query）及其对应的评价准则（rubric），并结合 GRPO 方法进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 构建了 9K 个查询-准则样本，训练的 DeepRubric-8B 模型在三个基准测试中达到了与现有顶级开源深度研究模型相当的性能，且训练所需的 GPU 耗时减少了约 13 倍。
AI.conclusion: DeepRubric 提供了一种高效的查询-准则（query-rubric）数据构建方法，通过“反向”生成流程确保证据树与评价准则的高度一致性，显著提升了深度研究 Agent 的训练效率和性能，同时大幅降低了对计算资源的需求。

title: QK-Normed MLA: QK normalization without full key caching
summary: Query-key (QK) normalization stabilizes attention by controlling the scale of queries and keys before the dot product, but is not immediately compatible with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). MLA achieves efficient decoding by caching low-dimensional latent states instead of full keys, whereas post-projection QK RMSNorm appears to require the fully projected key for every cached token. We show this apparent incompatibility is an implementation artifact, not an architectural constraint. RMSNorm decomposes into a static affine weight and a dynamic scalar RMS statistic. The static key-side weight can be absorbed into the MLA query-side projection; the dynamic key statistic reduces to one inverse-RMS scalar per token and KV group. The resulting formulation is exactly equivalent to explicit post-projection QK RMSNorm in exact arithmetic and preserves MLA's latent decode path. In our 400M runs trained for up to 100B tokens, QK-Normed MLA achieves lower training loss and better downstream accuracy than QK clipping, while H800 decode benchmarks show less than 2% latency overhead up to 256k context. These results make QK normalization a practical stabilization option for MLA models without requiring full-key caching.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明了QK归一化与MLA架构在数学上是可兼容的。通过将RMSNorm的权重量化并简化统计量计算，无需缓存全Key即可实现QK归一化，解决了MLA模型的训练稳定性问题，同时保持了极高的推理效率。
AI.motivation: QK归一化能有效稳定注意力机制，但与多头潜在注意力（MLA）架构存在实现层面的兼容性难题（主要是由于MLA缓存低维潜在状态而非全Key，导致传统的后投影QK RMSNorm难以直接应用）。
AI.method: 利用RMSNorm的数学特性进行重构：将静态的键侧（Key-side）仿射权重通过矩阵乘法结合到查询侧（Query-side）投影中，并将动态的键统计量简化为每个Token及KV组一个逆RMS标量，从而在无需全Key缓存的情况下实现数学等价的QK RMSNorm。
AI.result: 在训练规模达100B Token的400M参数实验中，QK归一化的MLA在训练损失和下游任务准确率上优于QK裁剪（Clipping）；在长达256k上下文的H800解码测试中，推理延迟增加不到2%。
AI.conclusion: QK归一化对于MLA模型是一种实用的稳定方案，且无需缓存全维度的键（Key），解决了MLA架构中引入QK归一化的兼容性问题。

title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
comment: Oral at the ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models
summary: Post-hoc context erasing over the KV cache is challenging because a local edit has a global consequence: once a span has been processed, its influence propagates into the cached states of all subsequent tokens. This issue arises naturally in long-context LLM applications, where stale retrieved facts, incorrect tool observations, retracted user preferences, or harmful prompt injections may be identified only after prefill. Exact erasing must then recompute all tokens after the deleted span, making its computational cost depend on suffix length rather than erased-span length. We introduce KVEraser, a learned KV-cache editing method for efficient localized context erasing. Given a processed context and a span to remove, KVEraser replaces only the KV states of the erased interval with learned steering states while reusing the remaining cache unchanged. To learn a transferable erasing mechanism, we build a two-stage training pipeline: generic span-neighbor pre-training teaches the eraser to suppress the influence of the erased span, while task-specific fine-tuning adapts this capability to downstream scenarios. Experiments show that KVEraser nearly matches full recomputation in post-erasure performance on in-domain tasks across 1K--32K context lengths, while its latency increases by only 24% compared with a 17.6x increase for full recomputation. KVEraser also generalizes to unseen long-document QA tasks with harmful factual distractors, achieving the best performance among approximate baselines with a 3--4x speedup over full recomputation.

AI.tldr: KVEraser 是一种针对长文本 LLM 高效 KV 缓存擦除的学习方法，通过替换受影响区间的 KV 状态而非重新计算整个序列，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算延时。
AI.motivation: 长文本 LLM 在处理事实修正（如过时引用、错误工具观测、撤销偏好、恶意提示注入等）时，由于 Transformer 的因果机制，已处理的 token 会影响后续所有状态，导致传统的“完全擦除”必须重计算整个后续序列，计算成本极高（与后缀长度呈正比）。
AI.method: 引入了一种基于学习的 KV 缓存编辑方法 KVEraser。该方法采用两阶段训练策略：首先通过“通用跨度邻域预训练”学习抑制已擦除跨度的影响，随后进行“任务特定微调”以适应下游场景。在推理时，仅将需擦除区间的 KV 状态替换为学习到的“引导状态（steering states）”，并复用其余缓存，无需对后续 tokens 进行全量重新计算。
AI.result: 在 1K-32K 上下文长度的实验中，KVEraser 的性能几乎与全量重计算持平，且延迟仅增加了 24%（全量重计算需增加 17.6 倍）。在长文档 QA 基准测试中，它在所有近似方法中表现最优，并实现了 3-4 倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: KVEraser 能够以极低的推理开销实现高效的 KV 缓存局部擦除，其性能接近全量重新计算，且具备良好的泛化能力，为解决长文本 LLM 中的动态上下文修正问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning for Fair and Energy-Efficient UAV-Assisted Wireless Networks
summary: The integration of generative artificial intelligence with wireless communication and signal processing systems has opened new avenues for intelligent, data-driven decision-making in future 6G networks. This work proposes a diffusion soft actor-critic (Diffusion-SAC) approach that leverages offline reinforcement learning (RL) enhanced by denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) to optimize trajectory and scheduling control in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks. While offline RL methods, such as conservative Q-learning (CQL), can learn from static datasets, they often struggle to generalize in low-data or dynamic conditions. To address this, we combine the robustness of CQL with the generative power of diffusion models, enabling expressive and signal-aware policy learning that generalizes beyond behavior policies. Applied to a UAV-assisted wireless network, the proposed framework minimizes transmission energy and improves fairness among devices. Simulations show that Diffusion-SAC outperforms standard offline RL baselines, achieving more stable convergence and higher rewards even with limited datasets. The method enhances data efficiency, reduces energy consumption, and increases throughput by more than 35 % compared to existing algorithms, demonstrating its potential for robust policy learning in next-generation wireless control systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的离线强化学习框架（Diffusion-SAC），用于优化无人机无线网络的轨迹与调度，显著提升了数据效率、能效及系统吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的离线强化学习方法（如CQL）在数据有限或动态变化的环境中泛化能力较差，难以有效应对6G网络中无人机通信系统的复杂优化需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）与保守Q学习（CQL）的“扩散软行动者-评论家”（Diffusion-SAC）离线强化学习框架，用于无人机的轨迹与调度优化。
AI.result: 与现有算法相比，Diffusion-SAC 在有限数据集下实现了更稳定的收敛，在降低能耗的同时，使系统吞吐量提升了超过 35%。
AI.conclusion: Diffusion-SAC 方法在无人机辅助无线网络中展现了卓越的性能，证明了扩散模型与离线强化学习结合在复杂无线控制系统策略学习中的有效性与稳健性。

title: Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often fail when answering requires identifying a small but decisive piece of evidence within a long or complex context, such as a single line in a tool trace or a subtle detail in an image. We propose ContextRL, a context-aware reinforcement learning (RL) method that improves long-horizon reasoning and multimodal performance through an \emph{indirect} auxiliary objective. Instead of supervising only the final answer, ContextRL presents the model with a query, an answer, and two highly similar contexts, and rewards it for selecting the context that supports the query--answer pair, thereby encouraging fine-grained grounding. We construct contrastive context data in two domains: for coding agents, trajectories serve as contexts, yielding 1k pairs built via condition filtering; for multimodal reasoning, images serve as contexts, yielding 7K pairs built via generative editing and similarity search. ContextRL achieves average gains of +2.2% over standard GRPO on 5 long-horizon benchmarks, and +1.8% across 12 diverse visual question answering benchmarks. To disentangle the effect of the proposed objective from that of additional data, we compare against data-augmentation baselines that repurpose the same contrastive contexts as standard query--context--answer examples. These baselines provide little to no improvement, showing that the gains arise from the proposed context-selection objective rather than from the contrastive data alone.

AI.tldr: ContextRL 通过引入“上下文选择”辅助任务，训练 LLM 在强化学习过程中强化对长序列/复杂图像中关键证据的细粒度识别，显著提升了推理准确度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长文本或复杂上下文中定位关键证据（如工具轨迹中的某一行或图片中的细微特征）的能力较弱。现有的监督方式往往只关注最终答案，忽略了对中间推理步骤中关键信息的“接地”（grounding）。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 ContextRL 的上下文感知强化学习方法。该方法引入了一个间接辅助目标：向模型提供查询、答案和两个高度相似的上下文，通过奖励模型选择正确支持该问答对的上下文，从而强化模型对关键信息的定位与推理能力（细粒度接地）。在编码（轨迹过滤）和多模态（图像编辑与相似性搜索）领域构建了对比语境数据集。
AI.result: ContextRL 在 5 个长序列基准测试上较标准 GRPO 平均提升 2.2%，在 12 个多模态问答基准测试上平均提升 1.8%。对照实验显示，直接将对比数据作为普通训练样本的效果远不及使用 ContextRL 的辅助目标，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ContextRL 提出的上下文选择辅助目标能够有效提升 LLMs 的细粒度推理能力，且该收益归功于训练范式的改变，而非简单的额外数据增强。

title: Communication-Efficient Verifiable Attention for LLM Inference
summary: Computation integrity of remote large language model (LLM) serving can be questionable. For conventional deep neural networks (DNNs), the existing TEE-shielded DNN partitioning (TSDP) approach uses Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) to compute non-linear components and verify the integrity of linear components offloaded to an untrusted GPU. However, directly applying TSDP to Transformer-based LLMs incurs significant TEE computation and TEE-GPU communication overhead. This paper presents Communication-efficient TEE-GPU Attention (\textsc{VeriAttn}) for accelerating verifiable LLM inference. \textsc{VeriAttn} offloads both linear and non-linear computations of attention to the GPU, while TEE performs verification. Moreover, for prefill, \textsc{VeriAttn} uses a two-level pipeline to overlap data movement, TEE pre-/post-processing, and GPU computation. For decoding, when the key-value cache exceeds available GPU memory, \textsc{VeriAttn} partitions attention across TEE and GPU to reduce repeated key-value transfers. Evaluation on an Intel TDX platform shows that \textsc{VeriAttn} achieves 2.60-3.38$\times$ and 3.86-5.42$\times$ acceleration over TSDP for 6k-token prompts and 10k-token outputs during prefill and decoding, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VeriAttn 框架，旨在解决远端 LLM 推理中的计算完整性验证问题。通过优化 TEE 与 GPU 的协同工作链路，引入流水线并行和注意力计算分区策略，在保证计算可验证性的前提下大幅降低了处理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的 TEE 保护的 DNN 分区（TSDP）方案在应用于 LLM 时，会导致过高的 TEE 计算开销以及 TEE 与 GPU 间的数据传输开销，难以满足高效推理需求。
AI.method: 1. 将注意力机制（Attention）的计算（包括线性和非线性）下放至 GPU 执行，TEE 仅负责验证；2. 针对预填充阶段（Prefill），设计了两级流水线以重叠数据传输、TEE 处理和 GPU 计算；3. 针对解码阶段（Decoding），当 KV Cache 超出显存时，采用 TEE 和 GPU 分布式协同注意力计算，以减少数据搬运。
AI.result: 在 Intel TDX 平台上，VeriAttn 在 6k token 提示和 10k token 输出场景下，预填充阶段相比 TSDP 提速 2.60-3.38 倍，解码阶段提速 3.86-5.42 倍。
AI.conclusion: VeriAttn 有效解决了在 TEE 环境下验证 Transformer 类大模型推理时的性能瓶颈，通过通信优化和流水线技术显著提升了计算验证的效率，使其在实际应用中具备可行性。

title: The Value Axis: Language Models Encode Whether They're on the Right Track
summary: We investigate whether language models internally track the value of their current trajectory, defined as the likelihood that their ongoing strategy will achieve their goals. Using synthetic, in-context reinforcement learning data, we construct a "value" axis for Qwen3-8B. We find that activations along this axis distinguish between high vs. low verbalized confidence, rollouts without and with backtracking, and correct vs. corrupted code. Steering towards high value causally suppresses self-correction and reduces explanatory verbosity, while steering towards low value induces backtracking and exploration. We demonstrate that direct preference optimization (DPO) can increase the internal value of rewarded behaviors (e.g. use a certain word), causing the model to act more confidently after exhibiting them. Finally, we apply the value axis to study in-the-wild settings. For example, we find that Qwen assigns low value to politically sensitive chat queries after post-training and that supervised fine-tuning increases internal confidence within the training domain. Our results suggest that language models linearly encode an estimate of expected goal success that modulates their confidence in pursuing a direction.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大模型内部存在线性编码的“目标执行价值”评估轴，通过操控该轴可因果性地改变模型的自信心、自我修正行为及探索倾向。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型是否在内部追踪其当前轨迹的“价值”，即当前执行策略实现目标的可能性，并验证这一内部评估是否会影响模型的决策行为。
AI.method:
1. 基于合成的上下文强化学习数据，构建了模型的“价值（Value）”激活轴；
2. 利用激活干预（Steering）技术改变该轴上的值，并观察模型行为（如自我修正、冗余度、探索行为）的变化；
3. 应用直接偏好优化（DPO）研究奖励机制对内部价值的影响；
4. 将该价值轴应用于真实场景（如敏感查询和监督微调）进行分析。
AI.result:
1. 识别出一条能够区分信心高低、是否回溯、代码正确与否的“价值”轴；
2. 调高该轴的值可抑制回溯，减少解释性赘述；调低该轴的值可诱发回溯与探索；
3. DPO能够提升被奖励行为的内部价值；
4. 真实场景中，该轴能反映模型经过后训练后对特定查询（如政治敏感问题）的低价值评估，以及监督微调带来的信心提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在内部线性编码了一个关于预期目标成功的评估值，该值作为一种内在机制调节模型在特定策略上的信心与行为方向。

title: Simulation-Augmented Multi-Step Split Conformal Prediction for Aggregated Forecasts
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 workshop: Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence
summary: We study uncertainty quantification for aggregated forecasting tasks such as annual totals and year-over-year growth rates. We propose SA-MSCP, a simulation-augmented multi-step split conformal method that generates future paths from cross-validated residuals using a block bootstrap and constructs prediction intervals from empirical quantiles. Experiments show that SA-MSCP improves empirical coverage over a simulated-path baseline for aggregated and growth-rate targets. Our results demonstrate that simulation-enhanced conformal calibration is an effective and general framework for uncertainty quantification in aggregated time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 针对聚合时间序列预测的不确定性量化问题，本文提出了 SA-MSCP 方法，通过仿真增强共形预测技术，有效提升了预测区间的覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有的不确定性量化方法在处理聚合预测任务（如年度总计和同比增长率）时，往往难以保持良好的经验覆盖率。
AI.method: 提出了 SA-MSCP（Simulation-Augmented Multi-Step Conformal Prediction）方法：结合了交叉验证残差、块引导（block bootstrap）来生成未来路径，并利用经验分位数构建预测区间。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与基准（ simulated-path baseline）相比，SA-MSCP 在聚合预测和增长率预测任务中显著提升了经验覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 仿真增强的共形校准（Simulation-enhanced conformal calibration）是一种有效且通用的框架，可用于提高聚合时间序列预测任务中不确定性量化的准确性。

title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
summary: Agentic search over large corpora relies on retriever-mediated interfaces (e.g., BM25 or ColBERT) for scalable candidate discovery. While effective at ranking relevant documents, these interfaces expose evidence only as ranked results or bounded document views, limiting agents' ability to reorganize material and verify constraints across documents. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) addresses this limitation by exposing shell-executable corpus operations for flexible search, filtering, comparison, and verification. However, full-corpus terminal commands become slow and unstable as the corpus grows, degrading performance and efficiency. We introduce DR-DCI, a retriever-steered DCI framework that treats retrieval as an agent-callable action for expanding a local workspace. Rather than operating directly over the full corpus, the agent dynamically pulls relevant documents into an evolving workspace and conducts DCI operations within it. This design combines retriever-level recall with DCI-style precision: retrieval keeps exploration scalable, while DCI preserves the local operations needed for effective evidence resolution. Experiments show that DR-DCI is both effective and efficient across scales. On Browsecomp-Plus, DR-DCI reaches 71.2\% accuracy, improving over raw DCI and ablated variants by up to 8.3 points while reducing tool usage, wall time, and estimated cost. With workspace-preserving context reset, accuracy further improves to 73.3\%. In corpus-scaling experiments, DR-DCI remains effective from 100K to 10M documents, whereas raw DCI becomes unstable and BM25 performs substantially worse. DR-DCI also scales to a 20M-scale file-per-document Wiki-18 QA setting, achieving an average score of 63.0 across six benchmarks and outperforming retrieval-based and trained search-agent baselines. Ablation analysis further shows that ranked previews and inter-document DCI are key to performance.

AI.tldr: DR-DCI通过“检索扩充本地工作空间+本地精确操作”的协作模式，解决了智能体在大规模语料库中进行高效、高精度信息检索与复杂推理的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于检索器的搜索接口（如BM25/ColBERT）虽利于发现候选文档，但限制了智能体对跨文档信息的组织和验证能力；而直接语料库交互（DCI）面临在大规模语料库下性能低下且不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 提出DR-DCI框架，将检索视为智能体可调用的“行动”，动态拉取相关文档至本地工作空间，并在该空间内执行DCI（如过滤、比较、验证）操作；引入工作空间保持上下文重置机制以提升性能。
AI.result: 在Browsecomp-Plus上达到71.2%（开启上下文重置后为73.3%）的准确率；在100K至10M级别的规模实验中表现优于raw DCI和基线模型；在20M规模的Wiki-18 QA任务中取得63.0的平均分。
AI.conclusion: DR-DCI通过将检索作为一种动态扩展工作空间的工具，成功结合了检索系统的可扩展性与直接语料库操作（DCI）的高精度，解决了大语料库下直接操作带来的性能和稳定性问题。

title: CacheMuon: Using Temporal Preconditioning To Approximate Polar Factor
summary: Muon is an optimizer that computes updates using the polar factor of the momentum matrix and has shown strong empirical performance across a range of training settings. A key component of Muon is the Newton-Schulz iteration used to compute this polar factor. Although this avoids the cost of an exact singular value decomposition, it remains expensive in practice because it is applied at every optimization step. At the same time, the momentum matrix changes smoothly over training, suggesting strong temporal correlation in the corresponding polar factors. In this paper, we exploit this structure and propose CacheMuon, a temporal preconditioning method that reuses information from previous optimization steps to approximate the polar factor at the current step. This reduces redundant orthogonalization computation across iterations. We analyze CacheMuon as an inexact Muon update, with error controlled by fresh-solver error and cache staleness. Empirically, CacheMuon provides a controllable quality-efficiency frontier: conservative thresholds closely match fresh Muon on language-model and vision training while reducing orthogonalization FLOPs, whereas more aggressive thresholds yield larger arithmetic savings at the cost of modest validation-quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 CacheMuon，通过缓存和重用 Muon 优化器在训练过程中的极分解计算结果，有效利用动量矩阵的时序相关性，显著降低了其计算开销，同时实现了良好的性能效率权衡。
AI.motivation: Muon 优化器虽然性能强劲，但每一步都需要通过 Newton-Schulz 迭代计算极分解，计算开销巨大。鉴于训练过程中动量矩阵变化平滑，存在高度的时序相关性，作者旨在通过复用历史信息来提高计算效率。
AI.method: 提出了 CacheMuon 算法，利用动量矩阵在训练过程中的时序相关性，通过缓存和重用之前的极分解结果来近似当前步的更新，减少了每步执行 Newton-Schulz 迭代带来的计算冗余。
AI.result: 实验表明，CacheMuon 提供了一个可控的质量-效率平衡点；保守策略下，其在语言模型和视觉模型训练中表现与原始 Muon 相当，且显著减少了正交化阶段的浮点运算（FLOPs）。
AI.conclusion: CacheMuon 是一种有效的时序预处理方法，通过复用历史动量矩阵的极分解信息，在保持训练质量的同时，显著降低了 Muon 优化器中极分解计算的计算开销。

title: Risk-Aware LLM Agents for Geospatial Data Retrieval: Design and Preliminary Adversarial Evaluation
comment: Accepted for publication in the International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences (ISPRS Archives), ISPRS Congress 2026
summary: We present an LLM-driven framework for retrieving remote sensing data from cloud-based geospatial catalogues using natural language queries. The system converts user intent into structured API calls, enabling efficient access to satellite imagery and environmental datasets. The architecture integrates three agents: Guardrail for safety and policy enforcement, General-QA for intent interpretation, and Recommender-Analyst for schema-aware API call generation. This coordinated design ensures reliable, semantically aligned interaction with external data services. The modular framework is portable across platforms through API schema substitution and supports applications in environmental monitoring, disaster response, and climate analysis. It establishes a scalable interface between user intent and geospatial infrastructure, enabling streamlined and automated Earth observation workflows. Preliminary experiments under adversarial multi-turn settings show that prompt-level safety instructions improve robustness, although rare high-impact failures persist in API manipulation scenarios and highlight the need for adaptive, system-level defenses that balance safety, usability, and cost efficiency, which motivates the use of our intercept-level Guardrail agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个LLM驱动的多智能体框架，利用自然语言查询自动检索云端地理空间数据，并通过内置的Guardrail、General-QA及Recommender-Analyst智能体实现了高效、安全、可移植的自动化地理监测与分析工作流。
AI.motivation: 地理空间数据检索通常需要专业的查询语言或API知识，这限制了数据的使用效率。本文旨在通过LLM将自然语言查询转化为结构化的API调用，从而简化对云端地理空间数据的访问，并解决在自动化工作流中的安全与交互可靠性问题。
