AI.method: 提出一个模块化的多智能体LLM框架，包含三个核心组件：Guardrail（安全与策略执行）、General-QA（意图理解与解释）以及Recommender-Analyst（基于模式感知的API调用生成）。该架构通过API模式替换实现跨平台的可移植性。
AI.result: 实现了从自然语言查询到结构化API调用的高效转换。实验表明，引入提示词层级的安全指令能显著提高系统的鲁棒性，而通过拦截级（intercept-level）的Guardrail智能体，能够有效处理复杂的对抗性多轮交互场景。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为非专家用户访问地理空间数据提供了一个可扩展的接口，证明了基于LLM的多智能体协作系统在复杂API交互中的潜力。尽管目前仍存在API操控方面的罕见失效，但通过引入拦截级安全防护机制，可以在安全性、可用性与成本之间达到较好的平衡。

title: CODA-BENCH: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 37 pages, 11 figures. Project page: https://coda-bench.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/CoDA-Bench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RUC-DataLab/CoDA-Bench
summary: Advanced agents are increasingly demonstrating the potential to operate as autonomous engineers, creating a growing demand for evaluation benchmarks that capture the complexity of real-world development. Such environments typically involve both complex code and large-scale data (i.e., file system). However, existing benchmarks usually evaluate code-centric or data-centric capabilities in isolation, leaving a clear gap with real development scenarios. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing CODA-BENCH, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate code and data intelligence in a data-intensive environment. We construct a data-intensive Linux sandbox based on the Kaggle ecosystem (containing hundreds of datasets), where agents must actively explore complex file hierarchies to identify relevant resources and generate code for data-driven analytical tasks. CODA-BENCH comprises 1,009 tasks spanning 31 communities, with each task environment containing an average of 980 files, simulating realistic data scale and noise. Evaluations of advanced agents reveal that even top-performing systems struggle to effectively integrate data discovery with code execution, achieving a success rate of only 61.1%. These results highlight a substantial gap in current agentic capabilities for data-intensive tasks and point to promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: CODA-BENCH是首个评估智能体在数据密集型开发环境下“代码+数据”综合能力的基准测试，揭示了目前主流智能体在复杂真实开发任务中的能力局限。
AI.motivation: 现有测试基准通常将代码能力与数据处理能力割裂评估，难以反映真实开发场景中“大规模数据管理”与“逻辑代码编写”协同的需求。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于Kaggle生态系统的Linux沙箱环境，包含31个社区及1,009个任务，要求智能体在数千个文件中探索并进行数据驱动的代码生成。
AI.result: 顶尖智能体在CODA-BENCH上的任务成功率仅为61.1%，证明了其在处理复杂文件系统、从噪声数据中提取资源并执行分析任务时仍面临严峻挑战。
AI.conclusion: 现有的智能体在处理数据密集型任务时能力不足，尤其在“数据发现”与“代码执行”的深度集成上存在明显短板，该基准测试为评估未来智能体开发提供了新的衡量标准。

title: Mixtures of Subspaces for Bandwidth Efficient Context Parallel Training
summary: Pretraining language models with extended context windows enhances their ability to leverage rich information during generation. Existing methods split input sequences into chunks, broadcast them across multiple devices, and compute attention block by block which incurs significant communication overhead. While feasible in high-speed clusters, these methods are impractical for decentralized training over low-bandwidth connections. We propose a compression method for communication-efficient context parallelism in decentralized settings, achieving a remarkable compression rate of over 95\% with negligible overhead and no loss in convergence. Our key insight is to exploit the intrinsic low-rank structure of activation outputs by dynamically constraining them to learned mixtures of subspaces via efficient reparameterizations. We demonstrate scaling billion-parameter decentralized models to context lengths exceeding 100K tokens on networks as slow as 300Mbps, matching the wall-clock convergence speed of centralized models on 100Gbps interconnects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种旨在去中心化环境下实现长上下文训练的压缩并行技术，通过利用激活值的低秩结构进行重参数化，在低带宽约束下实现了高效的上下文扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有的针对长上下文窗口的并行方法（如分块并行）在计算时会产生严重的通信开销，极度依赖高速集群互联，导致其难以在低带宽的去中心化训练场景中应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于压缩的通信高效上下文并行方法。核心在于利用激活输出的内在低秩结构，通过有效的重参数化技术，将激活值动态限制在学习到的子空间混合中，从而实现超过95%的压缩率。
AI.result: 在压缩率超过95%的同时，几乎没有引入额外开销，且模型收敛性能无损失。成功将十亿参数规模的模型在300Mbps带宽下扩展至100K上下文长度，收敛速度匹配100Gbps互联的中心化模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态限制激活输出至学习到的子空间混合，实现了去中心化环境下的高效上下文并行。该方法证明了在低带宽（300Mbps）网络下仍能实现超长上下文（100K+ token）的大模型训练，且性能与高速集群环境相当。

title: Robust Neural Tucker Factorization with Bias Correction and Adaptive Initialization
summary: High-dimensional incomplete (HDI) tensors are widely used in traffic and climate applications, but sparse observations make accurate completion difficult. The intrinsic non-linear dynamics and non-stationary variations across distinct multi-modal fields severely hinder the efficacy of conventional linear reconstruction frameworks. Neural Tucker factorization provides an effective framework for modeling high-order interactions among tensor modes. By parameterizing underlying structural characteristics into continuous latent spaces, neural representations circumvent the rigid low-rank constraints of classical algebra. However, its performance can still be affected by implementation-level choices, especially parameter initialization and the bias configuration of the final output mapping. Suboptimal initializations frequently lead to variance explosion across the cubically expanded interaction spaces, driving the subsequent non-linear activation boundaries into severe gradient saturation zones, while the omission of a dedicated translation parameter forces interaction weights to implicitly absorb global statistical deviations. This paper proposes a simple yet effective neural Tucker factorization model with Kaiming initialization and bias correction (KaBiN) for HDI tensor completion. The proposed model utilizes Kaiming uniform initialization for the embedding and Tucker linear parameters, and adopts a simple bias correction in output mapping. By elegantly decoupling global mean shifts from local structural representations, the framework provides a highly stable and well-conditioned optimization landscape. Experiments on three real-world HDI tensor datasets show that KaBiN achieves better performance than the original NeuTucF, while introducing minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对高维不完整张量补全，本文提出了 KaBiN 模型，通过 Kaiming 指导的初始化与输出偏置校正，解决了神经 Tucker 分解中的梯度饱和与偏差吸收问题，实现了更稳定且高效的优化。
AI.motivation: 现有神经 Tucker 分解方法在处理高维不完整（HDI）张量时，常因参数初始化不当（导致梯度饱和）和输出映射缺乏偏置配置（导致权重被迫吸收全局偏差）而导致性能受限，难以有效捕捉复杂的非线性动态。
AI.method: 提出 KaBiN 模型，具体包括：1. 采用 Kaiming 均匀初始化来处理嵌入层和 Tucker 线性参数；2. 在输出映射中引入偏置校正项，以解耦全局均值偏移与局部结构表示。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界的 HDI 张量数据集上的实验表明，KaBiN 在补全精度上优于原始的 NeuTucF 模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种简单且有效的 KaBiN 模型，通过 Kaiming 初始化和偏置校正技术，显著改善了神经 Tucker 分解在 HDI 张量补全任务中的训练稳定性和预测性能，且计算开销极小。

title: Agentic Retrieval and Reinforcement Learned Equation Chains: A Controlled Generation Framework for Complex and Novel Physics Word Problems
summary: Generating high-quality Physics Word Problems (PWPs) that are novel, complex, and solvable remains a challenging and underexplored problem in educational content generation. Existing approaches, many adapted from Math Word Problem (MWP) generation, often produce ambiguous, unsolvable, or structurally simple questions with limited linguistic diversity. We introduce ARVRE (Agentic Retrieval Value Reinforced Equation-chain), a two-stage framework for generating diverse and mathematically valid PWPs. In the first stage, a form of offline temporal-difference learning is used to construct valid chains of physics equations, while an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework dynamically selects topic-specific concepts and vocabulary. This design enables explicit control over problem structure and difficulty. In the second stage, a Large Language Model (LLM) converts the equation chain and retrieved concepts into a natural-language physics question. By grounding generation in valid equation chains, our method preserves mathematical correctness while promoting linguistic diversity and contextual richness. Human and automated evaluations demonstrate that ARVRE generates PWPs that are more complex, novel, and solvable than those produced by existing approaches. These results highlight the potential of combining reinforcement learning, retrieval, and LLMs for reliable generation of educational physics content.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了ARVRE框架，通过将物理方程链逻辑推理（强化学习）与知识检索（代理型RAG）相结合，成功实现了高质量、复杂且数学严谨的物理应用题自动化生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的数学应用题（MWP）生成方法在应用于物理题时，常出现题目歧义、不可解、结构简单及语言匮乏等问题，难以满足生成高质量、创新且复杂物理题的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一套名为ARVRE的两阶段框架：第一阶段利用离线时序差分学习（TD learning）构建逻辑严密的物理方程链，并结合代理型RAG动态选择主题概念与词汇；第二阶段利用LLM将方程链和概念转化为自然的物理叙述题。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，相比现有方法，ARVRE生成的物理应用题在数学复杂度、创新性以及可解性方面表现更优，显著提升了教育内容的质量与语境丰富度。
AI.conclusion: ARVRE证明了结合强化学习、检索增强生成（RAG）和大型语言模型（LLM）的框架，能够有效克服传统物理应用题生成（PWP）在逻辑复杂性、数学准确性和语言多样性方面的局限，为构建可靠的自动化教育内容提供了一种可行方案。

title: MUNI: Multimodal Unified Latent Diffusion for Coherent Any-to-Any Generation
summary: We introduce MUNI, an end-to-end multimodal latent diffusion framework for any-to-any generation that unifies subset-conditioned cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling through a shared stochastic latent. Existing multimodal generative models are largely LLM-based, which limits leveraging modality-specific generators and requires text-paired data for training. Recent diffusion- and flow-based any-to-any extensions take a different direction but still rely on text-aligned embeddings, fully-paired training, or matched-dimensionality deterministic mappings. MUNI rests on two complementary contributions, one architectural and one in the training objective. First, we extend latent diffusion to multimodal any-to-any generation end-to-end: instead of the standard two-stage recipe that precomputes a frozen latent space and then fits a prior over it, MUNI jointly trains modality-specific encoders, expressive decoders, and a single shared flow-based prior under one objective. Second, we identify that the standard aggregation rules of multimodal variational inference are insufficient once coupled with a learned prior and expressive decoders. A suitable shared latent must simultaneously satisfy coherence across generated modalities, predictive sufficiency of subset latents, and minimality of the latent content. We propose a routed training objective whose structural choices align the latent with these criteria and admit a minimal-sufficiency characterization in the realizable setting. Experiments on PolyMNIST-Quadrant-Labels and a large-scale image-text-audio benchmark show MUNI matching or exceeding the strongest baselines on conditional generation while opening its largest margins on unconditional coherence. Project page: https://muni-proj.github.io/.

AI.tldr: MUNI 是一个端到端的多模态扩散生成框架，通过共享流式潜在空间和创新的路由训练目标，统一了条件与无条件生成，在保持跨模态一致性的同时提升了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态生成模型多依赖大语言模型（LLM）或严格的文本对齐，且通常需要预先计算固定的潜在空间，限制了模型对特定模态生成能力的发挥及数据使用的灵活性。研究旨在解决如何构建一个无需强依赖文本对齐、且能有效统一各类模态生成的生成框架。
AI.method: 1. 架构创新：采用端到端架构，联合训练模态专用编码器、表达力强的解码器以及单一共享流式先验，摒弃了传统的多阶段预训练方案。2. 路由训练目标（Routed Training Objective）：提出一种新的聚类映射目标，确保共享潜在空间满足跨模态一致性、子集潜在变量的预测充分性以及潜在内容的最小化表示（Minimal-sufficiency）。
AI.result: 在 PolyMNIST-Quadrant-Labels 及大规模图-文-音基准测试中，MUNI 在条件生成任务上与顶尖模型持平或更优，并在无条件生成的一致性表现上展现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: MUNI 成功实现了端到端的任意多模态生成，通过共享流式先验和路由训练目标，在保证跨模态一致性的同时，不仅在条件生成任务上达到或超过现有最强基准，且在无条件生成的一致性方面表现显著。

title: Not all Jensen-Shannon Divergence Estimators are Equal
summary: The Jensen-Shannon divergence is widely reported as a scalar measure of fidelity for synthetic tabular data. Yet, in practice, it is estimated from finite samples using protocols that are often underspecified. This creates a measurement problem. Although the population divergence is well defined, the empirical value depends on the estimator family, sampling protocol, calibration, dimensionality, and class balance. We show that different protocols can yield non-comparable values: marginal-based estimators ignore dependencies in the joint distribution and can severely underestimate divergence, while classifier-based estimators capture joint structure but exhibit strong estimator dependence. We systematically study this behavior across controlled settings with reference divergences and real-world synthetic tabular benchmarks. Our analysis reveals dependence blindness in marginal estimators, prior-shift bias under class imbalance, and estimator sensitivity in high dimensions. To address prior shift, we derive a closed-form posterior correction for classifier-based Jensen-Shannon estimation. Our results show that empirical Jensen-Shannon divergence values are inherently protocol-dependent, making explicit specification of the estimation procedure necessary for meaningful comparison. We provide practical guidelines and an open-source tool for estimator-aware Jensen-Shannon evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了合成表数据评估中JS散度估计协议的不统一性，指出不同估计方法会导致结果不可比。研究量化了现有方法的偏差缺陷，提出了一种针对分类器估计器的修正方案，并强调了评估协议透明化的必要性。
AI.motivation: JS散度常被用作评估合成表数据保真度的指标，但目前缺乏统一的估计协议。现有的估计方法存在定义模糊、维度敏感、忽视联合分布依赖性及受类别分布影响等问题，导致不同研究间的评估结果不可比。
AI.method: 系统性地对比分析了不同JS散度估计协议（基于边际分布 vs. 基于分类器），探究了其在不同采样协议、维度和类别平衡下的表现；推导了一种针对分类器估计中标签偏移（prior shift）问题的闭式后验修正方法。
AI.result: 实验表明边际估计器会忽视联合分布中的依赖关系导致严重低估；分类器估计器在类别不平衡时存在先验偏移偏差，且在高维数据下敏感度高。提出的修正方案能有效缓解先验偏移问题。
AI.conclusion: 经验性的JS散度值具有本质上的协议依赖性；为了使数值具有可比性，必须明确指定评估协议。研究提供了实用的评估指南及开源工具，以实现感知评估器（estimator-aware）的基准测试。

title: Taylor-Calibrate: Principled Initialization for Hybrid Linear Attention Distillation
summary: Hybrid linear attention models offer an appealing path to faster long-context inference: they reduce the quadratic cost and KV-cache burden of full softmax attention while retaining much of the quality of Transformer models. A practical way to obtain such models is to convert a pretrained Transformer instead of pretraining a new architecture from scratch, but this conversion is still brittle. Simply copying the teacher attention projections into a Gated DeltaNet (GDN) student does not specify the new recurrent decay, write, and output-gating dynamics. As a result, the converted model often starts in a poor dynamical regime and must spend many distillation tokens repairing initialization rather than learning the remaining teacher behavior. We propose Taylor-Calibrate, a lightweight initialization method for hybrid GDN students. The method uses Taylor-guided teacher attention statistics to set the value projection, memory timescale, write gates, and output gate, then applies a short per-layer alignment step to match each converted layer to the teacher output. Across four teacher settings and three retained-layer policies, Taylor-Calibrate gives substantially stronger zero-shot students, with up to an 88x improvement in a representative ablation, and reaches matched recovery targets with 4.9x--9.2x fewer training tokens than naive conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 Taylor-Calibrate 的方法，通过 Taylor 展开辅助的统计初始化与逐层对齐，解决了将预训练 Transformer 转换为混合线性注意力模型（GDN）时初始化不佳的问题，显著降低了后续蒸馏训练的成本并提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 直接将预训练 Transformer 转换为高性能的混合线性注意力模型（如 GDN）时，初始化阶段往往处于较差的动态区间，导致后续蒸馏过程中浪费大量 Token 用于修复初始化错误。
AI.method: 提出 Taylor-Calibrate 初始化算法：利用 Taylor 展开指导的注意力统计数据，对 GDN 的值映射（value projection）、记忆时间尺度（memory timescale）、写入门（write gates）和输出门（output gate）进行初始化，并辅以短时间的逐层对齐步骤。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置下，Taylor-Calibrate 相比传统转换方法，零样本性能显著提升（最高达 88 倍），且达成相同指标所需的训练 Token 减少了 4.9 倍至 9.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: Taylor-Calibrate 是一种高效的初始化方法，能显著提升从 Transformer 到 GDN 的转换效率，缩短知识蒸馏阶段所需的训练步数，并使学生模型获得更好的初始性能。

title: Do LLMs Reliably Identify Correct Information Units in Aphasic Discourse?
summary: Correct Information Units (CIUs) are central to discourse assessment in aphasia because they quantify communicative informativeness rather than linguistic form alone. However, CIU scoring is time intensive and requires trained raters. This study examined whether instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) can reliably perform token-level CIU classification from aphasic discourse transcripts. Sixteen picture-description transcripts elicited with the Cat Rescue stimulus were annotated for CIU status according to Nicholas and Brookshire (1993). The sample spanned four severity strata: control, mild, moderate, and severe aphasia. Four publicly available instruction-tuned LLMs were benchmarked under zero-shot and two few-shot prompting conditions across five stratified random seeds. Performance was evaluated against consensus human labels using accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and Cohen's kappa. Zero-shot prompting was insufficient across models. In contrast, few-shot prompting yielded substantial gains and produced competitive performance for three viable models. Mean few-shot F1 scores ranged from 0.776 to 0.817 across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B, with no significant differences between fixed global and per-chunk local example selection. Phi-3-mini was unstable and did not yield reliable performance. Viable models showed high recall but lower precision, suggesting systematic over-classification of tokens as CIUs. Performance also varied by discourse severity, with the weakest results in more severe aphasia. Few-shot LLM prompting can support automated CIU identification without gradient-based task training, but agreement with human annotation remains insufficient for fully autonomous use. These findings support LLM-based CIU scoring as a promising human-in-the-loop component of discourse assessment systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了利用少样本提示词的大语言模型进行失语症CIU自动识别的有效性，虽然尚未达到完全自主评估的水平，但展示了作为临床辅助评分工具的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 失语症话语分析中“正确信息单元”（CIU）评分过程耗时且依赖人工，旨在探讨指令微调大语言模型（LLM）实现CIU自动化标注的可行性。
AI.method: 利用四种指令微调LLM（Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Phi-3-mini）对16份失语症患者描述语篇进行零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shot）实验，对比多种提示词策略，并采用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数及Cohen's kappa进行评估。
AI.result: 零样本学习表现较差；少样本学习效果显著（F1分数约0.776-0.817），模型表现出高召回率但低精确率（倾向于过分类），且在严重失语症样本中准确度下降。
AI.conclusion: 少样本提示词工程（Few-shot prompting）下的LLM在CIU识别任务中表现出潜力，可作为临床“人在回路”（human-in-the-loop）辅助工具，但目前尚不足以完全替代人工进行自动化评估。

title: Autonomous End-to-End SOH Prediction Services for Battery Systems via Temporal-Contrastive Representation Learning
summary: Accurate state of health (SOH) estimation is a critical diagnostic service for lithium-ion battery management. However, reliance on labor-intensive manual feature engineering and opaque black-box models hinders scalable industrial deployment. To address this, we introduce TC-SOH: a modular, plug-and-play service architecture for autonomous, end-to-end SOH prediction. TC-SOH employs a temporal-contrastive mechanism and a cross-window prediction pretext task to extract degradation-relevant representations directly from raw operational data. To improve transparency, we connect model efficacy with representation diagnostics: visualization, sensitivity analysis, redundancy analysis, bidirectional probing, future-SOH probing, and temporal shuffling show that learned features overlap with selected expert descriptors while retaining additional SOH-relevant variation, and that ordered temporal context improves subsequent-SOH prediction. Across four public datasets, TC-SOH outperforms the considered physics-informed and data-driven baselines, reducing MAPE by 1.91 times and RMSE by 2.13 times.

AI.tldr: TC-SOH是一个自动化的端到端SOH预测架构，通过时间对比学习从原始数据中提取特征，在保持高预测精度的同时，通过多种诊断技术解决了黑盒模型的可解释性难题。
AI.motivation: 传统的SOH估计依赖于人工特征工程，且黑盒模型缺乏透明度，难以满足大规模工业部署的需求。
AI.method: 提出TC-SOH架构，利用时间对比（temporal-contrastive）机制和跨窗口预测（cross-window prediction）预训练任务，直接从原始操作数据中提取退化特征；同时通过可视化、敏感性分析、冗余分析、双向探针等多种诊断方法来提升模型的可解释性。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上，TC-SOH的MAPE指标提升了1.91倍，RMSE指标提升了2.13倍。
AI.conclusion: TC-SOH提供了一种高效、透明且可解释的电池SOH预测方案，其性能超越了现有的物理信息模型和数据驱动基线，证明了自动特征表示学习在复杂工业环境中的有效性。

title: SDS-LoRA: Overcoming Anisotropic Gradient Scaling in Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient adaptation of large pre-trained models to downstream tasks by parameterizing weight updates with low-rank matrices. In this paper, we investigate the limitations of the LoRA parameterization from a geometric perspective. Specifically, we show that when a full fine-tuning gradient is backpropagated to the low-rank matrices, it undergoes anisotropic scaling driven by their singular values. We argue that this phenomenon is undesirable because it distorts the full fine-tuning gradient by skewing it toward dominant singular directions while suppressing others. Our analyses demonstrate that anisotropic gradient scaling reduces the effective rank of the low-rank matrices' gradients and results in suboptimal alignment between the full fine-tuning gradient and its low-rank approximation in LoRA, thereby exacerbating the gap to full fine-tuning. To address these limitations, we propose a new low-rank parameterization, SDS-LoRA, which structurally decouples singular values from the backward pass. Our method ensures that the full fine-tuning gradient backpropagates only through the orthonormal bases of the low-rank matrices' subspaces, independent of their scales. Convergence analysis demonstrates that while LoRA's convergence rate degrades with the condition number of the low-rank matrices, SDS-LoRA remains independent of it. Experimental results across natural language and vision benchmarks show that SDS-LoRA improves loss convergence and reduces the gap to full fine-tuning, significantly enhancing adaptation performance.

AI.tldr: 针对LoRA存在的各向异性梯度缩放带来的精度损失问题，本文提出了SDS-LoRA方法，通过将奇异值从反向传播中解耦，实现了更优的梯度流和更接近全参数微调的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统LoRA在反向传播时存在各向异性梯度缩放（anisotropic scaling）问题，导致梯度被严重偏向主奇异方向，抑制了其他方向的学习，降低了梯度有效秩，限制了其逼近全参数微调的能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为SDS-LoRA的低秩参数化方法。该方法在反向传播过程中将奇异值与低秩矩阵的基向量结构性解耦，确保梯度仅通过正交基传播，从而使梯度更新不受奇异值大小的影响。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，SDS-LoRA的收敛速度不受低秩矩阵条件数的影响。实验结果证明，在自然语言处理和计算机视觉任务中，SDS-LoRA比LoRA具有更快的损失收敛速度，并显著提升了适配性能。
AI.conclusion: SDS-LoRA通过解耦奇异值与反向传播，消除了传统LoRA中存在的各向异性梯度缩放问题，在保持参数高效性的同时，显著缩小了低秩适配与全参数微调之间的性能差距。

title: SPRI: SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization for Data-Constrained MoE Upcycling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling, but training them from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. MoE upcycling mitigates this cost by converting pretrained dense models into sparse MoE models. However, existing upcycling methods typically rely on large-scale continued training and often perform poorly under data-constrained supervised adaptation, due to either homogeneous experts or overly disruptive perturbations to pretrained parameters. In this setting, effective upcycling must leverage pretrained weight structure while introducing sufficient diversity among routed experts. To this end, we propose SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization (SPRI), which distributes SVD-partitioned residuals derived from pretrained feed-forward network (FFN) weights across routed experts, introducing controlled expert diversity grounded in pretrained spectral structure. We further introduce a two-stage training strategy to improve adaptation stability. We evaluate SPRI on multilingual speech-to-text translation, where limited supervised data challenges MoE upcycling and multiple target languages provide natural routing heterogeneity. On CoVoST2 across 15 En-to-XX directions, SPRI improves average BLEU and COMET over fully fine-tuned dense models by 2.58 and 3.32 points, respectively, and outperforms the prior best MoE upcycling baseline by 3.39 BLEU and 4.34 COMET points.

AI.tldr: 为解决数据受限下 MoE 模型升频效果不佳的问题，论文提出了基于 SVD 谱结构初始化专家的 SPRI 方法，在保持预训练结构的同时有效增强了专家多样性，显著提升了模型在多语言翻译任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型从头训练成本极高，现有的升频方法在数据受限的监督微调场景下，存在专家同质化严重或对预训练参数扰动过大的问题，难以有效利用预训练权重结构。
AI.method: 提出 SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization (SPRI) 方法，将预训练 FFN 权重的 SVD 分解残差分配给不同专家以引入受控的多样性；并配合两阶段训练策略以增强适应稳定性。
AI.result: 在 CoVoST2 多语言语音翻译数据集上，SPRI 相比全微调密集模型，BLEU 指标提升 2.58，COMET 提升 3.32；相比现有最优 MoE 升频基线，BLEU 和 COMET 分别提升 3.39 和 4.34 点。
AI.conclusion: SPRI 通过利用预训练 FFN 权重的谱结构实现专家多样化，有效解决了数据受限场景下 MoE 升频（Upcycling）性能不佳的问题，在多语言语音翻译任务上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Privacy from Symmetry: Orthogonally Equivariant Transformers for LLM Inference
summary: Running large language models locally is often impractical, pushing inference on sensitive text to third-party providers. Split inference partially mitigates this by keeping tokens on the client and sending only hidden representations, but these representations can still be recovered via nearest-neighbor search against the public embedding table. We propose an orthogonal obfuscation procedure in which the client multiplies embeddings by a secret orthogonal matrix before transmission. To enable correct inference under arbitrary rotations, we introduce ConjFormer, a transformer variant that is exactly $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariant via a lightweight normalization change (scalar RMSNorm) together with blockwise orthogonal conjugation of all linear weights. As a result, the server performs the full forward pass entirely in the rotated basis and never observes unrotated hidden states. Experiments on GPT-2 and Llama 3.2 1B models fine-tuned on PubMed show that orthogonal obfuscation eliminates direct cosine nearest-neighbor inversion and reduces token recovery from over 35% top-10 to at most 1.3%, while increasing perplexity by only 0.4% after fine-tuning. These results indicate that enforcing symmetry at the architectural level can provide a practical defense for privacy-preserving LLM inference without noise injection or heavy cryptographic machinery.

AI.tldr: 提出一种ConjFormer架构，通过正交变换保护LLM推理中的中间隐藏表示，在几乎不损失模型性能的前提下，有效防止通过隐藏状态反推输入Token的隐私攻击。
AI.motivation: 本地运行大型语言模型（LLM）资源消耗大，而使用第三方算力会导致敏感文本泄露；现有的“拆分推理”方法发送隐藏表示存在被通过最近邻搜索反推出原始Token的隐私风险。
AI.method: 1. 提出一种正交混淆（Orthogonal Obfuscation）过程，客户端发送前对嵌入进行随机正交矩阵变换；2. 设计ConjFormer架构，通过调整RMSNorm并对线性权重进行块状正交共轭处理，使其在任意正交变换下保持等变性（Equivariant）。
AI.result: 在PubMed数据集微调的GPT-2和Llama 3.2 1B模型上实验表明，该方法消除了直接的余弦相似度最近邻反演，且将Token恢复率从35%以上降至1.3%以下，同时困惑度（Perplexity）仅增加0.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在架构层面强制引入正交等变性（Equivariance），能够以极小的性能损失为LLM推理提供有效的隐私保护，无需依赖噪声注入或繁重的加密技术。

title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders
summary: Cross-subject EEG decoding promises more training data, but it also exposes neural networks to strong inter-subject distribution shifts. We study whether task supervision and architecture alone can learn subject-aligned representations. We replace a shared EEG encoder with subject-specific encoders followed by a common classifier, and compare this hybrid model with standard EEGNet, AttentionBaseNet, and CTNet baselines with Euclidean Alignment (EA) on four motor-imagery datasets. EA improves shared encoders by recentering subject covariances, but the hybrid encoder largely internalises this role: validation-loss curves and latent-distance analyses change little when EA is removed. Subject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold, improving most subjects while leaving a method-sensitive subset. These results support subject-specific encoders as a learned alignment mechanism for EEG decoding and identify head selection for unseen subjects as the remaining bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了通过主体特定编码器来缓解EEG解码中的主体间分布偏移，证明了该方法不仅能有效实现特征对齐，还能在无需手动预处理的情况下显著提升分类准确性。
AI.motivation: 跨主体脑电（EEG）解码虽然增加了训练数据，但存在严重的“主体间分布差异”。研究旨在探究仅靠监督信号和特定网络架构是否足以学习到主体对齐的潜在表示，从而减少对传统预处理手段（如EA）的依赖。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合“主体特定编码器 + 共享分类器”的混合模型架构，并将其与标准的EEGNet、AttentionBaseNet、CTNet（结合EA）进行对比；通过验证损失曲线和潜在空间距离分析，评估了该模型在处理主体间分布偏移时的表现。
AI.result: 混合模型在四个运动想象数据集上的表现优于或持平于具备EA的基线模型；实验发现EA对于混合模型几乎没有额外增益（表明编码器已内部化了对齐逻辑）；主体特定分类头显著提升了类别的区分度，并将不同主体映射到了其各自的潜在流形上。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，使用主体特定（subject-specific）编码器是一种有效的自动学习对齐机制。虽然基于欧几里得对齐（EA）的共享编码器能改善性能，但混合模型通过将预处理功能内部化，实现了类似的效果，且性能往往更优。未来研究的核心瓶颈在于如何为未见主体（unseen subjects）选择最佳的分类头。

title: Rhythm of the Deep: A Computational-Linguistic Test of Duality of Patterning in Sperm Whale Codas
summary: Human language has often been described as combining structure at two levels: lower-level units combine into larger units, which then combine into larger sequences. We test for this design feature, duality of patterning, in sperm whale codas using 1,483 codas from the Dominica Sperm Whale Project. Because acoustic similarity can imitate symbolic structure, we treat the problem as computational-linguistic structure discovery from continuous audio rather than as a direct claim about language or meaning. We use a consensus of frozen audio encoders, held-out structural tests, per-statistic nulls, and acoustic-null recoverability gates. The evidence supports a narrow two-tier architecture. At the lower tier, clicks compose into codas not by a stable ordered rule, but by which clicks are present together with their inter-click rhythm. At the upper tier, coda tokens show bout-level sequential dependence, with an NSB second-order transfer-entropy lift of 0.132 bits (p = 0.002). Under tempo scaling, encoder-derived click identity is strongly rate-bound, while coda identity remains substantially more stable, yielding a measurable abstraction gradient across the click-to-coda step. Rhythm-only baselines recover substantial lower-tier structure but fail to reproduce the upper-tier sequential-dependence signal. We do not claim language, semantics, perception, or human-like phonemes. Instead, we report representation-level evidence for a duality-of-patterning-like architecture whose lower tier is rhythmic rather than segmental, and provide a portable null-controlled framework for testing combinatorial structure in induced acoustic token systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对抹香鲸呜音的计算分析，发现其具备类似人类语言的“双重模式”架构，即由节奏定义的低层组合与具备序贯依赖的高层结构。研究强调这是计算层面的结构特征，而非对语言、语义或人类式音素的定义。
AI.motivation: 探索抹香鲸的呜音是否具备人类语言的“双重模式”特征（即低级单位组合成高级单位，再组合成序列），以验证非人类交流系统中是否存在组合式架构。
AI.method: 利用1,483条抹香鲸呜音数据，采用冷冻音频编码器（frozen audio encoders）、留出法结构测试、基于置换的统计显著性检验（per-statistic nulls）以及声学空值可恢复性门控（acoustic-null recoverability gates）进行计算语言学结构发现。
AI.result: 1. 下层结构由点击声（clicks）与其节律共同决定，而非简单的有序规则；2. 上层结构（codas）显示出显著的二阶序贯依赖（转移熵提升0.132比特，p=0.002）；3. 存在跨尺度的抽象梯度，节奏基准无法完全解释上层序列依赖。
AI.conclusion: 抹香鲸的呜音（codas）证明了一种类“双重模式（duality of patterning）”的两层架构。下层是基于节奏的组合，而上层则表现出序列依赖性。该研究证实了在非人类生物声学系统中存在组合式结构，并提供了一套严谨的计算分析框架。

title: BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models
summary: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.

AI.tldr: 针对传统 MBRL 模型中环境与智能体动力学耦合导致无法复用的问题，提出 BRICKS-WM 框架，通过在隐式动力学中进行功能化解耦，实现了背景动力学在不同智能体间的重用，同时保持了良好的控制性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的主流模型基强化学习（MBRL）大多依赖整体式（monolithic）隐式动力学模型，导致环境与智能体动力学高度耦合。这种耦合使得当智能体发生变化时，即便环境不变也必须从头训练整个世界模型，缺乏可重用性。
AI.method: 提出 BRICKS-WM 框架，将隐空间解耦为“智能体（Agent）”和“背景（Background）”两个模块，并通过一个学习到的隐式接口（latent interface）进行交互。该方法的核心是通过功能性分离（functional separation）而非视觉分割（visual segmentation）来构建模块，确保背景动力学与智能体动作无关。
AI.result: 1. 在从头训练时，BRICKS-WM 的控制表现与现有的主流整体式基线模型相当；2. 成功验证了冻结的背景动力学模型可在不同智能体之间进行复用。
AI.conclusion: BRICKS-WM 通过强制执行转换动力学中的功能分离，实现了高性能的控制，并首次在基于 latent world model 的方法中实现了背景动力学的跨任务复用，证明了模块化世界建模在解耦环境与智能体动力学方面的有效性。

title: Know Your Limits : On the Faithfulness of LLMs as Solvers and Autoformalizers in Legal Reasoning
comment: 10 pages, submitted to COLM 2026 (under review, average score of 6.25 across 4 reviewers) and accepted by the AI4Law workshop at ICML. This is the version where we already addressed most of the reviews from the COLM reviewers
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on reasoning tasks, but whether this reflects faithful logical inference or heuristic approximation remains unclear. We study this question in legal entailment by comparing three paradigms, including pure LLM classification, LLM-based Formal Reasoning, and solver-based Formal Reasoning using the Z3 SMT solver, on a re-annotated subset of ContractNLI across five LLMs. Our re-annotation reveals a systematic and measurable gap between pragmatic legal interpretation and strict formal entailment, where a substantial proportion of legally sound inferences are not formally grounded without additional unstated assumptions. While introducing formal structure improves accuracy, with LLM-based Formal Reasoning achieving the highest benchmark performance, we show that this gain does not imply faithful reasoning. We identify three recurring failure modes: scope laundering, where LLMs report solver-inconsistent classifications without executing the underlying formal reasoning, producing conclusions that appear logically grounded but are not; implicit constraint blindness, where LLMs overlook logical constraints present in formal representations; and program synthesis failures, where LLMs generate incorrect Z3 code despite structured prompting. Critically, scope laundering persists across all models, raising serious concerns about the faithfulness of LLM-based formal reasoning as a proxy for symbolic execution. These results reveal a fundamental gap between benchmark accuracy and logical faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了大语言模型在法律推理任务中存在严重的逻辑忠实度问题，其通过“形式化”获得的准确率提升往往是伪装的（即“范围洗钱”），而非真实的逻辑推导。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型（LLMs）在推理任务中表现出的强性能究竟是源于真实的逻辑推理，还是仅仅是启发式近似（heuristic approximation）。
AI.method: 研究对比了纯LLM分类、基于LLM的形式推理以及基于Z3 SMT求解器的形式推理三种范式；通过在ContractNLI的重标注子集上测试五种大语言模型，量化了法律解释与严格形式推论之间的差距，并分析了模型在结构化提示下的失败模式。
AI.result: 1. 法律语境中存在系统的形式蕴涵缺口，许多法律合理推论缺乏形式基础。2. 虽然形式结构能提升准确率，但这并不等同于逻辑忠实性。3. 识别出三种核心失败模式：范围洗钱（scope laundering）、隐式约束盲区（implicit constraint blindness）和程序合成失败（program synthesis failures）。
AI.conclusion: LLM在形式化推理任务上的基准测试高分并不代表其具备忠实的逻辑推理能力。研究发现“范围洗钱”（scope laundering）等失败模式在所有模型中均存在，由于基准测试准确率与逻辑忠实度之间存在根本鸿沟，LLM在形式推理中并不能作为符号执行的可信替代品。

title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
summary: GPU kernel optimization represents a paradigm where functional correctness is assumed and execution efficiency is the objective. We present daVinci-kernel, a reinforcement learning framework that couples skill discovery with skill exploitation through a dynamically evolving skill library. daVinci-kernel jointly trains three agents sharing one LLM backbone: a Skill Selection Agent that retrieves relevant techniques via BM25 and LLM reranking, a Policy Agent that generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton kernels conditioned on selected skills, and a Skill Summary Agent that distills successful rollouts into reusable skills. Candidate skills are added only after execution-based verification confirms reproducible speedups. All three agents share a single LLM backbone, are initialized via a structured SFT cold start on diversity-filtered data, and are then jointly optimized end-to-end with multi-turn REINFORCE and per-agent advantage estimation. On KernelBench, daVinci-kernel-14B achieves 37.2%, 70.6%, and 32.2% on Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 under the Fast$_1$ threshold, outperforming the strongest prior RL-trained model, Dr.Kernel-14B.

AI.tldr: daVinci-kernel 是一个基于大语言模型的强化学习框架，通过动态技能库实现 GPU 内核的高效优化，其核心在于将成功优化经验自动抽象为可重用技能，并结合多智能体协同机制实现性能的最优化。
AI.motivation: GPU 内核优化通常追求执行效率，现有工作难以高效自动化地生成高性能代码，亟需一种能够持续学习、积累并利用优化技巧的自动化框架。
AI.method: 提出 daVinci-kernel 框架，利用单一 LLM 主干共享三个智能体：1. 技能选择智能体（通过 BM25 和 LLM 重排序检索技术）；2. 策略智能体（生成 CUDA/Triton 内核）；3. 技能摘要智能体（提取成功案例为可重用库）。流程包含结构化 SFT 冷启动，并利用多轮 REINFORCE 和基于执行的验证进行端到端优化。
AI.result: 在 KernelBench 测试集上，daVinci-kernel-14B 模型在 Level 1、2、3 任务中分别达到了 37.2%、70.6% 和 32.2% 的通过率（Fast₁ 阈值），显著超越了现有的强化学习基准模型 Dr.Kernel-14B。
AI.conclusion: daVinci-kernel 通过结合技能发现与利用的强化学习框架，有效提升了 GPU 内核优化的自动化水平，在多层级任务上均优于现有的 RL 方法，证明了从执行反馈中迭代提取通用技能对于复杂编程任务的有效性。

title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-3B achieves frontier-level performance on highly demanding verifiable tasks. Specifically, it attains a score of 94.3 on AIME26 (improving to 97.1 with claim-level test-time scaling), an 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, and exhibits strong out-of-distribution generalization with a 96.1\% acceptance rate on recent unseen LeetCode contests. This effectively places it in the performance band of first-tier reasoning systems, matching or exceeding flagship models that are orders of magnitude larger, such as DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, and Gemini 3 Pro. Furthermore, a score of 93.4 on IFEval confirms that this extreme reasoning enhancement does not compromise strict instruction controllability. Extending our previous 1.5B work, these findings motivate the Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis, which views verifiable reasoning as compressible into compact reasoning cores, while open-domain knowledge and general-purpose competence require broad parameter coverage over facts, concepts, and long-tail scenarios. This perspective suggests that compact models are not merely deployment-efficient substitutes, but a complementary path toward frontier-level performance in parameter-dense capability regimes.

AI.tldr: VibeThinker-3B 是一款 3B 参数的紧凑模型，通过优化的后训练管道在验证性推理任务上达到前沿性能，证明了高效推理能力可被深度压缩至小型模型中。
AI.motivation: 探索在参数严格受限（3B）的小模型规模下，验证性推理能力（Verifiable Reasoning）所能达到的极限，并验证“参数压缩-覆盖假设”。
AI.method: 基于 Spectrum-to-Signal 后训练范式，采用包含基于课程的监督微调（Curriculum-based SFT）、多域强化学习（Multi-domain RL）及离线自我蒸馏（Offline Self-distillation）的优化流水线。
AI.result: VibeThinker-3B 在高难度验证任务中表现卓越：AIME26 得分 94.3（测试时缩放后 97.1），LiveCodeBench v6 Pass@1 达到 80.2，以及 IFEval 得分 93.4，性能媲美或超越 DeepSeek V3.2、GLM-5 等超大参数量模型。
AI.conclusion: 验证性推理能力可被压缩至紧凑的推理核心中，而开放域知识和通用能力则需要更广泛的参数覆盖。紧凑模型是实现前沿推理能力的互补路径，而非仅仅是部署效率的替代品。

title: Tail-Shape Estimation in LLM Evaluation Is Fragile: A Protocol for Diagnosing False Positives
comment: 9 pages of main paper, 4 figures and 4 tables in the main paper, more in the appendix
summary: Recent work motivates moving large language model (LLM) evaluation from mean-based to tail-aware metrics, including conditional value-at-risk and tail-index estimates of reward-model error. We ask whether the canonical extreme-value-theory tail-index parameter, which isolates how heavy a tail is from how large the tail mass is, adds discriminative information beyond the mean and a standard tail-magnitude statistic in LLM evaluation. We pre-register a protocol covering admissibility, goodness-of-fit, threshold-stability, and effect-size requirements for any positive tail-shape claim. The protocol is the contribution of this paper; the empirical study below is a demonstration of what its gates catch. Applied to a standard LLM toxicity-evaluation setup under two structurally different scorer families, the protocol catches three distinct modes of false positives that a naive analysis would have published, and rejects the headline tail-shape claim on both scorers. We conclude that tail-shape estimation in the LLM toxicity-evaluation setups we examined is more fragile than the recent literature suggests, and recommend the protocol as a starting point for tail-index claims in similar setups.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM评估中“关注长尾分布”的趋势，本文提出了一套严苛的统计评估协议，并证明现有的尾部指数分析结论往往是脆弱且不可靠的，建议业界采用该协议以确保研究结论的科学性。
AI.motivation: 近期研究提倡将大语言模型（LLM）评估从基于均值的指标转向关注尾部风险（如CVaR和尾部指数）。本文旨在探讨“尾部指数”（tail-index）这一能区分尾部厚度与规模的参数，是否真的比均值和标准的尾部强度统计能提供更有效的区分信息，并指出当前的尾部分析存在潜在的方法论误区。
AI.method: 提出了一套严谨的评估协议，涵盖了可接受性（admissibility）、拟合优度（goodness-of-fit）、阈值稳定性（threshold-stability）和效应量（effect-size）要求；并在毒性评估任务中应用该协议进行实证演示，对比了两种不同的打分模型。
AI.result: 应用该协议后，研究发现 naive 分析中存在的“尾部形状”显著性的主张均为虚假阳性。该协议成功识别出了三种不同的误导性模式，并驳回了两种打分器下的原结论。
AI.conclusion: 在当前的LLM毒性评估实验中，基于极端价值理论的尾部形状（tail-shape）估计极其脆弱。作者认为，相较于简单的均值和尾部强度统计，目前常见的尾部指数分析方式可靠性不足，并建议采用该文提出的协议作为未来相关研究的准入门槛。

title: Measuring Whether LLM Tutors Teach or Solve: A Diagnostic for Educational Impact
summary: Large language models are increasingly proposed as educational tutors, yet stronger task-solving ability does not necessarily imply stronger learning support. Motivated by recent calls to measure the social impact of NLP systems in practice, we study whether public LLM tutoring benchmarks distinguish learning-supportive behavior from mere answer production. We propose a lightweight diagnostic based on the gap between solving-oriented and pedagogy-oriented benchmark performance. Using public MathTutorBench leaderboard results, we show that these dimensions are only partially aligned: across eight publicly reported models, the correlation between solving and pedagogy composites is 0.421, and several models shift meaningfully in rank when evaluation moves from solving to pedagogy. We then analyze the public TutorBench sample and show that agency-relevant behaviors are explicitly encoded in benchmark rubrics, especially in active-learning settings that reward guiding questions, calibrated hints, and non-disclosive scaffolding. Together, these findings suggest that educational-impact evaluation should not treat task success as a sufficient proxy for learning support. We argue that public tutoring benchmarks can better support positive-impact evaluation by reporting solving-oriented and pedagogy-oriented scores separately and by making disclosure-sensitive, student-agency-preserving criteria more explicit.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出大语言模型作为导师时，解决任务的能力并不等同于教学支持能力；论文建议将教育大模型的评估与基准测试分为“任务解决”和“教学法”两个维度进行独立考察。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为教育辅导工具日益普及，但目前普遍存在一种误区，即认为模型解决问题的能力等同于其教学支持能力；作者旨在探讨现有的公共教育基准测试是否能够准确区分“直接给出答案”与“提供有效的教学支持”这两种行为。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于“任务解决导向”与“教学法导向”性能差异的轻量级诊断分析方法；分析了MathTutorBench排行榜中八种主流模型在两个维度的相关性及排名变化；详细分析了TutorBench的评分准则，重点关注引导性提问、校准提示和非披露式脚手架等主动学习行为。
AI.result: 实证研究发现，上述两个性能维度仅表现出弱相关性（r=0.421），且模型在两个维度下的排名存在明显差异；证明了将任务成功率作为学习支持的单一评估指标是不足且具有误导性的。
AI.conclusion: 现有的教育类LLM基准测试不能简单地将任务解决能力等同于学习支持能力。为了更科学地评估LLM的教育影响力，建议将基准测试拆分为“任务解决导向”和“教学法导向”两个评分维度，并加强对过程披露敏感性与学生主体性维护的评估。

title: How Post-Training Shapes Biological Reasoning Models
summary: Scientific reasoning models for biology combine language models with foundation models trained on multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, and proteins. These models are built through post-training, yet how each stage shapes reasoning and generalization remains poorly understood. We study when post-training improves performance and when it induces over-specialization. Across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, we train and evaluate more than 100 biological reasoning models under controlled variation in backbone, continued pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), measuring both in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We find that each post-training stage reshapes generalization in a distinct way rather than contributing uniform gains. CPT improves downstream performance by aligning models with biological language. SFT consistently increases ID performance but causes OOD performance to peak early and decline as models fit the training distribution. RL, when applied to strong SFT checkpoints with aligned rewards, improves OOD performance and partially recovers generalization. These results show that biological reasoning does not improve monotonically with additional supervision or compute. Instead, performance depends on how training stages are composed. Under fixed post-training budgets, the strongest ID-OOD trade-off comes from brief SFT, larger RL allocations, and asymmetric adaptation capacity across stages.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了生物学推理模型中后训练阶段对泛化能力的非均匀影响，提出“轻量SFT+适度RL”是平衡域内与域外性能的关键路径。
AI.motivation: 尽管融合多模态生物数据（DNA、RNA、蛋白质）的科学推理模型在生物学领域应用广泛，但目前对于后训练阶段（post-training）如何塑造模型推理能力以及导致过拟合（过拟合到特定数据集）的机制尚缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 对超过100个生物学推理模型进行控制变量研究，评估了不同骨干模型、继续预训练(CPT)、监督微调(SFT)和强化学习(RL)组合对基因组学、转录组学及蛋白质科学任务的影响。通过测量域内(ID)和域外(OOD)性能表现，分析各训练阶段对推理能力和泛化能力的作用规律。
AI.result: CPT有效使模型与生物学术语对齐从而提升下游性能；SFT虽能显著提升ID性能，但过度的SFT会导致OOD性能下降（过拟合）；在稳定的SFT基础上引入RL能提升OOD性能并恢复部分泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 生物学领域推理模型的性能并非随训练阶段的增加而单调提升，而是高度依赖于训练阶段的组合方式。在固定的训练预算下，通过“轻量级SFT + 大量RL”以及在不同阶段分配不对称的适应能力，能实现最佳的域内(ID)与域外(OOD)性能权衡。

title: Assessing Reliability of Symbol Detection in Concept Bottleneck Models
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are a relevant tool for explainable Artificial Intelligence because they make their predictions through human-interpretable symbols. However, high task accuracy does not guarantee that these symbols are detected faithfully: jointly trained CBMs may encode task-specific shortcuts in the bottleneck, making their explanations unreliable. In this paper, we study concept-detection reliability by swapping independently trained concept detectors and classification heads that share the same symbolic vocabulary. We use the resulting performance degradation, concept-level metrics, and symbol-wise uncertainty estimates to identify concepts that are especially prone to spurious firing. Finally, we propose a reliability-aware training strategy in which a shared concept detector is optimized with multiple classification heads and penalized for relying on globally or instance-wise unreliable symbols. On CUB-200-2011 with full concept supervision, detectors and heads are almost freely interchangeable (swap drop below one accuracy point, relative retention above $99\%$, and no concept detected below chance), whereas on a controlled synthetic task we show that, as the concept-supervision weight is reduced, models keep near-perfect task accuracy while swapped accuracy and agreement with the ground-truth concepts collapse to chance. Our reliability-aware training substantially mitigates this leakage, roughly doubling swap accuracy in the leaky regime.

AI.tldr: 针对联合训练的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在可解释性上存在的偏置问题，本文提出了一种可靠性感知训练策略，通过多头共享训练和惩罚不可靠概念，显著提升了概念检测的忠实度和模型的可交换性。
AI.motivation: 联合训练的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）虽然能实现高任务准确率，但由于存在任务特定的偏置（shortcuts），导致其识别的概念可能不可靠、不可解释。
AI.method: 提出了一种可靠性感知训练策略，通过在多个分类头之间共享并优化概念检测器，并对依赖于全局或实例级不可靠符号的行为进行惩罚。此外，通过交换独立训练的概念检测器和分类头来评估概念检测的可靠性。
AI.result: 实验表明，在CUB-200-2011数据集上，通过该策略训练的模型实现了高度的可交换性（swap accuracy 下降少于1个百分点，相对保持率 >99%）；在受控合成任务中，该方法显著缓解了信息泄露，使交换准确率提升了约两倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可靠性感知训练策略，联合训练的CBM可以有效缓解概念中存在的偏置（shortcuts）问题，在保持任务准确率的同时，提升了概念检测的忠实度和可解释性。

title: MIRAGE: Auditing Anti-Muslim Bias in Frontier LLMs Across Reasoning, Agentic, and Time-Coupled Conditions
summary: Five years after the discovery of persistent anti-Muslim bias in large language models, most evaluations remain confined to single-turn prompt completion, a setting that no longer reflects how frontier LLMs are deployed. We introduce \textbf{MIRAGE} (Muslim-Identity Reasoning and Agentic Generation Evaluation), a benchmark of 1{,}200 prompts spanning three deployment-realistic conditions: direct completion, chain-of-thought reasoning, and simulated agentic decision-making across content moderation, lending triage, refugee claim summarization, and hiring screens. Across six frontier models, we find that (i) chain-of-thought reasoning \emph{amplifies} rather than suppresses Muslim-violence associations by 12--34\% relative to direct completion, (ii) agentic decisions exhibit a 9--22 percentage-point asymmetry between Muslim and matched non-Muslim cases on identical evidence, and (iii) bias is sharply time-coupled to retrieved news context, increasing 18--27\% under recent-conflict retrieval. Existing prompt-based mitigations transfer poorly across our three conditions, suppressing direct-completion bias while leaving agentic asymmetry largely intact. We release MIRAGE and an open evaluation harness to support targeted mitigation research.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了MIRAGE benchmark，揭示了前沿大模型在思维链推理和智能体决策中仍存在严重的穆斯林偏见，且现有的提示词缓解方法在这些领域失效。
AI.motivation: 过去五年的评估多局限于单轮提示补全，无法真实反映前沿模型在实际复杂场景下的偏见表现，特别是模型处理多步骤推理和智能体决策时的反穆斯林偏见。
AI.method: 提出了MIRAGE基准测试集，涵盖1,200个提示词，评估三种真实部署场景：直接补全（direct completion）、思维链推理（CoT）以及四种模拟智能体决策任务（内容审核、贷款分类、难民申请摘要、招聘筛选）。
AI.result: 1) 思维链推理并未抑制反而加剧了穆斯林与暴力之间的关联（增加了12-34%）；2) 在相同的证据条件下，模型在智能体决策中对穆斯林与非穆斯林案例表现出9-22个百分点的决策不对称性；3) 偏见与检索到的新闻上下文高度相关，在检索到近期冲突背景时，偏见激增18-27%。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流LLM在更复杂的推理和智能体任务中仍存在显著的针对穆斯林的偏见。现有的基于提示词的缓解策略（Prompt-based mitigations）在多阶段推理和智能体决策场景中效果不佳，提示我们需要开发针对性的缓解机制，而非仅关注单轮补全。

title: State-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthetic Data Generation for Tool-Augmented LLMs
summary: Training tool-augmented LLM agents requires large corpora of multi-turn, tool-grounded conversational data that is expensive to annotate, privacy-constrained in production settings, and largely absent from public datasets. We present StateGen, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations by orchestrating a four-role LLM loop: a persona-conditioned user simulator, an agent under test, a state-grounded tool simulator, and a multi-axis LLM judge. The key architectural contribution is an authoritative state manager that maintains a structured world-state object across turns, enforcing a backend-is-truth invariant that eliminates the dominant class of tool-call hallucinations by construction. StateGen extends naturally to hierarchical multi-agent settings by declaring sub-agents as tools, all sharing a single state object. We report results on 64,698 evaluated conversations across three production corpora: tool-call hallucination scores reach 9.66/10, the system supports persona-driven variation via a 23-dimensional trait vector, and a cleanly separated train and golden evaluation set split confirms the data is not memorization bait (per-criterion gap analysis). Comparison with eight external systems shows that no single publicly available platform combines multi-turn generation, state-grounded tool simulation, hierarchical multi-agent support, and built-in judge scoring.

AI.tldr: StateGen 是一个合成数据生成平台，通过引入“权威状态管理器”确保工具调用的准确性，高效生成高质量的、具推理能力的工具增强型 LLM 训练数据。
AI.motivation: 工具增强型 LLM 代理的训练高度依赖大规模、高质量的多轮对话数据，但此类数据标注成本高昂、存在隐私限制且在公共领域极为匮乏。
AI.method: 提出 StateGen 平台，利用由四角色（用户模拟器、待测代理、状态基准工具模拟器、多维度 LLM 评分器）构成的 LLM 循环生成数据；核心在于引入“权威状态管理器”，通过维持结构化的世界状态对象，强制执行“后端为真”原则，从构造上消除了工具调用幻觉。
AI.result: 在 64,698 轮对话中，工具调用幻觉得分达到 9.66/10；支持 23 维特征向量驱动的人格化定制；通过了严苛的训练与评估集分离测试；相较于现有八个系统，StateGen 是首个融合了多轮生成、状态基准仿真、层级多智能体支持及内置评分功能的综合平台。
AI.conclusion: StateGen 通过四角色 LLM 架构和世界状态管理机制，有效解决了工具增强型 LLM 代理在由于数据稀缺、昂贵和隐私限制而导致的训练数据生成难题，提供了一种高质量、可扩展的合成数据生成范式。

title: RepNet: Tackling spectral bias in deep neural networks via parameter reparameterization
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in scientific computing, yet they often suffer from spectral bias in capturing oscillatory and multiscale behaviors. In this study, we investigate this limitation by examining the failure of shallow ReLU neural networks in fitting high-frequency functions. This observation identifies two important factors in resolving rapid oscillations: the initial slope scale and the distribution of partition points induced by the networks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose RepNet, a reparameterized DNN model for ReLU and tanh networks designed for high-frequency and multiscale problems. The key idea is to reparameterize the weights and biases in the first hidden layer, which enables effective control of the initial slope scale and provides an appropriate distribution of the initial partition points. Furthermore, treating the reparameterized weights and biases as trainable parameters allows the DNN to achieve adaptive frequency scaling during training. In addition, we derive quantitative estimates for the output and slope magnitudes of the reparameterized DNN to guide the initialization of the proposed method. Numerical experiments, including multiscale one- and four-dimensional function approximation, forward and inverse PDE problems in combination with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), and operator learning, demonstrate that RepNet improves the predicted accuracy of vanilla DNNs in capturing highly oscillatory features with slightly additional computational cost. These results indicate that RepNet provides an effective and flexible approach for overcoming spectral bias and applying DNNs to multiscale problems.

AI.tldr: 针对DNN在科学计算中处理高频振荡的“频谱偏差”问题，本文提出了RepNet重参数化模型，通过优化第一层的初始化和提供自适应频率调整机制，显著提升了模型对多尺度问题的拟合效能。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络（DNN）在科学计算中面临“频谱偏差”限制，难以捕捉高频和多尺度行为。研究人员观察到浅层ReLU网络在拟合高频函数时失败，并将其归因于初始斜率尺度和划分点分布的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为RepNet的重参数化深度神经网络（DNN）方法，通过重参数化第一隐藏层的权重和偏置，实现了对初始斜率尺度和初始划分点分布的有效控制，并允许在训练过程中进行自适应频率缩放。此外，通过推导输出和斜率幅值的定量估计来指导参数初始化。
AI.result: 通过在一维和四维函数近似、物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的前向及反向PDE问题以及算子学习等数值实验中验证，RepNet在捕获高频振荡特征方面展现出优于普通DNN的精度，且计算开销增加微小。
AI.conclusion: RepNet为克服神经网络的频谱偏差、处理高频及多尺度问题提供了一种有效且灵活的方法，能够以较低的计算成本显著提升模型在处理剧烈振荡特征时的预测精度。

title: On the Entropy Formula for Real, Complex, and Quaternionic Deep Linear Networks
summary: We extend the entropy formula of Menon and Yu for the real Deep Linear Network (DLN) to its complex and quaternionic analogues, obtaining a unified formula for DLNs over $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$, and $\mathbb{H}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文将深度线性网络（DLN）的熵公式从实数域推广至复数域和四元数域，构建了一个统一的数学描述框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的DLN熵理论主要局限于实数域，缺乏对深度学习中常见的复数网络及四元数网络模型的通用数学描述。因此，作者旨在建立一个统一的理论框架，以理解不同数域下深度线性网络的熵特征。
AI.method: 数学推导与推广：基于Menon和Yu在实数DLN中提出的熵公式，利用复数和四元数的代数性质及矩阵分析方法，将其映射推广至更广的数域。
AI.result: 得出了一个统一的熵公式，该公式能够同时适用于实数（$\mathbb{R}$）、复数（$\mathbb{C}$）和四元数（$\mathbb{H}$）深度的线性网络系统。
AI.conclusion: 成功将Menon和Yu针对实数域深度线性网络（DLN）的熵公式推广至复数域（$\mathbb{C}$）和四元数域（$\mathbb{H}$），提供了一个涵盖实数、复数、四元数三种数域的统一熵公式。

title: Whose hotel does the AI recommend? An algorithm audit of reputation signals in LLM-assisted hotel selection
summary: Travelers increasingly ask large language model (LLM) assistants which hotel to book, making these systems gatekeepers of property visibility -- yet what moves their recommendations is undocumented. We conduct a pre-specified algorithm audit using a randomized choice-based conjoint: across personas, prompt templates, and twelve open-weight and proprietary models, assistants choose among five hotels whose guest rating, review volume and recency, management response, chain affiliation, price, eco-certification, and list position are independently randomized. We estimate the average marginal component effect of each signal on the probability of recommendation. Guest rating and price dominate (a top rating raises selection by 31.6 percentage points; a high price lowers it by 30.0), reproducing human valence-and-price primacy but over-weighting eco-certification and ignoring management response. List position -- a content-free artifact -- shifts recommendations causally, worth about \$12 per night. Stated reasons track revealed weights imperfectly. The findings ground generative engine optimization and the accountability of AI infomediaries in causal evidence.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过算法审计揭示了LLM酒店推荐的内在逻辑，发现模型不仅受到价格和评分等显性因素的驱动，还存在明显的列表位置偏差和不均衡的权重分配，表明AI推荐并非完全客观。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正日益成为旅游决策的“看门人”，但其推荐机制往往缺乏透明度且未被记录。研究旨在定量分析哪些酒店特征真正驱动AI的推荐行为，以揭示潜在的算法偏差和经济影响。
AI.method: 采用预先设定的算法审计方法。通过随机化选择题联合分析（randomized choice-based conjoint），在不同人格设定、提示词模板及12种不同模型（开源与闭源）下，让AI在包含8个变量（星级、评论量/时效、管理回复、连锁品牌、价格、环保认证、列表位置）的酒店选项中进行选择，通过回归分析估计各因素的平均边际成分效应（AMCE）。
AI.result: 1. 核心权重：住客评分与价格起支配作用（高评分提升31.6%，高价格降低30%）。2. 偏差发现：模型过度权重化了环保认证，却忽略了管理回复。3. 位置偏见：列表位置（内容无关特征）会对推荐产生因果影响，其价值折合约每晚12美元。4. 理由不透明：模型给出的推荐理由与其内部真实的权重分配存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: AI旅游助手的推荐逻辑表现出与人类相似的“评分-价格”首位效应，但也存在偏差（如过度关注环保认证而忽视管理回复）。此外，列表位置作为无关内容特征，会产生显著的因果偏差。研究强调了对大型语言模型作为信息中介进行审计和增强问责制的必要性。

title: Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network with Mixture of Experts for Soil Organic Carbon Prediction
summary: Top-soil organic carbon (SOC) prediction is fundamental to agricultural sustainability, land use policy and fertilization planning. Existing approaches face two limitations: they pair hand-crafted covariates with classical ML or single-modal deep models that miss rich spectral and temporal information, and grid-based architectures ignore the irregular spatial structure of field measurements. We introduce SpTGNN, a multi-modal spatio-temporal graph neural network addressing both. SpTGNN represents soil measurements as nodes in a heterogeneous graph with three edge types (spatial proximity, spectral similarity, elevation), and applies relational graph attention to learn separate patterns per relation. A fine-tuned TerraMind encoder extracts node features from Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and DEM signals, combined with per-sample environmental covariates and learned positional and temporal embeddings. A sparse Mixture-of-Experts module fuses the four streams via top-$k$ routing. Uncertainty is captured by pairing heteroscedastic regression (aleatoric) with deep ensembles (epistemic), and a Moran's $I$ penalty regularizes spatial autocorrelation. We evaluate on a global SOC corpus split into three regional instances ($\sim$49k samples globally, Africa $\sim$26k, Europe $\sim$14k). Our 5-member deep ensemble reports $R^2=0.762$, RMSE $=3.51\pm0.48$ g/kg and MAPE $=22.9\%$ on the Africa test split, improving over a tabular XGBoost baseline; the best single checkpoint reaches validation $R^2=0.864$. Ablations confirm the heterogeneous graph, MoE fusion and fine-tuned backbone each contribute substantively, and the ensemble UQ stack achieves post-calibration ECE of $0.031$ (hybrid) and $0.026$ ($β$-NLL). To our knowledge, this is the first framework to unify foundation-model feature extraction, heterogeneous graph attention and decomposed uncertainty quantification for SOC estimation.

AI.tldr: SpTGNN是一种新型多模态时空图神经网络，通过集成基础模型特征提取、异构图注意力机制和混合不确定性分析，显著提升了全球尺度下SOC预测的准确性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有表层土壤有机碳（SOC）预测方法存在两大局限：一是依赖人工特征工程且缺乏对多模态光谱/时序信息的深度挖掘；二是基于网格的架构无法有效建模实际测量中非规则的空间地理结构。
AI.method:
1. 异构图神经网络：将采样点建模为节点，通过空间邻近、光谱相似性和高程关系构建三边异构图，并使用关系图注意力机制（RGAT）学习路径信息。
2. 多模态特征提取：利用微调的TerraMind编码器处理遥感数据（Sentinel-1/2、DEM），结合环境变量及位置/时间嵌入。
3. 动态融合：采用稀疏混合专家模型（MoE）通过top-k路由融合多源特征。
4. 不确定性量化：结合异方差回归（Aleatoric）与深度集成（Epistemic），并利用Moran's I正则化项优化空间自相关。
AI.result: 在全球SOC数据集（约4.9万样本）上，SpTGNN的5成员深度集成模型在非洲测试集上达到 $R^2=0.762$、RMSE $=3.51\pm0.48$ g/kg，优于XGBoost基准；最佳单检查点在验证集达到 $R^2=0.864$。在不确定性量化方面，校准后的预期校准误差（ECE）低至0.026。
AI.conclusion: SpTGNN是首个结合了基础模型特征提取、异构图注意力机制和混合不确定性量化框架的土壤有机碳（SOC）预测模型。实验证明，该框架在处理多模态数据、捕捉复杂空间结构及量化预测不确定性方面具有显著优势，优于传统的XGBoost基准模型。

title: Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at IEEE ICDL 2026. Cite as: F. M. López, M. R. Ernst, F. Cruz, M. Hoffmann, and J. Triesch, "Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL", in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL). IEEE, 2026, pp. 1-6
summary: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly implemented as temporally uncorrelated white noise. However, recent works show that temporally correlated colored noise can improve exploration efficiency by producing smooth trajectories with better coverage of the state space. We inquire whether action noise inspired by infant spontaneous movements can also improve exploration in deep RL. We find that the power spectral densities of babies' end-effector velocities follow a colored noise process where the spectral exponent increases with age. Inspired by this developmental pattern, we introduce a mechanism that progressively increases the temporal auto-correlation of exploration noise during RL training, matching the infant statistics. Experiments across several RL environments show that infant-inspired noise produces structured exploratory behavior and can improve learning efficiency compared to conventional exploration strategies. These findings suggest that human motor and cognitive development can provide useful guidance for designing learning mechanisms in artificial agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/trieschlab/baby-noise-rl.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了受婴儿自发运动启发的有色噪声对深度强化学习的影响，提出了一种随时间增加噪声时间自相关性的机制，验证了这种人类发育启发式的探索策略能显著提升智能体的学习效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习在探索过程中通常使用时间上不相关的白噪声，这种方式效率较低且覆盖范围有限。研究者试图通过模拟婴儿自发运动中观察到的“具有时间相关性的有色噪声”这一生物学特性，解决人工智能探索策略的低效问题。
AI.method: 1. 对婴儿末端执行器速度的功率谱密度（PSD）进行分析，发现其符合具有特定谱指数（随年龄增长而增加）的有色噪声过程；2. 设计了一种在训练过程中随时间增加时间自相关性的噪声生成机制；3. 在多个强化学习基准环境下对比了该机制与传统探索策略（如独立同分布的白噪声）的性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，模拟婴儿发育模式的噪声机制能够显著提升探索的一致性和覆盖范围，在多个测试环境中相比传统探索策略实现了更高的学习效率。
AI.conclusion: 受婴儿自发运动模式启发的探索噪声（具有递增的时间自相关性）能够产生结构化的探索行为，从而在深度强化学习中获得比传统随机噪声更优的学习效率。这项研究证明了人类发育过程对优化智能体探索机制的启发意义。

title: PhysGuard: Fisher-Guided Gradient Projection for Sim-to-Real Neural PDE Surrogates
summary: Neural operator models trained on simulation data often lose accuracy when applied to experimental measurements due to the sim-to-real gap. Standard fine-tuning with limited real data can reduce this gap, but it may also damage the core physics-relevant representations learned during pretraining. Although knowledge-preserving adaptation has been widely investigated in vision or language tasks, it remains unclear whether these methods are suitable for neural operators whose architectures and protected knowledge are fundamentally different. Neural operators need to preserve core-scale physical structures rather than semantic or visual features. We propose PhysGuard, a physics-preserving framework for accurate sim-to-real adaptation of neural operators. Specifically, PhysGuard uses the empirical Fisher Information Matrix computed on simulation data to identify physics-critical parameter directions, then restricts fine-tuning updates to directions that do not interfere with them. A layer-wise Gram-matrix formulation makes this efficient for models with millions of parameters, while an adaptive threshold automatically determines the protected subspace size. A spectral probe experiment shows that the dominant Fisher directions are strongly associated with low-frequency output structures. Experiments on benchmark across four neural operator architectures and different physical systems show that PhysGuard performs strongly on most evaluation metrics compared to baselines. The benefits are most evident under severe domain shift, where it reduces low-frequency error by up to 32\% compared to standard fine-tuning while maintaining adaptability. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhouChaunge/PhysGuard.

AI.tldr: PhysGuard 是一种针对神经算子的“物理守恒”微调框架，通过限制微调方向来保护预训练学到的核心物理结构，有效解决了 Sim-to-Real 场景下的性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 神经算子模型在“仿真到现实”（Sim-to-Real）迁移时面临精度下降问题，而传统的微调会破坏预训练阶段学到的核心物理表示，且现有的视觉/语言领域知识保留方法并不完全适用于物理算子。
AI.method: 提出 PhysGuard 框架，利用模拟数据计算经验费舍尔信息矩阵（Fisher Information Matrix）识别物理关键参数方向；采用层级 Gram 矩阵公式实现高效计算；引入自适应阈值自动确定受保护的子空间（物理关键参数方向），并限制微调更新以保护核心物理结构。
AI.result: 在四种神经算子架构和多种物理系统上的实验表明，PhysGuard 表现优于基准方法，特别是在严重的领域偏移下，低频误差降低高达 32%。研究还证实，主要的 Fisher 方向与低频输出结构密切相关。
AI.conclusion: PhysGuard 提供了一种有效的物理守恒调整框架，通过保护关键物理参数方向，显著缓解了神经算子在实验数据上的 Sim-to-Real 鸿沟，在保持适应性的同时最大程度减少了对预训练物理知识的破坏。

title: TCHG: Tri-Trust Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Reliable Dynamic Trust Prediction
summary: Trust prediction infers latent user-user trust relations and provides important support for social recommendation, fake-review and manipulation detection, and risk identification. Graph neural networks have become a prominent approach to trust prediction because of their ability to learn network structures and complex trust dependencies. However, existing methods often rely on a unified representation of trust signals and do not disentangle heterogeneous trust evidence into separate evidence channels, failing to exploit the distinct roles that different evidence channels should play during trust modeling. To address this gap, this paper argues that trust evidence should not be treated as an undifferentiated input, but should be decomposed and used as functional control factors over graph propagation. We propose TCHG, a tri-trust conditioned heterogeneous graph learning framework that decomposes trust evidence into three channels and assigns them distinct functional roles in propagation: entity reliability governs message admission, interaction-behavior reliability modulates propagation strength, and contextual trust adjusts the propagation mode through context-conditioned operator selection. Since the three evidence channels evolve at different temporal scales, TCHG maintains independent temporal states with non-uniform decay rates to prevent rapidly changing contextual signals from overwriting slowly accumulated entity reliability. It further predicts trust probability and calibrates the output probability, improving predictive confidence under sparse or conflicting evidence. Extensive experiments on multiple public trust datasets show that TCHG achieves effective and reliable trust prediction compared with representative trust prediction and heterogeneous graph baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对现有信任预测模型对异构信任证据处理方式单一的问题，本文提出了 TCHG 框架，通过将信任证据拆解为三个具有不同传播控制功能的通道，并引入多尺度时间衰减管理，实现了更精确、更鲁棒的信任关系预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的图神经网络信任预测方法通常将信任信号视为统一整体，忽视了异构信任证据在建模中应有的不同功能角色，导致无法充分利用异构信任驱动的深层信息。
AI.method: 提出了 TCHG（Tri-trust Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph learning）框架：1. 将信任证据分解为实体可靠性、交互行为可靠性和上下文信任三个通道；2. 为不同通道分配特定功能（消息准入、传播强度调制、传播模式调整）；3. 引入时间非均匀衰减机制管理多尺度时间状态；4. 增加输出置信度校准模块。
AI.result: 在多个公开信任数据集上的实验结果表明，TCHG 在准确性和可靠性方面显著优于现有的代表性信任预测及异构图学习基准模型。
AI.conclusion: TCHG 框架通过将信任证据解耦并赋予其不同的功能角色，能更精准地建模信任关系，在稀疏或冲突证据下表现出更好的预测性能和置信度，优于基准方法。

title: Multimodal Evaluator Preference Collapse: Cross-Modal Contagion in Self-Evolving Agents
summary: When AI agents use language models to evaluate their own outputs in a feedback loop, systematic biases emerge. We show that Evaluator Preference Collapse (EPC) is dramatically amplified in multimodal settings. Using GPT-4o to evaluate DeepSeek-chat across text and visual tasks, we find that a single strategy (step_by_step) absorbs 48.4% of all weight -- 3.2x the collapse observed in text-only self-evaluation -- while three visual-domain strategies receive only 9.1% combined weight. We then demonstrate a novel phenomenon we term cross-modal contagion: evaluator preferences acquired on one modality transfer to and corrupt strategy selection on another. Through a four-phase isolation training paradigm, we measure contagion coefficients and document strategy inversion -- the optimal strategy for a modality reverses after cross-modal exposure. A Phase 3 statistical validation across four evaluator configurations (N=53 total independent repetitions, 15,592 API calls) reveals a clear hierarchy: cross-model evaluation (GPT-4o, N=8) produces strong but symmetric bidirectional contagion (mean gamma_{T->V}=1.176, gamma_{V->T}=1.089, Delta=-0.088, p=0.575, Cohen's d=0.29); high round counts (DashScope, 50 rounds) cause collapse to single-strategy dominance (70% zero contagion); and self-evaluation provides near-complete immunity -- 97% of runs (N=30, DeepSeek-chat) yield exactly zero contagion (mean gamma=0.033, 95% CI [-0.031, 0.010], p=0.642, d=0.07). No evaluator condition shows statistically significant directional asymmetry. We introduce the contagion matrix indexed by evaluator identity, release the MM-EPC experimental framework, and identify cross-model evaluator architecture as the primary risk factor for preference contagion.

AI.tldr: 多模态AI系统在反馈评估中存在严重的“评估器偏好崩溃”和“跨模态污染”，即跨模态的反馈机制会导致模型产生次优的策略选择，而跨模型评估是引发该风险的主因，相比之下自我评估则表现出极高的抗污染免疫力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明AI在自我反馈回路中存在“评估器偏好崩溃”（EPC）现象，本文旨在探究该现象在多模态环境下如何被放大，以及评估器在不同模态间的偏好是如何相互干扰（跨模态污染）的。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o作为评估器，对DeepSeek-chat在文本和视觉任务中的输出进行评估；通过四阶段隔离训练范式（Four-phase isolation training paradigm）测量污染系数（Contagion coefficients）；利用15,592次API调用进行统计验证。
AI.result: 研究发现EPC现象在多模态环境下显著加剧（单策略占比从文本的15%左右跃升至48.4%）；揭示了“跨模态污染”现象，即评估器在一种模态学到的偏好会腐蚀另一模态的策略选择；发现自我评估（Self-evaluation）能提供近乎完全的免疫（97%的运行无污染）。
AI.conclusion: 交叉模型评估（Cross-model evaluation）架构是导致偏好污染（Preference Contagion）的核心风险因素。研究建议通过限制跨模态评估链或采用更严格的反馈评估协议来缓解这一问题。

title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
summary: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We argue that this single-axis sampling space is fundamentally limiting, and identify a second, fully deterministic and complementary axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollouts that solve different subsets of problems, with no stochasticity. We instantiate this axis through Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR), a training-free decoding procedure that re-applies the top-$L$ layers for at most $K_{\max}$ iterations until the next-token distribution converges. Combined with $T$ temperature samples, EGLR turns a single-axis stochastic rollout pool into an $L\times T$ Cartesian sampling space at almost the same per-rollout cost. We characterize this space across $8$ instruction-tuned models and $6$ math reasoning benchmarks, and show that the $L$-axis is genuinely complementary to temperature: on MATH-500 with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the joint $L\times T$ oracle reaches $91.6\%$, $+8.2$ percentage points beyond the temperature-only oracle ($83.4\%$) and $+10.4$ points beyond the layer-only oracle ($81.2\%$), confirming that the two axes capture genuinely complementary problems. The expanded rollout pool provides richer per-prompt candidates for any downstream procedure that consumes rollouts, including self-consistency, best-of-$N$ with verifiers, and group-relative RL training (GRPO), opening a new direction for inference-time scaling that does not rely on stochastic noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于层递归的推理扩展技术EGLR，通过复用模型高层构建独立于随机采样的确定性推理路径，显著提升了模型在复杂推理任务中的上限。
AI.motivation: 现有推理扩展方法过度依赖单一维度的随机采样（token-level sampling），缺乏多样性。作者试图寻找一种确定性的、与传统采样互补的维度来扩展推理时的rollout空间。
AI.method: 提出Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR)算法。该算法在推理时对高不确定性token识别后，递归重复应用预训练模型顶部的L层，直至分布收敛。与传统的温度参数（T轴）采样结合，形成L×T笛卡尔采样空间。
AI.result: 在8个指令微调模型和6个数学推理数据集上验证了该方法。以Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct在MATH-500上为例，L×T联合方案的oracle准确率达到91.6%，比单纯随机采样提升8.2个百分点，比单纯L层扩展提升10.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 提出了EGLR方法，证明了通过递归重用模型高层模块（L轴）结合传统采样（T轴）构建的二维推理空间能显著提升模型推理性能。这为摆脱纯随机性的推理时扩展提供了一条新的、互补的路径。

title: From Affect Prediction to Affect Forecasting: Evidence for Distinct Information Sources in Longitudinal Text
summary: Modeling dimensional affect in longitudinal text requires distinguishing current affect estimation from future affective change forecasting. Existing approaches often treat each text as an independent observation and apply similar assumptions to both tasks, without testing whether they rely on different information sources. This paper investigates that distinction using longitudinal self-reported ecological essays and feeling-word entries. We propose the Trait--State Affective Prediction (TSAP) framework and its temporal extension E-TSAP for per-text valence and arousal prediction, evaluated on a held-out prediction test set of 1,737 entries from 91 users. We further propose the Affective Change Forecaster Hybrid (ACF-Hybrid) for next-step affective change forecasting, evaluated on a held-out forecasting test set of 46 users. For prediction, E-TSAP achieves composite Pearson correlations of 0.670 for valence and 0.449 for arousal. For forecasting, textual representations perform worse than compact numeric trajectory baselines: the text-inclusive model achieves only r=0.316 for valence and r=0.284 for arousal, whereas a simple prior-state baseline reaches r=0.615 and r=0.670, respectively. ACF-Hybrid, using dimension-specific numeric trajectory features, achieves r=0.659 for valence and $r=0.658$ for arousal. These results show that textual semantics support current affect prediction, whereas future affective change is better captured through prior numeric trajectory dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了纵向文本中的“当前情感预测”与“未来情感变化预测”，发现前者依赖文本语义，而后者更依赖历史情感轨迹的数值动态信息。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本情感建模方法往往忽略了“当前情感估计”与“未来情感变化预测”在任务本质和信息来源上的差异，试图用统一的方法处理这两个任务。
AI.method: 提出了两个主要框架：1. TSAP（及其时间扩展 E-TSAP）用于个体文本的情感效价（Valence）和唤醒度（Arousal）预测；2. ACF-Hybrid（Affective Change Forecaster Hybrid）结合了文本特征与数值轨迹特征，用于预测下一时刻的情感变化。
AI.result: 在情感预测任务中，E-TSAP 表现良好（效价 r=0.670，唤醒度 r=0.449）；在情感变化预测任务中，单纯利用文本的模型表现弱于历史数值轨迹基准模型，而 ACF-Hybrid 通过结合数值轨迹特征，显著提升了预测准确度（效价 r=0.659，唤醒度 r=0.658）。
AI.conclusion: 文本语义对于当前情感预测（Affect Prediction）非常有效，但对于未来情感变化预测（Affective Change Forecasting），基于历史数值轨迹的动态信息比文本语义更具预测能力。

title: SPICE: Synergy and Partial Information Based Curriculum Evolution
summary: Multimodal learning exploits complementary information across heterogeneous modalities. The informativeness of each modality can vary widely across samples and training stages. Existing multimodal curriculum learning strategies often assume that the relative complexity of samples remains unchanged throughout training and therefore cannot adapt to model evolution. We propose SPICE (Synergy and Partial Information based Curriculum Evolution), a novel progressive curriculum framework for multimodal interaction learning. Guided by Partial Information Decomposition (PID) theory, our approach decomposes multimodal interactions into redundant, unique, and synergistic information components, enabling an interpretable and dynamic characterization of sample complexity. Building on this decomposition, we design a progressive curriculum that evolves throughout training, allowing the model to transition from learning shared cross-modal cues to modality-specific patterns and, finally, to complex synergistic interactions. Adapting to model evolution, sample ordering is refined in real-time using PID information estimates derived from unimodal and multimodal predictions. Experiments across multiple multimodal benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional training and state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of PID information decomposition and adaptive sample ordering for multimodal curriculum learning.

AI.tldr: SPICE是一种基于部分信息分解（PID）的多模态课程学习框架，通过动态量化样本中协同、冗余与独特信息，引导模型从简单跨模态 cues 逐步学习到复杂的多模态协同交互，显著提升了多模态学习效果。
AI.motivation: 现有研究无法适应多模态学习中样本复杂度随时间动态变化的特性，缺乏对不同模态交互成分的细粒度理解。
AI.method: 提出SPICE（基于协同与部分信息分解的课程进化）框架，利用部分信息分解（PID）理论将多模态交互分解为冗余、独特和协同三种信息成分，并设计了随模型进化实时调整的动态样本排序机制。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准测试中表现优异，在模型性能和训练鲁棒性上均超过现有的课程学习策略和最先进的基准方法。
AI.conclusion: SPICE框架通过PID理论实现了多模态学习中样本复杂度的可解释性量化，并根据模型训练进度动态调整学习策略，优于传统静态课程学习方法。

title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
summary: Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench, which tests computer-use agents as personal assistants on a Linux desktop populated with 17 simulated real-world web applications and a full desktop stack, all seeded for one canonical persona, Michael Scott from The Office. We define 184 tasks in this environment, each inspired by a real request drawn from the OpenClaw community, and benchmark six closed and open-weight models with a uniform computer+bash tool surface. We find that the best model, Claude Opus 4.6, fully solves 55.4\% of the tasks, the only model above 50\%. Model failures cluster on tasks that span many applications and on long trajectories, where personalization stresses an assistant the most. We release the environment, task set, and agent harness at https://mypcbench.com.

AI.tldr: MyPCBench 是首个引入角色化和个人历史数据维度的计算机使用基准测试，揭示了当前顶尖AI模型在处理真实个人助手任务时的能力瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用基准测试缺乏个性化维度，无法评估AI助手在处理涉及用户个人历史数据、账户登录及跨应用协作等真实场景下的能力，导致评估与实际部署之间存在巨大鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建了名为 MyPCBench 的基准测试环境，在一个包含17个模拟真实网页应用和完整Linux桌面的环境中，为“迈克尔·斯科特（Michael Scott）”这一预设角色设定了184项基于真实场景的自动化任务，并测试了六种主流模型。
AI.result: Claude Opus 4.6 模型表现最好，成功率达到55.4%；各模型在跨应用处理和极长任务序列上表现较差，反映出个性化需求对智能体造成的重大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的模型在个性化计算机使用任务中表现受限（最高仅55.4%），且在处理多应用交互和长轨迹任务时表现出显著的局限性，凸显了通用AI助手在复杂真实场景下的落后性。

title: Distribution Alignment for One-Shot Federated Learning via Optimal Transport
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: One-Shot Federated Learning (OSFL) addresses extreme communication regimes in which clients interact with the server only once, amplifying the impact of heterogeneous client data distributions. In particular, the interaction of domain shift and label shift across clients induces misaligned feature representations that cannot be corrected through iterative optimization. Existing OSFL methods rely on distillation, server-side generation or ensemble-based aggregation, but assume aligned representations or address domain and label shift separately. We introduce SLOT-Align (Single-round, Learning-free Optimal Transport Alignment), a geometry-aware feature harmonization framework for OSFL. SLOT-Align uses a shared frozen encoder to extract compact feature statistics, constructs a global reference via Bures-Wasserstein barycenters, and aligns local representations using closed-form geodesic optimal transport maps. The method is computationally efficient and can be combined with existing OSFL pipelines relying on frozen encoders without modifying their training procedures. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, pretrained backbones, and OSFL methods show that SLOT-Align consistently improves accuracy and robustness under joint domain and label shift.

AI.tldr: 针对单轮联邦学习（OSFL）中数据分布偏移导致的特征错位痛点，本文提出了 SLOT-Align 框架，通过无需训练的最优传输技术进行高效的几何特征对齐，实现了在联合偏移场景下的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的单轮联邦学习（OSFL）方法在处理严重的域偏移和标签偏移共存时，由于缺乏迭代优化机会，导致特征表示错位，性能受限且现有方案通常假设分布已对齐或独立处理偏移。
AI.method: 提出 SLOT-Align（一种单轮、无需学习的最优传输对齐框架）：1. 使用共享冻结编码器提取特征统计量；2. 构建基于 Bures-Wasserstein 重心的全局参考标准；3. 利用闭式解（Closed-form）测地线最优传输映射实现局部特征的对齐。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试、预训练骨干网络及不同 OSFL 方法上的实验证明，SLOT-Align 能持续提升模型在复杂数据分布偏移下的准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SLOT-Align 提供了一种高效且无需训练的几何对齐方案，通过 Bures-Wasserstein 重心和最优传输映射，有效解决了 OSFL 中的特征错位问题，显著提升了在联合域偏移和标签偏移下的模型性能。

title: OpenClaw-Skill: Collective Skill Tree Search for Agentic Large Language Models
summary: Equipping Large Language Model (LLM) agents with effective skills is crucial for solving complex tasks in real-world systems like OpenClaw. In this work, we aim to develop a framework that automatically constructs such reusable skills to enhance LLMs in tool use, multi-step reasoning, and dynamic environment interaction. To this end, we propose Collective Skill Tree Search (CSTS), a novel tree-search-based skill construction framework that constructs structured, diverse and generalizable tree of skills. The core idea of CSTS is to leverage collective intelligence to jointly search, identify and compose effective skills via two iterative phases: Collective Skill Node Generation (CSN-Gen) and Collective Skill Node Assessment (CSN-Assess). CSN-Gen exploits collective knowledge from multiple models to explore diverse candidate skills for each subtask, enabling comprehensive skill exploration.
