CSN-Assess employs multiple models as judges to evaluate and select skill nodes with two scoring mechanisms: (1) collective quality scoring that aggregates independent evaluations to produce a robust estimate of skill effectiveness, and (2) collective transferability scoring that explicitly verifies whether a skill generalizes well across different models. With CSTS, we construct a set of comprehensive tree of skills along with skill-augmented training data, enabling models to effectively learn and utilize skills. Besides, we introduce Collective Skill Reinforcement Learning, which actively selects multiple relevant skills from the tree to broaden solution-space exploration, avoid being trapped by a single skill and its resulting homogeneous or suboptimal solutions. As a result, our trained model, OpenClaw-Skill, exhibits outstanding agentic capabilities in long-horizon planning, tool use and generalization over challenging benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CSTS 框架，通过多模型协作搜索、评估和强化学习构建可重用的“技能树”，有效增强了 LLM 代理在复杂任务中的自主解决能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在大规模、复杂现实环境（如 OpenClaw）中缺乏有效、可重用技能的问题，以应对多步推理和动态交互挑战。
AI.method: 提出“集体技能树搜索”（CSTS）框架，包含两个迭代阶段：1. 集体技能节点生成（CSN-Gen）：利用多个模型探索多样化候选技能；2. 集体技能节点评估（CSN-Assess）：通过集体质量评分和集体可迁移性评分验证技能的有效性与泛化能力。此外，引入“集体技能强化学习”（CSRL）来优化多技能组合选择，避免局部最优。
AI.result: 训练出的 OpenClaw-Skill 模型在长链路规划、工具使用及跨模型泛化性能上表现卓越，在挑战性基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CSTS 框架能够成功构建结构化、多样且可泛化的技能树，显著提升了 LLM 在复杂代理任务（如长链路规划、工具使用和环境交互）中的性能，证明了集体智能在自动化技能获取中的有效性。

title: Near-Optimal Stochastic Linear Bandits with Delay
summary: We study stochastic linear bandits with delayed feedback under several delay models and establish near-optimal regret guarantees. Our results identify when delayed linear bandits exhibit the same qualitative behavior as multi-armed bandits (MAB), and when the linear structure creates fundamentally new challenges. Specifically, (1) for \emph{loss-independent delays}, where the delay does not depend on the realized loss (but potentially depends on the arm), we show that delays incur only an additive regret penalty. Under stochastic delays, this penalty scales with the expected delay, while under adversarial delays, it scales with the maximum number of outstanding observations. Notably, both delay penalties are dimension-free, improving upon the state-of-the-art results; (2) for \emph{loss-dependent delays}, we show that linear bandits are substantially harder than MAB: unlike in MAB, we prove matching (up to log factors) upper and lower bounds in linear bandits, whose delay penalty depends on the square root of the dimension. (3) for the \emph{delay-as-payoff model}, a special case of loss-dependent delay, we show that the optimal MAB guarantee, which depends only on the delay of the optimal arm, is also unattainable in linear bandits. Together, these results provide a sharp characterization of how delayed feedback interacts with linear generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了延迟反馈下的随机线性赌博机问题，发现与损失无关的延迟仅导致维度无关的加性悔值惩罚，而与损失相关的延迟则在线性结构中带来本质上比多臂赌博机更难的维度相关复杂性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究未完全阐明延迟反馈在线性结构赌博机中的影响，特别是在线性结构如何增加延迟处理难度方面缺乏清晰的理论界定。
AI.method: 对不同延迟模型（与损失无关的延迟、与损失相关的延迟以及“延迟作为收益”模型）进行理论分析，并提出用于 regret 分析的算法及对应的上下界证明。
AI.result: 1. 对于与损失无关的延迟，证明了其仅带来与维度无关（dimension-free）的加性 regret 惩罚；2. 对于与损失相关的延迟，证明了 regret 惩罚与维度的平方根相关，确立了与 MAB 相比更难的统计界；3. 在“延迟作为收益”模型中，证明了 MAB 中的最优保证在线性赌博机中无法达到。
AI.conclusion: 本文为带延迟反馈的随机线性赌博机问题提供了理论框架，明确了延迟反馈与线性泛化能力交互的边界，并证明了在处理依赖于损失的延迟时，线性赌博机比多臂赌博机（MAB）具有更高的复杂性。

title: Scaling LLM Reasoning from Minimal Labels: A Semi-Supervised Framework with a Lightweight Verifier
summary: For the development of Large language models (LLMs), recent approaches to generating pseudo intermediate reasoning have shown remarkable progress. But they typically rely on large numbers of correctly annotated answers to assess reasoning quality. This paper presents a semi-supervised framework that scales reasoning learning from minimal supervision, turning reasoning verification itself into a data creation mechanism. We train a lightweight reasoning-correctness classifier on only a few labeled samples, which judges whether intermediate reasoning traces generated by an LLM are valid. Furthermore, an entropy-based confidence threshold filters out unreliable samples, and the remaining high-confidence reasoning traces are used to fine-tune the model. Experiments on Verifiable Math Problems (Orca-Math subset) and Question Answering on Image Scene Graphs (GQA) with Visual Programming show that our method achieves accuracy comparable to using 10-15x more labeled data. Ablation analyses confirm that both the classifier and entropy filtering are essential for scalable and noise-resistant pseudo-labeling. By replacing expensive answer-level supervision with lightweight reasoning verification, our method provides a practical path toward constructing large-scale reasoning resources and paves the way for future autonomous reasoning systems that learn from minimal human input.

AI.tldr: 提出一种半监督学习框架，通过轻量级分类器和熵过滤自动筛选高质量推理轨迹，减少了对大规模标注数据的依赖，实现了小样本下的高效推理学习。
AI.motivation: 现有生成推理轨迹的方法过度依赖大规模的标注答案来评估推理质量，导致数据获取成本高昂且难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出一种半监督框架，仅利用少量标注样本训练一个轻量级“推理正确性分类器”，并结合基于熵（Entropy）的置信度阈值过滤技术，循环生成并筛选出高质量的伪标签推理轨迹，用于后续模型的微调。
AI.result: 在Verifiable Math Problems (Orca-Math)和GQA数据集上的实验表明，该方法在仅使用1/10至1/15标注数据的情况下，即可达到与全监督学习相当的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过轻量级推理验证替代了昂贵的答案级监督，证实了利用少量标注数据引导模型自主学习推理的可行性，为构建大规模推理资源提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: Beyond Defensive Reporting: Machine Learning for Active Anti-Money Laundering Control in Insurance
summary: Money laundering through insurance claims poses a threat to insurers both through fraudulent payouts and reputational and regulatory risk. Despite this, little research has examined how such laundering can be prevented. This paper examines whether machine learning can help insurers flag suspicious claims before payout, shifting the focus from passive reporting to active prevention. Using production data from a major Norwegian insurer, we train gradient-boosted decision tree models to detect claims later reported to authorities for suspected money laundering. Because fraud and laundering may share behavioural patterns, we also examine whether insurance fraud labels can serve as an auxiliary training signal. We compare different learning setups using the Budget-Weighted Capture Rate, a metric introduced in this paper to measure how many laundering cases are captured when only a small share of claims can be manually reviewed. The results show that incorporating fraud-related investigation labels substantially improves laundering detection. The best-performing model captures nearly two-thirds of laundering cases within the top-ranked 2 to 6 percent of claims selected for investigation. To our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of machine learning for money laundering detection in insurance claims.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了首个利用机器学习识别保险业洗钱风险的实证方法，通过融合欺诈与洗钱的特征模式，实现了在有限审核资源下的高精准度风险识别。
AI.motivation: 针对保险理赔洗钱带来的欺诈赔付、声誉及监管风险，现有研究匮乏，行业亟需从被动的事后报告向主动的事前识别与预防转型。
AI.method: 利用挪威大型保险公司的真实生产数据，训练梯度提升决策树（GBDT）模型；引入“预算加权捕获率”（Budget-Weighted Capture Rate）作为评价指标；探索整合保险欺诈标签作为辅助训练信号，以优化洗钱检测能力。
AI.result: 引入欺诈调查标签能显著提升洗钱检测效果；表现最好的模型在仅人工审核前 2%-6% 高风险理赔案件的情况下，成功捕获了近三分之二的洗钱案例。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次证明了机器学习在保险理赔反洗钱中的有效性，特别是在结合欺诈标签作为辅助训练信号时，能够显著提升识别效率，从而实现从未过后的被动报告转向主动预防。

title: Symbolic Informalization: Fluent, Productive, Multilingual
summary: Symbolic informalization enables a reliable conversion of formal mathematics to natural language. It has the potential to make machine-checked content human-readable without loss of precision. In a traditional proof system usage, symbolic informalization generalizes the limited mechanisms of syntactic sugar into the ordinary language of mathematics. In a setting where proofs are constructed by artificial intelligence and autoformalization, symbolic informalization can explain what precisely has been constructed. This paper outlines the project Informath, which aims to show how symbolic informalization can produce fluent text with a reasonable development effort and address multiple formal and natural languages. Informath is based on an interlingual architecture, where Dedukti works as a hub between different proof systems (Agda, Lean, Rocq) and Grammatical Framework (GF) takes care of linguistic correctness and variation in different natural languages.

AI.tldr: Informath 项目利用 Dedukti 和 GF 构建了一种中介语言架构，成功实现了将 Lean、Agda 等形式化证明自动、精准地转化为流畅的人类自然语言，推动了机器验证数学的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决形式化数学难以由人类直接阅读的痛点，通过将机器生成的严谨逻辑自动转换为流畅的自然语言，实现高效的“符号非形式化”，同时保持数学逻辑的精确性。
AI.method: 采用中介语言（Interlingua）架构。具体而言：利用 Dedukti 作为不同证明系统（如 Agda, Lean, Rocq）之间的通用逻辑枢纽，并将 Grammatical Framework (GF) 用于处理自然语言的语法正确性及多语言表达差异。
AI.result: 该项目成功构建了一个原型框架，能够支持多种证明系统与多种自然语言，有效验证了该架构在处理复杂形式化数学证明并将其转化为可读人类语言方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: Informath 项目通过结合 Dedukti（形式化中枢）和 GF（自然语言生成），证实了符号非形式化（Symbolic informalization）不仅可行，且能够以合理的开发投入高效地实现形式化数学向多种自然语言的高质量转换，从而架起了机器验证知识与人类可读文档之间的桥梁。

title: Adaptive inference and function vectors in deep transformers
summary: Transformers are widely used as a general-purpose substrate for learning complex correlations between a large collection of coupled variables, but their internal mechanisms have remained mysterious. We introduce a theory of a deep transformer as a mean-field interacting system that implements distributed inference, subject to constraints on communication, locality and depth. We show that such a system can exploit internal state representations ('function vectors') to infer a latent context variable at increasingly finer scales over its layers. In an in-context regression task, the theory predicts a non-trivial relationship between non-Gaussian, hierarchical structure in the latent context variable, and transformer depth. Predictions are tested using constrained linear attention transformers and demonstrate adaptive inference in deep architectures. Feedforward blocks and depth enable transformers to implement a much richer class of in-context learning algorithms than previously described.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将深度Transformer视为分布式推理系统的理论框架，阐明了其通过层级化处理“函数向量”实现高效上下文学习的机制，并揭示了深度与复杂推理算法之间的本质关联。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer内部工作机制尚不明确，缺乏对深度Transformer作为分布式计算系统如何处理复杂关联和执行上下文学习的理论解释。
AI.method: 将深度Transformer建模为一个平均场交互系统（mean-field interacting system），该系统在通信、局部性和深度的约束下执行分布式推理；通过引入“函数向量”（function vectors）概念来解释其如何推断潜在上下文变量。
AI.result: 理论预测了非高斯层次化潜在上下文变量与Transformer深度之间的非平庸关系；实验验证了受限线性注意力Transformer在深度架构中展现出的自适应推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 深度Transformer通过其前馈块和层深，能够实现比以往描述的更丰富、更复杂的上下文学习算法。该理论揭示了Transformer深度与上下文变量层次结构之间的内在联系，为理解深度学习模型的推理机制提供了理论框架。

title: Learning Policy from a Single Trajectory in Average-Reward Markov Decision Process
summary: While there is an extensive body of work characterizing the sample complexity of discounted cumulative-reward MDPs, finite sample analyses for average-reward MDPs have been limited, and most existing works rely on restrictive assumptions such as ergodicity or access to a generative model. In this work, we establish the first finite sample complexity guarantees from a single trajectory for weakly communicating average-reward MDPs. To this end, we study the dynamics of a single trajectory in weakly communicating MDPs and based on this analysis, we develop novel model-free methods. Notably, our value-based and policy-based methods provide finite sample complexity guarantees of $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$ and $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$ from a single trajectory in weakly communicating MDPs, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce the first model-free method that requires no prior knowledge of problem-dependent quantities for communicating MDPs.

AI.tldr: 该文首次实现了弱连通平均奖励MDP在单轨迹下的有限样本复杂度分析，并提出了性能高效且参数自适应的无模型强化学习算法。
AI.motivation: 现有平均奖励MDP的有限样本分析主要依赖遍历性或生成模型等严苛假设，缺乏对更弱假设下（弱连通）单轨迹场景的研究。
AI.method: 通过分析弱连通MDP中单轨迹的动力学，开发了基于价值（value-based）和基于策略（policy-based）的新型无模型（model-free）算法。
AI.result: 在弱连通MDP中，基于价值的方法实现了$\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$的样本复杂度，基于策略的方法实现了$\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$；此外，提出了首个无需预知问题依赖参数的连通MDP无模型方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功为弱连通平均奖励MDP提供了首个单轨迹有限样本复杂度保证，证明了无需强遍历性假设或生成模型的算法可行性，并提出了无需先验知识的通用算法。

title: Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Mean-Field Games with Average Reward
summary: We study inverse reinforcement learning for discrete-time, infinite-horizon mean-field games (MFGs) under an average-reward criterion. Expert demonstrations are assumed to arise from a stationary mean-field equilibrium under an unknown reward, and the goal is to recover a policy explaining the observed behaviour via the maximum causal entropy principle. We formulate the inverse problem by enforcing consistency with the expert mean-field term and long-run feature expectations, treating two reward classes within a unified occupation-measure framework. For finite-dimensional linear rewards, we give a convex dual reformulation with an explicit log-partition objective, and prove smoothness and curvature properties justifying constant-step-size gradient descent. For infinite-dimensional RKHS rewards, we develop a Lagrangian relaxation whose inner-maximising policy is characterised by a soft Bellman equation. The main obstacle is the absence of a discount-factor contraction. We resolve this by introducing a minorisation-based sub-stochastic kernel that yields a strict contraction of the soft Bellman operator. We establish Fréchet differentiability and Lipschitz smoothness of the log-likelihood score, leading to a gradient ascent algorithm with convergence guarantees. Two numerical examples, a malware-spread MFG and an RKHS-based consumer-choice model, show that the recovered policies closely match expert behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了离散时间无限时域平均场博弈（MFG）的逆强化学习问题，针对平均奖励准则下缺乏折扣因子收缩性的挑战，提出了一种基于最大因果熵的统一优化框架，并为线性和RKHS奖励函数提供了具有收敛保证的求解算法。
AI.motivation: 现有的逆强化学习方法大多依赖于折扣因子的收缩特性，但在平均奖励准则下的离散时间、无限时域平均场博弈（MFG）中，这一假设通常不成立，导致难以直接应用传统的逆强化学习框架。本文旨在解决这一理论与算法挑战，通过从专家的稳态均值场均衡演示中恢复隐藏的奖励函数。
AI.method: 1. 基于最大因果熵原则（Maximum Causal Entropy），建立了一致性约束下的逆问题框架；2. 将有限维线性奖励问题转化为具有明确对数配分函数的凸对偶形式；3. 针对无穷维RKHS奖励，利用拉格朗日松弛法，并通过基于小项（minorization）的次随机核技术证明了软贝尔曼算子的严格收缩性；4. 建立了对数似然分数的Fréchet可微性和Lipschitz平滑性，并设计了带有收敛保证的梯度上升算法。
AI.result: 1. 推导出了适用于有限维和无穷维奖励函数的逆强化学习算法；2. 理论上证明了算法的收敛性；3. 通过恶意软件传播MFG和RKHS消费选择模型两个数值实验，验证了算法能够有效恢复出与专家行为高度匹配的策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了均值场博弈（MFG）在平均奖励准则下的逆强化学习问题。通过引入基于小项（minorization）的次随机核，克服了缺乏折扣因子带来的收缩性缺失难题，并为线性和RKHS奖励函数提供了具有收敛保证的优化算法。

title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
comment: 4 pages + appendix, 9 figures, Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Differentiable Systems and Scientific Machine Learning (SysDiff) @ EurIPS 2025, OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=rdmHT72NQH
summary: Evaluating neural operators for 3D turbulent flow requires validated datasets with physical benchmarks. We present a reproducible pipeline generating training data for 3D channel flows around generated geometries at Re=1,000-10,000. Our lattice Boltzmann solver with cumulant collision operators is rigorously verified against experimental measurements (Strouhal number, drag coefficients, turbulent fluctuations) with comprehensive grid convergence studies at resolution 1024x512x512. Building upon an established framework, this validated pipeline enables standardized surrogate model comparison. We outline planned systematic evaluation of Fourier Neural Operator and U-Net variants on forecasting, super-resolution, and error correction tasks, using physics-informed metrics to assess turbulent energy cascade representation. Future work will compare computational efficiency between numerical solvers and neural surrogates, exploring practical application. We seek community feedback on our validation approach, planned benchmark methodology, and evaluation priorities for neural operators in turbulent flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于评估神经算子在3D湍流中表现的标准化基准测试流水线，通过高精度LBM模拟生成经验证的物理数据集，旨在解决流体建模中神经网络评估缺乏标准化的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏针对3D湍流的高质量、经验证的标准化数据集，导致神经算子（如FNO、U-Net）在复杂流动问题中的性能评估缺乏统一基准和物理一致性标准。
AI.method: 采用基于累积量碰撞算子的格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM），在1024x512x512高分辨率下进行网格收敛性研究，并根据实验数据进行物理验证（如Strouhal数、阻力系数等），构建起可重复的数据生成与基准测试流水线。
AI.result: 构建了一个涵盖Re=1,000-10,000范围的3D沟槽流数据集，实现了高精度的物理基准模拟，并为后续对比神经算子在预测、超分辨率及误差修正任务中的表现提供了标准化框架。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过构建标准化、经验证的3D湍流基准数据集，为评估神经算子（Neural Operators）在流体力学任务中的表现奠定了基础，并提出了基于物理约束的评估体系。

title: Taming Curvature: Architecture Warm-Up for Stable Transformer Training
summary: Training billion-parameter Transformers is often brittle, with transient loss spikes and divergence that waste compute. Even though the recently developed Edge of Stability (EoS) theory provides a powerful tool to understand and control the stability of optimization methods via the (preconditioned) curvature, these curvature-controlling methods are not popular in large-scale Transformer training due to the complexity of curvature estimation. To this end, we first introduce a fast online estimator of the largest (preconditioned) Hessian eigenvalue (i.e., curvature) based on a warm-started variant for power iteration with Hessian-vector products. We show theoretically, and verify empirically, that the proposed method makes per-iteration curvature tracking feasible at billion parameter scale while being more accurate. Using this tool, we find that training instabilities coincide with surges in preconditioned curvature and that curvature grows with depth. Motivated by these observations, we propose architecture warm-up: progressively growing network depth to carefully control the preconditioned Hessian and stabilize training. Experiments on large Transformers validate that our approach enables efficient curvature tracking and reduces instabilities compared to existing state-of-the-art stabilization techniques without slowing down convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的在线曲率估计器，并基于“架构预热”策略通过控制网络深度显著提升了大规模Transformer训练的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 大规模Transformer训练中经常出现瞬时损失激增和训练发散问题（即“稳定性边缘”EoS现象），但现有的曲率控制方法因计算复杂度过高，难以在大模型规模下应用。
AI.method: 1. 提出了一种基于带热启动能力的幂迭代（Power Iteration）算法的快速在线曲率估计算法，用于计算预处理Hessian矩阵的最大特征值；2. 提出“架构预热”方法，即通过动态增加网络深度来管控曲率并稳定训练过程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够在大规模模型上高效追踪曲率，相比现有的稳定技术，能有效提升训练稳定性，且不会降低收敛性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构预热（Architecture Warm-up）策略，即通过逐步增加网络深度来控制预处理Hessian矩阵的曲率，可以有效识别并降低大参数Transformer训练中的不稳定性，且不影响收敛速度。

title: GD$^2$PO: Mitigating Multi-Reward Conflicts via Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization
summary: As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy still encounters multi-reward conflicts: a single rollout can yield positive advantages on certain reward dimensions but negative ones on others, causing opposing signals to cancel each other out during aggregation, further hindering RL training efficiency. Inspired by Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO), which improves RL training efficiency by filtering out ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages, we propose Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GD$^2$PO). Specifically, GD$^2$PO employs a conflict-aware filtering mechanism to mask out rollouts suffering from severe reward-wise disagreement. By preventing conflicting signals from canceling each other out, this masking strategy preserves and enhances the magnitude of effective RL advantages, thereby significantly accelerating learning efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce query-level reweighting to dynamically adjust the update intensity of each query based on its overall reward consensus. Experiments on various multi-reward scenarios, including tool calling and human preference alignment, demonstrate that GD$^2$PO consistently and significantly outperforms existing baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/GD2PO.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型多维奖励优化中常见的奖励冲突导致训练效率低下的问题，本文提出了GD$^2$PO算法，通过冲突感知过滤和动态查询重加权机制，有效消除无效梯度干扰，显著提升了RL对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型多维度奖励强化学习（RL）训练中，不同奖励目标往往存在冲突。现有方法（如GDPO）虽将奖励解耦，但无法解决单个轨迹中不同维度奖励信号相互抵消的问题，导致训练效率低下且难以收敛。
AI.method: 提出GD$^2$PO算法，核心包含两个机制：1. 冲突感知过滤（Conflict-aware filtering）：通过掩码策略剔除不同奖励维度间存在严重冲突的采样数据，防止梯度抵消；2. 查询级重加权（Query-level reweighting）：根据奖励共识度动态调整不同样本的参数更新强度。
AI.result: 在工具调用和人类偏好对齐等多个多奖励基准测试中，GD$^2$PO的性能显著优于现有的GDPO及其他基线方法，表现出更快的学习效率和更好的综合能力。
AI.conclusion: GD$^2$PO通过解决多奖励目标间的冲突和非一致性问题，有效提升了强化学习对齐的效率与效果。该研究证明了在多维奖励优化中，精细化的信号过滤和动态权重调整优于简单的独立奖励分解。

title: We Need Explanation Cards to Connect Explanation Algorithms to the Real World
summary: Algorithmic explanations are intended to help stakeholders understand opaque algorithmic decisions, but in practice, they often fall short. First, the meaning of algorithmic explanations is often not what one might intuitively expect, so expert knowledge is required to interpret them correctly. Second, recent work has shown that popular explanation algorithms are uninformative about the behavior of complex decision functions. Together, these issues create a gap between what explanations appear to convey and what they actually provide. In this work, we propose Explanation Cards for Explanation Algorithms, which augment standard explanations with complementary information about robustness and validity, as well as clear instructions for interpretation. The complementary information can render otherwise uninformative explanations practically useful, while also helping to detect cases where they are not. Importantly, the interpretation instructions in explanation cards shift responsibility from users to providers: Rather than expecting users to recognize what can and cannot be concluded from an explanation, providers must make this explicit upfront. Using counterfactual explanations and SHAP as examples, we demonstrate how providers can construct explanation cards and that these cards provide users with the guidance needed for sound interpretation. We further argue that explanation cards offer a practical means of operationalising the explainability provisions of the EU AI Act. Overall, explanation cards are a significant step toward making explanation algorithms fit for real-world use cases.

AI.tldr: 针对现有深度学习算法解释不可靠、易误导的问题，论文提出了“Explanation Cards”方案。通过为解释增加鲁棒性、有效性及解读说明，将解释的边界责任从用户明确转移给算法提供方，从而提升解释的现实可用性并满足合规诉求。
AI.motivation: 现有的算法解释往往存在“语义鸿沟”：解释的直观含义与其实际意义不符，且往往无法准确反映复杂决策函数的内部逻辑，导致用户极易产生误解，缺乏对解释有效性的正确认知。
AI.method: 提出“Explanation Cards”（解释卡片）框架，旨在为现有的算法解释（如反事实解释、SHAP）补充关于鲁棒性、有效性的信息以及明确的解读指南。通过强调模型透明度和责任归属，引导提供方在交付解释时明确说明其适用范围。
AI.result: 通过针对SHAP和反事实解释构建的应用案例验证，证明了“Explanation Cards”能有效为用户提供解读指导，并帮助识别解释可能失效的场景，从而提升了算法解释的实用性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: “Explanation Cards”通过为算法解释提供透明的合规性与边界说明，将解释的责任从终端用户转移至提供方，是使算法解释符合现实应用需求的重要方案，并为满足欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）的合规要求提供了可行路径。

title: Decision-Weighted Flow Matching for Contextual Stochastic Optimization
summary: Conditional generative models are increasingly used as scenario generators for stochastic optimization, but standard training objectives emphasize uniform distributional fit rather than the downstream decisions induced by generated scenarios. This creates an objective mismatch: errors in statistically common regions may have little effect on decision regret, whereas errors in decision-sensitive regions can substantially change the optimal action. We propose Decision-Weighted Flow Matching (DW-FM), a regret-aligned training framework that preserves the simplicity of standard flow matching while reweighting its velocity-regression objective using decision-sensitive endpoint information. Theoretically, we connect downstream regret to pathwise velocity mismatch through a loss-induced decision discrepancy and an adjoint transport argument, yielding an ideal regret-aligned surrogate and practical endpoint-weighted objectives with regret guarantees. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of DW-FM on three CVaR-based contextual stochastic optimization benchmarks spanning synthetic portfolio, semi-real financial, and traffic-CVaR tasks, where DW-FM improves downstream regret over standard baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对随机优化中生成模型与决策目标不匹配的问题，本文提出了决策加权流匹配（DW-FM），通过引入决策敏感权重优化生成过程，提升了最终决策的质量和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的条件生成模型在随机优化任务中存在“目标不匹配”问题——标准训练仅关注分布拟合（uniform distributional fit），忽略了分布中对最终决策影响较大的区域，导致决策的次优性。
AI.method: 提出“决策加权流匹配”（Decision-Weighted Flow Matching, DW-FM）。该方法在标准的流匹配（Flow Matching）基础上，通过引入决策敏感终点信息，对速度回归目标（velocity-regression objective）进行加权，从而对齐决策遗憾。
AI.result: 在合成组合、金融及交通CVaR三个任务上的实证表明，DW-FM相比标准基线方法显著降低了下游决策的遗憾值。
AI.conclusion: DW-FM通过结合决策权重的流匹配框架，有效缩减了生成模型在随机优化场景下的决策遗憾（Regret），验证了针对决策目标调整生成学习的重要性。

title: Deep Q-Learning on Hölder Spaces
summary: We study the operator-theoretic core of Q-learning in continuous-time stochastic control with continuous states and actions. In value-based reinforcement learning, each Q-learning or DQN update is built from a Bellman optimality target; our analysis isolates this target in a diffusion setting and studies its regularity and approximation complexity. Under uniform ellipticity and Hölder-regular coefficients, we show that a Bellman update maps bounded inputs into an anisotropic regularity class, smoothing the state variable while leaving only Lipschitz dependence on the action variable. This yields a compact family of Bellman iterates and motivates a tensor-product DeepONet architecture adapted to the mixed regularity of the problem. We then derive explicit approximation and resource bounds, together with a stiffness--complexity trade-off as the time step $δ\to 0$. The resulting theory makes a direct contribution to Q-learning theory at the level of Bellman target regularity and approximation in continuous stochastic control. At the same time, we do not claim a full convergence theorem for practical sampled Q-learning with exploration, replay, and stochastic gradient updates.

AI.tldr: 本文从算子理论角度研究了连续时间随机控制中的Q学习，证明了贝尔曼算子具备混合正则性，并验证了DeepONet在解决该类问题时的逼近优势及复杂度边界。
AI.motivation: 现有的Q学习理论（尤其是深度Q学习）多关注离散时间下的随机逼近，缺乏对连续时间、连续空间下贝尔曼算子本身正则性及函数逼近复杂度的理论刻画。
AI.method: 基于算子理论，在一致椭圆性和Hölder连续系数条件下，分析贝尔曼更新算子在扩散过程中的映射行为；利用各向异性函数空间分析其平滑特性，并构建张量积DeepONet架构进行逼近。
AI.result: 证明了贝尔曼更新算子具有各向异性正则性（对状态平滑，对动作Lipschitz连续）；推导了Tensor-product DeepONet的明确逼近边界和资源复杂度，并揭示了时间步长趋于0时的刚性-复杂度权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了连续时间Q学习中贝尔曼更新算子的正则性结构（混合正则性），并由此证明了特定神经网络架构（DeepONet）的逼近效率，为连续随机控制中的值函数逼近提供了理论基础。

title: HawkesNest: A Multi-Axis Synthetic Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Pattern Complexity
summary: Evaluation of spatiotemporal point process (STPP) models relies heavily on opaque real-world datasets, where latent generative structure is unknown and model failures are difficult to attribute. We introduce HawkesNest, a generator-aligned benchmark for controlled spatiotemporal pattern complexity built on a multivariate Hawkes backbone. HawkesNest defines four complexity axes: space--time entanglement, background heterogeneity, cross-type interaction, and domain topology. Each axis is associated with a deterministic index computed from the latent data-generating mechanism. By varying these axes while holding global rate, stability, and simulation budget fixed, HawkesNest enables diagnostic stress tests of STPP models under known structural difficulty. We verify that the indices are monotone and nearly orthogonal under controlled sweeps. We illustrate its use by showing that Hawkes-family baselines degrade under joint heterogeneity--entanglement complexity, even though they are structurally aligned with the Hawkes data-generating backbone. We further show that HawkesNest exposes neural-model sensitivity: AutoSTPP remains vulnerable under isolated increases in space--time entanglement. Code. Available at https://github.com/YahyaAalaila/HawkesNest

AI.tldr: HawkesNest 是一个新型 STPP 模型基准测试框架，通过可控的生成机制量化模型在时空建模中的性能瓶颈与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的时空点过程（STPP）模型评估依赖于真实数据集，缺乏对其潜在结构复杂性的控制，导致难以明确模型失效的具体原因。
AI.method: 构建基于多变量 Hawkes 过程的生成器，定义四个关键复杂性轴（时空纠缠、背景异质性、跨类型交互、域拓扑），并为每个轴设计确定性指数，通过控制变量法进行模型诊断测试。
AI.result: 验证了所提复杂性指数的单调性和正交性；实验表明 Hawkes 系列模型在处理高异质性与时空耦合时性能会下降，且 AutoSTPP 在面对时空纠缠时表现出明显的鲁棒性不足。
AI.conclusion: HawkesNest 提供了一个有效的基准测试框架，能够通过量化复杂性轴来诊断 STPP 模型的失效机制；研究证实即使是同构模型在特定复杂性条件下也会发生性能衰减，且揭示了神经网络模型在应对时空耦合时的脆弱性。

title: Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM
summary: Retail marketing measurement increasingly requires granular campaign-level insights without relying on user-level tracking. However, the two dominant approaches, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), often produce fragmented insights. MMM is privacy-safe and robust for channel-level planning but is too coarse for campaign optimization, while MTA provides granular attribution but has become less reliable under increasing privacy restrictions. We propose Integrated Marketing Attribution (IMA), a unified framework that combines MMM with channel specific Bayesian attribution models to derive campaign-level effects from aggregated data. By leveraging MMM-informed priors, IMA delivers granular, privacy-safe attribution while preserving consistency with MMM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成营销归因（IMA）框架，通过结合MMM与贝叶斯归因，在无需用户追踪的隐私保护前提下，实现了高精度的营销活动归因分析。
AI.motivation: 传统零售营销测量面临困境：MMM虽保护隐私但在评估广告活动层面过于粗糙；MTA虽能提供细粒度归因但受限于隐私保护政策，两者结果往往不一致。需要一种平衡隐私、 granular 视角与归因一致性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出集成营销归因（Integrated Marketing Attribution, IMA）框架，将营销组合模型（MMM）与渠道特定的贝叶斯归因模型相结合，利用MMM生成的先验信息推导活动级效果。
AI.result: 该框架能够在不依赖用户级追踪的情况下，提供细粒度的营销活动归因分析，同时确保这些细分评估与整体模型保持高度的逻辑一致性。
AI.conclusion: IMA框架成功克服了传统MMM与MTA各自的缺陷，通过贝叶斯推断实现了在保护隐私的前提下，从聚合数据中获取细粒度的广告活动级洞察，保持了宏观预算分配与微观执行策略的一致性。

title: Upper Bounds on the Generalization Error of Deep Learning Models via Local Robustness and Stability
summary: Generalization is a critical property of data-driven models, particularly deep learning models deployed in safety-critical applications. Robustness-based generalization bounds have gained attention as a principled way to link robustness properties to generalization performance, often in a data-dependent manner. However, most existing bounds suffer from vacuousness in practical settings, yielding loose upper bounds that greatly exceed the actual error rates and limiting their usefulness for real-world evaluation. While this issue is often attributed to the uncertainty term, a substantial part of the problem originates from the robustness term itself, particularly for the 0-1 loss. Existing approaches typically treat the robustness term as a global measure, ignoring its variation across different sub-regions of the input space. In this work, we propose a generalization bound that addresses this limitation by scaling the robustness term according to the number of stable and unstable samples within each sub-region. Our bounds incorporate both data- and model-dependent factors while maintaining practical relevance (yielding tighter upper bounds on true error). Experiments on models trained on the ImageNet dataset show that our bounds remain consistently non-vacuous and achieve the tightest estimates among existing methods, closely aligning with empirical performance across a range of robust deep neural networks.

AI.tldr: 针对现有鲁棒性泛化界在实际中过于宽松的问题，本文提出了一种基于子区域比例缩放鲁棒性项的方法，显著提升了泛化界在真实深度学习模型中的紧致度与实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有的鲁棒性泛化界在处理0-1损失时通常采用全局度量，忽略了鲁棒性在不同输入区域的差异，导致理论边界极其宽松，在实际应用中缺乏指导意义。
AI.method: 提出了一种区域化（sub-region-based）泛化界计算方法。该方法不再使用全局鲁棒性度量，而是根据输入空间各子区域内稳定样本与不稳定样本的比例来动态缩放鲁棒性项，从而更精准地捕获数据和模型的依赖特征。
AI.result: 在ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，该方法生成的泛化界在深度神经网络中始终保持非空洞（non-vacuous），并且在现有方法中提供了最紧密的误差估计，与实际经验性能高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了通过在子区域尺度上细化鲁棒性度量，可以有效解决现有的鲁棒性泛化界在实际应用中过于宽松（空洞化）的问题，实现了理论鲁棒性与经验误差的紧密对齐。

title: Beyond Weights and Gradients: A Taxonomy of Federated Learning Messages
comment: 4 figures, 9 pages, with 7 pages of content
summary: Federated Learning is rapidly evolving beyond the exchange of traditional model weights and gradients, yet existing definitions fail to capture the full scope of modern payloads like synthetic data and federated analytics. This paper addresses the gap by proposing a formal mathematical definition of a federated message that accounts for both utility and privacy. We introduce a taxonomy that organizes these exchanges into three categories: model structures, statistical summaries, and data-conditioned representations. By evaluating these groups based on computational demands, communication costs, and privacy risks, we provide a clearer understanding of the trade-offs involved in decentralized training. Our review of 202 recent publications highlights a significant shift since 2021 toward diverse messaging paradigms, signaling a move away from standard deep learning updates toward more specialized information sharing. This framework provides a structured path for future research to optimize federated systems for varying hardware and security requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习中日益复杂的消息类型（如合成数据、分析结果），提出了一套正式的数学定义与分类框架，并分析了其在计算、通信及隐私方面的权衡，揭示了该领域正从标准模型更新转向多样化信息交互的趋势。
AI.motivation: 现有定义无法涵盖现代联邦学习中合成数据和联邦分析等新型载荷，学术界缺乏对不断演进的联邦消息交换本质及权衡的统一认知。
AI.method: 1. 提出一种针对联邦消息的正式数学定义（涵盖效用与隐私）；2. 建立联邦消息分类法（模型结构、统计摘要、数据条件表示）；3. 基于计算需求、通信成本和隐私风险对各类交换进行评估；4. 对202篇近期文献进行综述与调研。
AI.result: 研究发现自2021年以来，联邦学习领域正明显向多样化的消息范式转移，跨越了传统深度学习更新，趋向于更专业化的信息共享。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习正从传统的权重/梯度交换转向更多样化的通信载荷，本文提出的框架为优化不同硬件和安全需求下的联邦系统提供了结构化路径和参考标准。

title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization
summary: Matrix based optimizers such as Muon can substantially speed up language model pretraining, but their gains over AdamW are observed to shrink as model size and data scale grow when using standard constant decoupled weight decay. We propose Hyperball, a simple optimizer wrapper that addresses this issue. Given a base optimizer such as Adam or Muon, Hyperball sets the Frobenius norms of weight matrices and their corresponding optimizer updates to fixed constants. On Qwen3 style models up to 1.2B parameters, Muon Hyperball achieves 20--30% token equivalent speedup over weight decay baselines. Hyperball also improves learning rate transfer across widths and depths compared to decoupled weight decay. This method is motivated by prior theory showing that training with weight decay leads to an equilibrium weight norm that only depends on the training hyperparameters. Through this mechanism, the weight decay then decides the angular learning rate, i.e. how fast the direction of the weight matrix changes.

AI.tldr: Hyperball 是一种新型优化器封装，它通过将权重及其更新的 Frobenius 范数约束为固定常数，取代传统的权重衰减，从而解决了大规模模型训练中优化增益衰减的问题，显著提升了训练速度和超参数迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于矩阵的优化器（如 Muon）虽然能加速语言模型预训练，但在模型和数据规模扩大时，标准解耦权重衰减的效果会衰减。研究发现权重衰减本质上是在调节“角度学习率”（即权重方向的改变速度），传统的控制方式无法适应大规模训练的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“Hyperball”的优化器封装方法。该方法不对权重进行解耦权重衰减，而是将权重矩阵及其对应的优化器更新量的 Frobenius 范数强制缩放（投影）为固定的常数，从而控制权重的更新方向与范数行为。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3 风格（参数量高达 1.2B）的模型上，Muon Hyperball 相比基准权重衰减实现了 20%–30% 的等效 Token 训练加速，并表现出更优的跨宽度和跨深度的学习率迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: Hyperball 优化器封装有效地解决了传统解耦权重衰减在模型规模扩大时增益减小的问题，通过固定权重矩阵与更新量的 Frobenius 范数，实现了更好的超参数扩展性和训练加速，特别是在配合 Muon 时表现出显著的训练效率提升。

title: Factorized Neural Operators Decompose Dynamic and Persistent Responses
summary: Physical systems often exhibit heterogeneous mechanisms, where rapidly evolving dynamics coexist with persistent structures. Capturing such multiscale physical behavior remains challenging for existing neural operators, which typically rely on single dominant inductive bias and therefore couple distinct physical responses into a shared representation. We introduce the Unified Green's Function Framework across domains and propose the Factorized Neural Operators (FaNO), which decompose spectral representations into equivariant dynamic responses and invariant persistent responses, leading to better interpretability and generalization. Mechanistically, we show that the two operator branches spontaneously specialize into distinct physical roles that remain consistent across scales and domains: the equivariant branch captures rapidly varying transient dynamics, whereas the invariant branch extracts coherent persistent structures. This factorized mechanism of FaNO improves prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency and cross-scale generalization across physical systems and domains. In particular, it maintains consistent predictions under long-horizon autoregressive rollout, cross-resolution extrapolation and physical-regime shifts. These findings suggest that scalable physical modeling may benefit from moving beyond single-inductive-bias formulations toward factorized operator representations that better reflect the heterogeneous organization of physical systems, accelerating the reliable deployment of machine learning for scientific computing and discovery.

AI.tldr: 针对现有神经算子处理复杂物理系统时表示耦合的问题，本文提出了因子化神经算子（FaNO），通过将谱表示拆分为等变动态和不变结构，显著提升了多尺度物理建模的泛化性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子依赖单一归纳偏置，难以有效处理物理系统中快速演化动力学与持久物理结构共存的异质性挑战。
AI.method: 提出统一格林函数框架，设计因子化神经算子（FaNO），将谱表示分解为捕捉快速瞬态动态的等变分支和提取连贯持久结构的不变分支。
AI.result: FaNO在预测精度、参数效率及跨尺度泛化能力上表现优异，尤其在长时域自回归推演、跨分辨率外推及物理机制迁移场景中保持了卓越的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 引入因子化神经算子（FaNO）框架，通过解耦物理系统的动态与结构，克服单一归纳偏置带来的局限性，证明了因子化表示对实现可扩展、可解释且鲁棒的科学计算具有重要意义。

title: Demystifying Variance in Circuit Discovery of LLMs
summary:
Circuit discovery is a key technique in mechanistic interpretability to pinpoint the model components that are crucial for performing a given task. Although the current state-of-the-art method (EAP-IG) performs well on the metric of (un)faithfulness, it suffers from substantial variability. This includes resampling variance, where the circuit changes when we probe with a new batch of data from the same distribution; rephrasing variance, where the discovered circuit shifts when the prompts are rephrased; and sample-wise variance, where a circuit with low population unfaithfulness exhibits large fluctuations in unfaithfulness across individual samples.
  This paper studies the roots of these variances. We demonstrate that CEAP, our new circuit discovery method that improves upon EAP-IG with a theoretical guarantee, can substantially lessen resampling variance. We further show that rephrasing variance arises because prompts with different templates tend to activate different circuits in the model. This leads us to argue that it may be challenging to find a comprehensive circuit that explains and controls the model's behavior on a task, which can be expressed in countless templates, suggesting that LLMs may be inherently hard to steer. We show that sparsity, which has been claimed to form more compact and interpretable task circuits, fails to solve this problem. Regarding sample-wise variance, we argue that it is largely benign: extremely poor unfaithfulness scores often stem from how unfaithfulness is defined, rather than from defects in the measured circuits. We show that the magnitude of unfaithfulness is affected by selective contribution scaling, a neural mechanism that accounts for the extremely poor scores sometimes observed.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了现有电路发现方法在重采样、改写和样本层面存在显著的不稳定性，提出改进算法CEAP并证明了模型对于不同提示模板具有内在的电路多态性，指出大语言模型的可解释性与可控性在本质上比预期更为严峻。
AI.motivation: 现有的电路发现方法（如EAP-IG）虽然在平均性能上表现尚可，但存在显著的稳定性问题（方差大），包括重采样方差、改写方差和样本级方差，导致很难确定一个可靠的、能解释模型任务行为的“通用电路”。
AI.method: 1. 提出新方法 CEAP (Circuit Edge Attribution via Path-IG 的优化版)，旨在降低重采样方差；2. 通过分析不同提示模板下的电路发现结果，揭示模型内在的电路多态性；3. 对比不同稀疏度约束，评估稀疏化对电路稳定性的改善效果；4. 深入分析不忠实度度量指标，归因于模型内部的选择性贡献缩放（selective contribution scaling）机制。
AI.result: 1. CEAP 方法成功降低了重采样带来的电路发现波动；2. 证实了改写方差主要源于模型针对不同提示模板采用了不同的计算路径，而非方法缺陷；3. 证明稀疏性无法解决上述稳定性问题；4. 发现样本级的不忠实度异常现象往往是由现有不忠实度指标的定义缺陷以及模型内部的选择性贡献缩放导致，而非电路本身质量低下。
AI.conclusion: 模型电路发现中的方差（重采样、改写、样本级）是导致模型难以解释和控制的重要原因。单纯依靠稀疏化无法解决这一问题，且必须重新审视现有“不忠实度”（unfaithfulness）度量指标的局限性。未来LLM的解释与可控性研究应承认任务定义的复杂性以及神经网络内部机制的波动特点。

title: A Unified Causal-Origin Taxonomy of Distributional Shifts in Reinforcement Learning
comment: The paper is currently under review at the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (JAIR)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) systems often degrade when operating conditions differ from those previously encountered, reflecting distributional shifts in the underlying data-generating process. Such shifts may occur between training and evaluation, as in In-Distribution (ID) and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) generalization, or within non-stationary settings where environment dynamics evolve over time. However, the formal relationship between these views remains unclear, and existing work mainly focuses on mitigation rather than the causal origin of shift within the agent-environment interaction. This work develops a unified causal-origin taxonomy that characterizes sources of distributional shift in RL and relates ID/OOD generalization to non-stationary settings. We transfer the classical dataset-shift principle from supervised learning to RL by reformulating distributional shift in terms of the generative interaction process. Using a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), we decompose the interaction into structural components, including the state distribution, observation process, policy, reward, and transition dynamics, together with the shifted-time boundary. The proposed taxonomy distinguishes internal, agent-driven, and external, environment-driven, distributional shifts. The shifted-time boundary perspective further characterizes explicit, implicit, and hybrid shifts. This formulation unifies ID/OOD generalization and non-stationarity as structured changes in the underlying process. We also introduce an evaluation framework for measuring shift impact and adaptation through performance degradation and recovery metrics. By grounding distributional shift in the causal-origin structure of RL, this work supports systematic analysis of robustness under distributional shift.

AI.tldr: 本文通过POMDP将强化学习中的分布偏移分解为因果结构内的成分变化，提出了一个统一的分类法，将ID/OOD泛化与非平稳性整合至同一评价框架下，为分析强化学习系统的鲁棒性提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习系统在面对与训练环境存在分布差异（如ID/OOD泛化或非平稳性环境）时，性能往往会下降。然而，学界对这些分布偏移现象背后的因果起源缺乏统一的理解，且现有研究多集中于“缓解措施”而非解析偏移的来源。
AI.method: 作者采用了以下方法：1. 提出一个统一的因果起源分类法（Causal-origin Taxonomy）；2. 利用部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）将强化学习交互分解为状态分布、观测过程、策略、奖励和转移动态等结构化组件；3. 引入基于“偏移时间边界”的分类视角（显式、隐式、混合）；4. 建立一套用于衡量性能下降与恢复的评估框架。
AI.result: 1. 成功建立了一个能区分内部（代理驱动）和外部（环境驱动）分布偏移的 taxonomy；2. 将ID/OOD泛化与非平稳性统一在生成交互过程中；3. 提供了一套定量的评估框架，能够通过性能指标来衡量系统面对偏移时的耐受力和适应速度。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将强化学习中的分布偏移归结为生成交互过程中的结构性变化，建立了一个统一的因果起源分类法。该框架为系统地评估代理在分布偏移下的鲁棒性提供了理论基础，并将非平稳性与ID/OOD泛化联系在一起，有助于未来的韧性系统设计。

title: Scalable Circuit Learning for Interpreting Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: A prominent research direction in mechanistic interpretability is learning sparse circuits over LLM components to reveal how they jointly produce model behavior. However, raw neurons are polysemantic, making learned circuits hard to interpret. Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features alleviate this, but their high dimensionality makes existing intervention-based circuit learning methods computationally prohibitive. We propose CircuitLasso, a scalable circuit-learning approach based on sparse linear regression. CircuitLasso recovers circuits whose structural accuracy matches that of state-of-the-art intervention-based methods on the benchmark data, at a fraction of the computational cost. For interpretability, CircuitLasso efficiently uncovers relationships among SAE features, showing how human-interpretable semantic features propagate through the model and influence its predictions. Finally, we validate the utility of our learned circuits by leveraging their insights to achieve comparable performance at substantially lower cost on a domain-generalization task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 CircuitLasso，一种基于稀疏线性回归的可扩展电路学习方法。它通过高效分析 SAE 特征间的关系，在降低计算成本的同时保留了高结构准确性，有效推进了 LLM 的机械可解释性。
AI.motivation: 在机械可解释性研究中，直接使用 LLM 的原始神经元因“多义性”（Polysemanticity）难以解释。虽然使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征可缓解该问题，但面对 SAE 的高维空间，现有的基于干预的电路学习方法计算开销过大，难以规模化。
AI.method: 提出 CircuitLasso 方法，基于稀疏线性回归（Sparse Linear Regression）进行电路学习，旨在克服传统基于干预（Intervention-based）的方法在处理高维稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征时的计算瓶颈。
AI.result: 1. 在基准数据上，CircuitLasso 的结构准确性与先进的基于干预的方法相当，但计算成本大幅降低；2. 成功揭示了 SAE 特征间的传播路径，展示了语义特征如何影响模型预测；3. 通过学到的电路在领域泛化任务中实现了性能与成本的平衡。
AI.conclusion: CircuitLasso 是一种可扩展且高效的稀疏电路学习方法，能够揭示 SAE 特征间的相互作用，在保持高结构准确性的同时显著降低了计算成本，为大模型的可解释性研究提供了一种实用工具。

title: Beyond the Smile: A Hybrid Convolutional VAE for Crypto Volatility Surfaces
summary: We present a convolutional variational autoencoder for cryptocurrency implied-volatility surfaces, together with a deployable predictor that combines it with a quadratic smile re-fit through a deterministic per-tenor routing rule. Trained on 6,034 fully-filled hourly Binance Options surfaces of BTC and ETH spanning May-October 2023 and parameterised on a common $6 \times 7$ tenor-delta grid, the model attains a hidden-cell surface-completion RMSE in the 0.94-1.56 vol-point range across both markets and mask rates 10-50%. The hybrid predictor attains 0.83 vol points at 50% masking against 7.00 for the smile re-fit alone, an eightfold reduction obtained at no additional inference cost. Under structurally-correlated hole patterns that emulate the withdrawal of an entire tenor of strikes, the smile re-fit incurs 9.6-13.1 vol points of error while the learned model remains at 1.5-1.9, isolating a regime in which the generative model is the only viable predictor. Joint training on BTC and ETH improves the in-distribution model on both markets by 9-27% relative to the better-performing single-symbol counterpart, indicating a substantially shared vol-surface manifold across the two largest cryptocurrencies over the observation window. The hybrid is calendar- and butterfly-arbitrage-free at the listed strikes, a property that the parametric smile re-fit alone fails at high mask rates. The per-snapshot reconstruction error of the trained model flags the late-October ETF-anticipation rally and the August $17$, $2023$ flash crash as elevated-error periods without supervision. All training and evaluation infrastructure is released to support reproducible follow-on work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合卷积变分自编码器与传统拟合规则的混合预测框架，用于高效、准确地补全和预测加密货币隐含波动率曲面，在保持无套利约束的同时，大幅提升了对结构性缺失数据的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 针对加密货币期权市场中隐含波动率曲面存在的不完整、缺失严重或数据噪声问题，传统的参数化拟合方法难以处理结构性缺失且易产生套利风险，需要一种能学习波动率面内在流形结构的生成式模型进行补全和预测。
AI.method: 提出了一种卷积变分自编码器（CVAE），并结合基于确定性逐期限路由规则的二次微笑曲线（smile）重拟合技术，构成混合预测器。在Binance的BTC与ETH期权数据（2023年5-10月）上进行联合训练。
AI.result: 该混合模型在50%数据遮挡率下达到了0.83波动率点的表现，远优于单纯二次拟合的7.00点；在处理极端结构性缺失（如整期限缺失）时，误差仅为1.5-1.9点，而二次拟合高达9.6-13.1点。此外，联合训练提升了9-27%的性能，且模型生成的曲面满足无套利约束。
AI.conclusion: 该混合模型有效捕捉了加密货币隐含波动率曲面的复杂结构，显著优于传统的二次拟合方法。跨标的（BTC/ETH）联合训练证明了两者具有高度共享的波动率曲面流形，且模型具备自动检测市场异常波动及保持无套利约束的能力。

title: Scalable Pairwise Kernel Learning with Stochastic Vec Trick
summary: Pairwise learning is a specialized form of supervised learning that focuses on predicting outcomes for pairs of objects. In this work, we introduce SPaiK, a new scalable kernel learning method tailored for pairwise settings. Our approach preserves the expressive power of kernel methods while substantially reducing computational and memory requirements. The key innovation is the stochastic generalized vec trick (sGVT), a stochastic extension of the sparse Kronecker product multiplication algorithm, which enables efficient large-scale training with pairwise kernels. By incorporating sGVT, SPaiK makes it possible to apply kernel-based pairwise learning to datasets of a size previously out of reach. We evaluate the performance of SPaiK on seven real-world drug-target affinity datasets and compare the results with state-of-the-art methods in pairwise learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 SPaiK，一种利用随机广义向量化技巧 (sGVT) 的高效成对核学习方法，解决了大规模成对学习的计算与内存瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统的成对核学习方法计算和内存开销巨大，在大规模数据集上无法高效应用，限制了其在实际场景（如药物-靶点亲和力预测）中的扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了 SPaiK（Scalable Pairwise Kernel Learning），其核心创新点为“随机广义向量化技巧”（Stochastic Generalized Vec Trick, sGVT），这是一种针对稀疏克罗内克积乘法算法的随机扩展。
AI.result: 在七个真实世界药物-靶点亲和力数据集上的实验表明，SPaiK 在保持高性能的同时，显著提升了处理大规模数据的效率，优于现有的成对学习方法。
AI.conclusion: SPaiK 是首个在保持核方法表达能力的同时，通过随机广义向量化技巧（sGVT）大幅降低成对学习计算与内存开销的方法，有效解决了大规模数据集在核成对学习中的适用性瓶颈。

title: Analytic Torsion and Spectral Gap Capture Persistent-Laplacian Performance
summary: While persistent Laplacians (PL) offer a richer geometric representation of data than persistent homology, utilizing their full eigenspectrum for learning tasks is often hampered by high dimensionality and the ``varying length'' problem across different filtration scales. We propose a compact spectral representation that distills the persistent Laplacian into three mathematically grounded invariants: Betti numbers, the spectral gap, and analytic torsion. Across benchmark datasets including MNIST, QM-3D, and SKEMPI WT, we demonstrate that this reduced feature space captures the essential predictive signal of the full spectrum, and in some cases outperforms it, while significantly reducing computational overhead and preventing the noise introduced by higher-frequency eigenvalues. Our results suggest that these invariants provide a principled, fixed-length interface between spectral geometry and topological learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过提取Betti数、谱间隙和解析挠率这三种不变式，将持久拉普拉斯算子的复杂谱信息转化为高效的固定长度特征，从而解决了其在拓扑学习中的维度和计算难题。
AI.motivation: 持久拉普拉斯算子（PL）虽然比持久同调具有更丰富的几何表达能力，但其完整谱存在高维性、“变长”以及计算开销大的问题，难以直接应用于机器学习任务。
AI.method: 提出了一种紧凑的谱表示方法，通过提取持久拉普拉斯算子的三个数学不变式：Betti数、谱间隙（spectral gap）和解析挠率（analytic torsion）作为特征。
AI.result: 在MNIST、QM-3D和SKEMPI WT等基准数据集上，该方法不仅显著降低了计算成本，减少了高频噪声干扰，而且其预测性能与利用完整谱相当，甚至在某些情况下更优。
AI.conclusion: 提出的三种不变式（Betti数、谱间隙、解析挠率）为持久拉普拉斯算子提供了一个固定长度的数学表达接口，有效地替代了完整谱，在保持精度的同时降低了计算复杂度。

title: From Tokens to Policy: Causal and Interpretable Heterogeneous Treatment Effects Identification
summary: Heterogeneous Treatment Effect (HTE) identification is crucial to explain the impact of an intervention and optimize our policies accordingly. Existing approaches trade expressivity for interpretability, but, if some active heterogeneity drivers are unmeasured, methods at both ends of this spectrum allow for spurious HTE characterization with no causal reading. In this work, we focus on controlled experiments and argue that an oracle HTE causal characterization via the latent interactors is now within reach, thanks to (i) more extensive pre-treatment measurements, i.e., multi-modal and multi-view, and (ii) scalable representations with minimal human supervision. We then re-frame HTE identification as a Markov-blanket discovery problem on a sufficient and aligned pre-treatment representation, and introduce Neural EXposure Interaction Search (NEXIS), an iterative procedure with provable and empirically validated consistent selection. We deploy NEXIS on two anti-poverty programs in Africa, augmenting each with satellite imagery capturing previously unmeasured environmental effect modifiers, leading to novel, interpretable and prescriptive guidelines to optimize the programs' next iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 NEXIS 的算法，旨在通过在多模态预处理数据中发现马尔可夫毯，解决非独立同分布干扰导致的虚假异质性处理效应 (HTE) 问题，并在实际贫困干预中实现了性能优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的 HTE 方法在可解释性和表达能力之间难以平衡，且当存在未测量的活跃异质性驱动因素时，容易导致无因果意义的虚假 HTE 表征。作者旨在利用更广泛的预处理测量数据和可扩展的非监督表征学习，实现基于潜在交互因子的“神谕级”HTE 因果表征。
AI.method: 将 HTE 识别重新框架化为预处理表征中的“马尔可夫毯”(Markov-blanket) 发现问题；提出了 Neural EXposure Interaction Search (NEXIS) 算法，通过迭代过程实现一致性变量选择；整合了多模态数据（如卫星图像）以捕捉未测量的环境调节因子。
AI.result: 证明了 NEXIS 在理论上具有一致性选择能力，并在两个非洲反贫困项目中进行了实证，通过引入卫星图像捕获的环境调节变量，成功生成了新的、可解释且具有指导意义的干预优化建议。
AI.conclusion: NEXIS 能够通过在多模态预处理表征中发现“马尔可夫毯”来识别异质性处理效应 (HTE)，解决了因潜在未测量变量导致的虚假因果关系问题，并在实际减贫项目中体现了可解释性与决策指导价值。

title: ExpRL: Exploratory RL for LLM Mid-Training
summary: Sparse reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for improving LLM reasoning, but its success depends critically on the coverage present in the base model. In practice, models are often primed for RL through \emph{mid-training} on curated reasoning traces that teach useful primitive skills such as decomposition, verification, or self-correction. Although effective, this strategy requires manually specifying what the model should learn, and it remains unclear whether such primitive coverage is enough for much harder problems, which require combining these skills into broader solution strategies. We study a more automated approach: \emph{RL-based mid-training} using large corpora of human-written question-answer data. Rather than treating reference solutions as targets to imitate, our method, ExpRL, uses them as \emph{reward scaffolds}: references are hidden from the policy and used only to construct problem-specific grading rubrics for judging on-policy reasoning traces. The policy samples from the original problem prompt, while an LLM judge compares the sampled reasoning trace against the reference solution and assigns outcome-level or process-level dense rewards. This lets ExpRL reinforce partial progress, useful intermediate reductions, and productive reasoning behaviors that sparse final-answer rewards often fail to upweight. On challenging math reasoning tasks, ExpRL yields stronger RL priming than SFT, sparse-reward GRPO, and self-distillation, and provides a better initialization for subsequent sparse-reward RL. Additional mixed-domain experiments further suggest that ExpRL can extend beyond the original math-only setting.

AI.tldr: ExpRL通过将参考答案转化为“参考支架”，利用LLM评价过程，为模型提供密集奖励，从而在复杂推理任务中实现了比传统SFT和稀疏奖励RL更有效的模型预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于稀疏奖励（Sparse Reward）的强化学习依赖于基座模型本身的能力，而依赖人工策划轨迹的预训练（mid-training）不仅成本高且难以应对复杂问题中多种技能的组合。研究者旨在寻求一种自动化的预训练方法，以有效强化复杂的推理过程。
AI.method: 提出ExpRL（Experience-based RL）方法。该方法不直接模仿参考答案，而是利用参考答案构建“奖励支架”（reward scaffolds），通过LLM裁判对模型自主生成的推理过程进行过程级或结果级的密集奖励（dense rewards）评估。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学推理任务中，ExpRL的表现优于监督微调（SFT）、稀疏奖励GRPO和自我蒸馏（self-distillation）；同时，该方法在跨领域实验中也展现了良好的泛化潜力。
AI.conclusion: ExpRL提供了一种有效且自动化的RL预训练（mid-training）策略，通过将参考答案作为奖励支架，能显著提升模型在复杂推理任务中的表现，并为后续的稀疏奖励强化学习提供更优的初始化。

title: Your Privacy My Cloak: Backdoor Attacks on Differentially Private Federated Learning
summary: Prior research suggests that differential privacy (DP) inherently enhances the robustness of federated learning (FL) against backdoor attacks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption. Through an empirical analysis of two baseline attack strategies, we uncover a fundamental tension in DP-FL: while bypassing DP allows state-of-the-art defenses to detect and filter malicious updates, complying with DP inadvertently masks their distinguishing statistical characteristics. Consequently, existing defenses become ineffective as DP reduces the raw backdoor signal. Building on this masking effect, we propose RING, a novel attack that explicitly exploits DP to conceal malicious contributions while maximizing attack impact. By collaboratively crafting adversarial perturbations, compromised clients reconstruct a strong backdoor signal during aggregation without triggering anomaly detection. RING operates as a perturbation layer that is agnostic to the underlying backdoor technique, making it broadly applicable and composable with existing attacks -- a property that significantly amplifies the threat it poses to DP-FL. Extensive evaluations across four image and text datasets under non-iid distributions show that RING achieves an average attack success rate of 90.3% against six state-of-the-art defenses under a moderate privacy budget, an improvement of up to 26.08x over baseline strategies. Finally, we evaluate potential countermeasures and find that mitigating this threat incurs significant utility trade-offs, exposing a fundamental security gap in the deployment of differentially private FL.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了差分隐私（DP）会掩盖联邦学习中的后门攻击特征，导致现有防御失效；为此作者提出了RING攻击，利用DP机制隐蔽恶意贡献，证实了在DP-FL中存在难以通过常规防御手段解决的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 挑战“差分隐私（DP）能天然增强联邦学习（FL）对抗后门攻击”这一传统观点。研究发现，DP在保护隐私的同时，由于“屏蔽效应”遮盖了后门统计特征，导致现有防御机制在DP-FL环境下失效。
AI.method: 提出了一种新型攻击方法RING（Robustness-Injection via Noise-Gated attack）。该攻击通过在受损客户端协同构建对抗性扰动，使恶意更新在聚合时重构出后门信号，同时利用DP噪声隐蔽恶意特征以规避异常检测。
AI.result: 在四个数据集、非独立同分布（non-IID）环境下，RING在面对6种最先进防御机制时，平均攻击成功率达到90.3%，相比基线攻击策略提升最高达26.08倍。
AI.conclusion: 差分隐私与联邦学习防御机制之间存在根本性的安全权衡。现有通过抑制异常信号来防御后门的方法在DP噪声下失效，RING攻击证明了在DP约束下仍可实现高成功率的后门注入，且目前的潜在防御措施会导致显著的模型效用损失。

title: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 (Oral). Code is available at https://github.com/jeakwon/ai-engram/
summary: Memory formation is fundamental to intelligence, yet whether deep neural networks preserve identifiable memory traces analogous to biological memory units remains an open question. This work introduces a geometric framework to identify such "AI engrams" by formalizing the neuroscientific criteria of specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, and necessity into a constrained inverse problem. We derive a closed-form estimator that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters, and show that this biologically-derived solution corresponds to a natural gradient update on the parameter manifold. AI engrams enable surgical manipulation of learned knowledge: any subset of memories can be composed or erased through linear arithmetic, without iterative optimization. Experiments ranging from simple MLPs to LLMs demonstrate the causal validity and substantial scalability of AI engrams. Together, these results bridge theories of biological memory and artificial representation learning and offer geometric insight into how deep networks simultaneously support functional specificity within distributed storage.

AI.tldr: 本研究引入“AI印迹”几何框架，通过闭式估计器从深度神经网络的参数中成功分离出特定记忆，实现了无需迭代优化的精准知识编辑，连接了生物记忆理论与深度学习表示。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究深度神经网络是否如同生物系统一样，具备可识别的、类似于“记忆单元”的痕迹，并解决如何在分布式网络参数中精确定位、操作特定记忆知识的难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种几何框架，通过约束逆问题（constrained inverse problem）的形式化表达，定义了生物学意义上的“AI印迹（AI engrams）”；推导出一个闭式估计器（closed-form estimator），将局部记忆轨迹从全局耦合参数中解耦；证明该方法在参数流形上对应于自然梯度更新。
AI.result: 实验证明了AI印迹具有因果有效性与高度可扩展性（适用于从简单MLP到大语言模型LLM的各类架构）；支持通过简单的线性算术对特定记忆子集进行合成或删除，无需额外的迭代优化。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功构建了一个将生物记忆理论与人工表示学习连接起来的几何框架，揭示了深度神经网络中分布式存储与功能特异性并存的机制，并为理解AI的可解释性与知识编辑提供了强有力的工具。

title: Your Agent Has a Genome: Sequence-Level Behavioral Analysis and Runtime Governance of LLM-Powered Autonomous Agents
summary: We propose Base Sequence Analysis, a framework that encodes the runtime behavior of LLM-powered autonomous agents into compact symbolic sequences using a four-letter alphabet: X (Explore), E (Execute), P (Plan), and V (Verify). Drawing an analogy to genomic sequence analysis, we apply n-gram pattern mining, Markov transition matrices, and point-biserial correlation to 347 real-world execution traces collected from a production ReAct agent system over 8 days. Our analysis reveals that (1) the trigram P-X-P is the only statistically significant high-risk pattern, lowering success rate by 10.4%; (2) P-ratio is the strongest negative predictor of success (r=-0.256, p<0.0001); and (3) the E->V transition probability is only 2.1%, indicating a systemic verification deficit. Based on these findings, we design Governor, a three-layer runtime intervention system comprising a rule engine, a statistical accumulator, and a chi-square-based threshold adaptor. In a natural before/after deployment evaluation (N=101 vs. N=246), Governor achieves a +6.2% absolute increase in task success rate while simultaneously reducing average token consumption by 44%. To validate cross-system generality, we apply the XEPV encoding to 2,000 public SWE-agent trajectories on SWE-bench, confirming that exploration spirals and the E->V verification deficit replicate in an independent system. We outline six research directions including base sequence language models, cross-agent behavioral fingerprinting, and reward shaping, and release an open-source toolkit for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为“基序列分析”的框架，将 LLM 智能体的行为映射为 XEPV 序列，发现其存在的“计划过度”和“验证缺失”问题，并开发了 Governor 系统，成功在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低了成本。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体缺乏对其复杂、非透明运行时行为的有效分析工具，导致错误诊断困难且资源利用效率低下。研究旨在通过类比基因序列分析，定量刻画智能体行为模式以优化其性能。
AI.method: 提出 XEPV（探索、执行、计划、验证）四字母编码框架；使用 n-gram 模式挖掘、马尔可夫转移矩阵和点二列相关性（Point-Biserial Correlation）分析 347 条生产环境轨迹；基于分析结果设计了包含规则引擎、统计累加器和卡方阈值适配器的三层运行时干预系统 Governor。
AI.result: 发现 P-X-P 三元组是降低 10.4% 成功率的高风险模式；计划比例（P-ratio）与成功率呈显著负相关；E→V 转移概率极低（2.1%），存在严重验证缺失。部署 Governor 后，成功率提升 6.2%，Token 消耗减少 44%，且在 SWE-bench 上验证了方法的跨系统普适性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基因为类比的 XEPV 编码框架（Base Sequence Analysis）和运行时干预系统（Governor），证实了对 LLM 智能体运行时行为进行量化分析不仅能识别高风险模式，还能通过轻量级干预显著提升任务成功率并降低计算成本。同时，该研究揭示了智能体系统中普遍存在的“验证缺失”和“探索螺旋”问题。

title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Process-Level Evaluation of Web Agents with Semantic State Tracking
summary: Web agents act through long interaction sequences, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only terminal success, discarding all process information and offering little guidance on improvement. In this work, we conduct a process-level analysis of web agents. We introduce WebStep, a benchmark of 1,800 task instances with controlled difficulty and automatic semantic state tracking. Each website exposes a deterministic semantic MDP alongside the GUI: the agent operates on the interface, while the environment records high-level states and transitions in the background, enabling fine-grained analysis without manual annotation. Based on the semantic trajectory, we first show that process metrics reveal differences invisible to outcome evaluation: three agents whose success rates cluster within 31-33% diverge in exploration reach versus execution accuracy. Then, decomposing by skill characterizes the nature of these differences, exposing opposite per-skill rankings hidden within the same website: e.g., on Housing, OpenAI CUA outperforms Qwen3.5 by 23.7% on commit actions yet underperforms it by 15.6% on filtering, pinpointing a concrete skill to improve even within a domain. Bifurcation analysis further localizes the decisive error that loses the task and shows that this error is agent-specific rather than shared. Finally, these differences widen as tasks grow harder: success rate is similar on easy tasks but separates sharply as exploration becomes more demanding. Our process-level analysis opens a new avenue in web agent evaluation, providing fine-grained and actionable insight into where and how each agent should be improved.

AI.tldr: 为了解决现有 Web 代理评估忽视过程信息的局限，本文提出了 WebStep 基准测试，通过自动追踪语义状态实现细粒度的过程级分析，有效诊断了代理在技能执行、探索能力及决策失误等方面的深层差异。
AI.motivation: 现有 Web 代理基准测试仅关注任务的最终结果，忽略了漫长交互过程中的中间信息，导致难以诊断代理的具体瓶颈，无法为改进提供有效的指导。
AI.method: 构建了 WebStep 基准测试集（包含1,800个任务实例），通过为每个网站提供确定性的语义马尔可夫决策过程（Semantic MDP）来辅助 GUI 操作，自动追踪高层状态与转移，从而在无需人工标注的情况下实现细粒度的过程级分析。
AI.result: 实验表明：1. 过程级指标能区分成功率相近但行为差异巨大的代理；2. 通过技能分解分析，发现代理在同一任务域的不同操作技能上表现存在显著偏差（如：导航 vs. 筛选）；3. 分叉分析成功定位了导致任务失败的具体决策点，且证实不同代理的失败原因具有特异性。
AI.conclusion: 相较于仅关注最终成功率的评估方式，本文提出的过程级分析（Process-level Analysis）能够揭示代理在探索与执行能力上的本质差异，为 Web 代理的针对性改进提供了量化且可操作的洞察。

title: Recurrent Reasoning on Symbolic Puzzles with Sequence Models
summary: Large language models often appear strong on symbolic and algorithmic tasks, yet this apparent strength can hide brittle behaviour when problems become longer, harder, or slightly out of distribution. A major limitation of current reasoning benchmarks is that many primarily test whether a model can produce a valid answer, while paying less attention to whether the solution is minimal, robust, and stable under controlled difficulty scaling. We introduce RecurrReason, a difficulty-controlled benchmark of four recurrent logic puzzles (Tower of Hanoi, River Crossing, Block World, and Checkers Jumping) with BFS-optimal trajectories and a single interpretable difficulty parameter $N \in \{1,\dots,10\}$, totalling 10{,}817 unique puzzles and 285{,}933 moves. We benchmark two Transformer families, an encoder-decoder model (T5-style) and a decoder-only model (GPT-2-style), under consistent data splits and evaluation criteria, training on $N{=}1$ to $7$ and evaluating on both held-out in-distribution instances and harder out-of-distribution instances at $N{=}8$ to $10$. Fine-tuned pre-trained T5 achieves 97.27\% validation and 81.00\% OOD accuracy on Block World; all models score 0.00\% on River Crossing under all conditions. Failure mode analysis reveals that architecture is a stronger determinant of success than scale. Pre-training transfers only to puzzles with locally structured transition functions. Our code and dataset will be open-sourced upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型在逻辑推理任务中的脆性问题，本文提出了难度可控的RecurrReason基准，发现架构设计比模型规模对逻辑推理的鲁棒性影响更大，且预训练知识迁移存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有推理基准测试过于关注最终结果正确性，忽略了求解过程的鲁棒性、稳定性以及随着问题规模扩大时的行为表现；明确评估模型在面对长序列、高难度及分布外问题时的脆性。
AI.method: 提出RecurrReason基准测试，涵盖4种经典逻辑谜题（汉诺塔、渡河问题、积木世界、跳棋），通过单一可控参数N（1-10）控制难度。使用T5（Encoder-Decoder）和GPT-2（Decoder-only）架构在相同数据分布下进行受控实验，并进行难度外推（OOD）评估。
AI.result: 实验表明即使是微调后的T5模型在特定任务（如积木世界）显示出较好的OOD迁移能力（81%），但在更具挑战性的任务（如渡河问题）中全军覆没。分析揭示了架构差异对性能影响显著大于模型参数扩放。
AI.conclusion: 模型架构（而非参数规模）是推理能力表现的决定性因素；预训练知识仅在具有局部结构化转换函数的任务中表现出迁移能力。现有LLM在处理长序列、复杂逻辑任务时依然存在严重的鲁棒性不足问题。

title: An Integrated System for Real-Time Student Assessment and Career Guidance Using Neural Networks in Computing Disciplines
summary: Many undergraduate students in Computer Science (CS) and Software Engineering (SWE) struggle to identify suitable career paths, particularly when their academic performance, abilities, and interests do not fully align. To address this issue, this study proposes an AI-driven Student Assessment and Career Prediction System that integrates a Career Guidance Expert (CGE) system with a Web-Based Student Assessment (WBSA) platform. Within the integrated framework, CGE enhances personalized career recommendations using AI while also assisting students after graduation in identifying suitable jobs, research domains, and higher study opportunities aligned with their skills and interests. The WBSA platform further strengthens interaction between students and faculty through assessments, personalized tasks, mentorship activities, and a secure real-time chat application. The CGE system employs a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) model trained on real-world academic and extracurricular data collected using the snowball sampling method from the students of universities, achieving a validation accuracy of 94.71% in predicting personalized career paths. A pre-survey was conducted across universities to evaluate the proposed model before deployment. The WBSA system was developed as a modern web application using technologies such as Node.js, Next.js, and PostgreSQL to ensure scalability, responsiveness, and secure data management. The overall system is supported by a secure cloud-based infrastructure, the platform provides reliable performance while assisting graduates to select suitable career path in IT sector. In addition, a post-survey involving both students and faculty was conducted to gather feedback and further improve the overall effectiveness and usability of the system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI驱动的职业生涯预测与评估系统，结合多层感知机(MLP)模型与Web平台，成功实现了对CS/SWE专业学生职业路径的精准预测（准确率94.71%），并提供了职业指导与师生互动工具，有效辅助学生毕业后的学业与就业选择。
AI.motivation: 许多计算机科学(CS)和软件工程(SWE)专业的学生在学业表现、能力与个人兴趣不匹配时，难以规划合适的职业路径。
AI.method: 1. 构建集成了职业指导专家系统(CGE)与基于Web的学生评估平台(WBSA)的框架。2. 采用多层感知机(MLP)模型对学生学术及课外数据进行训练与预测。3. 使用雪球抽样法收集数据，利用Node.js、Next.js及PostgreSQL等技术开发应用，并在云端部署。
AI.result: AI预测模型的验证准确率达到94.71%；完成了前置调研与后置反馈评估，验证了该系统在提升学生职业规划能力及师生互动方面的有效性和可用性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建并验证了一个基于AI的学生职业生涯评估与预测系统，证明了通过整合学术表现、技能与兴趣数据进行个性化推荐的高效性，为解决计算机类专业学生职业路径迷茫问题提供了有效的技术方案。

title: STRIDE: Strategic Trajectory Reasoning via Discriminative Estimation for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on final-answer correctness to assign trajectory-level rewards, providing sparse supervision and treating all tokens uniformly regardless of their actual contribution to reasoning. Although recent studies introduce intermediate signals such as process rewards, high-entropy tokens, and semantic uncertainty, these signals are often not inherently verifiable and may fail to distinguish beneficial strategic patterns from harmful ones. To address this limitation, we propose STRIDE (Strategic Trajectory Reasoning with Discriminative Estimation), a fine-grained RLVR framework that derives strategic reasoning supervision from verifiable outcomes. STRIDE contrasts successful and failed trajectories within each response group to estimate the outcome-discriminative preference of each $n$-gram strategic pattern, and further combines this signal with reasoning saliency entropy to identify decision-relevant strategic patterns. These patterns are assigned differentiated advantage values during RL optimization, enabling more precise credit assignment while preserving the verifiability of RLVR. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STRIDE consistently improves reasoning performance across diverse models, tasks, and extended settings, including VLMs and agent-based systems.

AI.tldr: STRIDE 提出了一种更细粒度的强化学习方法，通过对比成功与失败路径来识别并奖励推理过程中的关键战略模式，解决了传统 RLVR 奖励稀疏和信度分配不均的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 RLVR 方法仅依赖最终答案导致奖励极度稀疏，且无法对推理路径中不同 token 的贡献进行区分（缺乏细粒度监督）；现有的过程辅助信号往往缺乏可验证性或难以识别有效的战略模式。
AI.method: 提出 STRIDE (Strategic Trajectory Reasoning with Discriminative Estimation) 框架：通过对比同一响应组中成功与失败轨迹，估计 n-gram 战略模式的“结果区分偏好” (outcome-discriminative preference)；并结合推理显著性熵 (reasoning saliency entropy) 识别决策相关模式，从而在 RL 优化中实现差异化的信度分配。
AI.result: 实验表明，STRIDE 在各种模型、任务及扩展设置（如 VLM 和智能体系统）中均表现出持续的推理能力提升。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE 是一种有效的细粒度强化学习框架，能够通过对比成功与失败轨迹，将奖励精准分配给决策关键的战略模式，从而显著提升大语言模型的推理能力。

title: Agentic Framework for Deep Learning workload migration via In-Context Learning
summary: Translating deep learning models from PyTorch's flexible, object-oriented design to JAX's functional, stateless setup is usually a manual and error-prone task. Automated migration is challenging because Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with strict and dynamic API alignment and are prone to mistakes for exacting operations. We propose a fully autonomous system that combines In-Context Learning (ICL) with oracle-driven self-debugging. First, we curated an ICL context that serves as a strict reference for idiomatic JAX styling and test case generation. Second, instead of depending on the LLM to deduce mathematical outputs, we run the source PyTorch modules to get their actual dynamic tensor states. This creates an unchangeable execution oracle. We then use an autonomous agentic loop to synthesize tests based on the oracle data. The test cases are executed repeatedly, and the traceback is sent back to the LLM for self-correction. Ablations show that combining ICL references with oracle grounding and self-debugging greatly outperforms pure instructional and basic agentic baselines. This improvement does not add an excessive computational overhead. Our lightweight pipeline achieves 91% numerical equivalence (compared to baseline: 9%, instruction + self-debugging: 27%) on neural modules, providing a highly reliable, scalable blueprint for cross-framework migration. This has been validated across several state-of-the-art models including SAM (segment anything), T5, Code Whisper amongst others showing high numerical equivalency. Code: https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxCode

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合上下文学习（ICL）与执行预言机反馈循环的自动化框架，显著提升了从 PyTorch 到 JAX 模型迁移的数值等价性和可靠性，解决了单纯依靠大模型进行复杂代码映射的局限性。
AI.motivation: PyTorch 向 JAX 的迁移通常是手动且易出错的，而单纯依赖大语言模型（LLM）进行代码迁移因难以处理严格的 API 对齐而表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出了一套全自动系统，包含：1. 基于习惯性 JAX 风格和测试用例生成的 ICL（上下文学习）参考；2. 使用 PyTorch 原模块作为动态张量状态的执行预言机；3. 采用自主代理循环，根据预言机数据合成测试，并通过错误反馈进行循环自修正。
AI.result: 在神经模块上实现了 91% 的数值等价性（基准仅为 9%，指令+自调试为 27%），并在 SAM、T5 和 Code Whisper 等 SOTA 模型上得到验证，且未造成过度的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过结合上下文学习、实际执行预言机和自调试机制，成功实现了从 PyTorch 到 JAX 的高精度自动化模型迁移，证明了预言机引导的反馈循环在解决深度学习代码转换中的有效性。

title: Auditing Reward Hackability in Code RL Training Environments
summary: We measure the rate at which code RL environments accept incorrect solutions as correct. On a 49-task sample of SWE-bench Verified, 28.5% of tasks have test suites weak enough that a Docker-verified incorrect patch passes them. On 20 R2E-Gym tasks across 6 repositories, the same pipeline at single-shot exploit generation yields 25.0%. A random-effects meta-analysis over 134 frontier model submissions to SWE-bench Verified finds, within the same human-rated difficulty stratum, model Pass@1 is +14.14 percentage points higher on flagged-hackable tasks than on robust ones (95% CI [+11.80, +16.48]; one-sided p < 10^-6; I^2 = 0%; 123 of 134 models positive). We then describe a procedure for hardening the broken tasks. An inline LLM judge with a Docker gold-sanity gate runs each generated test against the gold solution before the judge is consulted. On the 11 broken tasks in the audit, the gate flags 65 of 105 decisive LLM-generated tests as failing on the gold patch itself, a 61.9% per-augmentation defect rate the LLM judge alone misses. With diversity-biased retry, the loop converges 9 of 11 tasks to a gated upgrade.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了代码评估基准中广泛存在的测试脆弱性问题，即测试套件无法有效过滤错误代码，导致模型性能被高估。作者通过量化评估这一现象的影响，并提出了基于Docker金标准校验的防御性修复方法。
AI.motivation: 当前代码强化学习（RL）评估环境中存在的测试套件脆弱性（即评估环境未能准确区分错误方案与正确方案的问题）会导致模型性能评估偏差，亟需对其影响范围进行量化并提出修复方案。
AI.method: 1. 评估分析：对SWE-bench Verified和R2E-Gym任务进行审计，检测测试集对错误代码的接收率；2. 统计分析：采用随机效应模型量化评估测试脆弱性对模型表现（Pass@1）的影响；3. 修复流程：设计包含内联LLM裁判和Docker金标准检查的防御机制，并通过多样性重试优化测试集生成。
AI.result: 研究发现28.5%的SWE-bench任务和25%的R2E-Gym任务存在测试脆弱性；模型在易被“黑”的任务上表现比鲁棒任务高出约14.14个百分点；修复机制在审计任务中能有效识别并修复测试集缺陷，显著提高了评估的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 现有代码RL评估环境普遍存在测试套件脆弱的问题，导致错误方案被误判为正确。通过引入“Docker金标准健全性检查（gold-sanity gate）”和“多样性偏置重试机制”，可以有效识别并修复这些脆弱任务，提升评估的鲁棒性。

title: RecourseBench: A Modular Framework for Reproducible Algorithmic Recourse Evaluation
summary: Algorithmic recourse methods provide counterfactual explanations that inform individuals of the actions required to overturn an unfavorable model decision. Despite rapid methodological progress, principled comparison remains elusive; existing frameworks are often difficult to extend and lack both interoperability and systematic verification that integrated methods faithfully reproduce their originally reported results. We introduce \emph{RecourseBench}, a unified evaluation framework built around three commitments namely, modularity, reproducibility, and interactivity. The framework decomposes the pipeline into five fully decoupled layers -- Data, Preprocessing, Model, Recourse Method, and Evaluation -- governed by abstract interfaces and a dynamic registry. To address the reproducibility gap in prior benchmarks, we introduce a four-tier classification system in which every integrated method is validated by an automated test suite against its originally reported results. We further provide an interactive web interface for flexible, configuration-driven comparison across methods, datasets, and model architectures. Our framework currently integrates 28 state-of-the-art recourse methods and, to our knowledge, constitutes the first recourse benchmark to explicitly enforce method-level reproducibility through automated, quantitative testing.

AI.tldr: RecourseBench 是一个新型算法归因评估框架，通过模块化解耦、四层级自动化复现性验证及交互式界面，弥补了现有基准在可扩展性和复现性方面的局限，集成了 28 种主流归因方法。
AI.motivation: 当前算法归因（Algorithmic Recourse）领域缺乏统一的评估标准，现有研究存在难以扩展、互操作性差以及无法有效验证原始结果复现性等问题。
AI.method: 提出 RecourseBench 框架，将评估流程解耦为数据、预处理、模型、归因方法和评估五个独立层；引入四级分类系统，通过自动化测试套件强制验证集成方法的复现性，并提供交互式 Web 界面进行配置化对比分析。
AI.result: 成功整合了 28 种最先进（SOTA）的归因方法，通过自动化定量测试确保了所有集成方法的可重复性，并提供了一个可灵活配置的交互式评估基准。
AI.conclusion: RecourseBench 是首个引入方法级自动化验证机制的算法归因评估平台，通过模块化、可重复性和交互式设计，解决了现有基准测试在扩展性、互操作性及复现性上的不足，为领域内系统比较提供了标准化范式。

title: Latent Thought Flow: Efficient Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on intermediate reasoning, yet explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) suffers from a linguistic space bottleneck: each thought must be decoded into tokens, causing high inference overhead. Latent reasoning moves deliberation into continuous space, but existing methods mostly learn deterministic or reward-maximizing paths, lacking a principled way to allocate probability across trajectories with different correctness and costs. We propose Latent Thought Flow (LTF), which models reasoning as variable-length continuous trajectories and trains a sampler to match a reward-induced posterior over answer quality and computation cost. We instantiate this with a continuous GFlowNet using stochastic latent transitions. To handle sparse answer supervision, we introduce an Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance objective for intermediate rewards and a reference-prior regularizer to anchor exploration. Experiments under finetuning and transfer learning settings show that LTF outperforms explicit CoT and latent reasoning baselines, improving accuracy by 9.5% while reducing reasoning length by 27.2% on average compared with strong latent reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LTF框架，通过在连续空间内利用GFlowNet进行变长路径推理，在提升模型准确性的同时显著降低了推理所需的算力负担。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链（CoT）存在语言空间瓶颈，导致推理效率低下；现有的潜空间推理方法缺乏处理准确性与计算成本之间权衡的原则性框架，且难以应对稀疏监督。
AI.method: 提出“潜思维流”（Latent Thought Flow, LTF），将推理过程建模为变长连续轨迹；利用基于随机潜状态转换的GFlowNet训练采样器，以匹配关于质量与成本的奖励后验分布；引入“熵加权子轨迹平衡”（Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance）目标及参考先验正则化以处理稀疏监督。
AI.result: LTF在微调和迁移学习实验中表现优异，相比顶尖的潜空间推理基准，准确率提升了9.5%，推理平均长度缩短了27.2%。
AI.conclusion: LTF通过将推理过程从离散的token空间转移到连续空间，并引入基于GFlowNet的轨迹采样，有效地平衡了准确性与计算效率，证明了其在推理任务中优于显式CoT及现有潜空间推理方法。

title: Medical Heuristic Learning: An LLM-Driven Framework for Interpretable and Auditable Clinical Decision Rules
summary: Predictive modeling for clinical tabular data is central to clinical decision support and therefore requires not only strong predictive performance but also transparent decision logic. Although deep learning and tree-based ensemble methods can achieve high accuracy, their black-box nature remains a major obstacle to clinical deployment. This challenge is further compounded by common characteristics of medical data, including limited sample sizes, severe class imbalance, and feature evolution arising from changes in diagnostic criteria and clinical documentation. To address these issues, we propose Medical Heuristic Learning (MHL), an instantiation of the learning-beyond-gradients paradigm for clinical tabular prediction. Instead of relying on neural network weight updates, MHL uses a large language model (LLM)-driven workflow that integrates statistical probes, medical knowledge probes, rule synthesis, and code-level iterative refinement to optimize a deterministic and executable decision system. The resulting model is expressed not as opaque parameters, but as versioned pure-Python decision rules that are explicitly interpretable, fully auditable, and clinically grounded. MHL also supports continual learning by starting from previously validated rules and iteratively revising them using updated feature information under data drift or feature evolution. Comprehensive experiments on medical datasets show that MHL achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods while maintaining strong behavior in small-sample and highly imbalanced settings. The results further indicate that this explicit rule update mechanism can help alleviate catastrophic forgetting under feature evolution. Overall, these findings suggest that non-gradient-based heuristic systems offer a transparent and adaptable alternative for high-stakes clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 针对临床预测模型“黑盒化”和难以应对数据演变的问题，该论文提出一种基于LLM的医疗启发式学习（MHL）方法，通过生成可直接执行、透明且可解释的Python决策规则，实现了在保持高性能的同时具备卓越的临床审计能力与持续学习能力。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持要求模型不仅具备高性能，还需具备高度的解释性和透明度。现有的深度学习和集成学习方法虽准确，但因“黑盒”性质难以在医疗领域落地，且难以应对医疗数据中常见的数据量小、类别失衡及特征演变（数据漂移）等问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种“学习超越梯度”（learning-beyond-gradients）的范式——医疗启发式学习（MHL）。该方法利用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的工作流，执行统计探测、医学知识探测、规则合成以及代码级迭代优化，最终生成版本化的纯Python决策规则。
AI.result: 在医疗数据集上的实验表明，MHL的预测性能可媲美当前最先进的方法，并在小样本、高类别失衡场景下表现优异。此外，该方法通过显式规则更新机制，有效缓解了面对特征演变时的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.conclusion: 非梯度驱动的启发式系统（MHL）作为临床决策支持工具，在保持高性能的同时，提供了高度透明、可审计且易于适应数据演变的替代方案，有效解决了深度学习在医疗场景中的“黑盒”与适应性难题。

title: The Faithfulness Gap: Certifying Semantic Equivalence Between Natural-Language and Formal Mathematical Statements
